See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciReplaceStructArg, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

functions.name: ciRegisterAction
functions.description: Registers a list of attributes associated with an action and optionally adds the action to the constraints-related context menu, the Constraint Manager assistant's Constraint Menu, or both. This function is an alias for the ciRegisterConstraintGenerator function. The purpose of this alias is to emphasize the fact that constraint generator SKILL expressions can do everything possible in SKILL and not just create constraints.

functions.name: ciRegisterAssistant
functions.description: Registers a new assistant (category) with the Circuit Prospector assistant. Assistants (categories) are groups of related Circuit Prospector finders. A category may represent a set of finders for a particular device type, for example fet, or a category could represent a top down/bottom up constraints flow. Categories can be registered automatically by placing them in a .cadence/dfII/ci/categories directory located on the Cadence File Search Path. The category registration SKILL code should be placed in a file in that directory with an .il extension, for example: .cadence/dfII/ci/categories/myCategory.il.

functions.name: ciRegisterConstraintEditor
functions.syntax: ciRegisterConstraintEditor( list(nil 'name t_name 'description t_description 'constraintType t_constraintType 'constraintParams l_constraintParams 'editorAvailableExpression t_editorAvailableExpression 'startEditorExpression t_startEditorExpression 'iconName t_iconName 'addToToolbar g_addToToolbar 'templateTypes l_templateTypes 'useForTemplateEdit g_useForTemplateEdit 'useForConstraintCreation g_useForConstraintCreation 'useForConstraintParamEdit g_useForConstraintParamEdit 'editableConstraintParams l_editableConstraintParams ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a constraint editor with the Constraint Manager assistant and, optionally, adds a button to the Constraint Manager toolbar. This button can be used to open the registered constraint editor. An entry is also added to the Constraint Editor submenu that appears on the context-sensitive menu of the Constraint Manager.

functions.name: ciRegisterConstraintGenerator
functions.syntax: ciRegisterConstraintGenerator( list(nil 'name              t_name 'description       t_description 'expression        t_expression [ 'addToToolbar    g_addToToolbar ] [ 'args            l_args ] [ 'callback        t_callbackExpr ] [ 'iconName        t_iconName ] [ 'menu            g_menu ] [ 'precondition    t_preconditionExpr ] [ 'settings        l_settings ] [ 'size            l_size ] [ 'title           t_title ] [ 'useCGenForEdit  g_useCGenForEdit ] ) ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a constraint generator with the Constraint Manager and, optionally, will make it available as an entry in the Constraint Creation toolbar drop-down list of the Constraint Manager and in the Generate Constraints list in the context-menu. The constraint generator can then be set as the default generator for a Circuit Prospector finder or used explicitly in the Constraint Manager to create constraints.

functions.name: ciRegisterCustomDeviceFilter
functions.description: Registers a custom filter or modifies an existing filter.

functions.name: ciRegisterDefaultNetName
functions.syntax: ciRegisterDefaultNetName(  t_deviceCategory l_lcvNames t_terminalCategory t_termName t_defaultNetName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a default net name for the given terminal for either: the cellview of the same category or all lib/cell/view specified.

functions.name: ciRegisterDevice
functions.description: Function used by the Circuit Prospector assistant to register a list of fet, nfet, pfet, BJT and passive device names to be used by ciIsDevice.

functions.name: ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory
functions.syntax: ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory(  t_libName t_categoryName t_deviceTypeName ) => l_regdDevices / nil
functions.description: Calls the ciRegisterDevice function to register all cells of the t_categoryName PDK category in the t_libName library as a device of type, t_deviceTypeName. In addition, the ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory function returns the list of devices registered because of the current action. This list does not includes the devices that were registered with the given device type name previously.

functions.name: ciRegisterDynamicParamDef
functions.syntax: ciRegisterDynamicParamDef(  s_consTypeName t_paramTypeName l_paramDef ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers dynamic parameter definition for a constraint type.  Only a native constraint type can have a set of dynamic parameters in addition to the predefined (static) parameters defined in Virtuoso. Unlike a normal constraint parameter, a user specifies and registers a dynamic parameter definition at run time in SKILL. Dynamic parameter definitions for custom constraint types can be added by creating different definitions of the constraint using config.xml. These definitions can be dynamically loaded using the ciLoadConfigXML or ciLoadConfigXMLFromString function. However, ensure that you must not change the definition while a design is open using a different definition.

functions.name: ciRegisterFinder
functions.syntax: ciRegisterFinder(  t_name t_description t_iterator t_expression t_defaultCGen [ g_partialGroupingOk ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a new finder with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using the Edit Finder form). Finders are used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over a design and collect together groups of instances, nets, and pins that share common characteristics. The finder expression will determine how these objects are grouped together. Finders can be registered automatically by placing them in a .cadence/dfII/ci/finders directory located on the Cadence File Search Path. The finder registration SKILL code should be placed in a file in that directory with an .il extension, for example .cadence/dfII/ci/finders/netTermCountFinder.il.

functions.name: ciRegisterIterator
functions.syntax: ciRegisterIterator(  t_name t_description t_iteratorFnName t_expression t_defaultCGen g_supportsFlattenedHier ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a new iterator with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using the Edit Iterator form). Iterators are used by the Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over the design in a specific way, applying a finder expression which determines how objects are grouped.

functions.name: ciRegisterNet
functions.syntax: ciRegisterNet(  t_netType l_netNameList [ ?regexNetNames l_regExpressionList ] [ ?predicate g_predicate ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the net names, regular expressions and predicates that make up a net type. A net belongs to t_netType if its name is one of l_netNameList, or if it matches one of l_regExpressionList, or if g_predicate returns t.

functions.name: ciRegisterNetNames
functions.description: Registers a list of net names recognized by ciIsNet().

functions.name: ciRegisterNetPredicate
functions.description: Registers a net predicate function used by ciIsNet().

functions.name: ciRegisterNetRegexs
functions.description: Registers a list of regular expressions recognized by ciIsNet().  A net belongs to t_netType if its name matches any of these expressions.

functions.name: ciRegisterNetSuperType
functions.description: This function creates a net type that automatically includes the names, regular expressions, and predicates registered in other net types. The new net type is known as a super-type, and the net types included in it as sub-types.

functions.name: ciRegisterStructure
functions.description: Registers a structure with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using Capturing New Structures).

functions.name: ciReinitStructTemplateDefs
functions.description: Re-initializes the template definitions created by the Circuit Prospector for registered structures. This is necessary if any of the structure arguments are modified. Typically, these modifications will be in the libInit.il file loaded when the PDK library is loaded or in a .cdsinit file.

functions.name: ciRemoveConstrainedPinNetsFromRails
functions.description: Deletes any constraints on pins where the net on the pin is also a member of a rail constraint because this is currently not supported by the Analog Placer.

functions.name: ciRemoveDuplicateMembers
functions.syntax: ciRemoveDuplicateMembers(  { d_cellViewID | l_constraintList } [ ?conType t_conType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes duplicate constraint members from constraints which do not support duplicate members.

functions.name: ciRemoveHierarchicalNotes
functions.syntax: ciRemoveHierarchicalNotes(  t_libName t_cellname t_viewname [ g_hierarchical ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes the existing notes from the templates and constraints for a single cellview or all along the hierarchy beginning from the given cellview.

functions.name: ciRemoveLeadingSlash
functions.description: Removes the leading forward slash from a string if it has one.

functions.name: ciRemoveProcessRules
functions.description: Removes all process rules associated with the given object.

functions.name: ciRemoveSymmetricPinAlignments
functions.description: This utility function used by the Rapid Analog Prototype Enforce Precedence constraint generator to remove alignment constraints on symmetric pins.

functions.name: ciRemoveTrailingSlash
functions.description: Removes the leading forward slash from a string if it has one.

functions.name: ciReopenCellView
functions.description: Reopens the constraint view in read or edit mode.  Note: This function does not apply to layout constraint caches.

functions.name: ciReorderAssistants
functions.description: Reorders the listing of Circuit Prospector assistants (categories). The new ordering should be a list of the existing category names in the order that you wish them to appear in the Circuit Prospector category drop-down list.

functions.name: ciReplaceStructArg
functions.syntax: ciReplaceStructArg(  s_structType t_argName l_newArg ) => t / nil
functions.description: For the passed structure type this function replaces the named constraint generator argument with a new argument definition. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

functions.name: ciResetDIImplementation
functions.description: Resets the implementation status, implementation notes, and signed off status of all design intents in the constraints cache so that the cellview can be reused.

functions.name: ciResistorArrayUpdateRowColVal
functions.description: Increases or decreases the row and column values of the series or parallel resistor array template that contains the currently selected modgen. If the selected topology orders the resistor devices by Row, the value displayed in the Col field is updated using this function. Conversely, if the selected topology orders the resistor devices by Col, the value displayed in the Row field is updated.

functions.name: ciResolveBulkNet
functions.syntax: ciResolveBulkNet(  t_device l_hierContext [ ?viewNameList g_viewNameList ] [ ?stopViewList g_stopViewList ] ) => list / nil
functions.description: This function is used with Circuit Prospector finder expressions to retrieve the bulk net on a device and resolves the net to the highest level in the design.

functions.name: ciResolveNet
functions.syntax: ciResolveNet(  d_netDBid g_hierContext [ ?simplify t_simplify ] ) => g_resolvedNetInfo / nil
functions.description: Resolves the passed net to the highest equivalent design net. Used by Circuit Prospector finders when run on flattened hierarchies. For example, the Active Common Gate finder.

functions.name: ciRunFinder
functions.syntax: ciRunFinder(  t_finderName t_iteratorFnName t_finderExpression t_constraintGenExpr [ g_iteratorSupportFlatHier ] [ t_hierScope ] [ n_depth ] [ g_cache ] [ s_predicate ] ) => list
functions.description: Runs a Circuit Prospector finder and returns a list of objects grouped according to the finder expression evaluation result. If the depth argument is specified and the hierScope argument is 'depthCellViews, the finder searches only up to the specified depth. If cache is specified, the finder runs on that cache; otherwise, the search results are obtained from the current window. See also ciRegisterFinder and ciRegisterIterator.

functions.name: ciRunFindersAndGenerators
functions.syntax: ciRunFindersAndGenerators( g_cache t_categoryName [ ?runGenerators g_runGenerators ] [ ?deleteExisting g_deleteExisting ] [ ?addHierNotes g_addHierNotes ] [ ?printFinderResults g_printFinderResults ] [ ?updateArgsExpr g_updateArgsExpr ] [ ?triggerCBinMode g_triggerCBinMode ] ) => list
functions.description: Runs all the finders and their corresponding generators for the specified constraint cache and Circuit Prospector category. The finders first find all the results and then the constraint generators are ran on those results to create constraints and templates.

functions.name: ciRunGenerator
functions.syntax: ciRunGenerator( g_cache t_cGenName l_instsNetsPins [ ?argValuesToUpdate g_argValuesToUpdate ] [ ?triggerCBinMode g_triggerCBinMode ] ) => list
functions.description: Given a constraint cache, a generator name and a list of objects(insts, nets, pins & terminals), the function Runs the specified constraint generator in the given constraint cache for the specified list of objects, that is, instances, nets, pins, and terminals. This function is called by ciRunFindersAndGenerators to run the constraint generator.

functions.name: ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator
functions.syntax: ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator(  t_strength d_insts u_cache ) => t / nil
functions.description: This SKILL function is run by the Matching(Strength) constraint generator expression and used to create matching template constraints.

functions.name: ciRunPrecondition
functions.syntax: ciRunPrecondition( g_cache t_cGenName l_instsNetsPins ) => l_templates / t / nil
functions.description: Runs all the precondition checks that are needed before a constraint generator can be run.

functions.name: ciSameCellIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all design instances with the same master collecting them together into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderDeviceExpr). This iterator ensures that the devices within a group have the same master. All devices with the same master, which have the same finderDeviceExpr result, are grouped together. If the finderDeviceExpr evaluates to nil then the device is ignored.

functions.name: ciSaveConstraintGenerator
functions.description: Saves a constraint generator in the .cadence/dfII/ci/generators directory with the name given to it. The spaces in the constraint generator's name are replaced by underscores.

functions.name: ciSelectedConstraints
functions.description: Returns a list of selected constraint IDs that are contained in the passed constraints cache.

functions.name: ciSelectedTemplates
functions.description: Returns a list of selected template IDs that are contained in the passed constraints cache.

functions.name: ciSeparateInstsNetsPins
functions.description: Converts the instsNetsPins list into a disembodied property list to allow easier access to the instances, nets, pins, and instTerms in the sub-lists. This function is used within constraint generators.

functions.name: ciSeriesResistorArrayIterator
functions.description: Iterates over all resistor devices, collating them into groups of sequentially-arranged resistors that create the longest serial chain between two nets. The serial chain splits at a T-junction point. This function is used by the Series Resistor Array finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

functions.name: ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks
functions.description: Controls the constraint groups that are visible in the Constraint Manager.

functions.name: ciSetDIPropertyGroupDefs
functions.description: Sets the design intent property group definitions to the specified definitions. All existing property group definitions are deleted.

functions.name: ciSetDefaultConstraintEditor
functions.description: Sets the specified editor as the default constraint editor. The change will take effect at the next start-up of the Virtuoso Schematic Editor or Virtuoso Layout Editor. To keep the change persistent on each start-up of Virtuoso, set this function in an initialization file.

functions.name: ciSetHaloOptions
functions.description: Invokes a user interface that allows you to set the various constraint visualization options.

functions.name: ciSetHaloPolicy
functions.description: Sets the policy for object haloing and grouping.

functions.name: ciSetMaxHaloGroupSize
functions.description: Allows the setting of a limit on the number of database objects to be haloed and grouped together when a constraint is selected in the Constraint Manager. The setting of a group size limit is only possible when minDisplay has been set as the halo policy using ciSetHaloPolicy.

functions.name: ciSetModgenTopology
functions.description: Sets the database topology on the modgen and deletes any pre-existing database topologies.

functions.name: ciSetStructArgVal
functions.description: Replaces the specified structure argument value with the specified value. This SKILL function can be used to override the default settings for the predefined structures.

functions.name: ciSetStructArgs
functions.description: Sets the constraint generator arguments for the passed structure type. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg. ciReplaceStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

functions.name: ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions
functions.description: Sets the constraint generator expressions for the passed structure type. The generator expressions are specified within a ciStructGeneratorExpressions def struct. These expressions are evaluated by the ciCreateModgen function during modgen creation and modification. See also, ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions, ciListStructGeneratorExpressions, and ciCreateModgen.

functions.name: ciSetStructPDKMult
functions.description: Sets the PDK specific multiplier for the passed structure type and PDK name. The PDK multipliers are typically used within constraint generator argument expressions to scale the values in a PDK independent way. See also, ciGetStructPDKMult.

functions.name: ciSetSymmetricAxes
functions.description: Where symmetry constraints exist with multiple axes, forces a single axis of symmetry to be the most commonly used axis.

functions.name: ciSigTypeMatchesNetType
functions.description: This function creates a net predicate that checks whether or not the sigType attribute of a net matches a given net type.

functions.name: ciSignalIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all signals in the passed cellview, and return a list of corresponding signals.

functions.name: ciSimpleName
functions.description: Expands the passed name and simplifies it (removes duplicates). If the resulting name is a single string then this is returned otherwise the original name string is returned.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByFingerWidth
functions.description: Returns devs ordered by finger width. The device with the largest finger width will appear first in the list.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByMfactor
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by mfactor. The device with the largest mfactor will appear first in the list.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByX
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing X. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByXY
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing X and increasing Y where, devices have same X. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X/Y coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByY
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing Y. Margin defines the margin for equivalent Y coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByYX
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing Y and increasing X where devices have same Y. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X/Y coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortedOpenCellViews
functions.description: Returns a list of open constraint caches from ciGetOpenCellViews sorted using ciConstraintViewLessp.

functions.name: ciTemplateAddCons
functions.description: Adds one or more ci constraints to a ci constraint template.

functions.name: ciTemplateChangeDIProfile
functions.description: Replaces the property profile currently selected for a design intent template.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreate
functions.syntax: ciTemplateCreate(  u_cache t_templateDefinitionName [ ?name t_name ] [ ?members l_members ] [ ?params l_params ] [ ?userParams t_userParams ] ) => templateId / nil
functions.description: Creates a new template.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreateDI
functions.syntax: ciTemplateCreateDI( g_cache t_templateType { diDevices | diNets | diPins | diMaxVoltageDrop |     diHighCurrent | diCell } t_name l_memberNamesTypes [ ?profile t_profileName ] [ ?params l_paramNameAndValue ] [ ?propNameValue l_propNameValue ] ) => u_templateId / nil
functions.description: Creates a design intent template for the specified template type.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreateDefinition
functions.syntax: ciTemplateCreateDefinition( t_typeName s_checkSymbolName s_createSymbolName [ ?params l_params ] [ ?acceptsUserParams s_acceptsUserParams ] [ ?transferSymbolName s_transferSymbolName ] [ ?preDestroySymbolName s_preDestroySymbolName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a template definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreateExpanded
functions.syntax: ciTemplateCreateExpanded(  u_cache t_templateDefinitionName [ ?name t_name ] [ ?members l_members ] [ ?params g_params ] [ ?userParams g_userParams ] [ ?compress g_compress ] ) => templateId / nil
functions.description: The same functionality as ciTemplateCreate, but first expands any iterated or repeated members. For example, MN1<0:2> gets expanded to MN1<0>, MN1<1>, and MN1<2>.   In the case of net repetitions, such as <*3>inp, by default these get expanded N times as inp, inp, inp. However, if the optional compress argument is set to t, then <*3>inp will be expanded to just inp. The same applies to net bundles that contain repetitions. For example <*3>inp,a,b,c,inp,inp will by default be expanded to inp,inp,inp,a,b,c,inp,inp but with compress set to t will be expanded to inp,a,b,c.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIProfileName
functions.description: Returns the name of the profile associated with the specified design intent template.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIPropDef
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns the definition of the named property in the form of a DPL.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIPropGroupDef
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns the definition of all the properties in the form of a DPL.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIPropValue
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns the value of a named property.

functions.name: ciTemplateDefinitionExists
functions.description: Verifies whether a template definition with a given name exists.

functions.name: ciTemplateDelete
functions.description: Deletes given template.

functions.name: ciTemplateDeleteCons
functions.syntax: ciTemplateDeleteCons(  u_templateId l_listOfConstraints [ s_doDelete t | nil ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function deletes or removes one or more CI constraints from a CI constraint template.

functions.name: ciTemplateFind
functions.description: Finds template in cache.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetCache
functions.description: Returns the constraint cache that contains the template.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetComment
functions.description: Returns the comment that shows the template status.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetCreatedTime
functions.description: This function returns the creation time of a template, which is the time and date close to a second when the template has been created.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetDefName
functions.description: Gets the template definition name.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetName
functions.description: Gets the template name.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetNote
functions.description: Returns the note parameter of a template.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetStatus
functions.description: Returns the template status.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetType
functions.description: Returns the symbolic name of the given template type, such as commonCentroid.

functions.name: ciTemplateIsKindOfDI
functions.description: Confirms if the specified constraint template is a design intent template. The available design intent templates are: diDevices, diNets, diPins, diMaxVoltageDrop, diHighCurrent, and diCell.

functions.name: ciTemplateListCon
functions.description: Gets the template constraint list.

functions.name: ciTemplateListDIProps
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns a list of the property names, types, and values.

functions.name: ciTemplateListParamNames
functions.description: Returns a list of template parameter names if the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateListParams
functions.description: Returns a list of template parameter name, type, and value, provided the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateResetAllParams
functions.description: Resets all template parameters to their default values.

functions.name: ciTemplateResetParams
functions.description: Resets one or more template parameters to their default value.

functions.name: ciTemplateSetNote
functions.description: Sets the note parameter of a template.

functions.name: ciTemplateSetStatus
functions.syntax: ciTemplateSetStatus(  u_templateId s_statusSymbol t_statusComment ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the template status.

functions.name: ciTemplateSortParamDefs
functions.description: Sorts parameter definitions of a template type, by name and returns a list of parameter definitions sorted in alphabetical order.

functions.name: ciTemplateUpdateDIProps
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, updates the value of the named property.

functions.name: ciTemplateUpdateParams
functions.description: This function updates the parameter values of the listed parameters for templates that have one or more parameter definitions.

functions.name: ciTemplatep
functions.description: Checks if an object is a valid constraint template ID.

functions.name: ciToFloat
functions.description: Returns a floating point number for the passed value. If the value is a string, then it will be evaluated and the result returned.

functions.name: ciTransferConstraintsInProgress
functions.description: Returns a Boolean to indicate whether constraint transfer is in progress.

functions.name: ciTypeBindingParameter
functions.description: Returns the name of the registered binding parameter for a constraint type or an empty string if none is registered.

functions.name: ciTypeDefBaseType
functions.description: Returns the base type of the passed custom constraint type. You can define multiple versions of a custom constraint type in config.xml by assigning a unique constraint type name to different constraint types that all share the same base type name. This allows multiple versions of the same base constraint type to exist at the same time. To return the version number of a constraint type, see ciTypeDefVersion.

functions.name: ciTypeDefVersion
functions.description: Returns the version number of the passed constraint type. The default version number is 1. Custom constraint types defined through config.xml can specify the version number of the constraint through a version tag.

functions.name: ciTypeHasBindingParameter
functions.description: Checks if a binding parameter has been registered for the specified constraint type.

functions.name: ciTypeIsType
functions.description: Checks if the specified typeName is a constraint type name, which may be a built-in type, such as distance, or a user-defined custom constraint type that has been specified in a config.xml file.

functions.name: ciTypeIsUserDefined
functions.description: Checks if the specified typeName is a user-defined custom constraint type that is specified in a config.xml file.

functions.name: ciTypeListCon
functions.syntax: ciTypeListCon(  u_cache t_constraintType [ g_includeOutOfContext ] ) => l_designObject / nil
functions.description: Lists all the constraints of a given type for a given cache.

functions.name: ciUnRegisterTerm
functions.syntax: ciUnregisterTerm(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_termName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Unregisters the terminal of a l/c/v if that terminal has already been registered with a default net.

functions.name: ciUnexpandDeviceInfo
functions.description: Contracts any mfactored device names and optionally any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The mfactored device names used in the layout are of the format |<instName>.<mFactorIndx>, such as |MN1.3, and the iterated device names may be schematic device names like MN1<0> or layout device names like |MN1(0). In the layout, the device names may be mfactored and iterated, such as|MN1(3).4.  When a collection of mfactored device names are contracted (for example, |MN1.2, |MN1.3, |MN1.4) a single device will appear in the returned deviceInfo list using the base device name like |MN1, and the mfactor property will be set to the total number of devices that were contracted, in this case 3.

functions.name: ciUnexpandIteratedDeviceInfo
functions.description: Contracts any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The iterated device names may be schematic device names, such as MN1<0>, or layout device names, such as |MN1(0).

functions.name: ciUnexpandPhysicalDeviceInfo
functions.description: This is a utility function used in modgen generation for converting a physical devInfo disembodied property list into a logical devInfo disembodied property list. The devInfo disembodied property lists are created by calling ciCollectDeviceInfo for schematic (logical) and layout (physical) devices.

functions.name: ciUniqueMembers
functions.description: This utility function returns the unique members from the specified member list. It is typically used for member lists that can contain repeated member names due to mFactor expansion.

functions.name: ciUnregisterAssistant
functions.description: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector assistant (category) that was previously registered using ciRegisterAssistant.

functions.name: ciUnregisterConstraintEditor
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered constraint editor. If the constraint editor appears in the Constraint Manager's Constraint Editors menu, then running this function removes it from the menu list.

functions.name: ciUnregisterConstraintGenerator
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered constraint generator.

functions.name: ciUnregisterIterator
functions.description: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector iterator that was previously registered by using ciRegisterIterator. If successful, the iterator will no longer appear in the Edit Finder list or the Edit Iterator list.

functions.name: ciUnregisterNetSuperType
functions.description: Removes a net super-type, leaving its sub-types intact.

functions.name: ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes
functions.syntax: ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ g_hierarchical ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the existing notes on the templates and constraints for a single cellview or all along the hierarchy beginning from the given cellview.

functions.name: ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers
functions.syntax: ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers(  g_modgen  l_newModgenParams  l_newModgenMembers ) => t / nil
functions.description: A utility function, which updates the passed modgen constraint parameters and members.

functions.name: ciUpdateObjPropsFromDI
functions.description: Runs a callback to propagate design intent properties to the associated design intent objects. The function can be called when the Create Design Intent form or Edit Design Intent form are submitted.

functions.name: ciUprevEAConstrs
functions.description: Modifies and corrects those constraints in the 610EA (early adopter) release which became obsolete in the full 610 release. Specifically, this command will update any layout structure constraints to be modgen, cluster, or cluster boundary constraints.

functions.name: ciUtilsAddNTimes
functions.syntax: ciUtilsAddNTimes( g_val x_n t_valFmt g_addQuotes t_sep ) => x_str
functions.description: This utility function is used in modgen constraint generation for creating a string with repeated values.

functions.name: ciUtilsAddQuotes
functions.description: This function is used in constraint generation for converting a list of strings into a string where each string in the list will have double quotes when added to the string.

functions.name: ciUtilsBuildString
functions.description: This is a utility function for building a string from a list of values. The values are converted to strings by applying the passed string format and separated by the passed separator.

functions.name: ciUtilsGetArgVal
functions.syntax: ciUtilsGetArgVal(  l_args  t_argName  t_argAltName  [ ?defVal g_defVal ] ) => g_val
functions.description: This is a utility function for accessing constraint generator argument values from a disembodied property list where the argument names may take one of two forms.

functions.name: ciUtilsMakeNumberRange
functions.syntax: ciUtilsMakeNumberRange(  x_from  x_to  [ ?descending g_descending ]  [ ?fmt t_fmt ] ) => l_result
functions.description: This function returns a list containing a sequence of numbers ranging from the passed from value to the passed to value. Optionally, this function reverses the list into descending order and applies a sprintf format to the numbers.

functions.name: ciUtilsMakeUnique
functions.description: This function takes a list of items, which can contain duplicate items and returns a list without any duplicate items.

functions.name: ciUtilsRemoveNils
functions.description: Removes the nil elements from a list.

functions.name: ciUtilsRepeatNTimes
functions.description: This is a utility function for creating a list containing a single value repeated the specified number of times.

functions.name: ciUtilsReplaceNils
functions.description: This is a utility function for replacing any nil elements in a list with the specified value. See also, ciUtilsRemoveNils and ciUtilsMakeUnique.

functions.name: ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth
functions.syntax: ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth(  u_cache l_instsNetsPins [ ?minFingerWidth t_minWidth ] [ ?maxFingerWidth t_maxWidth ] ) => nil
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector as a generator to set a variantInfo property to each given instance registered as a fet, when the parameter value for the parameter registered as fingerWidth is greater than the given minWidth value, and smaller than the maxWidth value.

functions.name: ciWithinConstraint
functions.description: Returns the constraints that contain the specified objects as members of the given constraint type.

functions.name: ciXYInstSymmetricIterator
functions.syntax: ciXYInstSymmetricIterator(  d_cellview t_finderExpr [ ?trigger g_trigger ] [ ?likeSchemaSym g_likeSchemaSym ] ) => list / nil
functions.description: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects that are assigned to L and R local variables. Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all symmetric design instance pairs, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYNetSymmetricIterator
functions.syntax: ciXYNetSymmetricIterator(  d_cellview t_finderExpr [ ?trigger g_trigger ] [ ?likeSchemaSym g_likeSchemaSym ] ) => list / nil
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric nets, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYPinSymmetricIterator
functions.syntax: ciXYPinSymmetricIterator(  d_cellview t_finderExpr [ ?trigger g_trigger ] [ ?likeSchemaSym t_likeSchemaSym ] ) => list / nil
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric pins, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYSortInsts
functions.description: Sorts a list of dbInstID, first by their X coordinates and then by their Y coordinates. This will order the instances, from top to bottom and left to right, in terms of where they are located on the canvas.

functions.name: ciXYSymmetricIterator
functions.description: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects assigned to L and R local variables. The L and R variables can be referenced in the finderExpr. Iterates all pairs of symmetric design instances/pins (objects) collecting them together into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil. The Circuit Prospector assistant finders use this function.

functions.name: cstAddToConstraintGroup
functions.syntax: cstAddToConstraintGroup( g_cstConstraintGroupID g_memberConstraintGroupID [ g_append ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a constraint group to be a member constraint group of the containing constraint. You can position the constraint group at the beginning of the members or at the end of the members with g_append. The default value for g_append is nil, which means that add the constraint group to the beginning of the members. The member constraint group cannot be owned by other objects.   Note: A member constraint group cannot be added to itself.

functions.name: cstCreateConstraint
functions.syntax: cstCreateConstraint( g_cstConstraintGroupID t_constraintDefName g_layers g_value [ l_params ] [ g_isHard ] [ g_append ] [ t_name ] ) => g_cstConstraintID / nil
functions.description: Creates a constraint in the constraint group (g_cstConstraintGroupID) with the specified constraint definition name (t_constraintDefName), layers, constraint value, constraint parameters, hard attribute, the position of the constraint with the members of the constraint group and the name of the constraint.

functions.name: cstCreateConstraintGroupIn
functions.syntax: cstCreateConstraintGroupIn( { d_techID | d_cellViewID } t_constraintGroupName [ t_constraintGroupDefName ] [ g_operator ] ) => g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
functions.description: Creates a constraint group in the technology database (that is, techDb) or a cellview with arguments of the database ID, constraint group name, constraint group definition name and operator symbol.

functions.name: cstCreateConstraintGroupOn
functions.syntax: cstCreateConstraintGroupOn( g_object t_constraintGroupDefName [ g_operator ] ) => g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
functions.description: Creates a constraint group on an object (for example, net, term, and so on) with arguments of the object ID, constraint group definition name, and operator symbol. The constraint group definition name is required while constraint group operators are optional for this SKILL function.

functions.name: cstDeleteConstraint
functions.description: Deletes the constraint from any of the constraint groups it is a part of. Its value and constraint parameters are also deleted.

functions.name: cstDeleteConstraintGroup
functions.description: Deletes the constraint group (g_cstConstraintGroupID). The contained constraints in the constraint group are not automatically deleted when the constraintGroup is deleted.

functions.name: cstFindConstraintGroupIn
functions.syntax: cstFindConstraintGroupIn( { d_techID | d_cellViewID } t_constraintGroupName [ g_localOnly ] ) => g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
functions.description: Returns a constraint group ID (g_cstConstraintGroupID) from a database ID with constraint group name and a Boolean flag (g_localOnly).

functions.name: cstFindConstraintGroupOn
functions.description: Returns a constraint group ID (g_cstConstraintGroupID) from an object (g_object) with constraint group definition name.

functions.name: cstFindCutClassConstraintByName
functions.syntax: cstFindCutClassConstraintByName( d_constraintGroupId tx_layer t_name ) => d_cutClassConstraintId / nil
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the cut class constraint with a given cut class name, layer, and constraint group.

functions.name: cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize
functions.syntax: cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize( d_constraintGroupId tx_layer n_width n_length g_checkOrientation ) => d_cutClassConstraintId / nil
functions.description: Searches the specified layer in the specified constraint group and returns the first cut class constraint with the specified width and length. If g_checkOrientation is set to t, the orientation of the cut class will also be included as part of the search.

functions.name: cstFindFirstConstraint
functions.syntax: cstFindFirstConstraint( d_ConstraintGroupID t_constraintDefName [ ( tx_layer [ tx_purpose ] )... ] [ l_params ] [ g_onlyHard ] ) => d_ConstraintID / nil
functions.description: Searches a constraint group in the hierarchical order and returns the ID of the first constraint found with the given name, layers, purposes, and params. If the onlyHard argument is not specified, the first matching constraint is returned and it is possible that it is a hard constraint. If the onlyHard argument is specified, then the first matching hard constraint is returned.

functions.name: cstGet1DTableValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the table for the given index. The index varies depending on the constraint. It can be a width or a length.

functions.name: cstGet2DTableValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the table for the given indexes.

functions.name: cstGetConstraintGroups
functions.description: Returns all the containing constraint groups for the constraint (g_cstConstraintID).

functions.name: cstGetDefaultConstraintGroupName
functions.description: Gets the name of the constraint group that is used as the default constraint group on the objects of the cellview according to the specified application type.

functions.name: cstGetFoundryCGName
functions.description: Returns the name of the alternate foundry constraint group. If there is no alternate foundry constraint group specified, it returns the name of the foundry constraint group.

functions.name: cstGetFoundryConstraintGroup
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the alternate foundry constraint group specified for a given technology file. If there is no alternate foundry constraint group specified, it returns the ID of the foundry constraint group.

functions.name: cstGetTwoWidthTableValue
functions.syntax: cstGetTwoWidthTableValue(  d_ConstraintID  n_index1 n_index2 n_index3 ) => n_value
functions.description: Applies to the twoWidth table. It only returns the spacing value for a given width1, width2, and length.

functions.name: cstGetUnreferencedConstraints
functions.description: Returns all the unreferrenced constraints not belonging to any constraint group in a database (a technology database or a cellview).

functions.name: cstIsId
functions.description: Returns a Boolean that indicates whether the specified ID is a constraint ID.

functions.name: cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName
functions.syntax: cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName( d_cellview t_constraintGroupName t_type ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified constraint group name to be used as the default constraint group on the objects of the cellview according to the specified application type.

functions.name: drvCheckLists
functions.description: Returns a list of the registered Design Review checklists. Each checklist is a disembodied property list of the form list(nil 'category <categoryName> 'checks list(<checkDescription1> ... <checkDescriptionN>).

functions.name: drvGetReviewInfo
functions.syntax: drvGetReviewInfo( d_cvId t_rname [?name g_name] [?reviewText g_reviewText] [?implStatus g_implStatus] [?signedOff g_signedOff] [?checkList g_checkList] [?defects g_defects] ) => l_propertynames
functions.description: Returns information for the specified review in the given cellview.

functions.name: drvListLayoutReviews
functions.description: Returns the design review names for the specified layout cell view.

functions.name: drvRegisterCheckLists
functions.description: Registers Design Review checklists. Each checklist is a disembodied property list of the form list(nil 'category <categoryName> 'checks list(<checkDescription1> ... <checkDescriptionN>).

functions.name: tedSaveCSV
functions.description: Saves the specified Table Editor in a specified CSV file as comma-separated values.

functions.name: tedSaveXML
functions.description: Saves the specified Table Editor in a specified XML file as comma-separated values.

functions.name: lntAddTrace
functions.syntax: lntAddTrace( w_window { d_figId | t_netName } [ ?mode t_mode ] [ ?hierPath l_hierPath ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] [ ?userArea l_userArea ] [ ?hilightIncrementally g_hilightIncrementally ] [ ?retainColornStateInfo g_retainColornStateInfo ] [ ?hilightColor t_hilightColor ] [ ?maxCutShapes t_maxCutShapes ] [ ?constraintGroup t_constraintGroup ] [ ?stackLayers l_stackLayers ] ) => x_traceId / nil
functions.description: Creates a trace starting from the specified figure or net name in the specified window.

functions.name: lntClearNeighbors
functions.description: Deletes all computed neighbors in the specified window.

functions.name: lxRegMasterDiffName
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function that can return a name for the master difference reported by the Check Against Source command.

functions.name: abGetAssistant
functions.description: Returns the Annotation Browser window associated with the specified window.

functions.name: abGetCurrentIncompleteNetFilter
functions.description: Returns the incomplete net filter currently applied on the specified window. An incomplete net filter is used to control the display of incomplete net markers in the Connectivity tab of the Annotation Browser assistant by showing or hiding a subset of net names.

functions.name: abHiFindMarker
functions.description: In the specified window, selects the row corresponding to a marker in the Annotation Browser when the corresponding marker object is clicked in the layout canvas. Even though the marker object is selected in the layout canvas, this does not modify the selection in the canvas. If the corresponding marker is not displayed in the Annotation Browser due to the applied filtering, nothing is selected in the Annotation Browser. If a window ID is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: abSetColorOnSelection
functions.description: Sets the specified color as the highlight color for all selected rows in the Annotation Browser tree view.

functions.name: abSetIncompleteNetFilter
functions.syntax: abSetIncompleteNetFilter( w_windowID t_filterState { Show | Hide } l_netNamess g_enable ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified incomplete net filter state for the specified list of nets in the given window. An incomplete net filter is used to control the display of incomplete net markers in the Connectivity tab of the Annotation Browser assistant by showing or hiding a subset of net names.

functions.name: abeBlockagesFromCellView
functions.syntax: abeBlockagesFromCellView( t_layerName o_outLayer g_queue [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  ) => o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Copies blockages from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview to a new or existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied blockages to the specified ABE layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeBoundariesFromCellView
functions.description: Copies the boundaries from the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied boundaries to a specified layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeClearLayer
functions.description: Removes all the shapes on the ABE layer and frees the memory. This is useful for re-using ABE layers.

functions.name: abeDone
functions.description: Closes the current ABE session and frees all the memory that was used by ABE.

functions.name: abeElapsedTime
functions.description: Returns the elapsed time for the current ABE session.

functions.name: abeInit
functions.syntax: abeInit( d_cellViewId  [ ?doInterrupts g_interrupts ]  [ ?depth g_depth ]  [ ?threads g_threadCount ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Initializes an ABE session for the specified cellview. The ABE elapsed time clock is set to zero.

functions.name: abeIslandIterator
functions.description: Returns the island iterator for the rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. Each entry is a list of points for a shape on the ABE layer.

functions.name: abeLayerAbut
functions.syntax: abeLayerAbut( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer for ABE layer1 shapes that abut with shapes on ABE layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAnd
functions.syntax: abeLayerAnd( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on ABE layer1 overlap shapes on ABE layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAndNot
functions.syntax: abeLayerAndNot( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on layer1 do not overlap shapes on layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAvoid
functions.syntax: abeLayerAvoid( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ] [ ?islandBased g_islandBased ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes on the output layer for shapes on layer1 that are completely outside of, and have no abutting edges with, shapes on layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerFromCellView
functions.syntax: abeLayerFromCellView( t_layerName  [ ?bbox l_bbox ]  [ ?bBox l_bBox ] [ ?purpose t_purposeName ]  [ ?excludePurpose l_purposeName ] [ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer [ ?queue g_queue ] ] [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  [ ?startLevel g_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel g_stopLevel ]  [ ?orientation g_orientation ] [ ?onlyPinFig g_onlyPinFig ]  [ ?onlyVia g_onlyVia ]  ) => o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Copies the shapes from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied shapes to a specific area, purpose, mask color, or hierarchical depth. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeLayerFromFigSet
functions.description: Adds the shapes from a FigSet to an existing ABE layer or a new ABE layer.

functions.name: abeLayerFromNet
functions.syntax: abeLayerFromNet( t_layerName  t_netName [ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer ]  [ ?onlyPinFig g_onlyPinFig ]  [ ?onlyVia g_onlyVia ] [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  ) => o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Adds the shapes from a net to an existing or new ABE layer. Logical connectivity is not preserved and therefore cannot be restored if the shapes are written back to the ABE session cellview.

functions.name: abeLayerFromShapes
functions.description: Creates an ABE layer with shapes from the given list.

functions.name: abeLayerGrow
functions.syntax: abeLayerGrow( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?north g_sizeNorth ]  [ ?south g_sizeSouth ]  [ ?east g_sizeEast ]  [ ?west g_sizeWest]  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer that are ABE input layer shapes that have been increased in size along one or more directions in the north, south, east, and/or west.

functions.name: abeLayerInside
functions.syntax: abeLayerInside( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds ABE layer1 shapes that are completely inside an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeLayerMergeTiles
functions.syntax: abeLayerMergeTiles( i_abeLayer t_orientation [ ?queue { t | nil } ]  => o_outputLayer / nil
functions.description: Uses an existing ABE layer to recreate maximum tiles based on the specified orientation.

functions.name: abeLayerOr
functions.syntax: abeLayerOr( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes from the input ABE layer to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerOrPtArray
functions.description: Adds a polygon that is represented by a list of points to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerOutside
functions.syntax: abeLayerOutside( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds to the ABE output layer the ABE layer1 shapes that are completely outside the ABE layer2 shapes. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeLayerShrink
functions.syntax: abeLayerShrink( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?north g_sizeNorth ]  [ ?south g_sizeSouth ]  [ ?east g_sizeEast ]  [ ?west g_sizeWest]  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Decreases the size of shapes from the input ABE layer and outputs them to the ABE output layer. Shapes can be reduced by different distances in the north, south, east, and west directions.

functions.name: abeLayerSize
functions.syntax: abeLayerSize( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  g_size  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes that have been increased or decreased in size from the ABE input layer to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerStraddle
functions.syntax: abeLayerStraddle( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that partially overlap an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerToBlockages
functions.syntax: abeLayerToBlockages( o_abeInputLayer  t_layerName  [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  [ ?blockageType g_blockageType ]  [ ?tiles g_tiles  | ?noHoles g_noHoles ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes as blockage objects from the ABE layer to the specified layer. Optional arguments specify a mask color and blockage type for the blockage objects, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether shapes are copied as tiles instead of islands.

functions.name: abeLayerToCellView
functions.syntax: abeLayerToCellView( o_abeLayer  t_layerName  [ ?tiles g_tiles  | ?noHoles g_noHoles ]  [ ?purpose t_purposeName ]  [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  [ ?cell t_cellName ] [ ?view t_viewName ]  [ ?cvId d_cellviewID ]  [ ?shapeIds { t | nil} } ) => l_shapeIDs / t / nil
functions.description: Copies shapes from the ABE layer to the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview. Optional arguments specify the layer purpose, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as islands instead of primitive tiles.

functions.name: abeLayerToHilightSet
functions.syntax: abeLayerToHilightSet( o_abeInputLayer  h_hilightSetId  [ ?tiles g_tiles  | ?noHoles g_noHoles ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the rectangles and polygons on the specified ABE layer to the specified highlight set. Optional arguments specify whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as primitive tiles instead of islands.

functions.name: abeLayerTouch
functions.syntax: abeLayerTouch( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  [ ?includeCorners g_includeCorners ] [ ?islandBased g_islandBased ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that touch (completely overlap, partially overlap, or abut) an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerXor
functions.syntax: abeLayerXor( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds rectangles and polygons to the ABE output layer where ABE layer1 shapes and ABE layer2 shapes do not overlap.

functions.name: abeMTdebug
functions.description: Enables the output of additional messages to monitor progress when multithreading is used.

functions.name: abeNewLayer
functions.description: Creates a new ABE layer.

functions.name: abeRemoveLayer
functions.description: Removes the specified ABE layer.

functions.name: abeRunQueue
functions.description: Runs all the ABE operations that are queued for processing.

functions.name: abeShapesInside
functions.syntax: abeShapesInside( d_cellViewId  l_insideShapeObj  l_outsideShapeObj  ) => l_shapeObj / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes from the inside list that are completely inside a shape from the outside list. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeShapesOutside
functions.syntax: abeShapesOutside( d_cellViewId  l_outsideShapeObj  l_insideShapeObj  ) => l_shapeObj / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes from the outside list that are completely outside of shapes from the inside list. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeTileIterator
functions.description: Returns the tile iterator for the primitive rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. The iterator can be restricted to a region of the layer.

functions.name: adpInitFloorPlan
functions.syntax: adpInitFloorplan( d_cv t_engine ?all g_all ?deleteClusterBndry g_deleteClusterBndry ?deleteCluster g_deleteCluster ?deleteBlockages g_deleteBlockages ?prsvPlacementBkg g_prsvPlacementBkg ?prsvRoutingBkg g_prsvRoutingBkg ?prsvAreaHaloBkg g_prsvAreaHaloBkg ?prsvFeedthruBkg g_prsvFeedthruBkg ?prsvFillBkg g_prsvFillBkg ?prsvPinBkg g_prsvPinBkg ?prsvScreenBkg g_prsvScreenBkg ?prsvSlotBkg g_prsvSlotBkg ?prsvWiringBkg g_prsvWiringBkg ?deleteWires g_deleteWires ?deleteRows g_deleteRows ?deleteFillers g_deleteFillers ?fillerPrefix t_fillerPrefix ?deleteShapes g_deleteShapes ?prsvCircle g_prsvCircle ?prsvDonut g_prsvDonut ?prsvEllipse g_prsvEllipse ?prsvPath g_prsvPath ?prsvPolygon g_prsvPolygon ?prsvRectangle g_prsvRectangle ?deleteBndry g_deleteBndry ?prsvAreaBndry g_prsvAreaBndry ?prsvSnapBndry g_prsvSnapBndry ?initGrid g_initGrid ?designBndry g_designBndry ?origin t_origin ?aspectRatio f_aspectRatio ?chipWidth f_chipWidth ?chipHeight f_chipHeight ?boundaryShapeType t_boundaryShapeType ?boundaryPoints g_boundaryPoints ?designArea f_designArea ?initInstances g_initInstances ?prsvIO g_prsvIO ?prsvStd g_prsvStd ?prsvMacro g_prsvMacro ?prsvCustomCell g_prsvCustomCell ?initPins g_initPins ?prsvPlacedPin g_prsvPlacedPin ?prsvFixedPin g_prsvFixedPin ?prsvLockedPin g_prsvLockedPin ?prsvFigGrp g_prsvFigGrp ?window g_window ) => t / nil
functions.description: Initializes the floorplan of a design based on the options you specify. Most of the options being keywords, you need to specify only those parameters that you want to control. The parameters that you do not specify use the default values.

functions.name: adpnlSetEnv
functions.syntax: adpnlSetEnv( t_variable g_value [ ?domain s_domain ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a variable in the specified domain. If the environment variable does not exist in the domain, a variable is created.

functions.name: apCustomPDKSettings
functions.syntax: apCustomPDKSettings( t_pdkName [ ?paramList l_paramsList | ?paramFunc s_paramFunc ] [ ?cdsEnvs l_cdsEnvars ] [ ?regFile t_regFile ] [ ?fillParams l_fillParams ] [ ?modgenDummyParams l_ModgenDummyParams ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Registers PDK-specific instance parameters, environment variables, custom constraint registration procedures, fill instance parameters, and Modgen dummy parameters that must be honored while running each step of the automated placement and routing flow.

functions.name: apEnableM0OnFlow
functions.description: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Forces M0 flow to be turned on or off. Typically, the tool checks the Pcell parameters to automatically determine whether the flow must be turned on or off. You can use this SKILL API to force start or stop the flow. This API is valid only in certain advanced node flows.

functions.name: apPDKSetupGetCdsEnvs
functions.description: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves a list of CDS environment variables with values that are registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

functions.name: apPDKSetupGetFillParams
functions.description: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves a list of instance fill parameters that are registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

functions.name: apPDKSetupGetModgenDummyParams

functions.name: bndAddInstsBindingByName
functions.syntax: bndAddInstsBindingByName( d_schCellViewID  t_schInstName  d_layCellViewID  t_layInstName  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a named instance to an existing binding. If no binding exists, a new one is created. The schematic and layout instances must both be leaf instances. You can also use bndSetInstsBindingByName() to add the first binding and then add additional bindings to the same source or target instance by using the bndAddInstBindingByName() SKILL function.

functions.name: bndAddObjectsBinding
functions.description: Adds one or more objects to an existing binding. If no binding exists, a new binding is created. The specified objects must all be leaf-level instances. On the layout side, a leaf instance is an instance in the top level. On the schematic side, a leaf instance is the level at which the CPH stops such that INV1/P0 instance can bind to INV1|P0, but INV1 instance cannot bind to INV1|P0. For transparent instances, such as INV1, you can use INV1/N0 to add a binding to the nmos inside.

functions.name: bndGetBoundObjects
functions.description: Returns a list of objects bound to a specified object. The object ID of the bound objects can be specified in different formats. See the argument description for more information.

functions.name: bndGetSiblingBoundObjects

functions.description: Returns the objects bound in the same many-to-many relationship as the specified object, or the objects bound to the same mfactored, sfactored, folded or lxCombination instance as the specified object. However, the specified object is not included in the result. The object ID can be specified in different formats. See the argument description for more information.

functions.name: bndRegRemoveDeviceGetSurvivingNet

functions.name: bndRemoveObjectBinding

functions.name: bndRemoveTermBindingByName
functions.description: Removes the binding from a named terminal.

functions.name: bndReplaceInstsBindingByName
functions.syntax: bndReplaceInstsBindingByName( d_schCellViewID t_schInstName d_layCellViewID t_layInstName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a binding between specified schematic and layout instances, replacing any existing bindings in the process. The specified instances must all be leaf instances. On the layout side, a leaf instance is an instance in the top level. On the schematic side, a leaf instance is the level at which the CPH stops such that INV1/P0 instance can bind to INV1|P0, but INV1 instance cannot bind to INV1|P0. For transparent instances, such as INV1, you can use INV1/N0 to add a binding to the nmos inside.

functions.name: bndReplaceObjectsBinding
functions.description: Sets a binding between specified schematic and layout objects, replacing any existing bindings in the process. The specified objects must all be lead objects. On the layout side, a leaf instance is an instance in the top level. On the schematic side, a leaf instance is the level at which the CPH stops such that INV1/P0 instance can bind to INV1|P0, but INV1 instance cannot bind to INV1|P0. For transparent instances, such as INV1, you can use INV1/N0 to add a binding to the nmos inside.

functions.name: bndReplaceTermsBindingByName
functions.syntax: bndReplaceTermsBindingByName( d_schCellViewID t_schTermName d_layCellViewID t_layTermName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a binding between specified schematic and layout terminals, replacing any existing bindings in the process. The specified terminals must all be leaf objects. On the layout side, a leaf instance is an instance in the top level. On the schematic side, a leaf instance is the level at which the CPH stops such that INV1/P0 instance can bind to INV1|P0, but INV1 instance cannot bind to INV1|P0. For transparent instances, such as INV1, you can use INV1/N0 to add a binding to the nmos inside.

functions.name: ctGetCellCompTypeGroup
functions.syntax: ctGetCellCompTypeGroup( g_physConfigID t_physLib t_physCell ) => t_ctgName / nil
functions.description: Returns the component type group to which a specified physical cell is assigned.

functions.name: ctGetCellCompTypeGroups
functions.syntax: ctGetCellCompTypeGroups( g_physConfigID t_physLib t_physCell ) => l_compTypes / nil
functions.description: Returns all the component type groups to which a specified physical cell was assigned.

functions.name: ctGetCompTypeCells
functions.description: Returns a list of all the physical cells assigned to the specified component type.

functions.name: ctGetCompTypeGroupAttr
functions.syntax: ctGetCompTypeGroupAttr( g_physConfigID t_ctgName t_attrName { deviceType | activeLayer | width | foldingThreshold  	| views | drain | gate | source | bulk } ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of a specified attribute in the component type group.

functions.name: ctGetCompTypeNames
functions.description: Returns a list of component type group names for the physical configuration associated with the given ID.

functions.name: ctSetCompTypeGroupAttr
functions.syntax: ctSetCompTypeGroupAttr( g_physConfigID t_ctgName t_attrName { deviceType | activeLayer | width | length | splitParam | orientation | edgeType | numFins | widthPerFin | foldingThresholdFins | foldingThreshold | foldingMin | foldingStep | views | drain | gate | source | bulk } g_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an attribute by name in the component type.

functions.name: dbIsVPLGen
functions.description: Returns true if the design is a VPLGen.

functions.name: dbRegVPLGenCreateCellName
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function to create unique cell names for VPLGen core layouts.

functions.name: dbUnregVPLGenCreateCellName
functions.description: Unregisters the SKILL function used to generate unique cell names for VPLGen core layouts. Once unregistered, Layout XL uses the default naming convention when creating new VPLGen Pcell instances in the layout view.

functions.name: drdAddTarget
functions.description: Sets the shape located at the specified point in the specified window as a DRD target. The function does not remove from the selection the shapes already set as DRD targets. If two or more shapes overlap at the specified point, the shape on the active layer is set as a DRD target.

functions.name: drdBatchCheck
functions.description: Runs DRD checker on the specified area of the specified cellview. The hierarchy depth and batch checking rules specified in the DRD Options form are honored. Use this function to run a DRD check on read-only cellviews to view any DRC violations as warning messages in CIW.

functions.name: drdBatchCheckLicenseAvailable
functions.description: Checks whether a Layout XL license is available. If the license is available, the function returns t. If the license is unavailable, it attempts to check out the license. If the attempt is successful, it checks the license back in and returns t.

functions.name: drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem(  t_CategoryName x_toggleValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a constraint category in the Constraint Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdCheckedLayerGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdCheckedLayerGroupItem(  t_layerCategoryName x_toggleValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a layer category in the Layer Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdCheckedRuleGroupItem
functions.description: Toggles the state of check boxes.

functions.name: drdConstraintGroupHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the categories listed in the Constraint Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdConstraintHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the constraints listed in the Constraint column or sorts the constraints alphabetically, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdConstraintItemClicked
functions.syntax: drdConstraintItemClicked( t_constraintName x_columnIndex x_stateValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a constraint for different checking modes, that is, Enforce, Notify, Post-Edit, and Batch, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdEnablePixelThreshold
functions.description: Enables a pixel threshold. When you move an object toward another object and you cross this pixel threshold, the object being moved is automatically snapped to the closest edge of the DRC halo or the target object, if DRD Smart Snap mode is enabled. You can disable this pixel threshold to temporarily disable smart snapping during interactive editing.

functions.name: drdGetAllowedWidth
functions.syntax: drdGetAllowedWidth( d_objID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?upperLimit f_maxValue ] ) => l_integers / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of allowed widths for the specified layer.

functions.name: drdGetMinSpacing
functions.syntax: drdGetMinSpacing( d_techID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?width1 f_width1Val ] [ ?width2 f_width2Val ] [ ?prl f_prlVal ] [ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?sameMask { 0 | 1 } ] ) => f_minSpaceVal / nil
functions.description: Returns the minimum spacing value defined by the minSpacing (One layer) constraint for the specified layer, based on the specified width, parallel run length (prl), direction, and mask values.

functions.name: drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing
functions.syntax: drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing( d_techID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?span f_spanVal ] [ ?prl f_prlVal ] [ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?sameMask { 0 | 1 } ] ) => f_minSpanSpaceVal / nil
functions.description: Returns the minimum span length spacing value defined by the minSpanLengthSpacing constraint for the specified layer, based on the specified span, parallel run length (prl), direction, and mask values.

functions.name: drdGetMinVoltageSpacing
functions.syntax: drdGetMinVoltageSpacing( d_techID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?voltage1 f_voltage1Val ] [ ?voltage2 f_voltage2Val ] ) => f_minVolSpaceVal / nil
functions.description: Returns the minimum voltage-dependent spacing value defined by the minVoltageSpacing (One layer) constraint for the specified layer based on the specified voltages. The voltage difference is calculated as the absolute difference of the two input voltages, which correspond to the voltages set on the two objects for which you want to retrieve the minimum spacing.

functions.name: drdIsPixelThresholdEnabled
functions.description: Indicates whether the pixel threshold is enabled or disabled.

functions.name: drdLayerGroupHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the layer categories listed in the Layer Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdLayerHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the layers listed in the Layer column or sorts the layers alphabetically, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdLayerItemClicked
functions.syntax: drdLayerItemClicked( t_layerName x_columnIndex x_stateValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a layer on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdListConstraintCategoryRules
functions.syntax: drdListConstraintCategoryRules( [ ?cv d_cellViewID ] [ ?outputFile s_fileName ] [ ?active { t | nil } ] [ ?splitTF { t | nil } ] [ ?csv { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lists constraints supported by DRD in the version of the software that is currently running. The constraints' information can be saved in an ASCII file or listed in CIW, in a tabular format or as a comma-separated list.

functions.name: drdOptionUpdateConstraint
functions.syntax: drdOptionUpdateConstraint(  l_modeCategories l_constraints g_state )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default state for specified constraints and modes in the configuration file for the Filters tab of the DRD Options form. If the function is run without a maskLayout cellview open, the settings are discarded.

functions.name: drdOptionUpdateLayer
functions.description: Sets the default state for specified layers in the configuration file for the Filters tab of the DRD Options form. If the function is run without a maskLayout cellview open, the settings are discarded.

functions.name: drdOptionsSet
functions.description: Sets default states for fields in the configuration file for the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdRemoveTarget
functions.description: Unsets a DRD target that exists at the specified point in the specified window. If multiple DRD targets overlap at the specified point, the DRD target on the active layer is unset.

functions.name: drdRuleGroupHeaderClicked
functions.description: Toggles Rule Groups check boxes. The state of the of check boxes in the right panel, Rule Types and Rule IDs is also toggled.

functions.name: drdRuleIDHeaderClicked
functions.description: Toggles the state of check boxes of all rule IDs. The state of the associated Rule Group check box in the left panel and the associated rule type is also toggled.

functions.name: drdRuleIDItemClicked
functions.syntax: drdRuleIDItemClicked( t_ruleIDName x_selectIndex x_checkboxState w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Modifies the check box of the rule ID on the left panel and the corresponding rule group and rule type.

functions.name: drdRuleTypeHeaderClicked
functions.description: Toggles the state of check boxes of all rule types. The state of associated Rule Group check box in the left panel and the associated rule IDs are also toggled.

functions.name: drdRuleTypeItemClicked
functions.syntax: drdRuleTypeItemClicked( t_ruleTypeName x_selectIndex x_checkboxState w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Modifies the check box of rule type on the left panel and the corresponding rule group and rule ID.

functions.name: drdSelectConstraintGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdSelectConstraintGroupItem( t_constraintCategoryName x_selectIndex w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Selects the constraint category in the Constraint Category column and displays the corresponding constraints in the Constraint column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdSelectLayerGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdSelectLayerGroupItem( t_layerCategoryName x_selectIndex w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Selects the layer category in the Layer Category column and displays the corresponding layers in the Layer column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdSelectSignOffRuleGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdSelectSignOffRuleGroupItem( t_ruleGroupName x_selectIndex w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Selects the sign off rule group category on the left panel and displays the corresponding rule type or rule ID in the right panel.

functions.name: drdToggleSmartSnapMode
functions.description: Freezes DRC halos, which helps snap objects to the closest edge of the halo or the object.

functions.name: drdToggleSmartSnapModeForDiscreteSpacing
functions.description: Freezes discrete spacing markers, which helps snap objects to the closest marker.

functions.name: drdVerifySelSet
functions.description: Checks the objects selected in the specified design for rule violations and generates a marker for each rule violation found. If a design is not specified, it checks the objects selected in the design open in the current window.

functions.name: eadAddNetsToNetGroup
functions.syntax: eadAddNetsToNetGroup( x_cellViewID t_groupName ?netNames l_netNames ?regExp t_regExp ?file t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified nets to an existing net group for the given cellview.

functions.name: eadCreateDataSetFromLayCSV
functions.syntax: eadCreateDataSetFromLayCSV( d_cvId t_datasetName t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a user-defined dataset, with the specified name, in the given layout cellview using the electrical current values from the specified layout CSV file.

functions.name: eadCreateDataSetFromSchCSV
functions.syntax: eadCreateDataSetFromSchCSV( d_cvId t_datasetName t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a user-defined dataset, with the specified name, in the given layout cellview using the electrical current values from the specified schematic CSV file.

functions.name: eadCreateDataSetLayCSVTemplate
functions.description: Creates a CSV template file for a given layout cellview in a format that can be used later to fill in current values and to create a user-defined EAD dataset from it.

functions.name: eadCreateNetGroup
functions.syntax: eadCreateNetGroup( x_cellViewID t_groupName ?netNames l_netNames ?regExp t_regExp ?file t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a new net group by the given name in the given cellview. If given, it can also contain the nets.

functions.name: eadDeleteNetGroup
functions.description: Deletes a net group from the given cellview.

functions.name: eadDeleteScratchLib
functions.description: Deletes all data from the scratch library that contains data related to the scratch layout.

functions.name: eadExtractParasitics
functions.description: Extracts parasitics from the specified layout design.

functions.name: eadExtractParasiticsForDesign
