functions.description: Extracts parasitics for the specified layout window if the EAD Browser is initialized. You can configure extraction options on the EAD Options form.

functions.name: eadGetLocCurrentLimit
functions.syntax: eadGetLocCurrentLimit( w_winId l_point t_layerName [ ?direction t_direction ] [ ?pulseWidth n_pulseWidth ] [ ?dutyCycleRatio n_dutyCycleRatio ] [ ?rmsMetalLineNum n_rmsMetalLineNum ] [ ?hiEM n_hiEM ] ) => l_limit / nil
functions.description: Returns the current carrying EM limit of a resistor on the specified location. Additional arguments, such as ?pulseWidth and ?hiEM can be specified to match specific EM rules in the EAD technology file or the ICT-EM file.

functions.name: eadGetNetsInNetGroup
functions.description: Lists all the nets contained in the specified net group of the given cellview.

functions.name: eadGetTriggerDesc
functions.description: Provides a description about the given event and the arguments required by the SKILL triggers registered for that event.

functions.name: eadInitializeDesign
functions.syntax: eadInitializeDesign( t_layoutDesignCellViewId t_eadSetupFile t_cornerName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Initializes the specified layout design with the specified EAD setup and corner name.

functions.name: eadJobClose
functions.description: Collects results from the batch jobs submitted to computer farms or dedicated servers for distributed computation. When all the distributed jobs are completed successfully, you can use this command to collect extraction results from each job. The parasitic results from individual batch run are combined into one OA database and automatically displayed in the EAD browser summary table.

functions.name: eadJobStatus
functions.description: Returns the status of batch jobs submitted to computer farms or dedicated servers for distributed computation.

functions.name: eadJobSubmit
functions.description: Submits batch jobs to computer farms or dedicated servers for distributed computation.

functions.name: eadLoadSetup
functions.description: Initializes the EAD Browser in the specified layout window with the given setup file.

functions.name: eadPreEMSetUserStopCVList
functions.description: Sets all or the specified cells of user-specified libraries as stop views. The instances of the specified cells are not descended further during the pre-EM checks.

functions.name: eadRegTrigger
functions.syntax: eadRegTrigger( t_eventName t_callbackProcName n_priority ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a user-defined callback SKILL function for the specified event or trigger with the given priority. You can create custom callback functions to perform necessary updates when these events are triggered.

functions.name: eadRegisterCustomEMVariable
functions.description: Registers a variable as a custom variable for the purpose of EM calculation. By using the eadSetEMVariable function, you can vary the value of the registered variable before running EM checks. If a variable is not registered, modifying its values does affect EM calculations.

functions.name: eadRemoveDesignParasitics
functions.description: Removes the parasitics extracted from the specified layout design.

functions.name: eadRemoveNetsFromNetGroup
functions.syntax: eadRemoveNetsFromNetGroup( x_cellViewID t_groupName ?netNames l_netNames ?regExp t_regExp ?file t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes the given nets from the specified net group of the given cellview.

functions.name: eadRemoveParasitics
functions.syntax: eadRemoveParasitics( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the parasitic information associated with the specified layout design and saves the design (provided there were no other unsaved changes prior to calling the function).

functions.name: eadSetEMVariable
functions.syntax: eadSetEMVariable( g_varName [ g_varValue ] [ g_layerName ] [ g_analysisPointName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a custom variable registered by eadRegisterCustomEMVariable. The value is used by the EM limit calculation expressions in the ICT-EM file.

functions.name: eadUnregTrigger
functions.description: Removes the entry for the specified SKILL trigger from the registered list of triggers for the given event. When the specified event occurs, the remaining registered triggers, if any, for that event get executed in their order of priority.

functions.name: elecCreateDataSetCSVTemplate
functions.syntax: elecCreateDataSetCSVTemplate(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileName [ ?resultTypes l_resultTypes ] [ ?maxHierLevel n_maxHierLevel ] [ ?scaleFactors l_scaleFactors ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a CSV template file for a given schematic cellview in a format that can be later used to fill in the current or voltage values, and to create an EAD dataset from it.

functions.name: elecGetCurrentData
functions.syntax: elecGetCurrentData(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_dataSetName  t_terminalName [ t_measurementType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Gets the electrical data for the specified terminal in the given cellview. The data is retrieved from the specified dataset.

functions.name: elecGetDataSetNames
functions.syntax: elecGetDataSetNames(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ t_dataSetType ] ) => l_dataSetNames / nil
functions.description: Gets the list of available result datasets for a given design. Also see EM Dataset.

functions.name: elecGetDataSetParamsPropValue
functions.syntax: elecGetDataSetParamsPropValue(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_dataSetName t_paramName ) => t_paramValue / nil
functions.description: Gets the value for the given parameter from the property list of the given dataset saved for the given cellview.

functions.name: elecGetEnableEADMode
functions.description: Returns the current status of the Enable Electrical Data Capture for EAD Flow check box in the EAD Setup form for the specified session and history name.

functions.name: elecGetVsyncEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether the creation of post-simulation voltage constraints is enabled or disabled.

functions.name: elecMakeDefaultDatasetName
functions.syntax: elecMakeDefaultDatasetName( t_sessionName t_historyName t_dutLibName t_dutCellName t_dutViewName t_dutInstance t_cornerName t_temperature t_designPoint t_testName ) => t_defaultDatasetName
functions.description: Returns the user-defined default name of the dataset to be displayed in the DUT Dataset field of the EAD results view.

functions.name: elecSetEnableEADMode
functions.syntax: elecSetEnableEADMode( t_sessionName g_value [ ?historyName t_historyName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects or deselects the Enable Electrical Data Capture for EAD Flow check box in the EAD Setup form for the specified session and history name.

functions.name: elecSetVsyncEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables the creation of post-simulation voltage constraints.

functions.name: elecTransferDataSets
functions.syntax: elecTransferDataSets( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?dataSetList l_dataSetList ] [ ?dataSetType t_dataSetType ] [ ?schLCV g_schLCV ] [ ?needToSave g_needToSave ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Transfers datasets from schematic to layout. By default, the function transfers all the datasets from schematic to layout. You can use the key arguments to transfer specific datasets.

functions.name: elecUpdateDataSetParamsPropValue
functions.syntax: elecUpdateDataSetParamsPropValue(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_dataSetName t_paramName t_paramValue ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the value for a parameter/property of the given dataset saved for the given cellview. You can use this function to modify the value of a dataset property for a schematic or layout view.

functions.name: elecVdrCreateConstraints
functions.description: Creates a post-simulation voltageSyncedNet constraint at the DUT level when called from a user-defined function, which has been specified using the customVoltageConstraintFunc environment variable.

functions.name: elecVdrCreateDeltaV
functions.description: Creates a post-simulation deltaVoltage constraint at the DUT level when called from a user-defined function, which has been specified using the customVoltageConstraintFunc environment variable.

functions.name: electDeleteDatasets
functions.syntax: elecDeleteDataSets(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?dataSetList l_dataSetList ] [ ?dataSetType l_dataSetType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes electrical data from the specified design. This function can be used for both layout and schematic view of a design.

functions.name: gpeAbutGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpeAbutGridEntries( u_sandbox l_gridEntries [ ?abutType { x_abutType | t_abutTypeName } ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Abuts the specified list of instances or indexes using the given abutment type in the given sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeAddDummy
functions.syntax: gpeAddDummy( u_sandbox t_direction [ ?n x_rowsCols ] [ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified number of dummy rows or columns in the given direction to the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells
functions.syntax: gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells( u_sandbox [ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Fills the empty cells in the specified sandbox object with dummies.

functions.name: gpeAddDummySurround
functions.syntax: gpeAddDummySurround( u_sandbox [ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a ring of dummies around the specified sandbox grid.

functions.name: gpeAddInstance
functions.description: Adds the given list of instances to the specified Modgen.

functions.name: gpeAddMatchGroups
functions.syntax: gpeAddMatchGroups( u_sandbox l_matchGroups [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified matched groups to the specified Modgen sandbox object. A matched group is a set of topological trunks with similar properties.

functions.name: gpeAddStrapEntries
functions.syntax: gpeAddStrapEntries( u_sandbox l_straps [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified straps to the topology (topo) section of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeAddTrunkChains
functions.syntax: gpeAddTrunkChains( u_sandbox l_trunkChains [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified trunk chain values to the topo portion of the Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeCancelSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeCancelSandbox( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Discards the specified Modgen sandbox object. Changes made to the Modgen sandbox object are lost. This function can be run in both schematic and layout cellviews. If run from the schematic view, the associated scratch cellview is also deleted. The Modgen constraint is not transferred to the schematic view and the dummies are not backannotated.

functions.name: gpeClearChannelWidthEntry
functions.syntax: gpeClearChannelWidthEntry( u_sandbox x_index t_direction [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Clears the channelWidth value of the specified channel in the specified sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpeClearGridEntries( u_sandbox [ ?row x_row ] [ ?col x_col ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_gridEntries / nil
functions.description: Unplaces the grid entries that match the given identifiers in the given sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeClearMatchGroups
functions.syntax: gpeClearMatchGroups( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes all the matched groups from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeClearPresetGenerators
functions.description: Deletes all the registered preset generator functions from the system.

functions.name: gpeClearStrapEntries
functions.syntax: gpeClearStrapEntries( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes all straps from the specified Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearTopo
functions.syntax: gpeClearTopo( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes all topologies from the specified Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearTrunkChains
functions.syntax: gpeClearTrunkChains( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes all trunk chains from the Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeCopyColAbutment
functions.syntax: gpeCopyColAbutment( u_sandbox x_sourceCol x_targetCol [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies abutment information from one column to another.

functions.name: gpeCopyRowAbutment
functions.syntax: gpeCopyRowAbutment( u_sandbox x_sourceRow x_targetRow [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies abutment information from one row to another.

functions.name: gpeCreateAbutEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateAbutEntries( [ ?rows l_rows ] [ ?cols l_columns ] [ ?abutType l_abutType ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_abutEntry / nil
functions.description: Creates a list of abut entries that are in line with the information in the arguments.

functions.name: gpeCreateAbutType
functions.syntax: gpeCreateAbutType( [ ?syncChains { t | nil } ] [ ?preserveRows { t | nil } ] [ ?permute { t | nil } ] [ ?mirrorEquivOrients { t | nil } ] [ ?mirror { t | nil } ] [ ?interdigitateChains { t | nil } ] [ ?dummyFlexBothEndNets { t | nil } ] [ ?chainLeftNet { Source | Drain | Either } ] [ ?chainAlignPMOS { Top | Center | Bottom } ] [ ?chainAlignNMOS { Top | Center | Bottom } ] [ ?allowSingleBulk { t | nil } ] [ ?abutStrategy { sdFirst | dummyFirst } ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] )  => l_abutType / nil
functions.description: Creates an abutType DPL, which can be passed to the gpeCreateAbutEntry API. The abutment then uses the chaining parameters specified in the abutType parameter. The defaults for the arguments are obtained from the Modgen environment if set. Otherwise, the defaults of lxChain are honored.

functions.name: gpeCreateAlignment
functions.syntax: gpeCreateAlignment( [ ?direction t_direction ] [ ?type t_type ] [ ?reflayer g_reflayer ] [ ?spacing f_spacing ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_alignment / nil
functions.description: Creates an alignment DPL, which can be passed as an alignment argument for gpeCreateGridEntry to set the member alignment and spacing of a grid entry. Specifying a direction, although not necessary for types other than center, is highly recommended.

functions.name: gpeCreateAlignmentAndSpacing
functions.syntax: gpeCreateAlignmentAndSpacing( u_sandbox [?hAlignType { left | right | custom_left | custom_right | center }] [?hSpacing f_spacing] [?hRefLayer t_layerName] [?hRefPurpose t_purposeName] [?vAlignType { bottom | top | custom_bottom | custom_top | center }] [?vSpacing f_spacing] [?vRefLayer t_layerName] [?vRefPurpose t_purposeName] [?useDefaultForUnspecifiedArgs { t | nil } ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the alignment and spacing settings for all the grid entries in the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeCreateChannelWidthEntry
functions.syntax: gpeCreateChannelWidthEntry( [ ?width f_width ] [ ?reference t_reference ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => g_channelWidthEntry / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox channel width entry that can be passed in gpeSetChannelWidthEntry to set the channel widths.

functions.name: gpeCreateDummyConfig
functions.syntax: gpeCreateDummyConfig( [ ?master t_master] [ ?source l_source ] [ ?connectivity l_connectivity ] [ ?parameters l_parameters ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?defaultNet t_defaultNet ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_dummyConfig / nil
functions.description: Creates a dummyConfig DPL, which can be used as an argument for gpeCreateGridEntry to create a dummy grid entry. If the master is not set, the source is used to determine the master. If the source is not set, the dummy uses the neighboring instances as its source.

functions.name: gpeCreateDummyConfigNet
functions.syntax: gpeCreateDummyConfigNet( t_termName [ ?netName t_netName ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_dummyConfigNet / nil
functions.description: Creates a dummyConfigNet DPL that can be added to a list with other dummyConfigNet DPLs and passed as the connectivity argument to gpeCreateDummyConfig to create a dummyConfig DPL.

functions.name: gpeCreateDummyConfigParam
functions.syntax: gpeCreateDummyConfigParam( t_name [ ?type t_type ] [ ?value t_value ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] )  => l_dummyConfigParam / nil
functions.description: Creates a dummyConfigParam DPL that can be added to a list with other dummyConfigParam DPLs and passed as the parameters argument to gpeCreateDummyConfig to create a dummyConfig DPL.

functions.name: gpeCreateGridEntry
functions.syntax: gpeCreateGridEntry( [ ?row x_row ] [ ?col x_col ] [ ?name t_name ] [ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ] [ ?orientation t_orientation ] [ ?hAlign l_hAlign ] [ ?vAlign l_vAlign ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_gridEntry / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox grid entry DPL for an instance or a dummy. A grid entry can represent either an instance or a dummy.

functions.name: gpeCreateInstTermEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateInstTermEntries( [ ?deviceNames l_deviceNames ] [ ?instTermNames l_instTermNames ] [ ?gridEntries  l_gridEntries ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_instTermEntries / nil
functions.description: Creates instTerms for all combinations of the two identifiers and returns a list of instTerms names that were created. The return value is used as an argument to twig and strap entries to define the connectivity of the topology objects.

functions.name: gpeCreateMapEntry
functions.syntax: gpeCreateMapEntry( [ ?schematicName t_schematicName ] [ ?symbolName t_symbolName ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_mapEntry / nil
functions.description: Creates a map entry DPL that stores the schematic name of an instance, along with its symbol mapping.

functions.name: gpeCreateMatchGroupEntry
functions.syntax: gpeCreateMatchGroupEntry( d_matchGroupID [ ?twigMatchType t_twigMatchType ] [ ?trunkMatchType t_trunkMatchType ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a DPL that represents a matched group. The DPL can then be added to a Modgen sandbox object using the gpeAddMatchGroups function.

functions.name: gpeCreateSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeCreateSandbox( [ ?cv d_cellview ]  [ ?ids l_figs ] [ ?sync { t | nil } ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => u_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox object that includes the specified instances. This function can be used to create Modgen sandbox objects in both schematic and layout cellviews. If none of the arguments are provided, the current edit cellview and selected instances are considered.

functions.name: gpeCreateStrapEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateStrapEntries( [ ?netNames l_netNames ] [ ?instTermEntries l_instTermEntries ] [ ?direction t_direction ] [ ?constraints l_constraints ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_straps / nil
functions.description: Creates straps for the specified nets that connect the specified instance terminals.

functions.name: gpeCreateTrunkChain
functions.syntax: gpeCreateTrunkChain( ?trunks l_trunks ?anchorIndex n_anchorIndex [ ?trunkDirection { horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?offsetDirection { positive | negative } ] [ ?anchorPoint t_anchorPoint ] [ ?anchorReference t_anchorReference ] [ ?centerInChannel { t | nil } ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => g_trunkChainObject / nil
functions.description: Creates trunk chain entries based on the specified identifiers from the sandbox. It is recommended to use only one of the optional arguments. If none of the optional arguments is provided, all trunk chains available in the Modgen are listed. If multiple optional arguments are provided, the return value is the intersection of all the sets.

functions.name: gpeCreateTrunkEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateTrunkEntries( [ ?netNames lt_netNames ] [ ?offset f_offset ] [ ?longOffsetSource1 t_longOffsetSource1 ] [ ?longOffset1 f_longOffset1 ] [ ?longOffsetSource2 t_longOffsetSource2 ] [ ?longOffset2 f_longOffset2 ] [ ?twigs lg_twigs ] [ ?twigConstraints lg_twigConstraints ] [ ?constraints lg_constraints ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?matchGroup l_matchGroupID ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_trunkObjects / nil
functions.description: Creates a list of trunk entries, one for each netName. The properties defined by the arguments are applied to all trunks. To define different properties for each trunk, call the function in a for loop and set the arguments, as required, for each unique trunk.

functions.name: gpeCreateTwigEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateTwigEntries( [ ?instTermEntries l_instTermEntries ] [ ?constraints l_constraints ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => g_twigObject / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox twig object, which specifies the instance terminals to make connections to and the constraints that define how the connections must be made. The twig objects can be added to trunk with the ?twigEntries parameter on gpeCreateTrunkEntries.

functions.name: gpeDeleteDummyEntries
functions.syntax: gpeDeleteDummyEntries( u_sandbox g_includeInternal g_unplaceOnly g_fullRCOnly [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes dummy entries from the given Modgen sandbox object and compresses the grid based on the specified options.

functions.name: gpeDeleteSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeDeleteSandbox( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object but does not delete its associated figGroup.

functions.name: gpeEditSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeEditSandbox( [ d_modgenID | d_figGroupID ] [ g_sync ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => u_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Returns a Modgen sandbox object that represents the current Modgen or figGroup. The sandbox object can be edited using SKILL APIs.

functions.name: gpeExtractReuseTemplate
functions.syntax: gpeExtractReuseTemplate( u_constraint | d_fig | l_instIDs g_structureName t_fileName ) => t | nil
functions.description: Extracts the given Modgen into a reusable text file.

functions.name: gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV
functions.syntax: gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV( l_libNames [ l_cellNames ] [ l_viewNames ] [ g_includeNonUserDefinedGroups ] ) => t | nil
functions.description: Extracts array reuse template files for recognized groups and arrays for all combinations of the specified libraries, cells, and views in the current design.

functions.name: gpeExtractTemplateFromMG
functions.description: Generates a reusable template for each Modgen constraint present in the specified constraint cache.

functions.name: gpeFindArrayPatternDiffs
functions.description: Compares array patterns of the specified Modgen constraints or sandbox objects and reports differences, if any.

functions.name: gpeFinishSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeFinishSandbox( u_sandbox [ ?transfer { t | nil } ] [ ?removeScratch { t | nil } ] [ ?backAnnotate { t | nil } ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object. If run from the schematic view, the Modgen's associated scratch cellview is also deleted. If run from the layout view, the command optionally transfers the Modgen constraint to the schematic view and backannotates any dummies. gpeFinishSandbox must be used in tandem with the functions that create sandboxes, such as gpeCreateSandbox and gpeEditSandbox. It is recommend that all Modgen sandbox objects are finished by calling this function.

functions.name: gpeGetAbut
functions.syntax: gpeGetAbut( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_abut / nil
functions.description: Returns the Modgen abutment DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetAbutTypeList
functions.syntax: gpeGetAbutTypeList	( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_abutTypes / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of abutment types for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetAbutTypeName
functions.syntax: gpeGetAbutTypeName	( u_sandbox x_abutType [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t_abutTypeName / nil
functions.description: Returns the name corresponding to the given abutment type number from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetChannelWidthEntry
functions.syntax: gpeGetChannelWidthEntry( u_sandbox x_channelNumber t_direction [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => g_ChannelWidthEntry / nil
functions.description: Returns the channelWidth sandbox object that matches the specified index and direction values.

functions.name: gpeGetConstraints
functions.syntax: gpeGetConstraints( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => lu_constraintIDs / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of constraint IDs that are associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetDefaultAbutType
functions.syntax: gpeGetDefaultAbutType	( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t_abutTypeName / nil
functions.description: Returns the default abutment type name for the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetFigGroup
functions.syntax: gpeGetFigGroup( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => d_figGoupID / nil
functions.description: Returns the ID of the Modgen figGroup that is associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGrid
functions.syntax: gpeGetGrid( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_grid / nil
functions.description: Returns the Modgen sandbox grid DPL that describes the grid placement of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridColCount
functions.syntax: gpeGetGridColCount( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => x_columnCount / nil
functions.description: Returns the number of columns available in the grid of the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpeGetGridEntries( u_sandbox [ ?row x_row ] [ ?col x_col ] [ ?name t_name ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_gridEntries / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of grid entries from the Modgen sandbox that match the specified identifiers. If you specify multiple identifiers, then the function returns a list of instances that satisfy all requirements.

functions.name: gpeGetGridEntry
functions.syntax: gpeGetGridEntry( u_sandbox [ ?ref d_refID ] [ ?index l_index ] [ ?name t_layoutName ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_gridEntry / nil
functions.description: Returns a grid entry that matches the specified argument for the specified sandbox object. When calling this function, only one search argument of type reference, index, or layout name must be specified. If multiple arguments are specified, an error message is displayed.

functions.name: gpeGetGridRowCount
functions.syntax: gpeGetGridRowCount( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => x_rowCount / nil
functions.description: Returns the number of rows available in the grid of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridSelection
functions.syntax: gpeGetGridSelection( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_gridSelection / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of indexes that represent the grid selection in the GPE (Grid Pattern Editor) assistant. The DPL is a list of list of indexes, for example ((0 1) (1 3) ... ), that are associated with the specified userType (UT).

functions.name: gpeGetGridValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the cells in the Grid Pattern Editor table view.

functions.name: gpeGetMap
functions.syntax: gpeGetMap( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_map / nil
functions.description: Returns the Modgen sandbox map DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetMapEntry
functions.syntax: gpeGetMapEntry( u_sandbox t_name [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_mapEntry / nil
functions.description: Returns the map entry DPL from the specified Modgen sandbox object that matches the specified schematic or symbol name. The function first looks for a matching schematic name; if not found, then looks for a matching symbol name and returns the first match.

functions.name: gpeGetSelection
functions.syntax: gpeGetSelection( g_tableView ) => list(row column) / list(bottom:left top:right)
functions.description: Returns a list of currently selected cells or a range of cells in a grid-pattern-editor table format.

functions.name: gpeGetStrapEntries
functions.syntax: gpeGetStrapEntries( u_sandboxObject [ ?netNames l_netNames ] [ ?deviceNames l_deviceNames ] [ ?instTermNames l_instTermNames ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_straps / nil
functions.description: Filters straps in the Modgen sandbox based on the specified identifiers. It is recommended to use only one of the optional arguments. If no arguments are provided, all straps in the Modgen are displayed. If multiple arguments are provided, the intersection of the sets is displayed.

functions.name: gpeGetTrunkChains
functions.syntax: gpeGetTrunkChains( u_sandbox [ ?anchorIndex n_anchorIndex ] [ ?trunkDirection t_trunkDirection ] [ ?offsetDirection t_offsetDirection ] [ ?anchorPoint t_anchorPoint ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_trunksChains / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of trunk chains based on the specified identifiers. If none of the optional arguments are provided, all trunkChains available in the Modgen are listed. If multiple optional arguments are provided, the return value is the intersection of all the sets.

functions.name: gpeGetTwigEntries
functions.syntax: gpeGetTwigEntries( u_sandbox [ ?trunks l_trunks ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => l_Twigs / nil
functions.description: Returns all twigs on the specified trunks from the specified sandbox.

functions.name: gpeInsertEmptyColumns
functions.syntax: gpeInsertEmptyColumns( u_sandbox t_direction x_startColumn [ ?count n_count ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts empty columns in the specified Modgen sandbox object in the specified direction, starting at the specified column.

functions.name: gpeInsertEmptyRows
functions.syntax: gpeInsertEmptyRows( u_sandbox t_direction x_startRow [ ?count n_count ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts empty rows in the specified Modgen sandbox object in the specified direction, starting at the specified row.

functions.name: gpeIsPresetGenDisplayable
functions.description: Checks whether the given preset generator is displayed in the Preset drop-down of the Grid Pattern Editor for the selected Modgen.

functions.name: gpeIsRegisteredPresetGen
functions.description: Checks whether the specified function is a registered preset generator function.

functions.name: gpeIsSandboxSync
functions.syntax: gpeIsSandboxSync( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks whether the specified Modgen sandbox object is in sync with its associated Modgen constraint, and returns a Boolean that indicates the status.

functions.name: gpeIsValidAbutType
functions.syntax: gpeIsValidAbutType	( u_sandbox { t_abutTypeName | x_abutType } [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Validates the specified abutment type name or number for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeLoadReuseTemplate
functions.syntax: gpeLoadReuseTemplate( l_target t_structureName t_fileName [ l_mapping ] [ n_rows ] ) => u_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Creates a new Modgen constraint by applying the given Modgen reuse template to the specified list of instances.

functions.name: gpeMove
functions.syntax: gpeMove( g_tableView [ g_cells ] g_fromAnchor g_toAnchor ) => t / nil
functions.description: Moves a list of cells within the Grid Pattern Editor table from one point to another.

functions.name: gpePlaceGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpePlaceGridEntries	( u_sandbox l_gridEntries [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Places the specified grid entries at the specified location in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpePresetReorientResistor
functions.description: Flips the orientations of the members of a preselected Modgen to reduce the overall connectivity wire length. The placement of the members is not altered.

functions.name: gpeRegisterPresetGen
functions.syntax: gpeRegisterPresetGen( t_displayName  t_functionName  t_checkFunctionName [ g_noStacks ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the specified function as a preset generator.

functions.name: gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns
functions.syntax: gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns( u_sandbox g_includeInternal [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes empty rows and columns from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeRemoveInstance
functions.description: Removes the given instances from the specified Modgen figGroup.

functions.name: gpeRunPresetGen
functions.description: Invokes the specified preset generator function on the active figGroup. The figGroup is updated according to the preset generator logic. Ensure that the Grid Pattern Editor (GPE) assistant is open when running this command. Also ensure that the selection argument specifies a valid Modgen figGroup and that the preset is registered correctly.

functions.name: gpeSboxp
functions.syntax: gpeSboxp( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks whether the specified object is a valid Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeSelect
functions.syntax: gpeSelect( g_tableView [g_selectionList | g_type g_value] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Select cells in the Grid Pattern Editor or Grid Pattern Mapping assistants.

functions.name: gpeSetAbut
functions.syntax: gpeSetAbut( u_sandbox g_abut [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the abutment for the entire grid, without using individual abutment entries. The entire abutment object of the sandbox-in-place is replaced.

functions.name: gpeSetAbutEntries
functions.syntax: gpeSetAbutEntries u_sandbox l_abutEntries [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Modifies the Modgen sandbox object by applying the abutment specified by the abutment entries. If there is any conflict between the new entry and any existing entry, the existing entry is removed and the new entry is used.

functions.name: gpeSetChannelWidthEntry
functions.syntax: gpeSetChannelWidthEntry( u_sandbox x_index t_direction g_channelWidth [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the channelWidth for the specified channel.

functions.name: gpeSetGrid
functions.syntax: gpeSetGrid( u_sandbox l_grid [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the entire grid without using individual grid entries. You can also use this function to update grid placement by providing a list of lists describing the row placement of instances.

functions.name: gpeSetGridEntry
functions.syntax: gpeSetGridEntry( u_sandbox l_gridEntry [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified grid entry to the grid portion of the specified Modgen sandbox object. If the grid location specified in the grid entry is already occupied, the existing entry is unplaced, and the specified grid entry is set.

functions.name: gpeSetGridText
functions.description: Specifies a textual grid pattern for the Pattern field on the Text tab of the Grid Pattern Editor assistant.

functions.name: gpeSetGridValue
functions.syntax: gpeSetGridValue( g_tableView [ g_location ] S_value [ s_type ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the Grid Pattern Editor table view cells. If there is a single cell selected before the call, the next cell will be selected automatically.

functions.name: gpeSetMap
functions.syntax: gpeSetMap( u_sandbox g_map [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the symbol mapping without using individual map entries. When a sandbox map DPL is specified, the current mapping of instances is replaced with the mapping specified by the provided map DPL. Symbol mapping can also be updated by providing a list of lists of strings. The first string in each sub-list holds the schematic name of an instance and the second string holds its updated mapping.

functions.name: gpeSetMapEntry
functions.syntax: gpeSetMapEntry( u_sandbox l_mapEntry [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Modifies the map portion of the Modgen sandbox object by updating the symbol mapping value with the specified map entry. The key in the map is the schematic name. If the sandbox has a schematic instance with the same name as the one specified in the map entry, then the symbol mapping of that instance in the sandbox is modified.

functions.name: gpeSetMergeLayer
functions.syntax: gpeSetMergeLayer( u_sandbox g_mergeLayer { default | well | none | t_layerName | l_layerNames } [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the MergeLayer parameter for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeSetOrientText
functions.description: Specifies the grid pattern orientation for the Orient field on the Text tab of the Grid Pattern Editor assistant.

functions.name: gpeSetRouter
functions.syntax: gpeSetRouter( u_sandbox t_router [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the router to be used to route the Modgen.

functions.name: gpeSetSize
functions.syntax: gpeSetSize( g_tableView l_dimensions ['stable | 'nostable] [ n_rows ] [ n_columns ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Resizes the specified Grid Pattern Editor table. If the table dimensions are smaller or larger than the new dimensions, then rows or columns are added or removed, as needed.

functions.name: gpeStacksAreCompressed
functions.syntax: gpeStacksAreCompressed( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether the stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object are in the compressed state.

functions.name: gpeStacksCompress:
functions.syntax: gpeStacksCompress( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Compresses all stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeStacksUncompress
functions.syntax: gpeStacksUncompress( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Uncompresses all stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeStartSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeStartSandbox( [ ?ref l_reference ]  [ ?cv d_cellview ]  [ ?sync { t | nil } ] [ ?updateSchConstraint { t | nil } ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => g_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Checks for a Modgen sandbox object that includes the specified instances. If one exists, the handle of the Modgen sandbox object is returned for editing with the GPE placement and routing APIs. If an existing object does not have the specified instances, a new Modgen sandbox object is created.

functions.name: gpeSyncSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeSyncSandbox( u_sandbox [ g_transferConstraint ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified Modgen sandbox object to sync mode, meaning that changes made to the state of the Modgen sandbox object cause an update to any associated Modgen constraint and layout placement.

functions.name: gpeUnAbutGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpeUnAbutGridEntries( u_sandbox l_gridEntries [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Unabuts the specified list of instances or indexes in the specified sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeUnSyncSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeUnSyncSandbox( u_sandbox [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified Modgen sandbox object to the unsynchronized mode. In this mode, any change to the state of the Modgen sandbox object is not reflected in any associated Modgen constraint and the layout placement.

functions.name: gpeUnregisterPresetGen
functions.description: Unregisters the given preset generator function from the Grid Pattern Editor.

functions.name: gpeUpdateInstanceFromSchematic
functions.description: Updates the given Modgen instance parameters based on the binding schematic cellview.

functions.name: hiLayerDispMainForm
functions.description: Opens the Layer Purpose Pair Editor form. You can also access this form using the CIW - Tools - Technology File Manager - Edit Layers command.

functions.name: hiMakeLPChoiceList
functions.syntax: hiMakeLPChoiceList(  d_techFileID  l_layerName&Purpose  [ g_layerNum ] [ g_swatchIcon ] )  => l_iconList / nil
functions.description: Creates a layer purpose icon list for use in a form field or menu.

functions.name: iccIsConnected
functions.description: Indicates if a connection from the Virtuoso Studio Design Environment to the router has been established.

functions.name: iccSendCommand
functions.description: Sends a command to the router command line interpreter.

functions.name: iccSendSkillCommand
functions.description: Sends a SKILL command to the router.

functions.name: lceAddSimpleStopLayers
functions.description: Adds simple derived layers to the validLayers section of the technology file that has the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group defined. This SKILL function can be useful for adding simple stop layers in memory when the technology file cannot be edited on disk. If a stop layer is added and the second layer has an unknown material, the material is automatically changed to recognition. If you add an invalid stop layer, you must close the design or launch a new Virtuoso session to refresh the memory.

functions.name: lceClearLogicalConn
functions.description: Removes the logical connectivity on the specified cellview, such as nets that are not attached to terminals, and the nets and lxStickyNet property on all routes, shapes, and vias. In addition, the function clears all connectivity on instTerms and removes the markers created by the extractor.

functions.name: lceDestroyVoidShapes
functions.description: Destroys void shapes in the given layout cellview.

functions.name: lceExtract
functions.syntax: lceExtract( d_layCellViewID [ ?reportType reportType ] [ ?disableAnnotationChecking { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the Layout XL connectivity extractor on the specified cellview.

functions.name: lceExtractArea
functions.syntax: lceExtractArea( d_layCellViewID l_points [ ?reportType reportType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Extracts connectivity for a specified area of the design.

functions.name: lceExtractAreas
functions.syntax: lceExtractAreas( d_layCellViewID l_points [ ?reportType reportType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Extracts connectivity for the specified areas of the design.

functions.name: lceExtractNet
functions.syntax: lceExtractNet( net [ ?reportType reportType ] [ ?disableAnnotationChecking {t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the Layout XL connectivity extractor on the specified net.

functions.name: lceExtractNets
functions.syntax: lceExtractNets( l_nets [ ?reportType reportType ] [ ?disableAnnotationChecking {t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the Layout XL connectivity extractor on the specified nets.

functions.name: lceExtractUnverifiedAreas
functions.description: Extracts connectivity for the unverified areas that are defined by the bounding box of the specified markers.

functions.name: lceGetExtractLayers
functions.description: Lists the extractable layer-purpose pairs (LPPs) defined for a specified layout cellview. Layout XL can extract through the LPPs that are listed.

functions.name: lceGetFracturedShapes
functions.syntax: lceGetFracturedShapes( d_dbFigID [ g_points ] [ g_floatingOnly ] [ d_netID ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a report of the geometry and connectivity of fractured shapes that exist within a figure (shape or prBoundary).

functions.name: lceGetFracturedShapesFromNet
functions.description: Generates a report of fractured shapes corresponding to a specific net.

functions.name: lceGetIncompleteNetMarkers
functions.description: Generates a list of open markers on the specified incomplete nets. If a single net is specified, the opens on that net are returned. If multiple nets are specified, the opens on each net in the list are returned. If no nets are specified, all the opens in the design are returned.

functions.name: lceGetIncompleteNets
functions.description: Returns the list of incomplete net IDs corresponding to the specified cellview.

functions.name: lceGetNetNamesFromArea
functions.syntax: lceGetNetNamesFromArea( d_layCellViewID l_region l_layerNames [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] [ ?maxNumNets n_maxNumNets ] [ ?numChasedShapesLimit n_numChasedShapesLimit ] )  => l_netNames
functions.description: Returns a list of the net names corresponding to the effective connectivity of the shapes on the specified layers overlapping a specified area.

functions.name: lceGetOption
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified Connectivity Extractor option for the current or given cellview.

functions.name: lceGetShortMarkers
functions.description: Prints a list of short markers between the passed nets. If a single net is specified, the shorts between this net and all the other nets are returned. If two nets are specified, the shorts between these two nets are returned. If more nets are specified, the shorts between pairs of nets in the list are returned.

functions.name: lceHiExtract
functions.description: Opens the Extract Layout form, which you can use to extract the design either at the top level or hierarchically.

functions.name: lceHierExtract
functions.syntax: lceHierExtract( d_cellViewID x_searchDepth g_extractAll { t | nil } g_saveExtractedCellviews { t | nil } g_skipTopCellview { t | nil } [ g_fromUserList { t | nil } ] [ g_fromSelectedInsts { t | nil } ] [ g_reportType  [ g_extractPCells { t | nil } ] [ g_disableAnnotationChecking { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Performs connectivity extraction of a hierarchy of cellviews from bottom to top.

functions.name: lceIsExtractLayer
functions.description: Checks whether the specified layer or layer-purpose pair (LPP) is extractable.

functions.name: lceIsShapeTrimmed
functions.description: Checks if the specified shape has been trimmed during connectivity extraction.

functions.name: lcePrintConstraintGroupWarnings
functions.description: Prints the warnings issued by the connectivity extractor for the specified technology library. The constraint group for which the warnings are issued is the one defined using the setupConstraintGroup environment variable.

functions.name: lcePrintExtractLayers
functions.syntax: lcePrintExtractLayers( d_layCellViewID [ ?cgName d_cgName ] [ ?verifyWellSubstrateConnections { t | nil } ] [ ?useOverlappingLabelsAsConnectivitySources { t | nil } ] [ ?enableVirtualConnections { t | nil } ] [ ?fileName t_fileName ] [ ?appendToFile { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a report about the extractable layers. See Diagnostics Report (Connectivity form).

functions.name: lcePrintExtractVias
functions.syntax: lcePrintExtractVias( d_layCellViewID [ ?cgName d_cgName ] [ ?verifyWellSubstrateConnections { t | nil } ] [ ?useOverlappingLabelsAsConnectivitySources { t | nil } ] [ ?enableVirtualConnections { t | nil } ] [ ?fileName t_fileName ] [ ?appendToFile { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a report about the extractable vias.

functions.name: lcePrintTechDiagnostics
functions.syntax: lcePrintTechDiagnostics( d_layCellViewID [ ?cgName d_cgName ] [ ?verifyWellSubstrateConnections { t | nil } ] [ ?useOverlappingLabelsAsConnectivitySources { t | nil } ] [ ?enableVirtualConnections { t | nil } ] [ ?fileName t_fileName ] [ ?appendToFile { t | nil } ] ) => t
functions.description: Generates a report about the connectivity extractor technology diagnostics and indicates if the technology file has been correctly set up for extraction. See Diagnostics Reports (Connectivity form).

functions.name: lceRegenerateVoidShapes
functions.description: Regenerates void shapes in the given layout cellview.

functions.name: lceSetOption
functions.syntax: lceSetOption( name value [ cvID ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified Connectivity Extractor option for the current or given cellview.

functions.name: lceShortLocatorChaseAndSave
functions.syntax: lceShortLocatorChaseAndSave( d_winID g_shapes g_hierStart t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Chases islands from the specified start shapes and saves them along with the shortest paths between their points of stickiness.

functions.name: lceShortLocatorRaiseForm
functions.description: Opens the Short Locator form, which you can use to locate the shapes in a layout that are causing shorts.

functions.name: leAlign
functions.description: Aligns the objects in the selection set. The objects are aligned to the left, right, top, or bottom edge of the selection box or along the center of the selection box in the vertical or horizontal direction.

functions.name: leApplyAreaFunction
functions.syntax: leApplyAreaFunction(  s_funcs_funcSymbol d_databaseId l_paramList )  => f_result / nil
functions.description: Runs the area estimation function (provided as a function symbol) with provided parameters and database Id. This function is added as a part of Area Estimation consolidation.

functions.name: leApplyLastCopyTransform
functions.description: Copies the selected objects and applies the same transform as done in the last copy command and selects the newly created objects.

functions.name: leArrowFunc
functions.syntax: leArrowFunc(  t_keyName [ g_optionalArg ]  )  => return value from the called function or function bound by default or nil
functions.description: Executes the function specified in the layout environmental variable spaceFuncName, passing the ID of the current window, the key name, and the optional argument. If spaceFuncName is empty, this function executes the current non-enter function binding for the specified key name.

functions.name: leAttachFig
functions.description: Attaches d_figId1 to d_figId2 by making d_figId1 a child of d_figId2. If d_figId1 is already attached to another object, it is detached from it. If d_figId2 is not specified, d_figId1 is detached from any object it is currently attached to without attaching it to anything else.

functions.name: leBalloonCycleThru
functions.description: Cycles through overlapping objects displaying Info Balloon information for the individual objects. By default, the function is registered to Ctrl + i.

functions.name: leBalloonToggleOnOff
functions.description: Turns Info Balloons on or off. Info Balloons opens a window which displays information about an object when the mouse cursor is placed over the object.

functions.name: leCARCommand
functions.syntax: leCARCommand(  t_replayFileName  [ g_enterPointFlag ] [ g_debugFlag ] )  => l_recordedActions / nil
functions.description: (Layout EXL and higher tiers only) Replays the set of actions recorded in a .car file.

functions.name: leCARReloadReplays
functions.description: (Layout EXL and higher tiers only) Reloads the replays in all the open sessions. The replays with .car extension are displayed in the refreshed list of replay buttons.

functions.name: leCARStartCapture
functions.description: (Layout EXL and higher tiers only) Starts recording the actions that you perform in the current design window.

functions.name: leCARStopCapture
functions.description: (Layout EXL and higher tiers only) Stops the recording that was started using the leCARStartCapture SKILL function.

functions.name: leChopShape
functions.syntax: leChopShape( d_shapeId  l_points  g_closed  [ g_remove ]  [ x_sides ] )  => l_newShapes / nil
functions.description: Cuts the shape d_shapeId using the chop shape l_points.

functions.name: leClearAllMeasurement
functions.description: Deletes all measurements in the specified cellview.

functions.name: leCloseWindow
functions.description: Closes the current layout window. Similar to the hiCloseWindow function. To customize a bindkey you must use leCloseWindow because it is the function used in the callback of the File - Close menu command.

functions.name: leComputeAreaDensity
functions.syntax: leComputeAreaDensity( w_windowId l_lppSpec [ ?depth x_depth ] [ ?region l_region ] )  => l_result / nil
functions.description: Computes the total area and the density of shapes with specified layers within a region. If part of the shape is inside the region, only the area of the part that is inside the region is calculated.

functions.name: leComputeFigArea
functions.description: Computes the area of an object. The following objects are supported: rectangle, label, text display, polygon, ellipse, dot, marker, donut, path, figGroup, row, pathSeg, transmission line (trl), bend, taper, area or layer blockage, and area, snap, cluster, or place and route (PR) boundary.

functions.name: leConvertInstToMosaic
functions.syntax: leConvertInstToMosaic( d_instId | ld_instId [ mode { t | nil } ] )  => ld_mosaicId / nil
functions.description: Converts one or more selected instances into one or more mosaics.

functions.name: leConvertMosaicToModgen
functions.syntax: leConvertMosaicToModgen( d_mosaicId | ld_mosaicId )  => d_modgenId | ld_modgenId / nil
functions.description: Converts one or more selected mosaics into one or more modgens.

functions.name: leConvertPolygonToPath
functions.description: Converts the polygon d_polygonId to a path. If the conversion is successful, the polygon is replaced by a path with the same boundary as the polygon.

functions.name: leConvertSelectedDynamicShapes
functions.description: (Virtuoso RF Option) Converts the selected dynamic shapes to static shapes.

functions.name: leConvertShapeToPathSeg
functions.description: Converts a shape to an equivalent pathSeg. The function follows the routing direction defined for the corresponding layer in the technology file.

functions.name: leConvertShapeToPolygon
functions.description: Converts shape d_shapeId to an equivalent polygon. If it is a conic, the polygon has the specified number of sides.

functions.name: leConvertTrimmedShapesToPRStyle
functions.syntax: leConvertTrimmedShapesToPRStyle( d_cvId [ ?layerName t_layerName ] [ ?depth x_depth ] [ ?library l_library ] )  => x_count / nil
functions.description: Converts pathSegs that are trimmed by trim shapes in custom style to PR style so that they are readable in Innovus. Only pathSegs trimmed by trim shapes in the same cellview are converted. PathSegs that are trimmed by trim shapes in a different clone or in a different cellview are not converted. The function searches all trimmed pathSegs on the specified layer in the hierarchy up to the specified depth and converts them to PR style only in the cellviews of the libraries specified. The function also adds the relevant patch type to pathSegs abutted to trim shapes.

functions.name: leCopyTemplatesToCellView
functions.description: Copies the row region templates and WSPDefs from the source cellview specified with the environment variable autoCopyTemplateCellViewList to the cellview specified in this function. If the cellview has existing templates, the new templates from the source cellview are not copied.

functions.name: leCreateAutoPin
functions.syntax: leCreateAutoPin( d_cellViewId  l_point  t_termName t_termDir [ l_lpp ] [ g_pinSnapToWireEnd ] [ x_depth ] [ g_truncateWire ] ) => d_pinShapeId / nil
functions.description: Creates a pin shape in cellview d_cellViewId.

functions.name: leCreateLayerField
functions.syntax: leCreateLayerField( s_name ?callback t_callback ?appendChoices l_appendChoices ?prependChoices l_prependChoices ?maxVisibleItems x_maxVisibleItems ?syncedPaletteWindow w_syncedPaletteWindow ?techFile d_techFile ?value t_value ?enabled g_enabled ?invisible g_invisible ?layerFunction t_layerFunction ?maxWidth x_maxWidth )  => t_layerfield
functions.description: Creates a cyclic field for to display layer-purpose pair (LPP) names with swatches. The combo box created allows you to type and search for a layer purpose pair within the list of values. The list of layers is displayed only if a layout window is open.

functions.name: leCreateMeasurement
functions.syntax: leCreateMeasurement(  d_cellViewId  l_points  [ g_saveRulers ] [ t_rulerDisplayType ] )  => d_rulerID / nil
functions.description: Creates a measurement in cellview d_cellViewId with the coordinates listed in l_points.

functions.name: leCreateNetField
functions.syntax: leCreateNetField  name ?value t_value ?callback t_callback x_maxVisibleItems )  => netfield
functions.description: Creates cyclic field for showing net names of the current cellview. The combo box created allows you to type in and search for the net names within the list of values.

functions.name: leCreatePath
functions.syntax: leCreatePath( d_cellViewId  l_layerPurposePair l_points  n_width  [ t_pathStyle ] [ n_offset ]  [ t_justification ] )  => d_pathId / nil
functions.description: Creates a path in cellview d_cellViewId on the specified layer with point list l_points and width n_width.

functions.name: leCreatePin
functions.syntax: leCreatePin( d_cellViewId  l_layerPurposePair t_shape  l_points  t_termName  t_termDir  l_accessDir ) => d_pinShapeId / nil
functions.description: Creates a pin shape in cellview d_cellViewId on the specified layer.

functions.name: leCycleSnapModes
functions.description: Changes both the edit and create snap modes, in the order of diagonal, anyAngle, and orthogonal. If the edit and create mode values are different (unsynchronized), the first value for Create/Edit snap mode will be diagonal.

functions.name: leCycleSnapPatternDisplay
functions.description: Sets the snap pattern display to the next value in the Snap Pattern Display option, in the order of full, tracks, boundary, and periods.

functions.name: leDecrementStopLevelByOne
functions.description: Decrements the stop level value of the specified window by one when it is greater than zero.

functions.name: leDefineExternalPins
functions.description: Starts the Define External Pins enter function in the current window. The Define External Pins enter function provides a user interface for defining one or more pins on a net as being externally connected outside of a device.

functions.name: leDefineInternalPins
functions.description: Starts the Define Internal Pins enter function in the current window. The Define Internal Pins enter function provides a user interface for defining one or more pins on a net as being internally connected within a device.

functions.name: leDefineMPPTemplate
functions.syntax: leDefineMPPTemplate( 	?techId              d_techId 	?name                S_name 	?layer               list(layerName layerPurpose) 	[ ?width             n_width ] 	[ ?justification     S_justification ] 	[ ?offset            n_offset ] 	[ ?endType           S_endType ] 	[ ?beginExt          n_beginExt ] 	[ ?endExt            n_endExt ] 	[ ?choppable         g_choppable ]  	[ ROD Connectivity Arguments ] 	[ ?offsetSubPath     l_offsetSubpathArgs... ] 	[ ?encSubPath        l_encSubpathArgs... ] 	[ ?subRect           l_subrectArgs... ]  ) ; end leDefineMPPTemplate => t / nil  	; ROD Connectivity Arguments 	[ ?termIOType             S_termIOType ] 	[ ?pin                     g_pin ] 	[ ?pinAccessDir           tl_pinAccessDir ] 	[ ?pinLabel               g_pinLabel ] 	[ ?pinLabelHeight         n_pinLabelHeight ] 	[ ?pinLabelLayer          txl_pinLabelLayer ] 	[ ?pinLabelFont           S_pinLabelFont ] 	[ ?pinLabelDrafting        g_pinLabelDrafting ] 	[ ?pinLabelOrient         S_pinLabelOrient ] 	[ ?pinLabelOffsetPoint     l_pinLabelOffsetPoint ] 	[ ?pinLabelJust           S_pinLabelJust ] 	[ ?pinLabelRefHandle      S_pinLabelRefHandle ] 	; end of ROD Connectivity Arguments  	;l_offsetSubpathArgs  	list( 		list( 			?layer             list(layerName layerPurpose) 			[ ?width           n_width ] 			[ ?sep             n_sep ] 			[ ?justification   S_justification ] 			[ ?beginOffset     n_beginOffset ] 			[ ?endOffset       n_endOffset ] 			[ ?choppable       g_choppable ] 			[ Repeat ROD Connectivity Arguments here ] 			) ;End of first offset subpath list 			...		 		) ;End of offset subpath lists 	;End of l_offsetSubpathArgs  	;l_encSubpathArgs  	list( 		list( 			?layer             list(layerName layerPurpose) 			[ ?enclosure       n_enclosure ] 			[ ?beginOffset     n_beginOffset ] 			[ ?endOffset       n_endOffset ] 			[ ?choppable       g_choppable ]	 			[ Repeat ROD Connectivity Arguments here ] 			) ;End of first enclosure subpath list 			...		 		) ;End of enclosure subpath lists 	;End of l_encSubpathArgs  	;l_subrectArgs  	list( 		list( 			?layer              list(layerName layerPurpose) 			[ ?width            n_width ] 			[ ?length           n_length ] 			[ ?gap              S_gap ] 			[ ?sep              n_sep ] 			[ ?justification    S_justification ] 			[ ?beginOffset      n_beginOffset ] 			[ ?endOffset        n_endOffset ] 			[ ?beginSegOffset   n_beginSegmentOffset 			[ ?endSegOffset     n_endSegmentOffset 			[ ?space            n_space ] 			[ ?choppable        g_choppable ] 			[ Repeat ROD Connectivity Arguments here ] 			[?diagonal g_diagonalSubRect] 			) ;End of first subrectangle list 			...		 		) ;End of subrectangle lists 	;End of l_subrectArgs
functions.description: Provides the structure for defining the field names and default values for one multipart path (MPP) in an ASCII file. This information is referred to as an MPP template. A multipart path is a single relative object design (ROD) object consisting of one or more parts at level zero in the hierarchy on the same or on different layers. The purpose of an MPP template is to create MPPs in layout cellviews using predefined values. You can define any number of MPP templates in a single ASCII file by specifying leDefineMPPTemplate once for each MPP template; each template must be identified by a template name (t_name) that is unique within the ASCII file.

functions.name: leDefinePPPins
functions.description: Starts the Define Pseudo Parallel Connected Net enter function in the current window. Corresponds to the Connectivity - Pins - Pseudo Parallel Connect command. The Define Pseudo Parallel Connected Net form provides a user interface for defining one or more pins on a net as being pseudo parallel connected. If you do not specify w_windowId, the current window is used.

functions.name: leDefineWeaklyConnectedPins
functions.description: Starts the Define Weak Pins enter function in the current window. The Define Weak Pins enter function provides a user interface for defining one or more pins on a net as being weakly connected within a device.

functions.name: leDescend
functions.syntax: leDescend( w_windowId  d_instId  [ x_row ]  [ x_column ]  )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Descends through the hierarchy to open the master of instance d_instId. leDescend attempts to open the cellview in the same mode as the current cellview, but if an editable version is not available, leDescend opens the master in read-only mode.

functions.name: leDesignSummary
functions.syntax: leDesignSummary(  d_cellViewId  t_fileName  g_append  [ w_windowId ]  [ basicSummary ] [ netStats ] [ connectivityStats ] [ routingStats ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Stores or outputs leHiSummary results to an external specified file.

functions.name: leDoubleClick
functions.description: Runs the Edit In Place command on the object if the object at the point of double-click is either an instance or a group.

functions.name: leEIPZoomAbsoluteScale
functions.description: Fits the master cell of the instance you want to edit in the window. This function also supports edit in place for fig groups. The window is redrawn so the edit-in-place cell or fig group fills it.

functions.name: leEditDesignProperties
functions.description: Opens the Edit Cellview Properties form, which lets you change the design properties in the cellview d_cellViewId. If d_cellViewId is not specified, the cellview in the current window is used.

functions.name: leEditInPlace
functions.description: Descends through the hierarchy to edit a cell in place.

functions.name: leEnableInstPropEditFields
functions.syntax: leEnableInstPropEditFields(  t_libName [ ?libField g_libField ] [ ?cellField g_cellField ] => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the Library or Cell fields for an instance in the Property Editor form.

functions.name: leEnvLoad
functions.description: Loads the Virtuoso Layout Suite environment variables from the .cdsenv files. This file must be in your home directory. The variables are read into memory, but the windows are not updated with the new values. When new windows are created, they assume the new values.

functions.name: leExportLabel
functions.description: Saves the label information in the current cellview to the specified file.

functions.name: leFinishTrunk
functions.description: When the Create Wire command is active, this function converts the current wire(s) being edited into trunks. It then uses Pin To Trunk routing to completes the connection between the converted trunk(s) and all possible pin targets that are orthogonal to the trunk(s). The default bindkey is 2.

functions.name: leFinishWire
functions.description: When the Create Wire command is active, this function uses the point-to-point router to complete the current wire or wires being edited from their current end to the nearest viable target.

functions.name: leFlattenInst
functions.syntax: leFlattenInst( d_instId  x_levels  [ g_flattenPCells ] [ g_preservePins ] [ g_preserveRODobjs ] [ g_delDetachedBlockages ] [ g_preservePinFigs ] [ g_flattenVias ] [ g_preserveTermName ] [ t_excludePcellListFileName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Flattens instance d_instId up through x_levels of hierarchy. The optional arguments are positional: you must specify nil for optional arguments prior to an optional argument you want to specify. For example, if you do not want to specify g_flattenPCells, but want to set g_preservePins to t, you need to specify both (nil t).

functions.name: leFreezeInst
functions.syntax: leFreezeInst( d_instId  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ g_overwrite ] [ g_reuse ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Converts a Pcell instance to a non-Pcell instance of a new master created on the disk for the specified library, cell, and view. This function is supported for mosaics.

functions.name: leFullSelectFigOfSelSet
functions.description: Fully selects all the partially selected figures. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leGetAreaEstimationDisplayNames
functions.description: Retrieves area estimation function alias name list defined for the specified object types. The object types supported are 'cellView, 'inst, cluster, 'group. This function is added as a part of Area Estimation consolidation.

functions.name: leGetAreaEstimatorFunction
functions.description: Retrieves the function symbol of the area estimation function registered for alias name and object type. This function is added for Area Estimation Consolidation.

functions.name: leGetAreaEstimatorParamList
functions.description: Retrieves the parameter list of the area estimation function registered for alias name and object type. This function is added as a part of area estimation consolidation.

functions.name: leGetAreaEstimatorRunMode
functions.description: Retrieve the Run Mode list of the area estimation function registered for alias name and object types. This function is added as a part of area estimation consolidation.

functions.name: leGetCoordinateForm
functions.description: Opens the Enter Points form which is used to specify the coordinates required to allow a command to proceed.

functions.name: leGetEditFigGroup
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the currently active figure group for Edit-In-Group mode editing, in the specified window or the current window.

functions.name: leGetEntryLayer
functions.description: Returns the entry layer for technology file d_techFileId as a list containing the layer name and layer purpose. If d_techFileId is not specified, the current technology file is used.

functions.name: leGetEnv
functions.description: Returns the value currently assigned to the layout environment properties with the variable t_name.

functions.name: leGetGlobalGridsVisible
functions.description: Returns the visibility setting of global snap pattern grids.

functions.name: leGetLocalGridsVisible
functions.description: Returns the visibility setting of local snap pattern grids.

functions.name: leGetObjectSelectable
functions.description: Checks whether or not objects are set to selectable in the LSW.

functions.name: leGetObjectVisible
functions.description: Checks whether or not objects are set to visible in the LSW.

functions.name: leGetRefPoint
functions.description: Returns the reference point of cellview d_cellViewId. The reference point must be active.

functions.name: leGetSnapOptions
functions.description: Generates the default snap options in the form of DPLs (Disembodied Property Lists). If a valid window ID is specified in the input list and it is a layout window, the options are listed considering window variables. If a window ID is not specified, the default values of environment variables are listed.

functions.name: leGetSnapPatternVisible
functions.description: Returns the visibility setting of snap pattern grid with the specified name.

functions.name: leGetSnapToSPTransform
functions.syntax: leGetSnapToSPTransform( figId [ ?snapPatternDepth n_snapPatternDepth ] [ ?movingItemDepth n_movingItemDepth ] [ ?snapPatternLPP g_snapPatternLPP ] ) => x_InstTransform
functions.description: Returns the transform required to align the given figure with an underlying snap pattern or global grid. If a transform is not found, the function returns the identity transform.

functions.name: leGetSnapTransform
functions.syntax: leGetSnapTransform  d_figToSnap  d_targetRow | nil l_projectionTransform  l_ignoreFigs l_options g_detailedResults )  => l_result / nil
functions.description: Returns snap transform for the figure. The cellview of the figure is the one where the snapping is taking place. This function does not modify figure or cellview so it works for read only cellview as well. The cellview and the specified options are used to determine the licenses needed for the function to run. If the licenses can be checked out, the function runs. If not, the return value signifies failure because of licensing.

functions.name: leGetTechFormList
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) that stores the dynamic form Ids associated with a technology library opened in a Virtuoso session. If the forms have not been opened yet, the SKILL function creates the forms and returns the form ID list.

functions.name: leGetValidLayerList
functions.description: Returns a list of the valid entry layers for technology file d_techFileId. A layout view must be open for leGetValidLayerList to return the list of valid entry layers.

functions.name: leGetValidPurposeList
functions.description: Returns a list of all valid purposes for the specified technology file.

functions.name: leGetWidthSpacingGridsVisible
functions.description: Returns the visibility setting of width spacing snap pattern grids.

functions.name: leGetWidthSpacingSnapPatternVisible
functions.description: Returns the visibility setting of the specified width spacing snap pattern grid.

functions.name: leGetWirebondProfileVisible
functions.description: (Virtuoso RF Option) Returns the visibility setting of the specified wirebond profile.

functions.name: leHiAbout
functions.description: Opens the product information window, which includes the release number and copyright information.

functions.name: leHiAddShapeToNet
functions.description: Opens the Add Shape To Net form, which lets you associate a shape with a net. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiAddToGroup
functions.description: Opens the Select Target Group form to add shapes to an existing group.

functions.name: leHiAddWireVia
functions.syntax: leHiAddWireVia(  [ w_windowId ]  [ t_defaultTarget ]  [ g_rotate ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: When the Create - Wire command is active, this function allows you to place a via on a path or pathSeg or opens the Select Via form and select a via. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiAlign
functions.description: Opens the Align form, and returns the value of t.

functions.name: leHiAreaDensity
functions.description: Opens the Area and Density Calculator form in the specified window. This form lets you compute area and density of shapes. You can choose options to specify region, LPP, and hierarchical depth for the shapes to be considered for area and density calculations. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiAssignNet
functions.description: Starts the Assign Net enter function that provides the user interface for assigning new and existing nets to shapes, instance pins, vias, and pathSegs.

functions.name: leHiAttach
functions.description: Attaches a selected object in the specified window to another object in the window. The attached object is called the child object, and the object it is attached to is called the parent object. When you move, copy, or delete the parent, the child is also moved, copied, or deleted. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiBatchChecker
functions.description: Opens the Batch Checker form.

functions.name: leHiCancelStitch
functions.description: Cancels the via that is being added in a layout and returns to an active wire editing command, such as Create Wire or Create Bus.

functions.name: leHiCellviewTrackPatterns
functions.description: Opens the Track Pattern Editor form, which lets you add, update or delete track patterns. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiChop
functions.description: Opens the Chop form, which lets you remove parts of objects or break objects into multiple objects. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiClearMeasurement
functions.description: Clears the edit cellview measurement for the specified window. If windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiClearMeasurementInHier
functions.description: Clears the measurements in the hierarchy in the specified window. If windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiClearRuler
functions.description: Clears the rulers that stay in the window when the Keep Ruler option is selected using leHiCreateRuler. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiConvertInstToMosaic
functions.description: Starts the Convert To Mosaic command, which lets you convert one or more selected instances either into an equivalent number of mosaics or into a single mosaic. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used. You are prompted to select one or more instances to convert into mosaics.

functions.name: leHiConvertMosaicToInst
functions.description: Converts mosaics to instances.

functions.name: leHiConvertMosaicToModgen
functions.description: Converts one or more selected mosaics to an equivalent number of modgens. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used. You are prompted to select one or more mosaics to convert into modgens.

functions.name: leHiConvertPolygonToPath
functions.description: Converts a selected polygon in the specified window to a path if a uniform width path can be inferred. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiConvertShapeToPathSeg
functions.description: Converts a selected polygon, rectangle, or path in the specified window to a pathSeg, if a uniform width path can be inferred. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiConvertShapeToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a selected object in the specified window to a polygon. Converts rectangles, paths, donuts, circles, and ellipses using the number of conic sides specified using leHiEditEditorOptions. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCopy
functions.description: Opens the Copy form, which lets you copy selected objects in the specified window. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateAreaBoundary
functions.description: Opens the Create Area Boundary form, which lets you create an Area Boundary. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateBend
functions.description: Opens the Transmission Line Bend form, which lets you create a transmission line bend in the specified window. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateBlockage
functions.description: Opens the Create Blockage form, which lets you create blockages. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateBus
functions.description: Starts the Create - Bus command in XL. You can press F3 to open the Create Bus form. The command lets you create buses.

functions.name: leHiCreateChoiceOfPin
functions.description: Opens the Create Pin form in w_windowId. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateCircle
functions.description: Creates a circle in the specified window. You are prompted to point to a location for the center of the circle and the outer edge of the circle. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateClusterBoundary
functions.description: Opens the Create Cluster Boundary form, which lets you create a cluster boundary. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateClusters
functions.description: Opens the Create - P&R Objects - Clusters form, which lets you create and edit clusters and sub-clusters. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateDonut
functions.description: Creates a donut in the specified window. You are prompted to point to a location for the center of the donut, the inner edge of the donut, and the outer edge of the donut. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateEllipse
functions.description: Creates an ellipse in the specified window. You are prompted to point to the corners of the bounding box for the ellipse. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateGeometricWire
functions.description: Starts the Create - Shape - Geometric Wire command. You can press F3 to open the Create Geometric Wire form. Using this command, you can create geometric wires comprising of paths or pathSegs and vias outside of routes. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: leHiCreateGroup
functions.description: Opens the Create Group form to select figures to form a new group.

functions.name: leHiCreateGuardRing
