functions.description: Starts the Generate All From Source command, building the Generate Layout form without displaying it to the screen.

functions.name: lxGetAvailablePinLPPs
functions.description: Lists the valid layer-purpose pairs to use for setting the pin layer. This function must always be called between calls to lxGenerateStart and lxGenerateFinish or lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart and lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish. It is typically used to find a layer-purpose pair to pass to lxSetNetPinSpecs.

functions.name: lxGetCloneFamilyName
functions.description: Returns the family name of the specified clone.

functions.name: lxGetConnRef
functions.description: Gets the connectivity reference for the specified layout cellview or for the layout cellview opened in the specified window. The layout cellview does not need to be open in a Layout XL session for the connectivity reference to be returned.

functions.name: lxGetEditedSyncClone
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the synchronous clone currently being edited in the specified layout cellview. If the function finds a currently-edited layout group which is not a synchronous clone, it recursively checks to determine if its parent group is a synchronous clone. If it is, the function returns the ID of the parent synchronous clone.

functions.name: lxGetGroupArrayParams
functions.description: Returns parameters of the specified group array.

functions.name: lxGetOtherClonesInFamily
functions.description: The generated list does not contain the specified clone.

functions.name: lxGetPermutedInstTerms
functions.description: Returns the list of database IDs of instance terminals that have been permuted on a specified layout instance. The function can identify instance terminals that have been permuted, even if there is no permuteRule property on the schematic or layout instances or their masters.

functions.name: lxGetPinNets
functions.description: Lists the pin net names from the Generate Layout or Update Components and Nets form. This function must always be called between calls to lxGenerateStart and lxGenerateFinish or lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart and lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish. It is typically used to find net names to pass to lxSetNetPinSpecs.

functions.name: lxGetSchematic
functions.description: Returns either the schematic currently open in an existing Layout XL session, the schematic defined by the connectivity reference returned by lxGetConnRef, or the schematic in the same library and cell as the layout when no connectivity reference is defined.

functions.name: lxGetSource
functions.description: Returns the source (schematic) cellview ID for the specified layout window ID or layout cellview ID in the current Layout XL session. If the schematic reference for the specified layout window has changed since the current Layout XL session was started, Layout XL must be relaunched for lxGetSource to return the updated schematic reference.

functions.name: lxGetSyncClone
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the synchronous clone to which the specified object belongs. If the object belongs to a layout group which is not a synchronous clone, the function recursively checks to determine if its parent group is a synchronous clone. If it is, the function returns the ID of the parent synchronous clone.

functions.name: lxGetValidViaDefs
functions.syntax: lxGetValidViaDefs( d_objID [ ds_constraintGroup ] [ ltx_bottomLayer ] [ ltx_topLayer ] ) => list_of_viaDefs / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of via definitions associated with a specified design object. You can restrict the list to include only vias defined in a specified constraint group or which feature a specific top and/or bottom layer. If you specify a technology file, no constraint groups, and no layers, the function returns all the via definitions in the technology database. If you specify both top and bottom layers, the function returns only via definitions featuring those layers. If you specify either a top or bottom layer, the function returns only via definitions featuring the layer in question.

functions.name: lxGetVirtualFigGroupMasterName
functions.description: Returns the schematic cellview name for the specified virtual figGroup in the format 'lib/cell/view'.

functions.name: lxGroupArrayCreatePreset
functions.syntax: lxGroupArrayCreatePreset( t_presetName t_orientPattern t_presetDesc g_isEditable ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates an orientation pattern for group arrays.

functions.name: lxHiAbout
functions.description: Opens the product information window for Layout XL, which includes the release number and the copyright information.

functions.name: lxHiAdjustAreaBoundary
functions.description: Opens the Adjust Boundary form, which can be used to modify the area boundary of the selected virtual figGroups.

functions.name: lxHiAdjustBoundary
functions.description: Adjusts the area boundary of the selected virtual figGroups or the PR Boundary of the selected soft blocks.

functions.name: lxHiAlign
functions.description: Opens the Align form, in which you can specify how selected objects are to be aligned in the layout window design area.

functions.name: lxHiAutoPlace
functions.description: Opens the Auto Placer form in which you can set placement parameters and run the Virtuoso Custom Digital Placer automatic placement function.

functions.name: lxHiBackAnnotateAllActiveDummies
functions.syntax: lxHiBackAnnotateAllActiveDummies( [ ?schCV d_schCellViewId ] [ ?layCV d_layCellViewId ] [ ?autoSchExtract { t | nil } ] ) => t
functions.description: Backannotates to schematic the symbols of all the active dummy devices-dummy devices that are not tied to a power or ground net and are not bound in the current layout view. If the schematic and the layout cellview IDs are not supplied, Virtuoso tries to determine them automatically.

functions.name: lxHiBackAnnotateDummies
functions.description: Launches the interactive backannotation enter function to create dummy instances from the layout view into the corresponding schematic view.

functions.name: lxHiBackAnnotateSelectedDummies
functions.syntax: lxHiBackAnnotateSelectedDummies( [ ?schCV d_schCellViewId ] [ ?layCV d_layCellViewId ] [ ?autoSchExtract { t | nil } ] [ ?figs l_figs ] ) => t
functions.description: Backannotates to schematic the symbols of selected active dummy devices-dummy devices that are not tied to a power or ground net and are not bound in the current layout view. If the schematic and the layout cellview IDs are not supplied, Virtuoso tries to determine them automatically.

functions.name: lxHiChain
functions.description: Opens the Generate Chained Devices form, which you can use to specify the transistors in the design to be chained, and starts the interactive chaining function on the design in the specified window. If you do not specify a window, it operates on the design in the current window.

functions.name: lxHiCheck
functions.description: Checks XL compliance of the layout when called using the Connectivity - Check - XL Compliance command.

functions.name: lxHiCheckAllTerminalInterfaces
functions.description: Checks the interface and physical-only status of all the scalar terminals in the currently edited layout cellview. Markers are created in the layout for any mismatches found.

functions.name: lxHiClone
functions.description: Opens the Generate Clones form, which you can use to specify cloning parameters, and starts the interactive cloning function, which lets you replicate a section of the layout in such a way that the new piece of layout material can be placed at more than one location, with each part preserving the hierarchical structure and connectivity of the source. You can clone devices, pins, and (if selected from the layout window) interconnect structures such as wires and paths made of shapes. The interactive cloning function operates on the design in the specified window. If you do not specify a window, the function operates on the design in the current window.

functions.name: lxHiConnectInstPin
functions.description: Opens the Assign Nets form and starts the Assign Nets command, which let you assign instance pins to nets in the design.

functions.name: lxHiConvertMosaicToGroupArray
functions.description: Converts the selected mosaic to a group array. If a mosaic is not selected in the window, it starts the command and prompts you to select the mosaic that you want to convert to a group array.

functions.name: lxHiCreateGroup
functions.description: Creates a figGroup using the selected set of components, if the selected set is not already inside an existing figGroup. If the selected set is inside a virtual hierarchy in a cellview opened in Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL, the SKILL function creates a virtual group.

functions.name: lxHiCreateInstFromSch
functions.description: Opens the Generate Selected Components form and starts the interactive command which lets you generate selected schematic components in the layout view. The function operates on the design in the specified window. If you do not specify a window, the function operates on the current window.

functions.name: lxHiCreateMPP
functions.description: Opens the Create Multipart Path form, which you can use to specify the parameters for creating a multipart path, and starts the interactive command which lets you create a path in the layout window. The function operates on the design in the specified window. If you do not specify a window, the function operates on the design in the current window.

functions.name: lxHiCreatePinsFromLabels
functions.description: Creates pins in the layout from labels for those schematic terminals that do not have a corresponding layout pin. Additionally, creates pins for terminals that already have pins but labels are swapped in the layout.

functions.name: lxHiCreateVirtGroup
functions.description: Creates a virtual figGroup using the selected layout instances that are bound to schematic instances in the same design. When the vhSelectionMode environment variable is set to t, the SKILL function also creates virtual figGroups using selected layout devices that are bound to schematic instances from different designs. If a layout window is not specified, the function creates a virtual figGroup in the current window.

functions.name: lxHiDefineDeviceCorr
functions.description: Opens the Define Device Correspondence form, which lets you bind schematic devices to layout devices.

functions.name: lxHiDesignPlanningOptions
functions.description: Opens the Design Planning and Analysis Options form.

functions.name: lxHiEditComponentTypes
functions.description: Opens the Configure Physical Hierarchy window in Component Types mode, which lets you define component types and assign cells to them. The function operates on the design in the specified layout window. If you do not specify a layout window, it operates on the design in the current one; if there is no current layout window, the function exits.

functions.name: lxHiGenerateSelectedFromLayout
functions.description: Starts the Generate Selected From Layout enter function, which lets you generate selected layout components in the corresponding schematic cellview. The layout window from which the components are selected is specified. If the layout window is not specified, the function operates on the current window.

functions.name: lxHiGenerateSelectedVirtualHierarchy
functions.description: Runs the Generate Selected From Source command with the Design Planning - Virtual Hierarchy option selected to generate virtual hierarchies for the selected schematic instances.

functions.name: lxHiGenerateVirtualHierarchy
functions.description: Runs the Generate All From Source command with the Generate - Design Planning - Virtual Hierarchy option selected to generate virtual hierarchies.

functions.name: lxHiIChain
functions.description: Starts the enter function available through the shortcut menu of selected instances, pins, or a group of abutted instances to support incremental interactive chaining. The selected instances, pins, or a single group of abutted objects are considered as anchors to start the chain and the subsequent user-specified points are then used to interactively chain the instances and top-level pins until the Esc key is pressed to stop the function.

functions.name: lxHiLockSelected
functions.description: Sets the placement status of the currently selected objects to locked. Each object is locked at its current location and orientation in the layout view.

functions.name: lxHiMakeCell
functions.description: Opens the Design Planner Make Cell form, which can be used to create a new cellview using the selected virtual hierarchy from the top-cell layout.

functions.name: lxHiMakeVirtualHierarchy
functions.description: Opens the Make Virtual Hierarchy form, which can be used to create a virtual hierarchy at the top-cell level using the selected layout instance.

functions.name: lxHiMoveAutomatically
functions.description: Runs the Place As In Schematic command, which moves all of the components into the design boundary, maintaining the relative positions of the components in the schematic. If there is no connectivity reference, the Update Connectivity Reference form is opened.

functions.name: lxHiPRBoundaryInteriorHalo
functions.description: Displays an options form to specify if and on which layer a PR boundary interior halo shape should be created during when the Generate All From Source command is run.

functions.name: lxHiPlaceBoundaryCell
functions.description: Opens the Boundary Cell Placement form.

functions.name: lxHiPlaceFiller
functions.description: Displays the Insert/Delete Filler Cells form.

functions.name: lxHiProbe
functions.description: Opens the Probe Options form and starts the XL Probe command, which lets you select a component in either the layout or schematic and highlights the corresponding component the other cellview of the pair.

functions.name: lxHiReInitDesign
functions.description: Opens the Generate Layout form, which you can use to specify which layout components are to be generated from the schematic cellview, or clears the existing layout cellview so that you can restart.

functions.name: lxHiRemaster
functions.description: Opens the Remaster form, which can be used to replace the selected virtual hierarchy with an existing layout variant.

functions.name: lxHiSetOptions
functions.description: Opens the Connectivity form. The form opens with the General tab on top, unless you specify a different tab using the optional argument.

functions.name: lxHiSnapPatternOptions
functions.description: Opens the Design Planning and Analysis Options form to create snap pattern grids and specify that horizontal and vertical tracks be created inside the PR boundary.

functions.name: lxHiStack
functions.description: Opens the Generate Folded Devices form and starts the Generate Folded Devices command, which lets you fold a single transistor or an abutted group of MOS transistors into two or more fingers. The command operates on the design in the specified window. If you do not specify a window, it operates on the design in the current window.

functions.name: lxHiSwap
functions.description: Swaps instances and figGroups by launching the Swapping Components command. You can pre-select, partial-select, or post-select instances and figGroups. You can use the function to swap by origin with an option to swap with transform, or you can select one of the nine points on a bounding box: lower-left, center-left, upper-left, lower-center, center-center, upper-center, lower-right, center-right, or upper-right.

functions.name: lxHiUnlockSelected
functions.description: Changes the placement status of the selected objects from locked, placed, or firm to unplaced.If the original placement status is unknown or unplaced, this command does not change it.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateAllTerminalInterfaces
functions.description: Updates the scalar terminals in the currently edited layout cellview to correct mismatches in the interface or physical-only status.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateBinding
functions.description: Displays the Update Binding form.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateBusTerminals
functions.description: Updates the implicit bus terminals in the layout cellview based on the corresponding explicit bus terminals in the schematic cellview. The update is important to support interoperability of the layout cellviews with the designs created using the Innovus Implementation System.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateCellViewPair
functions.syntax: lxHiUpdateCellViewPair( [ d_cellviewID ] ) => ( { t_source t_lib t_cell t_view [ t_topcell ] | nil } )
functions.description: Starts the Update Connectivity Reference command and opens the Update Connectivity Reference form, where you can specify which schematic view provides the connectivity source for the specified layout view. If you do not specify a layout cellview, the function uses the current layout cellview.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateComponentsAndNets
functions.description: Starts the Update Components and Nets command, which lets you update the devices and pins in the layout view based on the devices in the schematic cellview.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateLayoutConstraints
functions.description: Runs the Update Layout Constraints command, which transfers constraints from the schematic view to the layout view. Constraints that have been created in the schematic but not yet saved are also transferred. Constraints are transferred only to the top-level layout view and are made read-only.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateLayoutParameters
functions.description: Starts the Update Layout Parameters command, which updates the parameters and values in the layout view to match those set in the schematic view.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateSchematicParameters
functions.description: Starts the Update Schematic Parameters command, which updates the parameters and values in the schematic view to match those set in the layout view.

functions.name: lxHiUpdateTerminalNetExpressions
functions.description: Corrects mismatches in the terminal net expressions between layout and schematic reported by the Check Against Source command.

functions.name: lxHiVerifyDesign
functions.description: Starts the Check Against Source command and opens the Check Against Source dialog where you can specify how Layout XL is to check the current layout implementation against corresponding schematic view. When you accept the dialog, the command checks the schematic cellview for any changes made since the layout cellview was last changed. It also opens an Info window detailing the differences between the views.

functions.name: lxHiVirtHierOptions
functions.description: Opens the Design Planning and Analysis Options form, which can be used to specify whether the layout displays the name of the virtual hierarchy, the cell, or both. In addition, the form can be used to enable or disable symbol overlay and to specify whether the virtual hierarchy can be auto placed during editing.

functions.name: lxHierCheck
functions.syntax: lxHierCheck( layCV [ ?checkDevices { t | nil } ] [ ?checkExtractLayout { t | nil } ] [ ?extractStopLevel [0-32] ] [ ?hierSummaryLogFileName t_hierSummaryLogFileName ] ) => 0 - 100 / -1
functions.description: Arguments

functions.name: lxHierCheckAgainstSource
functions.syntax: lxHierCheckAgainstSource( d_layCellViewID [ ?masterDiff { t | nil } ] [ ?paramDiff { t | nil } ] [ ?unboundInsts { t | nil } ] [ ?connectivity { t | nil } ] [ ?maxDiffsLimit x_maxDiffsLimit ] [ ?logFileName t_logFileName ] [ ?appendToLog { t | nil } ] [ ?nameDiff { t | nil } ] [ ?dummyDiff { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a report highlighting the differences between the schematic and layout cellviews for unique layout masters in the specified layout hierarchy. If you use the optional arguments, they override the existing environment variables set in the .cdsenv file. This SKILL function always skips any layouts that have no instances. If a log file name is specified for the hierSummaryLogFileName environment variable, the SKILL function prints the summary information to the specified log file, in addition to printing the information to the default Virtuoso log file.

functions.name: lxHierUpdateComponentsAndNets
functions.syntax: lxHierUpdateComponentsAndNets( d_layCellViewID [ ?initCreatePins { t | nil } ] [ ?initGlobalNetPins { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreatePadPins { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateInstances { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateBoundary { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateSnapBoundary { t | nil } ] [ ?initDoStacking { t | nil } ] [ ?initDoFolding { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateMTM { t | nil } ] [ ?deleteUnmatchedInsts { t | nil } ] [ ?deleteUnmatchedPins { t | nil } ] [ ?updateReplacesMasters { t | nil } ] [ ?updateWithMarkers { t | nil } ] [ ?updateLayoutParameters { t | nil } ] [ ?updateNetSigType { t | nil } ] [ ?updateNetMinMaxVoltage { t | nil } ] [ ?updateNetsOnly { t | nil } ] [ ?virtualHierarchy { t | nil } ] [ ?skipLeafs { t | nil } ] [ ?extractSchematic { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the components and nets for all unique layout masters in the specified layout cellview hierarchy. The layouts are automatically opened in edit mode for update. If a log file name is specified for the hierSummaryLogFileName environment variable, the SKILL function prints the summary information to the specified log file, in addition to printing the information to the default Virtuoso log file.

functions.name: lxIsGroupArray
functions.description: Checks whether the given object is a group array.

functions.name: lxIsGroupArrayEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether the group array functionality is available.

functions.name: lxIsGroupArrayLocked
functions.description: Checks whether the given group array is locked.

functions.name: lxIsGroupArrayRegular
functions.description: Checks whether the given group array is a regular group array. For a regular group array, the number of cells can be modified by updating the number of rows or columns. For a non-regular group array, the number of cells is fixed.

functions.name: lxIsVirtualFigGroup
functions.description: Checks if the specified figGroup is a virtual figGroup.

functions.name: lxLaunchLayoutEXL
functions.description: Launches Layout EXL from a specified schematic window. If you do not specify a window ID, Layout EXL is launched from the window returned by the hiGetCurrentWindow() function, but only if it is a schematic window.

functions.name: lxLaunchLayoutMXL
functions.description: Launches Layout MXL from a specified schematic window. If you do not specify a window ID, Layout MXL is launched from the window returned by the hiGetCurrentWindow() function, but only if it is a schematic window.

functions.name: lxLaunchLayoutXL
functions.description: Launches Layout XL from a specified schematic window. If you do not specify a window ID, Layout XL is launched from the window returned by the hiGetCurrentWindow() function, but only if it is a schematic window.

functions.name: lxMakeDummy
functions.description: Starts the Make Dummy enter function for the selected set of instances which can include mosaics. The function requires a reference point and a position for the created dummy devices. The dummy devices are tied to the named net passed in via netName.

functions.name: lxMakePrBoundarySelectable
functions.description: Makes the place and route boundary in the current layout selectable.

functions.name: lxMakePrBoundaryUnselectable
functions.description: Makes the place and route boundary in the current layout unselectable.

functions.name: lxMakeVirtualHierarchy
functions.syntax: lxMakeVirtualHierarchy( d_layCellViewID l_insts [ ?allInstsSameMaster { t | nil } ] [ ?preserveVirtualPins { t | nil } ] [ ?keepLabels { t | nil } ] [ ?placementStatus { Fixed | Locked | None } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates virtual hierarchies from the cells of the listed bound instances.

functions.name: lxMovePorts
functions.description: Moves top-level ports over components based on their connectivity.

functions.name: lxPermPermutePins
functions.description: Starts the Permute Pins command, which lets you swap the connectivity or net connections of the pins of a component. You specify the pins you want to permute by selecting them when prompted by the function. The pins to be permuted must belong to different nets and must first be defined as permutable terminals using the permuteRule property for the device.

functions.name: lxProbeRemoveAll
functions.description: Removes all probes from the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxRegPostUpdateComponentsAndNets
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function to be used as a post-function hook for lxUpdateComponentsAndNets to enable replacement of pins that have their layer and width characteristics defined using the Design Intent tool. lxRegPostUpdateComponentsAndNetsFn, when used in combination with lxRegPostUpdateComponentsAndNetsFn, avoids the need for deleting the pins defined in Design Intent before the pins can be updated.

functions.name: lxRegPrePosition
functions.syntax: lxRegPrePosition( t_lib t_cell t_view s_skillFunction  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function for a schematic Pcell to be called for newly generated layout instances corresponding to each instance of the schematic Pcell when Generate All From Source, Generate Selected from Source, or Update Components and Nets commands are run. Registration is done once before generation. The registered SKILL function is called after instance generation but before positioning.  Only one SKILL function can be registered per schematic Pcell.

functions.name: lxRegPreUpdateComponentsAndNets
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function to be used as a pre-function hook for lxUpdateComponentsAndNets to enable replacement of pins that have their layer and width characteristics defined using the Design Intent tool. lxRegPreUpdateComponentsAndNetsFn, when used in combination with lxRegPostUpdateComponentsAndNetsFn, avoids the need for deleting the pins defined in Design Intent before the pins can be updated.

functions.name: lxRemoveSynchronousCloneFromFamily
functions.description: Removes a specified synchronous clone from its family. As a result, the clone is desynchronized and it behaves as a basic group. If a clone that belongs to a two-member synchronous family is removed from the family, the other member clone is also removed and the family is deleted.

functions.name: lxRunCmdInVXL
functions.syntax: lxRunCmdInVXL( d_layCV  u_cmd  g_cmdArgs  [ ?schCV d_schCV ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function is being maintained only to support backward compatibility. Cadence recommends that you use lxRunCmdInXL instead. If you were to use lxRunCmdInVXL, use it to run a user-supplied command in Layout XL, with CPH and the Binder enabled, without opening the windows. The PhysConfig used is obtained from the layout cellview. If you want to work in Automatic mode, the schematic cellview, an optional argument, is required. The batch function does not work with the following: Interactive editing, Incremental binding, and Incremental extraction.

functions.name: lxRunCmdInXL
functions.syntax: lxRunCmdInXL( d_layCV  u_cmd  [ ?cmdArgs g_cmdArgs ]  [ ?hierarchical {t | nil} ] [ ?editLayout {t | nil} ] [ ?editSchematic {t | nil} ] [ ?skipLeafs {t | nil} ] [ ?noSchematic {t | nil} ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs a user-defined command in Layout XL in the current layout or for each unique layout master in the specified layout cellviews hierarchy. When the lxRunCmdInXL SKILL function is run, the CPH and the binder are enabled, but no windows open. The physConfig and the schematic connectivity reference is obtained from the layout cellviews by setting the SKILL functions lxSetConnRef and lxSetConfigRef. The lxRunCmdInXL function does not support the following commands: interactive edits, incremental binding, and incremental extraction. The user-supplied command must have at least two arguments-the schematic cellview ID and the layout cellview ID for the Layout XL session.

functions.name: lxSelectSynchronousFamily
functions.description: Selects all the clones in the layout canvas and the Navigator that are members of the specified clone family. If all the family members are already selected, no more clones are selected on the canvas or in the Navigator. If any new clones are identified, they are selected on the canvas and in the Navigator.

functions.name: lxSelectedDeleteNetRouting
functions.description: Deletes routing of the selected nets.

functions.name: lxSelectedExtendChain
functions.description: Extends the current selection to all the instances abutted to a selected instance such that the entire chain is selected.

functions.name: lxSelectedExtendExpanded
functions.description: Extends the current selection to any related instances, terminals, and nets.

functions.name: lxSelectedExtendSchematic
functions.description: Extends the current selection of instances to include any instances that are part of the bound top-level schematic.

functions.name: lxSelectedLock
functions.description: Locks the nets currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedLockNet
functions.description: Locks the nets attached to the shapes currently selected in the layout cellview

functions.name: lxSelectedRemoveIgnore
functions.description: Removes the ignore property on selected instances and pins.

functions.name: lxSelectedRoute
functions.description: Routes the nets currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedRouteNet
functions.description: Routes the nets attached to the shapes currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectAttachedGlobalNets
functions.description: Selects the power, ground, or global nets attached to the objects currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectAttachedNets
functions.description: Selects the nets attached to the objects currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectAttachedSignalNets
functions.description: Selects nets other than power, ground, or global nets attached to the objects currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectExternalGlobalNets
functions.description: Selects any power, ground, or global nets that are externally connected to the groups, clones, or modgens currently selected in the layout cellview. An external net connects an object within a group to an object outside the group.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectExternalNets
functions.description: Selects the external nets for the groups, clones, or modgens currently selected in the layout cellview. An external net connects an object within a group to an object outside the group.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectExternalSignalNets
functions.description: Selects any nets other than power, ground, or global nets that are externally connected to the groups, clones, or modgens currently selected in the layout cellview. An external net connects an object within a group to an object outside the group.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectInternalGlobalNets
functions.description: Selects any power, ground, or global nets that are internal to the groups, clones, or modgens currently selected in the layout view. An internal net connects objects contained within a group.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectInternalNets
functions.description: Selects the internal nets for the groups, clones, or modgens currently selected in the layout view. An internal net connects objects contained within a group.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectInternalSignalNets
functions.description: Selects any nets other than power, ground, or global nets that are internal to the groups, clones, or modgens currently selected in the layout view. An internal net connects objects contained within a group.

functions.name: lxSelectedSelectNetsShapes
functions.description: Selects all the shapes attached to the nets currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedUnlock
functions.description: Unlocks the nets currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedUnlockNet
functions.description: Unlocks the nets attached to the shapes currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedUpdateFromSource
functions.description: Updates the masters, connectivity, and parameters of the instances currently selected in the layout cellview.

functions.name: lxSelectedUpdateIgnore
functions.description: Sets the ignore property on selected instances and pins.

functions.name: lxSetAreaEstimationOptions
functions.syntax: lxSetAreaEstimationOptions( [ ?source1 t_source1 ] [ ?source1Val source1Val ] [ ?source2 t_source2 ] [ ?source2Val source2Val ] [ ?calcMethod t_calcMethod ] [ ?areaCalc t_areaCalc ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the area estimation options to be used in generating a rectangular boundary in either the Generate Layout or Update Components and Nets form. The function is valid only if you specify a rectangular boundary using the lxSetBoundaryOptions function. It must be called between calls to lxGenerateStart and lxGenerateFinish or lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart and lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish.

functions.name: lxSetBoundaryOptions
functions.syntax: lxSetBoundaryOptions( [ ?shape t_shape ] [ ?origin g_origin ] [ ?points lg_points ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the boundary options in the Generate Layout and Update Components and Nets forms. It must be called between calls to lxGenerateStart and lxGenerateFinish or lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart and lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish.

functions.name: lxSetCloneFamilyName
functions.description: Sets a new name for the family to which the specified clone belongs.

functions.name: lxSetConfigRef
functions.syntax: lxSetConfigRef( t_layLib  t_layCell t_layView  t_referenceType [ ?cfgLib t_cfgLib ] [ ?cfgCell t_cfgCell ] [ ?cfgView t_cfgView ] [ ?closeLay g_closeLay  ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets or unsets the physical configuration cellview for a specified layout cellview. You specify the layout cellview in question and whether the reference type is NONE or physConfig. If the reference type is physConfig, specify the library, cell, and view names of the physical configuration to use.

functions.name: lxSetConnRef
functions.syntax: lxSetConnRef( t_layLib  t_layCell t_layView  t_sourceType { CELLVIEW | NONE } [ ?schLib t_schLib ] [ ?schCell t_schCell ] [ ?schView t_schView ] [ ?closeLay g_closeLay ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets or unsets the connectivity reference for a specified layout cellview without opening the layout view graphically. You must specify the layout view and whether the source type is NONE or CELLVIEW. If the source type is CELLVIEW, you can specify the schematic cellview to use (by default it is set to the schematic view in the same library and cell). The function also saves the layout cellview, but only if had not been modified prior to lxSetConnRef being called.

functions.name: lxSetGenerateOptions
functions.syntax: lxSetGenerateOptions( [ ?pins { t | nil } ] [ ?instances { t | nil } ] [ ?boundary { t | nil } ] [ ?snapBoundary { t | nil } ] [ ?stacks { t | nil } ] [ ?folds { t | nil } ] [ ?posMinSep n_posMinSep ] [ ?inBoundary { t | nil } ] [ ?mtm { t | nil } ] [ ?extract { t | nil } ] [ ?virtualHierarchy { t | nil } ] ) => t
functions.description: Tells Generate All From Source or Update Components And Nets what types of objects to generate. You can call it between calls to lxGenerateStart and lxGenerateFinish or lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart and lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish.

functions.name: lxSetGroupArrayLocked
functions.description: Sets the lock attribute on the given group array. If a group array is locked, its X and Y spacing attributes cannot be modified.

functions.name: lxSetGroupArrayRegular
functions.description: Sets the given group array as regular. For a regular group array, the number of cells can be modified by updating the number of rows or columns. For a non-regular group array, the number of cells is fixed.

functions.name: lxSetNetPinSpecs
functions.syntax: lxSetNetPinSpecs( [ ?nets lt_nets ] [ ?lpp lt_lpp ] [ ?width n_width ] [ ?height n_height ] [ ?numPins x_numPins ] [ ?create g_create ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Takes a list of nets and with the specified parameters sets the pin information in either the Generate Layout or Update Components and Nets form. This function must always be called between calls to lxGenerateStart and lxGenerateFinish or lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart and lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish. If optional arguments are not supplied the normal default values for the form fields apply.

functions.name: lxSetPreserveFloorplanningOptions
functions.syntax: lxSetPreserveFloorplanningOptions( [ ?preserve { all | none } ] [ ?rows { t | nil } ] [ ?blockages { t | nil } ] [ ?areaBoundaries { t | nil } ] [ ?trackPatterns { t | nil } ] [ ?clusters { t | nil } ] [ ?clusterBoundaries { t | nil } ] [ ?prBoundary { t | nil}  [ ?snapBoundary { t | nil } ] [ ?snapPatterns { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the preserve floorplanning objects options in the Generate Layout form. This function must be called between calls to lxGenerateStart and lxGenerateFinish.

functions.name: lxSetSchematicDriven
functions.description: Sets the various schematic-driven options that are controlled by the Configure tab on the Virtuoso Layout Suite XL Connectivity form. The SKILL function can be used to control the following environment variables: lxSchematicDefaultApp, openConnRefTab, extractEnabled, constraintAwareEditing, flightLineEnable, autoUpdateFlightlines, netNameDisplayEnabled.

functions.name: lxSetUpdateOptions
functions.syntax: lxSetUpdateOptions( [ ?deletePins { t | nil } ] [ ?deleteInstances { t | nil } ] [ ?replaceMaster { t | nil } ] [ ?withMarkers { t | nil } ] [ ?netsOnly { t | nil } ] [ ?selected nil { t | nil } ] [ ?layoutParameters { t | nil } ] [ ?layoutConstraints { t | nil } ] [ ?sigType { t | nil } ] [ ?netVoltage { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the options in the Update group box of the Update Components and Nets form. It must be called between calls to lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart and lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish.

functions.name: lxShapeSlotting
functions.syntax: lxShapeSlotting(  [ ?cv d_cellViewId ]  [ ?all { t | nil } ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?layers l_layers  [ ?widthThreshold n_widthThreshold ] [ ?slotLength n_slotLength ] [ ?slotWidth n_slotWidth ] [ ?lSpacing n_lSpacing ] [ ?wSpacing n_wSpacing ] [ ?slotToEdge n_slotToEdge ] [ ?slotVia { t | nil } ] [ ?windowSize n_windowSize ] [ ?stepSize n_stepSize ] [ ?maxDensity n_maxDensity ] [ ?slotStaggered { t | nil } ] [ ?lengthWidthRatio n_lengthWidthRatio ] [ ?excludePins { t | nil } ] [ ?slotSpacingAtTurn n_slotSpacingAtTurn ] [ ?onlyComplexPolygons { t | nil } [ ?halfManhattan { t | nil } ] [ ?halfManhattanStyle l_halfManhattanStyle ] [ ?directionalSlotPattern l_directionalSlotPattern ] [ ?shapes l_shapes ] [ ?turnSlotPattern l_turnSlotPattern ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates slots on shapes to ensure that wide wires are in compliance with maxDensity and maxWidth constraint rules. It also preserves viable electromigration and resistance attributes by creating rectangular slots in the direction of the current over the wires and square slots at turns (same layer or changed layer). There are two modes depending on the arguments specified: Geometric and Density Aware. In Geometric mode, the slotting shapes are fully specified (size, spacing, and step size), while in Density Aware mode, the slotting shape geometries are automatically computed based on the maxDensity specification. Also, in Geometric mode, you can create slots on shapes on non-metal layers. It is still possible to override any of the geometric information, such as the width, length, or spacing.

functions.name: lxShowCommonIncompleteNetsForSelectedInsts
functions.description: Runs the Enter function named Show Common Incomplete Nets for Selected Instances, which displays the incomplete nets that are common to the instances selected in the layout. The SKILL function can also be run in pre-select mode on the set of instances that are already selected in the layout. The post-selection mode is supported when only one instance is pre-selected.

functions.name: lxShowHideIncompleteNets
functions.description: Shows and hides any incomplete nets associated with selected objects in the specified layout window. The function establishes the incomplete nets associated with the selected objects and toggles the visibility of the markers representing those incomplete nets on or off depending on their previous state.

functions.name: lxToggleLocalAbutment
functions.description: Changes the state of the lxLocalAbutment environment variable and honors the change immediately in Layout XL. Use this function to switch local abutment on and off without having to restart the software.

functions.name: lxToggleShowAllIncompleteNets
functions.description: Toggles the visibility of all the incomplete nets displayed in the design canvas.

functions.name: lxToggleShowIncompleteNets
functions.description: Toggles the visibility of the current set of incomplete nets displayed in the design canvas. The first time you run the command, it hides all currently visible incomplete nets and stores the list of incomplete nets for later retrieval. The next time you run the command, it restores the visibility of the stored set of incomplete nets.

functions.name: lxUnSlotVia
functions.syntax: lxUnSlotVia( [ ?cv d_cellViewId ]  [ ?all { t | nil } ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?layers l_layers ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Restores the via that has been slotted by the command lxShapeSlotting.

functions.name: lxUnfold
functions.description: Deletes all the folds of the selected folded device and creates a single, unfolded device at the same coordinates in the layout as the selected fold. The width of the new unfolded device is determined based on the width of the corresponding schematic device, if one exists. If the corresponding schematic device does not exist and the unfoldUseLayoutWidths environment variable is set to t, the sum of the fold widths is used to determine the total width of the unfolded device.

functions.name: lxUnregMasterDiffName
functions.description: Unregisters the SKILL function used to return a name for a master difference reported by the Check Against Source command.

functions.name: lxUnregPrePosition
functions.description: Unregisters the SKILL function previously registered using lxRefPrePosition for the specified schematic Pcell.

functions.name: lxUpdateAllPhysBinding
functions.description: Updates the physical bindings of all the instances in the specified layout cellview.

functions.name: lxUpdateBinding
functions.syntax: lxUpdateBinding( d_layCV [ ?schCV d_schCV ] [ ?nameOnly { t | nil } ] [ ?currentLevel { t | nil } ] [ ?extract { t | nil } ] [ ?clearConn { t | nil } ] [ ?extractStopLevel [0-32] ] [ ?preserveUserBindings { t | nil } ] [ ?preserveLayoutHierarchy { t | nil } ] [ ?flattenLayoutCreate { Synchronized Family | Grouped Objects| Free Objects } ] [ ?bindingFile t_fileName ] [ ?crossRefFile t_fileName ] [ ?extractedNetlistFile t_fileName ] [ ?PVSRulesFile t_fileName ] [ ?PVSScale n_PVSScale ] [ ?correctMaster { t | nil } ] [ ?ignoreRouteCells { t | nil } ] [ ?ignoreDummies { t | nil } ] [ ?preserveExistingBindings { t | nil } ] [ ?hierarchical { t | nil } ] [ ?allCellsInDesign { t | nil } ] [ ?createTransparent { t | nil } ] [ ?createPinsFromLabels { t | nil } ] [ ?checkDuplicateObjects { t | nil } ] [ ?removeDuplicateObjects { t | nil } ] ) => 0 - 100 / -1
functions.description: Improves the binding between the schematic and the layout by setting options that control how the connectivity, the manual bindings, and the design hierarchy is processed. If a log file name is specified for the hierSummaryLogFileName environment variable, the SKILL function prints the summary information to the specified log file, in addition to printing the information to the default Virtuoso log file

functions.name: lxUpdateComponentsAndNets
functions.syntax: lxUpdateComponentsAndNets( d_schCellViewID d_layCellViewID [ ?initCreatePins { t | nil } ] [ ?initGlobalNetPins { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreatePadPins { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateInstances { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateBoundary { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateSnapBoundary { t | nil } ] [ ?initDoStacking { t | nil } ] [ ?initDoFolding { t | nil } ] [ ?initCreateMTM { t | nil } ] [ ?deleteUnmatchedInsts { t | nil } ] [ ?deleteUnmatchedPins { t | nil } ] [ ?updateReplacesMasters { t | nil } ] [ ?updateWithMarkers { t | nil } ] [ ?updateLayoutParameters { t | nil } ] [ ?updateNetSigType { t | nil } ] [ ?updateNetMinMaxVoltage { t | nil } ] [ ?updateNetsOnly { t | nil } ] [ ?virtualHierarchy { t | nil } ] [ ?extractSchematic { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the components and nets for the specified schematic and layout cellviews. If you use the optional arguments, they override the existing environment variables set in the .cdsenv file. The default value for each optional argument corresponds to the default value of the associated environment variable.

functions.name: lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish
functions.syntax: lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsFinish( d_schId d_layId [ ?extractSchematic { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Finishes the update process by executing the Update Components And Nets command with the form values supplied by lxSet* functions and after the previous call to lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart.

functions.name: lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart
functions.syntax: lxUpdateComponentsAndNetsStart( d_schId d_layId [ ?extractSchematic { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Starts the Update Components And Nets command, building the Update Components and Nets form without displaying it to the screen.

functions.name: lxUpdateGroupArrayParams
functions.syntax: lxUpdateGroupArrayParams( d_groupArrayId [ ?rows x_rows ] [ ?columns x_cols ] [ ?X x_xValue ] [ ?Y x_yValue ] [ ?orients l_orientList ] [ ?mode 'pitch | 'spacing  ] [ ?lpp l_refLPP ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the specified parameters of a group array.

functions.name: lxUpdatePhysBinding
functions.description: Updates the physical bindings of the currently selected instances in the specified layout cellview.

functions.name: lxUpdatePlacementStatus
functions.description: Updates the placement status of instances and pins in the current cellview. Instances and pins that are wholly inside the PR boundary with status unknown are updated to status placed. Instances and pins wholly outside the PR boundary with status placed are updated to unknown.

functions.name: lxVerifyCloneFamily
functions.description: Runs a consistency check on the specified synchronous clone family to verify if the family members are identical to each other.

functions.name: lxVirtHierGetTermName
functions.description: Returns the associated terminal name if the selected shape is a virtual pin.

functions.name: lxVirtualHierarchyMakeCell
functions.syntax: lxVirtualHierarchyMakeCell( d_layCellViewID l_virtHiers [ ?lib { libName | nil } ] [ ?cell { cellName | nil } ] [ ?view { viewName | nil } ] [ ?cellType { softMacro | none | digital softMacro | block } ] [ ?overWriteCV { t | nil } ] [ ?allClones { t | nil } ] [ ?allLevels { t | nil } ] [ ?pinsChoice { Congestion aware | On boundary | Below boundary | Promote pins } ] [ ?deleteVirtualPins { t | nil } ] [ ?pushIntoBlock { t | nil } ] [ ?pushRoutesAsBlockages { t | nil } ] [ ?pushInternalRoutesOnly { t | nil } ] ) => l_layCellViewID / nil
functions.description: Creates real cellviews for the specified virtual hierarchies.

functions.name: mbGetAction
functions.description: Retrieves an action from the menu builder data structure.

functions.name: mbRegisterAction
functions.syntax: mbRegisterAction( t_viewType t_uniqueId t_name t_callback t_enableCB [ ?iconFile g_iconFile ] [ ?icon g_icon ] [ ?checkable g_checkable ] [ ?checkedCB t_checkedCB ] ) => o_action / nil
functions.description: Creates an action and registers it with the menu builder for future retrieval and use within menus. This action will appear only when mbSetContextData is used to set its visibility location.

functions.name: mbRegisterCustomMenu
functions.syntax: mbRegisterCustomMenu( t_viewType t_uniqueId t_enableCB t_customCB ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a custom menu with the menu builder for future retrieval and use within menus. A custom menu item is a single or slider menu that is built using the hi function calls, independently of the menu builder. The t_customCB argument is used to specify the function that is responsible for building and returning the menu item. The menu will display only when the mbSetContextData function is called.

functions.name: mbRegisterHierMenu
functions.syntax: mbRegisterHierMenu( t_viewType t_uniqueId t_name t_enableCB ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a hierarchical menu with the menu builder for future retrieval and use within menus.

functions.name: mbRegisterMenuItem
functions.syntax: mbRegisterMenuItem( t_viewType l_menuItemDef t_enableCB ) => t_menuItemId / nil
functions.description: Registers a menu item with the menu builder that has been defined using the older menu creation syntax. mbSetContextData needs to be called before the menu item is visible.

functions.name: mbSetContextData
functions.syntax: mbSetContextData( t_viewType t_uniqueId t_validObjs t_validWidgets t_grouping [ ?parent t_parent ] [ ?removeWhenDisabled g_removeWhenDisabled ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets various attributes to determine the menus with which the registered action is to be associated.

functions.name: mbUnregisterAction
functions.syntax: mbUnregisterAction( t_name [ ?objType t_objType ] [ ?viewType t_viewType ] [ ?silent g_silent ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes the provided menu item from the RMB menu. The optional arguments can be used to limit the removal of a menu item to specific object types or view types for which it is registered.

functions.name: mgAbutAllCB
functions.description: Abuts all currently selected instances.

functions.name: mgAbutCB
functions.description: Attempts to abut the selected instances in the Modgen currently being edited.

functions.name: mgAddBodyContact
functions.description: Adds a body contact on the specified side to the selected instances inside a Modgen. Side can be one of left, right, top, or bottom.

functions.name: mgAddCopyDummies
functions.syntax: mgAddCopyDummies( d_mgID t_sideString S_netName l_insts ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates copies of the specified Modgen dummy and places them on the t_sideString side of the instance.

functions.name: mgAddDummyBottomCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the bottom of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyLeftCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the left side of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCBottomCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the bottom of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCLeftCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the left of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCRightCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the right of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCTopCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the top of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRightCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the right side of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyTopCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the top of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddEmptyRCCB
functions.description: Adds an empty row or column to the specified side of a selected instance. To add empty row or column only one instance should be selected.

functions.name: mgAddGuardRingCB
functions.description: Displays the Guard Ring Options form for creating and modifying the guard ring for the current Modgen.

functions.name: mgAddShapeToTopo
functions.description: Adds a user-generated shape, such as a rectangle, to a topology group, usually a topological strap.

functions.name: mgAddTopologyToModgen
functions.description: Adds the specified topology object to the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen
functions.syntax: mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen( d_modgenConId l_tpObjects t_twigMatchType [ t_trunkMatchType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a matchGroup in the specified Modgen storage.

functions.name: mgCreateModgenAsLayout
functions.description: Creates a Modgen from the list of specified instances and keeps the relative instance locations inside the Modgen, as similar as possible to the original instances in the layout. If instance list is not specified, the selected instances from the cellview are used.

functions.name: mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout
functions.syntax: mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout( d_cvId l_InstanceList [ l_AbuttedInstances ] ) => g_constraintID / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen constraint that uses the current layout to drive the initial Modgen constraint and row/column assignments.

functions.name: mgCreateOrEdit
functions.syntax: mgCreateOrEdit( d_cellViewId  d_constraintId [ d_figGroupId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Opens the Modgen editor to create a new Modgen or to edit parameters of an existing Modgen. After making edits, the Modgen constraint is updated. If the source is a layout cellview, then the Modgen layout, the associated geometry, and the associated database objects are updated.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllBodyContacts
functions.description: Deletes all body contacts of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen edit window.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllDummies
functions.description: Deletes all dummies from the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllDummyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Deletes all dummy rows and columns of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen Editing window.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllEmptyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Deletes all empty rows and columns of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen Editing window.

functions.name: mgDeleteCB
functions.description: Deletes the selected dummy devices or body contacts.

functions.name: mgDeleteEmptyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Interactively deletes an empty row or column in Modgen Editor.

functions.name: mgDestroyMatchGroupOnObject
functions.description: Destroys the matchGroups that include the specified database object.

functions.name: mgEditGuardRingCB
functions.description: Displays the Guard Ring Options form for creating and modifying the guard ring for the current Modgen.

functions.name: mgEvalInBackgroundModgen
functions.syntax: mgEvalInBackgroundModgen( d_schCV o_schCon s_callback [ g_updateSrcConstraint ] )  => l_userCallbackReturnVal / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen scratch cellview for the specified schematic Modgen constraint, evaluates the specified user callback in the Modgen context, and then closes and deletes the scratch cellview.

functions.name: mgExecNoConObs
functions.description: Disables the Modgen constraint observer and evaluates the expressions in the specified sequence. Next, the function updates the constraint with any changes encountered while evaluating the expressions. After the process is complete, the Modgen constraint observer is re-enabled. This function helps change geometries or parameters of a Modgen or its instances without requiring the Modgen to enforce any consistency constraints on the resulting geometries. For example, increasing the numRows Modgen parameter using this function will cause the Modgen to have more rows, but will not rearrange the Modgen instances to fit in the new number of rows. This function is a defmacro.

functions.name: mgExitCB
functions.description: Closes the Modgen editing environment.

functions.name: mgFGREnterHandEdit
functions.description: Enters the hand edit mode for the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen. In this mode, the fluid guard rings are not regenerated each time the Modgen is updated. Therefore, all customizations remain. The guard rings that are not edited in the hand edit mode are regenerated, and all manual edits are lost. Use mgFGRExitHandEdit to exit the hand edit mode.

functions.name: mgFGRExitHandEdit
functions.description: Exits the hand edit mode for the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen. Unlike the hand edit mode, the fluid guard rings will now be regenerated each time the Modgen is updated. To enter the hand edit mode, use mgFGREnterHandEdit.

functions.name: mgFGRIsHandEdit
functions.description: Checks the status of the hand edit mode of the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgFlattenModgens
functions.description: Flattens the specified Modgens in the specified cellview. When a Modgen is flattened, its constraint is removed, it is ungrouped, and all geometry created by it remains ungrouped in the layout cellview.

functions.name: mgFlipHorizontalCB
functions.description: Horizontally flips the selected instance. To flip an instance, at least one instance should be selected. After you flip the instance, the orientation of the selected instance changes to reflect the flip.

functions.name: mgFlipVerticalCB
functions.description: Vertically flips the selected instance. To flip an instance, at least one instance should be selected. After you flip the instance, the orientation of the selected instance changes to reflect the flip.

functions.name: mgGetBoxLPPArea
functions.syntax: mgGetBoxLPPArea( d_cellViewID l_bBox tx_layerName t_purposeList ) => x_TotalModgenArea / nil
functions.description: Calculates the total area on the specified layer within the specified bounding box. If you specify a Modgen ID as the l_bBox parameter, then the total Modgen area is calculated and displayed.

functions.name: mgGetChannelTrunks
functions.syntax: mgGetChannelTrunks( d_mgCon n_channel g_isHoriz ) => l_topologyTrunks / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of topology trunks that belong to the specified channel.

functions.name: mgGetColumnRoutingChannelWidth
functions.description: Returns the routing channel width of the specified Modgen column.

functions.name: mgGetConstraintFromFG
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the Modgen constraint for the specified Modgen figGroup ID.

functions.name: mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams
functions.syntax: mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams( [ t_libName ] [ t_cellName ] [ t_paramName ] ) => l_registeredDummyDirectionalParams / nil
functions.description: Returns the first set of registered Modgen dummy directional parameters that match the specified library, cell, and parameter names.

functions.name: mgGetGuardRingConnectObject
functions.description: Returns the guard ring object for the topology connection for the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgGetIsLocalTrunk
functions.description: Checks whether the specified trunk is local. Trunks inside a Modgen are called local trunks. These trunks can be connected only within the same Modgen, and not from outside the Modgen.

functions.name: mgGetLayerSpacing
functions.syntax: mgGetLayerSpacing( d_instance1 d_instance2 t_referenceLayer t_direction x_spacing ) => x_effectiveSpacing / nil
functions.description: Returns the effective spacing between two instances, given the spacing between a reference layer inside the instances. For example, if the reference layer is Oxide_thk drawing, then x_spacing would indicate the spacing between the bounding box of the Oxide_thk layer inside the instances. The t_direction argument specifies the position of the instances relative to each other, either horizontal (next to each other) or vertical (above and below each other).

functions.name: mgGetMatchGroupMembers
functions.description: Displays a list of matchGroup members that belong to the same matchGroup as the specified database object d_dbObjectId.

functions.name: mgGetModgenConstraintFromTopology
functions.description: Returns the Modgen constraint ID that is associated with the specified topology object.

functions.name: mgGetModgenFGFromConstraint
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the Modgen figGroup for a specified Modgen constraint ID in a specified cellview.

functions.name: mgGetModgenFigGroupFromTopology
functions.description: Retrieves the Modgen figGroup object that is associated with the specified topology object.

functions.name: mgGetRegUserProc
functions.description: Accepts a user function symbol and returns the names of the user functions that are registered corresponding to the specified user function symbol.

functions.name: mgGetRegisteredDummyNetProc
functions.description: Returns a list of dummyNet procedures that are currently registered.

functions.name: mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters
functions.syntax: mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters( [ t_libName ] [ t_cellName ] [ t_paramType ] ) => l_registeredDummyOverrides / nil
functions.description: Returns the first set of registered Modgen dummy override parameters that match the specified library and cell names. If the library name is not specified, the function returns all registered overrides. If the cell name is not specified, the function returns all cell overrides that are registered for the given library.

functions.name: mgGetRowRoutingChannelWidth
functions.description: Returns the routing channel width of the specified Modgen row.

functions.name: mgGetStrapDirection
functions.description: Returns the direction of the specified strap. This function is valid if the strap has a single strap object. Otherwise, the router determines the strap direction.

functions.name: mgGetStrapHasDirection
functions.description: Determines whether the strap direction is set for the specified strap.

functions.name: mgGetStrapHasOffset
functions.description: Determines whether the specified strap has an associated offset value.

functions.name: mgGetStrapLongOffset1
functions.description: Returns the long offset attribute of the specified strap for the bottom or left edge. This value determines how far beyond the strap object that the strap can extend.

functions.name: mgGetStrapLongOffset2
functions.description: Returns the long offset attribute of the specified strap for the top or right edge. This value determines how far beyond the strap object that the strap can extend.

functions.name: mgGetStrapOffset
functions.description: Returns the strap offset attribute, which represents the distance from the bottom or left of the bBox of the strapObject.

functions.name: mgGetTopoShapes
functions.description: Retrieves all user-generated shapes from the specified topology group object, usually a topological strap.

functions.name: mgGetTopoTrunkShapes
functions.description: Retrieves the shapes associated with a topological trunk.

functions.name: mgGetTopologyFromModgen
functions.description: Returns a list of topology objects that are available in the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkChannel
functions.description: Returns the channel number in which the specified topological trunk pattern is located.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure
functions.syntax: mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure( d_instID t_side t_layerName t_purposeName ) => x_enclosure / nil
functions.description: Returns the enclosure of a topological trunk reference layer and the purpose within an instance. For example, if the LPP of a trunk reference is Oxide drawing, then the function returns the distance from one side of the Oxide bounding box to the instance bounding box. This value is subtracted from the channel width of the topological trunk to derive the trunk-to-device spacing to the reference layer in the instances above (or to the right of) a trunk.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkRefLayerPurpose
functions.description: Returns the reference layer and purpose of a topological trunk. This function returns a list containing the layer and purpose names.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkTopo
functions.description: Returns a list of topology trunks belonging to the specified pathSeg.

functions.name: mgHilightEmptyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Turns on or off highlighting of empty rows and columns.

functions.name: mgIsInBackAnnotation
functions.description: Checks if there are any Modgens currently running dummy backannotation. Use this function for user callbacks to allow changes to the Modgen constraint caused by backannotation, while preventing other changes to the Modgen constraint.

functions.name: mgIsTopologyInsideModgen
functions.description: Checks whether the specified topology object belongs to a Modgen. For example, this function can be used to identify Modgen topologies or to find all topologies that are available in the Modgen specified by the optional d_figGroupId argument.

functions.name: mgModgenHasTopology
functions.description: Checks whether the specified Modgen contains a topology.

functions.name: mgObjectHasMatchGroup
functions.description: Checks whether the specified database object is part of a matchGroup.

functions.name: mgRegUserProc
functions.description: Accepts user functions based on their keywords and registers them in the Modgen code to enable callbacks.

functions.name: mgRegenerateModgen
functions.description: Forces a Modgen-type group to rebuild its geometry.

functions.name: mgRegisterDummyNetProc
functions.description: Registers a function that specifies a net for a specified dummy instance ID and terminal ID.

functions.name: mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters
functions.syntax: mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters( t_libName t_cellNameOrRegex l_supplyParamsList [ l_signalParamsList ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the parameter overrides to be applied to Modgen dummies. The order in which the override parameters are registered is the order in which the look up is processed.

functions.name: mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection
functions.syntax: mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection( t_libName t_cellNameOrRegex t_direction [ Horizontal | Vertical ] l_paramsList ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers Modgen dummy parameters and forcefully matches them to their nearest directional neighbor, left/right or top/bottom.

functions.name: mgRemoveMemberFromMatchGroup
functions.description: Removes the specified database object from its associated matchGroup.

functions.name: mgRemoveTopologyFromModgen
functions.description: Removes the specified topology object from the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgRotateLeftCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected instance to the left. To rotate an instance at least one instance should be selected.

functions.name: mgRotateMXCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the MX transform.

functions.name: mgRotateMYCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the MY transform.

functions.name: mgRotateR270CB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the R270 transform.

functions.name: mgRotateR90CB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the R90 transform.

functions.name: mgRotateRightCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected instance to the right. To rotate an instance at least one instance should be selected.

functions.name: mgRouteCB
functions.description: Displays the Routing Style form for the current module.

functions.name: mgRoutePToTCB
functions.description: Routes the currently open Modgen using the Modgen pin-to-trunk router.

functions.name: mgSelectRowColCB
functions.description: Selects all of the instances in the current row or column from the currently selected instance.

functions.name: mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth
functions.syntax: mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth( d_constraintId x_channelIndex f_channelWidth ) => f_channelWidth / nil
functions.description: Sets the routing channel width for the specified Modgen column.

functions.name: mgSetIsLocalTrunk
functions.description: Sets the specified trunk as local. Trunks inside a Modgen are called local trunks. These trunks can be connected only within the same Modgen, and not from outside the Modgen.

functions.name: mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth
functions.syntax: mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth( d_constraintId x_channelIndex f_channelWidth ) => f_channelWidth / nil
functions.description: Sets the routing channel width for the specified Modgen row.

functions.name: mgSetStrapDirection
functions.description: Sets the strap direction. This value is valid only for straps with a single strap object. For straps with more than one strap objects, the router determines strap direction.

functions.name: mgSetStrapHasDirection
functions.description: Specifies whether the given strap can have a direction.

functions.name: mgSetStrapHasOffset
functions.description: Specifies whether the given strap has a valid offset value.

functions.name: mgSetStrapLongOffset1
functions.description: Sets the long offset attribute for the bottom and left edge of the specified strap. This value determines the distance that the strap will extend from the strap object.

functions.name: mgSetStrapLongOffset2
functions.description: Sets the long offset attribute for the top and right edge of the specified strap. This value determines the distance that the strap will extend from the strap object.

functions.name: mgSetStrapOffset
functions.description: Sets the strap offset attribute, which represents the distance from the bottom or left of the bBox of the strap object.

functions.name: mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose
functions.syntax: mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose( d_trunkId t_layerName [ t_purposeName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the layer and purpose of a topological trunk that is anchored to an instance. The bounding box of the specified layer and purpose inside the instance is used to determine the trunk's location. In other words, the trunk's orthogonal offset is from one side of the reference layer and purpose bounding box. The purpose argument is optional. If not specified, then the purpose argument defaults to any. A trunk's reference layer and purpose can be removed by setting both the layer and purpose arguments to any.

functions.name: mgSwapCB
functions.description: Swaps two selected instances, two rows of instances, or two columns of instances in Modgen.

functions.name: mgUnAbutCB
functions.description: Unabuts the selected instances in the current Modgen in the specified cellview.

functions.name: mgUnRegUserProc
functions.description: Accepts user functions based on the keywords and unregisters them in the Modgen code.

functions.name: mgUnRegisterDummyNetProc
functions.description: Unregisters a function that specifies a net for a given dummy instance ID and terminal ID.

functions.name: mgUnregisterDummyOverrideParameters
functions.description: Unregisters all registered Modgen dummy parameter overrides for the given library, if no library is specified, or all currently registered Modgen dummy parameter overrides.

functions.name: mgUnregisterDummyParamRefDirection
functions.description: Unregister either all registered Modgen dummy directional parameters for the given library name or cellNameOrRegex or all currently registered Modgen dummy directional parameters.

functions.name: mgUpdateCB
functions.description: Lets the Modgen ConObserver update the Modgen layout module.

functions.name: mgUpdateEmptyRowColumnHilightCB
functions.description: Update highlights of empty rows to follow any other changes in the Modgen.

functions.name: mgUpdateHoriAlignCB
functions.description: Aligns the selected instances on the specified side. Side can be one of left, right, or center.

functions.name: mgUpdateVertAlignCB
functions.description: Aligns the selected instances on the specified side. Side can be one of top, bottom, or center.

functions.name: mptActivate
functions.description: Specifies whether to switch the Virtuoso Multi-Patterning Technology coloring engine ON or OFF.

functions.name: mptCheckFlow
functions.description: Checks the flow settings by loading the check procedure of the specified flow or by comparing the current value of the related environment variables against the environment variables set by the set procedure of the flow.

functions.name: mptCheckHierarchicalLocks
functions.description: Performs a check for hierarchical color lock (HCL) conflict in the cellview.

functions.name: mptCleanClusters
functions.description: Cleans out-of-date cluster information in the cellview which can help to reduce the design size and/or improve performance.

functions.name: mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer
functions.syntax: mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer( d_cellViewID | g_libName t_layerName g_doHierarchy ) => t / nil
functions.description: Cleans layer-based color violations on the entire design hierarchy or library.

functions.name: mptColorRemastering
functions.syntax: mptColorRemastering( d_cellViewID  ?mode t_mode  [ ?mappingFile t_mappingFile ] [ ?fromView t_fromView ] [ ?toView t_toView ] [ ?invalidMappingWord t_invalidMappingWord ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Remasters color-shifted abstract views to corresponding layout views or color-shifted layout views to abstract views.

functions.name: mptDefineFlow
functions.syntax: mptDefineFlow( t_flowName s_setFunction [ s_checkFunction ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a flow by linking the flow name to a set and a check procedure. If the check procedure is not defined, the check defined in the cdsenv file is run. This function checks the environment variables defined in the set function against their current values.

functions.name: mptDeleteClusters
functions.syntax: mptDeleteClusters( d_cellViewID  [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?checkOnly g_checkOnly ] [ ?thruHierarchy g_thruHierarchy ] [ ?openForEdit g_openForEdit ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes coloring clusters in the specified cellview.

functions.name: mptDoColorChecks
functions.syntax: mptDoColorChecks( d_cellViewID  l_layers  l_region g_doColorShorts g_doUncoloredShapes g_doUnlockedShapes g_doColorability ) => t / nil
functions.description: Performs coloring checks in the specified cellview.

functions.name: mptDoToolbarAction
functions.description: Runs the specified Multiple Patterning toolbar function.

functions.name: mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked
functions.syntax: mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked( d_cellViewID  [ l_layers [ l_region [ g_fixUncolored [ g_fixUnlocked ]]]] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Searches for uncolored and unlocked, top-level shapes or vias, in the specified cellview and colors and locks them, respectively.

functions.name: mptGetColorShiftingLayers
functions.description: Returns a list of valid shifting layers set by the environment variable, colorShiftingLayers.

functions.name: mptGetColoredPurposes
functions.description: Returns a list of the colored layer purpose pairs for the cellview.

functions.name: mptGetDefaultColoringMethod
functions.description: Returns the session default coloring method that was set using mptSetDefaultColoringMethod.

functions.name: mptGetFlowNames
functions.description: Lists all available flow names that have been defined. It includes pre-defined and custom flow names.

functions.name: mptGetFlowSettings
functions.description: Reports, the procedure used to set a flow, in the CIW and output.

functions.name: mptGetLayerColoringMethod
functions.syntax: mptGetLayerColoringMethod( d_cellViewID  [ t_layerName ]  ) => t_coloringMethod / t_SDLcolorMethod / nil
functions.description: Returns either the coloring method for the given layer, or the coloring method for the session, the design, and layers with a specified coloring method.

functions.name: mptGetLayerDefaultColor
functions.syntax: mptGetLayerDefaultColor( d_techFileID  [ t_layerName ]  ) => t_color / l_layerColor / nil
functions.description: Returns either the default color for the given layer, or a list of layer-default color pairs.

functions.name: mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting
functions.syntax: mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting( d_techFileID  [ t_layerName ]  [ b_getAll ] ) => t_color / l_layerColor / l_ColorSettings / nil
functions.description: Returns the default color setting for the specified layer.

functions.name: mptGetLockDefaultColors
functions.description: Indicates whether the layer default color specified by mptSetLayerDefaultColor will be locked when assigned to a shape.

functions.name: mptGetOutdatedDesigns
functions.description: Returns a list of the cellviews in the design hierarchy for which the color information is outdated. The list can optionally specify the outdated layers for each cellview in the returned list.

functions.name: mptGetTrackPatternPattern
functions.description: Returns a list of the color patterns for the specified track pattern.

functions.name: mptGetUpToDateDesigns
functions.description: Returns a list of the cellviews in the hierarchy for which the color information is up to date.

functions.name: mptHiStitch
functions.description: Enables stitch mode to fix odd loop color violations by breaking shapes into two overlapping (stitched) shapes. The first click in the layout selects the shape to be stitched, and the second click sets the stitch location.

functions.name: mptHiUnStitch
functions.description: Enables unstitch mode to revert stitches that were created while in stitch mode (enabled by mptHiStitch). Click a stitched shape in the layout to remove the stitch.

functions.name: mptIsMaskColorShown
functions.description: Checks whether the specified mask color is visible for the layer.

functions.name: mptLPPMergeToColor
functions.syntax: mptLPPMergeToColor( d_cellviewID g_libName g_viewName l_mapping [ g_colorState ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Converts the layout into Virtuoso multi-pattern conformance format for designs that use two or more separate layer-purpose pairs to represent multi-patterning mask information, so that Virtuoso coloring engine can perform further operations on it. You can choose to write the conversion result into a different library or/and a different view. In this case, new cells with the same cell name and the library or/and view name that you specify are used. The original cell is not changed. If you choose to write the result to the same cell, the original layer-purpose pair data is removed. This function is performed on the entire hierarchy starting from the specified cell.

functions.name: mptLockAll
functions.description: Locks all the top-level shapes of the specified cellview with their current color. You can optionally lock only the shapes on specific colorable layers. Gray color shapes are not locked.

functions.name: mptMarkersToColoredBlockages
functions.description: Transforms the shapes on the specified purposes of the colored layers in the given cellview to colored blockages on the same layer. This function works hierarchically on a layout.

functions.name: mptMarkersToMaskColors
functions.syntax: mptMarkersToMaskColors( l_purposes  g_drawingPurpose  d_cellViewID  [ g_locked ] [ g_removeMarker ] [ g_recolorAll ] [ g_save ] ) => t / nil
