functions.description: Removes the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) from the list of WSSPDefs that are enabled as global grids in the cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRename
functions.description: Renames a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) by deleting and re-creating it. So, the DB ID may change. This function updates the global grid and any regions that reference the WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetActivePattern
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetActivePattern( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName t_defaultActiveName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default active width spacing pattern (WSP) for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatternGroups( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName l_patternGroupNames ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the allowed pattern groups for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatterns
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatterns( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName l_patternNames [ ?keepGroups g_keepGroups ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the allowed patterns for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. If the WSSPDef is enabled as global, the patterns apply to the global grid of the WSSPDef and to any regions for the WSSPDef for which the allowed patterns are not overridden.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetEnabledOverrides
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetEnabledOverrides( d_cellViewId  l_wsspDefNames [ ?direction t_direction ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Overrides the global grid in the specified cellview and by enabling the specified list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) as global grids. If the l_wsspDefNames argument does not contain any WSSPDef in a direction, there is no global grid for that direction even if the technology database specifies a global grid for that direction.

functions.name: xfgrAddOption
functions.syntax: xfgrAddOption(  ?optionName g_optionName ?optionLabel g_optionLabel ?optionType g_optionType ?optionWidgetType g_optionWidgetType ?optionDefaultValue g_optionDefaultValue ?supportedOptionValue g_supportedOptionValue ?groupName g_groupName ?deviceName g_deviceName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new field as specified in the option name to the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrConfigureOptionsCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers the specified user-defined callback function against xfgrConfigureOptions.

functions.name: xfgrDisableOption
functions.description: Disables the specified option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrEnableOption
functions.description: Enables the specified option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrGetAvailableValues
functions.description: Returns the available values for the specified option name. The options are combo box, spin box, or radio button.

functions.name: xfgrGetOptionValue
functions.description: Returns the current value for the specified option.

functions.name: xfgrHideAllGroups
functions.description: Hides all groups in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrHideAllOptions
functions.description: Hides all current groups in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrHideGroup
functions.description: Hides the options in the specified group from the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrHideOption
functions.description: Hides the specified option from the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrInitializeOptionsCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers a user-defined callback function to be called during the initialization of option values in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrOptionValueChangeCB
functions.syntax: xfgrOptionValueChangeCB(  t_mode s_callbackFunction [ g_optionName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Registers or de-registers user-defined callback function to be called when the value of any option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form changes.

functions.name: xfgrPostCreateCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers a user-defined callback function after the creation of the fluid guard ring instance.

functions.name: xfgrPreCreateCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers the user-defined callback function before the creation of the fluid guard ring instance.

functions.name: xfgrSetAvailableValues
functions.description: Specified the list of valid values for the specified option.

functions.name: xfgrSetOptionValue
functions.description: Sets the specified value for the option.

functions.name: xfgrSetTableCellValue
functions.syntax: xfgrSetTableCellValue(  t_tableName t_rowNumber t_columnNumber t_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified row and column of the specified table with the specified value in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrShowAllGroups
functions.description: Displays all groups in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrShowGroup
functions.description: Displays the options in the specified group on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrShowOption
functions.description: Displays the specified option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: addPoint
functions.description: Adds the point to the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: appTrigger
functions.description: The application trigger is responsible for any necessary banner setup (except for menus), installing the window popup menu, and other application-specific initialization. It is also responsible for managing the application context.

functions.name: applyEnterFun
functions.description: Calls doneProc, passes it the points you entered, resets the enterfunction, and calls initProc.

functions.name: bottomEdge
functions.description: Returns the lower left point's Y coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

functions.name: cancelEnterFun
functions.description: Cancels the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: ccBendConnector
functions.syntax: ccBendConnector( l_port n_radius n_bangle  n_rmin n_gamma )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a bend connector making a circular turn from the specified starting port with the radius, bend angle, and gamma fraction given in ccWaypointConnector. The connector consists of a central circular arc and two apex clothoids matching its curvature at one end and with zero curvature at the other end. Gamma is the ratio of the circular bend angle to the total bend angle.

functions.name: ccConvertIntoCurvy
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a new ccShape to which the specified database figure is attached.

functions.name: ccCopyFig
functions.syntax: ccCopyFig( o_shape [ ?cv d_cellViewID ] [ ?lpp g_lpp ]          [ ?transform l_transform ]    )  => o_shape2 / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Copies the specified ccShape object to the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair (LPP) by using the specified transform. The copied cellview and LPP default to the ones of the source ccShape.

functions.name: ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList
functions.syntax: ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList( n_startWidth n_endWidth S_taperStyle o_polyCurve [ ?startClamp n_startClampLength ] [ ?endClamp n_endClampLength ] ) => l_segmentsWidths
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a list of curved segments with the corresponding width expressions defining a tapered connector path of the specified tapering style with the specified start and end width around the centerline specified by the input polyCurve.   The segments of the input polyCurve are assumed to be parametrized by the arc length in the same way as the segments created by the connector generation functions ccBendConnector, ccCurveConnector, and ccWaypointConnector.   The tapering width function can optionally be clamped to have zero derivative at either or both the ends of the connector with the length of the clamping regions specified by the specified clamp lengths.

functions.name: ccCreateCurve
functions.syntax: ccCreateCurve( t_x t_y l_interval )  => o_curve / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccCurve object using the specified parametric functions and interval.

functions.name: ccCreateEllipse
functions.syntax: ccCreateEllipse( d_cellViewId l_lpp l_llPoint l_urPoint ?offset l_offset  ?rotation n_rotation ?genFigs g_genFigs ) => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates an ellipse with the specified coordinates as a ccSurface object in the cellview with specified layer-purpose pair. The ellipse is then transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

functions.name: ccCreateFacet
functions.syntax: ccCreateFacet( l_origin [ ?angle n_angle ] [ ?radius n_radius ] [ ?offsets l_offsets ] [ ?name t_name ] ) => o_facet / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccFacet object. A facet is a special type of straight segment that is specified by the origin point, offsets, curvature, and rotation angle. It can be used to implement a smooth stitching between two ccShape objects.

functions.name: ccCreateLine
functions.syntax: ccCreateLine( d_cellViewId l_lpp g_polyCurveSegments ) => o_line / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccLine object at the specified layer-purpose pair of the given cellview from either a ccPolyCurve object or a list of polyCurve segments forming a polyCurve. When list of polyCurve segments is specified the resulting polyCurve should be of class G2, otherwise, the function terminates with an error.

functions.name: ccCreateLineSegment
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccCurve object that represents a straight line segment connecting two specified points.

functions.name: ccCreatePath
functions.syntax: ccCreatePath( d_cellviewId l_lpp l_segments [?defaultWidth g_defWidth]  [?smoothness   S_smoothness] )  => o_path / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccPath object on the specified layer-purpose pair from one or a list of path segments.

functions.name: ccCreatePie
functions.syntax: ccCreatePie( d_cellviewId l_lpp  [ ?angle n_angle ]  [ ?startRadius n_startRadius ] [ ?length n_length ] [ ?endWidth n_endWidth ] [ ?endLength n_endLength ] [ ?offset l_offset ] [ ?rotation n_rotation ] [ ?genFigs { t | nil } ] )  => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a pie slice figure bounded by outer circle and optionally by an inner circle, two radiuses at given angles, and optionally by an outer capping of given length. The function generates different figures based on the input.   When the startRadius is nil, the pie shape that is generated is a true pie shape, with the length being the radius.   When the startRadius is larger than 0.0, a donut shape is generated, with the inner part radius determined by the value, while the length is used to represent the thickness of the donut.   When endWidth is specified, a termination is generated, caping the coupler by a shape that is conceptually the union of a rectangle and the last pie shape, with the inner-curved radius as specified. In this case, endWidth must be smaller than the arc defined by sum of radius and length and larger than the arc from radius.   If rotation or offset is specified, the resulting the object undergoes corresponding transformation.

functions.name: ccCreatePolyCurve
functions.syntax: ccCreatePolyCurve( l_segments [ ?close { t | nil } ] [ ?smoothness S_smoothness ] )  => o_polyCurve / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccPolyCurve object from a list of specified polyCurve segments.

functions.name: ccCreatePolygon
functions.syntax: ccCreatePolygon( d_cellview l_lpp l_points ?offset l_offset   ?rotation n_rotation ?genFigs g_genFigs )  => o_surface | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a polygon with the specified vertices as the ccSurface in the specified cellview and on the specified layer-purpose pair. The polygon is transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

functions.name: ccCreateRect
functions.syntax: ccCreateRect( d_cellview l_lpp l_llPoint l_urPoint ?offset l_offset   ?rotation n_rotation ?genFigs g_genFigs )  => o_surface | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a rectangle with the specified coordinates as a ccSurface object on the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair. The rectangle is then transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

functions.name: ccCreateSurface
functions.syntax: ccCreateSurface( d_cellViewId l_lpp o_boundary [ l_holes ]  )  => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccSurface object on the specified layer-purpose pair from the specified boundary, which is ccPolyCurve with positive area and a list of holes, which are ccPolyCurve objects with negative areas.

functions.name: ccCreateSurfaceFromPath
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccSurface object from the boundary of the given ccPath. Begin and end facets of the ccPath object in the resulting ccSurface boundary are renamed according to the value of facetNames, or are not renamed if facetNames is nil.

functions.name: ccCubicSplineConnector
functions.syntax: ccCubicSplineConnector( l_points [ ?d1 n_d1 ] [ ?d2 n_d2 ] )  => o_polyCurve / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a polyCurve representing a cubic spline function in the form where y is a function of x through the given list of points (x,y) with strictly increasing coordinates x.

functions.name: ccCurveConnector
functions.syntax: ccCurveConnector( l_port1 l_port2 n_rmin [ ?method x_method ] [ ?parameters l_parameters ] )  => l_connector | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a curve connector with two specified ports and a minimum curvature radius. Depending on the input, the connector consists of different combinations of line, circle, and clothoid curve segments.

functions.name: ccFindSurfaceFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Searches for a facet with the specified name on the specified surface.

functions.name: ccGenFigs
functions.syntax: ccGenFigs( o_shape [ ?attach { t | nil } ] [ ?snapToMFG { t | nil } ]  [ ?accuracy { n_accuracy | nil } ] ) => l_figs / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Generates geometry for the specified ccShape and optionally attaches it to the originating ccShape.

functions.name: ccGenOffsetFig
functions.syntax: ccGenOffsetFig( o_path g_lpp ?side t_side [ ?inner n_value | ?outer n_value | ?inner n_value | ?outer n_value ] ) => o_shape / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a new ccShape in the same cellview as the specified path on the specified layer-purpose pair. This shape is constructed by connecting two offsets of the edge of the specified path by using the inner and outer values, respectively, with two facets. The origins of these facets are the same as the origins of the facets of the specified path.

functions.name: ccGetAll
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns all persistent ccShapes in the specified cellview.

functions.name: ccGetCurveDerivative
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a derivative of a curve or a polyCurve segment at the specified value of the curve function parameter.

functions.name: ccGetCurveLength
functions.description: Returns the approximate length of a curve or a polyCurve by discretizing it with the specified accuracy and summing up the lengths of the linear segments between the discretization points corrected by additional terms due to curvature.

functions.name: ccGetCurvePoint
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a point on a curve or a polyCurve segment at the specified value of the curve function parameter.

functions.name: ccGetFromFig
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the ccShape object attached to the given database figure.

functions.name: ccGetPathBoundary
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the ccBoundary object of the specified ccPath.

functions.name: ccGetPathCenterLine
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the center line of the path as an open ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccGetPathEdge
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a new ccPolyCurve that is either the left or the right edge of the boundary of the specified path.

functions.name: ccGetPolyCurveMinRadius
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the minimum curvature radius of a polyCurve, ignoring any tangent discontinuity points.

functions.name: ccIsEnabled
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks if the CurvyCore engine is enabled.

functions.name: ccIsLinearCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks if the given ccCurve is linear.

functions.name: ccLayerAnd
functions.syntax: ccLayerAnd( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves { t | nil } ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived from the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 that overlap areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes1.

functions.name: ccLayerAndNot
functions.syntax: ccLayerAndNot( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves {  t | nil } ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived from the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 that do not overlap any areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes2.

functions.name: ccLayerOffset
functions.syntax: ccLayerOffset( g_shapes n_value [ ?cellView d_cellView ] [ ?lpp g_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves { t | nil } ] )  => l_surfaces
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of surfaces derived by merging the areas of the input shapes and offsetting them by the specified offset value. Resulting surfaces can optionally be created in the specified cellview and with the specified layer-purpose pair different from the default layer-purpose pair of the first input shape.

functions.name: ccLayerOr
functions.syntax: ccLayerOr( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves { t | nil } ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived by combining the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 and the areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes2.

functions.name: ccMirrorFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a mirrored or reversed copy of the given ccFacet. If the facet is viewed as a segment, it reverses the direction, which mean that it goes from the end of the original facet to its beginning. However, this function also updates the radius attribute in such a way that two G2-connected paths have mirrored facets at the connection point.

functions.name: ccMoveFig
functions.syntax: ccMoveFig( o_shape [ ?cv d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp g_lpp ] [ ?transform l_transform ] )  => o_shape2 / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Moves the specified ccShape to the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair (LPP) using the specified transform. The cellview and LPP default to the ones of the source ccShape.

functions.name: ccORE
functions.syntax: ccORE(  [ ?rule g_rule ] [ ?sourceCellView o_sourceCellView ] [ ?destinationCellView o_destinationCellView ] [ ?filterLPP l_filterLPP ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel  [ ?parameters l_parameters ] [ ?loadContext t_loadContext ] [ ?saveContext t_saveContext ] [ ?saveResult s_saveResult ] [ ?trace g_trace ]  )  => t
functions.description: Evaluates Optical Rule Engine (ORE) expressions specified in a file or a SKILL list. Expressions are evaluated on the source cellview and the resulting markers and shapes are stored in the source cellview or optionally in the destination cellview. The evaluation can  be limited only to shapes on the specified layer-purpose pairs and down to the specified level of hierarchy.   The default values defined in the expressions can be overridden by the specified parameter values. The ORE context can be saved at the end of the run under a specified name and loaded at the beginning of the next run by referring to the same name. The evaluation of ORE expressions can optionally be traced and the list of ORE objects resulting from them saved in a SKILL variable.

functions.name: ccORECompile
functions.description: Compiles the Optical Rule Engine (ORE) expressions specified as a file or a list and stores them in an encrypted form including an optional unencrypted header in a file with the specified name. The encrypted output file can be specified as the input g_rule key argument of the ccORE function.

functions.name: ccOREGetContext
functions.description: Retrieves the Optical Rule Engine (ORE) context with the specified name.

functions.name: ccOREGetContextObject
functions.description: Retrieves the defstruct representing the specified Optical Rule Engine (ORE) object in the specified ORE context.

functions.name: ccOREGetContexts
functions.description: Retrieves a list of Optical Rule Engine (ORE) context names.

functions.name: ccOREPurgeContext
functions.description: Purges the optical rule engine (ORE) context with the specified name.

functions.name: ccOREPurgeContexts
functions.description: Purges all Optical Rule Engine (ORE) contexts.

functions.name: ccOffsetPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified polyCurve that is expanded by the specified offset value.

functions.name: ccOrientCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified  ccCurve or ccPolyCurve rotated counterclockwise around the origin by a multiple of 90 degrees after optionally mirroring it across the X-axis or Y-axis. Mirroring also reverses the orientation of the curve.

functions.name: ccRemoveFigs
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Removes the database figures attached to the given ccShape.

functions.name: ccRenameFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified facet with a different name.

functions.name: ccReversePolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a reversed copy of the given polyCurve, which is the polyCurve with the same geometry but in the opposite direction, which is from the end of the original polyCurve to its beginning.   This function can be used to turn positive-closed polyCurves into negative polyCurves, and negative-closed polyCurves into positive polyCurves.

functions.name: ccSmoothenFig
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the result of smoothening of the specified ccShape as a new transient ccSurface.

functions.name: ccSmoothenPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a smoothened copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccSpiralConnector
functions.syntax: ccSpiralConnector( n_lengthInnerSpiral0 n_lengthOuterSpiral1 x_numberOfTurns n_minRadius n_gamma  [ ?portLocation t_location ] ) => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a spiral connector that consists of an inner S-shaped figure of two joined circular bend connectors. Each endpoint of S is prolonged by a straight extension and then by N-turnings of a spiral circling around S.

functions.name: ccTransformFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccFacet object.

functions.name: ccTransformPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccTromboneConnector
functions.syntax: ccTromboneConnector( l_legs  n_rmin n_gamma  )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a trombone-shaped connector that consists of five legs of given lengths, smoothly connected by waypoint connectors with the given gamma ratio and the minimum curvature radius.

functions.name: ccWaypointConnector
functions.syntax: ccWaypointConnector( l_port1    l_port2    l_points   n_rmin n_gamma    )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a waypoint connector between the specified points with the given minimum curvature radius and the given portion (gamma) of the circular bending angle in the overall bending angle.  If both ports are nil, then at least three waypoints must be specified as input. The connector starts at the first waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the first two waypoints and ends at the last waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the last two waypoints.  If both ports are not nil, they specify the initial and the final points, tangents, and radiuses of the connector.   If no waypoints are specified, the start and the end ports are connected by a curve connector.   If a single waypoint is specified, it is connected to the start and the end ports by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoint.   If two waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other with a straight line and to the start and the end ports with a pair of curve connectors with zero curvatures at the waypoints.   If three or more waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other by a waypoint connector like in the case where both ports are nil and to the start and the end ports by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoints.  It is an error to only specify one port as nil and the other port as not nil.  The waypoint connector consists of a sequence of lines, circles, and clothoids. If the calculation of the waypoint connector can only be partially completed, then the result will only contain segments between the starting point and the point where the calculation failed.

functions.name: ccWideConnector
functions.syntax: ccWideConnector( g_connector l_lengthWidths n_clamp1         n_clamp2         ) => l_segmentWidths
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a specification of a path around the specified connector centerline with the width specified by a cubic spline function.

functions.name: ccpCopy
functions.syntax: ccpCopy( q_src q_dest [ g_overWrite ] [ s_expFlag ] [ l_copyViewTypeList ] [ l_copyViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ s_whatToUpdate ] [ q_updateLibList ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies source data to another location.

functions.name: ccpCopyConfig
functions.syntax: ccpCopyConfig( G_src G_dest [ g_overWrite ] [ s_expFlag ] [ q_copySkipLibList ] [ l_copyViewTypeList ] [ l_copyViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ s_whatToUpdate ] [ q_updateLibList ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies a design configuration. Expansion is based on configuration rules specified in the expand.cfg file in the source configuration view.

functions.name: ccpCopyDesign
functions.syntax: ccpCopyDesign( G_src G_dest [ g_overWrite ] [ s_expFlag ] [ q_copySkipLibList ] [ l_copyViewTypeList ] [ l_copyViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ s_whatToUpdate ] [ q_updateLibList ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies a design, after expanding it, to the destination library you specify.

functions.name: ccpCopyExactDesign
functions.syntax: ccpCopyExactDesign( G_src G_dest [ g_overWrite ] [ s_expFlag ]  [ q_copySkipLibList ] [ l_copyViewTypeList ] [ l_copyViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ s_whatToUpdate ] [ q_updateLibList ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies a design, after expanding it, to the destination library you specify. This function is similar to ccpCopyDesign, except that it copies only the exact design-it does not copy any views that are not used in the design.

functions.name: ccpDmHasRename
functions.description: Checks whether a specified design management system (DMS) is loaded and enabled for GDM renaming. The DMS can be loaded either by Virtuoso at startup or by previously made successful calls to the DM objects from SKILL functions such as ddGetObjDMSys, ddIsPathManaged, or gdmstatus.

functions.name: ccpDmRename
functions.syntax: ccpDmRename( G_src G_dest [ ?destLibPath t_destLibPath ] [ ?whatToUpdate s_whatToUpdate ] [ ?updateLibList q_updateLibList ] [ ?existenceCheck x_existenceCheck ] [ ?reReferenceCustomVias x_reReferenceCustomVias ] [ ?tag t_tag ] [ ?description t_description ] [ ?xtraArgs t_xtraArgs ] [ ?feedbackStyle x_feedbackStyle ] [ ?limitChecks x_limitChecks ] [ ?checkOnly g_checkOnly ] [ ?returnGdmContext g_returnGdmContext ] [ ?returnCcpResults g_returnCcpResults ] [ ?feedbackCallback u_feedbackCallback ] [ ?doneCallback u_doneCallback ] [ ?gdmContextCallback u_gdmContextCallback ] [ ?nconsTag l_nconsTag ] [ ?dpl l_dpl ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Renames a specified gdmSpec object representing a cellview. The source object is deleted after a copy is created. When you copy a directory containing the cellview, all files in the directory are copied, regardless of whether they are co-managed or not.

functions.name: ccpExpand
functions.syntax: ccpExpand( q_src s_expFlag [ l_expandViewTypeList ] [ l_expandViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a list of source objects.

functions.name: ccpExpandConfig
functions.syntax: ccpExpandConfig( G_src s_expFlag [ q_expandSkipLibList ] [ l_expandViewTypeList ] [ l_expandViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a configuration, based on configuration rules specified in the expand.cfg file in the source configuration view.

functions.name: ccpExpandDesign
functions.syntax: ccpExpandDesign( G_src s_expFlag q_expandSkipLibList  [ l_expandViewTypeList ] [ l_expandViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a design, given a source cell or cellview gdmSpec object.

functions.name: ccpExpandExactDesign
functions.syntax: ccpExpandExactDesign( G_src s_expFlag q_expandSkipLibList  [ l_expandViewTypeList ] [ l_expandViewNameList ] [ t_vNameSimExp ] [ t_vNameSpace ] [ g_addProp ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a design, given a source cell or cellview gdmSpec object. This function is similar to ccpExpandDesign, except that the expansion list only includes those views that are used in the design.

functions.name: ccpGetAutoRename
functions.description: Gets the current status of the auto rename feature. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, the ccpSetAutoRename function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

functions.name: ccpRegMonitor
functions.description: Registers the copy monitor that you create. A copy monitor is a program that displays the progress of the copy command while it is being executed.

functions.name: ccpRegTrigger
functions.syntax: ccpRegTrigger( t_copyPhaseStr s_triggerFunction [ g_canEditList ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the copy trigger that you create. The copy trigger is called in the copy phase that you specify.

functions.name: ccpRemoveTrigger
functions.description: Removes the registered copy trigger function from the copy phase you specify.

functions.name: ccpRename
functions.syntax: ccpRename( G_src G_dest [ g_overWrite ] [ s_expFlag ] [ s_whatToUpdate ] [ q_updateLibList ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Renames a library, cell, view, or file. The source library, cell, view, or file is copied, and then the original one is deleted. When you copy a directory (library, cell, or view), all the files in the directory are copied, regardless of whether they are co-managed or not.

functions.name: ccpRenameReferenceLib
functions.syntax: ccpRenameReferenceLib( G_fromLib G_toLib q_updateList [ s_whatCanChange ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Renames references to an external library. The external library is not changed.

functions.name: ccpSetAutoRename
functions.description: Sets the status of the auto rename feature to on or off. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, this function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

functions.name: centerBox
functions.description: Returns the center point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and is assumed to be correct.

functions.name: changeEnterFun
functions.syntax: changeEnterFun( s_enterFun  [ ?prompts l_promptList ]  [ ?points l_pointList ]  [ ?wantPoints x_pointLimit ] [ ?form s_form ]  [ ?addPointProc t_addProcName ]  [ ?delPointProc t_delProcName ]  [ ?initProc t_initProcName ]  [ ?doneProc t_doneProcName ] [ ?formProc t_formProcName ] [ ?pathStyle t_pathStyle ] [ ?cursor x_cursor ] [ ?pathWidth f_pathWidth ] [ ?beginExtent f_beginExtent ] [ ?endExtent f_endExtent ]  [ ?dontDraw g_dontDraw ] [ ?alwaysMap g_alwaysMap ] [ ?acceptString g_acceptString ] [ ?acceptNumber g_acceptNumber ] [ ?noInfix g_noInfix ] [ ?cmdName t_cmdName ] [ ?target l_point ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Since this function uses the current window to determine which enterfunction to change, make sure to properly set the current window before using this function. See hiSetCurrentWindow for information about setting the current window.

functions.name: changeNextEnterFun
functions.description: If an enterfunction is currently active, sets a flag that causes the next enterfunction invocation for the current window or a specified window to use the changeEnterFun logic rather than being nested.

functions.name: ciwAddTranslatorItem
functions.syntax: ciwAddTranslatorItem( s_tag t_itemText t_callback ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds an entry for the Import or Export commands.

functions.name: ciwCreateMenu
functions.description: Creates a menu from the given menu definition. The menu created can be used as a pop-up menu. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwCreatePulldown
functions.description: Creates a pulldown menu from the given menu definition. The ls_menuDef argument can either be a list defining the contents of a pulldown menu or the SKILL symbol that represents the list. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwHiExit
functions.description: Exits the session.

functions.name: ciwMenuInit
functions.description: Initializes and installs the CIW pulldown menus based on the menu files found in the hierarchy. This function will be called instead of hiInstallCIWMenus. It can also be called from the CIW to debug the menu file contents.  If g_reset is specified as t, the CIW menus are reset. Calling ciwMenuInit without any arguments will initialize the CIW menus only if it has not already been done.

functions.name: ciwMenuInstall
functions.description: Creates and installs into r_window a menu banner based on ls_bannerDef. Useful for applications that create and manage their own windows. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwMenuLoadFile
functions.description: Reads menu files found in the DFII hierarchy using t_appName.

functions.name: ciwRemoveTranslatorItem
functions.syntax: ciwRemoveTranslatorItem( s_tag t_itemText t_callback ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes an entry from the Import or Export commands.

functions.name: clearAllEnterFunctions
functions.description: Cancels all nested enterfunctions associated with the current window.

functions.name: colorIndex
functions.description: Returns the pixel value for the colormap index of the specified RGB value. This function is an alias for hiMatchColor.

functions.name: dagAddActionToObject
functions.description: Adds the action to the specified dag node or class. However, if the action is already in the list, it is not replaced. For an existing action, use dagDeleteActionFromObject to delete the action and then call dagAddActionToObject.

functions.name: dagCreateClass
functions.description: Creates a dagClass and returns it. If a class by this name already exists, it is overwritten.

functions.name: dagCreateNode
functions.description: Creates a dagNode and returns it.

functions.name: dagDeleteActionFromObject
functions.description: Deletes the action named t_actionName from the specified class or node. If a node action was inherited from its class, the action must be deleted from the class, not the node.

functions.name: dagDestroyNode
functions.description: Destroys a dagNode. All descendant nodes and arcs of this node are also destroyed, as well as the arcs linking this node to its parents.

functions.name: dagDisplayTool
functions.description: Redisplays a dagTool. You can use this function if you want to re-display all of the objects in the graph rather than calling dagRefreshObject for each one.

functions.name: dagGetCurrentObject
functions.description: Identifies the node for which the action was selected. It takes no arguments and returns the current node, or nil.

functions.name: dagGetCurrentTool
functions.description: Returns the current dagTool, and nil if there is not a current dagTool. The current dagTool is different from the current window. The current tool might not be the current window.

functions.name: dagLinkParentToChild
functions.description: Creates a dagArc that links the parent node to the child node. It returns the arc it creates. If an error occurs, it returns nil.

functions.name: dagNumToTool
functions.description: Returns the dagtool that matches the window number specified by x_toolNumber.

functions.name: dagOpenTool
functions.syntax: dagOpenTool( x_backGroundColor l_bBox w_startingObject t_name t_help )  => w_dagTool / nil
functions.description: Creates a dagTool object and opens a window in which to display the graph starting from the specified starting node.

functions.name: dagPopTool
functions.description: Pops the tool stack specified by the w_dagTool argument.

functions.name: dagPushTool
functions.description: Pushes a new starting object specified by the w_newStartingNode argument onto the stack of the tool specified by w_dagTool.

functions.name: dagRefreshObject
functions.description: Redraws the node specified by w_dagNode in all the tools it is currently displayed.

functions.name: dagSetActionStatus
functions.syntax: dagSetActionStatus( t_actionName w_dagObject g_status  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the status of the specified action in the action list of the class or node. An action that has been turned off is grayed-out in the pop-up menu and not available through its action accelerator, if any.

functions.name: dagSetCurrentTool
functions.description: Sets the current dagTool to the one specified by the w_dagTool argument.

functions.name: dagSetExpandedActionStatus
functions.syntax: dagSetExpandedActionStatus( t_actionName w_dagObject g_status ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the status of the specified action in the expanded-action list of a node. Setting the status to nil makes the action name appear gray in the pop-up menu and makes the action accelerator unavailable. Once a dagNode has been placed into a tool, the actions from the dagClass are concatenated to make a full list of actions for this node. This is known as the expanded-action list.

functions.name: dagSetFont
functions.description: Modifies the font used in text mode in any dag tool.

functions.name: dagUnlinkParentFromChild
functions.description: Unlinks a parent node from a child node. It takes, as its only argument, the dagArc that connects the parent to the child. The arc is destroyed; however, neither the parent node nor the child node is destroyed. This can be useful if you want to change the parent of a node.

functions.name: dataTrigger
functions.description: The data trigger is called after the DE has collected and verified all of the trigger arguments, checked for the proper application registration, and opened or validated a window for the design.

functions.name: dbAbutIsInteractive
functions.description: This function is used by user-defined abutment functions. It indicates if the call to the abutment function was triggered by an interactive action.

functions.name: dbAbutIsReAbutGroup
functions.description: When called during abutment event 3 (un-abutment), the SKILL function indicates if re-abutment of Pcell instances will be triggered immediately after un-abutment. If the SKILL function returns true, the PDK SKILL function can store relevant information, if needed, from the current abutment group.

functions.name: dbAddAreaToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Adds an area boundary to the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddFigToFigGroup
functions.description: Adds a figure to the specified figGroup.

functions.name: dbAddFigToNet
functions.description: Assigns the given figure object to a specified net object. If the figure is already associated with a different net, the figure will be detached from that net before being assigned to the given net object.

functions.name: dbAddFigToPin
functions.description: Adds the specified figure to the given pin.

functions.name: dbAddFigToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function adds a via or a non-text shape to the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddFigsToPin
functions.description: Adds a list of figures to the given pin.

functions.name: dbAddObjectToGroup
functions.description: Adds a database object to a group.

functions.name: dbAddObjectsToMarker
functions.description: Adds a list of objects to a specified marker.

functions.name: dbAddPinToPinGroup
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Adds the padstack instance to the pin group.

functions.name: dbAddPinToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function adds a pin to the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaBackgroundDef
functions.description: Adds a reference to the specified placeArea object in the given backgroundDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified placeArea to the specified compTypeSetDefs. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaRailDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified placeArea to the specified railDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects specified are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowBackgroundDef
functions.description: Adds a reference to the specified row object in the given backgroundDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified compTypeSetDef to the specified row object. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowRailDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified railDef to the specified row object. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddStrapObject
functions.description: Adds a database object to a specified strap pattern. The object must be of the type InstTerm, Via, or Shape. The object must be in the same database as the strap.

functions.name: dbAllCellViews
functions.syntax: dbAllCellViews(  g_lib  t_cellName  [ d_contextCellView ]  )  => l_viewName / nil
functions.description: Lists all the view names of a cell.

functions.name: dbAreaBoundaryHasLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating that the layerPriorityOrder constraints set on the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbAreaBoundaryHasValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating that the validRoutingLayers constraint is set on the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbAttachRowRegionToPRBoundary
functions.description: Associates the given rowRegion with the PRBoundary in the same block. If the PRBoundary is assigned to another rowRegion, it is first detached from that region before being assigned to the specified rowRegion.

functions.name: dbBoundaryQuery
functions.syntax: dbBoundaryQuery( d_cellviewId l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_boundary / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the boundaries in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbCVHasInheritedSig
functions.description: Checks if there is any inherited signal in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCVHasInheritedTerm
functions.description: Checks whether there is any inherited terminal in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCVHasNetSetProp
functions.description: Determines if the netSet property is set on a cellview.

functions.name: dbCanonicalizeAnyAngleTransform
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Canonicalizes composition of the given transformations into a pair of orientation angles and a non-negative acute angle. Transformations are either numbers representing counter-clockwise rotation in degrees or strings representing orientation. The effect of transformation by the composition of the transformations in the return value is the same as effect of transformation by the composition of all input transformations.

functions.name: dbCellViewAreLayerShiftsValid
functions.description: Returns a Boolean depending on whether the layer shift information on the instances in the specified cellview is synchronized with the layers and color information in the bound tech. This function is currently intended only for the advanced nodes release.

functions.name: dbCellViewClearLayerShifts
functions.description: Clears the layer shift information from all instances in the specified cellview. Any cached layer shift specification for the tech bound to the cellview is left intact.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Checks whether the equivalent connectivity time is set on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasLayerShifts
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether there is layer shift information on any instance in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasOpticalData
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview has optical data.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasPhotonicPinFig
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks whether the specified cellview has a photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges
functions.syntax: dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges(  d_cellViewId  [ g_shapes g_vias g_HCLs ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Checks whether any edits were done to the specified type of objects in the older versions of Virtuoso after color lock type information was set for some of them.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasVirtHier
functions.description: Determines whether the specified cellview contains virtual hierarchy data.

functions.name: dbCellViewInitForLayerShifting
functions.description: Initializes the layer shift data for the given cell.

functions.name: dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes
functions.syntax: dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes(  d_cellViewId t_value  [g_shapes g_vias g_HCLs] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes color lock type for all color-locked objects of the specified object types to the given value.

functions.name: dbCellViewUpdateLayerShifts
functions.description: Creates or rebuilds the layer shift specification cache with the layers that are in the tech bound to the specified cellview. As a result, the per-layer shift information on the instances in the cellview is removed.

functions.name: dbChangeGroupType
functions.description: Changes the type of a group.

functions.name: dbCheckParamCell
functions.description: Checks if the specified cellview is a valid parameterized cell. If there was an error during the reading, binding, or evaluation of the specified cellview, a description of the error is returned.

functions.name: dbCheckRecursion
functions.description: Checks for occurrence of the given top cellview in the hierarchy of the instHeader masters or any other recursion inside the instHeader master hierarchy.

functions.name: dbClearAllActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Clears all the active wire type specifications on the design and for the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef. Additionally, clears all the region-specific active wire types.

functions.name: dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData
functions.syntax: dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData( d_cellView [ ?dryRun { t | nil } ] [ ?ignoreUnboundRefs { t | nil } ] ) => x_numClearedObjects / nil
functions.description: Opens hierarchy below the given cellview and removes all occShape coloring data that does not have any effect on the display of coloring data in the opened hierarchy. By default, if some instances or vias in the hierarchy cannot be bound, the function prints a warning message and returns nil, but cleanup can be forced with the ignoreUnboundRefs argument.

functions.name: dbClose
functions.description: Closes a cellview.

functions.name: dbCloseBag
functions.description: Closes the property bag in the given mode. If closing for append or write, the function decrements the write count.

functions.name: dbColorShapeQuery
functions.syntax: dbColorShapeQuery(  d_cellViewId l_layerPurposePair l_bBox [ x_startLevel ] [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ] [ l_transform ] ) => l_shapeColorPairs / nil

functions.name: dbCompressPointArray

functions.name: dbConcatTransform

functions.name: dbConvertAnyAngleTransformFromDbToMY

Orientation-based representation is a pair of DB orientation and any-angle rotation with the rotation applied first. functions.name: dbConvertArcToLine
functions.description: Converts an arc to a line. A line is defined as a number of connecting segments.

functions.name: dbConvertDonutToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a donut to a polygon.

functions.name: dbConvertEllipseToPolygon
functions.description: Converts an ellipse to a polygon.

functions.name: dbConvertLineToPath
functions.syntax: dbConvertLineToPath(  d_line  x_width  [ t_pathStyle ]  )  => d_path / nil
functions.description: Converts a line to a path.

functions.name: dbConvertPathSegToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a pathseg to a polygon based on the boundary list.

functions.name: dbConvertPathToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a path to a polygon with the same number of points as the path.

functions.name: dbConvertRectToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a rectangle into a polygon.

functions.description: Copies all the properties from the database object given in the first argument to the database object given in the second argument in a single, atomic, copy operation. functions.syntax: dbCopyShape( d_shapeId d_cellviewId [ l_transform ]  ) => d_newShapeId / nil
functions.description: Copies a shape to the specified cellview with the given transformation.

functions.name: dbCopySingleProp

functions.name: dbCreateArc

functions.description: Creates an arc.

functions.syntax: dbCreateAreaBoundary( d_cellviewId l_points [ t_name = nil]  [ lt_edgeNames = nil] ) => d_areaBoundaryId / nil
functions.description: Creates an area boundary object in the specified cellview.

functions.description: Creates an areaHalo blockage object of type placement. An area halo is associated with an instance or a prBoundary to represent an extended area around the master's prBoundary.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Creates an area pin group guide with the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.description: Creates a backgroundDef based on the SKILL DPL specification of the object. Contents of the SKILL DPL specification are checked before the backgroundDef is created.

functions.name: dbCreateBusNetDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateBusNetDef( d_cellviewId t_baseName t_bitOrder ) => d_busNetDefId / nil
functions.description: Creates a bus net definition with specified bit order and base name in the given cellview.

functions.description: Creates a cluster boundary object in the cellview of the given cluster. The cluster boundary is associated with a cluster (grouping of objects) and defines the area of the cluster objects.

functions.name: dbCreateCompTypeSetDefByAttr

functions.syntax: dbCreateConnByName(  d_net  d_inst  t_name  )  => d_instTerm / nil
functions.description: Similar to dbCreateConn, except the master terminal is defined by t_name instead of being specified by the master terminal's dbObject.

functions.name: dbCreateConnByNewName
functions.syntax: dbCreateConnByNewName(  d_net  d_inst  t_name  )  => d_instTerm / nil
functions.description: Similar to dbCreateConnByName, except t_name can refer to a master terminal to be created in the master cellview of instance d_inst.

functions.name: dbCreateCoverObstruction
functions.syntax: dbCreateCoverObstruction( d_prBoundaryId x_topLayerMaskNumber [ g_allowPGNet ] ) => d_coverObstructionId / nil
functions.description: Creates a cover obstruction object associated with the specified prBoundary object.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedAreaBoundary
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a curved area boundary in the specified cellview, using the specified points.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedPath
functions.syntax: dbCreateCurvedPath( d_cellViewId  txl_layerPurpose  l_curvedPoints x_width ) => d_curvedPathId
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a curved path that has a straight centerline and round edges at all segments.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedPolygon
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a curved polygon.

functions.description: Creates a custom viaVariant in cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateDonut
functions.syntax: dbCreateDonut(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose  l_point  x_outR  x_holeR  )  => d_donut / nil
functions.description: Creates a donut (two concentric circles).

functions.description: Creates an ellipse.

functions.description: Creates an enumerated property for an object.

In this case, for each parameter the function creates an explicit local user property on the instance, even if its value is the same as the default on the master.

functions.name: dbCreateFigGroup

functions.description: Creates a group of the specified group definition in the specified cellview. If a group definition is not specified, a traditional, unrestricted group is created, which allows all types of objects and all types of groups as members and can exist in any database.

functions.description: Creates a guide based on the specified parameters.

functions.name: dbCreateInPlaceCoverObstruction

functions.description: Creates an instance terminal on the instance d_inst for the master terminal d_term.

functions.name: dbCreateInstTermByPosition
functions.syntax: dbCreateInstTermByPosition( d_netId d_instId x_position ) => d_instTermId / nil

functions.description: Creates a marker object in the specified cellview.

functions.description: Creates a parameterized cell instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateParamInstByMasterName
functions.syntax: dbCreateParamInstByMasterName(  d_cellView  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_name  l_origin  l_orient  [ x_numInst  [ l_params  [ g_physOnly ] ] ] )  => d_inst / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance of the specified Pcell master in the specified cellview. The parameters in the parameter list may be CDF parameters. If the value is different from the default, the function stores the value as a local property on the instance.

functions.description: Creates a trunk connect pattern on the specified topology with the specified start and end trunks.

functions.name: dbCreateTwig
functions.description: Creates a twig pattern on the specified trunk.

functions.name: dbCreateUniqueNamedNet
functions.syntax: dbCreateUniqueNamedNet(  d_cellView  t_prefix  x_numBits  )  => d_net / nil
functions.description: Creates a new net with a unique name.

functions.name: dbCreateVectorInstDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateVectorInstDef( d_cellviewId t_baseName t_bitOrder ) => d_vectorInstDefId / nil
functions.description: Creates a vector instance definition with specified bit order and base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateVia
functions.syntax: dbCreateVia( d_cellviewId d_viaDefId l_point t_orient [ l_paramList ] ] ) => d_viaId / nil
functions.description: Creates a custom or standard via according to the specified viaDef type and the optional parameter list

functions.name: dbCreateViaShapeArray
functions.syntax: dbCreateViaShapeArray(  d_techCVId  g_viaLayer  [ d_netId ]  f_x  f_y  f_xPitch  f_yPitch  f_w  f_length  x_row  x_column  )  => l_xy / nil
functions.description: Creates an array of via shapes (rectangles) on the given layer in the technology cellview and adds all the shapes to the given net.

functions.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingPattern
functions.syntax: dbCreateWidthSpacingPattern(  d_cellView t_name l_patternSpecs [ n_offset ] [ g_repeatOffset ] [ g_shiftColor ] [ t_allowedRepeatMode ] [ t_defaultRepeatMode ] ) => d_widthSpacingPattern / nil
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup
functions.syntax: dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup( d_cellView t_name l_patternNames ) => d_widthSpacingPatternGroup / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Creates a group of width spacing patterns in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor
functions.syntax: dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor( d_cellView t_name l_patternSpecs t_startingColor [ n_offset ] [ g_repeatOffset ] [ t_allowedRepeatMode ] [ t_defaultRepeatMode ] ) => d_widthSpacingPattern / nil
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern in the specified cellview. This function requires you to specify the color for only the first track, referred to as the starting color. All other tracks are colored automatically by shifting colors.

functions.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef(  d_cellViewId  t_name (tx_layer [tx_purpose]) t_direction n_period t_defaultActivePattern [ l_snappingLayers ] [ n_offset ] [ l_patternNames ] [ l_patternGroupNames ] [ g_gridType ] ) => widthSpacingSnapPatternDefId / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Creates a widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateXformPCell
functions.description: Creates a new Pcell supermaster with the additional parameters: mag and angle. The new Pcell is used in emulating magnification and any-angle rotation of instances. If the source cellview is maskLayout, the Pcell cell name is same as that of the source cellview, with _xform appended to it, otherwise, the viewName is similarly renamed. This Pcell creates an instance of the source cellview, flattens it, and then transforms all the resultant shapes by adding the parameters mag and angle. If the Pcell supermaster already exists, it is opened as read-only, and the cellview ID is returned.

functions.name: dbDebugStats2
functions.syntax: dbDebugStats2(  [ d_cellViewId ] [ x_segNum ]  [ g_objName ]  [ g_outputFileName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Lists memory used by every cellview in virtual memory, memory used by a specified cellview, content of a specified segment of the cellview, and number of objName objects in the specified segment or cellview.

functions.name: dbDefineProc
functions.description: Changes the cellview specified by the d_cellView to be a parameterized cell. The specified file name should be the name of a file containing un-encrypted SKILL code defining procedure pcGenCell. The cellview should have a hierarchical property named parameters, which should be a hierarchical property list containing the default values for the parameters.

functions.name: dbDeleteAllNet
functions.description: Deletes all nets from a cellview.

functions.name: dbDeleteAllTerminalAntennaRules
functions.description: Deletes all antenna rules from the specified terminal.

functions.name: dbDeleteEmptyNet
functions.description: Deletes a net that is not associated with other objects.

functions.name: dbDeleteFigSetGroup
functions.description: Deletes the specified FigSetGroup, including the hierarchy of FigSetGroups that may exist in this FigSetGroup.

functions.name: dbDeleteGroupByName
functions.description: Deletes a group and its members from a cellview.

functions.name: dbDeleteGroupMemberFromGroup
functions.description: Deletes a particular group member from the group to which it belongs.

functions.name: dbDeleteHierCache
functions.description: Deletes the hierarchical cache file for the specified cellview, if the cache file exists.

functions.name: dbDeleteObject
functions.description: Deletes one of the following objects: shapes, nets, terminals, instance terminals, pins, instance pins, mosaics, instances, mosaic instances, properties, groups, and group members. Any other object type produces an error.

functions.name: dbDeleteObjectFromGroup
functions.description: Deletes an object from a group.

functions.name: dbDeletePropByName
functions.description: Deletes a property from an object.

functions.name: dbDeleteSigNetExpr
functions.description: Given a signal IDin d_sigId, this function deletes any existing inherited net expression associated with this signal and removes it from the set of inherited signals.

functions.name: dbDeleteStrap
functions.description: Deletes the specified strap pattern.

functions.name: dbDeleteTermNetExpr
functions.description: Given d_termId, this function deletes any existing inherited net expression associated with this terminal and removes it from the set of inherited terminals.

functions.name: dbDeleteTerminalAntennaRuleOnLayer
functions.syntax: dbDeleteTerminalAntennaRuleOnLayer(  d_termId  t_modelName t_dataName tx_layer ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the antenna rule of the terminal according to the specified antenna model name, antenna data name, and layer.

functions.name: dbDeleteTerminalAntennaRules
functions.syntax: dbDeleteTerminalAntennaRules(  d_termId  t_modelName  t_dataName l_antennaValueLayerPairs ) => t / nil
functions.description: Delete the antenna rules of a terminal according to the model name, data name, and value layer pairs.

functions.name: dbDeleteTopology
functions.description: Deletes the specified topology, which includes removing the association it has with the net, and deleting the associated trunk, trunk connect pattern, and strap pattern.

functions.name: dbDeleteTrunk
functions.description: Deletes the specified trunk pattern and objects associated with that pattern, such as trunk connects and twigs.

functions.name: dbDeleteTrunkConnect
functions.description: Deletes the specified trunk connect pattern, which includes removing the association the pattern has with the topology, and deleting associated trunks.

functions.name: dbDeleteTwig
functions.description: Deletes the twig pattern.

functions.name: dbDeleteWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Deletes the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object.

functions.name: dbDestroyInPlaceCoverObstruction
functions.description: Destroys an InPlaceCoverObstruction object on the given instance header.

functions.name: dbDetachPRBoundaryFromRowRegion
functions.description: Detaches the PRBoundary from any associated rowRegion.

functions.name: dbDisableCellViewCounter
functions.description: Disables updates to the modifiedCounter attribute of the cellview.

functions.name: dbDumpPcDefinePcell
functions.description: Writes out three lists to the file specified: The first list is a list of library names, cell names, and view names of the given cellview ID; the second list is of the parameter value; the last list is the SKILL procedure attached to the given cellview ID.

functions.name: dbDumpPcell
functions.syntax: dbDumpPcell(  d_cvId  t_outputFile t_pCellFile  )  => t / nil
functions.description: The dbDumpPcell function is used in the implementation of the keepPcell option, during streamIn and streamOut. Pcells are preserved by writing the Pcells to SKILL files (during StreamOut) which are loaded back into CDB/Virtuoso (during StreamIn).

functions.name: dbDumpPcellWithLib
functions.syntax: dbDumpPcellWithLib(  d_cvId  t_outputFile t_pCellFile  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Same functionality as dbDumpPcell, which preserves Pcells through StreamIn and StreamOut by writing the Pcells to SKILL files. dbDumbPcellWithLib does not directly write the library name in the SKILL code, instead writes a SKILL variable, dbD_NewLibNameForDump whose value can be set to the name of the target library before loading the SKILL file.

functions.name: dbEnableCellViewCounter
functions.description: Enables updating of the cellview's timestamp counter.

functions.name: dbEnableUndo
functions.description: Enables undo and redo operations in a Virtuoso session.

functions.name: dbEvalParamCell
functions.description: Evaluates the supermaster; the parameters on all the instance headers are fixed, and the submasters are evaluated.

functions.name: dbExpandToMemNameExpr
functions.description: Expands a bundle name to a list of member-name-expression strings.

functions.name: dbExternallyConnectPins
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. External connections are modeled by pinFigs on Pins on Terms in the same MustJoin set.

functions.name: dbFeaturePrintInfo
functions.description: Lists information about the features that are being used in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbFigGroupQuery

functions.description: Returns a list of all the figGroups in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbFindAbutFig

functions.name: dbFindAnyInstByName
functions.description: Retrieves an instance or mosaic.

functions.name: dbFindAreaBoundaryByName
functions.description: Finds the area boundary specified by name and cellview ID.

functions.name: dbFindBusNetDefByName
functions.description: Searches for a bus net definition with specified base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbFindBusTermDefByName
functions.description: Searches for a bus term definition with specified base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbFindClusterBoundaryByName
functions.description: Finds the cluster boundary specified by name.

functions.name: dbFindClusterByName
functions.description: Searches for a cluster in the specified cellview with the specified name.

functions.name: dbFindFigSetGroup
functions.description: Searches the specified cellview for a FigSetGroup that has the same name as the specified FigSet.

functions.name: dbFindFigSetGroupByName
functions.description: Searches for the specified FigSetGroup name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbFindMemInstByName
functions.syntax: dbFindMemInstByName(  d_cellView  t_name  )  => ( d_inst x_index ) / nil
functions.description: Retrieves an instance or mosaic and returns its member index.

functions.name: dbFindMosaicByName
functions.description: Returns a mosaic ID if a mosaic with the given name is found in the cellview specified.

functions.name: dbFindNetByName
functions.description: Retrieves a net in a cellview.

functions.name: dbFindOpenBag
functions.description: Finds an opened bag in virtual memory for the specified d_ddId.

functions.name: dbFindOpenCellView
functions.syntax: dbFindOpenCellView(  g_libId  t_cellName  t_viewName  [ t_version ]  )  => d_cellViewId / nil
functions.description: Finds an opened cellview.

functions.name: dbFindOpenCellViewByName
functions.syntax: dbFindOpenCellViewByName( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => d_cellViewId / nil
functions.description: Finds an opened cellview. Cadence recommends using this function instead of dbFindOpenCellView because you do not have to retrieve the database ID of the library.

functions.name: dbFindPinGroupGuideByName
functions.description: Searches for the pin group guide with the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbFindProp
functions.description: If a property of the given name is found on the object specified, d_propId of the property is returned; otherwise, nil is returned. This function has the same functionality as dbGetPropByName.

functions.name: dbFindRelatedSnapPatterns
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the group of related snap patterns with the specified name in the given cellview and technology library.

functions.name: dbFindRowByName

functions.name: dbFindRowRegion
functions.description: Searches for a rowRegion by the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbFindRowRegionSpec
functions.description: Searches for a rowRegionSpec with the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbFindSigByAlias
functions.description: Finds a signal in a cellview by an alias.

functions.name: dbFindSigByName
functions.description: Finds a signal in a cellview.

functions.name: dbFindTermByName
functions.description: Finds a terminal in a cellview.

functions.name: dbFindTermByPosition
functions.description: Finds the terminal assigned to specific position.

functions.name: dbFindVectorInstDefByName
functions.description: Searches for a vector instance definition with specified base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbFindViaHeaderByName
functions.description: Takes a viaDef name and returns a viaHeader that references that viaDef. The returned viaHeader is always the superHeader. The only exception is for a custom viaDef whose master is not parameterized.

functions.name: dbFindViaVariantByName
functions.description: Finds the viaVariant in a cellview.

functions.name: dbFindWidthSpacingPattern
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the width spacing pattern with the given name in the specified cellview and technology library.

functions.name: dbFindWidthSpacingPatternGroup
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the width spacing pattern group with the specified name in the given cellview and technology library.

functions.name: dbFindWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefByName
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the given widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbFix
functions.description: Fixes data corruption in inherited connectivity, rectangle, and instance header. This is a no-op function.

functions.name: dbFixParamCell
functions.description: Fixes the parameterized cell for which the reading, binding, or evaluation has failed, by re-defining it with a different SKILL procedure defined in t_fileName.

functions.name: dbFlattenInst
functions.syntax: dbFlattenInst( d_instId x_levels [ g_flattenPCells ] [ g_preservePins ] [ g_preserveRODobjs ] [ g_delDetachedBlockages ]  [ g_preservePinFigs ]  [ g_preserveTermName ] [ g_flattenVias ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Flattens instance d_instId up through x_levels of hierarchy. The dbFlattenInst function flattens mosaics as well as normal instances. To flatten a mosaic, pass the mosaicId to dbFlattenInst.

functions.syntax: dbFlattenInst2( d_instId x_levels [ g_options ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Flattens an instance up through x_levels of hierarchy along with an optional set of flatten options. dbFlattenInst2 flattens mosaics as well as normal instances.

functions.name: dbFlattenRowRegion
functions.description: Flattens the rowRegion by removing information related to the associated figGroup and areaBoundary, and retaining information related to rows and other shapes.

functions.name: dbFreeze
functions.syntax: dbFreeze(  d_topCellViewId t_regLibName t_pcellLibName [ g_cleanUp ] ) => d_figGroupId / nil
functions.description: Freezes a Pcell design hierarchy into a non-Pcell design hierarchy by converting a Pcell instance into a static instance and converting a Pcell customVia into a static customVia. If t_regLibName and t_pcellLibName are different, regular and Pcell frozen instances will be put into two different libraries.

functions.name: dbFullLibPath
functions.description: Returns the full library path of the specified library.

functions.name: dbFullPath
functions.description: Returns the full path of a cellview.

functions.name: dbGetAllTrimFillShapes
functions.description: Returns a list of database IDs of all shapes present in the specified cellview with a valid trim fill type.

functions.name: dbGetAnyInstSwitchMaster
functions.description: Switches into a different view of a master cell instance and opens the corresponding cellview.

functions.name: dbGetAnyTermGroundSensitivity
functions.syntax: dbGetAnyTermGroundSensitivity( d_termId [ g_all ] ) => d_groundTermId | l_groundTermId / nil
functions.description: Returns ground sensitivity terminal information for the specified terminal. This terminal can be a multi-bit terminal.

functions.name: dbGetAnyTermSupplySensitivity
functions.syntax: dbGetAnyTermSupplySensitivity( d_termId [ g_all ] ) => d_supplyTermId | l_supplyTermId / nil
functions.description: Returns the supply sensitivity terminal information for the specified terminal. The terminal can be a multi-bit terminal.

functions.name: dbGetAreaBoundaryLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Returns the value of the layerPriorityOrder constraint that is set on the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbGetAreaBoundaryPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Returns the pin group guide associated with the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbGetAreaBoundaryValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Returns the value of the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbGetAreaPinGroupGuideAreas
functions.description: Returns the list of area boundaries associated with the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbGetBackgroundDefAttr
functions.description: Returns the attributes of the specified backgroundDef.

functions.name: dbGetBag

functions.name: dbGetBagDdId

functions.name: dbGetBagOwner
functions.description: Returns the owner of the specified property bag. The owner could be a library, cell, or view.

functions.name: dbGetBagTimeStamp
functions.description: Returns the last time that the bag was modified.

functions.name: dbGetBlockageColor
functions.description: Returns the color assigned to the given blockage. The default color type is grayColor.

functions.name: dbGetBuildInfo
functions.description: Returns the OpenAccess release number, the tarkit revision number, and the date and machine on which the database was built.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the active wire types on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewActiveWireTypesForWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the active wire types on the specified cellview for a given widthSpacingSnapPatternDef.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewBackgroundDef
functions.description: Returns list of backgroundDefs in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: This function returns a list of compTypeSetDef objects defined in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewCounter
functions.description: Gets the timestamp counter value for the cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewDdId
functions.description: Returns a ddId associated with the cellViewId. This ddId contains the path to the library, cell, view, and file name.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewEEQMaster
functions.description: Returns the value of the EEQmaster attribute of the cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Retrieves the equivalent connectivity time that is set on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewFigSetGroups
functions.description: Returns a list of FigSetGroups in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewInheritedSig
functions.description: Retrieves from the given cellview all signals to which inherited net expressions are attached.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewInheritedTerm
functions.description: Retrieves from the given cellview all terminals to which inherited net expressions are attached.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewNetVoltageRange
functions.description: Returns the default minimum and maximum net voltages on the specified cellview ID.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewPlaceArea
functions.description: Returns a list of custom placeAreas in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewRailDef
functions.description: Returns a list of railDef objects defined in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewRowRegionSpecs
functions.description: Returns a list of rowRegionSpecs in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewRowRegions
functions.description: Returns a list of rowRegions in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewSymmetry
functions.description: Returns the symmetry of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetCellViewTopologies
functions.description: Returns a list of topologies in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbGetColorModel
functions.description: Returns a string value of the color model constraint for the specified cellview. Possible values are any, layerBased, or locked.

functions.name: dbGetCompTypeSetDefAttr
