functions.description: Changes the application type, help string, or scroll bar attributes of a window. You must register the new application type before setting it with this function.

functions.name: hiSetWindowDefaultPrompt
functions.description: Sets the prompt for the window associated with the given window ID instead of the default SKILL prompt. The function returns either the value of the previously set prompt or nil. If you specify an empty string for t_prompt, the function resets the prompt to the default value, which is the SKILL prompt.

functions.name: hiSetWindowFocus
functions.description: Sets the focus to the window associated with the given window ID.

functions.name: hiSetWindowIcon
functions.description: Sets the icon of a window, which is displayed when the window is minimized. A session window, when minimized, displays the icon of the window that is currently active within it; if the window does not have an icon set, then the session window's icon is displayed.

functions.name: hiSetWindowMenu
functions.description: Associates the given menu with the specified window.

functions.name: hiSetWindowName
functions.description: Sets the window name, which is displayed in the window manager frame of a window. A session window displays the window name of the window that is currently active within it.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeys
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for an application type or window in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeysByAppType
functions.syntax: hiShowBindKeysByAppType( w_window1 t_applicationType [ g_showInheritBindings ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for an application in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeysByWindow
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for a window in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowFieldBorders
functions.description: Displays or hides borders around form fields. Used as a debugging aid to avoid overlapping fields when laying out forms.

functions.name: hiShowListBox
functions.syntax: hiShowListBox( ?name s_listBoxHandle  ?choices lt_listItems  ?callback s_callback  [?title t_listBoxTitle]  [?multipleSelect g_multiSelect] [?value lt_selectedItem] [?appData g_appData] [?applyButton g_applyButton] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a list box. The list box displays a list of strings. The list box can be created so that one item is selectable or multiple items are selectable. While the list box is displayed on the screen, the user may change the items in the list box, or change the item(s) selected. The list box remains on the screen until the user selects OK or Cancel. The list box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

functions.name: hiShowProgressBar
functions.syntax: hiShowProgressBar( w_windowID [ x_totalSteps ] [ x_delay ] [ t_label ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays a progress bar in the status bar of a window, typically in the bottom-right corner. The progress bar displays the progress of a command.

functions.name: hiShowToolbar
functions.description: Displays a hidden toolbar.

functions.name: hiSleep
functions.description: The hiSleep() function is an alias for the ipcSleep function.

functions.name: hiStartGenTextIndex
functions.description: Searches the specified text string from the beginning of the file and returns the first character position of the matching text.

functions.name: hiStartLog
functions.description: Writes a transaction log to a file.

functions.name: hiStoreFormLocation
functions.description: Stores a form location coordinates so that the form can be restored later to the same position.

functions.name: hiStringToIcon
functions.syntax: hiStringToIcon(   a_colorArray  t_iconString  x_width  x_height  )  => l_hiIcon / nil
functions.description: Returns an icon description that can be used in hi functions that accept icons, such as  hiCreatePulldownMenu, hiCreateMenuItem, hiCreateSliderMenuItem, hiCreateButton, hiCreateCyclicField, hiCreateLabel, and hiAddCyclicChoice.

functions.name: hiStroke
functions.description: Mouse callback that initiates a stroke command.

functions.name: hiSwapTreeItemSelectionIcons
functions.description: Swaps the item icon and expanded icon with the selection icon and expanded selection icon respectively for the specified tree item. For information about setting these icons, see hiSetTreeItemIcons.

functions.name: hiSwitchWindowType
functions.syntax: hiSwitchWindowType( w_windowId  t_widgetType t_appType t_help [ g_scroll ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Switches the widget type of a window between graphics, text, or hypertext. The window must be in a session window.

functions.name: hiSync
functions.description: For programs with several GUI-related creation and deletion operations running in a loop, Qt objects deferred to be deleted later may accumulate and affect performance. This function solves this issue by forcing Qt to immediately delete these objects.

functions.name: hiSynchronize
functions.description: Flushes the event queue by calling QApplication::flush().

functions.name: hiTextDisplayString
functions.syntax: hiTextDisplayString( w_windowId  t_text g_erase [ g_dontScrollTop ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Displays a text string in a window.

functions.name: hiTextWidth
functions.description: Determines the width, in pixels, of a string of characters that has a specified font. Returns nil if the font type is not valid.

functions.name: hiToggleAnchorMagnifier
functions.description: Toggles the anchored state of the magnifier to anchored/un-anchored depending upon the current anchored state of the magnifier.

functions.name: hiToggleEnterForm
functions.description: Displays or removes the options form of the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: hiToggleMagnifier
functions.description: Changes the visibility of the magnifier to on/off depending on the current visibility setting of the magnifier.

functions.name: hiToggleMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Turns on magnifier resolution in the canvas if the canvas is not currently using magnifier resolution. Otherwise turns off magnifier resolution.

functions.name: hiTreeAppendItem
functions.description: Adds an item at the end of a tree. To add an item to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItem.

functions.name: hiTreeAppendItems
functions.description: Adds items at the end of a tree. To add items to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItems.

functions.name: hiTreePrependItem
functions.description: Adds an item to the beginning of a tree. To add an item at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItem.

functions.name: hiTreePrependItems
functions.description: Adds items to the beginning of a tree. To add items at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveAllItems
functions.description: Removes all the items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveItem
functions.description: Removes an item from a tree. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems. To remove all the items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveItems
functions.description: Removes the specified items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem; to remove all items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems
functions.description: Deselects all selected items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItem
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableDeselectItem( g_treeField g_item [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects an item in a tree table field. To deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems. To deselect all selected items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItems
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableDeselectItems( g_treeField l_items [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect all items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectAllItems
functions.description: Selects all items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectItem
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableSelectItem( g_treeField g_item [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects an item in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectItems
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableSelectItems( g_treeField l_items [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiUndo
functions.description: Undoes the last user command that modified the database and that has not been undone by a previous hiUndo.

functions.name: hiUndockWindow
functions.description: Undocks a dockable window from a session window. The window is floated. You can dock the window again with hiDockWindow.

functions.name: hiUnmapWindow
functions.description: Removes a window, dockable window, or session window from the screen without closing or destroying it.

functions.name: hiUnregCloseProc
functions.description: Unregisters the closing procedure for a window.

functions.name: hiUnregCurWindowTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters a SKILL function that was registered to be called whenever the current window changes.

functions.name: hiUnregZoomPanProc
functions.description: Unregisters a SKILL procedure that was registered with the hiRegZoomPanProc function and that is called whenever the user uses a zoom, pan, fit, or redraw command in a graphics window.

functions.name: hiUnselectText
functions.syntax: hiUnselectText( w_windowId t_text [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Unhighlights the next occurrence of selected text in the viewfile relative to the cursor position.

functions.name: hiUnselectTextAll
functions.syntax: hiUnselectTextAll w_windowId [ t_text ] [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Unselects all occurrences of the selected text that match with the specified pattern t_text and class x_class in the viewfile. If the search pattern t_text is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text of all classes. If the class x_class is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text that match with the specified pattern t_text. Afterwards, the cursor position is reset to the top of the file. If an empty string is passed for t_text, and x_class is specified, unselects all strings selected in that class

functions.name: hiUnselectTextByLoc
functions.syntax: hiUnselectTextByLoc( w_windowId l_locationPair [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Unhighlights selected text specified as a list of starting and ending location pairs in the given window.

functions.name: hiUnselectTextClass
functions.description: Unhighlights all occurrences of selected text belonging to the specified class.

functions.name: hiUpdate
functions.description: Updates window prompts and application-specific state variables. Especially important if an enterfunction has been canceled in a window that is not the current window.

functions.name: hiUpdateFormBlock
functions.description: Used to reset a form if you have blocked multiple updates with the hiSetFormBlock function. The functions pf hiUpdateFormBlock(r_form) is equivalent to hiSetFormBlock(r_form nil).

functions.name: hiUpdateMagOptions
functions.description: Update and display the Magnifier Options form with the magnifier values that are being used in the current window.

functions.name: hiUpdateTextSelectionColors
functions.description: Redraws all selections visible in the window and updates any colors previously reset with hiSetTextHighlightColor.

functions.name: hiUseMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Alters the movement of the cursor within the canvas.

functions.name: hiUsingMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Returns whether mouse movement in the canvas is set to behave as if the mouse is located within the magnifier.

functions.name: hiVectorPan
functions.syntax: hiVectorPan( [ w_window ]  [ l_refPt ]  [ l_destPt ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Scrolls the view of the design in any direction by specifying two points in user units.

functions.name: hiViewTextFile
functions.syntax: hiViewTextFile( t_file ?winSpec g_winspec ?title g_title ?appName g_appName ?help g_help ?iconPosition l_iconPosition ?deviceMode g_deviceMode ?pluginFactory g_pluginFactory ?fixedFont g_fixedFont )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates a viewfile window, inserts the menu bar, sets the window and icon names, specifies how to load the file in the window, and displays the file in the window.

functions.name: hiViewfile
functions.description: Brings up the Choose a File to View form in which you can specify a file to view and then calls the view function on the file.

functions.name: hiWinConfigModified
functions.description: Checks whether a workspace has been modified since it was last applied to the session window.

functions.name: hiWindowSaveImage
functions.syntax: hiWindowSaveImage( [ ?target g_target ] [ ?path t_path ] [ ?format t_format ] [ ?toplevel g_toplevel ] [ ?quality n_quality ] [ ?delay n_delay ] [ ?timeoutBeep g_timeoutBeep ] [ ?grabFromScreen g_grabFromScreen ] [ ?centralWidget g_centralWidget ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Takes a screen capture of a window, a region, or the entire screen. You can specify the object to capture either through the arguments or, in interactive mode, by selecting it with the mouse.

functions.name: hiWorldViewFit
functions.description: Fits the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewRedraw
functions.description: Redraws the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewZoomIn
functions.description: Zooms into the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewZoomOut
functions.description: Zooms out of the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiZoomAbsoluteScale
functions.syntax: hiZoomAbsoluteScale( [ w_window ]  [ n_scale ]  [ g_ignoreEFunBBox ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Zooms in or out with an absolute scale.

functions.name: hiZoomExpandAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms out by two in the specified window (or current window) expanding the zoom area in the direction of the mouse relative to the center of the window

functions.name: hiZoomExpandAtPoint
functions.syntax: hiZoomExpandAtPoint(  w_window f_zoomFactor l_point ) => t / nil
functions.description: Zooms out the image by keeping the mirror image point of l_point at the same location

functions.name: hiZoomIn
functions.description: Zooms in to a design.

functions.name: hiZoomInAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms into a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomInMagnifier
functions.description: Zooms into the picture in canvas, as opposed to the picture in the magnifier, with the current magnifier zooming factor.

functions.name: hiZoomOut
functions.description: Zoom out of a design.

functions.name: hiZoomOutAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms out of a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomOutMagnifier
functions.description: Backs out one call to the hiZoomInMagnifier command from the stack, similar to an undo action.

functions.name: hiZoomRelativeScale
functions.description: Zooms in or out with a scale relative to the current window.

functions.name: hiZoomWindowAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomWindowAtPoint
functions.syntax: hiZoomWindowAtPoint( w_window f_scale l_point ) => t / nil
functions.description: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point you specify at its current location in the window.

functions.name: iclicCheckOutAndLock
functions.description: Checks out the specified layout license, layout option license, or an appropriate higher-tier license and locks it after successful checkout.

functions.name: isBBox
functions.description: Validates that the given bounding box is properly defined. This function should not be used with Pcells.

functions.name: isLocation
functions.description: Validates that the given point is properly defined.

functions.name: lbuiGetCheckedOutLicenses
functions.description: Returns a list of the licenses consisting of each license feature name and the number of licenses (tokens) checked out.

functions.name: lbuiPrintLicenseUseReport
functions.description: Displays the license usage report (for example: user logins, host names, display time, number of licenses, and license version) in the CIW or the specified output log file.

functions.name: leftEdge
functions.description: Returns the lower left point's X coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

functions.name: lmgrAddMenuItems
functions.syntax: lmgrAddMenuItems(  t_menuName  t_popupSet  l_names  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Appends the named objects to the specified menu. An item can be another menu. Each menu item or menu can be added to only one menu. Likewise, any menu item can appear at most once in every pop-up menu. Menus cannot be added to a pop-up. Pop-ups must remain a flat structure only. Pop-ups cannot be added to menus.

functions.name: lmgrAddToolBarItems
functions.description: Adds menu items with the specified names to the Library Manager toolbar and optionally appends additional items with multiple calls. Item icons can be set using lmgrSetObject.

functions.name: lmgrCreateMenu
functions.description: Creates a structure for a menu, which can be populated with menu items. Once this menu is created, you can install it into the top menu bar or into another parent menu using lmgrAddMenuItems.

functions.name: lmgrCreateMenuItem
functions.syntax: lmgrCreateMenuItem(  t_itemName  t_itemType  l_itemAttributes  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance of a menu item, which should be populated into a single menu. Once this menu item is created, you can install it into a menu using lmgrAddMenuItems().

functions.name: lmgrDefineInits
functions.description: Defines the initialization action to perform when the customization code begins (after parsing the extension file) and the termination action to perform immediately before Library Manager terminates. You must define the callback in the Virtuoso program before it starts. Otherwise, you get an error. No arguments are passed to either callback.

functions.name: lmgrDeleteMenuItems
functions.description: Deletes the named objects from the menu/pop-up hierarchy. The object can be either a single item or an entire menu. There is no recovery or undo from this operation. If you merely wish to temporarily disable the view of an object, consider using lmgrManageMenuItems() instead.

functions.name: lmgrDisplayMessage
functions.description: Displays a string in the Message area on the Library Manager form and appends it to the Library Manager log file. If desired, the message can be written just to the Library Manager log file and not echoed to the user. Ensure that the string is terminated by a newline character, or the string might be confused with the output from other Library Manager commands or other calls to this function.

functions.name: lmgrGetObject
functions.description: Returns a list describing the state of the single named object or nil if the object does not exist. The format of the attribute list will be variable length list of tags (strings) paired with matching values that are either a string or Boolean value.

functions.name: lmgrInsertMenuItems
functions.syntax: lmgrInsertMenuItems(  t_menuItem  t_popupSet  l_names )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts the named objects into the menu directly before the indicated menu item. An object can be an entire menu. Each menu item or menu can be inserted or added to only one menu. Likewise, any menu item can appear at most once in each pop-up menu. Menus can not be inserted (added) to a pop-up. Pop-ups must remain a flat structure only. You cannot insert or add pop-ups to menus. This function is similar to lmgrAddMenuItems(), except in the meaning of the first argument.

functions.name: lmgrLogShowPopup
functions.description: Restores the context for popup menus for Library Manager replay. This function is only intended for supporting replay and cannot be called from other SKILL engine programs. You do not need to use this function directly.

functions.name: lmgrManageMenuItems
functions.description: Manages the named objects (enabling the display of named objects) inside their menu hierarchy and pop-up sets. Objects can be either a single item or an entire menu.

functions.name: lmgrMenuSubsInPopup
functions.description: This API is used only in the Library Manager's cdsLibMgr.il file for menu customization. The named menu may be placed into a sub-menu of a popup menu, which appears on clicking the right mouse button (RMB) in the Library Manager's window that lists the library, cell, and view items being browsed. This will be placed in a sub-popup if the boolean value was set to be true. In addition, menu items tagged for adding to the popup menus are displayed within its menu's sub-popup (if any). Sub-popup menus may be hierarchically nested per menu as they have been setup/defined through the customized menus' hierarchy.

functions.name: lmgrQueryNamedObjects
functions.description: Returns a list containing the names of all menu items in the Library Manager menu named t_menuName.

functions.name: lmgrRemoveToolBarItems
functions.description: Removes the specified items from the given toolbar that were previously added using lmgrAddToolBarItems.

functions.name: lmgrSensitizeMenuItems
functions.description: Sensitizes the named objects (enabling the active state of named objects) inside their menu hierarchy and pop-up sets. Objects can be either a single item or an entire menu.

functions.name: lmgrSetObject
functions.syntax: lmgrSetObject(  t_objName  l_attrList t_iconName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Accepts a list describing the state of the named object. Returns nil if the object does not exist. The format of the attribute list is a variable-length list of tags (strings) paired with matching string or Boolean values.

functions.name: lmgrShowToolBar
functions.description: Displays the specified toolbar when the Library Manager is launched and returns the previous show state specified.

functions.name: lmgrValidateIcon
functions.description: Checks whether an icon file exists in the Library Manager for the specified icon name before creating a menu item.

functions.name: lmgrVerbose
functions.description: Aids in debugging the callbacks registered in the cdsLibMgr.il file. It is possible to get additional informational messages to be shown inshown in the CIW.

functions.name: lowerLeft
functions.description: Returns the lower left point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and assumed to be correct.

functions.name: menuTrigger
functions.description: The menu trigger is called when an application is about to be installed as the current application in a window. At the time the menu trigger is called, all other triggers have already been called, and the window is about to be displayed (or if the window was a previously existing window, about to be refreshed).

functions.name: mouseAddPt

functions.name: mouseAddSelectPt

functions.name: mouseFinishPt
functions.description: Adds the point at the location where you clicked the mouse button to the enter function in the current window and completes the enter function, if possible.

functions.name: mousePopUp

functions.name: mouseSingleSelectPt

functions.name: mouseSubSelectPt

functions.name: mouseUndoPt

functions.name: nrDialogAccept
functions.description: Function logged when a dialog box is accepted, when the Return key is pressed or buttons such as OK, Yes, or Done in the dialog box are clicked. This function is logged only for native Qt dialog boxes. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrGetIndexesFromSelection
functions.description: Expands the specified compact list representing a selection of items from other lists or tree widgets into the corresponding expanded list representation detailing each selected item.

functions.name: nrGetSelectedIndexes
functions.description: Returns a list comprising the selected indexes of lists or tree widgets.

functions.name: nrListColumnMove
functions.syntax: nrListColumnMove( o_listView x_position x_newPosition ) => t / nil
functions.description: Function logged when a column in a list/tree view (created with the Qt QListView class) is moved. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrListColumnSort
functions.description: Function logged when a column in a list/tree view, created with the Qt QListView class, is sorted. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrListItemAction
functions.description: Function logged when the action associated with an item in a list/tree view created with the Qt QListView class is invoked by double-clicking on the item. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrListItemExpand
functions.syntax: nrListItemExpand( o_listView t_listItem g_expandedOrCollapsed ) => t / nil
functions.description: Function logged when an item in a list/tree view created with the Qt QListView class is expanded or collapsed. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrListItemRename
functions.syntax: nrListItemRename( o_listView t_itemName x_columnIndex t_newItemName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Function logged when an item in a list/tree view (created with the Qt QListView class) is renamed. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrResizeWindow
functions.description: Function logged when a window is resized or moved. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrSetCurrentWindow
functions.description: Function logged when the current window is set. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrSetFileFilter
functions.description: Function logged when a file filter is selected in a file dialog box. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrSetWindowVisibility
functions.description: Function logged when a window is displayed, removed from the screen, or iconified. When a window is displayed, the second argument of this function is the string show, when a window is removed, the second argument is hide, and when a window is iconified, the second argument is min. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: nrUpdateMenu
functions.description: Function logged when the contents of a dynamic popup menu are modified. This function is logged for menus derived from the nrReplayPopupMenu class, which is a part of the native Qt replay library. The function is logged whenever the contentsChanged signal is emitted from the menu. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.name: occpClose
functions.description: Closes a properties file without saving unsaved changes.

functions.name: occpCreateProp
functions.syntax: occpCreateProp( t_name  g_value @key (nonInheritable nil) (noEval nil) ) => r_occpProp / nil
functions.description: Creates an occurrence property structure. It is returned from the occpGet<Type>Prop family of functions and provided as an argument to the occpSet<Type>Prop family of functions.

functions.name: occpGetBestProp
functions.syntax: occpGetBestProp( o_occpHandle  h_pathVectorId  t_propName ) => r_occpProp / nil
functions.description: Gets the property information with the highest precedence for the specified occurrence path. The information is based on the occurrence path, the iterated instance, the instance, the cell, and the default properties with the specified name.

functions.name: occpGetBitInstProp
functions.syntax: occpGetBitInstProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName | nil  t_viewName | nil  t_baseInstName  x_bit  t_propName ) => r_occpProp / nil
functions.description: Gets the property information for an iterated instance.

functions.name: occpGetCellProp
functions.syntax: occpGetCellProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName  t_propName ) => r_occpProp / nil
functions.description: Gets the property information for a cell.

functions.name: occpGetDefaultProp
functions.description: Gets default property information from the specified properties file.

functions.name: occpGetInstProp
functions.syntax: occpGetInstProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName | nil  t_viewName | nil  t_instName  t_propName ) => r_occpProp / nil
functions.description: Gets the property information for an instance.

functions.name: occpGetPathProp
functions.syntax: occpGetPathProp( o_occpHandle  h_pathVectorId  t_propName ) => r_occpProp / nil
functions.description: Gets property information for the specified occurrence path.

functions.name: occpOpen
functions.syntax: occpOpen( t_libName  t_cellName t_viewName  t_mode [t_nameSpace [x_iterInstSupport]] ) => o_occpHandle / nil
functions.description: Opens a properties file in the specified configuration view for read or edit. When editing a properties file, include the hdbOpen call before occpOpen and close the properties file before closing the HDB handle.

functions.name: occpRmBitInstProp
functions.syntax: occpRmBitInstProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName | nil  t_viewName | nil  t_baseInstName  x_bit  t_propName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes a property for an iterated instance.

functions.name: occpRmCellProp
functions.syntax: occpRmCellProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName  t_propName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes a cell property.

functions.name: occpRmDefaultProp
functions.description: Removes a default property.

functions.name: occpRmInstProp
functions.syntax: occpRmInstProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName | nil  t_viewName | nil  t_instName  t_propName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes an instance property.

functions.name: occpRmPathProp
functions.syntax: occpRmPathProp( o_occpHandle  h_pathVectorId  t_propName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes an occurrence path property.

functions.name: occpSave
functions.description: Saves a properties file opened with occpOpen and keeps it open. Only saved updates are reflected when other tools access the file.

functions.name: occpSetBitInstProp
functions.syntax: occpSetBitInstProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName | nil  t_viewName | nil  t_baseInstName  x_bit  r_occpProp ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the property information for an iterated instance. The new setting overwrites any existing property setting for the iterated instance.

functions.name: occpSetCellProp
functions.syntax: occpSetCellProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName  r_occpProp ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the property information for a cell. The new setting overwrites any existing property setting for the cell.

functions.name: occpSetDefaultProp
functions.description: Sets the default property information. The new setting overwrites any existing default property setting.

functions.name: occpSetInstProp
functions.syntax: occpSetInstProp( o_occpHandle  t_libName | nil  t_cellName | nil  t_viewName | nil  t_instName  r_occpProp ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the property information for an instance. The new setting overwrites any existing property setting for the instance.

functions.name: occpSetPathProp
functions.syntax: occpSetPathProp( o_occpHandle  h_pathVectorId r_occpProp ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the occurrence path property information. The new setting overwrites any existing occurrence path property setting.

functions.name: pcdbClose
functions.description: Closes a pcdb handle opened with pcdbOpen.

functions.name: pcdbGetIgnoredInstMasterGen
functions.description: Creates a generator that can be used to get a list of ignored instance masters. An ignored instance master is one that is not a sub-design.

functions.name: pcdbGetInstGen
functions.description: Creates an instance generator that can be used to get the instances for a given master.

functions.name: pcdbGetInstMasterGen
functions.description: Creates a generator that can be used to get the masters of a view.

functions.name: pcdbInstMasterCell

functions.name: pcdbInstMasterCellFixed
functions.description: Gets whether a master cell name is fixed.

functions.name: pcdbInstMasterLib
functions.description: Gets the library name for a master.

functions.name: pcdbInstMasterLibFixed
functions.description: Gets whether a master's library name is fixed.

functions.name: pcdbInstMasterView
functions.description: Gets the view name for a master.

functions.name: pcdbInstMasterViewFixed
functions.description: Gets whether a master's view name is fixed.

functions.name: pcdbInstName
functions.description: Gets the instance name for an instance.

functions.name: pcdbInstWidth
functions.description: Gets the instance width for an instance.

functions.name: pcdbNextInst
functions.description: Gets the next instance from an instance generator.

functions.name: pcdbNextInstMaster
functions.description: Gets the next master from a master generator.

functions.name: pcdbOpen
functions.syntax: pcdbOpen( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_mode [ ?nameSpace t_nameSpace ] [ ?dontOpenNextLevel g_dontOpenNextLevel ] ) => h_pcdbHandle / nil
functions.description: Opens a configuration and gets a handle that will allow access to the parent/child data for a view.

functions.name: pcdbSave
functions.description: Save a pcdb handle opened with pcdbOpen. This function is currently not useful. It would require other functions that would modify a pcdb handle that do not currently exist.

functions.name: pcdbViewHasPcdbInfo
functions.syntax: pcdbViewHasPcdbInfo( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewname  [ t_nameSpace ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether the specified view has pcdb information. If t_nameSpace is not provided, t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName are assumed to be in the name space.

functions.name: perfDiagInstall
functions.syntax: perfDiagInstall g_RdOnly [ ?openCallstack g_openCallstack | ?loadOnly g_loadOnly ] => t / nil
functions.description: Installs the Performance Diagnosis tools and places its submenu under the Tools menu in CIW. You can use this tool to diagnose various performance issues in Virtuoso custom IC design platform, typically starting with the PerfDiagnosis control form to record callstacks.

functions.name: perfRefreshControl
functions.description: Refreshes the Health Monitor form to apply the changes made using the Performance Diagnostic environment variables.

functions.name: perfStartCallStackProc
functions.description: Starts collecting the callstacks using the Health Monitor tool.

functions.name: perfStopCallStackProc
functions.description: Stops the Health Monitor tool from collecting the callstacks.

functions.name: pgssDRC
functions.syntax: pgssDRC( d_cellviewID t_rulesFile t_layerMap t_objectMap l_options g_function )  => t / nil
functions.description: Launches Pegasus DRC and processes the generated shapes in accordance with the specified function. The pgssDRC SKILL function needs Pegasus license.

functions.name: phoAddWaveguidePorts
functions.syntax: phoAddWaveguidePorts(  ccPath  t_startPortName  t_startPortDirection  t_endPortName  t_endPortDirection  [ ?n_portPinWidth n_portPinWidth ] ) => l_port / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Adds circular optical ports at both ends of a ccPath. The ports have the same layer-purpose pair as the ccPath. For both start and end ports, the net, terminal, and pin names use the specified port name. Terminal direction is taken from the corresponding portDirection argument.

functions.name: phoBendConnector
functions.syntax: phoBendConnector( d_cellViewId t_waveguideLayer [ ?rotation n_rotation [ ?offset l_offset [ ?full g_full [ ?startPortName t_PortName [ ?endPortName t_PortName ] [ ?startPortDirection t_Direction ] [ ?endPortDirection t_Direction ]  [ ?width f_width  ] [ ?taperStyle  s_taperStyle ] [ ?startWidth f_width ] [ ?endWidth f_width ] [ ?taperStartClamp n_length ] [ ?taperEndClamp n_length ] [ ?angle f_angle ] [ ?radius f_radius ] [ ?arcPart f_arcPart ] [ ?Rmin f_Rmin ] [ ?modeSpec l_1_modeSpec ] [ ?modePropOnly g_modePropOnly ] [ ?portPinPurpose t_portPinPurpose ] [ ?waveguideDefPurpose t_waveguideDefPurpose ] ) =>  l_dpl / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Photonics Only) Returns a bend connector that connects two port points on the same circle with angles equal to the angles of the tangents on that circle. The bend connector is described by the bend radius of the circle and the bend angle of the arc of that circle. In its simplest form, a bend connector consists of a single circular arc segment.

functions.name: phoCompose
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Composes the specified list of waveguides into a composite of the specified master.

functions.name: phoComputeModeProps
functions.syntax: phoComputeModeProps( o_occPath n_waveLength n_temperature t_mode [ valueFlags l_valueFlags ] [ alpha n_alpha ] ) => l_values / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Computes the path length and average values for the selected mode properties along the center line of the given path

functions.name: phoCreatePort
functions.syntax: phoCreatePort( d_cellViewId l_lpp t_x t_y t_portDirection  t_netName t_termName t_pinName n_width n_angle n_radius [ n_portWidth ] [ n_portHeight ] => d_portShape / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a physical connection point (port) for an optical net on layer type waveguide. The area of the optical port is used to trigger auto-abutment of the instances to ensure that the ports with matching attributes (layer, angle, or width) are positioned to avoid any cuts between the facets.

functions.name: phoCurveDeltaConnector
functions.syntax: phoCurveDeltaConnector( g_cellViewId S_waveguideLayer [ ?rotation n_rotation ] [ ?offset l_offset ] [ ?full g_full ] [ ?startPortName t_PortName ] [ ?endPortName t_PortName ] [ ?startPortDirection t_Direction ] [ ?endPortDirection t_Direction ]  [ ?width f_width ] [ ?deltaX f_deltaX ] [ ?deltaY f_deltaY ] [ ?startPortAngle f_startPortAngle ] [ ?endPortAngle f_endPortAngle ] [ ?taperStyle  s_taperStyle ] [ ?startWidth f_width ] [ ?endWidth f_width ] [ ?taperStartClamp n_length ] [ ?taperEndClamp n_length ] [ ?startPortRadius f_startPortRadius ] [ ?endPortRadius f_endPortRadius ] [ ?modeSpec l_1_modeSpec ] [ ?modePropOnly g_modePropOnly ] [ ?portPinPurpose t_portPinPurpose ] [ ?Rmin n_Rmin ] [ ?method x_method ] [ ?costFunction l_costFunction ] ) => l_dpl / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Photonics Only) Returns a delta connector, defined by deltaX, deltaY, and facet angles. The connector calculates the curve to connect the start and end with their respective angles according to the passed parameters.

functions.name: phoDrawBendConnectorSymbol
functions.syntax: phoDrawBendConnectorSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?startPortName s_PortName ?startPortDirection s_direction ?endPortName s_PortName ?endPortDirection s_direction ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Draws a bend connector symbol.

functions.name: phoDrawCWLaserSymbol
functions.syntax: phoDrawCWLaserSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?startPortName s_PortName ?startPortDirection s_direction ) => t / nil

functions.name: phoDrawCompWaveguideLayout
functions.syntax: phoDrawCompWaveguideLayout( d_cellViewId  l_waveguideDevice  [ ?rotation n_rotation ]  [ ?offset l_offset ]  [ ?full g_full ] [ ?startPortName t_PortName ]  [ ?endPortName t_PortName ] [ ?startPortDirection t_Direction ]  [ ?endPortDirection t_Direction ] [ ?width n_width ] [ ?modeSpec l_1_modeSpec ] [ ?portPinPurpose t_portPinPurpose ] [ ?instPrefix ? t_instPrefix ]  ) => l_dpl / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Photonics Only) Returns a composite waveguide connector that takes a list of waveguide cells, such as the straight or the bend and creates a unique component. Each device can optionally have its own parameter set applied, such as tapering and width.

functions.name: phoDrawCompWaveguideSymbol

functions.syntax: phoDrawDCSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?addPortName s_PortName ?addPortDirection s_direction ?dropPortName s_PortName ?endPortDirection s_direction ?inPortName s_PortName ?inPortDirection s_direction ?thruPortName s_PortName ?thruPortDirection s_direction ) => t / nil

functions.syntax: phoDrawPhotoDiodeBBSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?Port1Name s_PortName ?Port1Direction s_direction ?cathodeName s_name ?cathodeDirection s_direction ?anodeName s_name ?anodeDirection s_direction ) => t / nil

functions.syntax: phoDrawStraightModulatorSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?startPortName s_PortName ?startPortDirection s_direction ?endPortName s_PortName ?endPortDirection s_direction ?cathodeName s_name ?cathodeDirection s_direction ?anodeName s_name ?anodeDirection s_direction ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Draws a straight modulator symbol.

functions.name: phoDrawStraightWaveguideSymbol
functions.syntax: phoDrawStraightWaveguideSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?startPortName s_PortName ?startPortDirection s_direction ?endPortName s_PortName ?endPortDirection s_direction ?thermalTerm1Name s_name ?thermalTerm1Direction s_direction ?thermalTerm2Name s_name ?thermalTerm2Direction s_direction ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Draws a straight waveguide symbol. You can add an optional thermal device to the display and ports of the symbol.

functions.name: phoDrawWayPointConnectorSymbol
functions.syntax: phoDrawWayPointConnectorSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?startPortName s_PortName ?startPortDirection s_direction ?endPortName s_PortName ?endPortDirection s_direction ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Draws a waypoint connector symbol.

functions.name: phoDrawYSplitterSymbol
functions.syntax: phoDrawYSplitterSymbol( d_cellViewId n_magnification ?startPortName s_PortName ?startPortDirection s_direction ?endPortName1 s_PortName ?endPortDirection1 s_direction ?endPortName2 s_PortName ?endPortDirection2 s_direction ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Draws a Y splitter symbol.

functions.name: phoGenWaveguide
functions.syntax: phoGenWaveguide( o_path [ ?excludeLayers l_excludeLayers ] [ ?derivedShapeSpecs l_derivedShapeSpecs ] ) => l_paths / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Generates a list of derived ccShapes for the specified ccPath, using the waveguide definition of the layer-purpose pair of the specified ccPath. The derived shapes on the layers listed in excludeLayers are skipped during the generation. For derived shapes of type offset with inner value, the inner edge of the generated derived shape is coincident with the centerline of the path.

functions.name: phoGetConnectorAnchors
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Reads the supported optical nets connected to the instance terminals of an instance to return the information about the start and end anchor points for an associated connector waveguide. A connector waveguide has exactly two directed optical ports.

functions.name: phoHiCompose
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Uses a list of waveguide building blocks that are abutted into a single chain and creates a composite waveguide using these building blocks. The instances used for building the composite waveguide could be bound or unbound at the time of waveguide creation, but all the source waveguide instances must originally be bound to the same schematic instance. The composite waveguide is created at the same location as the source waveguide instances and is bound to the same schematic instance as the source instances.

functions.name: phoHiDecompose
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Uses a list of composite waveguides or a single composite waveguide and flattens the waveguide to bring the instances inside to the current level. The newly separated waveguide building blocks are bound to the original schematic composite in a complex binding. The instances of the waveguide building blocks are abutted together into a chain and the chain has the same input and output connectivity as the original composite waveguide.

functions.name: phoHiEditCompositeWG
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Opens the Composite Waveguide Editor for the currently selected instance. The editor is displayed only when a single composite waveguide instance is selected. The editor, once open, needs to be manually closed.

functions.name: phoIsWaveguide
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks whether the specified master cellview or the library cellview is of type waveguide.

functions.name: phoOMGetObject
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Retrieves the list of information required to register an optical monitor menu item in the Virtuoso Schematic Editor contextual menu. The function call must be made inside the optical monitor, otherwise the information returned is not reliable.

functions.name: phoRegisterInstTermOpticalMonitorMenuItem
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Registers the callback function to add an optical monitor to the Virtuoso Schematic Editor contextual menu. Optical monitors are used to setup a simulation and plot for complex mathematical optical signals. This function can be called at any time in the code. However, calling it several times with the same name string overrides the previously stored callback for that menu item and causes a warning to be displayed in the CIW.

functions.name: phoSineDeltaConnector
functions.syntax: phoSineDeltaConnector( d_cellViewId t_waveguideLayer [ ?rotation n_rotation ] [ ?offset l_offset ] [ ?full g_full ] [ ?startPortName t_PortName ] [ ?endPortName t_PortName ] [ ?startPortDirection t_Direction ] [ ?endPortDirection t_Direction ] [ ?waveguidePurpose t_waveguidePurpose ] [ ?startPortAngle f_startPortAngle ] [ ?endPortAngle f_endPortAngle ] [ ?deltaX f_deltaX ] [ ?deltaY f_deltaY ] [ ?taperStyle  s_taperStyle ] [ ?startWidth n_width ] [ ?endWidth f_width ] [ ?taperStartClamp f_length ] [ ?taperEndClamp f_length ] [ ?modeSpec l_1_modeSpec ] [ ?modePropOnly l_modePropOnly ] [ ?portPinPurpose t_portPinPurpose ] [ ?waveguideDefPurpose t_waveguideDefPurpose ] ) => l_dpl / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Photonics Only) Creates a curvy sineDelta connector defined by deltaX and deltaY. Facet angles need to be opposite (difference of 180 degrees). The connector calculates the curve to connect the start and end with their respective angles according to the passed parameters.

functions.name: phoStraightConnector
functions.syntax: phoStraightConnector( d_cellViewId t_waveguideLayer [ ?rotation n_rotation ] [ ?offset l_offset ] [ ?full g_full ] [ ?startPortName t_PortName ] [ ?endPortName t_PortName ] [ ?startPortDirection t_Direction ] [ ?endPortDirection t_Direction ] [ ?length f_length ] [ ?width n_width ] [ ?modeSpec l_1_modeSpec ] [ ?modePropOnly l_modePropOnly ] [ ?portPinPurpose t_portPinPurpose ] [ ?taperStyle  s_taperStyle ] [ ?startWidth n_width ] [ ?endWidth f_width ] [ ?autoWide g_autoWide ] [ ?autoWideWideWidth n_wideWideWidth ] [ ?autoWideTaperStyle s_autoWideTaperStyle ] [ ?autoWideMinWideSectionLength n_wideLength ] [ ?autoWideTaperLength n_autoWideTaperLength ] [ ?autoWideTaperAngle n_wideTaperAngle ] [ ?autoWideStubLength n_wideStubLength ] [ ?waveguideDefPurpose t_waveguideDefPurpose ] ) => l_dpl / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Photonics Only) Returns a straight connector with tapering and auto-widening options.

functions.name: phoTechDeleteModePropDataTable
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Deletes the modeProp table for the specified waveguideDef from the given technology database.

functions.name: phoTechGetModePropDataTableParamValues
functions.syntax: phoTechGetModePropDataTableParamValues( d_techDB t_waveguideDefName S_param )  => l_values / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the list of values specified in the modeProp table for the given parameter.

functions.name: phoTechHasModeProp
functions.syntax: phoTechHasModeProp( d_techDB t_waveguideDefName s_param g_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks whether the specified parameter value is present in the modeProp table for the specified waveguide in the specified technology database.

functions.name: phoTechHasModePropDataTable
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks whether the given technology database contains a modeProp table for the given waveguideDef.

functions.name: phoTechIsModePropLocalOnly
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Retrieves the localOnly flag of the modeProp table for the specified waveguideDef. The table is searched only in the local technology database.

functions.name: phoTechLoadModePropDataTable
functions.syntax: phoTechLoadModePropDataTable( d_techID t_path( [ ?waveguideDefName t_waveguideDefName ] [ ?localOnly g_localOnly ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Loads the modeProp table from the specified data file for the given waveguide definition and stores it in the library data.dm file. If no waveguideDef is specified, the modeProp table is loaded for all the waveguide definitions encountered in the data file.

functions.name: phoWayPointConnector
functions.syntax: phoWayPointConnector( d_cellViewId t_waveguideLayer [ ?rotation n_rotation ] [ ?full g_full ] [ ?startPortName t_PortName	 ] [ ?endPortName t_PortName ] [ ?width f_width ] [ ?shapeDataList l_shapeDataList ] [ ?startPortAngle f_startPortAngle	 ] [ ?endPortAngle f_endPortAngle ] [ ?autoWide g_autoWide ] [ ?autoWideWideWidth n_wideWideWidth ] [ ?autoWideMinWideSectionLength n_wideLength ] [ ?autoWideTaperLength n_autoWideTaperLength ] [ ?autoWideTaperAngle n_wideTaperAngle ] [ ?autoWideStubLength n_wideStubLength ] [ ?autoWideTaperStyle s_autoWideTaperStyle ] [ ?arcPart f_arcPart ] [ ?minRadius f_minRadius ] [ ?vfoProtocolClass t_vfoProtocolClass ] [ ?modeSpec l_l_modeSpec ] [ ?modePropOnly l_modePropOnly ] [ ?portPinPurpose t_portPinPurpose	 ] [ ?waveguideDefPurpose t_waveguideDefPurpose ] ) => l_dpl / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Photonics Only) Returns a waypoint connector that connects the start port to the end port by a sequence of straight-line segments and bend connectors. The straight-line segments are defined by a polynomial line through a series of waypoints. This series of waypoints is defined by the key argument ?shapeDataList.

functions.name: pkxAddFuncDefPin
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Adds the specified funcDefPin object to the specified compDefPin object.

functions.name: pkxCreateCompDef
functions.syntax: pkxCreateCompDef( d_bagId t_deviceType t_class t_package )  => pkx_compDefId | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a compDef object in the specified database and returns its ID.

functions.name: pkxCreateCompDefPin
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a compDefPin object and returns its ID.

functions.name: pkxCreateFuncDef
functions.syntax: pkxCreateFuncDef( pkx_compDefId t_slot t_type )  => pkx_funcDefId / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a funcDef object in the specified compDef and returns its ID.

functions.name: pkxCreateFuncDefPin
functions.syntax: pkxCreateFuncDefPin( pkx_funcDefId t_number t_use x_swapCode )  => pkx_funcDefPinId / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a funcDefPin object in the specified funcDef object and returns its ID.

functions.name: pkxDeleteCompDef
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Deletes the specified compDef object.

functions.name: pkxFindCompDef
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Searches for a compDef object in the specified database with the specified device type and returns its ID if it exists.

functions.name: pkxFindCompDefPin
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Searches for a compDefPin object in the specified compDef with the specified attributes, and returns its ID if it exists.

functions.name: pkxFindFuncDef
functions.syntax: pkxFindFuncDef( pkx_compDefId t_slot t_type )  => pkx_funcDefId / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Searches for a funcDef object in the specified compDef with the specified attributes, and returns its ID if it exists.

functions.name: pkxFindFuncDefPin
functions.syntax: pkxFindFuncDefPin( pkx_funcDefId | pkx_compDefPinId t_name t_use s_swapCode )  => pkx_funcDefPinId | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Searches for a funcDefPin object with the specified attributes, either in a funcDef or in a compDefPin, and returns its ID if it exists.

functions.name: pkxGetCompDefPins
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns a list of compDefPin object IDs in the specified database.

functions.name: pkxGetCompDefs
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns a list of compDef object IDs in the specified database.

functions.name: pkxGetFuncDefPins
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns a list of funcDefPin object IDs in the specified database.

functions.name: pkxGetFuncDefs
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns a list of funcDef object IDs in the specified database.

functions.name: pkxGetProp
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns the property of the specified package object and name.

functions.name: pkxGetProps
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns a list of properties for the specified package object.

functions.name: pkxPadFile
functions.syntax: pkxPadFile( t_fileName  t_newFileName  g_magicBytes ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Pads the specified SiP file with so-called magic bytes up front. Magic bytes are a set of bytes that can be added to a SiP file to encrypt it. The import assisted flow takes a SiP file as an input to generate a Virtuoso RF Solution 5x hierarchy. In the process, the original SiP file can be modified incrementally in the assisted export flow. However, to ensure that the original SiP file can be retrieved, it is padded before any modification is done.

functions.name: pkxSetProp
functions.syntax: pkxSetProp( pkx_Obj t_propName S_propType g_propValue )  => pkx_property / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Sets the specified properties on the specified package object.

functions.name: pkxUnPadFile
functions.syntax: pkxUnPadFile( t_fileName  t_newFileName  g_magicBytes ) => t / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Removes the padding from the specified SiP file using magic bytes.

functions.name: postInstallTrigger
functions.description: Enables application to do processing, such as adding menu items to an existing menu, that cannot be done before all other processing is complete, including installation of banner menus and the display of the window.

functions.name: preXY
functions.description: Causes an addPoint( l_point ) command to be added to the command queue in order to be logged and executed at the next toplevel to simulate the user selecting a point.

functions.name: probeTrigger
functions.syntax: probeTrigger(  w_window  s_action  [ w_source ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: The probe trigger is called when the Design Editor has installed a new design in a window, whether an existing one or a new one. It is also called when the window is closed. This trigger allows the probing mechanism to keep its data structures consistent without requiring each application to call it separately.

functions.name: psConfigLoaded
functions.description: Indicates if the.cdsplotinit is already loaded.

functions.name: psLoadCdsPlotInit
functions.description: Indicates if the .cdsplotinit has successfully loaded or not.

functions.name: psQueryPaperSize
functions.description: Returns the dimensions of the specified paper size.

functions.name: psQueryPaperSizes
functions.description: Returns the paper sizes (such as A size) and offset of the paper that the plotter uses.

functions.name: psQueryPlotters
functions.description: Returns a list of plotter names from the loaded .cdsplotinit files.

functions.name: psQueueStatus
functions.description: Displays the plot jobs in the spooling queues.

functions.name: pvsApplyDRC
functions.syntax: pvsApplyDRC d_cellview t_rulesFile t_layerMap t_objectMap l_options g_function )  => t / nil
functions.description: Launches Virtuoso IPVS and process generated shapes.

functions.name: rightEdge
functions.description: Returns the upper right point's X coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

functions.name: setCurrentWindow
functions.description: The setCurrentWindow function is an alias for the hiSetCurrentWindow function.

functions.name: setEFunFlightLineTarget
functions.description: Sets a target point for the enterLine function so that a flight line is drawn from the cursor to this point.

functions.name: startCdsenvEditor
functions.description: Starts Cdsenv Editor.

functions.name: swindow
functions.description: Gets the window ID of a session window.

functions.name: swindowp
functions.description: Checks whether the specified object is a valid session window.

functions.name: topEdge
functions.description: Returns the upper right point's Y coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

functions.name: txAppendObjectToFigSet
functions.description: Appends an object to the end of the specified FigSet. The object can be a figure or a FigSet.

functions.name: txClearFigSet
functions.description: Clears the contents of the specified FigSet.

functions.name: txCloneFigSet
functions.description: Makes FigSet1 a clone of FigSet2 by replacing the contents of FigSet1with equivalent entries from FigSet2. It creates references to the objects; it does not make copies of the objects. The name of FigSet1 is preserved.

functions.name: txConcatFigSet
functions.description: Appends the contents of FigSet2 to the end of FigSet1.

functions.name: txCopyFigSet
functions.description: Copies each figure from the source FigSet and applies to it the specified transform to create a new FigSet with an automatically generated name.

functions.name: txCreateFigSet
functions.description: Creates an empty FigSet with the specified name in the given cellview. If the name is not specified, it will be generated automatically. If a FigSet with the specified name already exists, an error message is issued.

functions.name: txDeleteFigSet
functions.syntax: txDeleteFigSet( T_figSet [ g_deep = nil ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified FigSet. If the optional argument g_deep is set to true, then the FigSets referenced by the specified FigSet will also be recursively deleted.

functions.name: txFindFigSet
functions.description: Searches for a FigSet with the given name in the specified cellview. This function also searches for a FigSetGroup with the same name and automatically resurrects the corresponding FigSet from it, if required.

functions.name: txGetCellViewFigSets
functions.description: Returns the list of FigSets in the specified cellview.

functions.name: txGetFigSetBBox
functions.syntax: txGetFigSetBBox( T_figSet @key (onlyTheseLayers l_onlyTheseLayers) (onlyTheseLPPs l_onlyTheseLPPs) (notTheseLayers l_notTheseLayers) (notTheseLPPs l_notTheseLPPs) (onlyTheseTypes l_onlyTheseTypes) (notTheseTypes l_notTheseTypes) ) => l_bBox / nil
functions.description: Calculates the bounding box for the objects in the specified FigSet. The caller can optionally specify included and excluded layers, included and excluded layer-purpose pairs (LPPs), and included and excluded object types. The bounding box values are returned in user units.

functions.name: txGetFigSetData
functions.description: Returns the nth object from the specified FigSet. This object is either a dbObject (CDB figure) or txObject (a FigSet or a transient shape).

functions.name: txIsFigSet
functions.description: Determines whether the specified object is a FigSet object.

functions.name: txMakeFigSet
functions.description: Creates a FigSet from the given FigSetGroup in the specified cellview.

functions.name: txMoveFigSet
functions.description: Moves each figure in the given FigSet using the specified transform.

functions.name: txPrependObjectToFigSet
functions.description: Inserts an object in the beginning of the specified FigSet. The object may be a figure or a FigSet.

functions.name: txRemoveFigSetData
functions.description: Removes the nth object from the specified FigSet.

functions.name: txRemoveObjectFromFigSet
functions.description: Removes the specified object from the given FigSet, if the object is a member of this FigSet. This object can be a figure or a FigSet.

functions.name: undrawEnterFun
functions.description: Undraws any rubberbanding shapes. Called when an enterfunction is active. If you enter data in the window, rubberbanding resumes.

functions.name: upperRight
functions.description: Returns the upper right point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and is assumed to be correct.

functions.name: userAppTrigger
functions.description: After the application trigger is called, the user application trigger is called with the same argument list. The user application trigger allows clients to subclass existing application triggers, and thus add additional context to that already managed by the application. The user application trigger's return value is ignored, but should indicate t for success and nil for failure.

functions.name: userMenuTrigger
functions.description: The user menu trigger is called just before the application menu trigger is called and performs the same function. This trigger allows the user to attach menus to an application. Although it is called prior to the application menu trigger, the menu list it returns is appended after the application menus.

functions.name: userPostInstallTriggers
functions.description: Called immediately after the post-install trigger. It serves the same function but is intended for use only by the customer.

functions.name: view
functions.syntax: view( t_file [ g_boxSpec ] [ g_title ] [ g_autoUpdate ] [ l_iconPosition ] [ g_deviceMode ] )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates a viewfile window, inserts the menu bar, sets the window and icon names, specifies how to load the file in the window, and displays the file in the window. view is a wrapper function.

functions.name: window
functions.description: Given a window number, gets the window ID.

functions.name: windowp
functions.description: Checks whether the specified object is a valid window.

functions.name: wtypep
functions.description: A predicate function that returns t if g_object is of type window, and nil otherwise.

functions.name: xdvReplaceInstWithVias
functions.syntax: xdvReplaceInstWithVias( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Detects and replaces the via-like instances with standard vias in the existing design across the hierarchy of the given library, cell, and view. The function overwrites the existing design and saves it. New via definitions can be created if the technology file is writable.

functions.name: avSwitch
functions.description: From the rules file, this procedure returns t if the string passed as an argument is a switch name set by the user through the use of the -set option in the ivVerify or LVS commands. Otherwise, avSwitch() returns nil. You can use this procedure to select rules in the rules deck.

functions.name: ivCallProc
functions.description: You can place this command anywhere in the rules file. Placing this command in a DRC rule deck will only provide access to the layout view. Any marker generating rules which execute before the ivCallProc will result in the markers being present in the layout view. It is recommended that markers not be modified though use of the ivCallProc command. Markers stored in the ivEDB error database are not accessable from within an ivCallProc. Depending on where you place this command in an Extract rule deck, it has the following results:

functions.name: ivCompilingFor
functions.description: From the rules file, this procedure returns t if any of the strings passed as arguments contain the constant diva. It is expected that the results of calling the procedure will be used in a SKILL if statement. You can use the SKILL statement to select the Diva rules in a rule deck containing both Diva and Assura rules.

functions.name: ivConcICe
functions.description: Starts the ConcICe RC network reduction section of the layout verification program. Each of the arguments is a keyword preceded by a question mark (?). You must give each keyword a value, as indicated below. The ?cell, ?resModelData, and ?capModelData keywords are required, the other keywords are optional.

functions.name: ivCreatePCells
functions.description: This command creates parameterized versions of existing cells for the display of devices created by the device extraction commands.

functions.name: ivDRC
functions.description: Starts the DRC section of the layout verification program. Each of the arguments is a keyword preceded by a question mark (?). You must give each keyword a value or a symbolic name set to the value.The ?cell argument is required; the other arguments are optional.

functions.name: ivERC
functions.syntax: ivERC(  runDir libName cellName viewName netlist jobPriority rulesFromUnix rulesLibName rulesFilePath machine ) => t / nil
functions.description: Starts the ERC program of the layout verification system. All arguments are required.

functions.name: ivExtract
functions.description: Invokes the Extraction section of the layout verification program. The ?cell argument is required; the other arguments are optional.

functions.name: ivGetCellView
functions.description: From the rules file, this procedure gets the database ID of the layout cellview being processed, from which the cell, library, and techfile can be accessed. Properties associated with these are available for use in the rules.

functions.name: ivLVS
functions.syntax: ivLVS(  runDir layoutLibName layoutCellName layoutViewName netlistLayout  schematicLibName schematicCellName  schematicViewName  netlistSchematic  deviceFixing  noRewire  termCorr  useFileCorr  corrFile  xref  jobPriority rulesFromUnix rulesLibName rulesFilePath machine switches runInBg ) => t / nil
functions.description: Invokes the Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Comparison program of the layout verification system. All arguments are required.

functions.name: ivVerify
functions.syntax: ivVerify ( function [cell] [view]  [-lib library] [-dir directory_name] [-rsf run_specific_rules_name] [-set switch_name] ... [-full] [-hier] [-echo] [-edb directory_name] [-limitRule n] [-limitRun n] [-macro] [-optimize] [-imm] [-inc] [-join] [-area] [-z] [-rl rules_lib_name] [-rf rules_file_name] [-ru unix_file_path] [-extracted] [-excell]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs DRC and extraction from the UNIX environment.

functions.name: iqCreateDummyCell
functions.description: Creates a dummy cell and library when you type this SKILL command, in the Command Interpreter Window (CIW).

functions.name: ediFinishStatus
functions.description: Provides an exit status number when EDIF 200 In is done.

functions.name: edifLayerNumMap
functions.syntax: edifLayerNumMap( t_figureGroup ) => list( t_layerName t_purposeName ) / nil
functions.description: Maps the name of figureGroup specified in the input EDIF file to the layer-purpose pairs in the technology file.

functions.name: edifinDisplay
functions.description: Displays the EDIF 200 In form.

functions.name: edifinMakeRenameString
functions.description: Creates a special string when the string in the EDIF 200 In input file is an illegal name.

functions.name: conn2Sch
functions.syntax: conn2Sch( t_srcLibName t_srcCellName t_srcViewName [ ?destLibName t_destLibName ] [ ?destCellName t_destCellName ] [ ?destViewName t_destViewName ] [ ?block t_block ] [ ?paramFile t_paramFile ] [ ?cdslib t_cdslib ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a schematic view from an imported netlist view.

functions.name: conn2SchImpHdlDisplay
functions.description: Accepts the user interface name of Connectivity-to-Schematic tool as an argument and displays the GUI for the tool.

functions.name: conn2SchStartUp
functions.description: Invokes the graphical user interface of the Connectivity-to-Schematic tool. This is a CIW menu callback function.

functions.name: impHdlDisplay
functions.description: Displays the Verilog In form. Alternatively, in the CIW, choose File - Import - Verilog to open the Verilog In form.

functions.name: hedRegUICustomFunc
functions.description: Registers a UI customization function that gets called when a new Hierarchy Editor window is created.

functions.name: hnlRunPinChecker
functions.syntax: hnlRunPinChecker( t_lib  t_cell t_view [ ?checkAms { t | nil } ] [ ?useHDLPackageSettings { t | nil } ] [ ?compilerOptionFile t_compilerOptionFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the Pin Checker tool from the SKILL interface without launching Virtuoso or the Hierarchy Editor. This is especially helpful when you want to automate the launch of Pin Checker functionality before netlisting or running any simulations.

functions.name: ERC
functions.description: Defines the sequence of steps for performing an Electric Rule Checking (ERC). This function is invoked if you provide no overriding function. It checks the variables, the sequence of steps, such as netlisting (ercNetlist), and calls the ERC program for execution (ercSimout).

functions.name: cat
functions.description: Prints the contents of filename on standard output. The function is defined in /etc/skill/si/simcap.ile. You can modify this function.

functions.name: cdsGetNetlistMode
functions.description: Returns the value of the shell environment variable CDS_Netlisting_Mode that is set in the current shell to invoke Virtuoso.

functions.name: cdsSetNetlistMode
functions.description: Sets netlisting mode, which is based on the current value of the SHELL environment variable CDS_Netlisting_Mode. The valid values for this shell environment variable are Digital, Analog, or Compatibility. The function cdsSetNetlistMode is used in the Virtuoso SKILL environment to update the settings without restarting Virtuoso.

functions.name: fnlAbortNetlist
functions.description: Aborts netlisting. When the formatter detects an error during netlisting, it calls this function to inform the netlister to abort netlisting.

functions.name: fnlCurrentCell
functions.description: Returns the master of the current instance being expanded. This function must be called only during the evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString and NLPcreateModelString properties.

functions.name: fnlCurrentCellCdsName
functions.description: Returns the master cell name of the current instance being expanded. This function corresponds to the netlister-defined BlockName property and must be called only during evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString and NLPcreateModelString properties.

functions.name: fnlCurrentInst
functions.description: Returns the current instance being expanded. This function must be called only during expansion of the NLPcompleteElementString property. Do not use the master field of the resulting instanceId. If you use it, you get the symbol cellview rather than the stopping cellview corresponding to the symbol placed in the schematic. To get the instance master in a format instruction, use the fnlCurrentCell function.

functions.name: fnlCurrentInstCdsName
functions.description: Returns the full instance pathname to the current instance being expanded. This function must be called only during expansion of the NLPcompleteElementString property.

functions.name: fnlCurrentIteration
functions.description: Returns an index of the current iterated instance being expanded. Only an instance can be iterated and placed in the schematic.

functions.name: fnlCurrentModelExtName
functions.description: Returns the netlister-assigned model name of the current instance being expanded. This function corresponds to the netlister-defined ModelNumber property and must be called only during evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString and NLPcreateModelString properties.

functions.name: fnlCurrentSig
functions.description: Returns the current signal being expanded.

functions.name: fnlCurrentSigPathName
functions.description: Returns the full pathname of the current signal being expanded. It corresponds to the netlister-defined NetPathName property. As the corresponding property, this function is valid only during evaluation of the NLPcreateNetString property.

functions.name: fnlGetGlobalSigNames
functions.description: Returns a list of strings that are the names for all of the global signals contained in the design hierarchy. If the netlister-assigned name is required, you can pass these names to the fnlSigCdsNameExtName function to translate them during the header or footer evaluation. You can use the fnlGetGlobalSigName function at any time during the netlisting process.

functions.name: fnlInstCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Returns the netlister-assigned name for the instance name specified as an argument, if the instance is found.

functions.name: fnlPathList
functions.description: Returns a list representing the current instance path down the schematic hierarchy to the current instance or signal being expanded.

functions.name: fnlPrint
functions.description: Prints the specified argument in the netlist file.

functions.name: fnlSearchPropString
functions.description: Returns the property value for the property name specified as an argument.

functions.name: fnlSigCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Returns the netlister-assigned name for the signal name specified as an argument, if the signal is found.

functions.name: fnlTermCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Returns each netlister-assigned signal name for the signal attached to the terminal whose name is specified as an argument. The function is equivalent to the substitution expression [ |name ]. As with the matching expression, the terminal names allowed as arguments are restricted to the terminals attached to the current instance.

functions.name: fnlTermExtName
functions.description: Returns the netlister-assigned name for the signal attached to the bit of the terminal specified as an argument. The function is similar to the substitution expression [ |name ]. As with the matching expression, the terminals allowed as arguments are restricted to the formal terminals of the master of the current instance. This function must be called only during the evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString property.

functions.name: fnlTopCell
functions.description: Returns the top level cellview being netlisted. The function can be called throughout the netlist process. It may be especially useful during the evaluation of the NLPnetlistHeader and NLPnetlistFooter properties, where you can use it to output information about the top level design for the header and footer of the netlist. There is no equivalent netlister-defined property.

functions.name: hnlAbortNetlist
functions.description: Aborts netlisting. When the formatter detects an error during netlisting, it calls this function to inform the netlister to abort netlisting. This function aborts netlisting at the next convenient point, usually after the current cell is processed.

functions.name: hnlAddExtraParameters
functions.description: Adds user-specified design variables to the OSS design variables list. For example, ADE-XL requires to add more design variables to OSS design variables list that are obtained after CDF callback evaluation.

functions.name: hnlCatIncrementalNetlistFiles
functions.description: Concatenates the list of netlist files into a single file whose file handle is given as the first parameter to this function. The second parameter is the list of files to be concatenated.

functions.name: hnlCellExtracted
functions.description: Checks if the cellview has not been modified since it was last extracted.

functions.name: hnlCellInAllCells
functions.description: Checks if the cellview argument exists as a cellview in the list of all cells. If not, this function returns nil.

functions.name: hnlCloseCellFiles
functions.description: Closes all opened files to netlist the cell from hnlCurrentCell. This function calls the hnlWriteBlockControlFile function to create the control file under the directory for hnlCurrentCell.

functions.name: hnlCloseMasterList
functions.description: Closes a list of cellviews one by one. This is the reverse function of hnlGetMasterCells.

functions.name: hnlCompletePrint
functions.description: Clears the buffers needed for the hnlPrintString function and closes the netlist file.

functions.name: hnlDeRegPostNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Deregisters a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that has been registered using hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger.
