functions.name: 1/x
functions.description: Returns the inverse value. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: 10**x
functions.description: Returns the 10x value of the input signal. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: Mu
functions.description: Returns the alternative stability factor that indicates the minimum distance between the origin of the unit Smith chart and the load unstable region.

functions.name: Mu_prime
functions.description: Returns the alternative stability factor that indicates the minimum distance between the center of the unit Smith chart and the source unstable region.

functions.name: OS
functions.description: Returns the specified device parameter of the an instance from DC analysis data.

functions.name: OT
functions.description: Returns the specified device parameter of the given instance from the transient analysis data.

functions.name: PN
functions.description: Returns a waveform for the transient phase noise of the input waveforms in decibels (dBc/Hz). Phase noise is defined as the power spectral density of the absolute jitter of an input waveform. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: Rn
functions.description: Returns the equivalent noise resistance as a function of frequency. This function is available only on a 2-port network from that uses a S-Parameter analysis.

functions.name: aaSP
functions.description: Plots the S-Parameter waveform for a multi-port network. S-Parameters describe the input-output relationship between two ports in a multi-port network. Generally, S-parameters vary with frequency.

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Returns the absolute value of the specified value or signal.

functions.name: abs_jitter
functions.description: Returns a waveform that contains the absolute jitter values in the input waveform for the given threshold. The output waveform can be expressed in degrees, radians, or unit intervals (UI). The absolute jitter can be plotted as a function of cycle number, crossing time, or reference clock time.

functions.name: acos
functions.description: Returns the inverse cosine of a ignal.

functions.name: acosh
functions.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine or hyperbolic arc-cosine of a signal.

functions.name: adtFFT
functions.description: Calculates the fast Fourier transform (FFT) of the specified list.

functions.name: adtIFFT
functions.description: Calculates the inverse discrete Fourier transform of the specified list.

functions.name: analog2Digital
functions.description: Returns the digital form of an analog input waveform, which may be a scalar, list or family of waveforms or a string representation of expressions. The corresponding SKILL command name for this function is awvAnalog2Digital.

functions.name: appendWaves
functions.syntax: appendWaves( o_waveform1 o_waveform2 [ o_waveformN ] ) => o_appendedWaveform / nil
functions.description: Appends a series of input waveforms in x-vector direction into a single output waveform.

functions.name: armSetCalc
functions.description: Sets the specified property of the Calculator resource to the specified value.

functions.name: asin
functions.description: Returns the inverse sine of a signal.

functions.name: asinh
functions.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine or hyperbolic arc-sine of a signal.

functions.name: atan
functions.description: Returns the nverse tangent of a signal.

functions.name: atanh
functions.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent or hyperbolic arc tangent of a signal.

functions.name: average
functions.description: Computes the average of a waveform over its entire range.

functions.name: awvAddSubwindow
functions.description: Adds a subwindow to the specified Waveform window.

functions.syntax: awvAnalog2Digital( o_waveform n_vhi n_vlo n_vc n_timeX t_thresholdType [ ?releaseMemory g_releaseMemory ] => o_digWave / n_digValue / nil

functions.name: dft
functions.description: The tool which converts a temporal (time domain) description of a signal (real or complex) into one in terms of its frequency components is called the Fourier Transform. dft (Discrete Fourier Transform) is the discrete formulation of the Fourier Transform, which takes such regularly spaced data values (samples in time domain), and returns the value of the Fourier Transform for a set of values in frequency domain which are equally spaced. Most of the time, however, we work on real-valued signals only.

functions.name: dftbb
functions.description: Computes the Discrete Fourier Transform (fast Fourier transform) of a complex signal. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: dnl

functions.name: dutyCycle

functions.name: evmQAM
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) for multi-mode modulations. The function plots the I versus Q scatterplot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the four possible I and Q symbol combinations and calculating the difference between the original signal level and the ideal signal level.

functions.name: evmQpsk
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatter plot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the four possible I and Q symbol combinations and calculating the difference between the original signal level and the ideal signal level.

The result is a plot that has many overlapping lines enclosing an empty space known as the eye. The quality of the receiver circuit is characterized by the dimension of the eye. An open eye means that the detector can distinguish between 1's and 0's in its input, while a closed eye means that a detector placed on Vout is likely to give errors for certain input bit sequences.

functions.name: psd
functions.description: Describes how the power (or variance) of a time series (signal) is distributed with frequency. Mathematically, it is defined as the Fourier Transform of the auto correlation sequence of the time series (signal). The waveform is first interpolated to generate evenly spaced data points in time. The spacing of the data points is the inverse of the dft sampling frequency. The psd is computed by first breaking up the time interval into overlapping segments. Each segment is multiplied, time point by time point, by the specified windowing function. The dft is performed on each windowed segment of the baseband waveform. At each frequency, the dfts from all segments are averaged together and the squared modulus of these averages gives the psd.

functions.name: risetime
functions.description: Returns the rise time for a signal, which is the time taken by a signal to change from a specified low value to a specified high value. Typically, these values are 10% and 90% of the step height.

functions.name: rms
functions.description: Returns the root mean square of a signal. The equation for rms is:

functions.name: rmsNoise
functions.description: Computes the integrated root-mean-square of the total output noise over the bandwidth specified in Hertz in the From and To fields.This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: rms_jitter
functions.description: Returns the root mean square jitter value in the specified frequency range. The RMS jitter value is calculated based on the following equation:

functions.name: rn
functions.description: Returns the normalized equivalent noise resistance as a function of frequency. This function is available only for a 2-port network from running an S-Parameter analysis.

functions.name: root
functions.description: Computes the value of x at which f(x) equals the specified threshold. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: rshift
functions.description: Shifts the data in the graph window to the right by the specified amount. A negative value shifts the data to the left. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: s11
functions.description: Returns s11 of a two-port network. S-parameters describe the response of an N-port network to voltage signals at each port. The first number in the subscript refers to the responding port, while the second number refers to the incident port. Therefore, S11 means the response at port1 due to a signal at port 1.

functions.name: s12
functions.description: Returns s12 of a two-port network. S-parameters describe the response of an N-port network to voltage signals at each port. The first number in the subscript refers to the responding port, while the second number refers to the incident port. Therefore, S12 means the response at port1 due to a signal at port 2.

functions.name: s21
functions.description: Returns s21 of a two-port network. S-parameters describe the response of an N-port network to voltage signals at each port. The first number in the subscript refers to the responding port, while the second number refers to the incident port. Therefore, S21 means the response at port 2 due to a signal at port 1.

functions.name: s22
functions.description: Returns s22 of a two-port network. S-parameters describe the response of an N-port network to voltage signals at each port. The first number in the subscript refers to the responding port, while the second number refers to the incident port. Therefore, S22 means the response at port 2 due to a signal at port 2.

functions.name: sample
functions.description: Samples the given waveform over the specified interval.

functions.name: settlingTime
functions.description: Calculates the time taken by a signal before it reaches to a value that remains within a certain percent of its final value.

functions.name: sin
functions.description: Returns the sine of a signal.

functions.name: sinh
functions.description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a signal.

functions.name: skewness
functions.description: Calculates the skewness of the specified waveform.

functions.name: slewRate
functions.description: Computes the average rate at which the Buffer expression changes from percent low to percent high of the difference between the initial value and the final value.

functions.name: sourceStability
functions.description: Returns the source stability circles. Stability circles define the boundary between stable and potentially unstable  or . For a conditionally stable circuit, the load stability on an extended Smith chart is displayed in the figure below:

functions.name: spectralPower
functions.description: Plots the spectral power for the specified current waveform and voltage waveform. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: spectrumMeasurement
functions.description: Calculates Signal-to-Noise-and-Distortion Ratio (SINAD), Spurious Free Dynamic Range (SFDR), Effective Number of Bits (ENOB), and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (without distortion) by using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) of any given input signal.

functions.name: spm

functions.name: stddev

functions.name: swapSweep
functions.description: Swaps the X-axis value with the specified sweep variable.

functions.name: tan
functions.description: Returns the tangent of a signal.

functions.name: tangent
functions.description: Plots a line that passes through x and y coordinates and the slope that you specify. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: tanh
functions.description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a signal.

functions.name: thd
functions.description: Computes the percentage of THD of a signal with respect to the fundamental frequency and is expressed as a voltage percentage.

functions.name: topBaseLine
functions.description: Returns the topline and baseline values of the specified transient waveform.

functions.name: topLine
functions.description: Returns the topline value of the specified transient waveform.

functions.name: totalNoise
functions.description: Calculates the integrated noise power over a specified bandwidth.

functions.name: triggeredDelay
functions.description: Calculates the delay from the trigger point on the edge (either rising or falling) of a triggering signal to the next edge (either rising or falling) of the target signal. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: unityGainFreq
functions.description: Computes and reports the frequency at which the gain is unity. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: vh

functions.name: vtime

functions.name: vvDisplayBrowser

functions.name: waveVsWave
functions.description: Computes the YvsY function on the given input waveforms and plots the output waveform for which X- and Y- axes are created using the Y-axes of the specified input waveforms. When the specified input waveforms have different X-axes, this function performs the interpolation. You can also use this function to compare the Y-axis of a family of waveforms with the Y-axis of a single-leaf waveform.

functions.name: x**2
functions.description: Returns the x2 (second power) value of the input signal. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: xmax
functions.description: Computes the value of the independent variable x at which the expression attains its maximum value, that is, the value of x that maximizes y=f(x).

functions.name: xmin
functions.description: Computes the value of the independent variable x at which the expression has its minimum value, that is, the value of x that minimizes y=f(x).

functions.name: xval
functions.description: Returns the vector consisting of the X-axis values of the points in the signal. The following figure illustrates this function.

functions.name: y**2
functions.description: Returns the yx (y to the power x) value. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: ymax
functions.description: Computes the maximum Y-axis value of the expression y=f(x). This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: ymin
functions.description: Computes the minimum Y-axis value of the expression y=f(x). This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: ypm
functions.description: Returns the waveform for the y-parameter.

functions.name: zpm
functions.description: Returns the waveform for the z-parameter.

functions.name: ALIAS
functions.description: Can be used in two scenarios- to give alias or alternate names to long net names or instance name paths, and to return the first value of a waveform result, for non-swept variables.

functions.name: acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist
functions.description: Controls how an included netlist is included in the main netlist file. This function can be overridden by user settings. If user-override is not specified, the included netlist is copied without any modification. However, if both acdlPrintIncludedNetlist and acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist are defined, acdlPrintIncludedNetlist is called. acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist is preferred because the file pointer is not closed and re-initialized.

functions.name: addCheck

The scope of check is decided by the arguments ?sub, ?dev, ?mod, and ?prim. The ?min and ?max parameters can be used to set up the safe region if the parameter/expression being checked goes out of this region and a violation is reported.

The function must only be used by customized socket netlisters or custom socket netlist procedures. The routine takes into consideration the netlist mode (FNL, HNL or IHNL), case mapping (lower, upper or mixed) and the prefix for the instance.

functions.description: Retrieves the data from effective CDF. This function is used to match the CDF properties of the graphical window with the global effective CDF properties and needs to be called before annotating CDF properties to reflect the changes done in effective CDF properties.

functions.description: This is a utility function used to create a CDF for the <yourSimulator> simulator.The ansAnalogRegCDFsimInfo functions are called by the CDF editor. These functions are used to provide data type information for all the simInfo attributes.

functions.name: ansCdlCompPrim
functions.description: Enables printing of device information for primitives in the auCdl netlist. Specify this function as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the primitive devices for which you want the device information to be printed in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlGetMultiplicity
functions.description: Controls how multiplicity (converting an instance into multiple instances connected in parallel) is handled for an instance in the design when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the master of the instance.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSegmentConnections
functions.syntax: ansCdlGetSegmentConnections(  S_inst  l_connectionPairs  n_iterSeg  n_iterMult  n_numSegments  n_multiplicityFactor  t_segmentConnType  n_netCount  )
functions.description: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It controls how connectivity information is written in the netlist for instances for which a multiplicity factor is specified using the m or M property. For example, if an instance with a connection list like ((termA netA) (termB netB)) has to be converted into two segments connected in series, the modified connection list for the first segment will be  ((termA netA) (termB tempnet_0)) and ((termA tempnet_0) (termB netB)) for the second segment. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSegmentInfo
functions.description: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It returns the number of segments for an instance and the connection type (series, parallel, or user defined connection type name) between the segments. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

functions.description: Customizes how instance names are written in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintInstParams
functions.description: Customizes how instance parameters are written in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintInstProps
functions.description: Enables printing of user-defined instance properties and also customizes the format in which the properties are printed in the netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintModelName
functions.syntax: ansCdlPrintModelName( &_fp  g_isAPrimitive  g_definedPropVal  g_modelPropInstVal  g_componentPropInstVal  g_cdfModelName  g_cdfComponentName )
functions.description: Customizes the order in which auCdl looks for model names for primitives and the format in which the model information is written in the netlist.

functions.description: Customizes how module names are written in the auCdl netlist for subcircuits.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintString
functions.description: Prints comment strings in the device information for instances in the auCdl netlist. To print comment strings in the device information, you must also use the 'string argument in the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable defined in the .simrc file. For more information about the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable, see the Virtuoso ADE Explorer User Guide.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInst
functions.description: Writes the switch Pcell instance in the auCdl netlist based on the size and input values of the instance.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInstParam
functions.description: Writes into the auCdl netlist the list of CDF parameters and values defined for switch Pcell instances.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubCircuit
functions.description: Writes into the auCdl netlist the subckt definitions specified by hnlSpecialPCellLibCell in the .simrc file.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubcktConn
functions.description: Writes into the auCdl netlist the switch Pcell connections specified by hnlSpecialPCellLibCell in the .simrc file.

functions.name: artBlankString
functions.description: Returns true if the given object is equal to nil. If the given object is a string, checks if the string is empty or has blank space characters only and returns true. If the object is not nil and if the string has non-space characters, it returns nil.

functions.name: artClose
functions.description: Closes the file associated with the given handle.

functions.name: artCloseAllFiles
functions.description: Closes all files opened with artOutfile().

functions.name: artCurrentInstSimName
functions.description: This function provides the external instance name for the current instance being formatted in the netlister. The function should only be used for socket netlisters or custom netlist procedures for socket. The routine does not take into consideration case mapping registered for the tool or the prefix for the instance. It does take care of the netlisting mode (FNL, HNL or IHNL).

functions.name: artEnableAnnotationBalloon
functions.syntax: artEnableAnnotationBalloon( g_value  [ x_firstPoint ] [ x_lastPoint ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the display of parametric sweep results annotated on the schematic. When enabled, the first six result points are displayed in a pop-up window that appears when you hover the mouse pointer over an instance on the schematic. Use x_firstPoint and x_lastPoint to specify a range of result points to be displayed in the pop-up window.

functions.name: artFlush
functions.description: Flushes the file associated with the given handle.

functions.name: artFprintf
functions.syntax: artFprintf(  x_handle  t_text  g_args  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints out data like the standard C library fprintf, with the handle returned from artOutfile() as the first argument.

functions.name: artGenerateHierSymbolCDF
functions.description: Creates the cell CDF for the specified cellView, in the same way as happens when you create a symbol from a schematic in Composer. The cellView will be examined for any use of pPar() in expressions, and the corresponding parameters will be added to the CDF if they are not already present. Whilst both schematic and symbol cellViews may be passed to this function, it is usually best to pass a schematic cellView, in order to get the pPar()s used into the CDF.

functions.name: artGetCdfTargetCV
functions.description: This procedure returns the cell view dbobject that is the target of the update instance form or the create instance form. The function requires that either the arm property (armGet 'cdfInfo 'currentCellView) is set to a cellView, or that the variable cdfgForm is bound to a form with a property cellViewId attached (getq cdfgForm cellViewId). If neither of these is bound, nil is returned.

functions.name: artGetCellViewDesignVarList
functions.description: Returns the list of design variable name value pairs associated with the top level cell view.

functions.name: artInvalidateAmap
functions.description: Resets the in-memory Amap cache. Further mapping function calls will result in re-reading the amap files from disk.

functions.name: artListOpenFiles
functions.description: Lists names of all files opened with artOutfile.

functions.name: artListToWaveform
functions.description: This function takes a list of X,Y points and translates it into a waveform. Each of the X,Y points is also in a list format. If Y points are represented in a list format, they are treated as complex numbers while creating the waveform.

functions.name: artMakeString
functions.description: Converts data of the given data type to a string. The valid data types for the g_anyArg argument include symbol, integer, float, and string. The floating point numbers are converted into strings by using the '%.16g' format specification to produce the most precise output.

functions.name: artMakeStringPrec15
functions.description: Converts data of the given data type to a string. The valid data types for the g_anyArg argument include symbol, integer, float, and string. It similar to the function artMakeString, except that it uses the '%.15g' format specification to convert the floating point numbers into strings.

functions.syntax: artOutfile(  t_name  t_mode  x_len  t_break  t_cont  t_begCom  t_endCom  t_tab  t_comments  )  => x_handle
functions.description: Opens the named file. The first argument is mandatory. The other arguments keep their default values if they are not set.

functions.name: asiCheckAnalysis
functions.description: Checking function for the analysis class. e.g. for Spectre simulator object it checks each field value in the environment, highlights any errors, returns t or nil. Can be used for different analog simulator analysis objects.

functions.description: Creates a design object with the nlCreateDesign call, using the information on the OASIS session. Subsequently, the formatter is created with a call to nlCreateFormatter, using the information on the session. The formatter is added to the session and can be obtained with asiGetFormatter. This is a convenience function that you cannot redefine, and the interface should not call it.

functions.description: Creates a file that contains a statement to include netlist for simulation. Override this function to create a customized include statement according to the the simulator netlisting procedure and syntax.

functions.description: Creates the file logFileVerilog in the .../psf directory to indicate the analysis result of Verilog-XL in a mixed-signal transient run.

functions.name: asiDcStore
functions.description: Copies the DC node voltages in processId.dc to the name you pass in fileName. This function assumes that your simulator writes the DC node voltages to netlistDir/raw/processId.dc.

functions.description: Defines the data mapping functions.

functions.syntax: asiDeleteFlowchartLink(  o_flowchart  s_parentStep s_childStep ) => t / nil

functions.name: asiDeleteFlowchartStep
functions.syntax: asiDeleteFlowchartStep(  o_flowchart  s_name [ s_splice ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a step and any attached links from an existing flowchart. Typically, you do not need this function because you can unlink any flowchart step that you do not want to use with the asiDeleteFlowchartLink function.

functions.name: asiDeleteKeepOption
functions.description: Deletes a simulator keep option variable.

functions.name: asiDeleteSimOption
functions.description: Deletes a simulator option.

functions.name: asiDisableAnalysis
functions.description: Disables an analysis while keeping it in the analysis list. The analysis remains in the UI, but it is not sent to the simulator.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysis
functions.description: Displays the analyses for a tool. Use this function to determine which analyses you need to add or modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysisField
functions.description: Displays the analysis field names for an analysis. Use this function to determine which analysis field you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysisOption
functions.description: Displays the analysis option names for an analysis. Use this function to determine which analysis option you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysisOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the characteristics for one of the analysis options forms. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayEnvOption
functions.description: Displays the current set of simulation environment option names and values. Use this function only to determine which environment options you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayEnvOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the form characteristics for the Environment Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify.

functions.name: asiDisplayFlowchart
functions.description: Displays the current steps and links for the flowchart. You can display all the step and link information, or you can display the steps and links that are below the rootstep step. Use this function only to determine which part of the flowchart you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayHighPerformanceOption
functions.description: Displays a list of variable and values of the High Performance Simulation Option form.

functions.name: asiDisplayKeepOption
functions.description: Displays the current simulator keep option names. Use this function to determine which options you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayKeepOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the form characteristics for the Keep Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayNetlistOption
functions.description: Displays the current set of netlist options and values. Use this function only to determine which netlist options you can modify.

functions.name: asiDisplaySimOption
functions.description: Displays the current set of simulator option names and values. Use this function only to determine which simulator options you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplaySimOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the characteristics of the Simulator Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiEditDigitalStimulus
functions.description: This method edits the digital stimulus file. It gets the full path to the stimulus file by calling asiGetDigitalStimulusFileName. If the stimulus file does not exist, the asiNetlist flowchart step is executed to run the netlister and create a digital stimulus file. Finally the stimulus file is opened in an editor.

functions.name: asiEnableAnalysis
functions.description: Enables an analysis, which means the analysis is selected and sent to the simulator.

functions.name: asiExecuteFlowchart
functions.syntax: asiExecuteFlowchart(  o_session  s_goalStep  [ s_printMessages ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Executes the flowchart for a given session up to and including the goal step.

functions.name: asiExtractQRCTechPathFromDSPF
functions.description: Extracts the path to the QRC technology directory from the specified DSPF file.

functions.name: asiExtractQRCTechPathFromSession
functions.description: Extracts the path to the QRC technology directory from the DSPF file defined in the EMIR setup for the specified session.

functions.name: asiFinalNetlist
functions.description: Creates the final netlist.

functions.name: asiFormatAnalysis
functions.description: Formats and prints analysis statements to the control file. For the general asiAnalog class, it follows this routine: prints the analysis name by calling asiGetAnalysisName; prints the list of signals by calling asiGetAnalysisSigList and formats them in parentheses [for example: (net1 net2)]; prints the analysis field list in name=value pairs; prints the analysis options in name=value pairs; uses asiGetFormattedVal() to obtain the print string for an analysis field value or an analysis option value. Please see the description of asiGetFormattedVal routine for more details.

functions.name: asiFormatAnalysisList
functions.description: Formats all enabled analyses by calling asiFormatAnalysis.

functions.name: asiFormatControlStmts
functions.description: Creates and formats all control statements. It formats the following in the given order:

functions.name: asiFormatDefinitionFileList
functions.description: Formats the statement which includes the specified definition files.

functions.name: asiFormatDesignVarList
functions.description: Formats and prints the design variable statements to the design variable file. This routine first prints the string.PARAM followed by the design variables in name=value pairs. The design variables are obtained by calling asiGetDesignVarList.

functions.name: asiFormatGraphicalStimuli
functions.description: Formats the graphical stimuli statements to send to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiFormatGraphicalStimulusFileList
functions.description: Formats the statement that includes the graphical stimulus files.

functions.name: asiFormatInitCond
functions.description: Formats and prints the initial condition commands to the control statement file. This routine prints the string .IC followed by the initial conditions in V(net)=voltage pairs.

functions.name: asiFormatKeepList
functions.description: Formats and prints the signal save commands to the control statement file. At the asiAnalog class this routine returns t. You need to create your own asiFormatKeepList routine.

functions.name: asiFormatModelLibSelectionList
functions.description: Formats the statement which specifies the model library information.

functions.name: asiFormatNodeSet
functions.description: Formats and prints the nodeset commands to the control statement file. This routine prints .NODESET and then the nodesets in V(net)=voltage pairs.

functions.name: asiFormatSimulatorOptions
functions.description: Formats and prints the simulator option statements to the designated file. This routine prints .OPTIONS followed by name=value pairs.

functions.name: asiFormatSpecialParameterForRel
functions.description: Netlists the new options added to the customized tab.

functions.name: asiFormatTextStimulusFileList
functions.description: Formats the statement which includes the textual stimulus files.

functions.name: asiGetAdvAnalysis
functions.syntax: asiGetAdvAnalysis( { o_session | o_tool } s_analysisName )  => o_analysis / nil
functions.description: Returns the object of advanced analyses, such as Monte Carlo. This function is similar to the asiGetAnalysis function and is normally used by third party integrator to implement the simulator interface for their simulators.

functions.name: asiGetAnalogKeepList
functions.description: Returns a list of user-selected output signals that are analog. This method first checks if the current simulation session is mixed-signal. If yes, then it returns all the user-selected output signals within the analog partition of the mixed-signal design. Otherwise, it calls asiGetKeepList to get the list of signals and currents to be saved during simulation.

functions.name: asiGetAnalogRunDir
functions.description: Returns the analog simulator run directory.

functions.name: asiGetAnalogSimulator
functions.description: Gets the value of the analog simulator for a tool or session object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysis
functions.syntax: asiGetAnalysis( { o_session | o_tool } s_analysisName ) => o_analysis / nil
functions.description: Gets an analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisField
functions.description: Returns the specified analysis field object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for an analysis field that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldList
functions.description: Returns a list of analysis field objects defined for a particular analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldVal
functions.description: Gets the value of an analysis field from the environment.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldChoices(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of choices for a field in the Choosing Analyses form. This procedure can be used within the asiCheck method to get the list of choices for an analysis field from the form for subsequent value checking. You can also use this procedure in an expression that controls whether a field is displayed in the form.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldVal(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  ) => g_fieldValue / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of a field in the Choosing Analyses form. This procedure can be used within the asiCheck method to get the values of analysis fields from the form for subsequent value checking. You can also use this procedure in an expression that controls whether a field is displayed in the form.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFormObj
functions.description: Returns the current analysis selected in the Choosing Analysis form for the simulation session.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisName
functions.description: Gets the name of the analysis.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisNameList
functions.description: Returns a list of analysis names defined for a tool.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionChoices
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for an analysis option that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionList
functions.description: Gets a list of analysis option objects defined for a particular analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionSendMethod
functions.description: Gets the sendMethod for an option in an analysis. The sendMethod indicates how the analysis option is sent to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionVal
functions.description: Gets the value for the given option in an analysis.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisParamNameList
functions.description: Returns a concatenated list of fields and options defined for an analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisSigList
functions.description: Gets a list of analysis field objects which are of the type net. For example, the p and n nodes for the Spectre noise analysis.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisSimFieldList
functions.description: Gets a list of simulator analysis field objects that need to be netlisted.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisType
functions.description: Gets the type of the analysis.

functions.name: asiGetAvailableMCOptions
functions.description: Returns a list of Monte Carlo analysis options along with their description. The supported Monte Carlo analysis options are displayed in the <OptionName, Description> format.

functions.name: asiGetCalcResultsDir
functions.description: Returns the results directory currently used by calculator functions.

functions.name: asiGetCommandFooter
functions.description: Specifies the footer of the simulation run command.

functions.name: asiGetCommandLineOption
functions.description: Gets the simulation command line options. At the asiAnalog class this method returns the value of the environment option `userComdLineOption.

functions.name: asiGetCurrentSession
functions.description: Returns the session object for the current session.

functions.name: asiGetDefinitionFileList
functions.description: Gets the list of definition file names associated with the given simulation session.

functions.name: asiGetDesignCellName
functions.description: Returns the cell name of the design associated with the passed session object.

functions.name: asiGetDesignLibName
functions.description: Returns the library name of the design associated with the passed object.

functions.name: asiGetDesignVarList
functions.description: Gets the list of design variables for the design associated with the session you specify.

functions.name: asiGetDesignVarListWithOriginalExpressions
functions.description: Returns a list of name-value pairs for design variables specified in the given session.

functions.name: asiGetDesignViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the design associated with the passed object.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalCommandLineOption
functions.description: Returns the digital part of the mixed simulation command line options.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalKeepList
functions.description: Returns a list of user-selected output signals that are digital.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalNetlistFileName
functions.description: Returns the digital netlist file name.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalRunDir
functions.description: Returns the digital simulator run directory.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalSimExecName
functions.description: Displays the verimix executable name.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalSimulator
functions.description: Gets the value of the digital simulator for a tool or session object.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalSimulatorLogFileName
functions.description: Retrieves the digital simulator log file name for the given design.

functions.name: asiGetDigitalStimulusFileName
functions.description: Returns the digital stimulus file name. This file name is the concatenated path string of the digital netlist run directory followed by testfixture.verimix.

functions.name: asiGetDrlData
functions.syntax: asiGetDrlData(  t_anaType  l_specifier  t_dataDir  )  => g_familyOrWaveform / nil
functions.description: Returns the results data for the given specifier from the given data directory.

functions.name: asiGetEMIROptionVal
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified EMIR option from the EMIR Analysis Setup form.

functions.name: asiGetEnabledAnalysisList
functions.description: Returns a list of all the enabled analyses.

functions.name: asiGetEnvOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiGetEnvOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name  ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for an environment option that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetEnvOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiGetEnvOptionVal( { o_session | o_tool } s_name  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Gets the value for the specified simulation environment option.

functions.name: asiGetFlowchart
functions.description: Gets the flowchart object for a tool or session.

functions.name: asiGetFormFieldChoices
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for a form field that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetFormFieldVal
functions.description: Gets the value of a field on a form.

functions.name: asiGetFormattedVal
functions.syntax: asiGetFormattedVal(  o_anaField | o_anaOption | o_simOption  )  => t_formattedVal / nil
functions.description: Gets the string value of an analysis field object, an analysis option object, or a simulator option object. The format of the string values are based on the object types which are specified with functions such as asiCreateAnalysisField, asiCreateAnalysisOption, asiAddSimOption. A number of examples can be found in the example section.

functions.name: asiGetFormatter
functions.description: Returns the formatter created with the last asiCreateFormatter call. This is a convenience function that you should not redefine and the interface should not call.

functions.name: asiGetHighPerformanceOptionVal
functions.description: Returns the field value of the High Performance form with the passed session object.

functions.name: asiGetId
functions.description: Returns the name of the session ID associated with the given OASIS session.

functions.name: asiGetIterationUpdateFile
functions.description: Returns the name and path to the simulator-specific file in which the iteration number and the corresponding PSF data location is written after each Monte Carlo iteration completes. This file is used to monitor the progress of the Monte Carlo run and to get the directory path from where the PSF data corresponding to an iteration is read.

functions.name: asiGetKeepList
functions.description: Gets a list of signals and currents that are saved during simulation.

functions.name: asiGetKeepOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiGetKeepOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name  ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for a keep option that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetKeepOptionVal
functions.description: Gets the value of a keep option variable for a tool or session object.

functions.name: asiGetLogFileList
functions.description: Returns a list of the names of the log files.

functions.name: asiGetMarchList
functions.description: Returns a list of signals that are to be marched during simulation.

functions.name: asiGetModelLibFile
functions.description: Gets the file name of a model library selection object.

functions.name: asiGetModelLibSection
functions.description: Gets the section name of a model library selection object.

functions.name: asiGetModelLibSelectionList
functions.description: Formats the statement which specifies the model library information.

functions.name: asiGetNetlistDir
functions.description: Returns the netlist directory. If the directory does not exist, this function creates it.

functions.name: asiGetNetlistFileListToSymLink
functions.description: Returns the list of files present in the netlist directory and created by the asiNetlist procedure.

functions.name: asiGetNetlistFormatterClass
functions.description: Returns the netlist formatter class for the specified tool.

functions.name: asiGetNetlistOption
functions.syntax: asiGetNetlistOption( { o_session | o_tool } s_name ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Gets the value of the specified netlist option.

functions.name: asiGetNetworkId
functions.description: Returns the network ID of a mixed-signal design.

functions.name: asiGetOutputList
functions.description: Returns a list of structures. Each structure defines a output to be saved and/or plotted after simulation.

functions.name: asiGetPageCallBack
functions.description: Returns the callback function name when changing tabs in a form.

functions.name: asiGetPlotList
functions.description: Gets the list of signals that can be plotted for the current simulation session.

functions.name: asiGetPredefinedCommandLineOption
functions.description: Gets the predefined simulation command-line options. This function returns an empty string at the asiAnalog class. Overload this method for your simulator.

functions.name: asiGetPsfDir
functions.description: Returns the name of the PSF directory.

functions.name: asiGetReservedWordList
functions.description: Returns the simulator specific reserved keyword list. All the keywords specified by asiGetReservedWordList will be taken as keywords and not design variables. This process will ensure that the design parameters are not printed in the simulation control file under `parameters' statement. By default, this function returns nil.

functions.name: asiGetResultsNetlistDir
functions.description: Returns the name of the netlist directory for the current or last-run simulation.

functions.name: asiGetResultsPsfDir
functions.description: Returns the name of the PSF directory for the current or last-run simulation.

functions.name: asiGetSelObjName
functions.description: Returns the schematic name of the selected signal object.

functions.name: asiGetSelObjType
functions.description: Returns the type of the selected signal object.

functions.name: asiGetSelObjValue
functions.description: Returns the initial condition or nodeset values specified on the selected signal object.

functions.name: asiGetSession
functions.syntax: asiGetSession( { x_id | w_window | r_form | s_name | o_analysis } ) => o_session / nil
functions.description: Returns the session object given one of five possible identifiers.

functions.name: asiGetSimCommandLineOrder
functions.description: Returns the order of options used in the simulator run command. By default, it returns the options in the following order:

functions.name: asiGetSimExecName
functions.description: Gets the name of the simulator executable by calling asiGetSimName.

functions.name: asiGetSimInputFileList
functions.description: Returns a list of all file names concatenated to generate the input file to the simulator. You can override this method to add/delete files used to generate the final input file to your simulator.

functions.name: asiGetSimInputFileName
functions.description: Returns the name of the simulator input file. For the asiAnalog_session class, this is input followed by the return value of asiGetSimInputFileSuffix.

functions.name: asiGetSimInputFileSuffix
functions.description: Returns the suffix used for the simulator input file. This method can be redefined, and must return a string, or a SKILL error will result.

functions.name: asiGetSimName
functions.description: Gets the name of the simulator for a tool or session object.

functions.name: asiGetSimOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiGetSimOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for a simulator option that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetSimOptionNameList
functions.description: Returns the list of simulator option names.

functions.name: asiGetSimOptionSendMethod
functions.syntax: asiGetSimOptionSendMethod( { o_session | o_tool } s_name  ) => s_sendMethod / nil
functions.description: Gets the sendMethod for the specified simulator option. The sendMethod indicates how the simulator option is sent to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiGetSimOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiGetSimOptionVal( { o_session | o_tool } s_name ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Gets the value for the specified simulator option.

functions.name: asiGetSimulationRunCommand
functions.description: Gets the simulation run command. For direct simulators, it also creates the runSimulation file.

functions.name: asiGetSimulatorList
functions.description: The function returns a list of all simulation interfaces within the specified simulator subclass.

functions.name: asiGetSimulatorSrcList
functions.description: Customizes the values in the Function drop-down list of the Setup Analog Stimuli form.

functions.name: asiGetStimulusGlobals
functions.description: This method retrieves the list of global stimuli from the session.

functions.name: asiGetStimulusInputs
functions.description: This method retrieves the list of input stimuli from the session.

functions.name: asiGetSupportedMCOptions
functions.description: Returns a list of Monte Carlo analysis options supported by your simulator. Ensure that the option names returned by this method match with the option names returned by asiGetAvailableMCOptions.

functions.name: asiGetTextStimulusFileList
functions.description: Gets the list of textual stimulus file names associated with the given simulation session.

functions.name: asiGetTool
functions.description: Returns the tool object associated with the specified tool name or session. If the tool object is not found, an attempt is made to create and initialize the tool.

functions.name: asiGetTopCellView
functions.description: Returns the top-level cellview associated with the session.

functions.name: asiGetVerilogCommandLineOption
functions.description: Returns the Verilog simulator command line options.

functions.name: asiGetVerilogHost
functions.description: Returns the digital simulator host name for mixed-signal simulation. This method first verifies if host name was set using asiSetVerilogHost. If yes, it returns that host name. Otherwise, it returns the default value of digitalHost in the .cdsenv file for tool asimenv and partition startup.

functions.name: asiGetVerilogHostMode
functions.description: Returns the digital simulator host mode for mixed-signal simulation. This method first verifies if host mode was set using asiSetVerilogHostMode. If yes, it returns that mode. Otherwise, it returns the default value of digitalHostMode in the .cdsenv file for tool asimenv and partition startup.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>
functions.description: Calls the procedures to initialize your simulator's environment. This function must be defined for socket interfaces. Do not use it for direct interfaces.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>Analysis
functions.description: Calls the procedures that modify analyses in your simulator. You must write asiInit<yourSimulator>Analysis, where <yourSimulator> is the name of your simulator. Do not include the angle brackets (<>).

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>DataAccessFunction
functions.description: Calls the procedures that modify your data access routines.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>EnvOption
functions.description: Calls your procedures to modify the simulation options.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>Flowchart
functions.description: Calls the procedures to initialize the flowchart for your simulator.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>KeepOption
functions.description: Calls the procedures to initialize your simulator keep option variables.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>NetlistOption
functions.description: Calls the procedures that modify your simulator's netlist options.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>SimOption
functions.description: Calls the procedures to add your simulator options.

functions.name: asiInitAdvAnalysis
functions.description: Initializes the tool-specific analysis options for the tools derived from the asiAnalog class. This method can be used by third-party integrators to define their own analysis options in ADE XL.

functions.name: asiInitAnalysis
functions.description: Initializes the tool-specific analysis options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own analysis options.

functions.name: asiInitDataAccessFunction
functions.description: Initializes the data access function for the tool. This function can be used by a third-party integrator to define their own data access functions.

functions.name: asiInitEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the tool-specific environment options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own environment options.

functions.name: asiInitMixedKeepOption
functions.description: Initializes the mixed-signal keep options variables.

functions.name: asiInitSimOption
functions.description: Initializes the simulation options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own simulation options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilog
functions.description: Initializes the Verilog tool.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the base Verilog environment options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogFNLEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the Verilog FNL netlisting options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogHNLEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the Verilog HNL netlisting options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogSimOption
functions.description: Initializes the simulation options for Verilog.

functions.name: asiInitialize
functions.description: Initializes the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This function is not called for tools that are derived from the asiSocket class.

functions.name: asiInitializeNetlisterMixed
functions.description: Initializes the mixed-signal netlister. Partitions the design and then calls nlCreateDesign to get the design object. Does not re-partition if the design has not changed since last partition.

functions.name: asiInterruptSim
functions.description: This method provides an interrupt to the simulation run process for a session. It is associated with the Simulation->Stop action in the user interface. This method is called by the environment. Therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be re-defined for the interface. Use callNextMethod in this definition.

functions.name: asiInvalidateControlStmts
functions.description: The asiInvalidateControlStmts function is a wrapper to asiInvalidateFlowchartStep, which invalidates the asiSendControlStmts flowchart step.

functions.name: asiInvalidateFlowchartStep
functions.description: Invalidates a flowchart step for a particular session.

functions.name: asiIsAnalysisEnabled
functions.description: Determines whether an analysis is enabled.

functions.name: asiIsCaseSensitive
functions.description: Determines whether the simulator is case sensitive or not. Returns t, if the simulator is case sensitive, else returns nil. The default value for this function is t.

functions.name: asiIsConfigDesign
functions.description: The function returns t if the design associated with the session is a Cadence 5.x configuration.

functions.name: asiIsICLPSupported
functions.description: Specifies whether the simulator supports ICLP simulations that are enabled by the Optimize Single Job Run option on the Job Policy Setup form.

functions.name: asiLoadState
functions.syntax: asiLoadState(  o_session [ ?name t_name ] [ ?option s_option ] [ ?stateDir t_stateDir ] [ ?lib t_lib ] [ ?cell t_cell ] [ ?simulator t_simulator ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a saved state into the current simulation environment directly from the CIW without displaying the Loading State form.

functions.name: asiMapInstanceName
functions.description: Maps the hierarchical schematic instance name to the name in the netlist.

functions.name: asiMapNetName
functions.description: Maps the hierarchical schematic net name to the name in the netlist.

functions.name: asiMapOutputName
functions.syntax: asiMapOutputName(  t_dir s_type t_name [ ?formatflag s_formatflag ] )  => l_nameList
functions.description: Maps the given schematic name of the given type using the netlist directory. The result is a list of mapped strings.

functions.name: asiMapTerminalName
functions.description: Maps the hierarchical schematic terminal name to the name in the netlist.

functions.name: asiNeedSuffixEvaluation
functions.description: Specify whether the interface needs suffix evaluation or not. When this method returns t, the numeric suffixes specified in a numericString field will be evaluated. For example, suppose the start frequency field for the AC analysis has a value of 10M, asiGetFormattedVal(ac_start_fieldObj ) returns 1e7 provided it is created as a `numericString field.

functions.name: asiNetlist
functions.description: Creates a design object and then a formatter object with nlCreateFormatter. After this, the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist. Netlist statistics are then printed. The netlister also provides a component count, as well as the addition of design variables found during netlisting.

functions.name: asiNetlistMixed
functions.description: This method performs mixed netlisting. It creates a formatter object with nlCreateFormatter, after which the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist.

functions.name: asiOpenOceanScript
functions.description: Opens the specified file for writing the OCEAN script. If the file exists, it asks for your permission to overwrite it.

functions.name: asiPartitionDesign
functions.description: This method partitions a mixed-signal design into analog and digital parts.

functions.name: asiPrepareDigitalSimulation
functions.description: Performs digital run directory clean up. It removes the file that stores the exit code for any previous digital simulation and cleans up the digital simulator old log file.

functions.name: asiQuitSimulator
functions.description: This function quits the simulator run process based on the ipc signal being sent to the specified process. By default, the direct integration code sends a hard-kill signal to the simulator process. To change this option and send a soft-kill signal, the ?mode option should be set to true and overloaded for yourSimulator session. This method is called by the environment, therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be re-defined for the interface. Use, callNextMethod in its definition.

functions.name: asiRawNetlist
functions.description: Creates a raw netlist.

functions.name: asiRegCallBackOnSimComp
functions.description: Registers the specified user-defined callback function to run after completion of a simulation. The callback function should accept two arguments, a session object and the simulation status.

functions.name: asiRegCallBackOnSimCompForDist
functions.description: Registers the specified user-defined callback function to run after completion of distributed jobs.

functions.name: asiRegisterTool
functions.syntax: asiRegisterTool( '<simulatorName> [ ?class			s_className ] [ ?private			s_private ] [ ?initFunc			s_initFunc ] [ ?mixedSig			s_mixedSig ] ) => t
functions.description: Registers your simulator and your initialization function.

functions.name: asiRemoveAllModelLibSelection
functions.description: Removes all the model files by setting the modelFiles variable to nil. In addition, it also invalidates the asiSendControlStmts flowchart step by calling asiInvalidateControlStmts.

functions.name: asiRunSimulation
functions.description: This function runs the simulation for the session. It is called by the environment, so you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be redefined for the interface. Use callNextMethod in this definition.

functions.name: asiSaveState
functions.syntax: asiSaveState(  o_session [ ?name t_name ] [ ?option s_option ] [ ?stateDir t_stateDir ] [ ?lib t_lib ] [ ?cell t_cell ] [ ?simulator t_simulator ] [ ?description t_description ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the current state of the current simulation environment directly from the CIW without displaying the Saving State form.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisCompParam
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisCompParam(  s_analysisName  s_instField s_parField ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select a component instance from the schematic to pop up a list box containing the parameters for that instance.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisInst
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisInst(  s_analysis s_field [ t_prompt ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select an instance from the schematic to be used as input for the specified field for the specified analysis. If the user selects any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisNet
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisNet(  s_analysis  s_field  [ t_prompt ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select a net from the schematic to be used as input for the specified field for the specified analysis. If the user selects any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisSource
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisSource(  s_analysis  s_field  [ t_prompt ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select a source from the schematic to be used as input for the specified field for the specified analysis. If the user selects any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectInst
functions.syntax: asiSelectInst( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select an instance from the schematic. If you select any other object, the system beeps and ignores the selection.

functions.name: asiSelectNet
functions.syntax: asiSelectNet( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select a net from the schematic. If you select any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectSourceInst
functions.syntax: asiSelectSourceInst( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select a source instance on the schematic. If you select any other object, the system beeps and ignores the selection.

functions.name: asiSelectTerm
functions.syntax: asiSelectTerm( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select an instance terminal from the schematic. If you select any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectTermNet
functions.syntax: asiSelectTermNet( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select either an instance terminal or a net. If you select any other object, the system beeps and ignores the selection.

functions.name: asiSendAnalysis
functions.description: Sends analyses to Cadence SPICE by calling asiFormatAnalysis for each analysis.

functions.name: asiSendControlStmts
functions.description: Sends information such as nodesets, initial conditions, keep lists or output, analyses, restore files, include files, and stimulus files to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendDesignVars
functions.description: Sends the design variables to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendInitCond
functions.description: Places all the initial conditions in <netlistDirectory>/raw/ics and sends a ptprop command to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendInitFile
functions.description: Sends the init.s file to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendKeepList
functions.description: Sends the keep list to Cadence SPICE. The keep list can contain a list of nets or currents to save and it can contain statements to keep all nets or keep all currents.

functions.name: asiSendModelPath
functions.description: Sends the model path to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendNetlist
functions.description: Sends the raw netlist to Cadence SPICE using the Cadence SPICE sim command.

functions.name: asiSendNodeSets
functions.description: Places all the nodesets in <netlistDirectory>/raw/nodesets and sends a ptprop command to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendOptions
functions.description: Sends the simulation options to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendRestore
functions.description: If DC restore is on, send the commands to restore the DC node voltages to Cadence SPICE. If DC restore is off, sends the commands to turn off the DC restore function to Cadence SPICE. This function also works for the transient restore function.

functions.name: asiSendSim
functions.syntax: asiSendSim(  o_session  t_command  t_callback  g_param  g_saveOutput ) => t
functions.description: Sends a command to Cadence SPICE to forward to the target simulator.

functions.name: asiSendUpdateFile
functions.description: Sends the update.s file to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSetAnalogSimulator
functions.description: Sets the analog simulator.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFieldChoices(  o_analysis  s_fieldName  l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box for an analysis field.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFieldVal(  o_analysis  s_fieldName  g_value  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for a field of an analysis.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldChoices(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  l_choices  ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Sets the list of choices for the specified field on the Choosing Analyses form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldVal(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  g_value  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a field on the Choosing Analyses form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFormWidth
functions.description: Sets the width of the Choosing Analyses form. You need to add a call to this procedure to the analysis.il file if you do not want the inherited width of the analysis form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisOptionChoices( o_analysis  s_optionName  l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices for an analysis option that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisOptionFormProperties
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisOptionFormProperties( o_analysis [ ?type s_type ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?columns x_columns ] ) => o_formObj / nil
functions.description: Sets the display characteristics for a new analysis options form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisOptionVal(  o_analysis  s_optionName  g_value  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of an option in an analysis.

functions.name: asiSetDesignVarList
functions.description: Sets the design variable list for a session.

functions.name: asiSetDigitalSimulator
functions.description: Sets the digital simulator.

functions.name: asiSetEMIROptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetEMIROptionVal( o_session  s_name g_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the given value for the specified EMIR option.

functions.name: asiSetEnvOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetEnvOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box field for the specified environment option.

functions.name: asiSetEnvOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetEnvOptionVal( { o_session | o_tool } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified simulation environment option.

functions.name: asiSetFormFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetFormFieldChoices(  r_form  s_fieldName  l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Sets the list of choices to appear in the list box for the specified form field.

functions.name: asiSetFormFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiSetFormFieldVal(  r_form s_fieldName g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a field on a form.

functions.name: asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal(  s_sessionName  s_varName  s_varValue  )   => t_Value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for the specified High Performance option variable.

functions.name: asiSetHostOptions
functions.syntax: asiSetHostOptions( o_session t_hostMode [ t_host ] [ t_remoteDir ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the host mode, host and remote directory for simulation.

functions.name: asiSetKeepList
functions.description: Sets the list of the specific signals and currents to save during simulation.

functions.name: asiSetKeepOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetKeepOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box field for the specified keep option.

functions.name: asiSetKeepOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetKeepOptionVal( { o_tool | o_session } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for the specified keep option variable for a tool or session object.

functions.name: asiSetMarchList
functions.description: Sets the list of signals to march during simulation.

functions.name: asiSetNetlistFormatterClass
functions.description: Registers the netlist formatter class with the tool. This function is normally called from the asiInitFormatter method and should be defined for the interface.

functions.name: asiSetNetlistOption
functions.syntax: asiSetNetlistOption(  { o_session | o_tool } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets a netlisting option.

functions.name: asiSetPageCallBack
functions.description: Returns the status (whether successful or failed) of the specified callback function, when changing tabs in a form.

functions.name: asiSetPlotList
functions.description: Sets the plot list for the current simulation session.

functions.name: asiSetProjectDirChangeSetup
functions.description: Enables you to modify the simulator settings for the given session after changing the project directory. This function is called by the environment. Therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface.

functions.name: asiSetSimOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetSimOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box field for the specified simulator option.

functions.name: asiSetSimOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetSimOptionVal( { o_session | o_tool } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified simulator option.

functions.name: asiSetSyncFlag
functions.description: This function makes the simulation run in a blocking mode. This implies that control does not come back till the simulation is over. This functionality is needed in the replay files in order to wait for a simulation to finish before proceeding. Call this function (asiSetSyncFlag(t)) just before launching a simulation. This function should only be used for testing capabilities. OCEAN should be used for scripting simulations.

functions.name: asiSetValid
functions.description: The functions sets valid analysis in the current simulation environment. The call to asiSetValid should be used with asiCheck/asiCheckAnalysis method for the analysis.

functions.name: asiSetVerilogHost
functions.description: Sets the digital simulator host name for mixed-signal simulation.

functions.name: asiSetVerilogHostMode
functions.description: Specifies whether the digital simulator will run locally or on a remote host. If you specify remote, you must specify the host name by using the asiSetVerilogHost command.

functions.name: asiStmGenerateNetlist
functions.syntax: asiStmGenerateNetlist( o_session wavepath nodeDesc [ o_simOptions ] ) => l_netlistStatus
functions.description: Generates netlist, as part of preview waveform generation for a stimuli and saves it at the specified psf directory path.

functions.name: asiStmGenerateWaveform
functions.syntax: asiStmGenerateWaveform( o_session t_wavepath t_stimuliDesc [ o_simOptions ] [ o_varDefinitions ] ) => l_waveStatus
functions.description: Generates preview waveforms for the specified stimuli under the given directory path.

functions.name: asiStmRunSimulation
functions.syntax: asiStmRunSimulation( o_session wavepath nodeDesc [ o_simOptions ] [ o_varDefinitions ] ) => l_simStatus
functions.description: Runs a simulation by using the netlist generated by SKILL function asiStmGenerateNetlist, and writes the psf waveform data at the specified path.

functions.name: asiStmSupportWaveformGeneration
functions.description: Determines whether the Stimuli Assignment form supports waveform preview functionality or not.

functions.name: asiTransientStore
functions.description: Copies the final transient operating points in processId.tr to the name you pass in fileName. This function assumes that your simulator writes the final transient operating points to netlistDir/raw/processId.tr.

functions.name: asiUnRegCallBackOnSimComp
functions.description: Deregisters the specified callback function registered to run on completion of the simulation.

functions.name: asiUnRegCallBackOnSimCompForDist
functions.description: Unregisters the specified user-defined callback function that is registered using the asiUnRegCallBackOnSimComp function.

functions.name: asiVerilogNetlistMoreCB
functions.description: Displays the Verilog HNL Netlisting Option form.

functions.name: asiWriteOceanScript
functions.syntax: asiWriteOceanScript(  p_filePointer o_session [ ?noRun g_noRun ] [ ?fullKey g_fullKey ] [ ?calledFromCorners g_calledFromCorners ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Writes the OCEAN script.

functions.name: auCdl
functions.description: This function sets defaults of all the variables defined in si.env like preserveRES, shortRES as well as other global variables like cdlSimViewList, cdlPrintComments etc. The function also sets the list of functions and variables that must be unbound when environments(simulators) are changed.

functions.name: auLvs
functions.description: This is the primary function for LVS. It sets up all the actions needed to netlist the layout and schematics design as well as invoke LVS (for comparison) itself.

functions.name: auProbeAddDevsForNet
functions.description: This procedure enables you to select nets using the cursor or by typing the names in the CIW to add probes for all devices connected to the selected net. The function displays the prompt, Point to net or enter net name in CIW. On pointing to the net or typing the net name in CIW, probes would be added on all the devices connected to the selected net.

functions.name: axlAddJobPolicy
functions.syntax: axlAddJobPolicy(  t_jobPolicyName  t_selectedPath l_jobPolicyProperties )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds or saves a job policy at the specified location.

functions.name: axlAddModelPermissibleSectionLists
functions.description: Creates a new list or adds new section names to the existing list of permissible section names for the given model imported from a PCF file. If a model file includes many sections out of which only a limited number of sections are of relevance to your testbench, you can create a permissible section list for that model file. If the LimitModelSections environment variable is set to LimitedList, while displaying the list of section names in the Corners Setup UI, the tool checks the permissible section list for a model file and shows only the relevant names. If you specify a section name that is not included in the permissible list, the tool shows appropriate errors.

functions.name: axlAddOutputExpr
functions.syntax: axlAddOutputExpr( t_sessionName t_testName t_outputName [ ?expr t_expr ] [ ?evalType t_evalType ] [ ?exprDPLs l_exprDPLs ] [ ?plot g_plot ] [ ?save g_save ] ) => t / t_error
functions.description: Adds an output expression to a test setup.

functions.name: axlAddOutputSignal
functions.syntax: axlAddOutputSignal( t_sessionName t_testName t_signalName [ ?type t_outputType ] [ ?outputName t_outputName ] [ ?plot g_plot ] [ ?save g_save ] ) => t / t_error
functions.description: Adds a signal to a test setup.

functions.name: axlAddOutputs
functions.description: Defines one or more output measures in an OCEAN script.

functions.name: axlAddOutputsColumn
functions.description: Adds a new user-defined column to the outputs table.

functions.name: axlAddSpecToOutput
functions.syntax: axlAddSpecToOutput(  x_hsdb t_testName t_resultName [ ?min g_minValue ] [ ?max g_maxValue ] [ ?gt g_greaterThanValue ] [ ?lt g_lessThanValue ] [ ?range g_rangeValues ] [ ?tol g_toleranceValue ] [ ?info g_info ] [ ?weight g_weightingFactor ] [ ?corner g_cornerName ] )  => t / t_error
functions.description: Adds a specification to an output defined for a test. You can also use this function to modify an existing specification for an output.

functions.name: axlAttachJobPolicy
