functions.description: Saves the Palette configuration information in the specified file. This includes information about the Palette settings, such as the columns and toolbars currently displayed in the Palette.

functions.name: pteSaveGDSNumber
functions.description: Saves the active GDSII number layermap file.

functions.name: pteSaveLSWInfo
functions.syntax: pteSaveLSWInfo( t_configFilePath [ g_overwrite ] [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the current LSW Info file at the specified location. This file contains information about the state of the Palette. It does not store the color and lock information of layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteSaveLayerSet
functions.description: Saves the changes made to the layer set that is currently in use.

functions.name: pteSaveLayerSetList
functions.description: Saves the list of layer sets displayed in the Layer Set Manager to a file named layerset.order. The order in which the layer sets are listed and the enable state of each layer set is also saved.

functions.name: pteSaveLayerSetListInRepository
functions.syntax: pteSaveLayerSetListInRepository( t_layerSetRepositoryPath [ g_overwrite ] [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the list of layer sets displayed in the Layer Set Manager to a file named layerset.order in the specified repository. The order in which the layer sets are listed and their state-whether enabled or disabled-is also saved.

functions.name: pteSaveToTechFile
functions.description: Saves the display context from the Palette to the technology file. A display context determines display properties such as visibility and selectability of layer-purpose pairs, objects, and grids. The display context stored in individual layer sets is not considered.

functions.name: pteSelect
functions.syntax: pteSelect( t_rowPath t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects the specified layer, object, or grid. An item selected previously is not deselected when you run the command again to select another item. This function works only if the Selection Mode is set to Multi Selection.

functions.name: pteSelectAll
functions.description: Selects all items in the specified Palette panel. This function works only if the Selection Mode is set to Multi Selection.

functions.name: pteSetActiveLpp
functions.description: Sets the specified layer-purpose pair as active. A layer that is not defined in the technology file is not displayed in the Palette, and an invalid layer cannot be set as active. Therefore, ensure that the specified layer is defined in the technology file and is valid.

functions.name: pteSetActiveLppColor
functions.syntax: pteSetActiveLppColor( { grayColor | mask1Color | mask2Color } [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified color for the active layer-purpose pair. The lock state is set to unlocked.

functions.name: pteSetActiveLppColorLock
functions.syntax: pteSetActiveLppColorLock( { t | nil } [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Locks or unlocks the color on the current active layer-purpose pair.

functions.name: pteSetAllLSEnable
functions.description: Enables or disables all the layer sets listed in the Layer Set Manager, except the one that is currently in use.

functions.name: pteSetAllLayerSetMember
functions.syntax: pteSetAllLayerSetMember( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets all specified layer-purpose pairs as members of the layer set that is currently in use.

functions.name: pteSetAllSelectable
functions.syntax: pteSetAllSelectable( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets as selectable the specified items in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteSetAllStipple
functions.syntax: pteSetAllStipple( [ ?mode { Display | Selection } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets to visible the stipple for the specified layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteSetAllValidity
functions.syntax: pteSetAllValidity( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets as valid the specified items in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteSetAllVisible
functions.syntax: pteSetAllVisible( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets as visible the specified items in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteSetBindkeys
functions.description: Opens the Bindkey Editor form to the Palette section, with the Palette bindkeys displayed in the right pane.

functions.name: pteSetConfig
functions.syntax: pteSetConfig( t_configName t_configValue t_panelName [ w_windowId ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Assigns the specified configValue to the configName configuration parameter in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteSetFindModeOn
functions.description: Toggles the search mode for the specified window between Find and Filter.

functions.name: pteSetLSActive
functions.syntax: pteSetLSActive( ?layerSets t_layerSets ?turnOnVis { t | nil } ?turnOnSel { t | nil } ?turnOffAllVis { t | nil } ?turnOffAllSel { t | nil } ?deactivateOthers { t | nil } [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Activates one or more layer sets and can be used to force the visibility and selectability of the layer-purpose pairs contained in those layer sets. The visibility and selectability of layer-purpose pairs contained in layer sets previously set as active is affected only if the visibility or selectability of layer-purpose pairs contained in the layer set being set as active is forced.

functions.name: pteSetLSEnable
functions.syntax: pteSetLSEnable( t_layerSetName g_showState [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the specified layer set. The layer set currently in use cannot be disabled.

functions.name: pteSetLSPosition
functions.syntax: pteSetLSPosition( t_layerSetName x_position [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Moves the specified layer set to the specified position in the Layer Set Manager.

functions.name: pteSetLSSelectable
functions.syntax: pteSetLSSelectable( t_layerSetName g_selectabilityState [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Turns on or off the selectability state of all the layer-purpose pairs contained in the specified layer set.

functions.name: pteSetLSVisible
functions.syntax: pteSetLSVisible( t_layerSetName g_visibilityState [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Turns on or off the visibility state of all the layer-purpose pairs contained in the specified layer set.

functions.name: pteSetLayerSetColoredLpp
functions.syntax: pteSetLayerSetColoredLpp( t_layerSetName t_layerPurposeName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the layer-purpose pair for the specified layer set.

functions.name: pteSetLayerSetMember
functions.syntax: pteSetLayerSetMember( t_layerPurposeName g_memberState t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds or removes the specified layer-purpose pair from the layer set currently in use.

functions.name: pteSetLppVisibleByString
functions.syntax: pteSetLppVisibleByString( t_searchPattern g_visibilityState [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Searches for the specified search string based on the advanced search options (casing, match type, and search operator) set in the Layers panel, and sets the visibility state for all layer-purpose pairs that match the search criteria to the specified value.

functions.name: pteSetMPTSupportMode
functions.syntax: pteSetMPTSupportMode( w_windowId { t | nil } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables MPT support in the window with the specified ID.

functions.name: pteSetNoneLayerSetMember
functions.syntax: pteSetNoneLayerSetMember( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes from the active layer set all items that meet the specified criteria.

functions.name: pteSetNoneSelectable
functions.syntax: pteSetNoneSelectable( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Turns off the selectability of the specified items in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteSetNoneStipple
functions.syntax: pteSetNoneStipple( [ ?mode { Display | Selection } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Hides the stipple for the specified layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteSetNoneValidity
functions.syntax: pteSetNoneValidity( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets as invalid the specified items in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteSetNoneVisible
functions.syntax: pteSetNoneVisible( [ ?mode { Display | Selection | Propagate } ] [ ?only { t | nil } ] [ ?panel { Layers | Objects | Grids } ] [ ?window w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets as invisible the specified items in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteSetOnlySelectable
functions.syntax: pteSetOnlySelectable( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Turns on the selectability of the specified item in the specified panel. All other items in the specified panel are made non-selectable.

functions.name: pteSetOnlySelectableWithDepth
functions.syntax: pteSetOnlySelectableWithDepth( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Turns on the selectability of the specified layer-purpose pair and of the n layer-purpose pairs listed both above and below the specified layer-purpose pair in the Layers panel. The value n is obtained from the Depth for Selectability field in the Palette Options form. Selectability of all other layer-purpose pairs is turned off.

functions.name: pteSetOnlyVisible
functions.syntax: pteSetOnlyVisible( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Turns on the visibility of the specified item in the specified panel. All other items are made invisible.

functions.name: pteSetOnlyVisibleWithDepth
functions.syntax: pteSetOnlyVisibleWithDepth( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Turns on the visibility of the specified layer-purpose pair and of the n layer-purpose pairs listed both above and below the specified layer-purpose pair in the Layers panel. The value n is obtained from the Depth for Visibility field in the Palette Options form. Visibility of all other layer-purpose pairs is turned off.

functions.name: pteSetOption
functions.syntax: pteSetOption( t_optionName g_optionState [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Assigns a value to the specified Palette option.

functions.name: pteSetOptionString
functions.syntax: pteSetOptionString( t_envName t_envValue [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the state of a Palette environment variable during a Virtuoso session.

functions.name: pteSetRoutingDirection
functions.syntax: pteSetRoutingDirection( t_layerPurposeName t_routingDirectionName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the routing direction for the specified layer-purpose pair.

functions.name: pteSetSearchMatchCase
functions.syntax: pteSetSearchMatchCase( t_matchCaseType t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies whether search is case-sensitive or case-insensitive.

functions.name: pteSetSearchMatchType
functions.syntax: pteSetSearchMatchType( t_searchType t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Limits searches to items that match the search string, items with a specific prefix or suffix, or items that contain the search string as a substring.

functions.name: pteSetSearchOperator
functions.syntax: pteSetSearchOperator t_searchOperator t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default operator for the search criteria. Valid values are and, or, phrase, and not. Panel name is one of Layers, Objects, or Grids.

functions.name: pteSetSearchText
functions.syntax: pteSetSearchText( t_searchPattern t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Searches for the specified search string based on the casing, match type, and search operator set for the panel in which the search is to be performed.

functions.name: pteSetSelectable
functions.syntax: pteSetSelectable( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } g_selectabilityState t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the selectability state for the specified item.

functions.name: pteSetSelectableWithDepth
functions.syntax: pteSetSelectableWithDepth( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } g_selectabilityState t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the selectability for the specified layer-purpose pair and for the n layer-purpose pairs listed both above and below the specified layer-purpose pair in the Layers panel. The value n is obtained from the Depth for Selectability field in the Palette Options form.

functions.name: pteSetShowLockedColors
functions.syntax: pteSetShowLockedColors( { t | nil } [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays or hides the colors locked on shapes.

functions.name: pteSetShowUnlockedColors
functions.syntax: pteSetShowUnlockedColors( { t | nil } [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays or hides the unlocked colors on shapes.

functions.name: pteSetStipple
functions.syntax: pteSetStipple( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } g_stippleVisibilityState t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the stipple visibility state for the specified layer-purpose pair.

functions.name: pteSetValidity
functions.syntax: pteSetValidity( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } g_validityState t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the validity state for the specified item.

functions.name: pteSetVisible
functions.syntax: pteSetVisible( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } g_visibilityState t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the visibility state for the specified item.

functions.name: pteSetVisibleWithDepth
functions.syntax: pteSetVisibleWithDepth( { t_layerPurposeName | t_paletteElementPath } g_visibilityState t_panelName [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the visibility for the specified layer-purpose pair and for the n layer-purpose pairs listed both above and below the specified layer-purpose pair in the Layers panel. The value n is obtained from the Depth for Visibility field in the Palette Options form.

functions.name: pteSetWindowSynchro
functions.description: Synchronizes or desynchronizes the Palette.

functions.name: pteShowAllTools
functions.description: Displays all the toolbars in the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteShowMPTLPP
functions.syntax: pteShowMPTLPP( { t | nil } [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays in the Layers panel only those layer-purpose pairs that have color information.

functions.name: pteShowRoutingLPP
functions.description: Displays only the routing layer-purpose pairs in the Layers panel.

functions.name: pteShowUsedLPP
functions.description: Displays only the currently used layer-purpose pairs in the Layers panel.

functions.name: pteShowValidLPP
functions.description: Displays only valid layer-purpose pairs in the Layers panel.

functions.name: pteToggleAllLayerSetMember
functions.description: Toggles the layer set membership status of all the items in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleAllSelectable
functions.description: Toggles the selectability status of all the items listed in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleAllStipple
functions.description: Toggles the stipple visibility status of all the layer-purpose pairs in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleAllTools
functions.description: Toggles the display status of all toolbars in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleAllValidity
functions.description: Toggles the validity status of all the items in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleAllVisible
functions.description: Toggles the visibility status of all the items listed in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleLSActive
functions.syntax: pteToggleLSActive( ?layerSets t_layerSetName [ ?toggleVis { t | nil } ] [ ?toggleSel { t | nil } ] [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds or removes the specified layer set from the list of active layer sets. Additionally, toggles the visibility and selectability status of the various layer-purpose pairs contained in the layer set.

functions.name: pteToggleLayerSetEdition
functions.description: Displays or hides the membership status of layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteToggleLayerSetValidityEdition
functions.description: Displays or hides the validity and membership status of layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteTogglePanels
functions.description: Displays the contents of the specified panel and hides the other two panels.

functions.name: pteTogglePropagateAllSelectable
functions.description: Toggles the selectability status of all parent and child items in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteTogglePropagateAllVisible
functions.description: Toggles the visibility status of all parent and child items in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleShowMPTLPP
functions.description: Toggles the display of layer-purpose pairs in the Layers panel between all layer-purpose pairs and layer-purpose pairs with color information.

functions.name: pteToggleShowRoutingLPP
functions.description: Toggles the display of layer-purpose pairs in the Layers panel between routing layer-purpose pairs and all layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteToggleShowUsedLPP
functions.description: Toggles the display of layer-purpose pairs in the Layers panel between currently used layer-purpose pairs and all layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteToggleShowValidLPP
functions.description: Toggles the display of layer-purpose pairs in the Layers panel between valid layer-purpose pairs and all layer-purpose pairs.

functions.name: pteToggleToolbars
functions.description: Toggles the display status of all toolbars in the specified panel.

functions.name: pteToggleWindowSynchro
functions.description: Synchronizes or desynchronizes the Palette.

functions.name: pteUnRegisterUserLSManagerTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters the SKILL procedure that was registered using pteRegisterUserLSManagerTrigger.

functions.name: pteUnRegisterUserSelectionTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters the SKILL procedure that was registered using pteRegisterUserSelectionTrigger.

functions.name: pteUndockWindow
functions.description: Undocks the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteUnmapWindow
functions.description: Unmaps (hides, if displayed) the specified Palette panel.

functions.name: pteUnsetLSActive
functions.syntax: pteUnsetLSActive( ?layerSets t_layerSets ?turnOffAllVis { t | nil } ?turnOffAllSel { t | nil } [ w_windowId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deactivates one or more layer sets and can be used to force the visibility and selectability of the layer-purpose pairs contained in those layer sets.

functions.name: rdeCloseSession
functions.description: This function terminates the current Virtuoso Routing IDE session and closes the Virtuoso Routing IDE window. The rdeCloseSession function returns the GXL tokens if it was checked out by the rdeShow function.

functions.name: rdeCreateChamferFill
functions.syntax: rdeCreateChamferFill( [ ?all { t | nil } ]  [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?region l_region ]  [ ?layer lt_layer ]  [ ?lengthThreshold f_length ]  [ ?chamferValue1 {f_value1 | l_chamfer1} ] [ ?chamferValue2 {f_value2 | l_chamfer2} ] [ ?extendViaChamfer { t | nil } ] [ ?allowViolation { t | nil } ] [ ?outputPurpose t_purposeName ] [ ?materialRemovalPurpose t_purposeName ] [ ?chamferFilter l_filterCriteria ] [ ?useEdgeLength { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates chamfer fill on wires (pathSegs). The chamfer fill mechanism removes 90-degree corners by filling the corners of wires that form T-junctions, L-shaped wires, wire-to-via, wire-to-rectangle, and wire-to-polygon connections. T-junctions and L shapes created using only rectangles or polygons are not considered for chamfer fill.

functions.name: rdeCreateWireChamfer
functions.syntax: rdeCreateWireChamfer( [ ?all { t | nil } ] [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?region l_region ]  [ ?layer lt_layer ]  [ ?lengthThreshold f_length ] [ ?chamferValue1 {f_value1 | l_chamfer1} ] [ ?chamferValue2 {f_value2 | l_chamfer2} ] [ ?allowViolation { t | nil } ] [ ?innerChamfer { t | nil } ] [ ?chamferFilter l_filterCriteria ] [ ?chamferEndOfStripe { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates chamfers on wires (pathSegs). The wire chamfer mechanism replaces 90-degree wires with 45-degree wires.

functions.name: rdeDone
functions.description: This function closes the Virtuoso Routing IDE system.

functions.name: rdeEval
functions.syntax: rdeEval( t_expression [ g_openCurrentDesign ] [ s_doCheckPoint ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: This function evaluates the Tcl expression that is supplied. There are no arguments to open the current design and also perform a checkpoint once the Tcl expression is evaluated.

functions.name: rdeGetVar
functions.description: This function returns the Virtuoso Routing IDE environment variable. The Virtuoso Routing IDE environment variables are independent of the dfII environment package.

functions.name: rdeHide
functions.description: This function terminates the current Virtuoso Routing IDE session and closes the Virtuoso Routing IDE window. The rdeHide function returns the GXL tokens if it was checked out by the rdeShow function.

functions.name: rdeInspect
functions.description: This function displays the Virtuoso Routing IDE property inspector GUI. If a dbObject is supplied, then the inspector will show that object and its properties. If no object is supplied, then the currently open geWindow's cellview will be inspected.

functions.name: rdeOpenCurrentDesign
functions.description: This function will open the Virtuoso Routing IDE window and start the Virtuoso Routing IDE environment on the cellview that the geWindow has currently loaded. It will also make the current Virtuoso window ReadOnly until the window is closed.

functions.name: rdeRemoveChamferFill
functions.syntax: rdeRemoveChamferFill( [ ?all { t | nil } ]  [ ?region l_region ]  [ ?layer lt_layer ]  [ ?outputPurpose t_purposeName ] [ ?materialRemovalPurpose t_purposeName ] [ ?concaveOnly { t | nil } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes all the right-angled triangle shapes of purposes specified by outputPurpose and materialRemovalPurpose (except if concaveOnly is true). Usually, these shapes are created by the command rdeCreateChamferFill.

functions.name: rdeReplay
functions.syntax: rdeReplay( t_fileName  [ g_openCurrentDesign ] [ s_doCheckPoint ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: This function reads the supplied file name and send each line one-at-a-time to the Tcl interpreter. This is in contrast to rdeSource, in which the entire Tcl file is read into the interpreter and then executed. It may be useful in determining which line of a script file had an error, in case an error occurs. Since each line is executed independently, it is not possible to create expressions (such as function definitions) that span more than one line.

functions.name: rdeSequencer
functions.description: This function will display the auto router sequencer dialog box. It will obtain some values from the current geWindow. If there is no current geWindow, it will return nil.

functions.name: rdeSetVar
functions.description: This function sets the Virtuoso Routing IDE environment variable to the supplied value. The Virtuoso Routing IDE environment variables are independent of the dfII environment package.

functions.name: rdeShow
functions.description: This function displays the Virtuoso Routing IDE window.

functions.name: rdeSource
functions.syntax: rdeSource( t_fileName [ g_openCurrentDesign ] [ s_doCheckPoint ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: This function sources the Tcl expression that is supplied. There are arguments to open the current design and also perform a checkpoint once the Tcl file has been sourced.

functions.name: rteCheckAntenna
functions.syntax: rteCheckAntenna( [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?all g_all ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?set g_set ] [ ?excludeNets l_excludeNets ] [ ?model l_models ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Checks for process antenna violations for the entire design, specific nets, or nets in a set. You can choose to ignore specific nets.

functions.name: rteCheckDataForRouting
functions.syntax: rteCheckDataForRouting( [ ?mode t_mode ] [ ?designRuleSpec t_designRuleSpec ] [ ?fromRoutingLayer t_fromRoutingLayer ] [ ?toRoutingLayer t_toRoutingLayer ] [ ?annotate g_annotate ] [ ?reportFileName t_reportFileName ] [ ?selected g_selected ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Checks the technology data and the design data to ensure that the VSR router is able to perform correctly.

functions.name: rteCheckRoutability
functions.syntax: rteCheckRoutability( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?noBlockageCheck g_noBlockageCheck ] [ ?noMinSpaceCheck g_noMinSpaceCheck ] [ ?noMinWidthCheck g_noMinWidthCheck ] [ ?noViaCheck g_noViaCheck ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Checks the design for known conditions that can cause potential routing problems. Design Rule Checks applied to pins and some routability checks are performed primarily to determine the accessibility of pins. You can exclude any of the checks by specifying the appropriate argument. Annotations are automatically created for violations.

functions.name: rteComposeTrunks
functions.description: Converts pathSegs and vias to power trunks usable by both the power and signal routers. The function uses the current cellview and the selected set.

functions.name: rteCoverObstructionHilite
functions.description: Turns on the cover obstruction hilite sets if at least one cover obstruction has been defined in the top-level or masters.

functions.name: rteCoverObstructionUnHilite
functions.description: Turns off the cover obstruction hilite sets for the ones that are already turned on, if at least one cover obstruction has been defined in the top-level or masters.

functions.name: rteCreateBlockRingScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateBlockRingScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?contour g_contour ] [ ?channel g_channel ] [ ?blockClearance f_blockClearance ] [ ?horiLayer t_horiLayer ] [ ?vertLayer t_vertLayer ] [ ?latticeStyle g_latticeStyle ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a block ring routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreateCellRowsScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateCellRowsScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?allRouteLayers g_allRouteLayers ] [ ?routeLayers l_routeLayers ] [ ?endOfRow g_endOfRow ] [ ?extendToNearest g_extendToNearest ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a cell rows routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreateCoreRingScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateCoreRingScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?ringAtCenter g_ringAtCenter ] [ ?relativeTo s_relativeTo ] [ ?coreClearance f_coreClearance ] [ ?padClearance f_padClearance ] [ ?inAreaClearance f_inAreaClearance ] [ ?outAreaClearance f_outAreaClearance ] [ ?areaXLo f_areaXLo ] [ ?areaYLo f_areaYLo ] [ ?areaXHi f_areaXHi ] [ ?areaYHi f_areaYHi ] [ ?horiLayer t_horiLayer ] [ ?vertLayer t_vertLayer ] [ ?latticeStyle g_latticeStyle ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a core ring routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreatePadRingScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreatePadRingScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?allPinLayers g_allPinLayers ] [ ?pinLayers l_pinLayers ] [ ?railPins g_railPins ] [ ?edgePins g_edgePins ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a pad ring routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreatePinToTrunkScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreatePinToTrunkScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?allPinLayers g_allPinLayers ] [ ?pinLayers l_pinLayers ] [ ?useTrunkLayer g_useTrunkLayer ] [ ?trunkLayer t_trunkLayer ] [ ?minTrunkWidth f_minTrunkWidth ] [ ?minWireWidth f_minWireWidth ] [ ?maxWireWidth f_maxWireWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a pin to trunk routing scheme. A trunk is usually a power net created by power routing commands such as pad ring, core ring, block ring, stripes, or cell rows.

functions.name: rteCreateStripesScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateStripesScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?horiStripes g_horiStripes ] [ ?yStep f_yStep ] [ ?horiLayers l_horiLayers ] [ ?vertStripes g_vertStripes ] [ ?xStep f_sStep ] [ ?vertLayers l_vertLayers ] [ ?pinClearance f_pinClearance ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] [ ?minStripeWidth f_minStripeWidth ] [ ?offsetFrom s_offsetFrom ] [ ?leftOffset f_leftOffset ] [ ?bottomOffset f_bottomOffset ] [ ?useCenterLine g_useCenterLine ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a stripes routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreateViasScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateViasScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?layerRange g_layerRange ] [ ?minLayer t_minLayer ] [ ?maxLayer t_maxLayer ] [ ?cutArrayRule s_cutArrayRule ] [ ?cutArrayRows n_cutArrayRows ] [ ?cutArrayColumns n_cutArrayColumns ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a via insertion scheme.

functions.name: rteDecomposeTrunks
functions.description: Converts pathSegs and vias in power trunks to normal, routed pathSegs and vias. The function uses the current cellview and the selected set.

functions.name: rteDeleteRoutedNets
functions.description: Deletes the routed paths of all nets in the design. Optionally, you can preserve routed power nets.

functions.name: rteFixAntenna
functions.syntax: rteFixAntenna( [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?all g_all ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?set g_set ] [ ?excludeNets l_excludeNets ] [ ?layerList l_layerList ] [ ?fullRulesChecking g_fullRulesChecking ] [ ?maxWiresToPush x_maxWiresToPush ] [ ?model l_models ] [ ?useDiodes g_useDiodes ] [ ?useJumpers g_useJumpers ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Fixes process antenna violations for the entire design, a specific net, or nets in a set by inserting jumpers and/or diodes. You can choose to ignore specific nets.

functions.name: rteFixViolations
functions.syntax: rteFixViolations( [ ?cv d_cvID ] [ ?closeOpens g_closeOpens ] [ ?excludeNet t_excludeNet ] [ ?excludePowerGround g_excludePowerGround ] [ ?fixCrossing g_fixCrossing ] [ ?fixMfgGrid g_fixMfgGrid ] [ ?fixMinArea g_fixMinArea ] [ ?fixMinAreaAtPins g_fixMinAreaAtPins ] [ ?fixMinEdge g_fixMinEdge ] [ ?fixMinEncArea g_fixMinEncArea ] [ ?fixMinWidth g_fixMinWidth ] [ ?fixNumCuts g_fixNumCuts ] [ ?fixPortShort g_fixPortShort ] [ ?fixRouteGrid g_fixRouteGrid ] [ ?reducePinWireNotches g_ReducePinWireNotches ] [ ?maximizeCuts g_maximizeCuts ] [ ?offsetVia g_offsetVia ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?searchAndRepair g_searchAndRepair ] [ ?set g_set ] s_value ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: This function allows you to fix violations for a selected area or for an entire cellview.

functions.name: rteGeomAnd
functions.syntax: rteGeomAnd( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Generates new shapes that are common on two or more layer purposes.

functions.name: rteGeomAndNot
functions.syntax: rteGeomAndNot( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?size1 f_size1 ] [ ?size2 f_size2 ] [ ?trimCorners g_trimCorners ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Generates new shapes that exist on one layer purpose and do not overlap shapes on another layer purpose. You can optionally use sized shapes from one or both of the layer purposes. And you can choose to operate on a specific region or the entire design.

functions.name: rteGeomNot
functions.syntax: rteGeomNot( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Inverts the shapes on a layer purpose to generate new shapes.

functions.name: rteGeomOr
functions.syntax: rteGeomOr( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Merges all shapes on the input layer purposes and generates new shapes on the output layer purpose.

functions.name: rteGeomSize
functions.syntax: rteGeomSize( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?size f_size ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?trimCorners g_trimCorners ] [ ?fixEdgesToRegion g_fixEdgesToRegion ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Performs an oversize or undersize shapes on a specific layer purpose.

functions.name: rteGeomXor
functions.syntax: rteGeomXor( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Generates new shapes from shapes on either input layer purpose that do not overlap the other layer purpose.

functions.name: rteOptimizeRoute
functions.syntax: rteOptimizeRoute( [ ?cv d_cvID ] [ ?checkAntenna g_checkAntenna ] [ ?detailCritic g_detailCritic ] [ ?excludeNet t_excludeNet ] [ ?excludePowerGround g_excludePowerGround ] [ ?reduceVias g_reduceVias ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?set g_set ] [ ?useDoubleCutVias g_useDoubleCutVias ] ) ; => t / nil

functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteBlockRing( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?instances t_instances ] [ ?channels g_channel ] [ ?contour g_contour ] [ ?blockClearance f_blockClearance ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?lattice g_lattice ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil

functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteCellRow( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?routingArea l_routingArea ] [ ?rowEnd g_rowEnd ] [ ?extend g_extend ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes cell row routing for a layout cellview.

functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteCoreRing( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?coreClearance f_coreClearance ] [ ?padClearance f_padClearance ] [ ?inAreaClearance f_inAreaClearance ] [ ?outAreaClearance f_outAreaClearance ] [ ?routingArea l_routingArea ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?lattice g_lattice ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes core ring power routing for a layout cellview.

functions.name: rtePowerRoutePadRing
functions.syntax: rtePowerRoutePadRing( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?pads l_pads ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?railPins g_railPins ] [ ?edgePins g_edgePins ] ) ; => t / nil

functions.name: rtePowerRouteTieShield
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteTieShield( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?shieldTieFreq n_shieldTieFreq ] [ ?coaxTieFreq n_coaxTieFreq ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Ties shield wires to the shield nets in the entire design. Executed after creating shield nets either automatically or interactively.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteTrimStripes
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteTrimStripes( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?includeStraps g_includeStraps ] [ ?undoable g_undoable ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Trim existing stripes created by the rtePowerRouteStripes function.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteViaInsertion
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteViaInsertion( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?instances l_instances ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?minLayer t_minLayer ] [ ?maxLayer t_maxLayer ] [ ?rows n_rows ] [ ?columns n_columns ] [ ?squareCutArray g_squareCutArray ] [ ?useValidRoutingVias g_useValidRoutingVias ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes via insertion between previously routed power rings, stripes, and cell rows.

functions.name: rteSearchAndRepair
functions.syntax: rteSearchAndRepair( [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?closeOpens g_closeOpens ] [ ?excludeNet t_excludeNet ] [ ?excludeType t_excludeType ] [ ?set g_set ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?fullRulesChecking g_fullRulesChecking ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Searches for and fixes same net and different net spacing violations.

functions.name: sltSetContextSpecificationCells
functions.description: Defines a list of contexts for slotting. A slotting context has a name and an associated slotting specification cell in the format library/cell/view.

functions.name: sltShapeConsecutiveSlotting
functions.syntax: sltShapeConsecutiveSlotting( [ ?cv d_cellViewId ]  [ ?all { t | nil } ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?objects l_objects ] [ ?slotLength n_slotLength ] [ ?slotWidth n_slotWidth ] [ ?slotStaggered { t | nil } ] [ ?lengthWidthRatio n_lengthWidthRatio ] [ ?slotVia { t | nil } ] [ ?excludePins { t | nil } ] [ ?widthThreshold1 n_widthThreshold1 ] [ ?widthThreshold2 n_widthThreshold2 ] [ ?lSpacing1 n_lSpacing1 ] [ ?lSpacing2 n_lSpacing2 ] [ ?wSpacing1 n_wSpacing1 ] [ ?wSpacing2 n_wSpacing2 ] [ ?slotToEdge1 n_slotToEdge1 ] [ ?slotToEdge2 n_slotToEdge2 ] [ ?slotSpacingAtTurn1 n_slotSpacingAtTurn1 ] [ ?slotSpacingAtTurn2 n_slotSpacingAtTurn2 ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: slotSpacingAtTurn2

functions.name: soiEnableDrcDfm
functions.description: Enables the DRC/DFM tab in the Annotation Browser and the DRC/DFM commands in the Optimize menu in Layout XL.

functions.name: spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly
functions.syntax: spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly( d_lhsInst d_rhsInst n_minOd n_minPoly ) => n_odSpacing
functions.description: Calculates the required oxide diffusion spacing between two adjacent instances based on minimum oxide diffusion spacing and polysilicon spacing constraints.

functions.name: spdGetAbutName
functions.description: Returns the user abutment name associated with the specified abutment strategy registered using the spdGetUserAbutProc function.

functions.name: spdGetAbutStrategy
functions.description: Returns the abutment strategy associated with the specified user abutment name registered using the spdRegUserAbutProc function.

functions.name: spdGetSymDeviceInfo
functions.description: Returns an object containing information, such as length, width, fingers, and binding related to the specified symbolic device. This information can be used to write user callback functions.

functions.name: spdGetUserAbutProc
functions.description: Returns an object containing the registered user abutment options with associated user callbacks and the description that were registered using the spdRegUserAbutProc function.

functions.name: spdGetUserFlowProc
functions.description: Returns an object containing the user flow callbacks that were registered using the spdRegUserFlowProc function.

functions.name: spdPerformAbutment
functions.syntax: spdPerformAbutment( d_lhsInst d_rhsInst x_keepContacts t_abutStrategy { sdFirst | dummyFirst } ) => ld_chain / nil
functions.description: Performs abutment on two adjacent instances according to the specified arguments and the SPD P/N chain alignment setting.

functions.name: spdRegUserAbutProc
functions.syntax: spdRegUserAbutProc( l_abutNames t_abutProc t_checkProc t_restoreProc [ ?libName t_libName ] [ ?description t_description ] [ ?checkOdAbut t | nil ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers callback to check the design for OD abutment.  Registers a list of user-defined abutments and related callbacks to perform these abutments in the SPD Editing or SPD Preview window or when a layout generated using SPD is brought back to the SPD Editing window. You can register them globally or by name of the library. If the design contains instances from different libraries, SPD loads the user-defined abutments and related callbacks from only one of registered libraries.

functions.name: spdRegUserFlowProc
functions.syntax: spdRegUserFlowProc( [ ?postGen t_postGenProc ] [ ?preGen t_preGenProc ] [ ?postGenLayout t_postGenLayProc ] [ ?symPreviewInstParam t_symPreviewInstParamProc ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers user-defined callbacks to further customize the design in specific steps of the SPD flow.

functions.name: spdUnregUserAbutProc
functions.description: Unregisters the current user abutment callback for the specified library. You cannot unregister a callback during an SPD session because it is still in use.

functions.name: spdUnregUserFlowProc
functions.description: Unregisters the current user flow callback. You cannot unregister a callback during an SPD session because it is still in use.

functions.name: techGetLxExtractLayers
functions.description: Returns the list of extract layers from the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. These layers are listed as validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group.

functions.name: techGetLxNoOverlapLayers
functions.description: Lists the pairs of layers that cannot overlap.

functions.name: techIsLxExtractLayer
functions.description: Indicates whether the specified layer is listed as an extract layer in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The extract layers are listed under validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group.

functions.name: techIsLxNoOverlapLayer
functions.syntax: techIsLxNoOverlapLayer( d_techFileID tx_layer1 tx_layer2 ) => t / nil
functions.description: Indicates whether the specified pair of layers is a derived no overlap layer in the specified technology file. The order in which the layers is specified does not matter.

functions.name: techSetLxExtractLayer
functions.description: Adds the specified layer to the list of extract layers in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The extract layers are listed under validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group. If any of the necessary technology file sections do not already exist, this function creates them.

functions.name: techSetLxExtractLayers
functions.description: Adds the specified layers to the list of extract layers in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The extract layers are listed under validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group. If any of the necessary technology file sections do not already exist, this function creates them.

functions.name: techSetLxNoOverlapLayer
functions.syntax: techSetLxNoOverlapLayer( d_techFileID tx_layer1 tx_layer2 ) => t / nil
functions.description: Derives a no overlap layer by performing an AND operation on the two specified layers, and flags it as an error layer in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The derived layer is defined in the techDerivedLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section of the technology file and is listed as an errorLayer in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group. No overlap layers are named and numbered consecutively; each is named noOverlapLayern, where n is the next available consecutive integer. If any of the necessary technology file sections does not already exist, the function creates them.

functions.name: techSetLxNoOverlapLayers
functions.description: Creates a list of layers that cannot overlap. The function creates a derived layer by performing an AND operation on each pair of layers and flags the resultant layer as an error layer in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. Each derived layer is defined in the techDerivedLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section of the technology file and is listed as an errorLayer in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group.

functions.name: tpaDeselect
functions.description: Deselects the specified items on the Track Pattern Assistant.

functions.name: tpaSelect
functions.description: Selects the specified item on the Track Pattern Assistant.

functions.name: tpaSelectWSSPDef
functions.description: Selects the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) on the Track Pattern Assistant. This is similar to selecting the WSSPDef in the Track Pattern Assistant.

functions.name: tpaSetActivePattern
functions.description: Sets the active pattern for the given width spacing snap pattern definition (WSSPDef).

functions.name: tpaSetAllDefsVisible
functions.description: Sets the visibility of the active width spacing snap pattern definitions (WSSPDefs) to All Visible (AV) or None Visible (NV) for a cellview.

functions.name: tpaSetDefVisible
functions.description: Sets the visibility of the active pattern for the given width spacing snap pattern definition (WSSPDef) or snap pattern definition (SPDef) in the Track Pattern table. If the WSSPDef or SPDef is enabled in the Track Pattern table, this also controls the visibility of the active pattern in the canvas.

functions.name: tpaSetFilterByName
functions.description: Sets the related snap pattern (RSP) filter by name or by other filters specified in the Track Pattern assistant.

functions.name: tpaSetFilterByNumber
functions.description: Sets the Track Pattern Assistant Filter field using the list order number for the desired setting.

functions.name: tpaSetRegionActivePattern
functions.syntax: tpaSetRegionActivePattern( t_regionName t_wsspDefName t_wspName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the active width spacing pattern (WSP) of the specified width spacing snap pattern definition (WSSPDef) on a local region.

functions.name: tpaSetRegionDefVisible
functions.syntax: tpaSetRegionDefVisible( t_regionName t_defName  g_visible ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the visibility of the width spacing snap pattern definition (WSSPDef) or snap pattern definition (SPDef) on a local region.

functions.name: tpaSetRegionWireType
functions.syntax: tpaSetRegionWireType( t_regionName t_wspDefName  l_wireTypeNames  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the active wire types of the specified width spacing snap pattern definition (WSSPDef) on a local region.

functions.name: tpaSetWireType
functions.description: Sets the active wire types for the active width spacing pattern (WSP) of the given width spacing snap pattern definition (WSSPDef).

functions.name: tpaToggleDef
functions.description: Enables or disables the specified WSSPDef or SPDef.

functions.name: tpaToggleLayer
functions.description: Sets the visibility for the active pattern of the enabled WSSPDef or SPDef on the given snapping layer.

functions.name: tpaToggleRegionLayer
functions.syntax: tpaToggleRegionLayer( t_regionName t_layerName  g_visible  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the visibility for the layer of the specified region.

functions.name: tpoIsLayoutEXL
functions.description: Checks if the specified window is open in Layout EXL or a higher tier.

functions.name: tpoIsLayoutXL
functions.description: Checks if the specified window is open in Layout XL or a higher tier.

functions.name: ttrGetCurrentScope
functions.description: Returns the names of the active scopes. An active scope can be enabled for tracking by using the ttrStartTracking SKILL function.

functions.name: ttrGetScopes
functions.description: Returns the list of child scope names for a given scope.

functions.name: ttrGetTime
functions.description: Returns the accumulated tracking time data for the given scope.

functions.name: ttrStartTracking
functions.description: Starts tracking the time spent on various operations in the given scope. The tracking continues until it is stopped using ttrStopTracking.

functions.name: ttrStopTracking
functions.description: Stops tracking the time for the given scope name.

functions.name: updateReturnPopupMenuItem
functions.description: Adds the Return menu item to the pop up menu specified.

functions.name: vcpfeCreateRows
functions.syntax: vcpfeCreateRows( d_cv t_mode [ ?partitionName t_partitionName ] [ ?area l_area ]  [ ?createRows g_createRows ] [ ?insertTapCells g_insertTapCells ] [ ?insertBoundaryCells g_insertBoundaryCells ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Estimates and creates rows according to the specified arguments. This command also places tap cells and boundary cells after row creation, which can be controlled using arguments.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceBoundaryCells
functions.syntax: vcpfePlaceBoundaryCells( d_cvId t_mode { insert | delete } [ ?regionList l_list ] [ ?leftCell t_name ] [ ?rightCell t_name ] [ ?leftBottomCornerCell t_name ] [ ?rightBottomCornerCell t_name ] [ ?leftTopCornerCell t_name ] [ ?rightTopCornerCell t_name ] [ ?topEdgeCell t_name ] [ ?bottomEdgeCell t_name ] [ ?leftMirror { t | nil } ] [ ?rightMirror { t | nil } ] [ ?leftCornerMirror { t | nil } ] [ ?rightCornerMirror { t | nil } ] [ ?outside { t | nil } ] [ ?topBotRowPlaceable { t | nil } ] [ ?boundaryCompTypes t_name ] [ ?libraryFilter t_name ] [ ?selectedBoundaryCells t_name ] ) => l_cellIDs / nil
functions.description: Places boundary cells around core cells to isolate the core cells from each other.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceConstraintGroup
functions.description: Returns the name of the constraint group that will be used when the placer is run on the specified cellview.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceFillers
functions.syntax: vcpfePlaceFillers( d_cv g_mode ?partitionName { prBoundary | g_clusterBoundaryName } ?fillerCompTypes t_fillerCompTypes ?fillerCellNames t_fillerCellNames ?ignoreBlockages { t | nil } ?createphysOnly { t | nil } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts or deletes filler cells from the specified cellview.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceTapCells
functions.syntax: vcpfePlaceTapCells( d_cv t_mode {insert | delete} [ ?partitionName t_name ] [ ?tapCompTypes t_types ] [ ?tapCellNames t_cellNames ] [ ?tapToTapSpacing f_value ] [ ?tapBackOff f_value ] [ ?minTapSpacing f_value ] [ ?tapPattern {Regular | Checker Board} ]  [ ?skipRow x_number ] [ ?tapRowOffset f_value ] [ ?tapRowEndOffset f_value ] [ ?periodicTap {t | nil} ] [ ?lockTap {t | nil} ] [ ?avoidAbutment {t | nil} ]  [ ?ignoreBlockages {t | nil} ] ) => l_tapCellIDs / nil
functions.description: Inserts tap cells in the empty spaces between standard cells in the specified cellview as per the specified arguments. When t_mode is set to delete, all tap cells in the given cellview are deleted.

functions.name: vcpfeRegisterPostPlacementProc
functions.description: Registers the specified user-defined post-placement procedure. The procedure is called after running automatic placement.

functions.name: vcpfeRunCustomDigitalPlacer
functions.syntax: vcpfeRunCustomDigitalPlacer( d_schCvID d_layCvID [ ?groupCMOSPairs { t | nil } ] [ ?preserveChains { t | nil } ] [ ?groupMFactors { t | nil } ] [ ?allowRotation { t | nil } ] [ ?selectedCompList l_selectedCompList ] [ ?placementMode { Auto Placement | ECO Placement } ] [ ?optimization { none | basic | moderate | optimized } ] [ ?ecoModeImpact { none | localized | maximized } ] [ ?insertSubstrateContacts { t | nil } ] [ ?saveAs { t | nil } ] [ ?saveAsLibName t_libName ] [ ?saveAsCellName t_cellName ] [ ?saveAsViewName t_viewName ] [ ?overwrite { t | nil } ] [ ?intraRowSpacer { t | nil } ] [ ?interRowSpacer t | nil } ] [ ?adjustBdy { t | nil } ] [ ?reserveTracksForRouting { -1 | 0 | 1 ... 10 } ] [ ?vcpRulesConstraintGroup t_constraintGroupName ] [ ?minBoundaryOffset f_offset ] [ ?maxPinsPerNet x_numPins ] [ ?mixedMode { t | nil } ] [ ?placeCluster t_clusterName ] [ ?componentEdge { Boundary | Bounding Box } ] ) => t
functions.description: Runs the custom digital placer, specifying the type of placement that is done, the technology rules to be used, any automatic spacing adjustments to be done, and how the modified cellview is saved.

functions.name: vdrCheckVoltageLabels
functions.syntax: vdrCheckVoltageLabels( d_cellviewID [ t_reportFilename ] [ g_enablePopup ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that all top-level nets in the specified layout cellview are correctly labeled on the canvas.

functions.name: vdrCreateUserdvConstraintsFromFile
functions.syntax: vdrCreateUserdvConstraintsFromFile( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileName ) => nil
functions.description: Creates User Delta Voltage (userdv) constraints in the specified source schematic cellview based on information from the given CSV file. The schematic view is opened in read-only mode.

functions.name: vdrCreateVSyncConstraintsFromFile
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVSyncConstraintsFromFile( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileName ) => nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Creates Voltage Synced Net (vsync) constraints in the specified source schematic cellview based on information from the given CSV file. The schematic view is opened in read-only mode.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageLabel
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageLabel( d_cellviewID lt_datasetName t_lowVPurposeName t_highVPurposeName [ f_labelHeight ] [ g_externalNets ] [ g_internalNets ] [ g_update ] [ g_generateLabels ] [ g_overrideMode ] [ x_hierStopLevel ] [ u_customFunc ] [ u_postLabelCreationCB ] [ t_voltageInfoFile ] [ t_layerPurposeFile ] [ g_verbose ] [ t_logFile ] [ g_propagateNetVoltages ] [ lt_sourceName ] [ g_schematicCSV ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates labels on the nets in a layout design reflecting the minimum and maximum voltages from simulation data or a specified list of sources. Labels can also be generated for nets on which no geometry exists if the vdrZeroShapeNets environment variable is set to t.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageLabelEx
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageLabelEx( d_cellviewID lt_datasetName t_lowVPurposeName t_highVPurposeName [ ?labelHeight f_labelHeight ] [ ?externalNet { t | nil } ] [ ?internalNet { t | nil } ] [ ?update { t | nil } ] [ ?generateLabel { t | nil } ] [ ?overrideMode { t | nil } ] [ ?hierStopLevel x_hierStopLevel ] [ ?customFunc u_customFunc ] [ ?postLabelCreationCB u_postLabelCreationCB ] [ ?dataFile t_voltageInfoFile ] [ ?lppFile t_layerPurposeFile ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] [ ?logFile t_logFile ] [ ?propagateNetVoltages { t | nil } ] [ ?source lt_sourceName ] [ ?schematicCSV { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates labels on the nets in a layout design reflecting the minimum and maximum voltages from simulation data or a specified list of sources. Labels can also be generated for nets on which no geometry exists if the vdrZeroShapeNets environment variable is set to t.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageLabelOnNets
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageLabelOnNets( d_cellviewID ld_netIDs t_lowVPurposeName t_highVPurposeName [ f_labelHeight ] [ u_customFunc ] [ lt_ignoreZeroVoltNets ] [ u_postLabelCreationCB ] [ t_layerPurposeFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates labels from the voltage values entered manually in the Property Editor assistant for the specified top-level nets in the given cellview. The labels are created on the geometry of the net in question. Where there is no geometry, the labels are created on all the Pcell and instance terminals connected to the net. The command works only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageMarkers
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageMarkers( d_cellviewID t_voltagePurposeFile [ ?dataset t_datasetName ] [ ?update { t | nil } ] [ ?override_mode { t | nil } ] [ ?size f_markerHeight ] [ ?externalNet { t | nil } ] [ ?internalNet { t | nil } ] [ ?hierStopLevel x_hierStopLevel ] [ ?postMarkerCreationCB u_postMarkerCreationCB ] [ ?csvFile t_voltageInfoFile ] [ ?voltageRounding { roundOff | floor | ceiling } ] [ ?mode { maxVoltage | minVoltage | bothVoltage } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates markers for minimum and/or maximum voltages on the nets in the specified design. Voltage information can be taken from simulation datasets, from user-defined voltages on nets, or from a voltage information file. The voltage purpose file specifies on which layer-purpose pair a marker is created depending on the voltage value in question.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageMarkersOnNets
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageMarkersOnNets( d_cellviewID ld_netIDs t_voltagePurposeFile [ ?size f_markerHeight ] [ ?postMarkerCreationCB t_postMarkerCreationCB ] [ ?voltageRounding { roundOff | floor | ceiling } ] [ ?voltageMode { maxVoltage | minVoltage | bothVoltage } ] [ ?ignoreZeroVoltNets lt_netNames ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates markers from the voltage values entered manually in the Property Editor assistant for the specified top-level nets in the given cellview.

functions.name: vdrDebuggerGUI
functions.description: Opens the VDR Debugger form.

functions.name: vdrDeleteGUI
functions.description: Opens the Delete VDR Objects form, where you can select Labels/Markers, VSync Shapes, and Userdv Shapes check boxes to delete voltage labels and markers, VSync shapes, and Userdv shapes, respectively.

functions.name: vdrDeleteLabels
functions.description: Deletes from the specified cellview all the labels and markers created using the VDR flows.

functions.name: vdrDisplaySchematicGUI
functions.description: Opens the Voltage Dependent Rules form, which you can use to transfer voltage data on schematic nets from the specified simulation voltage datasets. This function works only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.name: vdrGenerateLabelsGUI
functions.description: Opens the Voltage Dependent Rules form, which you can use to create voltage labels or markers on nets. The command works only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.name: vdrGenerateUserdvShapes
functions.syntax: vdrGenerateUserdvShapes( d_cellviewID [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] [ ?logFile t_logFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 EXL Only) Creates User Delta Voltage (Userdv) shapes between nets that are constrained by a User Delta Voltage constraint. The Userdv marker shape and associated text label that are created correspond to each User Delta Voltage constraint. You can optionally print messages relating to problems encountered during Userdv shape creation and save these messages to a specified log file if required.

functions.name: vdrGenerateVSyncShapes
functions.syntax: vdrGenerateVSyncShapes( d_cellviewID [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] [ ?logFile t_logFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 EXL Only) Creates voltage sync (vsync) shapes between nets that are constrained by a common voltage sync constraint. You can optionally print messages relating to problems encountered during vsync shape creation and save these messages to a specified log file if required.

functions.name: vdrGetValidLayers
functions.description: Returns the list of valid layers on which labels or markers can be generated. The list was specified previously using the vdrSetValidLayers function.

functions.name: vdrRunSanityChecker
functions.syntax: vdrRunSanityChecker( d_cellviewID [ g_checkMarkers ] [ g_checkAgainstLayout ] [ f_tolerance ] [ g_isToleranceAbsolute ] [ t_logFile ] [ t_csvName ] [ l_datasets ] [ t_checkAgainstSource ] [ g_completeHierarchy ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks constrained voltage labels in the layout against the voltage values stored in the schematic or layout net properties and reports any discrepancies between the values. You can optionally apply a threshold up to which mismatches are tolerated and not reported. You can also specify the location and name of a log file in which the report is captured.

functions.name: vdrRunUserdvSanityChecker
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 EXL Only) Checks whether there are valid User Delta Voltage (Userdv) shapes on nets that are constrained by a common Userdv constraint. The checker reports any Userdv shapes that are wrongly created and any nets that have a Userdv constraint defined but no Userdv shape between them.

functions.name: vdrRunVSyncSanityChecker
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 EXL Only) Checks whether there are valid voltage sync (vsync) shapes on nets that are constrained by a common vsync constraint. The checker reports any vsync shapes that are wrongly created and any nets that have a vsync constraint defined but no vsync shape between them.

functions.name: vdrSanityCheckerGUI
functions.description: Opens the VDR Sanity Checker form, which you can use to check constrained VDR voltage labels in the layout view and report any labels that are missing or which have values different from the values specified for the net in the schematic or layout design.

functions.name: vdrSetNetVoltageRange
functions.syntax: vdrSetNetVoltageRange( t_libName t_cellName l_viewList [ ?netVoltages l_netVoltages ] [ ?voltageDataFile t_voltageInfoFile ] [ ?verbose { t | nil } ] [ ?logFile t_logFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets net voltages in the specified list of cellviews. The voltages can be either specified directly as a list when the command is called or read from voltage information file.

functions.name: vdrSetValidLayers
functions.syntax: vdrSetValidLayers( d_cellviewID { l_layers | nil } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies a list of valid layers on which labels or markers can be generated. The software creates labels or markers only for nets on one of the listed layers. Each subsequent call to the function overrides all the previously set layers.

functions.name: vdrTransferVSyncConstraints
functions.description: Transfers Voltage Synced Net (vsync) constraints from a specified source cellview to the specified target cellviews without opening any of the cellviews involved. If there is no target cellview specified, then the constraints are transferred to all open cellviews.

functions.name: vdrVsyncVisualizerGUI
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 EXL Only) Opens the VDR Constraints Visualizer form, which you can use to create Voltage Synced Net (vsync) constraints from the contents of a CSV file, list the vsync constraints currently present in the layout view, and delete those that are no longer required.

functions.name: vfoAbut
functions.syntax: vfoAbut( g_obj l_instsList [ @rest l_args ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Abuts the instances provided in the l_instList. You can pass optional arguments to this SKILL API. Note: The Abut command does not call the vfoAbut function for fluid devices.

functions.name: vfoAdvGRUpdateCDF
functions.syntax: vfoAdvGRUpdateCDF( g_obj t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => l_cdfParams
functions.description: Helps to modify the existing CDFs on a FGR device and add more CDFs on it. The function can be defined for subclasses of vfoAdvGuardRing. It works based on callback mechanism, that is, the user defines it and the infrastructure calls it.

functions.name: vfoAllocateProtocolObj
functions.description: Allocates and returns the newly allocated and initialized instance of the vfo protocol class of the Pcell. You can use the vfoGetProtocolClassName SKILL function to determine the name of the protocol class.

functions.name: vfoAllocateShapeData
functions.description: Returns a newly allocated and initialized instance of the subclass of the vfoShapeData  class for the specified database shape ID.

functions.name: vfoChopInstance
functions.syntax: vfoChopInstance( g_obj d_instId chopShapeData [ @rest l_args ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Chops the fluid shape of a given instance. The information of the chop rectangle or polygon is provided by chopShapeData which is a class object of vfoShapeData. The shape data points are in the design coordinates. This function transforms the chopShapeData before chopping the fluid shape.  Note: The Chop command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters. If the chop operation results in multiple shapes, it may need to create multiple Pcell instances.

functions.name: vfoConvertToPolygon
functions.syntax: vfoConvertToPolygon(  g_obj d_instId [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Converts the fluid shape of the given instance to a polygon. This is used for instances containing path type fluid shape. The Convert to Polygon command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfoCreateAutoFGR
functions.description: Wraps obstacles in wrap mode on clicking an obstacle if AUTO mode is selected in the Device field of the Create Guard Ring form. This function is used to specify the bindkey for creation of FGR in auto mode.

functions.name: vfoCreateObstruction
functions.syntax: vfoCreateObstructions( g_obj d_instId layerPurposePair obstructionShapeData [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. A tunnel helps you to cut a specific layer-purpose of a guard ring device for connectivity purpose. There are four types of tunneling mechanisms-Path, Rectangle, Polygon, and Overlapping Shape. For procedural details about creating tunnels using GUI, refer to the Creating a Tunnel Through a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.  Note: To remove any existing obstructions, use the vfoDeleteObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoCreateObstructions
functions.syntax: vfoCreateObstructions( g_obj d_instId l_lppPoint [ @rest l_args ] )  => nil
functions.description: Creates obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. A tunnel helps you to cut a specific layer-purpose of a guard ring device for connectivity purpose. There are four types of tunneling mechanisms-Path, Rectangle, Polygon, and Overlapping Shape. For procedural details about creating tunnels using GUI, refer to the Creating a Tunnel Through a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.  Note: To remove any existing obstructions, use the vfoDeleteObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoCreateShapeData
functions.description: Allocates, initializes, and returns an instance of the subclass of the vfoShapeData of the given shape type.

functions.name: vfoDeleteObstruction
functions.syntax: vfoDeleteObstruction( g_obj d_instId layerPurposePair obstructionShapeData [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. This SKILL function is equivalent to healing.  For procedural details about healing an obstruction using GUI, refer to the Healing a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.  Note: To create an obstruction, use the vfoCreateObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoDoSnapToSnapPattern
functions.description: Snaps the fluid object to the snap pattern.

functions.name: vfoDrawFluidShape
functions.syntax: vfoDrawFluidShape( g_shapeObj cellView layerPurposePair ) => d_obj / nil
functions.description: Creates a dbObject corresponding to shapeData object in the given cellview on the given layer purpose pair.

functions.name: vfoGRCleanVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGRCleanVersionCache( t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the index.pcl and cache.pcl files by removing any unused entries of sub-masters from these files. This is an alternative to cleaning the cache if you have disabled the automatic FGR cache cleaning mechanism described in the Automatic Cache Cleaning section, or even if the Automatic Cache Cleaning mechanism is enabled by you and would like to clean the FGR caches on-demand.

functions.name: vfoGRCompareParams
functions.syntax: vfoGRCompareParams( g_obj d_inst1 d_inst2 )  => t / nil
functions.description: Checks the equality of FGR instances. You override this function and can define its new  equality for FGR instances. By default, it checks the value of the following parameters: verticalPitch, horizontalPitch, verticalSegWidth, and horizontalSegWidth. This function is called by the Merge command. For the Merge command to succeed, this function should return t for the two FGR instances being compared.

functions.name: vfoGRCreateDeviceClass
functions.description: Creates the device class definition for fluid guard ring (cdsGuardRing) in the given technology file. If the device class already exists in the technology file, it is updated when override is set to true.

functions.name: vfoGRDisableVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGRDisableVersionCache( l_FGRcellDDID t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Disables version cache for all instances that belong to the specified super-master list and found in the specified library, cell, or view. All instances are updated and the value of their createVersionCache parameter is set to 0.

functions.name: vfoGREnableVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGREnableVersionCache( l_FGRcellDDID t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables version cache on all instances currently not cache-enabled that belong to the specified list of FGR super-masters and found in the in the specified library, cell, or view. The createVersionCache parameter of such instances will get updated from 0 to the VFO version of the current Virtuoso session.

functions.name: vfoGRGeometry
functions.description: Calls three generic functions in the following order: vfoSfInitialize(pcell), vfoSfDraw(pcell), and then vfoSfFinalize(pcell) for drawing the fluid Pcell geometry.  NOTE: This is the top-level entry point to the vfo space-filling Pcell.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCommonQPtr
functions.description: Returns the common queue pointer of the Create Guard Ring form customized by you.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormFieldProp
functions.description: Gets the value of a property assigned to an existing field or GUI component displayed on the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormIdentifier
functions.description: Returns the unique identifier string used for creating the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormPointer
functions.description: Returns the form pointer corresponding to the unique identifier that creates the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetExtraArgument
functions.description: Retrieves the value of user-defined fields, that is, list of `key value' pair set using the vfoGRSetExtraArgument SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoGRGetExtraArgumentName
functions.description: Returns the extra parameter names in a list. The end user should override this function for its class that has been extended from vfoAdvGuardRing.

functions.name: vfoGRGetQueuePointer
functions.description: Returns the pointer corresponding to the name of the queue of the customized Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRMaximizeShapes
functions.description: Tries all possible combinations of fillStyle and decompositionMode to find the combination that maximizes the number of shapes, and thereby the number of contact cuts.

functions.name: vfoGRNewCreateForm
functions.syntax: vfoGRNewCreateForm( t_uniqueFormIdentifier t_formType [ l_callbackList ] )  => r_formPointer / nil
functions.description: Creates the new Create Guard Ring form, that is, a new form pointer along with the unique fields and form symbol.

functions.name: vfoGRRegCreateFormUpdateCallback
functions.description: Registers the user-defined form customization procedure. This procedure gets called for the particular form pointer after the vfoGRUpdateCreateForm trigger is called.

functions.name: vfoGRSetCreateFormAllFieldsInvisible
functions.description: Sets the visible property for the predefined system fields, except the Technology and Device fields, on the Create Guard Ring form. This function cannot be used to set the properties of fields that you add while customizing the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRSetCreateFormFieldProp
functions.description: Sets the properties of the fields or components displayed on the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRSetExtraArgument
functions.description: Makes the values of the user-defined GUI components available for processing to the FGR infrastructure that resides in Virtuoso, and sets the corresponding CDF parameters. This SKILL function helps in binding the front-end data for back-end processing.

functions.name: vfoGRSmoothen
functions.description: Removes the small notches in the given direction from the fluid shape of the given fluid Pcell instance. The temporary shapes are created on tmpLpp.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateCreateFormSize
functions.description: Resizes the Create Guard Ring forms, including the form used for modgens. This function updates the size of all tabs and subtabs proportionately. However, there is no change in the size of the fields on the form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateTunnelLPPs
functions.description: Returns the layer-purpose pairs on which tunnelling is allowed. The VFO infrastructure selects common layer-purpose present in the FGR and LPPs returned by the function vfoGRUpdateTunnelLPPs. If the function vfoGRUpdateTunnelLLPs returns nil, all FGR layer-purposes are displayed on the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateTunnelOptions
functions.description: Returns the list of supported options for FGR tunnel shape types. VFO infrastructure uses options returned by this function and checks with the existing options. The first value returned by this function is selected by default when the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form opens. If the vfoGRUpdateTunnelOptions function is not defined, returns nil, or any invalid option is returned, all tunnel options are displayed on the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGRUpdateVersionCache( l_FGRcellDDID t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the vfoCreateVersion parameter of an instance to the current Virtuoso version. If the vfoCreateVersion parameter is set to 0, the vfoGRUpdateVersionCache function does not update the vfoCreateVersion parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. You have to call the vfoGREnableVersionCache function to update this parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. If the vfoCreateVersion parameter is set to an older Virtuoso version and the image of the sub-master is not found in the cache files, cache.pcl and index.pcl, the vfoGRUpdateVersionCache function does not update the vfoCreateVersion parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. You have to call the vfoGRDisableVersionCache function and then the vfoGREnableVersionCache function to update this parameter to the latest Virtuoso version.

functions.name: vfoGetDeviceClassParam
functions.syntax: vfoGetDeviceClassParam(  t_libName t_deviceName t_classParam )  => value / nil
functions.description: Returns the class parameter of the specified cdsGuardRing device. This SKILL function also supports the incremental technology database (ITDB). Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetDeviceFormalParam
functions.syntax: vfoGetDeviceFormalParam(  t_libName t_deviceName t_formalParam )  => value / nil
functions.description: Returns the implementation formal parameter of the specified cdsGuardRing device. This SKILL function also supports ITDB. Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetFileListWithLoadSequence
functions.description: Returns a list of vfo*.ils filenames with their loading sequence.

functions.name: vfoGetImplementationClassName
functions.description: Returns the value of the vfoGRImpl class parameter, that is the implementation class name, of an FGR device from the specified library. This SKILL function also supports the incremental technology database (ITDB). Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetInstWithMissingCache
functions.description: Returns three lists of dbIDs. The first is the list of dbIDs of all instances whose submaster is not found in index.pcl file. The second is the list of dbIDs of all instances whose submaster is found in index.pcl file but not found in cache.pcl file because the file is corrupt or missing. The third is the list of dbIDs of instances whose submaster is not found because the supermaster has been updated after instance creation.

functions.name: vfoGetParam
functions.description: Returns the value of a CDF parameter for the given object.

functions.name: vfoGetProtocolClassName
functions.description: Returns the symbol naming the protocol class to use with the fluid Pcell functions.

functions.name: vfoGetVersion
functions.description: Returns the version of the VFO SKILL code used in Virtuoso. This SKILL function is available from IC6.1.6 ISR2 and ICADV12.1 ISR4 onwards.

functions.name: vfoGrCreateCDF
functions.description: Creates fluid guard ring CDF parameters on the given library, cell view of the fluid guard ring device. It deletes any existing CDF parameters on the device.

functions.name: vfoInstallFluidDeviceFiles
functions.syntax: vfoInstallFluidDeviceFiles(  [ ?installPath t_installPath ] [ ?overwrite { t | nil } ] [ ?showMsg { t | nil } ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a set of Cadence-supplied SKILL files in a specific sequence in the Virtuoso environment. These files are required to work with fluid guard rings. These files are automatically loaded when you start Virtuoso.

functions.name: vfoIsCommandInDragMode
functions.description: Returns t if the vfo-related command is in drag mode, else returns nil.

functions.name: vfoIsGuardRing
functions.description: Returns t if the object to be queried is a valid guard ring instance, else returns nil.

functions.name: vfoMergeInstances
functions.syntax: vfoMergeInstances( g_obj d_inst1 d_inst2 [ @rest l_args ] )  => dbId / nil
functions.description: Merges the fluid Pcell instances inst1 and inst2. The Merge command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfoPostChopCBHandler
functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the chop command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoPostReshapeCBHandler
