functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the reshape command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoPostSplitCBHandler
functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the split command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoPostStretchCBHandler
functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the stretch command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoReInstallAllFluidGuardRingDevices
functions.description: Reinstalls all the FGR devices in the specified technology file.

functions.name: vfoReInstallGuardRingDevice
functions.description: Reinstalls the specified FGR devices in the specified technology file.

functions.name: vfoRotateInstance
functions.syntax: vfoRotateInstance( g_obj d_inst1 x_angle_in_degrees [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Applies the rotation angle on the FGR instance. This function applies to Pcells.

functions.name: vfoSetParam
functions.syntax: vfoSetParam( obj s_param value )  => value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a CDF parameter to the given value and triggers the callback, if any. The callback is triggered recursively so that if the callback changes another parameter, that callback is also triggered, recursively.

functions.name: vfoSetParams
functions.description: Sets the value of multiple parameters in a single call. The l_paramlist argument contains a list of parameter name and value pairs.

functions.name: vfoSetProtocolClassName
functions.description: Sets the protocol class for fluid Pcell for the given Pcell supermaster. This function gets called in the Pcell code for creating the supermaster of a fluid guard ring device in a text file.

functions.name: vfoSfDraw
functions.description: Draws the Pcell geometries using the information populated by the vfoSfInitialize function.

functions.name: vfoSfFinalize
functions.description: Performs any required cleanup.

functions.name: vfoSfInitialize
functions.description: This is the initialization function that is called during space-filling Pcell evaluation. This function initializes the slots and populates other required information for Pcell drawing (vfoSfDraw).

functions.name: vfoSfOuterEdgeCornerContRemoval
functions.description: Removes the ear-vertex and end-corner contacts from the corners of an FGR to ensure it is created with a smaller footprint. This is achieved by allowing specification of enclosure values lesser than the maximum value, but greater than the minimum value of the minOppExtension rule.

functions.name: vfoSmoothen
functions.syntax: vfoSmoothen( d_shape s_direction [ ?tmpLpp t_tmpLpp ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Smoothens the given polygon shape. If the shape is not a polygon, then the shape is returned unchanged.

functions.name: vfoSupportsAbut?
functions.description: Checks if the Abut operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsChop?
functions.description: Checks if the Chop operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsConvertToPolygon?
functions.description: Checks if the Convert to Polygon operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsCreateObstruction?
functions.description: Checks if the Create Obstruction (Tunnel) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsCreateObstructions?
functions.description: Checks if the Create Obstruction (Tunnel) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsDeleteObstruction?
functions.description: Checks if the Delete Obstruction (Heal) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsMerge?
functions.description: Checks if the Merge operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsRotation
functions.description: Checks of the Pcell instance supports rotation.

functions.name: vfoSupportsUpdateModelShape?
functions.description: Checks if the fluid shape of the given instance can be modified. This function is called by commands that directly update the fluid shape, such as Stretch, Reshape, Split, and Align.

functions.name: vfoSupportsVersionCache
functions.description: Checks whether the Version Cache Management feature is supported on the specified instance.

functions.name: vfoTransformFluidShape
functions.description: Applies the transform to the given shapeData. This function modifies the given shapeData object and returns it.

functions.name: vfoTunnelHigherMetalLayers
functions.description: Enables tunneling of high metal layers in a stacked metal fluid guard ring device. This function is called during the Pcell evaluation of fluid guard ring devices.

functions.name: vfoUpdateModelShape
functions.syntax: vfoUpdateModelShape(  g_obj d_instId shapeId newShapeType newPointList [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the given fluid shape of the Pcell instance. The new shape type and points are specified in the newShapeType and newPointList arguments, respectively. The newPointList points are in the design coordinates. This function transforms the newPointList before updating the fluid shape. The Edit command for fluid shapes does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfpAlignPins
functions.syntax: vfpAlignPins( t_referencePinFigNameList t_targetPinfigNameList g_topCellViewId ) => t / nil
functions.description: Aligns a list of target pins with respect to the position of a list of reference pins.

functions.name: vfpAutoPin
functions.syntax: vfpAutoPin( d_refView ?mode { cellview | selected } [ ?validRoutingLayer g_shapesOnRoutingLayersOnly ]  [ ?purpose t_shapesOnSpecificPurpose ]  [ ?schematicCheck g_schematicCheck ]  [ ?deleteMode { auto | all } ]  [ ?checkDuplicatePin g_checkDuplicatePin ] [ ?boundarySignalMode { single | multiple } ]  [ ?buriedSignalMode { single | multiple } ] [ ?boundaryMultipleMode { topLayer | useLayer } ] [ ?buriedMultipleMode { topLayer | useLayer } ] [ ?boundarySignalPinLayers t_boundarySignalPinLayers ] [ ?buriedSignalPinLayers t_buriedSignalPinLayers ] [ ?boundaryPowerPinLayers t_boundaryPowerPinLayers ]  [ ?buriedPowerPinLayers t_buriedPowerPinLayers ]  [ ?boundaryPinSize t_boundaryPinSize ] [ ?buriedPinSize t_buriedPinSize ] [ ?targetLPP t_targetLPP ]  [ ?pinConnectivity t_pinConnectivity ]  [ ?createLabel g_createLabel ]  [ ?enableColoring g_enableColoring ] [ ?createMetalShape g_createMetalShape ] [ ?metalShapeType { path | rectangle } ] [ ?hDepthCheck g_hDepthCheck ] [ ?startLevelValue x_startLevelValue ] [ ?createDeleteMode t_createDeleteMode ] [ ?preview g_preview ] [ ?customLengthsBoundaryShapePin t_customLengthsBoundaryShapePin ] [ ?customLengthsBuriedShapePin t_customLengthsBuriedShapePin ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Searches for net shapes in the specified window or cellview and automatically creates boundary and buried pins on these net shapes.

functions.name: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHier
functions.syntax: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHier( t_topLogicalLibName t_topLogicalCellName t_topLogicalViewName t_topPhysicalLibName t_topPhysicalCellName t_topPhysicalViewName t_FloorplanPropertyFileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a hierarchical floorplan. It takes the Floorplan property file and the names of the logical and physical top cellview names as inputs. The top logical lib cellview name should match the names provided in the Floorplan property file.

functions.name: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHierNoPropFile
functions.syntax: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHierNoPropFile( t_topLogicalLibName t_topLogicalCellName t_topLogicalViewName t_topPhysicalLibName t_topPhysicalCellName t_topPhysicalViewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a physical configuration without a Floorplanning property file.

functions.name: vfpCPHLoadFloorplanFile
functions.syntax: vfpCPHLoadFloorplanFile( t_topLogicalLibName t_topLogicalCellName t_topLogicalViewName t_FloorplanPropertyFileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Populates the CPH form in Soft Block mode by using the Floorplan property file.

functions.name: vfpCreateBoundaryPinsForSelectedShapes
functions.description: Creates boundary pins on selected shapes.

functions.name: vfpHiPushPreRoutesDown
functions.description: Invokes the GUI for pushing pre-routes down.

functions.name: vfpLoadPhysicalView
functions.syntax: vfpLoadPhysicalView( t_sourceLibName t_sourceCellName t_sourceViewName t_targetLibName t_targetCellName t_targetViewName [ ?updateInstances g_updateInstances ] [ ?updateInstanceOptions l_updateInstanceOptions ] [ ?updateDesignOptions l_updateDesignOptions ] [ ?updateSelectedNets l_updateSelectedNets ] [ ?loadPins s_updatePins ] [ ?mapperFile t_fileName ] [ ?addGeometries g_addGeometries ] [ ?addGeometryOptions l_addGeometryOptions ] [ ?updateBoundaries g_updateBoundaries ] [ ?updateBoundaryOptions l_updateBoundaryOptions ] [ ?replaceRows g_replaceRows ] [ ?replaceRowOptions l_replaceRowOptions ] [ ?replaceBlockages g_replaceBlockages ]  [ ?replaceHalos g_replaceHalos ]  [ ?replaceObstructionOptions l_replaceObstructionOptions ] [ ?transferConstraints g_transferConstraints ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the instances, pins, geometries, and P&R information from a source cellview to a target cellview. The source cellview acts as a template to perform the following in the target cellview:

functions.name: vfpPinConnectivitySetting
functions.description: This function takes no arguments. It invokes a GUI to enable the pin connectivity information setting.

functions.name: vfpPinSnapToEdge
functions.syntax: vfpPinSnapToEdge( ?cv d_cv [ ?pinIOType { input | output | inputOutput } ] [ ?pinTermNames l_pinTermNames ] [ ?edge { Left | Right | Top | Bottom | Nearest } ] [ ?layerName t_layerName ] [ ?skipTracks x_numTracks ] [ ?honorCurrentLocation { t | nil } ] [ ?verboseMode { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Snaps pins to the specified edge. You can select pins by specifying either their I/O types or terminal names. You can also change the pin layers and skip tracks between pins.

functions.name: vfpPtAddPinResizeEstimator
functions.description: Register a custom SKILL function for resizing pins. This registered function is passed as a parameter to vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator to resize pins.

functions.name: vfpPtGetPinResizeEstimators
functions.description: Retrieves a list of registered pin resize estimator SKILL functions. You can specify whether the list must include only the function nicknames or both the function names and their nicknames.

functions.name: vfpPtLoadPinResizeFile
functions.description: Loads the specified SKILL file containing pin-resize functions.

functions.name: vfpPtRemovePinResizeEstimator
functions.description: Deregisters the given pin resize estimator SKILL function.

functions.name: vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator
functions.syntax: vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator( d_topCellViewID t_nickname ?mode { all | selected | specify } ?pinList l_pinList ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the given registered pin resize estimator SKILL function on pins as specified in the mode argument.

functions.name: vfpPushPreRoutesDown
functions.syntax: vfpPushPreRoutesDown( t_topCVLibName  t_topCVCellName  t_topCVViewName t_softBlockInstName  t_targetLibName  t_targetCellName  t_targetViewName g_pushCloseWireBlkg g_rebindInst [ g_pushOverlappingBlockages ] [ g_pushPowerNetGeometry ] [ g_pushRegularNetGeometry ] [ g_pushRow ] [ g_pushWSP ] [ g_pushWholeShape ] [ g_pushSelection ] [ g_pushFloatingShapes ] [ t_pushMode ( Auto Push | Create Net & Push with Feed Thru Pins | Push as Blockage ) ] [ l_pushLPPs ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Pushes the top-level power structures of a cellview over a specified soft block instance into a target cellview.

functions.name: vfpReportIOPadLocation
functions.description: Prints the IO pad information in formatted manner for all the pads which are placed in the IO rows within the design.

functions.name: vfpSbDefineObstruction
functions.syntax: vfpSbDefineObstruction( l_PhysLCV t_obstructionType [ ?topOffset  n_topOffset ] [ ?bottomOffset n_BottomOffset ] [ ?leftOffset n_LeftOffset ] [ ?rightOffset n_RightOffset ] [ ?layerName t_layerName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates placement, routing, or other obstructions based on the obstructionType argument. All conditions that are enforced for these obstructions through GUI-based flow are applicable here. For example, only one placement blockage would be applied per soft block. If a second placement blockage is applied through this API, a warning is issued. The latest applied placement blockage will not replace the existing placement blockage.

functions.name: vfpSbDeleteObstruction
functions.syntax: vfpSbDeleteObstruction( l_PhysLCV t_obstructionType [ ?topOffset  n_topOffset ] [ ?bottomOffset n_BottomOffset ] [ ?leftOffset n_LeftOffset ] [ ?rightOffset  n_RightOffset ] [ ?layerName t_layerName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified obstruction.

functions.name: vfpSbEditIOPin
functions.syntax: vfpSbEditIOPin( l_PhysLCV t_termName [ ?lpp txl_lpp ] [ ?width n_width ] [ ?height n_height ] [ ?number x_number ] [ ?criticality x_criticality ] [ ?sigType t_sigType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Edits attributes of the pin that is associated with the specified termName.

functions.name: vfpSbEditSoftBlockType
functions.description: Edits the blockType of the specified soft block.

functions.name: vfpSbSetPolygonalBoundary
functions.syntax: vfpSbSetPolygonalBoundary( l_PhysLCV l_ listOfPolygonPoints ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the boundary attributes of soft blocks that are polygonal in shape.

functions.name: vfpSbSetRectangularBoundary
functions.syntax: vfpSbSetRectangularBoundary( l_PhysLCV n_width n_height ) => t  / nil
functions.description: Specifies the boundary vertices of the rectangular soft block.

functions.name: viaFindTransitions
functions.syntax: viaFindTransitions( t_constraintGroupSetup t_topLayerName t_bottomLayerName )  => l_viaTransitionsObject / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of transitions of the given constraint group setup object found between the specified top and bottom layers.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasAtPoint
functions.syntax: viaGenerateViasAtPoint( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_point t_viaOptionsObject [ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias with the specified options at a given location in the specified window or cellview.The figures present at the given location are queried, and if they form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasFromShapes
functions.syntax: viaGenerateViasFromShapes( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_shapes t_viaOptionsObject [ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias from the specified shapes with the given via options in the specified window or cellview. If the specified shapes form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the shapes.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasInArea
functions.syntax: viaGenerateViasInArea( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_ptArray t_viaOptionsObject [ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias with the specified options within a given area in the specified window or cellview. The figures present at the given location are queried, and if they form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaGetViaOptions
functions.description: Returns a via options object from the specified constraint group. This via options object can be used by any SKILL procedure enabling generation or re-computation of vias.

functions.name: viaLoadViaVariants
functions.description: Loads the via variants from the specified cellview for the Create Via command.

functions.name: viaRecomputeVias
functions.syntax: viaRecomputeVias( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_via t_viaOptionsObject [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Recomputes the via list with the given via options in the specified window or cellview. The figures connected by the vias are searched and the vias are recomputed with the via options specified to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaRecomputeViasAtPoint
functions.syntax: viaRecomputeViasAtPoint( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_point t_viaOptionsObject [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Recomputes vias with the specified options at a given location in the specified window or cellview. The vias present at the given location are queried along with the figures connected by the vias. The vias are then recomputed with the via options specified to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaRecomputeViasInArea
functions.syntax: viaRecomputeViasInArea( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_ptArray t_viaOptionsObject [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Recomputes vias with the specified options within a given area in the specified window or cellview. The vias present at the given location are queried along with the figures connected by the vias. The vias are then recomputed with the via options specified to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaRegisterCreateViaInitCallback
functions.description: Registers the function to be called each time the Create Via form is opened. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure and the init procedure that is registered should be defined without arguments.

functions.name: viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called after the viaEngine processing. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure. The postViaEngine procedure that is registered should be declared with one argument, the viaEngineContext. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback function that is registered should be declared with the viaEngineContext argument. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The function returns t or nil. If nil is returned by the viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback function registered, vias are not created.

functions.name: viaRegisterPostViaServerCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called after the via server processing. The function should be a valid SKILL procedure. The postViaServer procedure that is registered should be declared with three arguments, the constraintGroup, the overlapInfo, and the list of viaViaDef user type computed by the via server. The postViaServer procedure returns a list of viaViaDef user types. You can update all viaViaDefs specified in the viaViaDef argument. You also have the option to modify the sequence of the viaViaDef list.

functions.name: viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called before via engine processing. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure. The preViaEngine procedure that is registered should be declared with one argument, viaEngineContext. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback function that is registered should be declared with the viaEngineContext argument. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The function returns t or nil. If nil is returned by the viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback function registered, vias are not created.

functions.name: viaSaveViaVariants
functions.description: Saves the via variants from the Create Via command into the specified cellview.

functions.name: viaSetDefaultCutClasses
functions.syntax: viaSetDefaultCutClasses( t_techLibName [ t_constraintGroupName ] ((bottomLayer topLayer cutClass) ...) [ g_reset ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default cut classes to be used for each layer.

functions.name: viaSetDefaultValidViaDefs
functions.syntax: viaSetDefaultValidViaDefs( t_techLibName t_constraintGroupName l_viaDef [ g_reset ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default vias to be used by Wire Edit and Create Via commands from the list of valid vias of the specified constraint group.

functions.name: viaUnregisterCreateViaInitCallback
functions.description: Unregisters the createVia initialization procedure if it has been registered. If it has not been registered, this function does nothing.

functions.name: viaUnregisterPostViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Unregisters the postViaEngine procedure if it has been registered. If it has not been registered, this function does nothing.

functions.name: viaUnregisterPostViaServerCallback
functions.description: Unregisters the postViaServer procedure if it has been registered.

functions.name: viaUnregisterPreViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Unregisters the preViaEngine procedure if it has been registered. If it has not been registered, this function does nothing.

functions.name: vpaOptimizePins
functions.syntax: vpaOptimizePins( ?cv d_cellViewId ?layoutLCV l_LCVName [ ?cphId g_cphId ] [ ?selectedOnly g_selectedOnly ] [ ?spacingType t_spacingType ] [ ?spacingValue n_spacingValue ] [ ?targetPinSide l_targetPinSides ] [ ?enableCongestion g_enableCongestion ] [ ?congestionValue n_congestionValue ] ) => t / nil / List of (sbId lib:cell:view status)
functions.description: Runs pin optimization on the specified cellview or design based on the options you specify. You can specify only those parameters that you want to control. The parameters that you do not specify get their values from the corresponding LayoutXL environment variable.

functions.name: vreCreateRowRegion
functions.syntax: vreCreateRowRegion( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => d_rowRegionId / nil
functions.description: Creates a new row region for the specified scope of the given style or engine using the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant GUI or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreDeletePhysicalCells
functions.syntax: vreDeletePhysicalCells( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes physical-only instances for specified cell types. It uses the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant GUI or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreDeletePowerRouting
functions.syntax: vreDeletePowerRouting( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle ] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes power routing data for the specified scope of the given routing style or router using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreDeleteRowRegions
functions.syntax: vreDeleteRowRegions( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes all automatically created rows and row regions using the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant GUI or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreDeleteSignalRouting
functions.syntax: vreDeleteSignalRouting( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle ] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes signal routing data for specified scope based of the given routing style or router using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreFinishRouting
functions.syntax: vreFinishRouting( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle ] [ S_rName ] )  => l_result / nil
functions.description: Runs finish routing based on the given routing style or router using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreGenerateWSPs
functions.syntax: vreGenerateWSPs( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle ] [ S_rName ] )  => d_wsspDefId / nil
functions.description: Generates WSPs for the selected cellview. This SKILL API uses the options specified in the Routing Assistant or through vreSetOption based on the given routing style or router.

functions.name: vreGetCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview associated with the supplied routing environment handle object.

functions.name: vreGetHandle
functions.syntax: vreGetHandle( d_cvid  s_routingStyle s_router ) => g_vreHandle / nil
functions.description: Creates a routing environment handle object which captures the cellview, routing style, and router. This object can then be passed to other routing environment APIs that take a vreHandle parameter.

functions.name: vreGetOption
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified option for the supplied routing environment handle object.

functions.name: vreGetOptions
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list of all the options and values associated with the supplied routing environment handle object.

functions.name: vreGetRouter
functions.description: Returns the symbol for the router associated with the supplied routing environment handle object.

functions.name: vreGetRoutingStyle
functions.description: Returns the routing style associated with the supplied routing environment handle object.

functions.name: vreIsOption
functions.description: Indicates whether a named option is valid for the specified vreHandle before calling vreGetOption or vreSetOption. Directly manipulating an option value that is not valid for the specified vreHandle using vreGetOption or vreSetOption results in a warning message.

functions.name: vreRaiseConstraintManager
functions.syntax: vreRaiseConstraintManager( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle ] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Opens the Routing Constraint Manager based on the given routing style or router. This API uses the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set through vreSetOption based on the given routing style or router.

functions.name: vreRaisePreRoutingBrowser
functions.syntax: vreRaisePreRoutingBrowser( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle ] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Opens the Pre-routing Browser based on the given routing style and router name.

functions.name: vreRaiseResultsBrowser
functions.syntax: vreRaiseResultsBrowser( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Opens the Routing Results Browser for the specified scope. This API uses the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set through vreSetOption based on the given routing style or router.

functions.name: vreRemoveJogs
functions.syntax: vreRemoveJogs( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Removes jogs from the given cellview when the specified router is run on it. This API uses the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set through vreSetOption based on the given routing style or router.

functions.name: vreRemoveNotches
functions.syntax: vreRemoveNotches( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: 'Removes notches from the given cellview when the specified router is run on it. This API uses the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set through vreSetOption based on the given routing style or router.

functions.name: vreRunAssistedRouter
functions.syntax: vreRunAssistedRouter( d_cvid S_rStyle S_rName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs assisted routing for the specified scope using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set using vreSetOption based on the given routing style and router.

functions.name: vreRunChecker
functions.syntax: vreRunChecker( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the pre-route checker for the specified scope using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set using vreSetOption based on the given routing style and router.

functions.name: vreRunGeneration
functions.syntax: vreRunGeneration( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Generates selected object types from source. It uses the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreRunMeshRouter:
functions.syntax: vreRunMeshRouter( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the mesh router for the specified scope using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set using vreSetOption based on the given routing style and router.

functions.name: vreRunP2TRouter
functions.syntax: vreRunP2TRouter( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the Pin to Trunk router for the specified scope using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set using vreSetOption based on the given routing style and router.

functions.name: vreRunPlacer
functions.syntax: vreRunPlacer( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the specified stages of the placement flow using the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreRunPowerRouter:
functions.syntax: vreRunPowerRouter( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the power router for the specified scope using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set using vreSetOption based on the given routing style and router.

functions.name: vreRunSignalRouter
functions.syntax: vreRunSignalRouter( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the signal router for the specified scope using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set using vreSetOption based on the given routing style and router.

functions.name: vreSetOption
functions.syntax: vreSetOption( g_vreHandle s_optionName g_optionValue ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified option for the supplied routing environment handle object.

functions.name: vreSetOptions
functions.description: Sets all the options associated with the supplied routing environment handle object to the values in a specified DPL (typically returned by vreGetOptions()).

functions.name: vreSetRouter
functions.description: Updates the supplied routing environment handle object to use the specified router. Only certain combinations of router and routing style are supported.

functions.name: vreSetRoutingStatus
functions.syntax: vreSetRoutingStatus( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified routing status on nets within the specified scope.

functions.name: vreSetRoutingStyle
functions.description: Updates the supplied routing environment handle object to use the specified routing style. Only certain combinations of router and routing style are supported.

functions.name: vreShowCheckerLog
functions.syntax: vreShowCheckerLog( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Displays the log file viewer for the pre-route checker.

functions.name: vreShowPlacerLog
functions.syntax: vreShowPlacerLog( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Displays the placement log window.

functions.name: vreShowRowGenLog
functions.syntax: vreShowRowGenLog( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => d_RowRegionId / nil
functions.description: Displays row generation log based on the scope defined for the given routing style using the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant or set by vreSetOption.

functions.name: vreShowSignalRouterLog
functions.description: Displays the log file viewer for the signal type router.

functions.name: vreStopPlacer
functions.syntax: vreStopPlacer( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Stops the active placer.

functions.name: vreStopRowRegionCreation
functions.syntax: vreStopRowRegionCreation( [ d_cvid ] [ S_style ] [ S_eName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Stops the active row region generation.

functions.name: vreStopSignalRouter
functions.syntax: vreStopSignalRouter( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Stops the active signal router.

functions.name: vreStopWSPGeneration
functions.syntax: vreStopWSPGeneration( [ d_cvid ] [ S_rStyle] [ S_rName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Stops the active WSP generation.

functions.name: vrtCheckDesign
functions.syntax: vrtCheckDesign( [ d_cvid ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?all { t | nil } | ?checkDeadEndPins ?checkDeviceTrims ?checkDiffPins   ?checkGatePins ?checkGridSanity ?checkPinWSPConformance ?checkSDPins   ?checkSymmetry ?checkTracks ?checkTrimValidity ?checkVias ] [ ?showLog | ?logVios | ?createMarkers ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs pre-routing checks either on a whole cellview or on certain layers or a region of the design. You can either select the specific checks to run or run all available checks.

functions.name: vrtCreateIDLayer
functions.syntax: vrtCreateIDLayer( [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?debug { t | nil } ] )  => layer_ID / nil
functions.description: Creates an ID layer according to advanced node OppExtensionRules.

functions.name: vrtDeleteNets
functions.syntax: vrtDeleteNets( d_cvid [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?options l_options ] [ ?logFile g_logFile ] [ ?appendToLog g_appendToLog ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the routing on the nets. The routing is done by the signal router or power router either on the whole cellview or on certain layers or a region of the design. It can also delete pre-routes of nets that are not generated by signal router or power router.

functions.name: vrtPowerRoute
functions.syntax: vrtPowerRoute( d_cvid [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?layer l_layers ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?options l_options ] [ ?sharedTrack g_sharedTrack ] [ ?net2WireTypes g_net2WireTypes ] [ ?pullbacks g_pullbacks ] [ ?postFixTrim g_postFixTrim ] [ ?postFixMinLength g_postFixMinLength ] [ ?postFixEolKeepout g_postFixEolKeepout ] [ ?logFile g_logFile ] [ ?appenToLog g_appendToLog ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs power routing on the nets in the design.

functions.name: vrtRouteAssisted
functions.syntax: vrtRouteAssisted( d_cvid [ nets l_nets ] [ layers l_layers ] [ regionBox l_regionBox ] [ ?generateSpine g_generateSpine ] [ ?spineLayer g_spineLayer ] [ ?connectPins g_connectPins ] [ ?generateMesh g_generateMesh ] [ ?meshBottomLayer t_meshBottomLayer ] [ ?meshTopLayer t_meshTopLayer ] [ ?meshSetting l_meshSetting ] [ ?meshExtendPreRoute g_meshExtendPreRoute ] [ ?finishRouting g_finishRouting ] [ ?preferredLayerBottom t_preferredLayerBottom ] [ ?preferredLayerTop t_preferredLayerTop ] [ ?postFixTrim g_postFixTrim ] [ ?postFixMinLength g_postFixMinLength ] [ ?postFixEolKeepout g_postFixEOLKeepout ]  [ ?minSkipTrack d_minSkipTrack ]  [ ?createFigGroup g_createFigGroup ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: If both Generate Mesh and Finish Routing are selected and top and bottom layers are different in mesh control, Finish Routing starts first and then Generate Mesh.However, if the top and bottom layers are the same in mesh control, Generate Spine starts first and then Finish Routing.

functions.name: vrtRouteDesign
functions.syntax: vrtRouteDesign( d_cvid [ layers l_layers ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?regionBox l_regionBox ] [ ?reorderNets g_reorderNets ] [ ?excludeNets t_excludeNets ] [ ?constraintPriority g_constraintPriority ] [ ?preferredLayers l_preferredLayers ] [ ?viaCost f_viaCost ] [ ?connectBothGates g_connectBothGates ] [ ?preferConstraintViolationToOpen g_preferConstraintViolationToOpen ] [ ?postFixTrim g_postFixTrim ] [ ?postFixMinLength g_postFixMinLength ] [ ?postFixEolKeepout g_postFixEolKeepout ] [ ?enableDRDChecker g_enableDRDChecker ] [ ?appendDeviceLayers g_appenDeviceLayers ] [ ?deleteUnlockedShapes g_deleteUnlockedShapes ] [ ?logFile g_logFile ] [ ?appendToLog g_appendToLog  [ ?createFigGroup g_createFigGroup ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the device router on the selected design.

functions.name: vrtStrandRoute
functions.syntax: vrtStrandRoute( d_cvid [ layers l_layers ] [ spineLayer t_spineLayer ] [ createSpineSettings g_createSpineSettings ] [ routeSpineSettings g_routeSpineSettings ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?preferredLayers l_preferredLayers ] [ ?viaCost f_viaCost ] [ ?connectBothGates g_connectBothGates ] [ ?preferVio2Open g_preferVio2Open ] [ ?postFixTrim g_postFixTrim ] [ ?postFixMinLength g_postFixMinLength ] [ ?postFixEolKeepout g_postFixEolKeepout ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the ART spine generator and the spine router together.

functions.name: vsrDeletePreset
functions.syntax: vsrDeletePreset( t_fileName [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?path t_path ] [ ?confirmation g_confirmation ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a preset file.

functions.name: vsrLoadPreset
functions.syntax: vsrLoadPreset( t_fileName [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?execMode s_execMode ] [ ?path t_path ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a preset file to the Wire Assistant form and the Virtuoso Space-based Router Options form.

functions.name: vsrSavePreset
functions.syntax: vsrSavePreset( t_PresetLabel t_fileName [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?path t_path ] [ ?tooltip t_tooltip ] [ ?description t_description ] [ ?iconFileName t_iconFileName ] [ ?iconText t_iconText ] [ ?location s_location ] [ ?mode s_mode ] [ ?envGroups l_envGroups ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the current settings to a preset file for later re-use.

functions.name: weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem
functions.syntax: weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem( t_name t_customTransition [ t_bindkey ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a menu item to the context-sensitive menu of the Create Bus command. You can use the added menu item to call the customer SKILL API. A bindkey is also assigned to the menu item.

functions.name: weCWHoldWidth
functions.description: This function is used for the create wire command when smart snapping is active. The width that is highlighted by smart snapping is used by the next wire that is being created even if the wire is created at another position than the current one.

functions.name: weCycleCutColorVia
functions.description: Cycles color of each cut when a via is inserted.

functions.name: weCyclePatternGravityLayerTransitionType
functions.description: In a WSP design, the wires are snapped to the layer up or down WSPs, which is the default behavior. However, if you want the wire only to snap to layer up or layer down a WSP, then you can use the patternGravityLayerTransitionType environment variable to cycle the layer for snapping. The environment variable has three values: patternGravityLayerUp, patternGravityLayerDown, and patternGravityLayerAny. The default value is patternGravityLayerAny.

functions.name: weGatherBusWires
functions.description: This function is used when the leHiCreateBus command is running. If the gap between the bus wires does not match the minSpacing rule, then the wires are gathered at the minimum spacing. If the wires are already at minSpacing, they will be spread to use the initial gap, which is the gap before executing the weGatherBusWires function.

functions.name: weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks
functions.syntax: weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks(  d_cellViewId l_layerNum l_purposeNum l_direction l_dimension l_coordinates [ x_coord y_coord ] ) => l_trackInfo / nil
functions.description: Returns the Width Spacing Pattern (WSP) track information based on the inputs specified, such as layers, purposes, preferred directions, and shape dimensions, at a specific location.The purpose of the function is to check whether or not there are tracks at the given location.

functions.name: weGetCustomTransitionMenuItems
functions.description: Returns a list of custom transitions that were added to the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

functions.name: weGetPathSegWidth
functions.description: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal path segments when their width is being queried. Unlike dbGetPathSegWidth which returns the value stored in the OpenAccess database for the width of diagonal pathSegs, this API does the sqrt(2) conversion appropriately and return the width value as it appears in the property editor form or object inspector assistant.

functions.name: weHiCopyRoute
functions.description: Starts the Edit - Wiring - Copy Route command. Press F3 in the canvas to open the Copy Route form. The command lets you copy layout geometries similar to a bus from a single routed net.

functions.name: weHiCycleViaDefDown
functions.description: Returns the current via definition for the pending vias when you start either the Create Wire, Create Stranded Wire, or the Create Bus command.

functions.name: weHiCycleViaDefUp
functions.description: Automatically cycles up the via definition for the pending vias, while using the Create Wire, Create Stranded Wire, or the Create Bus command.

functions.name: weHiEditBus
functions.description: Starts the Edit - Wiring - Bus command in Layout XL and higher tiers. The command lets you edit the width and spacing of bus bits. If no window ID is specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: weHiInteractiveRouting
functions.description: Maps the function to the leHiCreateGeometricWire (paths mode) SKILL function when the technology file is one of the fabric types, package, module, or board, and the active application is Virtuoso RF. Otherwise, the function is mapped to leHiCreateWire when the technology file is of the fabric type IC or the active application is not Virtuoso RF.

functions.name: weHiWireTo45
functions.description: Starts the interactive command that lets you select wire corners to create chamfering.

functions.name: weRemoveCustomTransitionMenuItem
functions.description: Removes a custom transition menu item from the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

functions.name: weScaleMagnifierOrDecreaseWidth
functions.description: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom out in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, decrease the width of the current wire.

functions.name: weScaleMagnifierOrIncreaseWidth
functions.description: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, increase the width of the current wire.

functions.name: weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment
functions.description: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment SKILL API scroll down the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

functions.name: weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment
functions.description: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment SKILL API scrolls up the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

functions.name: weSetPathSegWidth
functions.syntax: weSetPathSegWidth(  [ g_pathSegId ]  float value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal pathseg when the width is being changed. In addition, it also supports diagonal pathseg with custom extension and appropriately updates the values when the width is being changed.

functions.name: wspCheckActive
functions.syntax: wspCheckActive( d_cellviewId  t_layerName | ?shapes g_selSetId  [ ?region l_bBox ]  [ ?purpose t_purposeName ]  [ ?hilightSet g_hlSetId ]  [ ?markers g_markers [ ?vioLimit g_limit ] ]  [ ?checkColor g_checkColor ]  [ ?checkWidth g_checkWidth ]  [ ?checkWireType g_checkWireType ]  [ ?depth x_depth ]  [ ?mergeShapes g_mergeShapes [ ?ignoreColorOnMerge g_ignoreColor ] ]  [ ?mergePurposes l_mergePurposes ] [ ?returnVioShapes g_returnVioShapes ] [ ?excludeBlockageCheck g_excludeBlockageCheck ] [ ?ignoreValidJogs g_ignoreValidJogs ] ) => t / l_dbID / nil
functions.description: Checks shapes and blockages for width, color, and wireType conformance to the active width spacing pattern (WSP) on the specified layer or in the specified set. The active WSP can be for the global grid or a pattern region.

functions.name: wspCreateWSP
functions.syntax: wspCreateWSP ( d_cellViewId  t_name  [ ?offset n_offset ]  [ ?repeatOffset g_repeatOffset ]  [ ?shiftColor g_shiftColor ]  [ ?allowedRepeatMode t_allowedRepeatMode ] [ ?defaultRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatMode ] [ ?wsspDef t_wsspDefName ] n_width n_space [ repeat n_repeats ] [ wireType t_wireType ] [ color n_mask ] [ displayPacket t_displayPacket ] ) => d_wspId
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern (WSP) in the specified cellview. If the WSP already exists, it is replaced. This function creates simple WSPs and not nested lists. It checks the shapes for width, color, and wire type conformance to the active WSP on the specified layer or set. The active WSP can be for the global grid or a pattern region.

functions.name: wspCreateWSPByAttr
functions.syntax: wspCreateWSPByAttr ( d_cellViewId  list (nil 	'name t_name 	'offset n_offset 	'shiftColor g_shiftColor 	'repeatOffset g_repeatOffset 	'allowedRepeatMode t_allowedRepeatMode 	'defaultRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatMode 	tracks  ( list(nil 			'width n_width 			'space n_space 			[ 'wireType t_wireType ] 			[ 'color t_color ] 			[ 'displayPacket t_displayPacket ] 			 ) ) ) => d_wspId
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern (WSP). The pattern attributes are specified as a DPL. This function is specified with the wspGetFlatAttr function, which returns an existing pattern as a DPL. It lets you convert the existing patterns to a DPL, modify them, and recreate them.

functions.name: wspCreateWSPGroup
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern (WSP) group in the specified cellview. The argument after t_name are interpreted as group members.

functions.name: wspCreateWSSPDef
functions.syntax: wspCreateWSSPDef ( d_cellViewId  t_name tx_layer t_direction n_period [ ?defaultActive t_defaultActive ] [ ?allowedPatterns l_patterns ] [ ?allowedPatternGroups l_groups ] [ ?defPurpose tx_purpose ] [ ?offset n_offset ] [ ?orthogonalGrid t_orthogonalGrid] )  => d_wsspDefId
functions.description: Creates a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. If t_defaultActive is specified, the WSSPDef is created immediately. If it is not specified, the creation of WSSPDef is deferred until the first call to the function wspCreateWSP that references this WSSPDef. This enables all WSSPDefs to be specified first, followed by calls to wspCreateWSP that reference the WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspCreateWSSPDefByAttr
functions.description: Creates a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) using an attribute DPL.

functions.name: wspDeleteCellViewAllWSPData
functions.description: Deletes all the width spacing pattern (WSP) data from the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspDeleteMetalFill
functions.syntax: wspDeleteMetalFill ( d_cellViewId t_LayerName ?removeTrim g_removeTrim ?removePatch g_removePatch ?removePassive g_removePassive )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the shapes created by the wspMetalFillTrim() function.

functions.name: wspDumpToFile
functions.description: Creates a SKILL file that can be used to recreate the width spacing pattern (WSP) information in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspGetLineEndGrids
functions.description: Returns a list of line-end grid names for the specified layer.

functions.name: wspGetWSSPDefLP
functions.description: Returns the layer and purpose name of a widthSpacingSnapPatternDef.

functions.name: wspRegionFindByLayer
functions.description: Returns a list of the width spacing pattern (WSP) region IDs for the specified routing layer name in a cellview.

functions.name: wspRegionFindByWSSPDef
functions.description: Returns a list of region IDs in the specified cellview for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspRegionGetActivePattern
functions.description: Returns the name of the active pattern for a width spacing pattern (WSP) region.

functions.name: wspRegionGetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: Returns a list of names of allowed pattern groups for the specified width spacing pattern (WSP) region.

functions.name: wspRegionGetAllowedPatterns
functions.description: Returns a list with the names of the allowed patterns for a width spacing pattern (WSP) region. By default, this function returns the effective set of patterns by combining the allowed patterns and allowed pattern groups. You can use the g_excludeGroups argument to ignore the allowed pattern groups.

functions.name: wspRegionGetWSSPDef
functions.description: Returns the ID of the widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) to which the specified region is bound.

functions.name: wspSPDefFind
functions.syntax: wspSPDefFind ( d_cellViewId  t_layerName  [ ?enabledOnly g_enabledOnly ] )  => l_spdef / nil
functions.description: Finds all the snapPatternDefs (SPDefs) that apply to the specified routing layer name. In a cellview, one SPDef or widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) per layer is enabled as a global grid. With the optional argument g_enabledOnly set to t, WSSPDefs that are enabled as global for the specified routing layer are returned.

functions.name: wspSetWSSPDefRegionPurpose
functions.description: Overrides the region purpose attribute for the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspWSPFindByName
functions.syntax: wspWSPFindByName ( d_cellViewId  t_wspname  [ cellViewOnly g_cellViewOnly ] )  => d_wspId
functions.description: Finds a width spacing pattern (WSP) by name in a cellview or in the technology database.

functions.name: wspWSPGetFlatAttr
functions.description: Returns the attributes of a width spacing pattern (WSP) as a DPL.

functions.name: wspWSPGroupFindByName
functions.syntax: wspWSPGroupFindByName ( d_cellViewId  t_wspname  [ cellViewOnly g_cellViewOnly ] )  => d_wspGroupId
functions.description: Finds a width spacing pattern (WSP) group by its name in a cellview or in the technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatternGroups
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatternGroups(	 d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName  t_patternGroupName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a width spacing pattern (WSP) group to the list of allowed pattern groups for a WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatterns
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatterns( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName  t_patternName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a width spacing pattern (WSP) to the allowed patterns for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToEnabled
functions.description: Adds a list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) to the list of WSSPDefs enabled as global grids in the specified cellview. This will filter out any duplicate, undefined wsspDefs, and wsspDefs with direction mis-match.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefClearEnabledOverrides
functions.description: Removes any global grid overrides from the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefFind
functions.description: Returns a list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) that apply to a given routing layer name. The WSSPDefs may exist in the cellview or in the technology database. With the optional argument g_enabledOnly set to t, routing WSSPDefs that are enabled as global for the given layer are returned.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefFindByName
functions.description: Finds a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) by its name in a cellview or technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetActivePattern
functions.description: Returns the active pattern name for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. The active pattern may be set by a constraint in the cellview or from the WSSPDef in the cellview or technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: Returns a list with the names of the allowed pattern groups for the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAllowedPatterns
functions.description: Returns a list of names of allowed width spacing patterns (WSPs) for a given widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. A WSSPDef has a list of allowed patterns and allowed pattern groups. The effective set of allowed patterns is a combination of the allowed WSPs and a WSP that is a member of an allowed pattern group. By default, this function returns the effective set of allowed patterns. You can use the g_excludeGroups argument to get only the directly allowed WSPs.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAttr
functions.description: The attributes of the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) are converted to a DPL format. All the attribute representations are the same as the source representation, except the snappingLayers attribute, which is stored as an association table for layer-purpose pair lookup.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetEnabledOverrides
functions.description: Returns the names of all the widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) in the specified direction that are enabled as global grids. The WSSPDef direction is orthogonal to the routing direction. This filters out any duplicates, undefined wsspDefs, and wsspDefs with a direction mis-match.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatternGroups
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatternGroups( d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_patternGroupName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes a pattern group from the allowed pattern groups of a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatterns
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatterns(	 d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_patternName  => t / nil
functions.description: Removes a width spacing pattern (WSP) from the allowed patterns of the specified cellview. This function only removes the directly-allowed WSP. If a pattern is allowed because it is a member of an allowed pattern group, then no update is made.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromEnabled
functions.description: Removes the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) from the list of WSSPDefs that are enabled as global grids in the cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRename
functions.description: Renames a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) by deleting and re-creating it. So, the DB ID may change. This function updates the global grid and any regions that reference the WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetActivePattern
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetActivePattern( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName t_defaultActiveName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default active width spacing pattern (WSP) for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatternGroups( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName l_patternGroupNames ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the allowed pattern groups for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatterns
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatterns( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName l_patternNames [ ?keepGroups g_keepGroups ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the allowed patterns for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. If the WSSPDef is enabled as global, the patterns apply to the global grid of the WSSPDef and to any regions for the WSSPDef for which the allowed patterns are not overridden.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetEnabledOverrides
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetEnabledOverrides( d_cellViewId  l_wsspDefNames [ ?direction t_direction ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Overrides the global grid in the specified cellview and by enabling the specified list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) as global grids. If the l_wsspDefNames argument does not contain any WSSPDef in a direction, there is no global grid for that direction even if the technology database specifies a global grid for that direction.

functions.name: xfgrAddOption
functions.syntax: xfgrAddOption(  ?optionName g_optionName ?optionLabel g_optionLabel ?optionType g_optionType ?optionWidgetType g_optionWidgetType ?optionDefaultValue g_optionDefaultValue ?supportedOptionValue g_supportedOptionValue ?groupName g_groupName ?deviceName g_deviceName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new field as specified in the option name to the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrConfigureOptionsCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers the specified user-defined callback function against xfgrConfigureOptions.

functions.name: xfgrDisableOption
functions.description: Disables the specified option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrEnableOption
functions.description: Enables the specified option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrGetAvailableValues
functions.description: Returns the available values for the specified option name. The options are combo box, spin box, or radio button.

functions.name: xfgrGetOptionValue
functions.description: Returns the current value for the specified option.

functions.name: xfgrHideAllGroups
functions.description: Hides all groups in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrHideAllOptions
functions.description: Hides all current groups in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrHideGroup
functions.description: Hides the options in the specified group from the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrHideOption
functions.description: Hides the specified option from the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrInitializeOptionsCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers a user-defined callback function to be called during the initialization of option values in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrOptionValueChangeCB
functions.syntax: xfgrOptionValueChangeCB(  t_mode s_callbackFunction [ g_optionName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Registers or de-registers user-defined callback function to be called when the value of any option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form changes.

functions.name: xfgrPostCreateCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers a user-defined callback function after the creation of the fluid guard ring instance.

functions.name: xfgrPreCreateCB
functions.description: Registers or de-registers the user-defined callback function before the creation of the fluid guard ring instance.

functions.name: xfgrSetAvailableValues
functions.description: Specified the list of valid values for the specified option.

functions.name: xfgrSetOptionValue
functions.description: Sets the specified value for the option.

functions.name: xfgrSetTableCellValue
functions.syntax: xfgrSetTableCellValue(  t_tableName t_rowNumber t_columnNumber t_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified row and column of the specified table with the specified value in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrShowAllGroups
functions.description: Displays all groups in the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrShowGroup
functions.description: Displays the options in the specified group on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: xfgrShowOption
functions.description: Displays the specified option on the Create Fluid Guard Ring form.

functions.name: addPoint
functions.description: Adds the point to the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: appTrigger
functions.description: The application trigger is responsible for any necessary banner setup (except for menus), installing the window popup menu, and other application-specific initialization. It is also responsible for managing the application context.

functions.name: applyEnterFun
functions.description: Calls doneProc, passes it the points you entered, resets the enterfunction, and calls initProc.

functions.name: bottomEdge
functions.description: Returns the lower left point's Y coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

functions.name: cancelEnterFun
functions.description: Cancels the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: ccBendConnector
functions.syntax: ccBendConnector( l_port n_radius n_bangle  n_rmin n_gamma )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a bend connector making a circular turn from the specified starting port with the radius, bend angle, and gamma fraction given in ccWaypointConnector. The connector consists of a central circular arc and two apex clothoids matching its curvature at one end and with zero curvature at the other end. Gamma is the ratio of the circular bend angle to the total bend angle.

functions.name: ccConvertIntoCurvy
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a new ccShape to which the specified database figure is attached.

functions.name: ccCopyFig
functions.syntax: ccCopyFig( o_shape [ ?cv d_cellViewID ] [ ?lpp g_lpp ]          [ ?transform l_transform ]    )  => o_shape2 / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Copies the specified ccShape object to the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair (LPP) by using the specified transform. The copied cellview and LPP default to the ones of the source ccShape.

functions.name: ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList
functions.syntax: ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList( n_startWidth n_endWidth S_taperStyle o_polyCurve [ ?startClamp n_startClampLength ] [ ?endClamp n_endClampLength ] ) => l_segmentsWidths
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a list of curved segments with the corresponding width expressions defining a tapered connector path of the specified tapering style with the specified start and end width around the centerline specified by the input polyCurve.   The segments of the input polyCurve are assumed to be parametrized by the arc length in the same way as the segments created by the connector generation functions ccBendConnector, ccCurveConnector, and ccWaypointConnector.   The tapering width function can optionally be clamped to have zero derivative at either or both the ends of the connector with the length of the clamping regions specified by the specified clamp lengths.

functions.name: ccCreateCurve
functions.syntax: ccCreateCurve( t_x t_y l_interval )  => o_curve / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccCurve object using the specified parametric functions and interval.

functions.name: ccCreateEllipse
functions.syntax: ccCreateEllipse( d_cellViewId l_lpp l_llPoint l_urPoint ?offset l_offset  ?rotation n_rotation ?genFigs g_genFigs ) => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates an ellipse with the specified coordinates as a ccSurface object in the cellview with specified layer-purpose pair. The ellipse is then transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

functions.name: ccCreateFacet
functions.syntax: ccCreateFacet( l_origin [ ?angle n_angle ] [ ?radius n_radius ] [ ?offsets l_offsets ] [ ?name t_name ] ) => o_facet / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccFacet object. A facet is a special type of straight segment that is specified by the origin point, offsets, curvature, and rotation angle. It can be used to implement a smooth stitching between two ccShape objects.

functions.name: ccCreateLine
functions.syntax: ccCreateLine( d_cellViewId l_lpp g_polyCurveSegments ) => o_line / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccLine object at the specified layer-purpose pair of the given cellview from either a ccPolyCurve object or a list of polyCurve segments forming a polyCurve. When list of polyCurve segments is specified the resulting polyCurve should be of class G2, otherwise, the function terminates with an error.

functions.name: ccCreateLineSegment
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccCurve object that represents a straight line segment connecting two specified points.

functions.name: ccCreatePath
functions.syntax: ccCreatePath( d_cellviewId l_lpp l_segments [?defaultWidth g_defWidth]  [?smoothness   S_smoothness] )  => o_path / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccPath object on the specified layer-purpose pair from one or a list of path segments.

functions.name: ccCreatePie
functions.syntax: ccCreatePie( d_cellviewId l_lpp  [ ?angle n_angle ]  [ ?startRadius n_startRadius ] [ ?length n_length ] [ ?endWidth n_endWidth ] [ ?endLength n_endLength ] [ ?offset l_offset ] [ ?rotation n_rotation ] [ ?genFigs { t | nil } ] )  => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a pie slice figure bounded by outer circle and optionally by an inner circle, two radiuses at given angles, and optionally by an outer capping of given length. The function generates different figures based on the input.   When the startRadius is nil, the pie shape that is generated is a true pie shape, with the length being the radius.   When the startRadius is larger than 0.0, a donut shape is generated, with the inner part radius determined by the value, while the length is used to represent the thickness of the donut.   When endWidth is specified, a termination is generated, caping the coupler by a shape that is conceptually the union of a rectangle and the last pie shape, with the inner-curved radius as specified. In this case, endWidth must be smaller than the arc defined by sum of radius and length and larger than the arc from radius.   If rotation or offset is specified, the resulting the object undergoes corresponding transformation.

functions.name: ccCreatePolyCurve
functions.syntax: ccCreatePolyCurve( l_segments [ ?close { t | nil } ] [ ?smoothness S_smoothness ] )  => o_polyCurve / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccPolyCurve object from a list of specified polyCurve segments.

functions.name: ccCreatePolygon
functions.syntax: ccCreatePolygon( d_cellview l_lpp l_points ?offset l_offset   ?rotation n_rotation ?genFigs g_genFigs )  => o_surface | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a polygon with the specified vertices as the ccSurface in the specified cellview and on the specified layer-purpose pair. The polygon is transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

functions.name: ccCreateRect
functions.syntax: ccCreateRect( d_cellview l_lpp l_llPoint l_urPoint ?offset l_offset   ?rotation n_rotation ?genFigs g_genFigs )  => o_surface | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a rectangle with the specified coordinates as a ccSurface object on the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair. The rectangle is then transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

functions.name: ccCreateSurface
functions.syntax: ccCreateSurface( d_cellViewId l_lpp o_boundary [ l_holes ]  )  => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccSurface object on the specified layer-purpose pair from the specified boundary, which is ccPolyCurve with positive area and a list of holes, which are ccPolyCurve objects with negative areas.

functions.name: ccCreateSurfaceFromPath
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccSurface object from the boundary of the given ccPath. Begin and end facets of the ccPath object in the resulting ccSurface boundary are renamed according to the value of facetNames, or are not renamed if facetNames is nil.

functions.name: ccCubicSplineConnector
functions.syntax: ccCubicSplineConnector( l_points [ ?d1 n_d1 ] [ ?d2 n_d2 ] )  => o_polyCurve / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a polyCurve representing a cubic spline function in the form where y is a function of x through the given list of points (x,y) with strictly increasing coordinates x.

functions.name: ccCurveConnector
functions.syntax: ccCurveConnector( l_port1 l_port2 n_rmin [ ?method x_method ] [ ?parameters l_parameters ] )  => l_connector | nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a curve connector with two specified ports and a minimum curvature radius. Depending on the input, the connector consists of different combinations of line, circle, and clothoid curve segments.

functions.name: ccFindSurfaceFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Searches for a facet with the specified name on the specified surface.

functions.name: ccGenFigs
functions.syntax: ccGenFigs( o_shape [ ?attach { t | nil } ] [ ?snapToMFG { t | nil } ]  [ ?accuracy { n_accuracy | nil } ] ) => l_figs / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Generates geometry for the specified ccShape and optionally attaches it to the originating ccShape.

functions.name: ccGenOffsetFig
functions.syntax: ccGenOffsetFig( o_path g_lpp ?side t_side [ ?inner n_value | ?outer n_value | ?inner n_value | ?outer n_value ] ) => o_shape / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a new ccShape in the same cellview as the specified path on the specified layer-purpose pair. This shape is constructed by connecting two offsets of the edge of the specified path by using the inner and outer values, respectively, with two facets. The origins of these facets are the same as the origins of the facets of the specified path.

functions.name: ccGetAll
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns all persistent ccShapes in the specified cellview.

functions.name: ccGetCurveDerivative
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a derivative of a curve or a polyCurve segment at the specified value of the curve function parameter.

functions.name: ccGetCurveLength
functions.description: Returns the approximate length of a curve or a polyCurve by discretizing it with the specified accuracy and summing up the lengths of the linear segments between the discretization points corrected by additional terms due to curvature.

functions.name: ccGetCurvePoint
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a point on a curve or a polyCurve segment at the specified value of the curve function parameter.

functions.name: ccGetFromFig
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the ccShape object attached to the given database figure.

functions.name: ccGetPathBoundary
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the ccBoundary object of the specified ccPath.

functions.name: ccGetPathCenterLine
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the center line of the path as an open ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccGetPathEdge
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a new ccPolyCurve that is either the left or the right edge of the boundary of the specified path.

functions.name: ccGetPolyCurveMinRadius
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the minimum curvature radius of a polyCurve, ignoring any tangent discontinuity points.

functions.name: ccIsEnabled
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks if the CurvyCore engine is enabled.

functions.name: ccIsLinearCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks if the given ccCurve is linear.

functions.name: ccLayerAnd
functions.syntax: ccLayerAnd( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves { t | nil } ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived from the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 that overlap areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes1.

functions.name: ccLayerAndNot
functions.syntax: ccLayerAndNot( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves {  t | nil } ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived from the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 that do not overlap any areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes2.

functions.name: ccLayerOffset
functions.syntax: ccLayerOffset( g_shapes n_value [ ?cellView d_cellView ] [ ?lpp g_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves { t | nil } ] )  => l_surfaces
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of surfaces derived by merging the areas of the input shapes and offsetting them by the specified offset value. Resulting surfaces can optionally be created in the specified cellview and with the specified layer-purpose pair different from the default layer-purpose pair of the first input shape.

functions.name: ccLayerOr
functions.syntax: ccLayerOr( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] [ ?facetsToCurves { t | nil } ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived by combining the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 and the areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes2.

functions.name: ccMirrorFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a mirrored or reversed copy of the given ccFacet. If the facet is viewed as a segment, it reverses the direction, which mean that it goes from the end of the original facet to its beginning. However, this function also updates the radius attribute in such a way that two G2-connected paths have mirrored facets at the connection point.

functions.name: ccMoveFig
functions.syntax: ccMoveFig( o_shape [ ?cv d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp g_lpp ] [ ?transform l_transform ] )  => o_shape2 / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Moves the specified ccShape to the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair (LPP) using the specified transform. The cellview and LPP default to the ones of the source ccShape.

functions.name: ccORE
functions.syntax: ccORE(  [ ?rule g_rule ] [ ?sourceCellView o_sourceCellView ] [ ?destinationCellView o_destinationCellView ] [ ?filterLPP l_filterLPP ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel  [ ?parameters l_parameters ] [ ?loadContext t_loadContext ] [ ?saveContext t_saveContext ] [ ?saveResult s_saveResult ] [ ?trace g_trace ]  )  => t
functions.description: Evaluates Optical Rule Engine (ORE) expressions specified in a file or a SKILL list. Expressions are evaluated on the source cellview and the resulting markers and shapes are stored in the source cellview or optionally in the destination cellview. The evaluation can  be limited only to shapes on the specified layer-purpose pairs and down to the specified level of hierarchy.   The default values defined in the expressions can be overridden by the specified parameter values. The ORE context can be saved at the end of the run under a specified name and loaded at the beginning of the next run by referring to the same name. The evaluation of ORE expressions can optionally be traced and the list of ORE objects resulting from them saved in a SKILL variable.

functions.name: ccORECompile
functions.description: Compiles the Optical Rule Engine (ORE) expressions specified as a file or a list and stores them in an encrypted form including an optional unencrypted header in a file with the specified name. The encrypted output file can be specified as the input g_rule key argument of the ccORE function.

functions.name: ccOREGetContext
functions.description: Retrieves the Optical Rule Engine (ORE) context with the specified name.

functions.name: ccOREGetContextObject
functions.description: Retrieves the defstruct representing the specified Optical Rule Engine (ORE) object in the specified ORE context.

functions.name: ccOREGetContexts
functions.description: Retrieves a list of Optical Rule Engine (ORE) context names.

functions.name: ccOREPurgeContext
functions.description: Purges the optical rule engine (ORE) context with the specified name.

functions.name: ccOREPurgeContexts
functions.description: Purges all Optical Rule Engine (ORE) contexts.

functions.name: ccOffsetPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified polyCurve that is expanded by the specified offset value.

functions.name: ccOrientCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified  ccCurve or ccPolyCurve rotated counterclockwise around the origin by a multiple of 90 degrees after optionally mirroring it across the X-axis or Y-axis. Mirroring also reverses the orientation of the curve.

functions.name: ccRemoveFigs
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Removes the database figures attached to the given ccShape.

functions.name: ccRenameFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified facet with a different name.

functions.name: ccReversePolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a reversed copy of the given polyCurve, which is the polyCurve with the same geometry but in the opposite direction, which is from the end of the original polyCurve to its beginning.   This function can be used to turn positive-closed polyCurves into negative polyCurves, and negative-closed polyCurves into positive polyCurves.

functions.name: ccSmoothenFig
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the result of smoothening of the specified ccShape as a new transient ccSurface.

functions.name: ccSmoothenPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a smoothened copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccSpiralConnector
functions.syntax: ccSpiralConnector( n_lengthInnerSpiral0 n_lengthOuterSpiral1 x_numberOfTurns n_minRadius n_gamma  [ ?portLocation t_location ] ) => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a spiral connector that consists of an inner S-shaped figure of two joined circular bend connectors. Each endpoint of S is prolonged by a straight extension and then by N-turnings of a spiral circling around S.

functions.name: ccTransformFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccFacet object.

functions.name: ccTransformPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccTromboneConnector
functions.syntax: ccTromboneConnector( l_legs  n_rmin n_gamma  )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a trombone-shaped connector that consists of five legs of given lengths, smoothly connected by waypoint connectors with the given gamma ratio and the minimum curvature radius.

functions.name: ccWaypointConnector
functions.syntax: ccWaypointConnector( l_port1    l_port2    l_points   n_rmin n_gamma    )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a waypoint connector between the specified points with the given minimum curvature radius and the given portion (gamma) of the circular bending angle in the overall bending angle.
