By default the cellview is saved to the same database ID; however, you can optionally specify a different destination cellview ID or create a new cellview in a different library. A cellview opened in read mode can only be saved as a new cellview with the different name.

functions.name: dbSaveBag
functions.description: Writes the virtual memory image of the property bag to disk.

functions.name: dbSearchCDF
functions.description: Sets and un-sets a flag that will cause CDF to be searched for parameter values.

functions.name: dbSearchPropByName
functions.description: Searches for the specified property.

functions.name: dbSetAnyTermGroundSensitivity
functions.description: Sets the ground sensitivity value for each bit of the specified terminal. If the terminal is a multi-bit terminal, the function only sets the ground sensitivity value on implicit bits. The ground sensitivity values on explicit bits are not affected.

functions.name: dbSetAnyTermSupplySensitivity
functions.description: Sets the supply sensitivity value for each bit of the specified terminal. If the terminal is a multi-bit terminal, the function only sets the supply sensitivity value on implicit bits. The supply sensitivity value on explicit bits are not affected.

functions.name: dbSetAreaBoundaryLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Sets the value of the layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbSetAreaBoundaryValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Sets the value of the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbSetAutoSave
functions.description: Enables or disables the automatic save feature.

functions.name: dbSetAutoSaveCallback
functions.description: Enables a user-defined callback function to control the frequency at which large designs are auto-saved. When set, the user-defined callback function is called just before the design is about to be auto-saved.

functions.name: dbSetBeginPatch
functions.description: Adds or removes the beginStyle patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value.

functions.name: dbSetBlockageColor
functions.description: Assigns color to the specified blockage.

functions.name: dbSetBoundaryEdge
functions.syntax: dbSetBoundaryEdge( d_boundaryId l_points [ lt_edgeNames ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the points (edges) and edge names for the specified boundary.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewActiveWireTypesForWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified cellview for a given widthSpacingSnapPatternDef.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewEEQMaster
functions.description: Sets the value of the EEQmaster attribute of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Sets the equivalent connectivity time on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange
functions.syntax: dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange( d_cvId  n_minVoltage n_maxVoltage ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default minimum and maximum net voltages on a cellview ID.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewSymmetry
functions.description: Sets the symmetry (or orientation) on a cellview (for which the ID is specified). The symmetry of the cellview can be set to a string value, such as X, Y, XY, any, or none, where X mirrors the cellview about the x axis and Y mirrors the cellview about the y axis.

functions.name: dbSetColorModel
functions.description: Sets the value of the color model constraint for the specified cellview. It specifies how you want the contents of the block to be color-shifted. Possible values are any, layerBased, or locked.

functions.name: dbSetCompTypeSetDefCompFilters
functions.description: Sets the component filters in the specified compTypeSetDef.

functions.name: dbSetConnCurrent
functions.description: Sets the value of the connectivity current property to the cellview timestamp counter value.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedAreaBoundaryPoints
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Sets curved points for the specified curved area boundary object.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedPathRealWidth
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Sets the real width of the curved path. The real width could be 1DBU or more.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedPolygonPoints
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Sets the given curved point list for the specified polygon. If the polygon is not curved, it is converted to curved and the points are set.

functions.name: dbSetEndPatch
functions.description: Adds or removes the endStyle patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value.

functions.name: dbSetFigAbutName
functions.description: Assigns a unique abutment name to the figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment names specified for the figure ID.

functions.name: dbSetFigAbutRefName
functions.description: Assigns an abutment reference name to the specified figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment reference names specified for the figure ID.

functions.name: dbSetFluidShape
functions.description: Sets the given name for the specified shape to mark it as a fluid shape. This function can be used only in a sub-master layout view, for example, during Pcell generation.

functions.name: dbSetFullPatch
functions.description: Adds or removes the full style patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value. Path segment needs to have at least one property among beginStyle or endStyle or both to set the full style patch type.

functions.name: dbSetGenViaParamDefault
functions.description: Sets the specified parameter to its default value based on the given genVia ID and parameter name.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridDefaultRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetGlobalGridDefaultRepeatMode( d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_repeatMode ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode as the default on a cellview for the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grid.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridOffsetReferenceType
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the global grid offset reference type on a cellview for the snapPatternDef and widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grids. The global grid offset reference type can be boundary or origin.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetGlobalGridRepeatMode( d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_patternName t_repeatMode ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode for the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grid in the specified cellview for the given width spacing pattern.

functions.name: dbSetHierCacheUsage
functions.description: Sets the intended hierarchical cache usage for a given design, if specified; otherwise, it sets the usage for the session. The subset of operations permitted by both the session and design cache usages is enabled for the design.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractFileName
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractFileName attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractFilePath
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractFilePath attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractViewName
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractViewName attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBloat
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBloat( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName n_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction Bloat attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBlockageAttributeValue
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction BlockageAttributeValue attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBlockageModel
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction BlockageModel attribute on the specified instance header on the specified layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionDoughnutHalo
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionDoughnutHalo( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName n_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction DoughnutHalo attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionMergeDistance
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction MergeDistance attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionNeedsRemodeling
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction NeedsRemodeling attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinCutOut
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinCutOut( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName g_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction PinCutOut attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinRemodeling
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction PinRemodeling attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionSpacingModel
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionSpacingModel( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName t_spacingModelName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction SpacingModel attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInstHeaderMasterName
functions.syntax: dbSetInstHeaderMasterName(  d_instHeader  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the master of individual instance on the instHeader to the new master. All the instances are removed from the old instHeader and move to the new instHeader, which may exist or not. When an instHeader is empty, meaning it does not have any instance on this instHeader, the instHeader is removed and the ID is no longer valid.

functions.name: dbSetInstHeadersCounter
functions.description: Sets the value of the instance header change count property on each instance header to the instance master cellview timestamp counter value.

functions.name: dbSetInstTransparent
functions.description: Sets an instance as transparent to the Virtuoso Layout Suite XL binder.

functions.name: dbSetIntegrationColorModel
functions.description: Sets the value of the integration color model constraint for the specified cellview. Possible values are any or locked.

functions.name: dbSetLibDataCompressionLevel
functions.description: Sets the data compression level for designs that are saved to the specified library ID.

functions.name: dbSetMarkerName
functions.description: Assigns the specified name to the marker associated with the given marker ID. The name can be an empty string. The name can be an empty string. By default, the markers are first sorted by names and then by their box.

functions.name: dbSetNIMsgMode
functions.description: Turns on/off the not implemented message.

functions.name: dbSetNetNameDescend
functions.description: Sets a mode, descending or ascending, which determines the direction of the net name vector expression.

functions.name: dbSetNetPowerDomain
functions.description: Sets the power domain for the specified net.

functions.name: dbSetNetVoltageRange
functions.syntax: dbSetNetVoltageRange( d_netId  n_minVoltage n_maxVoltage ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the minimum and maximum voltages on the specified net.

functions.name: dbSetNetVoltageRangeSource
functions.description: Sets the voltage range source on the specified net ID.

functions.name: dbSetOccShapeColor
functions.description: Assigns the specified color to the given occurrence shape. You can set the color for occurrence shapes with types Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

functions.name: dbSetOccShapeColorLockType
functions.description: Changes the color lock type of the specified occurrence shape. You can set the color state only for occurrence shapes with the following types: Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

functions.name: dbSetOccShapeColorLocked
functions.description: Changes the color state of the specified occurrence shape. You can set the color state for occurrence shapes with types Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

functions.name: dbSetPatchType
functions.description: Sets the patch type for the specified path segment.

functions.name: dbSetPathSegPoints
functions.syntax: dbSetPathSegPoints( d_pathSegId l_beginPt l_endPt  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the beginning and ending points for the given path segment.

functions.name: dbSetPathSegStyle
functions.syntax: dbSetPathSegStyle( d_pathSeg n_width t_beginStyle t_endStyle 	[ n_beginExt n_endExt      [ n_beginLeftDiagExt n_beginRightDiagExt n_beginRightHalfWidth     n_endLeftDiagExt n_endRightDiagExt n_endRightHalfWidth ]	] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the path segment style of a given path seg database object.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionActivePattern
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the given active pattern for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified pattern region.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the given allowed pattern groups for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the given allowed patterns for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionDefaultRepeatMode
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets default repeat mode on the specified pattern region.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionName
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the specified pattern region for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionNoActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets no active wire types on the specified pattern region.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetPatternRegionRepeatMode( d_patternRegion t_patternName t_repeatMode )  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode on the pattern region for the specified width spacing pattern.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionShiftColor
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Determines whether shift color is enabled for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefName
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef name on the specified pattern region. The widthSpacingSnapPatternDef must already exist.

functions.name: dbSetPhotonicPinFigAngle
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Sets the given attribute value as the angle of the specified photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbSetPhotonicPinFigRadius
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Sets the given attribute value as the radius of the specified photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbSetPhotonicPinFigWidth
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Sets the given attribute value as the width of the specified photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbSetPinFigAccessDirection
functions.description: Specifies the access direction for the given pin figure.

functions.name: dbSetPinFigName
functions.description: Specifies the name for the given pin figure.

functions.name: dbSetPinFigPlacementStatus
functions.description: Specifies the placement status for the given pin figure.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdge
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdge( d_edgePinGroupGuide d_prBoundary t_name ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies new or updates existing prBoundary edge information for the edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdgeStartOffset
functions.description: Sets the start offset of the edge on the edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdgeStopOffset
functions.description: Sets the stop offset of the edge on the edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideKeepoutSpacing
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideKeepoutSpacing( d_pinGroupGuide tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the keepoutSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Sets the value of the layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing( d_pinGroupGuide tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the minSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinWidth
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing( d_pinGroupGuide tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the minWidth constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Sets the value of the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinMinPinSpacing
functions.syntax: dbSetPinMinPinSpacing( d_pinID tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the minSpacing constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbSetPinMinPinWidth
functions.syntax: dbSetPinMinPinWidth( d_pinID tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the minWidth constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbSetPlaceAreaOrient
functions.description: Sets the orientation of the specified custom placeArea.

functions.name: dbSetPlaceAreaUtilization
functions.description: Sets the assigned placement utilization for the specified custom placeArea.

functions.name: dbSetPlaceBoundMaxHeight
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Sets the maximum thickness of a placeBound.

functions.name: dbSetPlaceBoundMinHeight
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Sets the minimum thickness of a placeBound.

functions.name: dbSetPlacementGrid
functions.syntax: dbSetPlacementGrid( d_cellviewId l_origin  f_pitchX f_pitchY ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the placement grid information. The origin of the placement grid, and the X pitch and Y values are set for the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetRailDefFigType
functions.description: Sets the railFigType for the specified railDef.

functions.name: dbSetRouteAuthor
functions.syntax: dbSetRouteAuthor( d_routeId t_authorType [ t_subAuthorType ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the author and, optionally, the sub-author type for the specified route.

functions.name: dbSetRouteSubAuthor
functions.description: Sets the sub-author attribute on the specified route.

functions.name: dbSetRowRegionPoints
functions.description: Changes the rectilinear specification of the given rowRegion.

functions.name: dbSetRowRegionRowRegionSpec
functions.description: Sets the given rowRegionSpec as the template for the specified rowRegion.

functions.name: dbSetRowRegionUsesPartialRowSpec
functions.description: A Boolean indicating whether the population of rowRegion is set to fill the space with partial specialization of rowRegionSpec.

functions.name: dbSetShapeColor
functions.description: Assigns the specified color to the given shape if the color state is unlocked.

functions.name: dbSetShapeColorLockType
functions.description: Sets the color lock type for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetShapeColorLocked
functions.description: Changes the color state of the shape.

functions.name: dbSetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer
functions.description: Sets the connectToLayer attribute of the specified softConnect terminal.

functions.name: dbSetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer
functions.description: Sets the pinlessTerminalLayer attribute of the specified softConnect terminal. You can specify both the layer name or layer number of the terminal.

functions.name: dbSetStrapName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified strap pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetStrapTwig
functions.description: Changes the twig associated with the specified strap pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTermGroundSensitivity
functions.description: Specifies the terminal ground sensitivity attributes for the given terminal ID.

functions.name: dbSetTermMustConnectAllPins
functions.syntax: dbSetTermMustConnectAllPins( d_termId g_value { t / nil } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Indicates whether to set the mustConnectAllPins attribute on the specified terminal. The terminal must be a single-bit terminal.

functions.name: dbSetTermMustJoin
functions.description: Sets the connection status of the terminals specified by the terminal IDs to mustJoin.

functions.name: dbSetTermSoftConnect
functions.description: Sets the softConnect attribute of the specified terminal to the given value.

functions.name: dbSetTermSupplySensitivity
functions.description: Specifies the terminal supply sensitivity attributes for the given terminal ID.

functions.name: dbSetTerminalAntennaRuleOnLayer
functions.syntax: dbSetTerminalAntennaRuleOnLayer(  d_termId  t_modelName t_dataName g_value tx_layer ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an antenna rule to a specified terminal according to model name, data name, and value layer pair.

functions.name: dbSetTerminalAntennaRules
functions.syntax: dbSetTerminalAntennaRules(  d_termId  t_modelName t_dataName l_antennaValueLayerPairs  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an antenna value layer pair list to a terminal according to model name and data name.

functions.name: dbSetTextDisplayNameValueVisible
functions.syntax: dbSetTextDisplayNameValueVisible(  d_tdId g_isNameVisible g_isValueVisible ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the isNameVisible and the isValueVisible flags. The isNameVisible flag sets the text display name visibility. When this flag is set to true, the name of the text display will be visible. The isValueVisible flag sets the text display value visibility. When this flag is set to true, the value of the text display will be visible.

functions.name: dbSetTopologyName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified topology ID.

functions.name: dbSetTopologyNet
functions.description: Changes the net associated with the specified topology. The net must be a single-bit net.

functions.name: dbSetTrackPatternColorAlternating
functions.description: Sets the coloring type of the track pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor
functions.description: Assigns a color to the first track of the specified track pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkAnchor
functions.description: Sets the anchor for the specified trunk pattern. The anchor may be an instance or another trunk.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkConnectName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified trunk connect pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkConnectTrunks
functions.syntax: dbSetTrunkConnectTrunks( d_trunkConnectId  d_startTrunkId  d_endTrunkId  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the start and end trunks for the specified trunk connect ID.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkDirection
functions.description: Specifies whether the given trunk is running in the horizontal or vertical direction.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffset1
functions.description: Sets the longitudinal offset1 value for the specified trunk pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffset2
functions.description: Sets the longitudinal offset2 value for the specified trunk pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffsetSource
functions.description: Sets the longitudinal offset source value of the specified trunk pattern ID. Valid source values are twigExtents, figGroupExtents, twigExtentsTermOnly, and guardRing.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffsetSource1
functions.description: Sets the first longitudinal offset source value of the specified trunk pattern ID. Valid source values are twigExtents, figGroupExtents, instanceExtents, guardRing, and connExtents.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffsetSource2
functions.description: Sets the second longitudinal offset source value of the specified trunk pattern ID. Valid source values are twigExtents, figGroupExtents, instanceExtents, guardRing, and connExtents.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkName
functions.description: Sets the name of the trunk specified by the trunk pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkOrthoOffset
functions.description: Sets the orthogonal offset value for the specified trunk pattern ID. The specified value must be in userUnits. An orthogonal offset is only meaningful when there is an anchor set for the trunk pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkSide
functions.description: Sets the side value for the specified trunk pattern ID. The valid side values are bottom, top, left, and right.

functions.name: dbSetTwigName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified twig pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetTwigObject
functions.description: Sets the database object for the specified twig ID. A twig can have only one object and that is one of the following: InstTerm, Via, MPPShape, or a Strap.

functions.name: dbSetTwigPinName
functions.description: Sets the pin name set for the specified twig.

functions.name: dbSetUndoHandle
functions.description: Sets an undo handle with the specified name on the current undo checkpoint. If there already exists a handle with the same name, you can optionally specify that the existing handle is moved from its current position in the undo stack and associated with the current undo checkpoint.

functions.name: dbSetViaColorInfo
functions.syntax: dbSetViaColorInfo( d_dbViaId l_layer1ControlInfo  l_layer2ControlInfo  l_cutLayerControlInfo  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the color control and color state for the three via layers (via layer1, via layer2, and cut layer) of the given via.

functions.name: dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked
functions.syntax: dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked( d_dbViaId t_dbViaLayerType g_setLocked ) => t / nil
functions.description: Locks and unlocks the color state for individual layers in a via.

functions.name: dbSetViaColorStateLocked
functions.description: Sets the color state for the specified via.

functions.name: dbSetViaCutLayerControl
functions.description: Sets the color control for the cut layer shapes of the via master.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayer1Control
functions.description: Sets the color control for layer1 shapes of the via master.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayer2Control
functions.description: Sets the color control for layer2 shapes of the via master.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayerColorLockType
functions.syntax: dbSetViaLayerColorLockType( d_viaId t_viaLayer g_lockType ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the color lock type for the specified via layer.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayerControl
functions.syntax: dbSetViaLayerControl( d_dbViaId t_dbViaLayerType t_colorControl ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the color control for the specified layer in the given via.

functions.name: dbSetViaParamDefault
functions.description: Sets the value of a parameter of a specified via to use its default value by a parameter name.

functions.name: dbSetViaShapePurpose
functions.description: Sets the purposes of all shapes in the cdsVia to the specified purpose. The updated parameters include primaryShapePurpose, cutShapePurpose, and otherShapePurpose. To set all purposes to their original values (defined in the cdsViaDevice definition), use an empty string as the new purpose value.

functions.name: dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode( d_wspId t_allowedRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatMode ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets a valid combination of allowed and default repeat modes for the specified width spacing pattern.

functions.name: dbSetq, dbSet
functions.syntax: dbSetq( d_object g_value St_AttrOrPropName )  	=> g_value / nil   dbSet( d_object g_value St_AttrOrPropName )  	=> g_value / nil
functions.description: Modifies the value of an attribute or a property associated with a database object.

functions.name: dbShapeQuery
functions.syntax: dbShapeQuery( d_cellviewId l_layerPurposePair l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => l_occShapes / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the shapes in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbSoftConnectTermHasConnectToLayer
functions.description: Checks if the given terminal has the softConnect connectToLayer attribute set.

functions.name: dbSoftConnectTermHasPinlessLayer
functions.description: Checks if the given terminal has the softConnect pinlessTerminalLayer attribute set.

functions.name: dbStartGenAnyInstToInstTerm
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all instance terminals for the specified instance.

functions.name: dbStartGenInstHeader
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all instance headers of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbStartGenInstHeaderToAnyInst
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all instances of the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbStartGenLPPHeaderToShape
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all shapes of the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair (LPP) header.

functions.name: dbStartGenLPToShape
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all shapes of the specified cellview and layer-purpose pair (LPP).

functions.name: dbStartGenMarker
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all markers of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbStartGenNet
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all nets of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbStartGenNetToInstTerm
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all instance terminals of the specified net.

functions.name: dbStartGenNetToRoute
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all routes of the specified net.

functions.name: dbStartGenRoute
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all routes of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbStartGenShape
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all shapes of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbStartGenTerm
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all terms of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbStartGenViaHeader
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all via headers of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbStartGenViaHeaderToVia
functions.description: Returns a dbGenerator object that can be used to iterate over all via of the specified via header.

functions.name: dbSteinerQuery
functions.syntax: dbSteinerQuery( d_cellviewId tx_layer l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_steiner / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the steiners in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbStopGen
functions.description: Forces a dbGenerator object reference to close and removes it from virtual memory.

functions.name: dbStronglyConnectPins
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. Strong connections are modeled by multiple pinFigs on the same pin.

functions.name: dbSubAreaFromPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Removes an area boundary from the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSubFigFromNet
functions.description: Removes the given figure object from the net object with which it is already associated.

functions.name: dbSubFigFromPin
functions.description: Removes the specified figure from the given pin.

functions.name: dbSubFigFromPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Removes a via or a non-text shape from the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSubFigsFromPin
functions.description: Removes the specified list of figures from the given pin.

functions.name: dbSubPinFromPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Removes a pin from the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbTermHasMustConnectAllPins
functions.description: Checks whether the mustConnectAllPins attribute value is set on the specified single-bit terminal.

functions.name: dbTransformAccessDirection
functions.description: Transforms the given direction by the specified orientation and returns the corresponding access direction.

functions.name: dbTransformBBox
functions.description: Transforms a bounding box.

functions.name: dbTransformCellView
functions.syntax: dbTransformCellView(  d_cellViewId  f_mag  f_angle )  => t / nil
functions.description: Scales (magnifies) and/or rotates all shapes in a cellview.

functions.name: dbTransformPoint
functions.description: Transforms a coordinate pair.

functions.name: dbTransformPointList
functions.description: Transforms all points in an array in the same way as dbTransformPoint does with a single point. This function does not modify the original array, and returns the transformed array.

functions.name: dbUnabutGroup
functions.description: Unabuts members of an abutment group.

functions.name: dbUndefineProc
functions.description: Changes the parameterized cell specified by the d_cellView to be a regular cellview.

functions.name: dbUndoToHandle
functions.description: Invokes undo back to the given handle. If no handle name is given, rolls back to the last labeled checkpoint.

functions.name: dbUnregPostSaveAsTrigger
functions.description: Allows users to unregister the trigger function called after a postSaveAs operation

functions.name: dbUnregPostSaveTrigger
functions.description: Un-registers the post save trigger function from dbSave.

functions.name: dbUnregPurgeTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters a user-defined trigger function.

functions.name: dbUnregSaveTrigger
functions.description: This function unregisters the SKILL preSave trigger function specified by the given name.

functions.name: dbUnsetAreaBoundaryLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Deletes the layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbUnsetAreaBoundaryValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Deletes the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbUnsetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Removes equivalent connectivity time information from the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbUnsetCellViewNetVoltageRange
functions.description: Resets the voltage range on a cellview to its default value.

functions.name: dbUnsetCellViewPhysicalOnly
functions.description: Unsets the physical-only attribute of the specified cellview, allowing connectivity to be visible in the OpenAccess module domain.

functions.name: dbUnsetCompTypeSetDefCompFilters
functions.description: Removes the component filters from the specified compTypeSetDef.

functions.name: dbUnsetLibDataCompressionLevel
functions.description: Removes the data compression level of the specified library.

functions.name: dbUnsetNetVoltageRange
functions.description: Resets the minimum and maximum voltages on a net to their default values.

functions.name: dbUnsetNetVoltageRangeSource
functions.description: Resets the voltage range source of the specified net ID to its default value.

functions.name: dbUnsetPhotonicPinFigAngle
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Resets the attribute value of the angle for the specified photonics pinFig.

functions.name: dbUnsetPhotonicPinFigRadius
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Resets the attribute value of the radius for the specified photonics pinFig.

functions.name: dbUnsetPhotonicPinFigWidth
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Resets the attribute value of the width for the specified photonics pinFig.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideKeepoutSpacing
functions.description: Deletes the keepoutSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Deletes layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing
functions.description: Deletes the minSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideMinPinWidth
functions.description: Deletes the minWidth constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Deletes the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinMinPinSpacing
functions.description: Deletes the minSpacing constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinMinPinWidth
functions.description: Deletes the minWidth constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbUnsetTermMustJoin
functions.description: Removes the mustJoin pin connection status from the given terminal.

functions.name: dbValidP
functions.description: Determines if the argument is a valid database object ID.

functions.name: dbViaQuery
functions.syntax: dbViaQuery( d_cellviewId l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => l_hiervia / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the vias in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbWeaklyConnectPins
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. Weak pin connections are modeled by pinFigs on different pins on the same terminal.

functions.name: dbWriteSkill
functions.syntax: dbWriteSkill(  d_cellViewId  t_fileName  t_mode  t_release  [ g_conn ] db [ g_ref ]  [ g_lppString ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a file that contains all the SKILL commands needed to recreate a cellview, so that the design can be recreated in the current or previous release by loading the file in the current or previous release, respectively.

functions.name: dbWriteSkillWithLib
functions.syntax: dbWriteSkillWithLib(  d_cellviewId  t_fileName  t_mode  t_release  [ g_conn ]  [ g_ref ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a file that contains all the SKILL commands needed to recreate a cellview.

functions.name: dbobjectp
functions.description: Checks whether argument is a database object.

functions.name: ddAmUsingDM
functions.description: Uses a Design Management system if the library containing b_objId.

functions.name: ddAutoCheckin
functions.syntax: ddAutoCheckin(  l_ddIds  [ g_isBatch( { t | nil } ) ]  ) => l_list
functions.description: Automatically checks in an object or list of objects. Objects in a temporary directory cannot be managed. The function skips objects that exist only in the temporary directory of the library and displays a warning for them.

functions.name: ddAutoCheckout
functions.syntax: ddAutoCheckout(  l_ddIds  [ g_isBatch( { t | nil } ) ]  ) => l_list
functions.description: Checks out an object or list of objects automatically. Objects in a temporary directory cannot be managed; this function skips objects that exist only in the library's temporary directory and displays a warning for them.

functions.name: ddAutoCtlGetVars
functions.description: Returns a list of four elements in the following order:  x_prompCkout x_promptCkin x_AutoCkout x_AutoCkin  Each element is a value from 0 through 3 as in ddAutoCtlSetVars. Each element can have one of four values: 0 - none, 1 - views, 2 - files, 3 - both views and files.

functions.name: ddAutoCtlSetVars
functions.syntax: ddAutoCtlSetVars(  x_promptCkout  x_promptCkin  x_AutoCkout  x_AutoCkin  ) => t
functions.description: Sets prompting and automatic check-in and check-out controls for files and views. Takes a list of four integers, each of which can be one of four values: 0 - none, 1 - views, 2 - files, 3 - both views and files. The integers are applied to indicate to the system to prompt for check out, prompt for check in, automatically check out, and automatically check in respectively.

functions.name: ddCatAddItem
functions.syntax: ddCatAddItem(  b_ddId  t_name  t_type  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified name to the given category.

functions.name: ddCatClose
functions.description: Closes the category and purges its information from virtual memory. Any edits since the last ddCatSave are lost.

functions.name: ddCatFindCat
functions.syntax: ddCatFindCat(  b_ddId  t_name  t_mode  )  => b_objId / nil
functions.description: Returns the ID of a category with the given name in the given mode. Traverses category hierarchies.   This function calls ddCatOpen to get the category ID to be returned. The caller must call ddCatClose to properly flush the information from virtual memory when done. The category is opened in the given mode.

functions.name: ddCatGetCatMembers
functions.description: Returns the list of members of the given category. The function does not return the members (cells) that do not exist in the library.

functions.name: ddCatGetCatName
functions.description: Returns the category name of the given category ID.

functions.name: ddCatGetCellsNotInCat
functions.description: Returns the names of cells that are not in any category. This information is derived from an existing library.

functions.name: ddCatGetLibCats
functions.description: Returns the list of library-level categories.

functions.name: ddCatIsObjInCat
functions.description: Searches for the named object in the given category.

functions.name: ddCatOpen
functions.syntax: ddCatOpen(  b_ddId  t_categoryName  t_mode  )  => b_objId / nil
functions.description: Opens a category with the given name and uses the mode to get the object ID.

functions.name: ddCatOpenEx
functions.syntax: ddCatOpenEx(  b_ddId  t_categoryName  t_mode  x_keepEmpty  ) => b_objId / nil
functions.description: Opens a category with the given name using the mode to get the object ID.

functions.name: ddCatRefresh
functions.description: Given the DD ID of a category file, this function will purge the in-memory copy of the file and read it in again from disk. This will update the in-memory copy. Refresh is allowed only if the category was opened in read mode.

functions.name: ddCatRemove
functions.description: Removes the category and its contents from disk. All references to the category are removed from the library.

functions.name: ddCatSave
functions.description: Writes the category information to disk. This writes out any changes made to the category to disk.

functions.name: ddCatSubItem
functions.description: Removes the named item from the given category.  If the name is the name of a category (that is, removing a subcategory from another category), the  checks if it is referenced in any other category. If not, the category is moved to the library category list. This action ensures that the caller must do a ddCatRemove to remove category entries from a library. Changes are not written to disk until a ddCatSave is done.

functions.name: ddCheckin
functions.syntax: ddCheckin(  g_files  t_description  [ t_switches ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks in the new version of the checked-out and modified data files. Builds a system command that invokes the gdmci command. ddCheckin makes it possible to integrate Cadence tools with other design management software.

functions.name: ddCheckout
functions.description: Checks out a version of the files. No version of a cellview can be checked out by any user until any version that is currently checked out is checked in. Builds a system command that invokes the gdmco command. ddCheckout makes it possible to integrate Cadence tools with other design management software.

functions.name: ddClearLibUnmanaged
functions.description: Removes any DMTYPE entry from the cdsinfo.tag file in the library directory. This will allow the default value for DMTYPE to be used for this library.

functions.name: ddCreateLib
functions.description: Searches for the named library in the library list.

functions.name: ddDeleteLocal
functions.description: Removes b_objectId from the local work area only. If the objects are under design management, they are not removed from the repository.

functions.name: ddDeleteObj
functions.description: Deletes b_objectId from the disk.

functions.name: ddDumpLibList
functions.description: Prints information about the library list. It first prints the list of library files (cds.lib and lib.defs files) and then prints information about each library in the library list. This includes the path to the library and the path to TMP directories, if any.

functions.name: ddGetCoManagedSet
functions.description: Returns the list of comanaged files for the specified view.

functions.name: ddGetCombineValue
functions.description: Returns a list of names of libraries in a combined library, if the library specified has the COMBINE attribute assigned.

functions.name: ddGetDisplayValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the DISPLAY attribute assigned to a library.

functions.name: ddGetForcedLib
functions.description: Returns the path to the cds.lib file that was set by using either the -cdslib argument to the executable or by using ddSetForcedLib.

functions.name: ddGetForcedLibEx
functions.description: Gets the cds.lib file that was set with the ddSetForcedLib or ddSetForcedLibEx functions or with the -cdslib command line option.

functions.name: ddGetLibList
functions.description: Generates a list of the libraries in the libList.

functions.name: ddGetObj
functions.syntax: ddGetObj(  { t_libName / nil }  [ t_cellName / nil ]  [ t_viewName / nil ]  [ t_fileName / nil ]  [ b_contextId / nil ]  [ t_mode ]  )  => b_ddId / nil
functions.description: Finds libraries, cells, views, and files, and creates cells, views, and files (you use ddCreateLib to create libraries).

functions.name: ddGetObjAccess
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX access rights of the person specified by t_which to the object designated by b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjAccessEx
functions.syntax: ddGetObjAccessEx( b_objId  t_which  x_pathType )  => t_access / nil
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX access rights of the person specified by t_which to the object designated by b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjAccess except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjChildren
functions.description: Returns the children of b_objId. This includes all the objects in both the temporary and master directories.

functions.name: ddGetObjChildrenEx
functions.description: Returns the children of b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjChildren except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjDMSys
functions.description: Returns the name of the Design Management system of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjFiles
functions.description: Lists all the files found in the object. This includes files found in both the master and temporary directories.

functions.name: ddGetObjFilesEx
functions.description: Lists all the files found in the object. This function is similar to ddGetObjFiles except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjGroup
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX group ID of b_objId as an integer.

functions.name: ddGetObjGroupEx
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX group ID of b_objId as an integer. This function is similar to ddGetObjGroup except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjLastModify
functions.description: Returns the last-modified time from the directory or file associated with b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjLastModifyEx
functions.description: Returns the last-modified time from the directory or file associated with b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjLastModify except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjLib
functions.description: Finds the ID of the library object that contains it b_objId. If the object is a library, it returns the same ID.

functions.name: ddGetObjName
functions.description: Returns the name of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjOwner
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX owner name of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjOwnerEx
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX owner name of b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjOwner except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjParent
functions.description: Returns the ID of the logical (often physical as well) owner-object od b_objId. For a file, it is the library, cell, or view. For a view, it is the cell. For the cell, it is the library. For the library, it is the library itself.

functions.name: ddGetObjReadPath
functions.description: Returns the read path to b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjReadPathEx
functions.description: Returns the read path to b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjReadPath except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjSize
functions.description: Returns the length of b_objId in bytes.

functions.name: ddGetObjSizeEx
functions.description: Returns the length of b_objId in bytes. This function is similar to ddGetObjSize except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjType
functions.description: Returns the ddType of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjWritePath
functions.description: Returns the write path to b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjWritePathEx
functions.description: Returns the write path to b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjWritePath except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetPathDMSys
functions.description: Takes a string that is the path to a file or directory and either returns the string name of the design management system that manages that path or returns none if no design management system is in use for that path.

functions.name: ddGetStartup
functions.description: Looks for t_fileName in each standard place, and if it is not there, in stdPlace/share/cdssetup.

functions.name: ddGetTmpdirWarn
functions.description: Returns the current setting used to suppress or print a warning message for an ASSIGN statement with attribute TMP that appears in cds.lib files. The TMP attribute defines a temporary storage directory for a read-only or reference library. If you set the DD_TMPDIR_ON environment variable to NO, the temporary directory functionality is turned off and DDPI skips ASSIGN and UNASSIGN statements when parsing cds.lib files and, by default, prints the following warning:  WARNING `<PATH_TO_CDSLIB_FILE>/cds.lib', Line 3: skipping: 'ASSIGN' lib1 TMP /tmp

functions.name: ddGetTriggerList
functions.description: Returns a list of functions registered to be executed when t_triggerName is activated.

functions.name: ddGetUpdatedLib
functions.description: Returns the path to the cds.lib file that was last used by ddUpdateLibList. This is the same as ddGetForcedLib if a forced library was in effect.

functions.name: ddHiCreateCellComboField
functions.syntax: ddHiCreateCellComboField( ?name s_fieldName  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]  [ ?validationType g_validationType ]  [ ?highlightType g_highlightType ]  )  => r_comboField
functions.description: Creates a customized Cell combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting cells.

functions.name: ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox
functions.syntax: ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox( ?name s_name  [ ?prompt t_prompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]  [ ?validationType g_validationType ]  [ ?highlightType g_highlightType ]  )  => o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a customized Cell combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting cells.

functions.name: ddHiCreateLibraryComboField
functions.syntax: ddHiCreateLibraryComboField( ?name s_fieldName  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]  [ ?validationType g_validationType ]  [ ?highlightType g_highlightType ]  )  => r_comboField
functions.description: Creates a customized Library combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting libraries.

functions.name: ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox
functions.syntax: ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox( ?name s_name  [ ?prompt t_prompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]  [ ?validationType g_validationType ]  [ ?highlightType g_highlightType ]  )  => o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a customized Library combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting libraries.

functions.name: ddHiCreateViewComboField
functions.syntax: ddHiCreateViewComboField( ?name s_fieldName  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]  [ ?viewTypes l_viewTypes ] [ ?validationType g_validationType ]  [ ?highlightType g_highlightType ]  )  => r_comboField
functions.description: Creates a customized View combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting views.

functions.name: ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox
functions.syntax: ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox( ?name s_name  [ ?prompt t_prompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]  [ ?viewTypes l_viewTypes ] [ ?validationType g_validationType ]  [ ?highlightType g_highlightType ]  )  => o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a customized View combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting views.

functions.name: ddHiLinkFields
functions.syntax: ddHiLinkFields( o_libraryComboBox o_cellCombobox o_viewComboBox ) => t / nil
functions.description: Connects the given combo boxes, where the value changes in one combo box triggers re-populating of the next combo box.

functions.name: ddIsHiddenCell
functions.description: Determines whether the specified cell is hidden. A cell is hidden if it is a member of the Hidden category or a member of a subcategory of the Hidden category.

functions.name: ddIsId
functions.description: Returns t if b_objId is an opaque ID known to the PI, and nil otherwise. Some dd functions will accept nil as the ID parameter, but this function returns nil if the argument is nil.

functions.name: ddIsObjLibMarked
functions.description: Returns t if the library that owns b_objId is marked to be deleted or its path is changed.

functions.name: ddIsObjReadable
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be read by the current process.

functions.name: ddIsObjReadableEx
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be read by the current process. This function is similar to ddIsObjReadable except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddIsObjWritable
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be modified by the current process.

functions.name: ddIsObjWritableEx
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be modified by the current process. This function is similar to ddIsObjWritable except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddIsPathManageable
functions.description: Returns t if the supplied path is manageable (is in a location that is supported by a design management system).

functions.name: ddIsPathManaged
functions.description: Returns t if the specified path is currently managed by a design management system. A path is managed if the file associated with the path is checked in. You can use ddIsPathManaged to implement a check against creating a file when another user has already created it but the local user work area is not updated to reflect the creation.

functions.name: ddLibHasTmpDir
functions.description: Checks if the library has a temporary directory. A temporary directory for a library is defined by putting a TMP attribute on the library with an ASSIGN statement in a cds.lib file.

functions.name: ddLibIs5X
functions.description: Determines if the library was created with the 5.X library structure.

functions.name: ddLockDescribe
functions.description: Fills a static string with a message.

functions.name: ddLockFree
functions.description: Releases any existing lock on the file specified by b_lockId.

functions.name: ddLockGetStatus
functions.syntax: ddLockGetStatus(  b_lockId  )  => x_sysId t_type x_value t_userName t_userHost t_fileHost t_filePath
functions.description: Retrieves frequently needed information from the lock table: The lock-system ID, type, and value and the holder's user name and hostid.

functions.name: ddLockPath
functions.description: Creates a handle that allows you to lock the file and returns a lock ID for the file. Once you call ddLockFree, all references to that lock ID become invalid.

functions.name: ddLockSet
functions.syntax: ddLockSet(  b_lockId  t_mode  [ t_block ]  [ t_message ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Gets the type of lock in t_mode for the file ID. If you have already locked the file, this function changes the lock type.

functions.name: ddLockSetEx
functions.syntax: ddLockSetEx( b_lockId  t_mode  [ g_block ]  [ t_message ]  [ g_doErrMsgs]  [ g_timeout ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: An extension of ddLockSet with two additional arguments.

functions.name: ddMapGetDataTypeFileName
functions.description: Returns the pattern registered in the registry for t_dataType.

functions.name: ddMapGetDataTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of names of the data types specified in the registry.

functions.name: ddMapGetFileDataType
functions.description: Returns the name of the data type associated with b_fileObjId.

functions.name: ddMapGetFileTool
functions.description: Looks up the data format registered in the registry for b_fileObjId's file name, and returns the tool name of the preferred editor (if there is one) or the default editor which is registered for that data format.

functions.name: ddMapGetFileViewType
functions.description: Returns the name of the view type associated with b_fileObjId.

functions.name: ddMapGetToolNameDataType
functions.description: Returns the name of the first data type in the registry which is associated with t_toolName.

functions.name: ddMapGetToolNameList
functions.description: Retrieves a list of the names of the tools specified in the registry, in alphabetical order.

functions.name: ddMapGetToolNameViewType
functions.description: Returns the name of the first view type in the registry which is associated with t_toolName.

functions.name: ddMapGetViewTypeFileName
functions.description: Returns the pattern registered in the registry for a view alias or data type named t_viewType.

functions.name: ddMapGetViewTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of names of view types defined in the registry, in alphabetical order. If a data type in the registry has a dfII_viewType property defined, the value of that property will be in the list. Otherwise, the data type name will be in the list.

functions.name: ddMapIsFileNameKnown
functions.description: Returns t if the file name is registered as the pattern for some data format in the registry.

functions.name: ddMapIsToolLegal
functions.description: Returns t if t_toolName is either the preferred editor or the default editor for b_fileObjId.

functions.name: ddMapIsToolNameKnown
functions.description: Returns t if t_toolName is defined in the registry.

functions.name: ddMarkObjMaster
functions.description: Changes the master.tag file to designate the object as the new master. The master.tag file must be located with the file it designates, so you must be able to write a file to mark it master. The master.tag file is checked out of the Design Management system, if necessary.

functions.name: ddNeedCheckout
functions.description: Enables the tools that need to provide automatic checkout behavior to determine if these tools need to call the ddCheckout and ddCheckin functions.

functions.name: ddObjHasNamedObj
functions.description: Returns t if b_objId has a child object named t_fileName.

functions.name: ddObjHasNamedObjEx
functions.syntax: ddObjHasNamedObjEx( b_objId t_fileName  x_pathType ) => t / nil
functions.description: Returns t if b_objId has a child object named t_fileName. This function is similar to ddObjHasNamedObj except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddObjIsInMaster
functions.description: Checks if the object exists in the master directory.

functions.name: ddObjIsInTmp
functions.description: Checks if the object exists in the temporary directory. A temporary directory for a library is defined by putting a TMP attribute on the library with an ASSIGN statement in a cds.lib file. The library itself is considered the master directory.

functions.name: ddProduceObjRelNames
functions.syntax: ddProduceObjRelNames(  b_objId  g_consumer  g_clientData  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Produces the names of all the objects that belong to a library, cell, or view and calls the given function with each name and any provided data structure.

functions.name: ddProduceObjRelNamesEx
functions.syntax: ddProduceObjRelNamesEx( b_objId  g_consumer  g_clientData  x_pathType )  => t / nil
functions.description: Produces the names of all the objects that belong to a library, cell, or view and calls the given function with each name and any provided data structure. This function is similar to ddProduceObjRelNames except that you can specify whether to look for the objects in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddRegHiddenCellsFunc
functions.description: Registers a user-defined SKILL function that will be called to obtain a list of hidden cell names. Note that additionally the Virtuoso environment considers a cell to be hidden if it is a member of the Hidden category or its subcategories.

functions.name: ddRegTrigger
functions.syntax: ddRegTrigger(  t_triggerName  s_triggerFunc  [ x_priority ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a function to be called when the triggering event occurs. Adds callbacks (triggers) to PI functions that change things. Each of these PI functions has a pre-trigger and an post-trigger.

functions.name: ddReleaseObj
functions.description: When you find an object using write (w) or append (a) mode, and the object and its parents do not yet exist, ddGetObj creates the object and its parents in the file system. The effect of this action is to make them visible in the browser and to permit us to designate file as a Master. After you close the file, you should call ddReleaseObj, which then deletes the file if you did not save it yet.

functions.name: ddSetForcedLib
functions.description: If the given path is a valid path, the forcedLib is used for all future library updates/creates/deletes and t is returned. If the path is an empty string, the default cds.lib file is used for all future library updates/creates/deletes and t is returned. If a path is given that is not valid, nil is returned with no error message and the forcedLib will be unchanged.

functions.name: ddSetForcedLibEx
functions.description: Sets the cds.lib file to be used instead of searching for them in the default locations. If no cds.lib is specified but a lib.defs file is specified, the function will use the specified lib.defs as a forced cds.lib file. Cadence recommends you to use the ddSetForcedLib function instead.

functions.name: ddSetLibDmType
functions.description: Sets the DMTYPE entry of the cdsinfo.tag file in the library.

functions.name: ddSetLibUnmanaged
functions.description: Sets the DMTYPE entry of the cdsinfo.tag file in the library directory to none. This will guarantee that regardless of the default value for DMTYPE, this library will not be DM managed. If the library has a temporary directory, it will also not be managed.

functions.name: ddSetTmpdirWarn
functions.description: Enables or disables printing of a warning message for an ASSIGN statement with attribute TMP which appears in cds.lib files. The TMP attribute defines a temporary storage directory for a read-only or reference library. If you set the DD_TMPDIR_ON environment variable to NO, the temporary directory functionality is turned off and DDPI skips ASSIGN and UNASSIGN statements when parsing cds.lib files. In that case, DDPI prints the following warning by default: WARNING `<PATH_TO_CDSLIB_FILE>/cds.lib', Line 3: skipping: 'ASSIGN' lib1 TMP /tmp  If you do not want the warning message to be printed, specify nil for the g_doWarn argument.

functions.name: ddUnregHiddenCellsFunc
functions.description: Unregisters a hidden cells function that was registered using ddRegHiddenCellsFunc.

functions.name: ddUnregTrigger
functions.description: Removes a callback (trigger function) from a named list of trigger functions.

functions.name: ddUpdateLibList
functions.description: Establishes and re-establishes a list of libraries in virtual memory to be used by ddGetObj.

functions.name: ddoAccepts
functions.description: This function is a method of ddHiObjFilter that is called with a specified dd object argument to get listed in the associated combo box.

functions.name: ddoPreferred
functions.description: This function is a method of ddHiObjFilter that returns the preferred dd view object only for the View combo box. This return value is called after a linked cell ID is changed, and the value of the View combo box is not valid. The function is called with a list of dd object IDs and is expected to return a valid dd-view-id or nil.

functions.name: ddsAboutDFII
functions.description: Opens the product information dialog box, which indicates the product, the release number, and copyright information. This dialog box is used for the custom IC design tools.

functions.name: ddsBrowserAction
functions.description: Returns the Boolean value of the requested Library Browser option. This function explains how applications use the Library Browser preferences and the actions specified in the ddsSyncWithForm function. If you are integrating your own Library Browser, you must decide whether to support such actions; if so, you can use this function. This functionality provides applications the ability to support the user's need to see the Library Browser when a particular command is executed.

functions.name: ddsCheckSessionName
functions.description: Checks to see if the current MPS session is also the default session for the user. If the given session name is the same as the effective user ID's name or if there is no session name, builds a unique session name using the process ID. This implies that the current process checks the session and returns the session name to use - either the given name if it is checked or a new unique name to use to perform the checking.

functions.name: ddsCheckinPreferences
functions.description: Sets the prompt behavior you choose for the current DFII design session for checking in design data. This function displays a form to set the auto checkin prompt preferences for properties, files, and cellviews. This process controls access to the design data files that design and team members store in a project data repository.

functions.name: ddsCheckoutPreferences
functions.description: Sets the prompt behaviors you select for the current DFII design session for checking out design data. This function displays a form to set the auto checkout prompt preferences for properties, files, and cellviews. This process controls access to the design data files that design and team members store in a project data repository.

functions.name: ddsCloseLibManager
functions.description: Closes the Library Manager.

functions.name: ddsEditProp
functions.description: Invokes the property editor on the named object. Calls peEditProp after getting the ID for the named object.

functions.name: ddsEndSyncWithForm
functions.description: Terminates an application's form synchronization with the Library Browser and closes the Library Browser.

functions.name: ddsFileBrowseCB
functions.syntax: ddsFileBrowseCB(  g_form s_targetName [ t_filter ]  [ s_mode ]  [ t_caption ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a file browser dialog for specifying file names through browsing.

functions.name: ddsGetCurrentLib
functions.description: Accesses the currently selected library in the Library Browser.

functions.name: ddsGetCustomLibSelect
functions.description: Returns the name string passed to ddsRegCustomLibSelect if a custom Library Browser is registered to the system. If a custom Library Browser is not registered, nil is returned.

functions.name: ddsGetLibManLCV
functions.description: Returns the library, cell, and view name entries currently selected in the library manager

functions.name: ddsGetLibManLogFileName
functions.description: Returns the path to the log file created by Library Manager.

functions.name: ddsGetServiceName
functions.description: Returns a string that can be used as an MPS service name. The string is the name of the invoked program plus the process ID number.

functions.name: ddsHiCloseData
functions.description: Displays the Close and Purge Data form that prompts you to select one or more objects to close and purge form virtual memory.

functions.name: ddsHiCreateLibrary
functions.description: Create new libraries from within DFII.

functions.name: ddsHiMakeReadOnly
functions.description: Displays a form that prompts you to select cellviews currently open in edit mode and change them to read only mode.

functions.name: ddsHiOpenCdsLibEditor
functions.description: Brings up the Library Path Editor.

functions.name: ddsHiPreferences
functions.description: Invokes the Browser and CIW Preferences form.

functions.name: ddsHiRefresh
functions.description: Opens a form listing the open technology files, properties, and cellviews that are not current with their corresponding files on disk.

functions.name: ddsHiSaveData
functions.description: Displays the Save Modified Data form that prompts you to select one or more objects to save from virtual memory.

functions.name: ddsLEWhatsNewAtStartup
functions.description: Brings up the What's New window for Virtuoso Layout Editor.

functions.name: ddsOnLineHelp
functions.description: Brings up online Help documentation for DFII tools.

functions.name: ddsOpenConvertToolBox
functions.description: Displays the Conversion Tool Box user interface.

functions.name: ddsOpenLibManager
functions.description: Starts the library manager. The separate process, library manager, is invoked and connected to using mps.

functions.name: ddsProgramName
functions.description: Returns the name of the program minus any .exe extension.

functions.name: ddsRefresh
functions.syntax: ddsRefresh( [ ?cellview { t | nil } ] [ ?cdf { t | nil } ] [ ?property { t | nil } ] [ ?techfile { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Refreshes open cellviews, CDFs, property bags, and technology files that are not current with their corresponding files on disk.

functions.name: ddsRegCustomLibSelect
functions.syntax: ddsRegCustomLibSelect(  t_name  s_sync  s_update  s_endSync  s_curlLib ) => t / nil
functions.description: ddserv only supports one customization at a given time. If you call this function more than once, the latest set of functions are registered. The ddsRegCustomSelect function performs an isCallable Check on each of its arguments to insure that the functions have been loaded into the system. If not, a message is generated.

functions.name: ddsRegPostRefreshTrigger
functions.description: Registers a user-defined SKILL function that is called after completion of the Refresh command using CIW - File - Refresh or the ddsRefresh  SKILL function.

functions.name: ddsRegPreRefreshTrigger
functions.description: Registers a user-defined SKILL function that is called before executing the Refresh command using CIW - File - Refresh or the ddsRefresh SKILL function.

functions.name: ddsServSelect
functions.description: Processes a select request from the browser process if and only if a form is synchronized to it. It is the call logged in the cds.log file. The function sets the appropriate form field with the library, cell, and view values.

functions.name: ddsSetLibManLCV
functions.syntax: ddsSetLibManLCV( t_lib [ t_cell ] [ t_view ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Allows the application to set the library name, cell name, or view name entries in the library manager from a DFII session.

functions.name: ddsSyncWithForm
functions.syntax: ddsSyncWithForm(  g_form  s_action  s_libField  [ s_cellField [ s_viewField [ l_viewTypes ] ] ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the given form and fields of that form for synchronization with the Library Browser. The Library Browser is seeded with the current values of the library, cell, and view names from the fields in the form if they are not blank. The field value is not updated by ddsSyncWithForm when its enabled or editable attribute is set to nil. From this point until ddsEndSyncWithForm, selections in the Library Browser seed the given form fields.

functions.name: ddsUnregCustomLibSelect
functions.description: Un-registers the custom Library Browser interface during a session.

functions.name: ddsUpdateSyncWithForm
functions.description: If an application has registered a form with the Library Browser by calling ddsSyncWithForm or dmbSyncWithForm, this function updates the Library Browser with the values currently in the respective form fields.

functions.name: ddsViewDDProp
functions.description: Finds information about the specified object and any properties found in its property bag.

functions.name: ddsWhatsNew
functions.description: Brings up the What's New window.

functions.name: deAddAppCapabilities
functions.syntax: deAddAppCapabilities( t_viewType [ ?newFile g_newFile ] [ ?openFile g_openFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the required application capabilities to the specified view type.

functions.name: deBack
functions.description: This API allows you to go back to a particular window event. It takes two optional integer arguments, w_window and numSteps. If deBack is called without any arguments it will open and display the cellview that was displayed prior to the current cellview in the current window.

functions.name: deBeginConfigurePlugins
functions.description: Lets applications issue a series of deInstallPlugin and deRemovePlugin calls to add or remove plugins in the specified application window. Using deBeginConfigurePlugins before adding or removing plugins helps in reducing calls to the hiApplyWinConfig SKILL function.

functions.name: deCopy
functions.description: Makes a complete copy of the given window, including its stack and the context data stored on it.

functions.name: deCustomizeToolbars
functions.syntax: deCustomizeToolbars(  [ ?app t_appName ] [ ?toolbar t_toolbar ] [ ?toolbarItem t_toolbarItem ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Invokes the Toolbar Manager graphical user interface for customizing toolbars in the Virtuoso environment.

functions.name: deDisableApp
functions.description: Enables the application registered with t_appName in w_window. It affects only the customizer menu in w_window. It is available to allow certain applications to be disabled depending on run-time state associated with a particular design.

functions.name: deEditInPlace
functions.syntax: deEditInPlace(  w_window  [ l_fileSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName ] ] ]  )  => w_window / nil
functions.description: Requires that w_window exists and has at least one stack element.

functions.name: deEnableApp
functions.description: Enables the application registered with t_appName in w_window. It affects only the customizer menu in w_window. It is available to allow certain applications to be enabled depending on run-time state associated with a particular design.

functions.name: deEndConfigurePlugins
functions.description: Indicates an end to a series of calls for deInstallPlugin and deRemovePlugin marked by the deBeginConfigurePlugins in the same application window.

functions.name: deFileNew
functions.description: Opens the Create New File form.

functions.name: deFileOpen
functions.description: Similar to deOpen(). Radio buttons on the Open form are displayed that allow selection between opening the cellview in a new tab, current tab, or a new window.

functions.name: deFindAssistant
functions.syntax: deFindAssistant( t_assistant w_sessionWindow [ ?search_object_name { t | nil } ] [ ?search_window_name { t | nil } ] [ ?in_active_tab { t | nil } ] ) => w_dwindow / nil
functions.description: Returns the dock window ID associated with the specified assistant name in the specified session window. By default, the function returns the assistant whose window name matches t_assistant in the currently active tab of w_sessionWindow.
