You can optionally widen the search to include object names in all tabs of the specified session window.

functions.name: deFindPlugin
functions.description: Searches for and returns an instance of the specified plugin installed in the given application window

functions.name: deFindToolbar
functions.description: Searches for and returns an instance of the specified toolbar installed in the given session window. This function also supports the Virtuoso design editor toolbars, such as Workspaces, Go, and Bookmarks.

functions.name: deForward
functions.description: Allows you to go forward to a particular window event. It takes two optional integer argument; w_window and numSteps. If the command is called without any arguments it will open and display the cellview that was displayed prior to the use of the last deBack command in the current window.

functions.name: deGetAllApplicationNames
functions.description: Returns a list of all applications that can be associated with the given root view type.

functions.name: deGetAllRootTypes
functions.description: Returns a list of all currently registered root view types.

functions.name: deGetAllViewTypes
functions.description: Returns a list of all fully registered view types and view sub types. Any view sub type for which some parent has not been registered will not appear in this list.

functions.name: deGetAppClassInfo
functions.description: Returns a copy of the registration information (DPL) associated with the given application

functions.name: deGetAppInfo
functions.description: Returns the application registration information associated with t_viewType and its sub-view types.

functions.name: deGetCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. A value of nil is returned if the stack is empty, x_level is not a valid stack level in w_window, or x_level is -1. If x_level is defaulted or nil then the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetConfigId
functions.description: Gets the Hierarchy Manager configuration ID associated with the given window.

functions.name: deGetContext
functions.description: Returns the context for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. A value of nil is returned if the stack is empty or x_level is -1. If x_level is not specified or is nil, the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetEIP
functions.description: Returns the edit-in-place state for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. The edit-in-place state is t if that stack level was created by the deEditInPlace function and nil otherwise. f nil is returned if the stack is empty or x_level is -1. If x_level is not specified or is nil then the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetEditCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview for the item on the window stack corresponding to the current edit level. nil is returned if the stack is empty.

functions.name: deGetEditContext
functions.description: Returns the context for the item on the window stack corresponding to the current edit level.

functions.name: deGetEditLevel
functions.description: Returns the current edit level of w_window. If the stack is empty, the routine returns -1. The current edit level is the level of the stack which is currently being displayed. This is normally the maximum edit level, unless deGoToLevel was executed.

functions.name: deGetEditRootType
functions.description: Returns the root class view type of the item at the current edit level in w_window.

functions.name: deGetEditViewType
functions.description: Returns the t_viewType of the item at the current edit level in w_window.

functions.name: deGetLowerTierApp
functions.description: Returns a list of application names, which are x_lowerBy levels lower in tier in the same family of given t_appName. The default value for x_lowerBy is one.

functions.name: deGetMaxEditLevel
functions.description: Returns the highest edit level of w_window. If the stack is empty, returns -1.

functions.name: deGetMaxInContextLevel
functions.description: Gets the maximum level of the given window that is being edited in the context of the Hierarchy Manager configuration ID associated with the window. If the window has no configuration ID, 0 is returned.

functions.name: deGetPlugins
functions.description: Returns a list of all plugin instances installed in the given application window

functions.name: deGetProbeContext
functions.description: Returns the probe context for the window.

functions.name: deGetProbeTrigger
functions.description: Returns the current probe trigger.

functions.name: deGetPushed
functions.description: Returns the pushed state for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. The pushed state is t if that x_level is any level other than the current edit level and nil otherwise. nil is returned if the stack is empty or x_level is -1. If x_level is defaulted or is nil then the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetRootType
functions.description: Returns the root class t_viewType of the item at x_level in w_window. nil is returned if the stack is empty. If x_level is not specified, the current level is assumed.

functions.name: deGetRootViewTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of root view types, which have an associated tool as specified in the tool registry.

functions.name: deGetVector
functions.description: Gets the Hierarchy Manager path vector associated with the given window.

functions.name: deGetViewType
functions.description: Returns the view type of the item at x_level in w_window. nil is returned if the stack is empty. If x_level is not specified, the current level is assumed.

functions.name: deHiSetDefaultApplication
functions.description: Opens the Set Default Application form for the current cellview.

functions.name: deInheritEnabling
functions.description: Enables t_viewType to depend on the enabling of its parent type. Thus, the user must have the parent application licensed in order to use the application. t_viewType must be a subclass of some other view type.

functions.name: deInheritMenus
functions.description: Causes t_viewType to inherit the menus defined by its parent class.

functions.name: deInstallApp
functions.description: Switches the current application in w_window to t_appName. The enable trigger is called before switching, and if it returns nil, the switch is aborted. Otherwise, the application menus and bindkeys are installed as if the user had executed the corresponding customizer item.

functions.name: deInstallPlugin
functions.description: Installs (or activates) the specified plugin in an application window associated with the given ID. For each session window, DE makes only one instance of a plugin. deInstallPlugin function installs a plugin in an application window. A session window can host multiple application windows. This means that if an instance of the plugin already exists in the specified window, the instance is returned. And, if there exists an instance in another tab of the same session window, the instance is shared.

functions.name: deIsEditInContext
functions.description: Tells whether the current edit cellview in the window is in the context of a Hierarchy Manager configuration.

functions.name: deManageToolbar
functions.syntax: deManageToolbar(  w_sessionWindow o_toolbar [ g_appName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Puts the toolbar handle on the given session window (under DE management) for the specified application. A managed toolbar is displayed as a menu item in Window-Toolbars and in the context menu of the session window.

functions.name: deMapUserTypeToViewType
functions.description: Maps a user type to the dfII_viewType.

functions.name: deMapViewTypeToUserType
functions.description: Maps the dfII_viewType to the user type.

functions.name: deNew
functions.syntax: deNew(  [ l_fileSpec ]  [ g_winSpec ]  [ t_accessMode ]  [ t_appName ]  )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates a new cellview and opens it in a window.

functions.name: deNewCellView
functions.syntax: deNewCellView(  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_viewType  g_winSpec  ) => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates a new cellview and opens it in a window.

functions.name: deOpen
functions.syntax: deOpen(  [ l_fileSpec [ g_winSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName g_sessionWindow g_saveSessionHistory] ] ] ]  )  => w_window / nil
functions.description: Takes a design specification and a window specification and attempts to install the design in the specified window.

functions.name: deOpenCellView
functions.syntax: deOpenCellView(  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_viewType  g_winSpec  t_accessMode  ) => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Opens an existing cellview in a window.

functions.name: dePush
functions.syntax: dePush(  [ l_fileSpec [ g_winSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName ] ] ] ]  )  => w_window / nil
functions.description: The same as deOpen, except that if the window already exists, the current contents are not removed. Instead the new design is pushed on top of the existing one.

functions.name: deRegApp
functions.syntax: deRegApp( [ ?viewType t_viewType ] [ ?parentType t_parentType ] [ ?appName t_appName ] [ ?help t_help ] [ ?dataTrigger s_dataTrigger ] [ ?appTrigger s_appTrigger ] [ ?enableTrigger s_enableTrigger ] [ ?menuTrigger s_menuTrigger ] [ ?postInstallTrigger s_postInstallTrigger ] [ ?viewNameSwitchTrigger s_viewNameSwitchTrigger ] [ ?widgetType t_widgetType ] [ ?noCadenceMenu g_noCadenceMenu ] [ ?windowBBoxProc s_function ] [ ?appTitle t_appTitle ] [ ?exclusive g_exclusive ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the characteristics and entry points of applications so that they can be called in the appropriate situations.

functions.name: deRegPlugin
functions.syntax: deRegPlugin( t_appName s_className s_superClass [ ?appTitle t_appTitle ] [ ?bindkeys l_bindkeys ] [ ?group t_group ] [ ?help t_help ] [ ?pluggableMainApps g_pluggableMainApps ] [ ?pluggableViewTypes l_pluggableViewTypes ] [ ?shortDescription t_shortDescription ] [ ?excludeViewTypes l_excludeViewTypes ] ) => l_appClassInfo
functions.description: Registers the characteristics of plugins.

functions.name: deRegProbeTrigger
functions.description: Registers a probe trigger, s_probeTrigger, to be called after creating a new window or installing a new design in an existing window.

functions.name: deRegUserTriggers
functions.syntax: deRegUserTriggers(  t_viewType  [ s_appTrigger [ s_menuTrigger [ s_postInstallTrigger ] ] ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Registers user application, user menu, and user post install triggers.

functions.name: deRemoveAppCapabilities
functions.syntax: deRemoveAppCapabilities( t_viewType [ ?newFile g_newFile ] [ ?openFile g_openFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes the required application capabilities from the specified view type.

functions.name: deRemovePlugin
functions.description: Removes (or deactivates) the named plugin from the specified application window-session or tab window. If the ID is of a session window, the plugin is removed from all tab windows associated with the session window.

functions.name: deReturn
functions.description: Pops the window stack one or more levels.

functions.name: deSetCellView
functions.syntax: deSetCellView(  [ w_window [ d_cellview [ x_level ] ] ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Replaces the cellview for the current item on the window stack. nil is returned if the stack is empty. This routine is intended for use by data triggers executing the 'swap operation. It should never be called by an application outside of a data trigger.

functions.name: deSetConfigId
functions.description: Sets the Hierarchy Manager configuration ID associated with the given window. Also creates a path vector and sets the window path vector. If g_hdbConfigId is nil, the window path vector is destroyed, and the window configuration ID is set to nil.

functions.name: deSetContext
functions.syntax: deSetContext(  [ w_window [ g_context [ x_level ] ] ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Replaces the context for the item at the specified level on the window stack. nil is returned if the stack is empty. This routine is intended for use by data triggers executing the 'swap operation. It should never be called by application code outside of a data trigger.

functions.name: deSetHistoryOpenMode
functions.description: Controls whether designs are opened from history in a new tab or a new window. The setting applies equally to opening a design from the CIW as well as from a session window.

functions.name: deSetProbeContext
functions.description: Sets the probe context for the window. This is normally executed only by the probing implementation in the probe trigger.

functions.name: deSetWorkspace
functions.description: Sets a workspace name to a given window (as long as the workspace name is valid for that window).

functions.name: deSwap
functions.syntax: deSwap(  [ l_fileSpec [ g_winSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName] ] ] ]  )  => w_window / nil
functions.description: This function is same as deOpen, except that if the window already exists, the current contents are not removed. Instead the current stack item is replaced with the new design.

functions.name: deToggleAssistantVisibility
functions.description: Toggles the visibility of the given assistant in the given session window.

functions.name: deToggleAssistants
functions.description: Toggles the visibility of the current assistants off or on to maximize the size of the design window.

functions.name: deToggleToolbars
functions.description: Toggles the currently visible toolbars off. If no visible toolbars are found, toggles the previously hidden toolbars on.

functions.name: deUnInheritEnabling
functions.description: Removes the inheritance of enabling for t_viewType.

functions.name: deUnInheritMenus
functions.description: Removes the inheritance of menus for t_viewType.

functions.name: deUnRegApp
functions.description: Un-registers the view type.  Only one application can currently be registered for each view type. If a second registration is attempted, an error results. To re-register a view type with different procedures, the view type must first be unregistered with this routine.

functions.name: deUnRegProbeTrigger
functions.description: Removes the current probe trigger.

functions.name: deUnRegUserTriggers
functions.description: Removes any user triggers associated with t_viewType.

functions.name: deUnmanageToolbar
functions.syntax: deUnmanageToolbar(  w_sessionWindow s_toolbar [ g_appName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes the toolbar from the given session window (under DE management) for the specified application. A toolbar should be removed using the deUnmanageToolbar function before it can be deleted.

functions.name: deViewTypeIsRegistered
functions.description: Returns a non-nil value if t_viewType is fully registered; that is, all ancestors up to and including the root type are currently registered.

functions.name: deletePoint
functions.description: Deletes a point from the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: deoEnableTrigger
functions.description: Determines if the application is enabled for use by the current user. The enable trigger will normally do any appropriate security checks necessary to make this determination. Design Editor calls the enable trigger before installing a plugin and then installs the plugin only if this trigger returns a non-nil value. The default deoEnableTrigger permits a plugin to be installed on top of an application as long as it is pluggable to the application.

functions.name: deoExitTrigger
functions.description: When a plugin is being removed from a window, Design Editor calls the exit trigger before disabling all GUI components of the plugin and removes the plugin only if this trigger returns a non-nil value. The return value of the exit trigger is ignored if the window on which the plugin is installed is being closed. The default implementation is a no-op, and always returns t.

functions.name: deoGetAssistantList
functions.description: Returns a list of t_assistant_name and s_placement pairs (called an association list and contains a list of key and value pairs). The default implementation returns all assistants defined by this plugin and super-plugins.

functions.name: deoGetBindkeys
functions.description: Returns a copy of bindkeys defined for the plugin in the format that is acceptable by hiSetBindKeys(). When installing a plugin, DE calls hiSetBindKeys using the value of deoGetBindkeys method. A default implementation of deoGetBindkeys is provided by DE, which returns a list of bindkeys collectively defined by a plugin and its super-plugin(s) through deRegPlugin ?bindkeys argument. The bindkeys returned are ordered from generic to specific.

functions.name: deoMenuTrigger
functions.description: Returns a list of menus to be installed in the banner of a window. The menu trigger is called when the Design Editor installs and removes the plugin. Whenever there's an application switching event, deoMenuTrigger is called again for plugins that are pluggable to the application being switched into. For example, given a plugin whose pluggableViewTypes equals schematic, the plugin is pluggable to all schematic-based applications. So, if the plugin is currently installed in a VSE window then, if you launch VSE XL in the same window the menu trigger will be called again. Also push down, or return back into another schematic cell-view, the deoMenuTrigger is called again. The default deoMenuTrigger is a no-op. It returns args->bannerMenus as is.

functions.name: deoOnApplicationChange
functions.description: An event notification function called when data or application changes in a window, such as when a user opens new data or installs a new application in a window, traverses down or up a design hierarchy, or opens another cellview. This function is called for all active plugins at the same time the DE change-application-trigger is called. The order in which calls are made to all deoOnApplicationChange functions is not defined.

functions.name: deoOnEvent
functions.description: This event handler can be reimplemented in a subclass to receive various events.

functions.name: deoOnTabSwitch
functions.syntax: deoOnTabSwitch( g_application w_sessionWin w_intoWin g_outofWin ) => g_value
functions.description: An event notification function called during HI calling post tab switch procedures. The order in which calls are made to all deoOnTabSwitch functions is not defined.

functions.name: deoPostInstallTrigger
functions.description: The post-install trigger is called after all other processing is done, including installation of banner menu, toolbar, assistant, bindkeys. This is provided for those applications that need to finish up any initialization that must occur after GUI is installed.

functions.name: deoRequireToolbars
functions.description: Returns a list of toolbar names (string) that are to be customized by the plugin. A plugin can customize toolbars of a main application, or those of another plugin. For a plugin to declare which toolbars need customization, re-define method deoRequireToolbars.

functions.name: deoUpdateToolbar
functions.syntax: deoUpdateToolbar( g_plugin t_name o_toolbar l_args ) => g_value
functions.description: Customizes a toolbar that is requested by deoRequireToolbars. DE calls this method during installing and removing a plugin.

functions.description: Specifies that a set of environment variables is to be loaded from a specified file.

functions.name: envRegLoadDumpTrigger
functions.syntax: envRegLoadDumpTrigger( ?tool t_toolName  ?loadFunc s_loadFunc  ?dumpFunc s_dumpFunc ?preDumpFunc s_preDumpFunc ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the trigger function to be called when a tool's environment variables are loaded or saved to a file. Both the load and dump trigger functions are called after the load or dump of the environment variables, respectively. The preDump trigger is called just before the dump occurs. The dump trigger can be used to update the defValues of forms when a saving of defaults is performed.

functions.name: envRegSetTrigger
functions.description: Registers a set trigger function for a tool. This trigger is called after an environment variable is set. You can set only one trigger for a tool. Subsequent calls to envRegSetTrigger for the same t_tool returns nil, indicating that the trigger was not set.

functions.name: envSetToolCurrValToDefault
functions.description: Sets the current value of all the environment variables to the default values.

functions.name: envSetToolDefaultToCurrVal
functions.description: Sets the default value of all the environment variables to the current value of the variables.

functions.name: envSetVal
functions.syntax: envSetVal( t_tool[.Partition] t_varName s_varType g_newVal )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an environment variable value in the setup database. The tool is faulted in if it is not already faulted in, where faulting in is the process of reading the .cdsenv file and initializing the variables. If a set trigger function is registered for this variable (see the  envRegSetTrigger function), it gets called after the value is set.

functions.name: envSetVarCurrValToDefault
functions.description: Sets the current value of the environment variable you specify to the default value.

functions.name: envSetVarDefaultToCurrVal
functions.description: Sets the default value of the environment variable you specify to the current value of the variable.

functions.name: envStoreEnv
functions.syntax: envStoreEnv( [ ?envFile t_fileName ]  [ ?tool t_tool[.partition] ]  [ ?toolStatus t_toolStatus ] [ ?varStatus s_varStatus ] [ ?fileStatus t_fileStatus ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Stores environment variables associated with tools to a specific file. You can choose to save variables for a specific tool, all loaded tools, or all possible tools. You can also specify whether you want to save all the variables for a tool, the variables that have been modified, or only the variables that have been modified and that are different from the default value.

functions.name: envUnregLoadDumpTrigger
functions.syntax: envUnregLoadDumpTrigger( ?tool t_toolName  ?loadFunc s_loadFunc  ?dumpFunc s_dumpFunc ?preDumpFunc s_preDumpFunc ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deregisters the specified trigger functions for the specified tool. The specified functions are deleted from the corresponding list of the trigger functions for the tool.

functions.name: envUnregSetTrigger
functions.description: Deregisters the specified set trigger function for the specified tool. The specified function is deleted from the list of the set trigger functions for the tool.

functions.name: finishEnterFun
functions.description: Completes an enterfunction if possible.

functions.name: gdmAddSpecToSpecList
functions.description: Adds a gdmSpec object to a gdmSpecList. This function automatically increases the size of the gdmSpecList object to add more gdmSpec objects, if required.

functions.name: gdmCreateSpec
functions.syntax: gdmCreateSpec( t_libName | emptyString | nil t_cellName | emptyString | nil t_viewName | emptyString | nil t_fileName | emptyString | nil t_namespace [ x_gdmOptions ] ) => G_gdmSpecId / nil
functions.description: Creates a gdmSpec object, a user-defined type of SKILL object, according to the options you specify. You must specify at least one of the first four arguments-a library name, cell name, view name, or file name. If you specify a cell name, you must also specify a library name. If you specify a view name, you must also specify a cell name and a library name.

functions.name: gdmCreateSpecFromDDID
functions.description: Creates a gdmSpec, a user-defined type of SKILL object, from a ddId object.

functions.name: gdmCreateSpecList
functions.description: Creates a gdmSpecList object, where you can add gdmSpec objects later with the gdmAddSpecToSpecList function.

functions.name: gdmExecute
functions.description: Executes the command line.

functions.name: gdmInspectSpec
functions.description: Extracts and returns the library name, cell name, view name, and file name from a gdmSpec object, if they exist. The information returned will be in the name space you specify in t_namespace.

functions.name: gdmIsSpecId
functions.description: Checks whether an object is a valid gdmSpec object.

functions.name: gdmNextFromSpecList
functions.description: Takes a gdmSpecList object and returns a gdmSpec object from it. The first time you call this function, it returns the first gdmSpec object in the gdmSpecList. Each successive call gets the next gdmSpec object.

functions.name: gdmObjIsCreated
functions.description: Checks whether a view or file has already been created by another user in the same DM.

functions.name: gdmRemovename
functions.syntax: gdmRemovename( G_gdmSpec [ g_version ] [ g_name ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Requests that GDM removes a name from the specified files.

functions.name: gdmResetSpecList
functions.description: Resets the gdmSpecList so that you can obtain gdmSpec objects from it with successive calls of the gdmNextFromSpecList function.

functions.name: gdmSpecListp
functions.description: Checks whether an object is a gdmSpecList.

functions.name: gdmSpecType
functions.description: Returns the type of a gdmSpec object. A gdmSpec object can be one of the following types: lib, libCell, libCellView, libFile, libCellFile, libCellViewFile, directory, or file.

functions.name: gdmSpecp
functions.description: Checks whether an object is of type gdmSpec, a user-defined type of SKILL object.

functions.name: gdmcancel
functions.syntax: gdmcancel( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Cancels the checked-out status of the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents. Co-managed files in a view are always canceled as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

functions.name: gdmci
functions.syntax: gdmci( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList }  [ g_description ] [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks in the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents. Co-managed files in a view are always checked in as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

functions.name: gdmco
functions.syntax: gdmco( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList }  [ g_version ] [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks out the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents. Co-managed files in a view are always checked out as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

functions.name: gdmdelete
functions.syntax: gdmdelete( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents from the workarea and the default configuration.

functions.name: gdmexport
functions.syntax: gdmexport( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } g_destination [ g_version ] [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Exports the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents from the design management system data repository to the destination you specify.

functions.name: gdmhistory
functions.syntax: gdmhistory( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } x_information ) => g_returnInfo / nil
functions.description: Returns information about the version history of a file.

functions.name: gdmsetdefver
functions.syntax: gdmsetdefver( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } g_version [ g_name ] [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets g_version as the default version of the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents.

functions.name: gdmsetname
functions.syntax: gdmsetname( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } g_name [ g_version ] [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Associates the name you specify with the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents.

functions.name: gdmstatus
functions.syntax: gdmstatus( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } x_information ) => l_fileStatus / nil
functions.description: Returns the design management status of the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents.

functions.name: gdmsubmit
functions.syntax: gdmsubmit( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } [ g_description ] [ g_name ] [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Submits the files G_gdmSpec represents for the release. Co-managed files in a view are always submitted as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

functions.name: gdmupdate
functions.syntax: gdmupdate( { G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } [ g_version ] [ g_name ] [ x_gdmOptions ] [ g_xtra ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Makes files in the workarea available for reading. Co-managed files are updated in the same grouping in which they were checked in; co-managed behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

functions.description: Adds an ellipse to a highlight set.

functions.syntax: geAddHilightPath(  g_hlSetId  l_points  n_width  ) => g_hlObjectId / nil

functions.description: Adds a sliced circle to a highlight set.

functions.syntax: geAddHilightSlicedDonut(  g_hlSetId  l_center  n_radius  f_startAngle f_StopAngle ) => g_hlObjectId / nil
functions.description: Adds a sliced donut to a highlight set.

functions.description: Adds a track pattern to a highlight set.

functions.name: geAddInstProbe
functions.description: Adds an instance probe to a window.

functions.name: geAddNetProbe
functions.description: Adds a net probe to a window.

functions.name: geAddNetProbeFromTo
functions.description: Adds a probe between two points where there is a connection between two different nets, such as nets separated by feedthrough or nets on different hierarchy but physically connected by pins.

functions.name: geAddPathProbe
functions.syntax: geAddPathProbe(  [ w_windowId ]  [ l_lpp ]  [ lt_probeSpec1 ] [ lt_probeSpec2 ]  ) => o_probe
functions.description: Adds a path probe to a window.

functions.name: geAddSelectBox
functions.syntax: geAddSelectBox(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_bBox ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the add mode of area selection. With no arguments given, it prompts you to enter the area to be selected in the current window. Partial selection is performed only when the window environment variable partialSelect is set and the stretch command is active. Partial selection lets you select an edge, vertex, or endpoint of an object to stretch.

functions.name: geAddSelectPoint
functions.syntax: geAddSelectPoint(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_point ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the add mode of point selection.

functions.name: geAddTermProbe
functions.description: Adds a terminal probe to a window.

functions.name: geAdjustPoint
functions.description: Returns the point after applying the adjustment associated to the window ID provided. Adjustment is defined using gravity, the current snap grid, and any snap mode defined in the window interface.

functions.name: geAdvWireSelection
functions.description: Allows the user to select route elements and the adjacent routes. Its behavior is based on the initial state of the selection and the number of consecutive calls to geAdvWireSelection().

functions.name: geAskOverwriteMode
functions.description: Prompts the user to determine whether or not to overwrite the already open cellview.

functions.name: geBackgroundCellView
functions.description: Opens the Background CellView form which is used to superimpose cellviews in the same window.

functions.name: geCellViewToDlist
functions.description: Returns a display list of all the objects in a cellview.

functions.name: geCenter
functions.description: Pans the display so that the edit cellview is centered in the window.

functions.name: geChangeCellView
functions.syntax: geChangeCellView(  [ w_windowId ]  [ t_libName ]  [ t_cellName ]  [ t_viewName ]  [ t_accessMode ]  ) => w_windowId
functions.description: Opens a design in an existing window.

functions.name: geChangeEditMode
functions.syntax: geChangeEditMode(  t_newMode { r | a }  [ w_windowId ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the mode of a design, allowing you to edit or view the design.

functions.name: geChangeHilightPacketName
functions.description: Changes the packet on which the given highlight set is drawn.

functions.name: geClearIgnoreProp
functions.description: Deletes the ignoreCheck property for all objects given in the list. The name of the property is ignoreCheck*, where * is a numerical value.

functions.name: geClearNetNameDisplayFilter
functions.description: If the specified cellview is editable, clears the net name filter setting currently saved for the cellview.

functions.name: geClearProbeNetFilter
functions.description: If the specified cellview is editable, clears the probe net filtering settings currently saved for the cellview.

functions.name: geClosePolygon
functions.syntax: geClosePolygon(  d_cellview  l_points  t_snapMode  ) => l_pointsPolygon / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of points that describe a closed polygon if a polygon could be made from the specified points. Otherwise, returns nil.

functions.name: geCompressPointArray
functions.syntax: geCompressPointArray(  d_cellview  l_points  g_closedList  ) => l_pointList / nil
functions.description: Searches a point list in a cellview for collinear points and deletes the intermediate collinear points.

functions.name: geComputeQueryBbox
functions.description: Takes a point as parameter and returns a corresponding bounding box. The point that is specified is the center of the bounding box. The lower-left and upper-right corners of the bounding box are based on selectionAperture.

functions.name: geCoordp
functions.description: Determines whether the data supplied bycoord is a point coordinate.

functions.name: geCopySelSet
functions.syntax: geCopySelSet(  [ w_windowId ]  [ l_sourcePt ]  [ l_destPt ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Procedural interface to copy the selected set.

functions.description: Creates a highlight set.

functions.description: Creates a box-shaped marker whose size and position are determined by the software.

functions.name: geCreateMarkerByBBox
functions.syntax: geCreateMarkerByBBox(  d_cellview  t_type  t_owner  t_reason  t_displayText  l_bBox  ) => d_shapeId / nil
functions.description: Creates a rectangular marker whose size you define with l_bBox.

functions.description: Creates a polygon-shaped marker.

functions.name: geCrossSection
functions.description: (Layout MXL Only) Invokes the Cross Section command in the specified window. The cross section viewer is displayed and a cutline appears on the canvas. The cross section of the area under the cutline is displayed in the viewer.

functions.name: geCrossSectionAddLayerThickness
functions.description: (Layout MXL Only) Specifies the thickness to be used for displaying the given layers in the cross section viewer. By default, all layers are displayed using the same thickness. This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

functions.name: geCrossSectionAddLayerToSkip
functions.description: (Layout MXL Only) Specifies the layers that should not be displayed in the cross section viewer.  This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

functions.name: geCrossSectionAddLayersToMerge
functions.description: (Layout MXL Only) Specifies the layers that should be displayed on the same line in the cross section viewer.  This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

functions.name: geCrossSectionAddMaterialToSkip
functions.description: (Layout MXL Only) Specifies the material to be skipped. Layers made of the specified material are not displayed in the cross section viewer. This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

functions.name: geCrossSectionClearConfig
functions.description: (Layout MXL Only) Unloads the configuration file from the memory so that it is not used for displaying the cross section of a layout.

functions.name: geCrossSectionLoadConfig
functions.description: (Layout MXL Only) Loads the specified configuration file for displaying the cross section of a layout in the cross section viewer.

functions.name: geCyclePotentialSelectNext
functions.description: Cycles the potential selection to the next object.

functions.name: geCycleSelectNext
functions.description: Cycles to the next object at the current selection point.

functions.name: geDSAFreeze
functions.description: Toggles between the freeze and unfreeze states of the Dynamic Selection Assistant (DSA).

functions.name: geDeleteAllAreaViewLevel
functions.description: Removes all area view levels from a window.

functions.name: geDeleteAllHilightSet
functions.description: Deletes all highlight sets from the specified window.

functions.name: geDeleteAllInstViewLevel
functions.description: Removes all instance-specific view levels from a window.

functions.description: Deletes all markers in d_cellview that have owner l_owner and severity l_severity. If l_owner is specified, l_severity must be specified. All markers in the specified traversal hierarchy are deleted, unless g_traverse argument is specified as nil.

functions.name: geDeleteAllProbe
functions.description: Removes all the probes from a window.

functions.name: geDeleteAllWindowHilightSet
functions.description: Deletes all the window highlight sets registered on the given window.

functions.name: geDeleteAreaViewLevel
functions.description: Removes from a window all area view levels located in l_bBox.

functions.name: geDeleteHilightGroup
functions.description: Deletes the specified highlight group.

functions.name: geDeleteHilightObject
functions.description: Deletes the highlight object from the highlight set.

functions.name: geDeleteHilightSet
functions.description: Deletes a highlight set.

functions.name: geDeleteHilightSetInWindows
functions.description: Deletes the given window highlight set in all windows where it is referenced, or in the given windows specified in the list.

functions.name: geDeleteInstProbe
functions.description: Deletes an instance probe from a window.

functions.name: geDeleteInstViewLevel
functions.description: Removes all instance-specific view levels associated with an instance ID.

functions.name: geDeleteNetProbe
functions.description: Deletes a net probe from a window.

functions.name: geDeletePathProbe
functions.description: Deletes a path probe from a window.

functions.description: Removes a probe from a set of probes in a window.

functions.name: geDeleteStoredSelectionSet
functions.description: Removes the specified stored selection set from the manual store selection set of the given cellview.

functions.name: geDeleteTermProbe
functions.description: Deletes a terminal probe from a window.

functions.name: geDeselectAll
functions.description: Deselects everything in the specified window. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: geDeselectAllFig
functions.description: Deselects all objects in a cellview.   Does not use the selection filter, so all objects are deselected.

functions.name: geDeselectAllObject
functions.description: Deselects everything in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geDeselectArea
functions.description: Calls geSubSelectBox to deselect objects within the specified bounding box in the specified window.

functions.name: geDeselectFig
functions.description: Removes an object from the selected set if the object passes the selection filter.

functions.name: geDeselectFigNoFilter
functions.description: Deselects the specified figure.

functions.name: geDeselectFigPoint
functions.description: Removes vertices from the selected set if they pass the selection filter.

functions.name: geDeselectFigs

functions.name: geDeselectObject
functions.description: Deselects the specified object at the specified hierarchical path, if it passes the selection filter.

functions.name: geDeselectObjectNoFilter

functions.syntax: geDeselectObjectPoint(  d_figId  l_path  l_points  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselect the specified vertices of the specified figure if it passes the selection filter.

functions.name: geDeselectPoint
functions.description: Calls geSubSelectPoint to deselect the figure at the specified point in the specified window. This might deselect just a vertex or edge, or the whole figure, depending on the state of the partialSelect window environment variable. Use the F4 key to toggle this variable. You can see the state of partialSelect in the window banner.

functions.name: geDeselectProtected
functions.description: Deselects all the objects that are marked protected in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geDeselectStoredSelectionSet
functions.description: Removes the elements of the specified selection set from the current selection set of the given cellview.

functions.name: geDisableBackgroundCellView
functions.description: Disables the display of the background cellview for the given window. The current window is used by default.

functions.name: geDiscardEdits
functions.description: Discards all edits made to a design.

functions.name: geDispWinEnvProps
functions.description: Lists all the window environment variables that can be set using the envSetVal function or stored inside the .cdsenv file.

functions.name: geDrawHilightSet
functions.description: Redraws a highlight set from a specified window ID.

functions.description: Edits an instance in place.

functions.name: geEditSelSet
functions.description: Displays and edits the properties of each object in the selected set in a cellview.

functions.name: geEditSingleObject
functions.description: Displays and edits the properties of an object.

functions.name: geEditToWindowPoint

functions.name: geEnableBackgroundCellView

functions.name: geEnterAddNetProbe
functions.syntax: geEnterAddNetProbe(  [ w_windowId ]  [ l_lpp ]  [ lt_probeSpec ]  [ g_repeatCmd ]  ) => o_probe

functions.syntax: geEnterDeleteNetProbe(  [ w_windowId ]  [ lt_probeSpec ]  [ g_repeatCmd ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a net probe from a window.

functions.name: geEnterDeleteTermProbe
functions.description: Deletes a terminal probe from a window.

functions.name: geEquivWindow

functions.description: Reduces the given hierarchical net path to the shortest hierarchical name that is equivalent to this net.

functions.name: geGetAllAreaViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves all area view levels set for a window. The view levels are returned as a list with the start level and stop level for the areas.

functions.name: geGetAllInstViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves the start level and stop level assigned within a window. The start level and stop level are returned as a list of integers. If no start level and stop level are defined, then nil is returned.

functions.name: geGetAllProbe
functions.description: Gets a list of all the probes in a window.

functions.name: geGetAreaViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves an area view level overlapping a bounding box. The view level is returned as a list with the start level and stop level for that area. If more than one area overlaps the given box, the first area found is used.

functions.name: geGetBackgroundCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview used for the background cellview.

functions.name: geGetCellViewWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of a window in which the specified cellview is displayed.

functions.name: geGetCrossProbeValue
functions.description: Queries the view type to see if it is set.

functions.name: geGetCurrentHilightSet
functions.description: Retrieves the current highlight set.

functions.name: geGetCurrentWindowHilightSet
functions.description: Returns the window highlight set which is at the top of the window highlight stack.

functions.name: geGetDisabledMenus
functions.description: Given a windowId, returns all the inactive submenus for all banner menus on that window. If menuList is specified, only the inactive submenus on those banner menus are returned.

functions.name: geGetEditCellView
functions.description: Returns the ID for the cellview being edited.

functions.name: geGetEditCellViewWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the edit cellview.

functions.name: geGetEditRep
functions.description: Returns the ID for the cellview being edited. It is an alias for geGetEditCellView.

functions.name: geGetEnablePredicate
functions.description: Returns the enable predicate of the menu for the application named appName or nil if undefined.

functions.name: geGetFigHilightObjectId
functions.description: Returns the highlight object ID of the object d_figId in the highlight set g_hlSetId.

functions.name: geGetHierMemInst
functions.description: Returns a list describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place to arrive at the cellview in the window.

functions.name: geGetHilightObjectFigId
functions.description: Returns the figure ID of the highlighted object.

functions.name: geGetInstHier
functions.description: Returns a string describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place in the current window to arrive at the cellview in the window.

functions.name: geGetInstHierPath
functions.description: Similar to geGetInstHier but returns additional information for mosaic instances.   This function returns a list of list describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place in the current window to arrive at the cellview in the window. The list contains the following information for each instance:  (dbinst memInst row column)

functions.name: geGetInstTransform
functions.syntax: geGetInstTransform(  d_InstId  )  => list( list( xOffset yOffset ) rotation magnification )
functions.description: Evaluates a path to an instance returned by dbGetTrueOverlaps and concatenates the overall offset, transform, and magnification of the instance placed within the design hierarchy. The value returned by geGetInstTransform is a three member list containing the values of the three variables mentioned above. This transform list can be passed to the functions dbCopyFig or dbMoveFig as their third argument to copy or move the shape to the cellView passed to dbGetTrueOverlaps as its first argument. Cadence recommends you to use the dbGetInstTransform function instead.

functions.name: geGetInstViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves the start level and stop level of an instance. The start level and stop level are returned as a list of integers. If start level and stop level are not defined for the chosen instance, nil is returned.

functions.name: geGetLockInfo
functions.syntax: geGetLockInfo(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t_userHostInfo / no data on lock available
functions.description: Returns the user and host from a .cdslck file.

functions.name: geGetMarkerDisplayText
functions.description: Displays the text associated with a marker.

functions.name: geGetMarkerOwner
functions.description: Displays the owner of a marker.

functions.name: geGetMarkerReason
functions.description: Displays the reason for a marker.

functions.name: geGetMarkerType
functions.description: Displays the type of a marker.

functions.name: geGetNetNameDisplayFilter
functions.description: Returns the net name filtering settings currently in use for the given cellview.

functions.name: geGetObjectSelectedSet
functions.syntax: geGetObjectSelectedSet(  [ d_cellview ]  )  => list( 	list(d_selectedObject 		list( 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				... 		) 	list(d_selectedObject 		list( 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				... 		) 	... ) => l_selectedSet
functions.description: Returns a list of lists describing objects selected in the hierarchy of the given cellview. If the cellview is omitted, the current edit cellview of the current window is used. For each object in the selected set, the path to it consisting of the instance ID, the member instance, the row, and the column is given.

functions.name: geGetPotentialSelection
functions.syntax: geGetPotentialSelection(  [ w_windowId ] [ g_ignoreSelect]  [ l_point] ) => ((d_figId l_path) g_isAllSelected [l_selArray]) / nil
functions.description: Returns the figure ID of the object which can be selected, hierarchical path of the figure, and indicates if the figure is fully or partially selected.

functions.name: geGetProbeNetFilter

functions.name: geGetProbeNetStopLevel
functions.description: Gets the display stop level of net probes.

functions.name: geGetProbeUserLPP
functions.description: Gets the layer-purpose pair to be used by the geAdd*Probe functions if no layer-purpose pair is passed into these functions.

functions.name: geGetScrollPercent
functions.description: Obtains the percentage used by geScroll when shifting the drawing.

functions.name: geGetSelProtectedObjects
functions.description: Returns a list of all the objects that are marked protected in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelSet
functions.description: Returns a list of the currently selected objects in a window or cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelSetCount
functions.description: Counts selected objects in a cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelSetFigPoint
functions.description: Returns a list indicating whether points are selected for an object.

functions.name: geGetSelectedInstancesCount
functions.description: Counts selected instances in a cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelectedSet
functions.description: Returns a list of selected objects in a cellview.

functions.name: geGetSortedSelectByLine
functions.description: Returns the sorted list of the crossed objects by the line.

functions.name: geGetStoredSelectionSets
functions.description: Returns the list of names for the stored selection sets in the given cellview.

functions.name: geGetTopCellViewWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the top cellview.

functions.name: geGetTopLevelCellView
functions.description: Returns the ID of the top-level cellview displayed in a window.

functions.name: geGetWindowBox
functions.description: Returns the lower left and upper right coordinates of the current window display.

functions.name: geGetWindowCellView
functions.description: Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window.

functions.name: geGetWindowRep
functions.description: An alias for geGetWindowCellView. Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window.   This function returns nil if the current window is empty or if no current window is defined. The cellview being displayed in the window can be different from the cellview being edited, as returned by geGetEditCellView, if you are currently editing a cell in place.

functions.name: geGetWindowSelProtectionHighlight
functions.description: Returns whether or not the protected objects in the specified window are highlighted.

functions.name: geGetWindowSelProtectionSelectability
functions.description: Returns whether or not the protected objects in the specified window can be selected.

functions.name: geGetWindowStatus
functions.description: Returns the status for the application named appName on the window windowId.

functions.name: geHasMarker
functions.syntax: geHasMarker(  d_cellview  [ l_owner ]  [ l_type ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Queries whether the cellview contains any markers with owner l_owner and type l_type.

functions.name: geHiCommonFindMarker
functions.description: Opens the Find Marker form and highlights the current marker in the current window.

functions.name: geHiDeleteAllMarker
functions.description: Displays a form that prompts you to select the markers to be deleted from the current cellview.

functions.name: geHiDeleteMarker

functions.name: geHiDisplaySelectionForm

functions.description: Used in conjunction with other SKILL functions to implement the dragging of selected database figures.

functions.description: Explains the current marker in the current cellview.

functions.description: Highlights the current marker in the current window.

functions.name: geInsertHilightObjectsInGroup

functions.name: geInstIdToFileSpec

functions.name: geIsAutoStoreSelectionOn
functions.description: Returns true if the auto store selection set feature is enabled.

functions.name: geIsFigAllSelected
functions.description: Checks whether an object is completely selected.

functions.name: geIsFigPartiallySelected
functions.description: Checks whether an object is partially, but not completely, selected.

functions.name: geIsFigSelected
functions.description: Checks whether an object is at least partially selected.

functions.name: geIsGraphicalWindow
functions.description: Tests if the specified window, or by default the current window, is a graphical window.

functions.description: Checks whether a shape was created as a marker.

functions.name: geIsNetNameDisplayActiveOnWindow
functions.description: Checks whether the Net Name Display functionality is supported for the given window ID.

functions.name: geIsNetNameDisplayEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether the Net Name Display functionality is enabled for the given window ID.

functions.name: geIsObjectAllSelected
functions.description: Tests if the specified figure is fully selected.

functions.name: geIsObjectPartiallySelected
functions.description: Tests if the specified figure is partially selected.

functions.description: This function determines whether a highlight ID is valid.

functions.name: geIsValidHilightObject
functions.description: Determines whether the highlighted object is valid.

functions.name: geIsValidHilightSet
functions.description: Determines whether a highlight set is valid.

functions.description: Creates an icon from a SKILL file.

functions.description: Loads probes into a window.

functions.name: geMenuForObjectsUnderPoint

functions.name: geNetNameDisplayOptionForm
functions.description: Opens the Net Name Display Options form. This SKILL function is supported only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.description: Makes a copy of a window.

functions.name: gePointQuery
functions.syntax: gePointQuery(  w_windowId  l_point  t_filterProc  ) => d_figId / nil
functions.description: Returns the ID of the object found at the point l_point.

functions.name: gePointToFig
functions.syntax: gePointToFig(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_ignoreSelect ]  [ l_list ]  ) => d_figure / nil
functions.description: Returns the ID of the object located at the coordinates given in l_list.

functions.name: gePopHilightStack

functions.name: gePopWindowHilightStack
functions.description: Pops the current window highlight set out of the window highlight stack.

functions.description: Prints a list of the probes in a window.

functions.description: Checks if the value passed in is a probe.

functions.description: Redraws all areas of all windows that have not been updated since the last redraw and need redrawing.

functions.description: Redraws a cellview when necessary. If a bounding box is specified, only the specified area is redrawn.

functions.description: Displays a form that shows all cellviews from the specified cellview that have been modified by another process but not reread from disk. You can then select which ones should be refreshed. The top-level cellview is also checked for modification.

functions.name: geRefreshWindow
functions.description: Refreshes a window. If a bounding box is specified, only that area is refreshed.

functions.name: geRefreshWorldView
functions.description: Refreshes the worldView window.

functions.name: geRegCrossProbeTrigger
functions.syntax: geRegCrossProbeTrigger( g_ilFunc x_priority t_name ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a trigger function for cross probing.

functions.name: geRegSaveAllTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger name for the Save All form.

functions.name: geResetBackgroundCellView
functions.description: Resets the background cellview on the given window.

functions.name: geResetCellView
functions.description: Re-displays the last saved version of a cellview.

functions.name: geResetHilightSetAlphaBlendingParameters
functions.description: Resets the alpha blending values to maximum values (1000) for the given highlight set.

functions.name: geResetHilightSetHaloParameters
functions.description: Resets the halo parameters set on a highlight set.

functions.name: geRestoreWinView
functions.description: Restores the view saved with geSaveWinView.

functions.description: Returns to the previous (parent) level displayed in a window before a descend, edit in place, or switch was done. This function does not support figGroups.

functions.name: geReturnToLevel
functions.description: Displays a list box containing the levels to which you can return.

functions.name: geSaveIcon
functions.syntax: geSaveIcon(  [ w_windowId ]  [ t_iconName ]  [ t_fileName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a cellview as a SKILL icon file.

functions.description: Saves the net name filtering settings that are currently applied on the given cellview after the geSetNetNameDisplayFilter function is called. After you call geSaveNetNameDisplayFilter, the settings will be reloaded automatically when you open the cellview in a new Virtuoso session.

functions.name: geSaveProbe
functions.description: Saves probes to a port.

functions.description: Saves the probe net filtering settings that are currently applied on the given cellview after the geSetProbeNetFilter function is called. After you call the geSaveProbeNetFilter, the settings are reloaded automatically when you open the cellview in a new Virtuoso session.

functions.name: geSaveWinView

functions.name: geScroll

functions.description: Scrolls a view.

functions.description: Adds the objects within the area defined by t_areaShapeType to the selection.

functions.description: Enables you to select objects by drawing a line. Press Shift and draw a line to overlap the additional objects to be selected. Press Ctrl and draw a line to overlap the objects to be removed from the selected set. Double-click to end the line.

functions.name: geSelectFig

functions.name: geSelectFigNoFilter

functions.name: geSelectNextInSelSet
functions.description: Selects an object from the selected set of objects in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geSelectObject
functions.description: Selects the specified figure at the specified hierarchical path, if it passes the selection criteria.

functions.name: geSelectObjectNoFilter
functions.description: Selects the specified figure at the specified hierarchical path.

functions.name: geSetProbeDirection
functions.description: Sets the specified probe as a directed probe.

functions.name: geSetProbeNetFilter
functions.syntax: geSetProbeNetFilter(  d_cellview  t_mode l_netNames ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a net filtering for probe on the given cellview.

functions.name: geSetProbeNetStopLevel
functions.description: Sets the display stop level of net probes.

functions.name: geSetProbeUserLPP
functions.description: Sets the layer-purpose pair to be used by the geAdd*Probe functions if no layer-purpose pair is passed in to these functions.

functions.name: geSetScrollPercent
functions.description: Controls the percentage of the drawing currently visible that is shifted when geScroll is activated.

functions.name: geSetSelProtection
functions.syntax: geSetSelProtection(  [ d_cellview ] | [ d_figId ] | [ l_figId ] ) => l_results / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified object as protected, which prevents it from being selected. If no figId is specified, the selected objects in the specified or in the current cellview are set as protected.

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionAllObjects
functions.description: Sets all the objects in the specified cellview as protected, which prevents them from being selected.

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptionForm
functions.description: Opens the Selection Protection Highlight Options form where you can configure the settings for highlighting protected objects.

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptions
functions.syntax: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptions(  w_window d_cellview [ l_options ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the highlight options for objects that are marked protected.

functions.name: geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle
functions.syntax: geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle(  d_probeId g_trueColorProbeVal g_probeHighlightVal )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the trueColorProbeVal and probeHighlightVal options of the specified probeId.

functions.name: geSetWindowStatus
functions.description: Sets the status for w_windowId and t_appName to n_status.

functions.name: geShareWindowHilightSet
functions.description: Shares the given window highlight set with other windows.

functions.name: geShift
functions.description: Shifts w_windowId in the direction t_dir.

functions.name: geSingleSelectBox
functions.syntax: geSingleSelectBox(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_point ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the single mode of area selection.

functions.name: geSingleSelectPoint
functions.syntax: geSingleSelectPoint(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_point ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the single mode of point selection.

functions.name: geStoreSelectionSet
functions.description: Records the current selection set into the cellview manual store selection set list.

functions.name: geSubSelectBox
functions.syntax: geSubSelectBox(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_bBox ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the sub mode of area selection.

functions.name: geSubSelectPoint
functions.syntax: geSubSelectPoint(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_point ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the sub mode of point selection.

functions.name: geSwitch
functions.syntax: geSwitch(  w_windowId  t_accessMode  d_instId  x_iteration  x_row  x_col  ) => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Switches into an instance.

functions.name: geSwitchInContext
functions.syntax: geSwitchInContext(  w_windowId  t_accessMode  d_instId  x_iteration  x_row  x_col  [ verbose ] ) => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Switches into an instance by using the view name specified in the hierarchy manager configuration context. If the correct configuration context is not found, this function uses the geSwitch command to perform the switch.

functions.name: geToggleAreaSelectOption
functions.description: Toggles area selection mode.

functions.name: geToggleDisplayResolution
functions.description: Rotates the value of the graphic environment variable displayResolution between the values Very High, High, Medium, and Low. This function is bound to the F9 bindkey in the default layout editor bindkeys.

functions.name: geTogglePartialSelect
functions.description: Toggles partial selection off and on.

functions.name: geToggleWindowSelProtectionHighlight
functions.description: Toggles the highlight state of protected objects in the specified window.

functions.name: geToggleWindowSelProtectionSelectability
functions.description: Toggles the selectability state of protected objects in the specified window.

functions.name: geTransformUserBBox
functions.description: Transforms the specified bounding box by a list describing the offset, orientation, and magnification.

functions.name: geTransformUserPoint
functions.description: Transforms a coordinate pair by the displacement and rotation passed in.

functions.name: geTransparencyOptions
functions.description: Opens the Transparency Options form.

functions.name: geUnRegCrossProbeTrigger
functions.description: Removes the cross probe trigger, if one is registered.

functions.name: geUnhighlightProtected
functions.description: Removes the halo from the objects marked as protected in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geUnsetAllSelProtection
functions.description: Removes the selection protection from all the protected objects in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geUnsetSelProtection
functions.syntax: geUnsetSelProtection(  [ d_cellview ] | [ d_figId ] | [ l_figId ] ) => l_results / nil
functions.description: Removes the selection protection from the specified protected objects. If no figId is specified, protection of the selected objects in the specified or in the current cellview is removed.

functions.name: geUpdateWindowMenus
functions.description: Updates the enabled status of all the menu items in the window's banner menu hierarchy and all of the window's fixed menu items.

functions.name: geValidateWindow
functions.description: Verifies the database ID of a window.

functions.name: geWindowToEditPoint
functions.description: Translates coordinate values when you are using edit in place. geWindowToEditPoint applies the top-level cellview's coordinates to the cellview being edited; geEditToWindowPoint does the reverse.

functions.name: geWriteCellView
functions.syntax: geWriteCellView(  d_cellview  t_libName  t_cellName t_viewName  [ t_version ]  [ d_contextId ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a copy of a cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToBackgroundAndEditCV
functions.description: When a background cellview is set on the window, zooms to fit the background cellview and the current edit cellview. If a background cellview is not set on the window, zooms to fit the current edit cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToBackgroundCV
functions.description: When a background cellview is set on the window, zooms to fit the background cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToGrid
functions.description: Zooms in on a subject up to the last point at which the major grid is still visible.

functions.name: gec
functions.description: Returns the ID for the cellview being edited. This function is a shortcut for the function, geGetEditCellView.

functions.name: geiLoadProbe
functions.description: Displays the Load Probes form.

functions.name: geiSaveProbe
functions.description: Displays the Save Probes form.

functions.name: getCurrentWindow
functions.description: The getCurrentWindow function is an alias for the hiGetCurrentWindow function.

functions.name: getMaxScreenCoords
functions.description: The getMaxScreenCoords function is an alias for the hiGetMaxScreenCoords function.

functions.name: gtc
functions.description: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the top cellview. This function is a shortcut for the function geGetTopCellViewWindow.

functions.name: gwc
functions.description: Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window. This function is a shortcut of the function geGetWindowCellView.

functions.name: hdbAddConfigToBag
functions.description: Adds a configuration handle to a configuration bag.

functions.name: hdbBind
functions.syntax: hdbBind( h_pathVector t_masterLibName t_masterCellName t_masterViewName t_instName g_fixedLib g_fixedCell g_fixedView [ g_wantSignature ] [ g_wantWhy ] )  => ( t_boundLibId t_boundCellId t_boundView h_bindSignature h_bindWhy )
functions.description: Binds an instance to a master.

functions.name: hdbBindBit
functions.syntax: hdbBindBit( h_pathVector t_masterLibName t_masterCellName t_masterViewName t_baseInstName x_bit x_leftRangeIndex x_rightRangeIndex g_fixedLib g_fixedCell g_fixedView [ g_wantSignature ] [ g_wantWhy ] ) => ( t_boundLib t_boundCell t_boundView h_bindSignatureId h_bindWhyId )
functions.description: Binds a single bit of an iterated instance.

functions.name: hdbBitHasRules
functions.syntax: hdbBitHasRules( h_hdbPathVector t_baseInstName x_bit ) => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether a bit-specific configuration rule applies to the specified iterated instance bit.

functions.name: hdbClose
functions.description: Closes a configuration. In all cases where you are using the hdb interface to traverse (bind, elaborate) a design use hdbCloseConfigsInBag to close open configurations instead of this function.

functions.name: hdbCloseConfigsInBag
functions.description: Closes all of the configurations held in a configuration bag.

functions.name: hdbConfigHasOccRules
functions.description: Checks whether a configuration contains any occurrence rules.

functions.name: hdbCreateConfigBag
functions.description: Creates a configuration bag to hold configurations.

functions.name: hdbCreatePathVector
functions.description: Creates a path vector to use while traversing (elaborating) a design hierarchy.

functions.name: hdbCreatePathVectorStack
functions.description: Creates a stack to hold path vectors when traversing into sub-configurations.

functions.name: hdbDestroyPathVector
functions.description: Destroys a path vector.

functions.name: hdbExplainBinding
functions.syntax: hdbExplainBinding( t_indentation t_masterLibName t_masterCellName t_masterViewName t_instName g_fixedLib g_fixedCell g_fixedView t_boundLib t_boundCell t_boundView h_bindSignatureId h_bindWhyId )  => t_string
functions.description: Explains why a hdbBind binding was made the way it was.

functions.name: hdbExplainSignature
functions.description: Explains the contents of a binding signature.

functions.name: hdbExplainStop
functions.description: Explains why a stop was declared.

functions.name: hdbGetCellName
functions.description: Gets the cell name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetLibName
functions.description: Gets the library name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetPathStackStr
functions.description: Creates a string listing all the path vectors. Creates something similar to a fully rooted path for a design binding that contains sub-configurations.

functions.name: hdbGetPathStr
functions.description: Creates a string representation of a path vector.

functions.name: hdbGetPathVectorStackTop
functions.description: Gets the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbGetTopCellName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top cell of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetTopLibName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top library of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetTopViewName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top view pointed to by h_hdbConfig.

functions.name: hdbGetViewName
functions.description: Gets the view name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbHasIterInstBitRules
functions.description: Determines whether a configuration contains rules that apply to iterated instance bits.

functions.name: hdbIsAtStopPoint
functions.description: Checks if the point just pushed into with hdbPushCell is a stop point.

functions.name: hdbIsConfig
functions.syntax: hdbIsConfig( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks if a given library/cell/view is a configuration.

functions.name: hdbIsIterInst
functions.syntax: hdbIsIterInst( t_instName  [ t_nameSpace ] ) => (t_baseInstName t_leftIndex t_rightIndex) / nil
functions.description: Determines whether an instance name is of an iterated instance. If it is of an iterated instance, the base instance name and range indexes are returned.

functions.name: hdbIsOpenConfig
functions.description: Checks if the configuration ID you specify is valid. The configuration ID is valid if the configuration is still open.

functions.name: hdbIterInstHasBitRules
functions.syntax: hdbIterInstHasBitRules( h_pathVectorId t_baseInstName x_leftRangeIndex x_rightRangeIndex ) => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether an iterated instance has bit-specific configuration rules. If it does, you might want to check whether the binding for individual bits of the iterated instance are different from the iterated instance binding.

functions.name: hdbOpen
functions.syntax: hdbOpen( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_mode  [ t_nameSpace ] )  => h_configId / nil
functions.description: Opens a configuration for read or edit.

functions.name: hdbPopCell
functions.description: Pops an entry off a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPopPathVect
functions.description: Pops a path vector off the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbPushBitCell
functions.syntax: hdbPushBitCell( h_pathVectorId t_baseInstName x_bit  x_leftRangeIndex x_rightRangeIndex t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ h_bindWhy ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Pushes the cell of an iterated instance bit on to a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPushCell
functions.syntax: hdbPushCell( h_pathVectorId  t_instanceName  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Push a cell onto a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPushPathVect
functions.description: Adds a path vector on to the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbReOpenNewConfig
functions.description: Increments the reference count of an in-memory only configuration (that is, a new configuration that has not yet been written to disk) and returns t. If the configuration does not exist in memory or if it already exists on disk, this function returns nil and the reference count is not incremented.

functions.name: hdbSave
functions.description: Saves a configuration opened with hdbOpen.

functions.name: hdbSaveACopy
functions.syntax: hdbSaveACopy( h_configId  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Makes a copy of a configuration and saves it to a library/cell/view. Unlike hdbSaveAs, this function does not modify the location of the configuration associated with the specified configId.

functions.name: hdbSaveAs
functions.syntax: hdbSaveAs( h_configId  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a configuration to a library/cell/view.

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultLibListString
functions.description: Sets the global library list in the configuration specified by the h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultStopListString
functions.description: Sets the global stop view list in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultViewListString
functions.description: Sets the global view list in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetObjBindRule
functions.syntax: hdbSetObjBindRule( h_configId g_specifier g_rule ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets or deletes a binding rule on a cell, instance, or occurrence (path). You can set the following binding rules: library list, view list, binding, or stop point.

functions.name: hdbSetTopCellViewName
functions.syntax: hdbSetTopCellViewName( h_configID t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the top of the design hierarchy to library.cell:view in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hiAbout
functions.description: Displays an application's product information window, which includes the release version and copyright information. If w_windowId is a session window, the product information is about the window that is displayed in the top tab.

functions.name: hiAbsolutePan
functions.syntax: hiAbsolutePan( [ w_window ]  [ n_%x ]  [ n_%y ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Scrolls a window in any direction by specifying the amount to pan as a percentage of the window size.

functions.name: hiAddCyclicChoice
functions.syntax: hiAddCyclicChoice(  r_form  s_cyclicField  g_newChoice  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the new entry to the end of the list of choices in the cyclic field in the form.

functions.name: hiAddExtraRepeatCommand
functions.description: Adds the specified SKILL command to the extra repeat command list so that the command becomes repeatable next time the hiRepeat function is called. Additionally, you can add the specified commands to the extra repeat command list that are not repeated automatically after there first run.

functions.name: hiAddField
functions.syntax: hiAddField(  g_formRegionOrLayout g_field  [ x_attachment | s_layout [ l_field_controls ] ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a field to a form. The form must already exist, and the field must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

functions.name: hiAddFields
functions.syntax: hiAddFields(  g_formRegionOrLayout l_items [ g_attachmentsOrLayout ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds fields to a form. The form must already exist, and the fields must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

functions.name: hiAddFixedMenu
functions.syntax: hiAddFixedMenu(  [ ?window w_window ]  ?fixedMenu g_fixedMenu  [ ?menuSide s_menuSide ]  [ ?append g_append ] [ ?newLine g_newLine ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Fixed menus are no longer supported in windows. Use the new toolbar functions to create toolbars instead for windows. Existing fixed menus that have been added to windows are no longer displayed, although no warnings are being generated. Replace these menus with toolbars.

functions.name: hiAddIconOverrides
functions.description: Adds names to the list of icons that are loaded using CSF search results directly, bypassing the hierarchy files. If the CSF search fails, the files in the hierarchy are loaded.

functions.name: hiAddItemToLayout
functions.syntax: hiAddItemToLayout(  g_formRegionOrLayout  g_item  [ ?layoutControls l_layoutControls ]  [ ?toLayout s_layoutName ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the required controls to the layout.

functions.name: hiAddMenuItem
functions.description: Adds the menu item or action to the end of all instances of the specified hiMenu.

functions.name: hiAddNonRepeatPrefix
functions.description: Adds a string to the list of repeat filter strings. All strings is compared on every command run.

functions.name: hiAddTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Adds characters to the word delimiter list for the window.

functions.name: hiAddToolbarItem
functions.description: Adds one toolbar item to a toolbar. The item is added to the end of the toolbar.

functions.name: hiAddToolbarItems
functions.description: Adds a list of toolbar items to a toolbar. The items are added at the end of the toolbar.

functions.name: hiAdvanceProgressBarOneStep
functions.description: Increments the  progress bar by one step for the specified window.

functions.name: hiAppendInputCmd
