functions.name: hiGetWindowFixedMenu
functions.description: Identifies the fixed menu on a window.

functions.name: hiGetWindowIconifyState
functions.description: Returns the icon position of an iconified window. If the window is contained in a session window, this function returns the icon position of the session window.

functions.name: hiGetWindowList
functions.description: Returns a list of window IDs of all windows that have been created but not closed, including those that are not currently displayed. You can specify the type of window with the s_windowType argument. By default, all windows except session windows and dock windows are returned.

functions.name: hiGetWindowMenu
functions.description: Returns the symbol of the menu associated with the specified window. This menu was associated with a window by using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiGetWindowName
functions.description: Returns the window name, which is displayed in the window manager frame of a window. This name is set with the hiSetWindowName function.

functions.name: hiGetWindowState
functions.description: Returns the display state of a window: mapped, unmapped, or iconified.

functions.name: hiGetWindowToolbars
functions.description: Gets the list of toolbars that a window contains. The toolbars are listed in the order in which they were placed in the window with hiPlaceToolbar.

functions.name: hiGetXFontName
functions.description: Returns the default font name for the specified font type that was used prior to TrueType fonts.

functions.name: hiGoToIndex
functions.syntax: hiGoToIndex( w_windowId x_indexNo ?highlight g_highlight ?align g_align ?forceAlign g_forceAlign ) => t / nil
functions.description: Positions the specified character index within the viewport for a given text window

functions.name: hiGoToLine
functions.syntax: hiGoToLine( w_windowId x_lineNo ?highlight g_highlight ?align g_align ?forceAlign g_forceAlign ) => t / nil
functions.description: Positions the specified line number onscreen for a given text window

functions.name: hiGraphicMode
functions.description: Checks if the Virtuoso environment is currently running in graphical mode. Returns nil if it is running in -nograph mode.

functions.name: hiHasToolbarBreak
functions.description: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether there was a toolbar break before the specified toolbar.

functions.name: hiHelp
functions.syntax: hiHelp(  s_objType S_objName  [ g_objDetail ] [ g_moreDetail ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Constructs a help symbol from its arguments and invokes the Doc Assistant API to display the help document associated with the help symbol. If the hiHelpAction property is set, hiHelp executes the callback associated with the property, instead of calling the Doc Assistant API. hiHelp is the main service routine for the online help system.

functions.name: hiHideProgressBar
functions.description: Removes the progress bar (and its label) from the window you specify.

functions.name: hiHideToolbar
functions.description: Hides a toolbar. If g_detach is set to t, this function removes the toolbar from the window.

functions.name: hiHighlightField
functions.syntax: hiHighlightField(  g_form  s_field  g_highlightType  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Highlights a type-in field depending on the value of g_highlightType.

functions.name: hiHypertextReadin
functions.description: Reads in a text file, which can include hyperlinks, into a hypertext field. This function resets the value of the hypertext field.

functions.name: hiHypertextReplace
functions.description: Replaces the text in a hypertext field with the new text that you provide. The text can contain hyperlinks. This function replaces the value of the hypertext field with the new text.

functions.name: hiHypertextScroll
functions.description: Scrolls a hypertext field to display the text containing the link you specify. This function updates the ?pos argument of hiCreateHypertextField().

functions.name: hiIconifyWindow
functions.description: Converts a window to its icon. If the window is contained in a session window, the session window is iconified.

functions.name: hiIgnoreProp
functions.description: Does not display the specified property of a given object type in the Property List Editor form.

functions.name: hiInEnterFun
functions.description: Returns the symbol of the enterfunction pending in the window.

functions.name: hiInFormApply
functions.description: Checks whether the Apply button on a mapped form is selected.

functions.name: hiInheritBindKey
functions.description: Causes a registered application to inherit bindkeys from another application.

functions.name: hiInsertBannerMenu
functions.syntax: hiInsertBannerMenu( w_windowId  g_menu  x_menuPosition  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a menu into the menu bar of a window. If the menu symbol that you specify already exists on the window, a warning message is issued and the menu is not placed on the window.

functions.name: hiInsertBlankCIWOutputPage
functions.description: Inserts a blank page in the CIW output area.

functions.name: hiInsertItemToLayout
functions.syntax: hiInsertItemToLayout(  g_formRegionOrLayout  g_item  [ ?layoutControls l_layoutControls ]  [ ?index x_index ]  [ ?toLayout s_layoutName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts the required controls to the layout.

functions.name: hiInsertMenuItem
functions.syntax: hiInsertMenuItem( r_hiMenu  r_menuItem g_position  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a menu item or action into a specified position of all instances of r_hiMenu.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbar
functions.syntax: hiInsertToolbar( w_windowID o_hiToolbar s_toolbar ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a toolbar into the toolbar area of a window before s_toolbar.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbarBreak
functions.description: Inserts a toolbar break into the toolbar area of a window before the specified toolbar.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbarItem
functions.syntax: hiInsertToolbarItem( o_hiToolbar o_hiToolbarItem s_toolbarItemBefore ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a toolbar item before a specific item in a toolbar.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbarItems
functions.syntax: hiInsertToolbarItems( o_hiToolbar l_hiToolbarItems s_toolbarItemBefore ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts toolbar items before the specified item in a toolbar.

functions.name: hiInstantiateForm
functions.description: Instantiates the C structure of a form from SKILL.

functions.name: hiIs2DMenu
functions.description: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid 2D menu.

functions.name: hiIsBlinkEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether blinking is enabled or not. You can use hiEnableBlink to enable or disable blinking in your current session.

functions.name: hiIsExtraRepeatCommand
functions.description: Checks whether the specified SKILL command is in the extra repeat command list.

functions.name: hiIsForm
functions.description: Checks whether a form or menu is a valid one.

functions.name: hiIsFormDisplayed
functions.description: Checks whether a form is displayed.

functions.name: hiIsIcon
functions.description: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid icon.

functions.name: hiIsInFieldCancel
functions.description: Query this function during a field callback to determine if the form is currently being canceled, the callback may be initiated by the cancel operation. If the form is being canceled, the form handle is returned; otherwise nil is returned.

functions.name: hiIsInReplay
functions.description: Indicates whether your Virtuoso session is in replay mode, that is, if commands are being executed from a replay file, which is typically a log file. Your session is in replay mode if you are running a Virtuoso workbench with the -replay logfile or -test option or if you are replaying a file with the hiReplayFile SKILL function.

functions.name: hiIsInstantiated
functions.description: Displays a form at least once or a menu has been placed in a window. Returns nil if the form has been deleted or if g_formRegionOrMenu is not valid.

functions.name: hiIsMagnifierAnchored
functions.description: Checks if the magnifier has been anchored inside the specified graphics window. If the magnifier has been anchored it and does not move with the mouse cursor.

functions.name: hiIsMagnifierOpened
functions.description: Indicates whether a magnifier is currently opened in the specified window.

functions.name: hiIsMenu
functions.description: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid menu.

functions.name: hiIsMenuItemEnabled
functions.syntax: hiIsMenuItemEnabled( r_hiMenu s_itemHandle [ w_windowId ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether a menu item is enabled.

functions.name: hiIsMenuSlotFilled
functions.description: Checks whether a menu already exists in the specified position in the menu bar of a window.

functions.name: hiIsProgressBoxCancelled
functions.description: Checks whether a progress box is canceled. A progress box is considered canceled if it is canceled with the Cancel button, canceled with the hiCancelProgressBox function, closed from the window manager, or automatically closed when the progress bar reaches 100% (if it was created with the ?autoClose argument set to t).

functions.name: hiIsScrollRegion
functions.description: Determines if the item is a scroll region field.

functions.name: hiIsWidgetType
functions.description: Determines if a widget type is valid or not.

functions.name: hiIsWindowSpecifier
functions.description: Validates a window specifier, which is passed as the boxSpec argument to the hiCreateWindow and hiOpenWindow functions.

functions.name: hiItemInsertTree
functions.description: Creates a sub-tree under an item. You need to specify the item and the sub-tree as the arguments for this function.

functions.name: hiItemRemoveTree
functions.description: Removes the sub-tree from an item in the tree. The item remains in the tree as a leaf; only the sub-tree under it is removed. The expansion icon next to the item is removed.

functions.name: hiLaunchBrowser
functions.description: Starts a Web browser, if needed, and opens the URL you specify.

functions.name: hiLayerMatchCyclicStr
functions.description: Returns the layer cyclic value associated with the specified t_layer.

functions.name: hiLayerStringToLPP
functions.description: Returns the layer object in the specified d_techFileID associated with the specified t_layer.

functions.name: hiLayoutUTp
functions.description: Verifies that an argument is an instantiated hiLayout object.

functions.name: hiListBoxCancel
functions.description: Performs the same action as the Cancel button on the listbox.

functions.name: hiListBoxDone
functions.description: Performs the same action as the OK button on the listbox.

functions.name: hiListFocusableToolbarItems
functions.description: Lists all type-in and combo toolbar items that are currently defined in the specified window and can be used as arguments for the function hiFocusToToolbarItem.

functions.name: hiListView
functions.description: Lists the saved viewing parameters for a given view, or for all views if viewName is not specified. This function applies to graphics windows only

functions.name: hiLoadIconData
functions.description: Loads a pixmap and returns it in a format that can be used with any hi function that accepts icons, such as hiCreateMenuItem or hiCreateButton. This function can load files that are in any of the image formats supported by Qt; currently these are:  BMP, JPG, PNG, PPM, XBM, and XPM. PNG is the recommended format.

functions.name: hiLoadIconFile
functions.syntax: hiLoadIconFile( t_fileName x_width x_height ) => l_hiIcon / nil
functions.description: Loads an icon file of any format, such as PNG, and returns the icon in a format that can be used with hi functions that accept icons. If t_fileName is a relative path, the Cadence Search File mechanism (CSF) is used to search for the file.

functions.name: hiLoadImageFile
functions.syntax: hiLoadImageFile( t_fileName x_width x_height ) => l_hiImage / nil
functions.description: Loads an image file of any format, such as PNG, and returns the image in a format that can be used with hi functions that accept icons. If t_fileName is a relative path, the Cadence Search File mechanism (CSF) is used to search for the file.

functions.name: hiLogDragEvents
functions.description: Starts logging drag events (mouse movements in a graphics window while an enter function is active) in the log file so that they can be replayed later.

functions.name: hiLookupHRFtag
functions.description: Returns the command that has been defined as the help response for a help tag in a .HRF file. You can get more information about the usage of this function from the your_install_dir/tools/dfII/samples/local/hrfHelp.il file.

functions.name: hiLowerTab
functions.description: Lowers a tabbed window contained in a session window to the bottom of the list of tabbed windows.

functions.name: hiLowerWindow
functions.description: Lowers a window to the bottom of the list of visible windows.

functions.name: hiMapWindow
functions.description: Displays a window, dockable window, or session window on screen.

functions.name: hiMarkNestable
functions.description: Makes enterfunctions nestable. When an enterfunction is running and a new one is called, the new enterfunction replaces the old enterfunction in the stack. When the new enterfunction is finished or canceled, the old enterfunction is resumed. This function reverses the effect of hiMarkNonNestable.

functions.name: hiMarkNonNestable
functions.description: Makes enterfunctions non-nestable. When an enterfunction is running and a new one is called, the new enterfunction replaces it in the stack. When the new enterfunction is finished or canceled, the enterfunction it replaced will not be returned to, but will have been canceled by the new enterfunction.

functions.name: hiMatchColor
functions.description: Returns a layer color index corresponding to the specified RGB color. It creates a new color index if the color specified does not have any corresponding index.

functions.name: hiMatchColorByName
functions.description: Returns a layer color index corresponding to the specified color name.

functions.name: hiModalDBoxHelp
functions.description: Displays a message in a modal dialog box. A modal dialog box is a blocking dialog box-it waits for an acknowledgement before allowing the application to continue.

functions.name: hiModelessDBoxHelp
functions.description: Displays a message in a modeless dialog box. A modeless dialog box is a non-blocking dialog box-it does not wait for an acknowledgement before allowing the application to continue.

functions.name: hiMoveField
functions.syntax: hiMoveField(  r_2DFormOr2DMenu  s_field  l_location  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Moves the specified field to a new location. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiMoveFixedMenu
functions.syntax: hiMoveFixedMenu(  [ ?window w_window ]  [ ?menuSide s_menuSide ]  [ ?fixedMenu g_fixedMenu ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Moves the fixed menu to the opposite side of the window.

functions.name: hiMoveInsBarToEnd
functions.description: Places the cursor (insertion point) at the end of a text field, scrolling the field so the cursor is visible.

functions.name: hiMoveToFormField
functions.syntax: hiMoveToFormField(  g_formOrRegion s_field )  => moved / focused / nil
functions.description: If the specified field is a text field and can accept input focus, it is set as the current field and the input focus is set to it.

functions.name: hiMoveWindow
functions.description: Moves the lower left corner of a window to a new screen location. If w_windowId is a window contained in a session window, the session window is moved.

functions.name: hiNextWinView
functions.description: Undoes hiPrevWinView on a graphics window.

functions.name: hiObShowTag
functions.syntax: hiObShowTag( t_tool t_tag t_version ) => t / nil
functions.description: Opens Doc Assistant to display the help document related to the specified tool and tag.

functions.name: hiOffsetField
functions.syntax: hiOffsetField(  r_2DFormOr2DMenu  s_field  l_offsets  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Offsets one field from its current position. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiOffsetFields
functions.syntax: hiOffsetFields(  r_2DFormOr2DMenu  l_fields l_offsets  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Offsets several fields from their current positions. All fields are offset by the same distance, they move as a block. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiOpenWindow
functions.syntax: hiOpenWindow( [ ?bBox l_boxSpec ]  [ ?type t_widgetType ]  [ ?appType t_applicationType ]  [ ?menus l_menus ]  [ ?labels l_labels ]  [ ?help t_helpString ]  [ ?scroll g_scrollbars ] [ ?form g_form ] [ ?closeProc s_closeProc ] [ ?iconPosition l_iconPosition ] [ ?session g_sessionWindow ] [ ?tabTitle g_tabTitle ] [ ?tabIcon g_tabIcon ] [ ?tabTip g_tabTip ] )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a window. This function displays the new window in a session window if the session window argument is specified or if the new window is a graphics window.

functions.name: hiPan
functions.description: Scrolls a window so that the display is centered on a point.

functions.name: hiPickWindow
functions.description: Lets you select a window without changing the current window. When this function is called, the pointer is grabbed and not released until either the mouse button or the Escape key is pressed. Any other keyboard event is ignored and the mouse click is not passed on to anything else.

functions.name: hiPlaceToolbar
functions.syntax: hiPlaceToolbar( w_windowID o_hiToolbar [ s_toolbarArea ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a toolbar to the specified toolbar area of a window. If the toolbar already exists on the window, this function moves it to the specified area. The toolbar is placed at the end of the current toolbars in that area.

functions.name: hiPlaceToolbarBreak
functions.description: Adds a toolbar break to the specified toolbar area of a window.

functions.name: hiPrevWinView
functions.description: Restores a graphics window to the view displayed before the last zoom or pan command.

functions.name: hiPrintBindKeyUsage
functions.description: Returns bindkey usage data for the specified applications.

functions.name: hiPrintToLogFile
functions.description: Prints the specified string to the CDS.log file and to any secondary log files that might have been opened with hiStartLog, without displaying it in the CIW output area.

functions.name: hiQueryFont
functions.description: Returns the values of the attributes of S_fontType.

functions.name: hiQuit
functions.description: Quits the Virtuoso session. It displays a dialog box to confirm if you wish to quit and then calls exit if you click Yes.

functions.name: hiRaiseTab
functions.description: Raises a tab contained in a multi-tabbed session window to the top of the list and makes it the active tab. If there is only a single tab, the function does nothing.

functions.name: hiRaiseWindow
functions.description: Raises a window to the top of the list of visible windows.

functions.name: hiReadWinConfig
functions.description: Reads a workspace file previously saved by hiSaveWinConfig and returns the workspace ID.

functions.name: hiReattachField
functions.description: Reattaches a field in a two-dimensional form or scroll region that has field attachments. This function places the field according to the new position and attachment information. This function can be used only with forms or scroll regions that already have field attachments. For forms or scroll regions that do not have field attachments, use the hiMoveField, hiResizeField, hiOffsetField, and hiOffsetFields functions.

functions.name: hiReattachToolbar
functions.description: Reattaches a given toolbar to its parent main window without showing it.

functions.name: hiRedo
functions.description: Undoes the last hiUndo, assuming no other database modifications have occurred.

functions.name: hiRedraw
functions.description: Redraws the contents of a window.

functions.name: hiRefreshTextWindow
functions.description: Redraws all the selections and refreshes the viewfile window.

functions.name: hiRegCloseProc
functions.description: Registers the procedure to be called when a window is closed. You can register closing procedures for windows, session windows, and dockable windows. A session window's closing procedure is called before the closing procedure of any of the windows it contains.

functions.name: hiRegCurWindowTrigger
functions.description: Registers the SKILL function to be called whenever the current window changes. The SKILL function is called with one argument: an integer representing the window number of the new current window. If no window is current (for example, if all windows except the CIW are closed or if any open windows have the property neverCurrentWindow set to t), then the argument is 0.

functions.name: hiRegSetBindKeyProc
functions.syntax: hiRegSetBindKeyProc( t_application S_function [ g_notInherited ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function that will be called after a bindkey is set for the specified application with the hiSetBindKey function or the CIW Key or Mouse Binding form, or after a set of bindkeys is defined with the hiSetBindKeys function.

functions.name: hiRegTimer
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function string that is initialized after the specified time.

functions.name: hiRegZoomPanProc
functions.description: Registers a SKILL procedure for a graphics window that gets called whenever a user uses a zoom, pan, fit, or redraw command in that window. If you do not specify a window while registering the procedure, the procedure gets called whenever the user uses these commands in any graphics window. The SKILL procedure is passed the window ID.

functions.name: hiRegisterBindKeyPrefix
functions.description: Registers an application bindkey prefix. Use this function to register prefixes that you do not want to register with the Design Editor application. Cadence applications are already registered.

functions.name: hiRemoveExtraRepeatCommand
functions.description: Removes the specified SKILL command from the extra repeat command list. The commands in this list are added using hiAddExtraRepeatCommand. When the command is removed it becomes unrepeatable.

functions.name: hiRemoveFixedMenu
functions.description: Removes a fixed menu from a window. If you do not specify a menu, all fixed menus are removed. To delete a fixed menu, first use hiRemoveFixedMenu to remove the fixed menu from the window and then use hiDeleteMenu to destroy the fixed menu.

functions.name: hiRemoveIconOverrides
functions.description: Removes names from the list of icons that are loaded using the CSF search results directly, bypassing the hierarchy files. If the CSF search fails, the files in the hierarchy are loaded.

functions.name: hiRemoveNonRepeatPrefix
functions.description: Removes a repeat filter prefix that has been previously added using hiAddNonRepeatPrefix.

functions.name: hiRemovePromptLine
functions.description: Removes the prompt line from the graphics window you specify or, if you do not specify a window, from the current window.

functions.name: hiRemoveTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Removes characters from the word delimiter list for the window.

functions.name: hiRepeat
functions.description: Re-runs the last command run in the CIW.

functions.name: hiReplaceAllBannerMenus
functions.description: Replaces all menus in a window with new menus.

functions.name: hiReplaceTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Replaces the original word delimiters for the window with a new set of characters.

functions.name: hiReplayFile
functions.description: Replays a log file. Use this function only for testing or debugging. In general, use the functions load or loading instead of hiReplayFile. hiReplayFile is intended to be run only from a Command Interpreter Window.

functions.name: hiReportDeselectAllItems
functions.description: Deselects all selected items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportDeselectItem
functions.syntax: hiReportDeselectItem( g_reportField g_itemIndex [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects an item in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportDeselectItems
functions.syntax: hiReportDeselectItems( g_reportField l_itemIndexList [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportGetSelectedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently selected in a report field.

functions.name: hiReportSelectAllItems
functions.description: Selects all items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportSelectItem
functions.syntax: hiReportSelectItem( g_reportField g_itemIndex [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects an item in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportSelectItems
functions.syntax: hiReportSelectItems( g_reportField l_itemIndexList [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiResetAbort
functions.description: Sets the global abort flag to nil. This flag can be set to t by calling hiSetAbort.

functions.name: hiResetProgressBox
functions.syntax: hiResetProgressBox( g_pboxID x_totalSteps t_text g_autoClose ) => t / nil
functions.description: Resets a progess dialog box to the new values you specify. The progress bar is also reset to 0%.

functions.name: hiResizeField
functions.syntax: hiResizeField(  r_2DForm  s_field  l_resizeDescription  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the width, height, or promptBox width of a specified field. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiResizeMagnifier
functions.description: Changes the magnifier size dynamically.

functions.name: hiResizeWindow
functions.description: Resizes a window to the size of a bounding box. If w_windowID is a window within a session window, the session window is resized.

functions.name: hiRestoreView
functions.description: Restores a graphics window to the view specified by viewName.

functions.name: hiSaveAsViewfile
functions.description: Saves the contents of the current window to the specified name.

functions.name: hiSaveForRestore
functions.description: Saves your session information in the file you specify. This function is the programmatic equivalent of selecting the Options - Save Sessions command in the CIW and saving a file in the Save Sessions form that appears.

functions.name: hiSaveIconData
functions.syntax: hiSaveIconData( l_hiIcon t_fileName [ t_formatName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a loaded pixmap to a file in the specified format. This function accepts an hi pixmap description and converts it to any of the image formats supported by Qt; currently, these are: BMP, JPG, PNG, PPM, XBM, and XPM. However, PNG is the recommended format.

functions.name: hiSaveView
functions.description: Saves the current viewing parameters of a graphics window.

functions.name: hiSaveViewfile
functions.syntax: hiSaveViewfile( [ w_windowId ]  [ t_fileName ]  [ g_donotOverwrite ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the contents of the viewfile window to a file on disk. If you do not specify any arguments, a Save As form appears that lets you select the file.

functions.name: hiSaveWinConfig
functions.syntax: hiSaveWinConfig( n_configID t_pathToFile [ g_overwrite ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a workspace to a file. The g_overwrite argument lets you specify whether or not to overwrite an existing file.

functions.name: hiScaleBox
functions.description: Returns a bounding box that has the same center point as the bounding box passed, but whose sides are scaled by 1/n_scale.

functions.name: hiScaleMagnifier
functions.description: Changes the zooming factor of the magnifier dynamically.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowBottom
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the bottom position of the viewable window.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowDown
functions.description: Scrolls the window down one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowLeft
functions.description: Scrolls the window left one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowRight
functions.description: Scrolls the window right one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowToCurrentIndex
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the current cursor index position in the viewable window.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowToIndex
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the index position in the specified window and forces the text at the given position to be displayed.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowToName
functions.description: Scrolls a hypertext window to a link and displays the text associated with the link. A hypertext window is a text window that can display text with hyperlinks in it.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowTop
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the top position of the viewable window.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowUp
functions.description: Scrolls the window up one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiSelectTextByLoc
functions.syntax: hiSelectTextByLoc( w_windowId  l_locationPair [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Highlights a list of strings specified as a list of starting and ending location pairs.

functions.name: hiSetAbort
functions.description: Sets the global abort flag to t. This flag can be set to nil by calling hiResetAbort.

functions.name: hiSetActionChecked
functions.syntax: hiSetActionChecked( o_action g_checkState [ g_triggerCB ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets checked state for an action and triggers the action callback, unless you specify otherwise by setting g_triggerCB to nil.

functions.name: hiSetBeepVolume
functions.description: Sets the loudness of the beep when a default in the system is detected.

functions.name: hiSetBindKey
functions.syntax: hiSetBindKey( [ t_applicationType ]  [ t_key ]  [ t_skill_cmd ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Binds a SKILL command string to a keyboard key or a mouse sequence for an application.

functions.name: hiSetBindKeys
functions.description: Sets multiple bindkeys for an application at one time. For memory and performance efficiency, use this function instead of hiSetBindKey if you are setting multiple bindkeys. For information about restrictions, see hiSetBindKey.

functions.name: hiSetButtonIcon
functions.description: Changes a button icon after the button is created. This function updates all instances of the button.

functions.name: hiSetButtonLabel
functions.description: Changes a button label text or icon after the button is created. This function updates all instances of the button.

functions.name: hiSetCallbackStatus
functions.description: Overrides the removal (unmapping) of a form when the form's OK button is pressed.

functions.name: hiSetClipboard
functions.description: Sets the text to be pushed to the system clipboard.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentField
functions.syntax: hiSetCurrentField( g_form  s_fieldName [ g_limitSearch ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Makes the specified type-in field the current field (sets input focus to the field). If the field is not visible, hiSetCurrentField scrolls the form or scroll region field so the field becomes visible.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentForm
functions.syntax: hiSetCurrentForm( g_form [ g_setIfNotDisplayed [ g_setIfNotInstantiated ] ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Makes the form you specify the current form. If the form is displayed, moves the focus to the form.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentIndex
functions.description: Sets the current cursor index position relative to all the text in a window and scrolls the window, if needed.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentTextSelectionLoc
functions.syntax: hiSetCurrentTextSelectionLoc( w_windowId  x_startIndex  x_endIndex  ) => t | nil
functions.description: Selects the range of text specified by the start and end indexes in the given text window. This is equivalent to selecting the text with the mouse.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentWindow
functions.description: Sets the window you specify as the current window.

functions.name: hiSetCursor
functions.description: Sets the cursor you specify for the window.

functions.name: hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation
functions.syntax: hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation( l_location [ g_autoUpdate { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default location for all dialog boxes created with hiDisplayAppDBox, hiDisplayUserDBox, hiDisplayProgressBox, and hiDisplayFileDialog. This setting is used if the l_location argument of those functions has not been set or has been set incorrectly.

functions.name: hiSetDisabledIcon
functions.description: Specifies a disabled icon for an icon, which is displayed whenever the icon is disabled. This function only applies to icons used in menus, not to icons used in form fields or buttons.

functions.name: hiSetDrawThruDelta
functions.description: Sets the default draw-thru delta and, optionally, the high draw-thru delta for mouse buttons 1, 2 or 3.

functions.name: hiSetEFDrawThruDelta
functions.description: Sets the Enter Function draw-thru delta.

functions.name: hiSetEFunCursor
functions.description: Sets the cursor for an active enterfunction.

functions.name: hiSetEncapHistory
functions.syntax: hiSetEncapHistory( w_window  t_msg [ g_redraw ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Copies a message into the next available insertion position in an encapsulation output window.

functions.name: hiSetEncapPrompt
functions.description: Sets the prompt for an encapsulation window.

functions.name: hiSetEncapSkillCmd
functions.description: Registers the SKILL function that wraps or embraces the input command line entered during the current encapsulation session.

functions.name: hiSetFieldEditable
functions.description: Sets the specified field editable or noneditable, in all forms where it appears.

functions.name: hiSetFieldEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables a form field. A disabled field is greyed-out. This function updates all instances of the field. You can use hiSetFieldEnabled with all types of fields except separator fields.

functions.name: hiSetFieldMinSize
functions.syntax: hiSetFieldMinSize(  g_formRegionOrLayout  s_fieldName  [ ?widgetWidth x_widgetWidth ]  [ ?widgetHeight x_widgetHeight ]  [ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the minimum width and height for the widget portion of a field.

functions.name: hiSetFilter
functions.description: Sets the output message filter for the CIW with the option specified by t_filter. The output area of the CIW is refreshed immediately. If no option is specified, the Set Log File Display Filter form appears allowing you to specify the display options you want.

functions.name: hiSetFilterOptions
functions.syntax: hiSetFilterOptions( g_accelInput g_prompt g_output g_returnAccel g_typedReturn g_errorOutput g_warnOutput )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the output message filter for the CIW with the specified options. This function corresponds to the Set Log File Display Filter form (displayed by choosing Options - Log Filter in the CIW). Standard message output, return values from typed-in commands, errors and warning messages are displayed by default.

functions.name: hiSetFont
functions.syntax: hiSetFont( [ S_fontType  ?name t_fontName  ?size x_fontSize  ?bold g_useBold  ?italic g_useItalics  ?fontInfo l_fontInfoDpl ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the required font attributes, such as font name, font size, or font weight for label, text, or ciw. If no argument is specified, then the Set Fonts window is displayed. In this window, you can set any of the valid fonts and click the Apply button to save the changes. If any of the key arguments is specified in this function, then it is mandatory to specify S_fontType.

functions.name: hiSetFormBlock
functions.syntax: hiSetFormBlock( r_form [ g_blockUpdates ] [ g_unmanage ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Prevents time-consuming multiple updates to a form during multiple changes (such as adding, deleting, moving, or resizing elements). You can also blank out the form during extensive changes. Updates are blocked until you call hiSetFormBlock(r_form nil) or hiUpdateFormBlock(r_form).

functions.name: hiSetFormButtonEnabled
functions.syntax: hiSetFormButtonEnabled( r_form s_buttonSym g_enabled ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables a button on a form. To enable or disable fields on a form, use the hiSetFieldEnabled function.

functions.name: hiSetFormHighlights
functions.description: Highlights all type-in fields for form, depending on the value of highlightType.

functions.name: hiSetFormMinMaxSize
functions.syntax: hiSetFormMinMaxSize( r_form g_minSize g_maxSize ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the minimum or maximum size of the form. The size excludes the window manager title and border.

functions.name: hiSetFormName
functions.description: Changes the form title, which is displayed in the window frame banner. The function can be called by its alias hiChangeFormTitle.

functions.name: hiSetFormPosition
functions.description: Sets the default initial location for forms displayed without an explicit location argument.

functions.name: hiSetFormSize
functions.syntax: hiSetFormSize( r_form l_size [ g_reattachFields ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Resizes a form programmatically. If the optional argument g_reattachFields is non-nil, field attachments is recalculated based on the new form size and original field sizes.

functions.name: hiSetFormToDefaults
functions.description: Sets each field in the form to its default value, except the disclosure field value.

functions.name: hiSetIconName
functions.description: Sets the name that is displayed on a window's icon when the window is minimized. A session window, when minimized, displays the icon name of the window that is currently active within it; if the window does not have an icon name set, then the session window's icon name is displayed.

functions.name: hiSetInsertionPosition
functions.syntax: hiSetInsertionPosition( g_form s_field x_newPosition ) => t / nil
functions.description: Resets the position of the insertion cursor in a type-in field. You can use the hiGetInsertionPosition function to get the current position of the cursor.

functions.name: hiSetKeyboardFocusField
functions.syntax: hiSetKeyboardFocusField(  g_formOrRegion  s_field  [ g_limitSearch [ g_onlyCurrentTabPage ]] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the keyboard focus to field, s_field, if it is found in the form or region, g_formOrRegion and is allowed to have keyboard focus. It also enables you to do a hierarchical search if g_limitSearch is not specified or is set to nil. The search is limited to only the top-level of the form or scroll region field if, g_limitSearch is specified as a non-nil value.

functions.name: hiSetLayerCyclicValue
functions.syntax: hiSetLayerCyclicValue(  d_techFileId l_lpp r_form  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the current value of the layer cyclic field.

functions.name: hiSetLayoutFrameTitle
functions.syntax: hiSetLayoutFrameTitle( g_title  g_formRegionOrLayout  [ s_layoutName ] ) => t_title / t / nil
functions.description: Sets the frame title of a hiLayout form, a scroll region, or a tab page in the hiLayout form.

functions.name: hiSetLayoutMargins
functions.syntax: hiSetLayoutMargins(  l_margins  g_formRegionOrLayout  [ s_layoutName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Set the top, bottom, left, and right margins of the layout.

functions.name: hiSetListItemCenter
functions.description: Brings the specified list box item into view in the center of the list box, if possible. Takes a list box field of a form as the first argument and the numeric position of the item you want to bring into view as the second argument.

functions.name: hiSetListItemVisible
functions.description: Brings the specified list box item into view in the list box. Takes a list box field of a form as the first argument and the numeric position of the item you want to bring into view as the second argument. If the numeric position specified is 0 or less than 0, the last item in the list is scrolled into view.

functions.name: hiSetMenuItemCallback
functions.syntax: hiSetMenuItemCallback( r_hiMenu  s_itemHandle  t_callback  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the callback associated with all instances of a specified menu item.

functions.name: hiSetMenuItemStatusTip
functions.syntax: hiSetMenuItemStatusTip( r_hiMenu s_itemHandle t_statusTip ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the status tip for the specified menu item. The status tip is displayed on the status bar at the bottom of the window when the mouse hovers over the menu item.

functions.name: hiSetMenuItemText
functions.syntax: hiSetMenuItemText( r_hiMenu  s_itemHandle  t_itemText  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the text associated with all instances of a specified menu item.

functions.name: hiSetMouseMoveSampleRate
functions.description: Sets the number of mouse motion events to be processed.

functions.name: hiSetMouseStopDetectTime
functions.description: Sets the stop detection time to detect if a mouse has stopped moving.

functions.name: hiSetMultiClickTime
functions.description: Sets the number of milliseconds that must elapse before a mouse click is recognized as a separate single click rather than the second click of a double click.

functions.name: hiSetProgress
functions.description: Sets the progress bar in a progress dialog box to the step you specify. Note, however, that the text above the progress bar remains the same; use hiSetProgressText to update the text or hiSetProgressAndText to update both the step and the text.

functions.name: hiSetProgressAndText
functions.syntax: hiSetProgressAndText( g_dboxID x_step t_text ) => t / nil
functions.description: In a progress dialog box, sets the current step of the progress bar as well as the text that is displayed above the progress bar.

functions.name: hiSetProgressBannerText
functions.description: Sets the text that is displayed on the window banner of a progress dialog box.

functions.name: hiSetProgressBar
functions.description: Sets the progress (the current step) of the progress bar in the window you specify.

functions.name: hiSetProgressButtonText
functions.description: Changes the text of the button on a progress dialog box. Progress dialog boxes, created with hiDisplayProgressBox, have one button, whose default text is Cancel.

functions.name: hiSetProgressLabel
functions.description: Sets the label of the progress bar in the specified window. An empty string removes the label.

functions.name: hiSetProgressText
functions.description: Sets the text that is displayed above the progress bar in a progress dialog box.

functions.name: hiSetProgressTotalSteps
functions.syntax: hiSetProgressTotalSteps( g_dboxID x_totalSteps x_step ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the total number of steps on the progress bar in a progress dialog box. This function also sets the current step.

functions.name: hiSetScrollBarValue
functions.description: Sets the horizontal and vertical scroll bars in a form or scroll region field to the position you specify, therefore allowing you to display a specific part of the form or scroll region field programmatically. Use hiGetScrollBarInfo to get information about the form or scroll region field before you use this function.

functions.name: hiSetSessionFocus
functions.description: Sets the keyboard focus to a session window's active tab window or docked window when the session window becomes active. The active tab window or docked window that you specify must be part of a session window and must contain a sub-widget that is enabled, visible, and that can get focus through the Tab key. The focus is set to a sub-widget.

functions.name: hiSetShadowMode
functions.description: Controls the display of unselected objects in a graphics window. When you enable shadow mode with this function, all unselected objects are dimmed and all selected objects are displayed at full brightness in their original layer color instead of the selection color. The shadow mode setting applies to all graphics in all windows of the application, not just to the current window.

functions.name: hiSetSplashBackground
functions.description: Sets the background for an application's splash screen. If the graphic you specify has too many colors, the background is not set.

functions.name: hiSetSplashDefaultBackground
functions.description: Sets the splash screen background to the default background.

functions.name: hiSetSplashFamily
functions.description: Sets the product family name on an application's splash screen.

functions.name: hiSetSplashIcon
functions.description: Sets a new icon for an application splash screen. The icon is displayed between the product name and the license information and always be set to a 48x48 size.

functions.name: hiSetSplashLicense
functions.description: Sets the license information in an application's splash screen. You can currently set only Cadence license information.

functions.name: hiSetSplashProduct
functions.description: Sets the product name on an application's splash screen.

functions.name: hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex
functions.syntax: hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex(  x_index  g_formRegionOrLayout  [ s_layoutName ]  )  => x_index / nil
functions.description: Sets the index of the current top item of a valid stacked hiLayout.

functions.name: hiSetTabWindowIcon
functions.description: Sets the icon in the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

functions.name: hiSetTabWindowTip
functions.description: Sets the tooltip for the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

functions.name: hiSetTabWindowTitle
functions.description: Sets the title of the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

functions.name: hiSetTextClass
functions.description: Sets the active selection (highlight) text class in a window.

functions.name: hiSetTextHighlightColor
functions.syntax: hiSetTextHighlightColor( x_class l_foreground l_background  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the foreground and background highlight colors of a class to the specified RGB value.

functions.name: hiSetTextSelectAll
functions.syntax: hiSetTextSelectAll( w_windowId  t_text [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Highlights all occurrences of a specified string and resets the cursor to the top of the file.

functions.name: hiSetTextSelection
functions.syntax: hiSetTextSelection( w_windowId  t_text [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Highlights the next occurrence of a specified string relative to the current cursor position. If no matching string is found between the current cursor position and the end of the file, it wraps around to the beginning of the file and continues the search.

functions.name: hiSetToolbarObjName
functions.description: Sets a name for the toolbar that is used for storing window configuration information about the toolbar. Every toolbar must have a unique name that does not change. Do not use this function with toolbars provided by Cadence.

functions.name: hiSetTopListItem
functions.description: Sets the first visible item in a list box field to the specified position (x_itemPosition). A position value of 1 indicates the first item, a position value of 2 indicates the second item, and so on. A value of 0 (zero) specifies the last item in the list.

functions.name: hiSetTreeItemDescription
functions.description: Changes the item description. The description is initially set with the g_description argument of  hiCreateTreeItem. To get the current description, use hiGetTreeItemDescription.

functions.name: hiSetTreeItemIcons
functions.description: Sets the following icons for a tree item: default icon, expanded icon (displayed when the item is expanded), selection icon (displayed when the item is selected), and expanded selection icon (displayed when the item is both expanded and selected).

functions.name: hiSetTypeinMenuItemCompleterList
functions.syntax: hiSetTypeinMenuItemCompleterList( r_menu  s_menuItem  l_completerList  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Replaces the list of strings that store the history of user inputs for the specified type-in menu item. This list is used to assist user inputs in the type-in menu item.

functions.name: hiSetUndoLimit
functions.description: Sets the maximum number of hiUndo commands that can be performed in sequence. Specify either 0 or 128; 0 disables the undo command and 128 sets the undo limit to 128. If you specify any number other than 0, the undo limit is 128.

functions.name: hiSetUserPreferences
functions.description: Displays the User Preferences form with the latest values.

functions.name: hiSetViewfile
functions.syntax: hiSetViewfile( w_windowId  t_fileName [ g_deviceMode ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Reads a file and displays its contents in a viewfile window that has already been created.

functions.name: hiSetWinObjName
functions.description: Sets the window name which is used for storing workspace information about a dock assistant. Every dock assistant must have a unique name that does not change. Do not use this function with dock assistants provided by Cadence.

functions.name: hiSetWinStyle
functions.description: Sets the window creation style to 'default, 'interactive or 'bBox.

functions.name: hiSetWindowAtts
functions.syntax: hiSetWindowAtts( [ ?window w_windowId ]  [ ?appType t_applicationType ]  [ ?help t_help ]  [ ?scroll g_scrollbars ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the application type, help string, or scroll bar attributes of a window. You must register the new application type before setting it with this function.

functions.name: hiSetWindowDefaultPrompt
functions.description: Sets the prompt for the window associated with the given window ID instead of the default SKILL prompt. The function returns either the value of the previously set prompt or nil. If you specify an empty string for t_prompt, the function resets the prompt to the default value, which is the SKILL prompt.

functions.name: hiSetWindowFocus
functions.description: Sets the focus to the window associated with the given window ID.

functions.name: hiSetWindowIcon
functions.description: Sets the icon of a window, which is displayed when the window is minimized. A session window, when minimized, displays the icon of the window that is currently active within it; if the window does not have an icon set, then the session window's icon is displayed.

functions.name: hiSetWindowMenu
functions.description: Associates the given menu with the specified window.

functions.name: hiSetWindowName
functions.description: Sets the window name, which is displayed in the window manager frame of a window. A session window displays the window name of the window that is currently active within it.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeys
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for an application type or window in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeysByAppType
functions.syntax: hiShowBindKeysByAppType( w_window1 t_applicationType [ g_showInheritBindings ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for an application in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeysByWindow
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for a window in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowFieldBorders
functions.description: Displays or hides borders around form fields. Used as a debugging aid to avoid overlapping fields when laying out forms.

functions.name: hiShowListBox
functions.syntax: hiShowListBox( ?name s_listBoxHandle  ?choices lt_listItems  ?callback s_callback  [?title t_listBoxTitle]  [?multipleSelect g_multiSelect] [?value lt_selectedItem] [?appData g_appData] [?applyButton g_applyButton] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a list box. The list box displays a list of strings. The list box can be created so that one item is selectable or multiple items are selectable. While the list box is displayed on the screen, the user may change the items in the list box, or change the item(s) selected. The list box remains on the screen until the user selects OK or Cancel. The list box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

functions.name: hiShowProgressBar
functions.syntax: hiShowProgressBar( w_windowID [ x_totalSteps ] [ x_delay ] [ t_label ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays a progress bar in the status bar of a window, typically in the bottom-right corner. The progress bar displays the progress of a command.

functions.name: hiShowToolbar
functions.description: Displays a hidden toolbar.

functions.name: hiSleep
functions.description: The hiSleep() function is an alias for the ipcSleep function.

functions.name: hiStartGenTextIndex
functions.description: Searches the specified text string from the beginning of the file and returns the first character position of the matching text.

functions.name: hiStartLog
functions.description: Writes a transaction log to a file.

functions.name: hiStoreFormLocation
functions.description: Stores a form location coordinates so that the form can be restored later to the same position.

functions.name: hiStringToIcon
functions.syntax: hiStringToIcon(   a_colorArray  t_iconString  x_width  x_height  )  => l_hiIcon / nil
functions.description: Returns an icon description that can be used in hi functions that accept icons, such as  hiCreatePulldownMenu, hiCreateMenuItem, hiCreateSliderMenuItem, hiCreateButton, hiCreateCyclicField, hiCreateLabel, and hiAddCyclicChoice.

functions.name: hiStroke
functions.description: Mouse callback that initiates a stroke command.

functions.name: hiSwapTreeItemSelectionIcons
functions.description: Swaps the item icon and expanded icon with the selection icon and expanded selection icon respectively for the specified tree item. For information about setting these icons, see hiSetTreeItemIcons.

functions.name: hiSwitchWindowType
functions.syntax: hiSwitchWindowType( w_windowId  t_widgetType t_appType t_help [ g_scroll ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Switches the widget type of a window between graphics, text, or hypertext. The window must be in a session window.

functions.name: hiSync
functions.description: For programs with several GUI-related creation and deletion operations running in a loop, Qt objects deferred to be deleted later may accumulate and affect performance. This function solves this issue by forcing Qt to immediately delete these objects.

functions.name: hiSynchronize
functions.description: Flushes the event queue by calling QApplication::flush().

functions.name: hiTextDisplayString
functions.syntax: hiTextDisplayString( w_windowId  t_text g_erase [ g_dontScrollTop ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Displays a text string in a window.

functions.name: hiTextWidth
functions.description: Determines the width, in pixels, of a string of characters that has a specified font. Returns nil if the font type is not valid.

functions.name: hiToggleAnchorMagnifier
functions.description: Toggles the anchored state of the magnifier to anchored/un-anchored depending upon the current anchored state of the magnifier.

functions.name: hiToggleEnterForm
functions.description: Displays or removes the options form of the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: hiToggleMagnifier
functions.description: Changes the visibility of the magnifier to on/off depending on the current visibility setting of the magnifier.

functions.name: hiToggleMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Turns on magnifier resolution in the canvas if the canvas is not currently using magnifier resolution. Otherwise turns off magnifier resolution.

functions.name: hiTreeAppendItem
functions.description: Adds an item at the end of a tree. To add an item to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItem.

functions.name: hiTreeAppendItems
functions.description: Adds items at the end of a tree. To add items to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItems.

functions.name: hiTreePrependItem
functions.description: Adds an item to the beginning of a tree. To add an item at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItem.

functions.name: hiTreePrependItems
functions.description: Adds items to the beginning of a tree. To add items at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveAllItems
functions.description: Removes all the items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveItem
functions.description: Removes an item from a tree. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems. To remove all the items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveItems
functions.description: Removes the specified items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem; to remove all items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems
functions.description: Deselects all selected items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItem
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableDeselectItem( g_treeField g_item [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects an item in a tree table field. To deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems. To deselect all selected items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItems
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableDeselectItems( g_treeField l_items [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect all items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectAllItems
functions.description: Selects all items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectItem
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableSelectItem( g_treeField g_item [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects an item in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectItems
functions.syntax: hiTreeTableSelectItems( g_treeField l_items [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiUndo
functions.description: Undoes the last user command that modified the database and that has not been undone by a previous hiUndo.

functions.name: hiUndockWindow
functions.description: Undocks a dockable window from a session window. The window is floated. You can dock the window again with hiDockWindow.

functions.name: hiUnmapWindow
functions.description: Removes a window, dockable window, or session window from the screen without closing or destroying it.

functions.name: hiUnregCloseProc
functions.description: Unregisters the closing procedure for a window.

functions.name: hiUnregCurWindowTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters a SKILL function that was registered to be called whenever the current window changes.

functions.name: hiUnregZoomPanProc
functions.description: Unregisters a SKILL procedure that was registered with the hiRegZoomPanProc function and that is called whenever the user uses a zoom, pan, fit, or redraw command in a graphics window.

functions.name: hiUnselectText
functions.syntax: hiUnselectText( w_windowId t_text [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Unhighlights the next occurrence of selected text in the viewfile relative to the cursor position.

functions.name: hiUnselectTextAll
functions.syntax: hiUnselectTextAll w_windowId [ t_text ] [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Unselects all occurrences of the selected text that match with the specified pattern t_text and class x_class in the viewfile. If the search pattern t_text is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text of all classes. If the class x_class is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text that match with the specified pattern t_text. Afterwards, the cursor position is reset to the top of the file. If an empty string is passed for t_text, and x_class is specified, unselects all strings selected in that class

functions.name: hiUnselectTextByLoc
functions.syntax: hiUnselectTextByLoc( w_windowId l_locationPair [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Unhighlights selected text specified as a list of starting and ending location pairs in the given window.

functions.name: hiUnselectTextClass
functions.description: Unhighlights all occurrences of selected text belonging to the specified class.

functions.name: hiUpdate
functions.description: Updates window prompts and application-specific state variables. Especially important if an enterfunction has been canceled in a window that is not the current window.

functions.name: hiUpdateFormBlock
functions.description: Used to reset a form if you have blocked multiple updates with the hiSetFormBlock function. The functions pf hiUpdateFormBlock(r_form) is equivalent to hiSetFormBlock(r_form nil).

functions.name: hiUpdateMagOptions
functions.description: Update and display the Magnifier Options form with the magnifier values that are being used in the current window.

functions.name: hiUpdateTextSelectionColors
functions.description: Redraws all selections visible in the window and updates any colors previously reset with hiSetTextHighlightColor.

functions.name: hiUseMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Alters the movement of the cursor within the canvas.

functions.name: hiUsingMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Returns whether mouse movement in the canvas is set to behave as if the mouse is located within the magnifier.

functions.name: hiVectorPan
functions.syntax: hiVectorPan( [ w_window ]  [ l_refPt ]  [ l_destPt ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Scrolls the view of the design in any direction by specifying two points in user units.

functions.name: hiViewTextFile
functions.syntax: hiViewTextFile( t_file ?winSpec g_winspec ?title g_title ?appName g_appName ?help g_help ?iconPosition l_iconPosition ?deviceMode g_deviceMode ?pluginFactory g_pluginFactory ?fixedFont g_fixedFont )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates a viewfile window, inserts the menu bar, sets the window and icon names, specifies how to load the file in the window, and displays the file in the window.

functions.name: hiViewfile
functions.description: Brings up the Choose a File to View form in which you can specify a file to view and then calls the view function on the file.

functions.name: hiWinConfigModified
functions.description: Checks whether a workspace has been modified since it was last applied to the session window.

functions.name: hiWindowSaveImage
functions.syntax: hiWindowSaveImage( [ ?target g_target ] [ ?path t_path ] [ ?format t_format ] [ ?toplevel g_toplevel ] [ ?quality n_quality ] [ ?delay n_delay ] [ ?timeoutBeep g_timeoutBeep ] [ ?grabFromScreen g_grabFromScreen ] [ ?centralWidget g_centralWidget ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Takes a screen capture of a window, a region, or the entire screen. You can specify the object to capture either through the arguments or, in interactive mode, by selecting it with the mouse.

functions.name: hiWorldViewFit
functions.description: Fits the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewRedraw
functions.description: Redraws the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewZoomIn
functions.description: Zooms into the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewZoomOut
functions.description: Zooms out of the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiZoomAbsoluteScale
functions.syntax: hiZoomAbsoluteScale( [ w_window ]  [ n_scale ]  [ g_ignoreEFunBBox ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Zooms in or out with an absolute scale.

functions.name: hiZoomExpandAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms out by two in the specified window (or current window) expanding the zoom area in the direction of the mouse relative to the center of the window

functions.name: hiZoomExpandAtPoint
functions.syntax: hiZoomExpandAtPoint(  w_window f_zoomFactor l_point ) => t / nil
functions.description: Zooms out the image by keeping the mirror image point of l_point at the same location

functions.name: hiZoomIn
functions.description: Zooms in to a design.

functions.name: hiZoomInAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms into a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomInMagnifier
functions.description: Zooms into the picture in canvas, as opposed to the picture in the magnifier, with the current magnifier zooming factor.

functions.name: hiZoomOut
functions.description: Zoom out of a design.

functions.name: hiZoomOutAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms out of a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomOutMagnifier
functions.description: Backs out one call to the hiZoomInMagnifier command from the stack, similar to an undo action.

functions.name: hiZoomRelativeScale
functions.description: Zooms in or out with a scale relative to the current window.

functions.name: hiZoomWindowAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomWindowAtPoint
functions.syntax: hiZoomWindowAtPoint( w_window f_scale l_point ) => t / nil
functions.description: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point you specify at its current location in the window.

functions.name: iclicCheckOutAndLock
functions.description: Checks out the specified layout license, layout option license, or an appropriate higher-tier license and locks it after successful checkout.

functions.name: isBBox
functions.description: Validates that the given bounding box is properly defined. This function should not be used with Pcells.

functions.name: isLocation
functions.description: Validates that the given point is properly defined.

functions.name: lbuiGetCheckedOutLicenses
functions.description: Returns a list of the licenses consisting of each license feature name and the number of licenses (tokens) checked out.

functions.name: lbuiPrintLicenseUseReport
functions.description: Displays the license usage report (for example: user logins, host names, display time, number of licenses, and license version) in the CIW or the specified output log file.

functions.name: leftEdge
functions.description: Returns the lower left point's X coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

functions.name: lmgrAddMenuItems
functions.syntax: lmgrAddMenuItems(  t_menuName  t_popupSet  l_names  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Appends the named objects to the specified menu. An item can be another menu. Each menu item or menu can be added to only one menu. Likewise, any menu item can appear at most once in every pop-up menu. Menus cannot be added to a pop-up. Pop-ups must remain a flat structure only. Pop-ups cannot be added to menus.

functions.name: lmgrAddToolBarItems
functions.description: Adds menu items with the specified names to the Library Manager toolbar and optionally appends additional items with multiple calls. Item icons can be set using lmgrSetObject.

functions.name: lmgrCreateMenu
functions.description: Creates a structure for a menu, which can be populated with menu items. Once this menu is created, you can install it into the top menu bar or into another parent menu using lmgrAddMenuItems.

functions.name: lmgrCreateMenuItem
functions.syntax: lmgrCreateMenuItem(  t_itemName  t_itemType  l_itemAttributes  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance of a menu item, which should be populated into a single menu. Once this menu item is created, you can install it into a menu using lmgrAddMenuItems().

functions.name: lmgrDefineInits
functions.description: Defines the initialization action to perform when the customization code begins (after parsing the extension file) and the termination action to perform immediately before Library Manager terminates. You must define the callback in the Virtuoso program before it starts. Otherwise, you get an error. No arguments are passed to either callback.

functions.name: lmgrDeleteMenuItems
functions.description: Deletes the named objects from the menu/pop-up hierarchy. The object can be either a single item or an entire menu. There is no recovery or undo from this operation. If you merely wish to temporarily disable the view of an object, consider using lmgrManageMenuItems() instead.

functions.name: lmgrDisplayMessage
functions.description: Displays a string in the Message area on the Library Manager form and appends it to the Library Manager log file. If desired, the message can be written just to the Library Manager log file and not echoed to the user. Ensure that the string is terminated by a newline character, or the string might be confused with the output from other Library Manager commands or other calls to this function.

functions.name: lmgrGetObject
functions.description: Returns a list describing the state of the single named object or nil if the object does not exist. The format of the attribute list will be variable length list of tags (strings) paired with matching values that are either a string or Boolean value.

functions.name: lmgrInsertMenuItems
functions.syntax: lmgrInsertMenuItems(  t_menuItem  t_popupSet  l_names )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts the named objects into the menu directly before the indicated menu item. An object can be an entire menu. Each menu item or menu can be inserted or added to only one menu. Likewise, any menu item can appear at most once in each pop-up menu. Menus can not be inserted (added) to a pop-up. Pop-ups must remain a flat structure only. You cannot insert or add pop-ups to menus. This function is similar to lmgrAddMenuItems(), except in the meaning of the first argument.

functions.name: lmgrLogShowPopup
functions.description: Restores the context for popup menus for Library Manager replay. This function is only intended for supporting replay and cannot be called from other SKILL engine programs. You do not need to use this function directly.

functions.name: lmgrManageMenuItems
functions.description: Manages the named objects (enabling the display of named objects) inside their menu hierarchy and pop-up sets. Objects can be either a single item or an entire menu.

functions.name: lmgrMenuSubsInPopup
functions.description: This API is used only in the Library Manager's cdsLibMgr.il file for menu customization. The named menu may be placed into a sub-menu of a popup menu, which appears on clicking the right mouse button (RMB) in the Library Manager's window that lists the library, cell, and view items being browsed. This will be placed in a sub-popup if the boolean value was set to be true. In addition, menu items tagged for adding to the popup menus are displayed within its menu's sub-popup (if any). Sub-popup menus may be hierarchically nested per menu as they have been setup/defined through the customized menus' hierarchy.

functions.name: lmgrQueryNamedObjects
functions.description: Returns a list containing the names of all menu items in the Library Manager menu named t_menuName.

functions.name: lmgrRemoveToolBarItems
functions.description: Removes the specified items from the given toolbar that were previously added using lmgrAddToolBarItems.

functions.name: lmgrSensitizeMenuItems
functions.description: Sensitizes the named objects (enabling the active state of named objects) inside their menu hierarchy and pop-up sets. Objects can be either a single item or an entire menu.

functions.name: lmgrSetObject
functions.syntax: lmgrSetObject(  t_objName  l_attrList t_iconName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Accepts a list describing the state of the named object. Returns nil if the object does not exist. The format of the attribute list is a variable-length list of tags (strings) paired with matching string or Boolean values.

functions.name: lmgrShowToolBar
functions.description: Displays the specified toolbar when the Library Manager is launched and returns the previous show state specified.

functions.name: lmgrValidateIcon
functions.description: Checks whether an icon file exists in the Library Manager for the specified icon name before creating a menu item.

functions.name: lmgrVerbose
functions.description: Aids in debugging the callbacks registered in the cdsLibMgr.il file. It is possible to get additional informational messages to be shown inshown in the CIW.

functions.name: lowerLeft
functions.description: Returns the lower left point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and assumed to be correct.

functions.name: menuTrigger
functions.description: The menu trigger is called when an application is about to be installed as the current application in a window. At the time the menu trigger is called, all other triggers have already been called, and the window is about to be displayed (or if the window was a previously existing window, about to be refreshed).

functions.name: mouseAddPt

functions.name: mouseAddSelectPt

functions.name: mouseFinishPt
functions.description: Adds the point at the location where you clicked the mouse button to the enter function in the current window and completes the enter function, if possible.

functions.name: mousePopUp

functions.name: mouseSingleSelectPt

functions.name: mouseSubSelectPt

functions.name: mouseUndoPt
