functions.description: This procedure is registered to be called whenever something is typed into the input window of the encapsulation window.The  tmpStream argument is passed into the procedure to be packaged before it is sent to the simulator. This function also checks if the user has registered a function to be called so that the simulator inputs can be passed to this user-registered function for filtering. After filtering, the user can call the isePrintSimulatorCommand function such that the data will be sent to the simulator. All inputs typed into the encapsulation window are automatically reflected in the history section of the encapsulation window. If no user-function is registered then the inputs are sent directly to the simulator without filtering.

functions.name: iseGetMappedProbeList
functions.description: Returns a SKILL list of the netlister-assigned names of all of the nets currently probed in the schematic window.

functions.name: iseGetProbeList
functions.description: Returns a SKILL list of the user-assigned names of all nets currently probed in the schematic window.

functions.name: iseInitSchematicWindow
functions.description: Reads in the design specified by the simLibName, simLibConfigName, simCellName, simViewName, and simVersionName variables in the schematic window maintained by ISE.

functions.name: iseInitSimWindow
functions.description: Initializes the simulator window.

functions.name: iseInterruptSimulator
functions.description: Issues a soft interrupt to the simulator.

functions.name: iseNetExtNameCdsName
functions.description: Displays a form for the user to enter a netlister-assigned node name. A second form appears which displays both this name and its corresponding user-assigned name.

functions.name: iseOpenWindows
functions.description: Opens three new windows and updates internal ISE structures required to keep track of the identifications of these windows. The first covers the bottom right quarter of the screen and is set to be the schematic window. The second occupies the upper half of the screen and is the waveform window. The third window occupies the lower left quarter of the screen and is used to run the simulator. The original windows are not altered, but instead are overlaid with the new windows. This is the default window configuration.

functions.name: isePrintName
functions.description: Prints the netlister-assigned name of the object being pointed at in the schematic window to the input portion of the simulation window, starting from the current cursor position.

functions.name: isePrintNameCB
functions.description: The callback function of isePrintName which is to be called by the enter points function in iseGetExtName.

functions.name: isePrintSimulatorCommand
functions.description: Used when you create menu commands that interface with both the design and simulator.

functions.name: iseReleaseNodeFrom
functions.description: After forcing a node to a preferred value, this function calls the function specified by the iseReleaseFunc variable to release the node from that value.

functions.name: iseSearchForASchWindow
functions.description: If iseDontOpenSchematicWindowIfOneExists is set to t, this function searches for the first existing schematic window with the correct design opened for edit and uses that window as the ISE schematic window.

functions.name: iseSendOutputToEncapHistory
functions.description: Writes the string passed in as a parameter to the history section of the encapsulation window.

functions.name: iseSetEncapBindKeys
functions.description: Sets the bindkeys for the encapsulation window.

functions.name: iseSetNodeTo
functions.description: Replaces the iseSet function. It calls the function specified by the iseSetFunc variable.

functions.name: iseSimulate
functions.description: Calls the function specified by the iseSimulateFunc variable.

functions.name: iseStartInteractive
functions.description: Sets up the default interactive simulation environment.

functions.name: iseStartSimulator
functions.description: Issues the command to start the simulator in the simulator window by first evaluating the iseInvokeSimulatorFunc variable.

functions.name: iseUpdateNetlist
functions.description: Generates a new netlist by calling the SE netlist function.

functions.name: iseUpdateStimulus
functions.description: Runs the input name translation simin function.

functions.name: netlist
functions.description: Performs all the steps needed to generate a netlist. If the simDoNetlist variable is not set to t, the function returns t and does not run.

functions.name: runsim
functions.description: Runs the SKILL instructions stored in the simCommand variable, which is used to run the simulator for this simulation. The function then calls simOutWithArgs with the correct arguments to translate the textual simulator output stored in the simout.tmp file and generate the si.out file.

functions.name: simAddProbeCapByName
functions.description: Displays the net capacitance of the supplied net name. This function is to be used in conjunction with the function simReadNetCapFile, which reads in the sim.cap file, initializing all the net names in the design with the associated capacitance values. This function refreshes the active display window by displaying the capacitance value of the given net name.

functions.name: simAddProbeCapByScreen
functions.description: Displays all the nets capacitance on the current screen.

functions.name: simAddProbeCapForBusBit
functions.description: Displays net capacitance on each bit of a bus.

functions.name: simCheckExist
functions.description: Checks whether all of the variables in the variableNames list argument are defined and are not set to nil. Otherwise, prints an error message.

functions.name: simCheckHeader
functions.description: Checks the header stamp of the net capacitance file pointer,sim.cap. The header stamp must be the first word on the first line of the sim.cap file, and it must be equal to Net_Capacitance_File. Use the infile function to open the sim.cap file before calling this function.

functions.name: simCheckVariables
functions.description: Checks whether the variables simSimulator, simCellName, simLibName, simViewName, simRunDir, simViewList, simStopList, simSedFile, simCommand, simNlpGlobalLibName, and simNlpGlobalCellName have been set and their value is t. It does so by calling the simCheckExist function.

functions.name: simCheckViewConfig
functions.syntax: simCheckViewConfig( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks if the design you want to netlist is an HDB configuration.

functions.name: simCleanRun
functions.description: Deletes files created by both SE and the analysis tool being used from the simulation run directory. The function deletes only files that can be recreated by renetlisting or resimulating. Files which are required to rerun the simulation, such as the si.env and control files, are not deleted. The function displays a dialog box so you can confirm that you intend to delete the information. If the deletion is confirmed, the files that SE creates are deleted along with the files specified by the simCleanFileList variable. The simCleanFileList variable is set differently by each application integrated into SE.

functions.name: simDateStamp
functions.description: Prints the value contained in t_string argument followed by the date to standard output.

functions.name: simDeleteRunDirFile
functions.description: Deletes the specified file in the simulation run directory.

functions.name: simDesignVarCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Accepts the user-assigned variable name, cdsDesignVarName, as an argument and returns the netlister-assigned name for it as it appears in the netlist. The function reads the mapping information from the simRunDir directory using the design information set through the simCellName, simLibName, simViewName SKILL variables. Therefore, all these variables must be set before calling this function.

functions.name: simDesignVarExtNameCdsName
functions.description: Accepts the netlister-assigned variable name, extDesignVarName, as an argument and returns the user-assigned name for it as it appears on the schematic. The function reads the mapping information from the simRunDir directory using the design information set through the simCellName, simLibName, simViewName SKILL variables. Therefore, all these variables must be set before calling this function.

functions.name: simDrain
functions.description: Performs the equivalent of drain( stdout ) when run in the non-graphic environment without accepting any arguments. No action is taken or required when this function is run in the Cadence graphics environment.

functions.name: simEditFileWithName
functions.description: Calls the edit function internally to display the specified file.

functions.name: simExecute
functions.description: Runs the UNIX command or program provided as its single argument.

functions.name: simFindFile
functions.description: Finds the full file system pathname to t_filename in the install hierarchy, if it exists. The pathname this function searches for is specified by the prependInstallPath function.

functions.name: simFlattenWithArgs
functions.syntax: simFlattenWithArgs( t_simLibName t_simCellName t_simViewName t_simRunDir t_simNlpGlobalLibName t_simNlpGlobalCellName t_simNlpGlobalViewName l_simViewList l_simStopList t_simGlobalErrFileName t_simProbeFileName t_simSimulator f_simTimeUnit f_simCapUnit t_simFlatLibName t_simFlatCellName t_simFlatViewName t_simFlatViewTypeName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the prFlatten tool. The design hierarchy is specified by the simLibName, simCellName, and simViewName variables. The global formatting properties are defined in simNlpGlobalLibName, simNlpGlobalCellName and simNlpGlobalViewName. The function is defined in /bin/si and also in the Cadence graphics program.

functions.name: simGetLoginName
functions.description: Returns the string-valued login name of the current user.

functions.name: simGetTermList
functions.syntax: simGetTermList( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => l_list / nil
functions.description: Collects all the terminals for a block and returns them as a list.

functions.name: simIfNoProcedure
functions.description: Same as the SKILL keyword procedure, except the procedure definition given as an argument is only defined if it is not currently defined. This function is used instead of the SKILL procedure to permit the overriding of procedures defined in SE by procedures in .simrc.

functions.name: simIlSleep
functions.description: Suspends the current process by the number of seconds specified as an argument. The current process in a replay file launches si in batch mode and waits for si to return before it runs the next command in the file.

functions.name: simInWithArgs
functions.syntax: simInWithArgs(  l_fileList t_runDirName  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Translates the designer-assigned names for nets and instances in the input files into the corresponding netlister-assigned names and creates the files for input into the simulator.

functions.name: simInitControl
functions.description: Checks whether  a file called control exists in the simulation run directory.

functions.name: simInitEnv
functions.description: Initializes the simulation environment within the Cadence graphics environment.

functions.name: simInitEnvWithArgs
functions.syntax: simInitEnvWithArgs(  t_runDirName  t_libName | nil t_cellName | nil t_viewName | nil t_simulatorName | nil g_forceInit )  => t / nil
functions.description: Initializes the simulation environment within the Cadence graphics environment. In addition to defining the SKILL environment needed for SE and the target application, the run directory is created and initialized as needed.

functions.name: simInitRaw
functions.description: Creates the raw directory in the simulation run directory that stores the waveform file.

functions.name: simInitRunDir
functions.description: Executes the list of functions specified by the variable simInitRunActions. If this variable is not set then simInitControl and simInitRaw are the default list of functions to be executed in this order, which initializes a simulation run directory.

functions.name: simInitSimulator
functions.description: Calls the function with the same name as the simulator name specified by the simSimulator variable, for example,  silos. This function must be defined in a file with the same name with either the .il or the .ile suffix added and stored in the local/si/caplib directory.

functions.name: simInstCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Accepts the user-assigned instance name as an argument and returns the netlister-assigned instance name for cdsInstName as it appears in the netlist. The exact name returned depends on the design.

functions.name: simInstExtNameCdsName
functions.description: Accepts the netlister-assigned instance name as an argument extInstName and returns the user-assigned instance name as it appears in the schematic.

functions.name: simJobMonitor
functions.description: Displays a form listing the analysis jobs invoked in the background using the simRunNetAndSim and simRunNetAndSimWithArgs functions. The analysis job is listed on the form, along with its current status, time of invocation, and execution priority. Using this form, you can view the run log of a job, terminate the execution of an active job, suspend the execution of an active job, change the execution priority of a job, or delete a job from the form.

functions.name: simLoadNetlisterFiles
functions.description: Loads the file specified as an argument from the local/fnl directory. If the tool does not find the file in the local/fnl directory, it searches in the etc/skill/fnl directory in the install hierarchy. If it does not exist, no error is generated.

functions.name: simLoadSimulatorFiles
functions.description: Loads the simulator-specific file from the local/si/caplib directory. If it does not find the file in local/si/caplib, it searches etc/skill/si/caplib directory in the install hierarchy. If the file does not exist, no error is generated.

functions.name: simNetCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Accepts  the user-assigned net name as an argument for cdsNetName and returns the netlister-assigned net name as it appears in the netlist.

functions.name: simNetExtNameCdsName
functions.description: Accepts  the netlister-assigned net name as an argument and returns the user-assigned net name for extNetName as it appears in the schematic.

functions.name: simNetlistWithArgs
functions.syntax: simNetlistWithArgs(  t_simLibName t_simCellName t_simViewName  t_simRunDir  t_simNlpGlobalLibName t_simNlpGlobalCellName t_simNlpGlobalViewName l_simViewList l_simStopList  t_simGlobalErrorFileName  t_simProbeFileName  t_simSimulator  f_simTimeUnit  f_simCapUnit  t_simNetlistFileName t_simFlatViewTypeName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a flattened description of the design hierarchy specified by simLibName, simCellName, and simViewName in the syntax described by the global formatting properties in simNlpGlobalLibName, simNlpGlobalCellName and simNlpGlobalViewName.

functions.name: simNoNetlist
functions.description: Sets the simNoNetlist variable to t to specify that no netlist is generated, and then callsthe sim function to perform a complete simulation, except for netlist generation.

functions.name: simOutWithArgs
functions.syntax: simOutWithArgs( l_fileList t_runDirName t_libName t_cellName t_viewName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Translates the netlister-assigned names for nets and instances in the input files specified in fileList to the corresponding user-assigned names, and produces the output files specified in fileList.

functions.name: simPostNameConvert
functions.description: Clears all allocated storage and marks the map structure as invalid. Since this function can be called using SKILL, the parameter has to be maintained as a list.

functions.name: simPreNameConvert
functions.description: Sets up the variables needed for name conversion routines. If no arguments are passed, it does the setup by doing a lookup of the simulator environment settings.

functions.name: simPrintEnvironment
functions.description: Writes the primary simulation control variables and their values to the si.env file in the simulation run directory.

functions.name: simPrintError
functions.description: Prints the text argument to the stderr port if executed in the Cadence nongraphic environment. If the function is called from within the Cadence graphics environment, the output is written to the CIW window.

functions.name: simPrintErrorLine
functions.description: Prints the errors for a cell and writes them out to a file.

functions.name: simPrintMessage
functions.description: Prints the text argument to the stdout port if executed in the Cadence non-graphic environment. If the function is called from within the Cadence graphics environment, the output is written to the CIW window.

functions.name: simPrintTermList
functions.syntax: simPrintTermList( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileName )  => t
functions.description: Lists the terminals for a cell and writes them out to a file.

functions.name: simReadNetCapFile
functions.description: Reads in the net capacitance file and initializes the simAllNets global variable. This contains the list of all nets in the design and their associated capacitance values, which are present in the capacitance file.

functions.name: simRunDirInfile
functions.description: Opens the file specified using the fileName argument in the simulation run directory for reading. It creates a full file system path name to the file in the simulation run directory and then passes the file as an argument to the SKILL infile function. The function returns a SKILL port.

functions.name: simRunDirLoad
functions.description: Loads the file specified using the t_fileName argument in the simulation run directory. It creates a full file system path to the file in the simulation run directory and then passes the file as an argument to the SKILL load function.

functions.name: simRunDirOutfile
functions.description: Opens the file specified using the fileName argument in the simulation run directory for writing. It creates a full file system path name to the file in the simulation run directory and then passes the file as an argument to the SKILL outfile function. The function returns a SKILL port.

functions.name: simRunNetAndSim
functions.description: Starts an analysis job in either foreground or background mode.

functions.name: simRunNetAndSimWithArgs
functions.syntax: simRunNetAndSimWithArgs(  t_libName | nil t_cellName | nil t_viewName | nil t_simulatorName | nil g_doNetlist g_doSimulation g_runBackground x_jobPriority )  => t / nil
functions.description: Starts an analysis job in either foreground or background mode.

functions.name: simRunNetAndSimWithCmd
functions.syntax: simRunNetAndSimWithCmd(  t_libName | nil t_cellName | nil t_viewName | nil t_simulatorName | nil t_cmdToBeExecuted g_runBackground x_jobPriority )  => t / nil
functions.description: Runs a command that you specify in either foreground or background mode. The simulation environment must be initialized before simRunNetAndSimWithCmd is called. The simRunDir global variable specifies the current run directory. It is set when the simulation environment is initialized.

functions.name: simSetDef
functions.description: Sets the g_variableName variable to g_value only if the variable is not yet set or if the symbol variableName evaluates to nil. If the variable was set prior to calling this function, and the simGenWarnings variable is not nil, a warning message is printed to stdout that the value of the variableName variable is overridden.

functions.name: simSetDefWithNoWarn
functions.description: Sets the g_variableName variable to g_value, same as the simSetDef function, except that no warning is generated if variableName is already set.

functions.name: simStringsToList
functions.description: Accepts a string of names separated by blanks and tab characters as an argument and returns a list of strings.

functions.name: simSubProbeCapByName
functions.description: Displays net capacitance by name.

functions.name: simSubProbeCapByScreen
functions.description: Displays all the net capacitance on the current screen.

functions.name: simVertToHoriz
functions.description: Reads in the inputFileName file, converts names in vertical table headers to horizontal, and copies the rest of the file.

functions.name: simViewFileWithArgs
functions.syntax: simViewFileWithArgs(  t_fileName l_windowSize [ t_windowTitle ] )  => winID / nil
functions.description: Calls the view function with the file name as the first argument and the window size as the second argument. The view function creates a viewFile window where the file text is displayed with the banner as the value supplied through the optional windowTitle argument.

functions.name: simWaveOpen
functions.description: Invokes a form displaying the current simulation run directory name, and prompts you for the name of the waveform file to display. The default waveform file is raw/waves in the simulation run directory. When the file name is specified, a new window is opened, displaying the waveform information.

functions.name: simin
functions.description: Translates the user-assigned names for nets and instances in the control file to the corresponding netlister-assigned names and creates the si.inp file for input to the simulator. A message is printed stating that simin is being run, and then the simInWithArgs function is called with the correct arguments to do the translation.

functions.name: simout
functions.description: Translates the netlister-assigned names for nets and instances in the simout.tmp file to the corresponding user-assigned names and produces the si.out file. The simout.tmp file is normally the simulator text output. A message is printed stating that simout is being run, and then the simOutWithArgs function is called with the correct arguments to do the translation.

functions.name: vhdlHiImport
functions.description: Builds and displays the VHDL Import form.

functions.name: vhdlHiInvokeToolBox
functions.description: Invokes the VHDL Toolbox window.

functions.name: vhdlImport
functions.syntax: vhdlImport( t_libName l_srcFiles t_logName l_params [ g_runInBackground ] [ g_displayResults ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs vhdlin to import a list of VHDL source files into the specified library with the given parameters. The parameters are the names of the vhdlin parameters, passed in as a disembodied property list. Optionally, it can run vhdlin as a background process and display the results interactively.

functions.name: vhdlPinListToVHDL
functions.syntax: vhdlPinListToVHDL( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName l_pinList ) => t / nil
functions.description: Allows the generation of VHDL views from an intermediate pin list format.

functions.name: vhdlRegisterSimulator
functions.syntax: vhdlRegisterSimulator( [ t_parserCallBack ] [ t_analyzerCallBack ] [ t_analyzerFileExt ] [ t_elaboratorCallBack ]  [ t_simulatorCallBack ] [ t_dataDirCallBack ] [ t_dataFileCallBack ] [ t_workLibCallBack ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you  use non-Cadence VHDL tools by defining your own SKILL procedures and registering this information with the toolbox..

functions.name: vhdlToPinList
functions.syntax: vhdlToPinList( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName )  => list / nil
functions.description: Translates a VHDL cellview into an intermediate pin list format.

functions.name: vhmsCompilationFailure
functions.syntax: vhmsCompilationFailure( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileName ) => l_list / nil
functions.description: Informs about the compilation failures of the file specified with the fileName parameter. A compilation error message is displayed and you can open the file for editing by clicking 'Yes'.

functions.name: vhmsDefaultEdit
functions.syntax: vhmsDefaultEdit( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileObj t_mode [ t_errFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Opens an existing file or creates a template and opens it in an editor. If the mode is set to r, which indicates read-only then it tries to open an existing file.

functions.name: vhmsGetCellParameters
functions.description: Returns the CDF parameters of the vhdl generics. The sub-list returned contains the name of the generic, the default value, and the type.

functions.name: vhmsPinListToVHDLAMS
functions.syntax: vhmsPinListToVHDLAMS( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName l_pinList ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a vhdlams entity, package, body, configuration, or architecture depending on the view name. Specify the view name as entity, package, body, or configuration for creating an entity, package, body, or configuration respectively. If nothing is specified, an architecture view is created. The view is created in ./libName/cellName/viewName.

functions.name: vhmsSaveFile
functions.syntax: vhmsSaveFile( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileName ) => l_list / nil
functions.description: Compiles the vhms file. If the symbol does not exist, it displays a prompt to create the symbol. If the compilation fails, it calls the vhmsCompilationFailure function.

functions.name: vhmsSymbolToPinListGen
functions.syntax: vhmsSymbolToPinListGen( t_libName t_cellName [ t_viewName ] ) => l_pinList / nil
functions.description: Generates a pin list from the symbol.

functions.name: vhmsToPinList
functions.syntax: vhmsToPinList( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => l_list / nil
functions.description: Translates a VHDLAMS cellview into an intermediate pin list format. The pin list represents all the ports to the VHDLAMS description and their directions, such as input, output, and inout.

functions.name: vhmsUpdateCellCDFParams
functions.description: Updates the CDF parameters by reading all the parameters from the pin list. The CDF is updated if a given parameter does not exist in the CDF.

functions.name: vicOpenVlogCallBack
functions.description: Opens the Verilog Integration form.This function is a CIW menu callback function and is called when the Verilog integration environment is invoked.

functions.name: vlVicCrossSelectionForm
functions.description: Opens the Cross Selection Setup form. This form is used to cross-select objects of a design between SimVision and Virtuoso Schematic Editor during interactive simulation.

functions.name: vlVicPSForm
functions.description: Opens the Post Simulation Analysis form. This form is used to cross-select objects of a design between SimVision and Virtuoso Schematic Editor during post-simulation analysis.

functions.name: vlogifCrossSelectionCB
functions.description: Controls the cross-selection between SimVision and Virtuoso Schematic Editor when performing interactive simulation.

functions.name: vosHiDisplayNetlist
functions.description: Displays the generated VHDL netlist. This function can be used only when a single netlist is generated for the complete design.

functions.name: vosLaunchIrunSimulation
functions.description: Launches the xrun simulator from the command line. If the vhdlSimNetlistandSimulate variable is set to t, the function netlists the design before launching the xrun simulator. Otherwise, it launches the simulator without netlisting the design.

functions.name: ac
functions.syntax: ac( g_fromValue g_toValue g_ptsPerDec )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Specifies an AC analysis.

functions.name: add1
functions.description: Adds 1 to a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: addSubwindow
functions.description: Adds a subwindow to the current Waveform window and returns the number for the new subwindow, which is found in the upper right corner.

functions.name: addSubwindowTitle
functions.description: Adds a title to the current subwindow in the active window. The current subwindow is defined using the currentSubwindow command.

functions.name: addTitle
functions.description: Adds a title to the current active OCEAN window. The current window is defined using the currentWindow command.

functions.name: addWaveLabel
functions.syntax: addWaveLabel(  x_waveIndex  l_location  t_label  [ ?textOffset g_textOffset ]  [ ?color x_color ] [ ?justify t_justify ]  [ ?fontStyle t_fontStyle ]  [ ?height x_height ]  [ ?orient t_orient ] [ ?drafting g_drafting ]  [ ?overBar g_overbar ])  => s_labelId / nil
functions.description: Attaches a label to the specified waveform curve in the current subwindow.

functions.name: addWindowLabel
functions.description: Displays a label in the current subwindow. The location for the label is specified with a list of two numbers between 0 and 1.

functions.name: analysis
functions.syntax: analysis( s_analysisType  [ ?analysisOption1 g_analysisOptionValue1 ]... [ ?analysisOptionN g_analysisOptionValueN ] )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Specifies the analysis to be simulated.

functions.name: appendPath
functions.description: Appends a new path to the end of the search path list. You can append as many paths as you want with this command.

functions.name: awvRefreshOutputPlotWindows
functions.description: Refreshes all existing plot windows (with new simulation data, if any) attached with the session s_session.

functions.name: cPwrContour
functions.syntax: cPwrContour(  o_iwave  o_vwave  x_harm  [ ?iwaveLoad o_iwaveLoad ]  [ ?vwaveLoad o_vwaveLoad ]  [ ?maxPower f_maxPower ]  [ ?minPower f_minPower ]  [ ?numCont x_numCont ] [ ?refImp f_refImp ] [ ?closeCont g_closeCont ]  [ ?modifier s_modifier ] [ ?ifam ifam ] [ ?vfam vfam ] )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Constructs constant power contours for Z-Smith plotting. The trace of each contour correlates to reference reflection coefficients that all result in the same power level.

functions.name: cReflContour
functions.syntax: cReflContour(  o_iwave  o_vwave  x_harm  [ ?iwaveLoad o_iwaveLoad ]  [ ?vwaveLoad o_vwaveLoad ]  [ ?maxRefl f_maxRefl ]  [ ?minRefl f_minRefl ]  [ ?numCont x_numCont ]  [ ?refImp f_refImp ]  [ ?closeCont g_closeCont ]  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Constructs constant reflection coefficient magnitude contours for Z-Smith plotting. The trace of each contour correlates to reference reflection coefficients that all result in the same reflection coefficient magnitude.

functions.name: case
functions.syntax: case(  g_selectionExpr l_clause1 [ l_clause2 ... ] )  => g_result / nil
functions.description: Evaluates the selection expression, matches the resulting selector values sequentially against comparators defined in clauses, and runs the expressions in the matching clause.

functions.name: clearAll
functions.description: Erases the contents of the current Waveform window and deletes the waveforms, title, date stamp, and labels stored in internal memory.

functions.name: clearSubwindow
functions.description: Erases the contents of the current subwindow.

functions.name: clipX
functions.description: Restricts the waveform to the range defined by n_from and n_to.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Drains, closes, and frees a port.

functions.name: closeResults
functions.description: Closes the simulation results stored in the input results directory. The function closes all the internal resources opened by the tool that are related to the results directory. It is recommended that you must call this function before deleting a results directory, moving the directory to any other location, or renaming a results directory.

functions.name: complex
functions.description: Creates a complex number of which the real part is equal to the real argument, and the imaginary part is equal to the imaginary argument.

functions.name: complexp
functions.description: Checks if an object is a complex number. The suffix p is added to the name of a function to indicate that it is a predicate function.

functions.name: compressionVRICurves
functions.syntax: compressionVRICurves(  o_vport  x_harm  [ ?iport o_iport ]  [ ?rport f_rport ]  [ ?epoint f_epoint ] [ ?gcomp f_gcomp ]  [ ?format format ] )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Constructs the waveforms associated with an nth compression measurement.

functions.name: cond
functions.description: Examines conditional clauses from left to right until either a clause is satisfied or there are no more clauses remaining.

functions.name: connectRules
functions.syntax: connectRules( t_ruleName [ ?lib t_libName ]  [ ?view t_viewName ]  [ ?baseRule t_baseRule ] [ ?moduleInfo l_moduleInfo ]  [ ?resolutionInfo l_resolutionInfo ]  [ ?commonParam l_commonParam ] [ ?userDefined s_userDefined ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets connect rules for a given AMS OCEAN session required by the elaborator. To specify multiple connect rules, use this command multiple times. To add a connect rule to an OCEAN session, you can either choose a built-in rule from the connectLib library (by specifying t_ruleName, t_libName and t_viewName) or one of your own compiled built-in connect rules (by specifying t_ruleName, t_libName and t_viewName). To add a user defined connect rule to an OCEAN session specify s_userDefined. To modify an existing built-in rule, you need to specify t_baseRule (the name of the built-in rule that needs be modified), specify a new name (by specifying t_ruleName, t_libName and t_viewName) and also specify one or more of the optional arguments.

functions.name: converge
functions.syntax: converge(  s_convName t_netName1 f_value1 ... [ t_netNameN f_valueN ] )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets convergence criteria on nets.

functions.name: createFinalNetlist
functions.description: Creates the final netlist for viewing purposes. The netlist also can be saved but is not required to run the simulator.

functions.name: createNetlist
functions.description: Creates the simulator input file.

functions.name: currentSubwindow
functions.description: Sets x_subwindow as the current subwindow.

functions.name: currentWindow
functions.description: Specifies w_windowId as the current Waveform window.

functions.name: dataTypes
functions.description: Returns the list of data types that are used in an analysis previously specified with selectResult.

functions.name: db10
functions.syntax: db10( { o_waveform | n_number } )  => o_waveform / n_number / nil
functions.description: Returns 10 times the log10 of the specified waveform object or number. This function can also be written as dB10.

functions.name: db20
functions.description: Returns 20 times the log10 of the specified waveform object or number. This function can also be written as dB20.

functions.name: dbCompressionPlot
functions.syntax: dbCompressionPlot( o_wave  x_harmonic x_extrapolationPoint  [ ?compression x_compression ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Plots the nth compression point plot. The x_compression argument is optional and defaults to 1 for 1dB compression, if omitted.

functions.name: dbm
functions.syntax: dbm( { o_waveform | n_number } )  => o_waveform n_number / nil
functions.description: Returns 10 times the log10 of the specified waveform object plus 30. This function can also be written as dBm.

functions.name: dc
functions.syntax: dc(  t_compName  [ t_compParam ]  g_fromValue g_toValue g_byValue  )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Specifies a DC sweep analysis with limited options. If other analysis options are needed, use the analysis command.

functions.name: dcmatchSummary
functions.syntax: dcmatchSummary( [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] [ ?result S_resultName ]  [ ?output t_fileName | p_port ]  [ ?paramValues ln_paramValues ]  [ ?deviceType ls_deviceType ] [ ?variations ls_variations ]  [ ?includeInst lt_includeInst ]  [ ?excludeInst lt_excludeInst ]  [ ?truncateData n_truncateData ] [ ?truncateType s_truncateType ]  [ ?sortType ls_sortType ] )  => t_fileName / p_port/ nil
functions.description: Prints a report showing the mismatch contribution of each component in a circuit. If you specify a directory with resultsDir, it is equivalent to temporarily using the openResults command. The dcmatchSummary command prints the results for that directory and resets the openResults command to its previous setting. If you specify a particular result with resultName, it is equivalent to temporarily using the selectResult command on the specified results. The dcmatchSummary command prints the results and resets the selectResult command to its previous setting.

functions.name: definitionFile
functions.syntax: definitionFile(  t_fileName [ t_fileName2 ... t_fileNameN ] )  => l_fileNames / nil
functions.description: Specifies definitions files to be included in the simulator input file.

functions.name: delete
functions.syntax: delete(  s_command  [ g_commandArg1 ] [ g_commandArg2 ] ...  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes all the information specified.

functions.name: deleteJob
functions.syntax: deleteJob(  t_jobName  [ t_jobName2 t_jobName3 ... t_jobNameN ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Removes a job or series of jobs from the text-based job monitor.

functions.name: deleteOpPoint
functions.description: Deletes the specified operating point instance.

functions.name: deleteSubckt
functions.description: Deletes the specified subcircuit instance saved using the saveSubckt command.

functions.name: deleteSubwindow
functions.description: Deletes the current subwindow from the current Waveform window.

functions.name: deleteWaveform
functions.description: Deletes the specified waveform curve or all the waveform curves from the current subwindow of a Waveform window.

functions.name: deriv
functions.description: Computes the derivative of a waveform with respect to the X axis.

functions.name: desVar
functions.syntax: desVar(  t_desVar1 f_value1 ... [ t_desVarN f_valueN ] )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets the values of design variables used in your design. You can set the values for as many design variables as you want.

functions.name: design
functions.syntax: design(  t_cktFile | t_lib t_cell t_view [ t_mode ]  )  => t_cktFile / nil | (t_lib t_cell t_view) / nil
functions.description: Specifies the directory path to the netlist of a design or the name of a design to be simulated.

functions.name: digitalHostMode
functions.description: For mixed-signal simulation, specifies whether the digital simulator will run locally or on a remote host.

functions.name: digitalHostName
functions.description: For mixed-signal simulation, specifies the name of the remote host for the digital simulator.

functions.name: discipline
functions.description: Adds discrete disciplines to the existing set of disciplines for a given 'ams' OCEAN session. You can use delete('discipline) to delete one or more specified disciplines. You can use ocnDisplay('discipline) to view the currently active disciplines in an OCEAN session.

functions.name: displayMode
functions.description: Sets the display mode of the current subwindow.

functions.name: displayNetlist
functions.description: Displays the concatenated AMS complete design info file used in a given AMS OCEAN session. The concatenated file displays the netlisting of the cellviews used in the configuration along with the analog control file and the TCL file generated by AMS-ADE. This command is applicable for Spectre.

functions.name: displaySubckt
functions.description: Prints the subcircuit information to the output file.

functions.name: edgeTriggeredEyeDiagram
functions.syntax: edgeTriggeredEyeDiagram( o_waveform  n_start  n_stop  o_triggerWave  n_threshold  s_edgeType  n_triggerOffset  [ ?intensityPlot g_intensityPlot ] )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Desription

functions.name: envOption
functions.syntax: envOption(  s_envOption1 g_value1 ... [ s_envOptionN g_valueN ]  )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets environment options.

functions.name: evcdFile
functions.description: Sets an EVCD file for a given UltraSim OCEAN session. You also need to specify an EVCD info file while using this command. You can specify only one EVCD file for a session. You may use ocnDisplay('evcdFile) to view the currently active EVCD file.

functions.name: evcdInfoFile
functions.description: Sets a EVCD info file for a given UltraSim OCEAN session. You also need to specify an EVCD file while using this command. You can specify only one EVCD info file for a session. You may use ocnDisplay('evcdInfoFile) to view the currently active EVCD info file.

functions.name: eyeMeasurement
functions.syntax: eyeMeasurement( o_waveform [ ?sample n_sample ] [ ?auto g_auto ] [ ?horizThreshold n_horizThreshold ] [ ?sample n_sample ] [ ?xTypePercent0 g_xTypePercent0 ] [ ?startx0 n_startx0 ]  [ ?starty0 n_starty0 ] [ ?yTypePercent0 g_yTypePercent0 ] [ ?endx0 n_endx0 ] [ ?endy0 n_endy0 ] [ ?xTypePercent1 g_xTypePercent1 ] [ ?startx1 n_startx1 ] [ ?starty1 n_starty1 ] [ ?yTypePercent1 g_yTypePercent1 ] [ ?endx1 n_endx1 ] [ ?endy1 n_endy1 ] [ ?noOfBins n_noOfBins ] [ ?measure t_measure ] )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Evaluates the measurements for the eye diagram plot.

functions.name: for
functions.syntax: for( s_loopVar  x_initialValue  x_finalValue  g_expr1  [ g_expr2 ... ]  )  => t
functions.description: Evaluates the sequence g_expr1 g_expr2 ... for each loop variable value, beginning with x_initialValue and ending with x_finalValue.

functions.name: forcenode
functions.syntax: forcenode(  t_netName1 f_value1 ... [ t_netNameN f_valueN ]  )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Holds a node at a specified value.

functions.name: foreach
functions.syntax: foreach(  s_formalVar  g_exprList  g_expr1 [ g_expr2 ... ] )  => l_valueList
functions.description: Evaluates one or more expressions for each element of a list of values.

functions.name: fscanf
functions.syntax: fscanf(  p_inputPort t_formatString  [ s_var1 ... ]   )  => x_items / nil
functions.description: Reads input from a port according to format specifications and returns the number of items read in.

functions.name: gac
functions.syntax: gac(  o_s11  o_s12  o_s21  o_s22 g_level g_frequency  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the available gain circles.

functions.name: getResult
functions.description: Gets the data object for a specified analysis without overriding the status of any previously executed selectResult() or openResults() commands.

functions.name: gets
functions.description: Reads a line from the input port and stores the line as a string in the variable. This is a macro.

functions.name: globalSigAlias
functions.description: Removes all the previous signal aliases and creates the specified aliases. The signal names in each of the signal lists are marked as aliases of each other. Each of the signal lists is a set of signal names that are to be aliased. The signal names should match the names that were specified using the globalSignal command. To unalias all signal, pecify nil instead of signal lists.

functions.name: globalSignal
functions.syntax: globalSignal(  [ ?name t_signalName ]  [ ?lang t_langName ]  [ ?wireType t_wireType ]  [ ?discipline t_discipline ] [ ?ground t_ground ] @Rest args )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds or modifies a global signal for a given AMS OCEAN session needed by the elaborator. If the global signal already exists in the session, the values are updated. If it does not exist, a global signal with the specified name is added. In case of a vector signal, the range information can be appended with the name of the signal.

functions.name: gpc
functions.syntax: gpc(  o_s11  o_s12 o_s21 o_s22  g_level  g_frequency )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the power gain circles.

functions.name: graphicsOff
functions.description: Disables the redrawing of the current Waveform window.

functions.name: graphicsOn
functions.description: Enables the redrawing of the current Waveform window.

functions.name: hardCopy
functions.description: Sends a Waveform window plot to a printer or a file. To plot to a printer specify a printer name using the ?hcPrinterName argument of the hardCopyOptions command. To plot to a file, specify a file name using the ?hcOutputFile argument of the hardCopyOptions command.

functions.name: hardCopyOptions
functions.syntax: hardCopyOptions(  [ ?hcCopyNum x_hcCopyNum ] [ ?hcOffsetHeight x_hcOffsetHeight ]  [ ?hcOffsetWidth x_hcOffsetWidth ] [ ?hcOrientation s_hcOrientation ] [ ?hcOutputFile g_hcOutputFile ] [ ?hcPrinterName s_hcPrinterName ]  [ ?hcTmpDir t_hcTmpDir ] [ ?hcPaperSize s_hcPaperSize ] [ ?hcMakeExactCopy g_hcMakeExactCopy ] [ ?hcQuality x_hcQuality ] [ ?hcOptimizeForWindows g_hcOptimizeForWindows ] [ ?hcImageWidth x_hcImageWidth ] [ ?hcImageHeight x_hcImageHeight ] [ ?hcImageSizeUnits s_hcImageSizeUnits ] [ ?hcImageResolution x_ImageResolution ] [ ?hcResolutionUnits s_hcResolutionUnits ] [ ?hcImageAspectRatio x_hcImageAspectRatio ] [ ?hcUseExistingBackground g_hcUseExistingBackground ] [ ?hcDisplayTitle g_hcDisplayTitle ] [ ?hcDisplayLegend g_hcDisplayLegend ] [ ?hcDisplayAxes g_hcDisplayAxes ] [ ?hcDisplayGrids g_hcDisplayGrids ] [ ?hcSaveEachSubwindowSeparately g_hcSaveEachSubwindowSeparately ] ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the graph window hardcopy plotting options.

functions.name: harmonicFreqList
functions.description: Returns a list of lists, with each sublist containing a harmonic index and the minimum and maximum frequency values that the particular harmonic ranges between.

functions.name: harmonicList
functions.description: Returns the list of harmonic indices available in the resultName or current result data.

functions.name: histo
functions.syntax: histo(  o_waveform  x_bins  n_min  n_max  ) => o_histoWaveform / nil
functions.description: Returns a waveform that represents the statistical distribution of input data in the form of a histogram. The height of the bars (or bins) in the histogram represents the frequency of the occurrence of values within a specific period. Using the histo function, the range for capturing these frequencies can be specified through the n_min and n_max values.

functions.name: history
functions.description: Displays the command history. By default, it the last twenty commands are listed from the current session and the most recently terminated session. More commands can be printed by giving a number as an argument.

functions.name: hlcheck
functions.description: Sets or gets the value of the hlcheck option used in the vec_include statement in a netlist. You may use the ocnDisplay('hlcheck) command to view the current value of hlcheck in an OCEAN session associated with vector files.

functions.name: hostMode
functions.description: Sets the simulation host mode.

functions.name: hostName
functions.description: Specifies the name of the remote host.

functions.name: ic
functions.syntax: ic(  t_netName1 f_value1 ... [ t_netNameN f_valueN ]  )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets initial conditions on nets in a transient analysis.

functions.name: if
functions.syntax: if( g_condition  g_thenExpression  [ g_elseExpression ]  )  => g_result if(  g_condition  then g_thenExpr1 ...  [ else g_elseExpr1 ... ]  )  => g_result
functions.description: Evaluates g_condition, typically a relational expression, and runs g_thenExpression if the condition is true (that is, its value is non-nil); otherwise, runs g_elseExpression.

functions.name: iim
functions.description: Aliased to imag(i()). Gets the imaginary part of a complex number representing the AC current through a component.

functions.name: im
functions.description: Aliased to mag(i()). Gets the magnitude of the AC current through a component.

functions.name: includeFile
functions.description: Includes the specified file in the final netlist of the simulator for the current session.

functions.name: infile
functions.description: Opens an input port ready to read a file.

functions.name: ip
functions.description: Aliased to phase(i()). Gets the phase of the AC current through a component.

functions.name: ip3Plot
functions.syntax: ip3Plot(  o_wave x_sigHarmonic x_refHarmonic  x_extrapolationPoint  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Plots the IP3 curves.

functions.name: ipnVRICurves
functions.syntax: ipnVRICurves(  o_vport  x_harmspur  x_harmref  [ ?iport o_iport ] [ ?rport f_rport ] [ ?ordspur f_ordspur ] [ ?epoint f_epoint ] [ ?psweep g_psweep ] [ ?epref f_epref ] [ ?ordref f_ordref ] [ ?displayLabels g_displayLabels ] )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Constructs the waveforms associated with an ipn measurement.

functions.name: ir
functions.description: Aliased to real(i()). Gets the real part of a complex number representing the AC current through a component.

functions.name: killJob
functions.syntax: killJob(  t_jobName [ t_jobName2 t_jobName3 ... t_jobNameN ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Stops processing of a job or a series of jobs.

functions.name: linRg
functions.syntax: linRg( n_from n_to n_by  )  => l_range / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of numbers in the linear range from n_from to n_to incremented by n_by.

functions.name: load
functions.description: Opens a file and repeatedly calls lineread to read in the file, immediately evaluating each form after it is read in.

functions.name: log
functions.description: Returns the natural logarithm of a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: logRg
functions.syntax: logRg( n_from n_to n_by  )  => l_range / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of numbers in the log10 range from n_from to n_to advanced by n_by.

functions.name: lsb
functions.syntax: lsb(  o_s11  o_s12 o_s21  o_s22  g_frequency  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the load stability circles.

functions.name: max
functions.description: Returns the maximum of the values passed in. Requires a minimum of two arguments.

functions.name: min
functions.description: Returns the minimum of the values passed in. Requires a minimum of two arguments.

functions.name: mod
functions.description: Returns the integer remainder of dividing two integers. The remainder is either zero or has the sign of the dividend.

functions.name: modelFile
functions.description: Specifies model files to be included in the simulator input file.

functions.name: monitor
functions.description: Monitors the jobs submitted to the distributed system.

functions.name: nc
functions.syntax: nc(  o_Fmin  o_Gmin o_rn  g_level  g_frequency  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the noise circles.

functions.name: newWindow
functions.description: Creates a new Waveform window and returns the window ID.

functions.name: newline
functions.description: Prints a newline (backslash n) character and then flushes the output port.

functions.name: nodeset
functions.syntax: nodeset(  t_netName1 f_value1 ... [ t_netNameN f_valueN ] )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets the initial estimate for nets in a DC analysis, or sets the initial condition calculation for a transient analysis.

functions.name: noise
functions.description: Specifies a noise analysis.

functions.description: Prints a report showing the noise contribution of each component in a circuit.

functions.name: ocnAmsSetUNLNetlister
functions.description: Sets the netlister mode to AMS Unified Netlister for a given ams OCEAN session.

functions.name: ocnCloseSession
functions.description: Closes the current OCEAN session without saving any settings made during the session. The command has no effect if no session is currently active.

functions.name: ocnDisplay
functions.syntax: ocnDisplay( [ ?output t_filename | p_port ]  s_command [ g_commandArg1 ] [ g_commandArg2 ] ...  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Displays all the information specified.

functions.name: ocnDspfFile
functions.syntax: ocnDspfFile(  t_dspfFile [ t_dspfFile1 ... t_dspfFileN ]  )  => t_dspfFile(s) / nil
functions.description: Sets the parasitic (dspf, spf) files to be used in a Spectre OCEAN session. You can use this command to specify a list of parasitic files to be included in the control file. You can use ocnDisplay('dspfFile) to view the currently active parasitic (dspf, spf) files in an OCEAN session.

functions.name: ocnGenNoiseSummary
functions.syntax: ocnGenNoiseSummary( x_hierLevel s_resultName t_resultsDir ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a noise summary report at the end of a simulation run. This report contains a summary of noise contribution of each component for the specified hierarchy level.

functions.name: ocnGetAdjustedPath
functions.syntax: ocnGetAdjustedPath(  t_libName t_cellName  t_viewName  t_netName )  => t_adjustedPath / nil
functions.description: Reduces the given hierarchical net path to the shortest hierarchical name that is equivalent to this net.

functions.name: ocnGetInstancesModelName
functions.description: This function returns the model name used by the instance in opened simulation results.

functions.name: ocnHelp
functions.syntax: ocnHelp(  [ ?output t_filename | p_port ] [ s_command ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Provides online help for the specified command.

functions.description: Prints the text data of the waveforms specified in the list of waveforms.

functions.name: ocnPrintTMIReliabilityResults
functions.syntax: ocnPrintTMIReliabilityResults( t_psfdir  [ ?resultType t_resultType ] [ ?threshold t_threshold ] [ ?exportFile t_exportFilePath ] [ ?sortRule  t_sortRule ] ) t / nil
functions.description: Prints simulation results for reliability analysis run in the OCEAN mode.

functions.name: ocnPrintTMIResultTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of valid result types.

functions.name: ocnPspiceFile
functions.syntax: ocnPspiceFile(  t_PSpiceFile [ t_PSpiceFile1 ... t_PSpiceFileN ] )  => t_PSpiceFile(s) / nil
functions.description: Sets the PSpice files to be used in  a Spectre OCEAN session. Use this command to specify a list of PSpice files to be included in the control file.

functions.name: ocnResetResults
functions.description: Unsets the results opened by the openResults command. Use this command to return to the state that existed prior to using the openResults command.

functions.name: ocnSetAttrib
functions.syntax: ocnSetAttrib(  [ ?XAxisLabel xLabel ]  [ ?YAxisLabel yLabel ]  [ ?XScale xscale ]  [ ?YScale yscale ]  [ ?XLimit xlimit ]  [ ?YLimit ylimit ] [ ?YRange yrange ] [ ?Origin origin ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the waveform window plotting attributes.

functions.name: ocnSetSilentMode
functions.description: Filters out OCEAN warning and information messages and allows only error messages to be written. This functionality is useful while running the OCEAN scripts when you might want to skip all OCEAN messages except errors.

functions.name: ocnSpefFile
functions.syntax: ocnSpefFile(  t_SpefFile [ t_SpefFile1 ... t_SpefFileN ] )  => t_SpecFile(s) / nil
functions.description: Sets the parasitic (spef) files to be used in a Spectre OCEAN session. You can use this command to specify a list of parasitic files to be included in the control file. You can use ocnDisplay('SpefFile) to view the currently active parasitic (spef) files in an OCEAN session.

functions.name: ocnWriteLsspToFile
functions.syntax: ocnWriteLsspToFile( filename t_filename net1 input_node_name  term1 input_src_terminal net2 output_node_name term2 output_src_terminal [ ?format t_format ] [ ?datafmt t_data_format ] [ ?port1 port1_name ] [ ?port2 port2_name ] [ ?result1 result1_name ] [ ?result2 result2_name ] ) => nil
functions.description: Writes the large signal S-Parameter results to a file in Touchstone or Spectre format.

functions.name: ocnYvsYplot
functions.syntax: ocnYvsYplot( [ ?wavex o_wavex ?wavey o_wavey ] [ ?exprx o_exprx ?expry o_expry ] [ ?titleList l_titleList ] [ ?colorList l_colorList ] )  => wave / nil
functions.description: Plots a wave against another wave or an expression against another expression.

functions.name: off
functions.syntax: off(  s_command [ g_commandArg1 ] [ g_commandArg2 ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Turns off the specified information.

functions.name: openResults
functions.syntax: openResults(  s_jobName | t_dirName  [ g_enableCalcExpressions ]  )  => t_dirName / nil
functions.description: Opens simulation results stored in PSF files or opens the results from a specified job, depending on which parameter is called.

functions.name: option
functions.syntax: option(  [ ?categ s_categ ] s_option1 g_value1 [ s_option2 g_value2 ] ... )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Specifies the values for built-in simulator options. You can specify values for as many options as you want.

functions.name: outfile
functions.description: Opens an output port ready to write to a file.

functions.name: outputParams
functions.syntax: outputParams( t_compType  [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ]  ) => l_outputParams / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of output parameters for the specified component.

functions.name: outputs
functions.syntax: outputs( [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ]  [ ?type t_signalType ] )  => l_outputs / nil
functions.description: Returns the names of the outputs whose results are stored for an analysis. You can plot these outputs or use them in calculations.

functions.name: paramAnalysis
functions.syntax: paramAnalysis( t_desVar  [ ?start n_start ]  [ ?stop n_stop ]  [ ?center n_center ]  [ ?span n_span ]  [ ?step f_step ]  [ ?lin n_lin ]  [ ?log n_log ]   [ ?dec n_dec ]  [ ?oct n_oct ]  [ ?times n_times ]  [ ?spanPercent n_spanPercent ]  [ ?sweepType t_sweepType ] [ ?values l_values ]  [ o_paramAnalysis ] )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets up a parametric analysis.

functions.name: paramRun
functions.description: Runs the specified parametric analysis.

functions.name: path
functions.description: Sets the search path for included files.

functions.name: pfile
functions.description: Opens an output port ready to write to a file or returns the name of an existing port indicating that it is available.

functions.name: phaseDegUnwrappedWithFreq
functions.description: Calculates the unwrapped phase in degrees of a waveform and returns a waveform with the specified start frequency, the phase of which remains in the range of -180 to 180 degrees.

functions.name: plot
functions.syntax: plot( o_waveform1 [ o_waveform2 ... ]  [ ?expr l_exprList ] [ ?strip x_stripNumber ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Plots waveforms in the current subwindow. If there is no Virtuoso Visualization and Analysis XL window, this command opens one.

functions.name: plotStyle
functions.description: Sets the plotting style for all the waveforms in the current subwindow.

functions.name: prependPath
functions.description: Adds a new path to the beginning of the search path list. You can add as many paths as you want with this command.

functions.name: printGraph
functions.syntax: printGraph(  [ ?window x_window ] [ ?printerName s_hcPrinterName ] [ ?horizontalMargin x_horizontalMargin ] [ ?verticalMargin x_verticalMargin ] [ ?numCopy x_numCopy ] [ ?paperSize x_paperSize ] [ ?orientation s_orientation ] [ ?fileName s_fileName ] [ ?tempDir s_tempDir ] [ ?matchWindow g_matchWindow ] [ ?numGraphsPerPage x_numGraphsPerPage ] [ ?printMarkerTable g_printMarkerTable ] [ ?markerTableLocation s_markerTableLocation ] [ ?enableHeader g_enableHeader ] [ ?enableFooter g_enableFooter ] [ ?headerLeftText s_headerLeftText ] [ ?headerCenterText s_headerCenterText ] [ ?headerRightText s_headerRightText ] [ ?footerLeftText s_footerLeftText ] [ ?footerCenterText s_footerCenterText ] [ ?footerRightText s_footerRightText ] [ ?printColor g_printColor ] [ ?doubleSidedPrint g_doubleSidedPrint ] [ ?duplexMode s_duplexMode ] [ ?pageOrder s_pageOrder ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the graph plotted in the specified window.

functions.name: printf
functions.description: Writes formatted output to poport, which is the standard output port.

functions.name: println
functions.description: Prints a SKILL object using the default format for the data type of the value, and then prints a newline character.

functions.name: pv
functions.syntax: pv(  t_name t_param  [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ]  )  => g_value / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified component parameter. You can use the outputParams command to get the list of parameters for a particular component.

functions.name: pzFrequencyAndRealFilter
functions.syntax: pzFrequencyAndRealFilter( o_wave  [ ?freqfilter f_fval ] [ ?realfilter f_rval] ) => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Returns a filtered Pole or Zero waveform from the pole zero simulation data. Filtering is done on the basis of given maximum frequency and minimum real value.

functions.name: pzPlot
functions.syntax: pzPlot(  [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ]  [ ?result S_resultName ]  [ ?plot S_toPlot ] [ ?freqfilter f_fval ]  [ ?realfilter f_rval ]) => t / nil
functions.description: Plots a report showing the poles and zeros of the network. If you specify a directory with resultsDir, the pzPlot command plots the results for that directory. The S_toPlot option can be used to plot only poles, only zeros or both poles and zeros information.

functions.name: pzSummary
functions.syntax: pzSummary(  [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ]  [ ?result S_resultName ]  [ ?print S_toPrint ]  [ ?freqfilter f_fval ]  [ ?realfilter f_rval ]  [ ?output t_output] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints a report with the poles and zeros of the network. If you specify a directory with resultsDir, the pzSummary command prints the results for that directory. Use the S_toPrint option to print only poles, only zeros or both poles and zeros information.

functions.name: random
functions.description: Returns a random integer between 0 and x_number minus 1.

functions.name: rapidIIPN
functions.syntax: rapidIIPN(  o_result [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] [ ?resistance n_resistance ] @Rest args  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Plots the input IPN curves.

functions.name: rapidIPNCurves
functions.syntax: rapidIPNCurves(  o_result [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] [ ?resistance n_resistance ] @Rest args )  => o_waveformReal / nil
functions.description: Plots IPN curves.

functions.name: remoteDir
functions.description: Specifies the project directory on the remote host to be used for remote simulation.

functions.name: removeLabel
functions.description: Removes the label, or all the labels identified in a list, from the current subwindow.

functions.name: report
functions.syntax: report( [ ?output t_filename | p_port ]  [ ?type t_type ] [ ?name t_name ]  [ ?param t_param ] [ ?format s_reportStyle ] [ ?report s_reportStyle ] [ ?maxLineWidth charsPerLine ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints a report of the information contained in an analysis previously specified with selectResult.

functions.name: restore
functions.description: Tells the simulator to restore the state previously saved to a file with a store command.

functions.name: resultParam
functions.syntax: resultParam(  S_propertyName  [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ]  )  => L_value / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of a header property from the selected result data.

functions.name: results
functions.description: Returns a list of the type of results that can be selected.

functions.name: resultsDir
functions.description: Specifies the directory where the PSF files (results) are stored.

functions.name: resumeJob
functions.syntax: resumeJob( t_jobName [ t_jobName2 t_jobName3 ... t_jobNameN ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Resumes the processing of a previously suspended job or series of jobs. The resumeJob command applies only to jobs that are suspended.

functions.name: riseTime
functions.syntax: riseTime( o_waveform  n_initVal g_initType  n_finalVal  g_finalType n_theta1 n_theta2  [ g_multiple [ s_Xname ] [ g_histoDisplay ] [ x_noOfHistoBins ] ] )  => o_waveform / n_value / nil
functions.description: Returns the rise time measured between theta1 (percent low) to theta2 (percent high) of the difference between the initial value and the final value.

functions.name: rmsTerminalVoltage
functions.description: Calculates the root-mean-square voltage between two terminals for fast and regular envlp analysis.

functions.name: rmsVoltage
functions.description: Calculates the root-mean-square voltage between two nets for fast and regular envelop analysis.

functions.name: round
functions.description: Rounds a floating-point number to its closest integer value.

functions.name: run
functions.description: Starts the simulation or specifies a time after which an analysis should start. If distributed processing is not available on the system or is not enabled, the arguments specific to distributed processing (see Arguments section below for list of arguments specific to distributed processing) are ignored and the simulation runs locally. If distributed processing is available and is enabled, the environment default values are used if not specified in the run command arguments. The environmental default values are stored in the .cdsenv file.

functions.name: save
functions.syntax: save( [ ?categ s_categ ] s_saveType  [ t_saveName1 ] ... [ t_saveNameN ]  )  => undefined / nil
functions.description: Specifies the outputs to be saved and printed during simulation.

functions.name: saveGraphImage
functions.syntax: saveGraphImage(  [ ?window x_window ] [ ?fileName x_fileName ] [ ?exactCopy g_exactCopy ] [ ?quality x_quality ] [ ?msOptimize g_msOptimize ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?height x_height ] [ ?units s_units ] [ ?resolution x_resolution ] [ ?resolutionUnits s_resolutionUnits ] [ ?aspectRatio g_aspectRatio ] [ ?enableTitle g_enableTitle ] [ ?enableLegend g_enableLegend ] [ ?enableAxes g_enableAxes ] [ ?enableGrids g_enableGrids ] [ ?backgroundColor s_backgroundColor ] [ ?saveAllSubwindows g_saveAllSubwindows ] [ ?saveEachSubwindowSeparately g_saveEachSubwindowSeparately ] ) => x_fileName / nil
functions.description: Saves the graph as an image.

functions.name: saveOpPoint
functions.description: Specifies the operating point parameters to be saved for a given instance.

functions.name: saveOption
functions.syntax: saveOption( [ s_option1 g_optionValue1 ]...[ s_optionN g_optionValueN ] ) => undefined / nil
functions.description: Specifies save options to be used by the simulator.

functions.name: saveSubckt
functions.syntax: saveSubckt( t_name [ ?voltage g_voltage ] [ ?current g_current ] [ ?power g_power ]  [ ?vDepth s_vDepth ] [ ?iDepth s_iDepth ] [ ?pwrDepth s_pwrDepth ] [ ?compress g_compress ] [ ?filterRC g_filterRC ] [ ?ports g_ports ] [ ?userOptions g_userOptions ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves and modifies the specified subcircuit instances and signals.

functions.name: selectResult
functions.description: Selects the results from a particular analysis whose data you want to examine.

functions.name: setup
functions.syntax: setup( [ ?numberNotation s_numberNotation ] [ ?precision x_precision ] [ ?reportStyle s_reportStyle ] [ ?charsPerLine x_charsPerLine ]  [ ?messageOn g_messageOn ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies default values for parameters.

functions.name: simulator
functions.description: Starts an OCEAN session and sets the simulator name for that session. The previous session (if any) is closed and all session information is cleared.

functions.name: smithType
functions.description: Sets the Smith display mode type for the active graph.

functions.name: solver
functions.description: Sets a solver for a given AMS OCEAN session. The valid values for solver are Spectre and UltraSim. You select Spectre if you want to use an accurate AMS-Spectre analog engine. You select UltraSim if you want to use the AMS-Ultrasim or FastSPICE(UltraSim) solver for a given AMS simulation.

functions.name: sp
functions.syntax: sp(  x_iIndex  x_jIndex  [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ] )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Returns S-parameters for N port networks.

functions.name: sprobeData
functions.syntax: sprobeData(  t_ana  t_sprobeInst  [ ?type t_type ]  [ ?dataDir t_dataDir ]  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Returns the waveform for the specified analysis and parameter type of the given sprobe instance.

functions.name: sqrt
functions.description: Returns the square root of a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: srandom
functions.description: Sets the seed of the random number generator to a given number.

functions.name: ssb
functions.syntax: ssb(  o_s11  o_s12 o_s21 o_s22 g_frequency )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the source stability circles.

functions.name: stimulusFile
functions.syntax: stimulusFile( t_fileName [ t_fileName2 ... t_fileNameN ] [ ?xlate g_xlate ] )  => l_fileNames / nil
functions.description: Specifies stimulus files to be used by the simulator.

functions.name: store
functions.description: Requests that the simulator store its node voltages to a file.

functions.name: sub1
functions.description: Subtracts 1 from a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: suspendJob
functions.syntax: suspendJob( t_jobName [ t_jobName2 t_jobName3 ... t_jobNameN ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Suspends the processing of a job or series of jobs. The suspendJob command applies only to jobs that are pending or running.

functions.name: sweepNames
functions.syntax: sweepNames(  [ o_waveForm ]  [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ] )  => l_sweepName / nil
functions.description: Returns the names of all the sweep variables for either a supplied waveform, a currently selected result (via selectResult()) or a specified result.

functions.name: sweepValues
functions.description: Returns the list of sweep values of the outermost sweep variable of either the selected results or the supplied waveform. This command is particularly useful for parametric analyses.

functions.name: sweepVarValues
functions.syntax: sweepVarValues( [ t_varName ] [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ] ) => l_sweepName / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of sweep values for a particular swept variable name. This command is particularly useful for parametric analyses.

functions.name: temp
functions.description: Specifies the circuit temperature.

functions.name: thd_fd
functions.description: The thd_fd function returns the total harmonic distortion of the input waveform.

functions.name: tran
functions.syntax: tran(  g_fromValue g_toValue g_byValue )  => g_byValue / nil
functions.description: Specifies a transient analysis with limited options. If other analysis options are needed, use the analysis command.

functions.name: unless
functions.description: Evaluates a condition. If the result is true (non-nil), it returns nil; otherwise it evaluates the body expressions in sequence and returns the value of the last expression.

functions.name: vcdFile
functions.description: Sets a VCD file for a given AMS or UltraSim OCEAN session. You also need to specify a VCD info file while using this command. You can specify only one VCD file for a session. You may use ocnDisplay('vcdFile) to view the currently active VCD file.

functions.name: vcdInfoFile
functions.description: Sets a VCD info file for a given AMS or UltraSim OCEAN session when you have set UltraSim as the solver. You also need to specify a VCD file while using this command. You can specify only one VCD info file for a session. You may use ocnDisplay('vcdInfoFile) to view the currently active VCD info file.

functions.name: vdb
functions.description: Aliased to db20(v()). Gets the power gain in decibels from net in to net out.

functions.name: vecFile
functions.syntax: vecFile(  t_vecFile [ t_vecFile1 ... t_vecFileN ] )  => t_vecFile(s) / nil
functions.description: Sets the vector files to be used in an AMS or UltraSim OCEAN session. You use the vecFile command to specify a list of vector files which go to control file. You may use ocnDisplay('vecFile) to view the currently active vector files in an OCEAN session.

functions.name: vfreqterm
functions.syntax: vfreqterm(  s_ana  t_terminal [ freq x_freq ] ) => o_waveform | g_value | nil
functions.description: Returns the voltage of a terminal at a specified frequency or at all frequencies in the frequency domain.

functions.name: vhterm
functions.syntax: vhterm(  s_ana  t_terminal  [ harmonic x_hlist ] ) => o_waveform | g_value | nil
functions.description: Returns the voltage on a terminal at the specified harmonic or at all the harmonics in the frequency domain.

functions.name: vim
functions.description: Aliased to imag(v()). Gets the imaginary part of a complex number representing the voltage of a net.

functions.name: vm
functions.description: Aliased to mag(v()). Gets the magnitude of the voltage of a net.

functions.name: vp
functions.description: Aliased to phase(v()). Gets the phase of the voltage of a net.

functions.name: vr
functions.description: Aliased to real(v()). Gets the real part of a complex number representing the voltage of a net.

functions.name: vswr
functions.syntax: vswr( x_index  [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ]  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the voltage standing wave ratio.

functions.name: vtimeterm
functions.syntax: vtimeterm(  s_ana  t_terminal [ time n_time ] ) => o_waveform | g_value | nil
functions.description: Returns the voltage of a terminal at a specified time point or at all time points in the time domain.

functions.name: wait
functions.syntax: wait( [ ?queue t_queueName ]  jobName [ jobName2 jobName3 ... jobNameN ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Postpones processing of a script until the specified jobs complete. This command is ignored if distributed processing is not available.

functions.name: when
functions.description: Evaluates a condition.

functions.name: while
functions.description: Repeatedly evaluates g_condition and the sequence of expressions  g_expr1 ... if the condition is true.

functions.name: xLimit
functions.description: Sets the X axis display limits for the current subwindow. This command does not take effect if the display mode is set to smith.

functions.name: xor
functions.description: Returns the XOR value of the boolean inputs.

functions.name: yLimit
functions.description: Sets the Y axis display limits for the waveforms associated with a particular Y axis and strip in the current subwindow.

functions.name: zm
functions.syntax: zm( x_index  [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ]  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the port input impedance.

functions.name: zref
functions.syntax: zref(  x_portIndex [ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ] )  => f_impedance / nil
functions.description: Returns the reference impedance for an N-port network.

functions.name: ocnSetXLMode
functions.description: Sets the OCEAN mode to XL. In this mode, the simulation setup can contain multiple tests, corners, or advanced run modes, such as MonteCarlo. The OCEAN XL mode can be used to run simulations for ADE XL, ADE Explorer, or ADE Assembler. Accordingly, it checks out the required license. Once the mode is set to XL, it cannot be reverted.

functions.name: ocnxPutChecksAssertsTest
functions.syntax: ocnxPutChecksAssertsTest(  [ ?testName t_testName ]  [ ?netlist g_netlist ]  [ ?netlistScope g_netlistScope ]   ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the name of the test to which the checks and asserts defined in the Checks/Asserts assistant will be applicable and whether to netlist the checks and asserts for that test. In addition, it also specifies the scope for netlisting. By default, the checks and asserts are not applied to any test.

functions.name: ocnxlAddOrUpdateOutput
functions.description: Adds the specified scalar output to the simulation setup so that the results for the output can be viewed on the Results tab in ADE XL. If the specified output name already exists, only its value is updated with the specified value. This command must be used only in a pre-run script.

functions.name: ocnxlAddRelxScenariosSetup
functions.syntax: ocnxlAddRelxScenariosSetup( t_relxName t_freshTest t_stressTest t_agedTest [ ?freshTestEnabled t_freshTestEnabled ] [ ?stressTestEnabled t_stressTestEnabled ] [ ?agedTestEnabled t_agedTestEnabled ] [ ?scenariosList t_scenariosList ] [ ?relxOptions t_relxOptions ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new scenario setup in the reliability analysis setup.

functions.name: ocnxlAddRelxSetup
functions.syntax: ocnxlAddRelxSetup( t_relxSetupName t_freshTest t_stressTest t_agedTest [ ?stressVarList l_stressVarList ] [ ?agedVarList l_agedVarList ] [ ?freshTestEnabled t_freshTestEnabled ] [ ?stressTestEnabled t_stressTestEnabled ] [ ?agedTestEnabled t_agedTestEnabled ] [ ?stressFile t_stressFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new reliability analysis setup with the specified fresh, stress, and aged tests and any variables for which the values need to be overridden.

functions.name: ocnxlBeginTest
functions.description: This command indicates the beginning of the test specified by testName. Subsequent commands populate this test. The test specification ends when ocnxlEndTest() command is given.

functions.name: ocnxlConjugateGradientOptions
functions.syntax: ocnxlConjugateGradientOptions ( [ ?runFullEvaluation t_runFullEvaluation ] [ ?meetAllGoals t_meetAllGoals ] [ ?timeLimit t_timeLimit ] [ ?numPoints t_numPoints ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets options for conjugate gradient runs. This command works only in XL mode. See help on ocnSetXLMode().

functions.name: ocnxlCorner
functions.description: Lets you define a corner.cornerDetails is a list of elements where each element is (t_type t_varName t_value). Available types are variable, parameter, and model.

functions.name: ocnxlCornerVars
functions.description: Specifies a list of corner variables (along with their minimum, maximum, and reference values) to be used to run the Create Worst Care Corner simulation run mode.

functions.name: ocnxlDeleteNote
functions.description: Deletes a note from the given test, history, corner, or variable.

functions.name: ocnxlDisableCorner
functions.description: Lets you disable a corner. A disabled corner will not be run when the ocnxlRun() command is run. This command works only in XL mode. See help on ocnSetXLMode()

functions.name: ocnxlDisableCornerForTest
functions.description: Lets you disable a corner for a test.

functions.name: ocnxlDisableRelxScenariosSetup
functions.description: Disables the specified reliability scenario setup.

functions.name: ocnxlDisableRelxSetup
functions.description: Disables the specified reliability analysis setup.

functions.name: ocnxlDisableSweepParam
functions.description: Lets you disable a sweep parameter. A disabled parameter is not run when ocnxlRun() command is fired. See help on ocnxlRun().

functions.name: ocnxlDisableSweepVar
functions.description: Lets you disable a sweep variable. A disabled sweep is not run when ocnxlRun() command is fired. See help on ocnxlRun().

functions.name: ocnxlDisableTest
functions.description: Lets you disable a test. A disabled test will not be run when ocnxlRun() command is fired. See help on ocnxlRun().

functions.name: ocnxlEADAddMeasurement
