functions.name: asiNeedSuffixEvaluation
functions.description: Specify whether the interface needs suffix evaluation or not. When this method returns t, the numeric suffixes specified in a numericString field will be evaluated. For example, suppose the start frequency field for the AC analysis has a value of 10M, asiGetFormattedVal(ac_start_fieldObj ) returns 1e7 provided it is created as a `numericString field.

functions.name: asiNetlist
functions.description: Creates a design object and then a formatter object with nlCreateFormatter. After this, the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist. Netlist statistics are then printed. The netlister also provides a component count, as well as the addition of design variables found during netlisting.

functions.name: asiNetlistMixed
functions.description: This method performs mixed netlisting. It creates a formatter object with nlCreateFormatter, after which the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist.

functions.name: asiOpenOceanScript
functions.description: Opens the specified file for writing the OCEAN script. If the file exists, it asks for your permission to overwrite it.

functions.name: asiPartitionDesign
functions.description: This method partitions a mixed-signal design into analog and digital parts.

functions.name: asiPrepareDigitalSimulation
functions.description: Performs digital run directory clean up. It removes the file that stores the exit code for any previous digital simulation and cleans up the digital simulator old log file.

functions.name: asiQuitSimulator
functions.description: This function quits the simulator run process based on the ipc signal being sent to the specified process. By default, the direct integration code sends a hard-kill signal to the simulator process. To change this option and send a soft-kill signal, the ?mode option should be set to true and overloaded for yourSimulator session. This method is called by the environment, therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be re-defined for the interface. Use, callNextMethod in its definition.

functions.name: asiRawNetlist
functions.description: Creates a raw netlist.

functions.name: asiRegCallBackOnSimComp
functions.description: Registers the specified user-defined callback function to run after completion of a simulation. The callback function should accept two arguments, a session object and the simulation status.

functions.name: asiRegCallBackOnSimCompForDist
functions.description: Registers the specified user-defined callback function to run after completion of distributed jobs.

functions.name: asiRegisterTool
functions.syntax: asiRegisterTool( '<simulatorName> [ ?class			s_className ] [ ?private			s_private ] [ ?initFunc			s_initFunc ] [ ?mixedSig			s_mixedSig ] ) => t
functions.description: Registers your simulator and your initialization function.

functions.name: asiRemoveAllModelLibSelection
functions.description: Removes all the model files by setting the modelFiles variable to nil. In addition, it also invalidates the asiSendControlStmts flowchart step by calling asiInvalidateControlStmts.

functions.name: asiRunSimulation
functions.description: This function runs the simulation for the session. It is called by the environment, so you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be redefined for the interface. Use callNextMethod in this definition.

functions.name: asiSaveState
functions.syntax: asiSaveState(  o_session [ ?name t_name ] [ ?option s_option ] [ ?stateDir t_stateDir ] [ ?lib t_lib ] [ ?cell t_cell ] [ ?simulator t_simulator ] [ ?description t_description ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the current state of the current simulation environment directly from the CIW without displaying the Saving State form.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisCompParam
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisCompParam(  s_analysisName  s_instField s_parField ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select a component instance from the schematic to pop up a list box containing the parameters for that instance.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisInst
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisInst(  s_analysis s_field [ t_prompt ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select an instance from the schematic to be used as input for the specified field for the specified analysis. If the user selects any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisNet
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisNet(  s_analysis  s_field  [ t_prompt ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select a net from the schematic to be used as input for the specified field for the specified analysis. If the user selects any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectAnalysisSource
functions.syntax: asiSelectAnalysisSource(  s_analysis  s_field  [ t_prompt ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets the user select a source from the schematic to be used as input for the specified field for the specified analysis. If the user selects any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectInst
functions.syntax: asiSelectInst( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select an instance from the schematic. If you select any other object, the system beeps and ignores the selection.

functions.name: asiSelectNet
functions.syntax: asiSelectNet( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select a net from the schematic. If you select any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectSourceInst
functions.syntax: asiSelectSourceInst( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select a source instance on the schematic. If you select any other object, the system beeps and ignores the selection.

functions.name: asiSelectTerm
functions.syntax: asiSelectTerm( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select an instance terminal from the schematic. If you select any other object, the system ignores the selection and beeps.

functions.name: asiSelectTermNet
functions.syntax: asiSelectTermNet( s_field [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?form r_form ] [ ?tab l_tab ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lets you select either an instance terminal or a net. If you select any other object, the system beeps and ignores the selection.

functions.name: asiSendAnalysis
functions.description: Sends analyses to Cadence SPICE by calling asiFormatAnalysis for each analysis.

functions.name: asiSendControlStmts
functions.description: Sends information such as nodesets, initial conditions, keep lists or output, analyses, restore files, include files, and stimulus files to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendDesignVars
functions.description: Sends the design variables to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendInitCond
functions.description: Places all the initial conditions in <netlistDirectory>/raw/ics and sends a ptprop command to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendInitFile
functions.description: Sends the init.s file to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendKeepList
functions.description: Sends the keep list to Cadence SPICE. The keep list can contain a list of nets or currents to save and it can contain statements to keep all nets or keep all currents.

functions.name: asiSendModelPath
functions.description: Sends the model path to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendNetlist
functions.description: Sends the raw netlist to Cadence SPICE using the Cadence SPICE sim command.

functions.name: asiSendNodeSets
functions.description: Places all the nodesets in <netlistDirectory>/raw/nodesets and sends a ptprop command to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendOptions
functions.description: Sends the simulation options to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSendRestore
functions.description: If DC restore is on, send the commands to restore the DC node voltages to Cadence SPICE. If DC restore is off, sends the commands to turn off the DC restore function to Cadence SPICE. This function also works for the transient restore function.

functions.name: asiSendSim
functions.syntax: asiSendSim(  o_session  t_command  t_callback  g_param  g_saveOutput ) => t
functions.description: Sends a command to Cadence SPICE to forward to the target simulator.

functions.name: asiSendUpdateFile
functions.description: Sends the update.s file to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiSetAnalogSimulator
functions.description: Sets the analog simulator.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFieldChoices(  o_analysis  s_fieldName  l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box for an analysis field.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFieldVal(  o_analysis  s_fieldName  g_value  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for a field of an analysis.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldChoices(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  l_choices  ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Sets the list of choices for the specified field on the Choosing Analyses form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisFormFieldVal(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  g_value  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a field on the Choosing Analyses form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisFormWidth
functions.description: Sets the width of the Choosing Analyses form. You need to add a call to this procedure to the analysis.il file if you do not want the inherited width of the analysis form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisOptionChoices( o_analysis  s_optionName  l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices for an analysis option that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisOptionFormProperties
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisOptionFormProperties( o_analysis [ ?type s_type ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?columns x_columns ] ) => o_formObj / nil
functions.description: Sets the display characteristics for a new analysis options form.

functions.name: asiSetAnalysisOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetAnalysisOptionVal(  o_analysis  s_optionName  g_value  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of an option in an analysis.

functions.name: asiSetDesignVarList
functions.description: Sets the design variable list for a session.

functions.name: asiSetDigitalSimulator
functions.description: Sets the digital simulator.

functions.name: asiSetEMIROptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetEMIROptionVal( o_session  s_name g_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the given value for the specified EMIR option.

functions.name: asiSetEnvOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetEnvOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box field for the specified environment option.

functions.name: asiSetEnvOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetEnvOptionVal( { o_session | o_tool } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified simulation environment option.

functions.name: asiSetFormFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetFormFieldChoices(  r_form  s_fieldName  l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Sets the list of choices to appear in the list box for the specified form field.

functions.name: asiSetFormFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiSetFormFieldVal(  r_form s_fieldName g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a field on a form.

functions.name: asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal(  s_sessionName  s_varName  s_varValue  )   => t_Value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for the specified High Performance option variable.

functions.name: asiSetHostOptions
functions.syntax: asiSetHostOptions( o_session t_hostMode [ t_host ] [ t_remoteDir ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the host mode, host and remote directory for simulation.

functions.name: asiSetKeepList
functions.description: Sets the list of the specific signals and currents to save during simulation.

functions.name: asiSetKeepOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetKeepOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box field for the specified keep option.

functions.name: asiSetKeepOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetKeepOptionVal( { o_tool | o_session } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for the specified keep option variable for a tool or session object.

functions.name: asiSetMarchList
functions.description: Sets the list of signals to march during simulation.

functions.name: asiSetNetlistFormatterClass
functions.description: Registers the netlist formatter class with the tool. This function is normally called from the asiInitFormatter method and should be defined for the interface.

functions.name: asiSetNetlistOption
functions.syntax: asiSetNetlistOption(  { o_session | o_tool } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets a netlisting option.

functions.name: asiSetPageCallBack
functions.description: Returns the status (whether successful or failed) of the specified callback function, when changing tabs in a form.

functions.name: asiSetPlotList
functions.description: Sets the plot list for the current simulation session.

functions.name: asiSetProjectDirChangeSetup
functions.description: Enables you to modify the simulator settings for the given session after changing the project directory. This function is called by the environment. Therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface.

functions.name: asiSetSimOptionChoices
functions.syntax: asiSetSimOptionChoices( { o_session | o_tool } s_name l_choices ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box field for the specified simulator option.

functions.name: asiSetSimOptionVal
functions.syntax: asiSetSimOptionVal( { o_session | o_tool } s_name g_value ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified simulator option.

functions.name: asiSetSyncFlag
functions.description: This function makes the simulation run in a blocking mode. This implies that control does not come back till the simulation is over. This functionality is needed in the replay files in order to wait for a simulation to finish before proceeding. Call this function (asiSetSyncFlag(t)) just before launching a simulation. This function should only be used for testing capabilities. OCEAN should be used for scripting simulations.

functions.name: asiSetValid
functions.description: The functions sets valid analysis in the current simulation environment. The call to asiSetValid should be used with asiCheck/asiCheckAnalysis method for the analysis.

functions.name: asiSetVerilogHost
functions.description: Sets the digital simulator host name for mixed-signal simulation.

functions.name: asiSetVerilogHostMode
functions.description: Specifies whether the digital simulator will run locally or on a remote host. If you specify remote, you must specify the host name by using the asiSetVerilogHost command.

functions.name: asiStmGenerateNetlist
functions.syntax: asiStmGenerateNetlist( o_session wavepath nodeDesc [ o_simOptions ] ) => l_netlistStatus
functions.description: Generates netlist, as part of preview waveform generation for a stimuli and saves it at the specified psf directory path.

functions.name: asiStmGenerateWaveform
functions.syntax: asiStmGenerateWaveform( o_session t_wavepath t_stimuliDesc [ o_simOptions ] [ o_varDefinitions ] ) => l_waveStatus
functions.description: Generates preview waveforms for the specified stimuli under the given directory path.

functions.name: asiStmRunSimulation
functions.syntax: asiStmRunSimulation( o_session wavepath nodeDesc [ o_simOptions ] [ o_varDefinitions ] ) => l_simStatus
functions.description: Runs a simulation by using the netlist generated by SKILL function asiStmGenerateNetlist, and writes the psf waveform data at the specified path.

functions.name: asiStmSupportWaveformGeneration
functions.description: Determines whether the Stimuli Assignment form supports waveform preview functionality or not.

functions.name: asiTransientStore
functions.description: Copies the final transient operating points in processId.tr to the name you pass in fileName. This function assumes that your simulator writes the final transient operating points to netlistDir/raw/processId.tr.

functions.name: asiUnRegCallBackOnSimComp
functions.description: Deregisters the specified callback function registered to run on completion of the simulation.

functions.name: asiUnRegCallBackOnSimCompForDist
functions.description: Unregisters the specified user-defined callback function that is registered using the asiUnRegCallBackOnSimComp function.

functions.name: asiVerilogNetlistMoreCB
functions.description: Displays the Verilog HNL Netlisting Option form.

functions.name: asiWriteOceanScript
functions.syntax: asiWriteOceanScript(  p_filePointer o_session [ ?noRun g_noRun ] [ ?fullKey g_fullKey ] [ ?calledFromCorners g_calledFromCorners ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Writes the OCEAN script.

functions.name: auCdl
functions.description: This function sets defaults of all the variables defined in si.env like preserveRES, shortRES as well as other global variables like cdlSimViewList, cdlPrintComments etc. The function also sets the list of functions and variables that must be unbound when environments(simulators) are changed.

functions.name: auLvs
functions.description: This is the primary function for LVS. It sets up all the actions needed to netlist the layout and schematics design as well as invoke LVS (for comparison) itself.

functions.name: auProbeAddDevsForNet
functions.description: This procedure enables you to select nets using the cursor or by typing the names in the CIW to add probes for all devices connected to the selected net. The function displays the prompt, Point to net or enter net name in CIW. On pointing to the net or typing the net name in CIW, probes would be added on all the devices connected to the selected net.

functions.name: axlAddJobPolicy
functions.syntax: axlAddJobPolicy(  t_jobPolicyName  t_selectedPath l_jobPolicyProperties )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds or saves a job policy at the specified location.

functions.name: axlAddModelPermissibleSectionLists
functions.description: Creates a new list or adds new section names to the existing list of permissible section names for the given model imported from a PCF file. If a model file includes many sections out of which only a limited number of sections are of relevance to your testbench, you can create a permissible section list for that model file. If the LimitModelSections environment variable is set to LimitedList, while displaying the list of section names in the Corners Setup UI, the tool checks the permissible section list for a model file and shows only the relevant names. If you specify a section name that is not included in the permissible list, the tool shows appropriate errors.

functions.name: axlAddOutputExpr
functions.syntax: axlAddOutputExpr( t_sessionName t_testName t_outputName [ ?expr t_expr ] [ ?evalType t_evalType ] [ ?exprDPLs l_exprDPLs ] [ ?plot g_plot ] [ ?save g_save ] ) => t / t_error
functions.description: Adds an output expression to a test setup.

functions.name: axlAddOutputSignal
functions.syntax: axlAddOutputSignal( t_sessionName t_testName t_signalName [ ?type t_outputType ] [ ?outputName t_outputName ] [ ?plot g_plot ] [ ?save g_save ] ) => t / t_error
functions.description: Adds a signal to a test setup.

functions.name: axlAddOutputs
functions.description: Defines one or more output measures in an OCEAN script.

functions.name: axlAddOutputsColumn
functions.description: Adds a new user-defined column to the outputs table.

functions.name: axlAddSpecToOutput
functions.syntax: axlAddSpecToOutput(  x_hsdb t_testName t_resultName [ ?min g_minValue ] [ ?max g_maxValue ] [ ?gt g_greaterThanValue ] [ ?lt g_lessThanValue ] [ ?range g_rangeValues ] [ ?tol g_toleranceValue ] [ ?info g_info ] [ ?weight g_weightingFactor ] [ ?corner g_cornerName ] )  => t / t_error
functions.description: Adds a specification to an output defined for a test. You can also use this function to modify an existing specification for an output.

functions.name: axlAttachJobPolicy
functions.syntax: axlAttachJobPolicy(  t_sessionName t_jobPolicyName t_toolName l_jobPolicyProperties  [ t_testName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds and attaches a job policy to the setup.

functions.name: axlCloseSession
functions.description: Closes the specified session.

functions.name: axlCloseSessionInWindow
functions.description: Closes the given session in the current window, if there is one opened.

functions.name: axlCloseSetupDB
functions.description: Closes an open setup database.

functions.name: axlCommitSetupDB
functions.description: Saves the setup database file, for instance, the maestro.sdb or data.sdb file.

functions.name: axlCommitSetupDBAndHistoryAs
functions.description: Saves the setup database along with history entries under a new name.

functions.name: axlCommitSetupDBas
functions.description: Saves the setup database under a new name.

functions.name: axlCorners
functions.description: Opens the Corners Setup form.

functions.name: axlCreateSession
functions.description: Creates a new session with the specified name. You can use this function to create a new session before running a SKILL code for a maestro cellview in the non-GUI mode.

functions.name: axlCustomADETestName
functions.syntax: axlCustomADETestName(  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_stateName  ) => t_testName / nil
functions.description: A function that can be defined in the .cdsinit file or in CIW to customize the test name in ADE XL. The default format of test name is <library-name>:<cell-name>:<sequence-num>. You can use this function to customize the format to be used for test name. While creating a new test, ADE XL checks for the existence of a definition of axlCustomADETestName. If found, ADE XL calls this function and uses the returned value as the test name.

functions.name: axlDeleteJobPolicy
functions.description: Deletes the named job policy from the setup.

functions.name: axlDeleteNote
functions.syntax: axlDeleteNote(  x_mainSDB  t_item  t_name )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a note from the given test, history, corner, parameters, variable or Reliability Analysis setup.

functions.name: axlDeleteOutput
functions.syntax: axlDeleteOutput( t_sessionName t_testName [ ?outputName t_outputName ] [ ?type t_outputType ] ) => t / t_error
functions.description: Deletes an output from a test setup.

functions.name: axlDeleteOutputsColumn
functions.description: Deletes a user-defined column from the Outputs table.

functions.name: axlDetachJobPolicy
functions.syntax: axlDetachJobPolicy( t_sessionName t_jobType t_testName => t / nil
functions.description: Detaches a job policy from the specified test.

functions.name: axlDiffSetup
functions.description: Compares two setup databases and reports the differences.

functions.name: axlExportOutputView
functions.syntax: axlExportOutputView(  t_sessionName  t_fileName  t_viewType  [ ?history g_historyName ] [ ?testName g_testName ] [ ?filterName t_filterName ] [ ?clearAllFilters g_clearAllFilters] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Exports the results view to the specified .csv or .html file.

functions.name: axlExportSetup
functions.syntax: axlExportSetup(  t_session  x_hsdb t_path l_tags )  => t / nil
functions.description: Exports the setup from the currently loaded setup database to a different file. The list of tags passed are the top-level elements like variables, tests, etc to export.

functions.name: axlGetActiveSetup
functions.description: Returns a handle to the active setup. You can use this handle to get or set setup details for the active setup.

functions.name: axlGetAllCornersEnabled
functions.description: Returns the selection status of the Corners check box in the Run Summary assistant in ADE Assembler or the Explorer Run Summary assistant in ADE Explorer.

functions.name: axlGetAllParametersDisabled
functions.description: Returns the selection status of the option to include the device parameters in simulations. In the GUI, this is the selection status of the Parameters check box in the Data View assistant pane.

functions.name: axlGetAllSweepsEnabled
functions.description: Returns the selection status of the Sweep check box in the Run Summary assistant.

functions.name: axlGetAllVarsDisabled
functions.description: Returns the status for inclusion of the global variables in a simulation. In the GUI, this is the selection status of the Global Variables check box in the Data View assistant pane of ADE Assembler.

functions.name: axlGetAttachedJobPolicy
functions.syntax: axlGetAttachedJobPolicy(  [ t_sessionName ] [ t_toolType ] [ t_testName ] )  => l_jobPolicyProperties / nil
functions.description: Returns the current job policy attached to the setup or to the given test.

functions.name: axlGetCopyRefResultsOption
functions.description: Specifies whether the simulation results are required to be copied or moved from the reference history based on the settings in the setup database.

functions.name: axlGetCorner
functions.description: Finds a corner by its name and returns a handle to that corner.

functions.name: axlGetCornerCountForName
functions.description: Returns the count of individual corners contained in the specified corner group.

functions.name: axlGetCornerDisabledTests
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to the disabled tests and the names of tests that are disabled for the given corner.

functions.name: axlGetCornerNameForCurrentPointInRun
functions.description: Returns the name of the corner for the current point being simulated. This function is useful for customized processing or debugging in the OCEAN script-based measures.

functions.name: axlGetCorners
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all corners and a list of names of corners and corner groups in the setup database.

functions.name: axlGetCornersForATest
functions.description: Returns a list of corners enabled for the given test.

functions.name: axlGetCurrentHistory
functions.description: Returns the internal integer value representing the current history entry in active use.

functions.name: axlGetCurrentResultSimulationHost
functions.description: This is a callback function that runs from a Results table context menu.

functions.name: axlGetCurrentRunMode
functions.description: Returns the current simulation run mode of a given session.

functions.name: axlGetCustomOutputResultMenu
functions.description: A callback function that you can use to add custom commands in the shortcut menu of the Results tab of Virtuoso ADE Explorer and Virtuoso ADE Assembler. These products call this function to get the custom command names and the associated callback functions to be added to the menu.

functions.name: axlGetDataViewHistoryUserMenu
functions.description: This callback function is called when you right-click a history item in the History tab of the Data View assistant. You can override this function in .cdsinit to add customized menu items in the popup menus of the history items.

functions.name: axlGetElementParent
functions.description: Returns the handle to the parent of the specified setup database element.

functions.name: axlGetEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether a setup database element is enabled or not.

functions.name: axlGetEnabledGlobalVarPerTest
functions.syntax: axlGetEnabledGlobalVarPerTest(  x_hsdb t_varName t_test  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Returns the status of a global variable for the given test. When a global variable is overridden for a test, this function returns nil, which implies that the value of the global variable will not be considered for the test. Instead, the test will use a local value set for that variable.

functions.name: axlGetEnabledTests
functions.description: Returns a list of tests enabled in the given setup database.

functions.name: axlGetHistory
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all history entries in the setup database and a list of all the history entries.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryCheckpoint
functions.description: Returns the handle to the checkpoint of a history entry.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryEntry
functions.description: Finds the specified history entry in the setup database and returns the handle to that entry.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryGroup
functions.description: Returns a handle to the specified history group in the setup database.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryGroupChildren
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all history children entries in the history group and a list of names of all the history children entries.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryGroupChildrenEntry
functions.description: Finds a history entry in a group run by name and returns the handle to it.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryLock
functions.description: Returns the lock status of the given history. When a history item is locked, the corresponding setup details and results cannot be deleted.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryName
functions.description: Returns the name of the history item that holds the data for the latest simulation run.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryPrefix
functions.description: Returns the current history prefix value from the given session. The prefix value depends on the run mode selected in the session.

functions.name: axlGetHistoryResults
functions.description: Gets the results database from a history entry. This function calls axlGetResultsLocation to get the results location.

functions.name: axlGetJobPolicy
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list containing property-value pairs for the job policy.

functions.name: axlGetJobPolicyTypes
functions.description: Returns a list containing names of all available job policies.

functions.name: axlGetLocalResultsDir
functions.description: Returns the local results directory associated with a run on a remote machine.

functions.name: axlGetMainSetupDB
functions.description: Returns a handle to the working setup database of the named session.

functions.name: axlGetModel
functions.description: Returns a handle to the specified model file associated with the given corner.

functions.name: axlGetModelBlock
functions.description: Returns the block name with which the specified model is associated. By default, a model file is associated with a test and therefore, the block name is set to Global. However, in MTS mode, a model can be associated with a specific block in the design. Using this function, you can get the name of the block with which a model file is associated.

functions.name: axlGetModelFile
functions.description: Returns the model file path for the specified model.

functions.name: axlGetModelGroup
functions.description: Returns a handle to the specified model group in the setup database.

functions.name: axlGetModelGroupName
functions.description: Returns the name of the model group associated with the specified corner.

functions.name: axlGetModelGroups
functions.description: Returns a list of the model group names in a given setup database.

functions.name: axlGetModelPermissibleSectionLists
functions.description: Returns a list of permissible section names for the given model extracted from a PCF file.

functions.name: axlGetModelSection
functions.description: Returns the model section being used for the corner with which the model file is associated.

functions.name: axlGetModelSections
functions.description: Returns a list of simulator sections in the specified model file.

functions.name: axlGetModelTest
functions.description: Returns the name of the test associated with the specified model. By default, a model file is associated with a test. However, in MTS mode, a model can be associated with a specific block in the design. Using this function, you can get the name of the test with which a model file is associated.

functions.name: axlGetModels
functions.description: Returns a list of model files associated with the givne corner.

functions.name: axlGetNominalCornerEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether the nominal corner is enabled in the specified setup database. This is same as the status of the Nominal check box in the Run Summary assistant.

functions.name: axlGetNominalCornerTestEnabled
functions.description: Returns the status of the check box corresponding to the given test in the Nominal column on the Corners Setup form.

functions.name: axlGetNote
functions.syntax: axlGetNote(  x_hsdb t_item t_name )  => t_note / nil
functions.description: Returns notes from the specified test, history, corner, parameters, variable or Reliability Analysis setup.

functions.name: axlGetOrigTestToolArgs
functions.description: Returns an associative list of original tool options set for the test before you ran the simulation after modifying the test setup.

functions.name: axlGetOutputSignificantDigits
functions.description: Returns the number of significant digits set for the specified output of the test.

functions.name: axlGetOverwriteHistory
functions.description: Returns a Boolean value specifying the status of the Overwrite History check box in the Save Options form for the active setup.

functions.name: axlGetOverwriteHistoryName
functions.description: Returns the name of the history that is set to be overwritten for the active setup.

functions.name: axlGetParameter
functions.description: Returns the database handle to the given device parameter in the setup database.

functions.name: axlGetParameterValue
functions.description: Returns value of the specified device parameter in the setup database.

functions.name: axlGetParameters
functions.description: Returns a list of paths to all the device parameters found in the given database.

functions.name: axlGetParasiticParaLCV
functions.description: Gets the name of the parasitic cellview attached to the parasitic run mode in the active setup or history checkpoint.

functions.name: axlGetParasiticRunMode
functions.description: Gets the parasitic run mode name from the active setup or history checkpoint.

functions.name: axlGetParasiticSchLCV
functions.description: Gets the name of the schematic cellview attached to the parasitic run mode in the active setup or history checkpoint.

functions.name: axlGetPointNetlistDir
functions.syntax: axlGetPointNetlistDir( x_historyID t_testName  [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?designPointId x_designPointId ]  ) => t_pointNetlistDir / nil
functions.description: Returns the netlist directory for a particular corner and design point combination in the given test run of the specified history.

functions.name: axlGetPointPsfDir
functions.syntax: axlGetPointPsfDir( x_historyID t_testName  [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?designPointId x_designPointId ] ) => t_pointPsfDir / nil
functions.description: Returns the psf directory for a particular corner and design point combination in the given test run of the given history.

functions.name: axlGetPointRunDir
functions.syntax: axlGetPointRunDir( x_historyID t_testName  [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?designPointId x_designPointId ]  ) => t_pointRunDir / nil
functions.description: Returns the run directory for a particular corner and design point combination in the given test run of the specified history.

functions.name: axlGetPointTroubleshootDir
functions.syntax: axlGetPointTroubleshootDir( x_historyID t_testName  [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?designPointId x_designPointId ]  ) => t_trblDir / nil
functions.description: Returns the troubleshoot directory for a particular corner and design point combination in a specified test run of the given history.

functions.name: axlGetPreRunScript
functions.description: Returns the path to the pre-run script file attached to the given test.

functions.name: axlGetResultsLocation
functions.description: Returns the results location for the specified setup database.

functions.name: axlGetReuseNetlist
functions.description: Checks if the option to use reference netlist is enabled for the setup database. This option helps in reusing the netlist of the reference history for the incremental simulation run.

functions.name: axlGetRunData
functions.description: Returns the handle to the history obtained after running a simulation in the given session. You can use this handle to get access to the history results or to get setup details by using the history checkpoint.

functions.name: axlGetRunDistributeOptions
functions.description: Returns the current run option settings for the given setup database.

functions.name: axlGetRunMode
functions.description: Returns a handle to the named run mode in the specified setup database.

functions.name: axlGetRunModes
functions.description: Returns a list of available run modes from the specified setup database.

functions.name: axlGetRunOption
functions.syntax: axlGetRunOption(  x_hsdb  t_mode  t_runoptName  )  => x_runOption / nil
functions.description: Returns a handle to the named run option (t_runoptName) in the setup database for the specified run mode (t_mode).

functions.name: axlGetRunOptionName
functions.description: Returns the run option name.

functions.name: axlGetRunOptionValue
functions.description: Returns the value associated with the provided run option.

functions.name: axlGetRunOptions
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all run option names for the specified run mode.

functions.name: axlGetRunStatus
functions.description: Returns the completion status in terms of the number of points, tests, or corners completed for all histories running in the given session or for the specified history.

functions.name: axlGetScript
functions.description: Finds a script by name and returns a handle to it.

functions.name: axlGetScriptPath
functions.description: Returns the path of a script.

functions.name: axlGetScripts
functions.description: Returns a list containing the handle to all scripts for this database entry and a list of all script names.

functions.name: axlGetSessionCellName
functions.description: Returns the cell name associated with the session or setup database.

functions.name: axlGetSessionFromSetupDB
functions.description: Determines the session associated with the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlGetSessionLibName
functions.description: Returns the library name associated with the given session or setup database.

functions.name: axlGetSessionViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name associated with the given session or setup database.

functions.name: axlGetSessionWindowNumber
functions.description: Returns a unique integer representing a number corresponding to a given session name.

functions.name: axlGetSetupDBDir
functions.description: Returns the path to the directory of the specified setup database.

functions.name: axlGetSetupInfo
functions.description: Returns the setup information for the complete setup or a specific test. This includes the number of corners, sweep points, and data points in the setup.

functions.name: axlGetSpec
functions.description: Finds the named specification in the setup database and returns its handle.

functions.name: axlGetSpecData
functions.syntax: axlGetSpecData(  x_hsdb t_resultName t_testName [ t_cornerName ] )  => l_specDetails / nil
functions.description: Returns the specification for the given result, test, and corner combination in the given setup database.

functions.name: axlGetSpecWeight
functions.description: Returns the weight value for a specification. This value represents the weighting factor for the specification during optimization.

functions.name: axlGetSpecs
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all specifications in the setup database and a list of all specification names.

functions.name: axlGetStatVars
functions.description: Returns a list of the names of statistical variables that use the statistical::mismatch or statistical::global prefix for the given statistical corner.

functions.name: axlGetTemperatureForCurrentPointInRun
functions.description: Within the OCEAN measurement script, this function allows to access the temperature of the current point in the run.

functions.name: axlGetTest
functions.description: Finds a test in the setup database and returns its handle.

functions.name: axlGetTestToolArgs
functions.description: Returns an associative list of tool option names and values for a test.

functions.name: axlGetTests
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all tests in the setup database and a list of all test names.

functions.name: axlGetToolSession
functions.syntax: axlGetToolSession( t_sessionName t_testName [ ?history x_history ] )  => g_sessionID / nil
functions.description: ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler internally maintains a unique in-memory identifier for each active test. This function returns that unique identifier for the specified test.

functions.name: axlGetTopLevel
functions.description: Returns the handle to the setup database containing the specified element.

functions.name: axlGetUseIncremental
functions.description: Checks if using reference results as cache during incremental run is enabled for the active setup or checkpoint.

functions.name: axlGetUserDefinedOutputsColumns
functions.description: Returns a list of names of the user-defined columns in the specified setup database.

functions.name: axlGetVar
functions.description: Finds a variable associated with the specified database element and returns a handle to it.

functions.name: axlGetVarValue
functions.description: Returns value of the given variable.

functions.name: axlGetVars
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all variables associated with the given database element (the setup database, a corner, or a history checkpoint) and a list of all variable names.

functions.name: axlGetWCCCorner
functions.description: Gets the corner name for the given specification handle of a worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCHistory
functions.description: Returns name of the history for a specification of a worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCRangeBound
functions.description: Returns an integer value that specifies whether the worst-case corner corresponds to the minimum or the maximum value of the spec.

functions.name: axlGetWCCResult
functions.description: Returns result of a specification of a worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCSpec
functions.description: Returns handle to a specification for the specified worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCSpecs
functions.description: Returns a list of specifications for the given worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCTest
functions.description: Returns the name of the test of the specification associated with a worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCTime
functions.description: Returns the generated time information for the given specification handle of a worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCVar
functions.description: Finds the specified variable by name and returns a handle to it.

functions.name: axlGetWCCVarMonotonicity
functions.description: Gets the monotonicity of a specific variable or parameter of the worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWCCVars
functions.description: Returns a list containing a handle to all variables and a list of all variable names in a worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlGetWYCSigmaTargetLimit
functions.description: Gets the sigma-to-target limit for the Improve Yield flow using worst yield corners. If this value is not set, the flow internally sets it to 100.

functions.name: axlGetWindowSession
functions.description: Returns the ADE session associated with a window.

functions.name: axlImportPreRunScript
functions.syntax: axlImportPreRunScript( t_sessionName t_testName t_preRunScriptName ) => t_preRunScriptName / nil
functions.description: Imports and attaches the given script to the specified test. In the GUI of the application, you can right-click the test name and choose Add/Edit Pre Run Script to view or edit the pre-run script attached to the test.

functions.name: axlImportSetup
functions.syntax: axlImportSetup(  t_session  t_path l_tags [ t_historyName ] [ s_operation ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Imports the setup from a file. The list of tags passed are the top-level elements like vars, tests, etc to import.

functions.name: axlIsICRPProcess
functions.description: Returns t if the code is currently running in a remote child process for the tool. You can use this function in your .cdsinit file or in custom SKILL code.

functions.name: axlIsLocalResultsDir
functions.description: Returns the status of Use Local Simulation Results Directory flag for the specified history item.

functions.name: axlIsSessionReadOnly
functions.description: This functions determines whether the specified session is opened in read-only or edit mode.

functions.name: axlIsSimUsingStatParams
functions.description: Returns t if statistical variables are being set or varied for a particular simulation run. For example, statistical parameters in a Monte Carlo run or a statistical corner for Improve Yield.

functions.name: axlIsValidAXLSession
functions.description: Checks the validity of the specified session.

functions.name: axlJPGUICusReadFromForm
functions.description: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to read any HI customization into a property list that will be saved as a job policy.

functions.name: axlJPGUICustDiffer
functions.syntax: axlJPGUICustDiffer( g_inst l_propList1 l_propList2 ) => t / nil
functions.description: Job Policy GUI Customization member function that determines whether l_propList1 and l_propList2 differ. The Job Policy GUI uses this method to determine if the GUI settings differ from those already attached to the tool.

functions.name: axlJPGUICustHIFields
functions.description: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to create the HI field displayed for a particular JP GUI customization. The Job Policy GUI calls this method once during initialization. If no customizations are desired, the function does not need to be specialized.

functions.name: axlJPGUICustHiddenSections
functions.description: Job Policy GUI Customization member function that returns a list of sections or fields to be hidden from the Job Policy Setup form.

functions.name: axlJPGUICustOffset
functions.description: Job policy GUI customization member function to return the y size of the HI field customizations provided with the axlJPGUICustHIFields method. The value is obtained by adding 10 to the y position of the last HI element. The Job Policy form uses this value as the y offset for the form elements underneath the customization area.

functions.name: axlJPGUICustSelected
functions.description: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to enable or disable any HI customizations. The Job Policy GUI calls this function every time the job policy type is changed.

functions.name: axlJPGUICustWriteToForm
functions.description: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to load a property list that is saved as a job policy into HI customizations.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcDebugPrintf
functions.description: Formats and writes output to the log if interface debugging is enabled.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcDebugToFile
functions.description: Enables the interface job debugging and sets the output to a file.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcDebugp
functions.description: Specifies whether interface debugging is enabled.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcExitMethod
functions.description: Job Interface member function used to exit a job. The application usually attempts to call exit(0) on remote job cleanup the job's resources properly. However, if this fails or if the tool is forced to kill all jobs, the exit method will be called on every remote job. This method may be called after the job has already exited. This job can also be called multiple times.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcHealthMethod
functions.description: Job Interface member function used to return the current health of the job. The application calls this function regularly (currently, every 5 seconds) on each job in order to recognize health changes. The available health types are: unknown, alive, or dead.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcSetDebug
functions.description: Enables or disables printing of the job interface diagnostics to the CIW.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcStartJobArrayMethod
functions.syntax: axlJobIntfcStartJobArrayMethod( g_inst x_startIndex x_endIndex ) => t / nil
functions.description: Job interface member function to start a job array where the job IDs are set between the range of the specified start and end indexes for the array. For example, if the start and end indexes are set to 4 and 10 respectively, the jobs with IDs 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 would be launched.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcStartMethod
functions.description: Job Interface member function to start a job. For each new job ID, a new instance of the selected interface class will be created. After some basic properties are set on the instance, it will be passed to the start method of the class.

functions.name: axlLoadCorners
functions.description: Loads a set of corners from the specified XML file in which the corners were saved earlier.

functions.name: axlLoadCornersFromPcfToSetupDB
functions.syntax: axlLoadCornersFromPcfToSetupDB ( t_session t_fileName t_testNameList g_overwriteExistingCorners )  => t / nil
functions.description: Imports a set of predefined corners from a process customization file into the corners setup for the given session.

functions.name: axlLoadHistory
functions.description: Copies the setup database branch and returns the handle to the copy.

functions.name: axlLoadSetupState
functions.syntax: axlLoadSetupState(  t_session  t_stateName l_tags s_operation )  => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a setup state.

functions.name: axlMainAppSaveSetup
functions.description: Saves the ADE state and setup database information associated with the given session to relevant persistent files on disk. This function is useful only in the non-GUI mode.

functions.name: axlNewSetupDB
functions.description: Opens the named setup database and returns its handle. If the named setup database does not already exist, this function creates one and returns a handle to it.

functions.name: axlNewSetupDBLCV
functions.syntax: axlNewSetupDBLCV(  t_libraryName t_cellName t_viewName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a new setup database in the specified location. It automatically overwrites any existing setup database in any of the above mentioned locations.

functions.name: axlNoSession
functions.description: Returns t if there is no session in the current window.

functions.name: axlOpenResDB
functions.description: Opens the database file specified by t_fileName. If the file does not exist, it is created.

functions.name: axlOutputResult
functions.description: Specifies the value of an output in an OCEAN script file. This function only assigns a value to a measure, but does not add it to the script. You need to use the axlAddOutputs function to add or define output measures in an OCEAN script.

functions.name: axlOutputsExportToFile
functions.syntax: axlOutputsExportToFile( t_sessionName t_fileName [ ?omitTestCol g_omitTestCol ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Exports outputs from the currently active setup to the specified CSV file.

functions.name: axlOutputsImportFromFile
functions.syntax: axlOutputsImportFromFile( t_sessionName t_fileName [ ?operation t_operationType ] [ ?test t_test ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Imports outputs from the specified CSV file. Outputs can be exported to a CSV file by using axlOutputsExportToFile.

functions.name: axlPlotAcrossDesignPoints
functions.syntax: axlPlotAcrossDesignPoints(  t_session t_testName t_historyName t_outputName t_cornerName  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Plots an output across all the design points for a particular corner.

functions.name: axlPutCorner
functions.description: Adds a new corner by the given name and returns a handle to that corner. If a corner already exists with the same name, the function returns the handle to that corner.

functions.name: axlPutDisabledCorner
functions.description: Adds a new corner by the given name and returns a handle to that corner. If a corner already exists with the same name, the function returns the handle to that corner. In addition, the corner is disabled for the specified test name, but enabled for other tests in the session.

functions.name: axlPutHistoryEntry
functions.description: Inserts or finds a history entry in the setup database and returns a handle to that entry.

functions.name: axlPutModel
functions.syntax: axlPutModel(  x_cornerHandle  t_modelFileName  [ ?testName t_testName ]  [ ?blockName t_blockName ]  )  => x_modelHandle / nil
functions.description: Adds a model file to the specified corner.

functions.name: axlPutModelGroup
functions.description: Adds a model group to the setup database or returns the handle to the model group if it already exists.

functions.name: axlPutNote
functions.syntax: axlPutNote(  x_mainSDB  t_item  t_name t_note )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a note to the given test, history, corner, parameters, variable or Reliability Analysis setup.

functions.name: axlPutOutputNotation
functions.syntax: axlPutOutputNotation( x_sdb t_testName t_outputID t_value ) => x_sdb / nil
functions.description: Sets the notation style for the specified output of the test.

functions.name: axlPutOutputSignificantDigits
functions.syntax: axlPutOutputSignificantDigits( x_sdb t_testName t_outputID x_value ) => x_sdb / nil
functions.description: Sets the number of significant digits corresponding to the specified output of the test.

functions.name: axlPutOutputSuffix
functions.syntax: axlPutOutputSuffix( x_sdb t_testName t_outputID x_value ) => x_sdb / nil
functions.description: Sets the suffix corresponding to the specified output of the test.

functions.name: axlPutOutputUnits
functions.syntax: axlPutOutputUnits( x_sdb t_testName t_outputID t_value ) => x_sdb / nil
functions.description: Sets the unit to the specified output of the test.

functions.name: axlPutRunOption
functions.syntax: axlPutRunOption( x_hsdb t_mode t_runoptName )  => x_runOption / nil
functions.description: Adds a run option to the setup database or edits an existing one and returns the handle to the option. The list of valid option names (t_runoptName) depends on the run mode (t_mode).

functions.name: axlPutScript
functions.syntax: axlPutScript(  x_element  t_scriptName  t_path  )  => x_script / nil
functions.description: Inserts or finds a script by name, sets its path, and returns a handle to that script.

functions.name: axlPutTest
functions.syntax: axlPutTest(  x_hsdb  t_test  t_tool )  => x_test / nil
functions.description: Finds or inserts a test into the setup database and returns a handle to that test.

functions.name: axlPutVar
functions.syntax: axlPutVar(  x_element  t_varName  t_value  )  => x_varHandle / nil
functions.description: Creates or finds a variable by the given name for the specified database element and sets its value.

functions.name: axlReEvaluateHistory
functions.syntax: axlReEvaluateHistory(  t_sessionName  x_historyHandle S_mode )  => t / nil
functions.description: Re-evaluates the history in the specified mode with respect to the active setup for a given session.

functions.name: axlReadHistoryResDB
functions.description: Returns a handle to the results database saved with the specified history.

functions.name: axlReadResDB
functions.description: Returns a handle to the specified results database. This handle provides read-only access to the results database that contains objects of the following types:

functions.name: axlRegisterCustomDeviceFilter
functions.description: Adds a custom filter for device instance parameters on the Variables and Parameters assistant pane in ADE Explorer and ADE Assembler.

functions.name: axlRegisterJobIntfc
functions.syntax: axlRegisterJobIntfc( s_displayName s_className [ ?isInitializedFun u_isInitFun ] [ ?displayInGUI g_shouldDisplay ] ) => t
functions.description: Registers a job interface class into the application. Job interfaces should be registered before use, preferably during virtuoso initialization.

functions.name: axlRegisteredJPGUICust
functions.description: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to register a customization into the Job Policy Setup form. Any registered customizations will appear the next time the job policy Setup form is displayed.

functions.name: axlRegisteredJobIntfcNames
functions.description: Retrieves the registered job interfaces.

functions.name: axlRemoveElement
functions.description: Removes an element and all its children from the setup database.

functions.name: axlRemoveSetupState
functions.description: Removes the specified setup state for the given session.

functions.name: axlRemoveSimulationResults
functions.description: Removes the simulation results data for the given history. The function removes only the results saved by the simulator. The results database and the history item is not removed.

functions.name: axlRenameOutputsColumn
functions.syntax: axlRenameOutputsColumn( x_mainSDB t_columnName t_newColumnName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the name of a user-defined column in the outputs table.

functions.name: axlResetActive
functions.description: Resets the active setup database.

functions.name: axlRestoreHistory
functions.description: Sets the given history as the active setup in the given session.

functions.name: axlRunAllTests
functions.description: Starts a run with all enabled tests.

functions.name: axlRunAllTestsWithCallback
functions.syntax: axlRunAllTestsWithCallback(  t_session  t_mode  t_callback  )  => x_runid / nil
functions.description: Starts a simulation run with all enabled tests and specifies a SKILL expression to call upon their completion.

functions.name: axlRunSimulation
functions.description: Starts a simulation run of all enabled tests and specifies a SKILL expression to call upon completion.

functions.name: axlSDBDebugPrint
functions.description: Prints the in-memory database rooted at the supplied handle. Useful for debugging so that SDB modifications can be seen without saving the XML to disk.

functions.name: axlSDBGetChild
functions.syntax: axlSDBGetChild( x_SDBH t_name [ t_value ] ) => x_hsdb / nil
functions.description: Works as a wrapper around axlSDBGetChildren and returns a setup database handle to a single child element. An error will be reported if multiple matching elements are found.

functions.name: axlSDBGetChildVal
functions.description: Works as a wrapper around axlSDBGetChild and returns the value for a single child element.

functions.name: axlSDBGetChildren
functions.syntax: axlSDBGetChildren( x_SDBH [ t_name ] [ t_value ] S_returnAs ) => l_children / nil
functions.description: Returns child elements of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBGetExtension
functions.description: Returns the named setup database extension.

functions.name: axlSDBGetName
functions.description: Returns the name of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBGetValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBHp
functions.description: Returns whether the supplied argument is a valid setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBPutExtension
functions.description: Adds an extension to the ADE setup database under which customization can be created.

functions.name: axlSDBSetChild
functions.syntax: axlSDBSetChild( x_SDBH t_name t_value ) => x_SDBH / nil
functions.description: Creates a new child element under the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBSetMultipleEntry
functions.description: Sets a setup database name to be a multiple entry name. By default, a setup database handle is a single entry name.  A single-entry element is differentiated only by its name, whereas a multi-entry element is differentiated by both name and value.

functions.name: axlSDBSetValue
functions.description: Sets the value of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSaveJobPolicy
functions.description: Saves the policy given by the t_policyName argument.

functions.name: axlSaveSetup
functions.description: Saves the setup database file and test state files for the current window. The behavior of this function is similar to File - Save. If the cellview was opened in the read-only mode, a new library, cell, and view value must be provided for which you need to save the setup details.

functions.name: axlSaveSetupState
functions.syntax: axlSaveSetupState( t_session t_stateName l_tags [ ?inReadOnly readOnlyAction ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a setup state for the specified session.

functions.name: axlSaveSetupToLib
functions.syntax: axlSaveSetupToLib(  x_hsdb  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the setup database to the specified lib/cell/view.

functions.name: axlSessionConnect
functions.syntax: axlSessionConnect(  t_sessionName t_signalName s_callbackFunc )  => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a SKILL callback to be connected to a known signal or trigger emitted from an ADE session.

functions.name: axlSessionDisconnect
functions.description: Disconnects the specified SKILL callback connected to one or more known signals emitted by the ADE Explorer and ADE Assembler session.

functions.name: axlSessionRegisterCreationCallback
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function as callback for an event. The callback is called whenever that event occurs.

functions.name: axlSessionSignalList
functions.description: Returns a list of all the signals or triggers that are emitted from the given session. You can create custom callback functions to be executed when these events are triggered.

functions.name: axlSessionSignalSignature
functions.description: Returns the signature of a given signal that is emitted by a session. This function serves as a utility function to determine how to implement the slot or callback function in SKILL.

functions.name: axlSetAllCornersEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables all the corners for simulation. This changes the selection status of the Corners check box in the Run Summary assistant.

functions.name: axlSetAllParametersDisabled
functions.description: Sets the status of the Parameters check box in the Data View assistant pane in ADE Explorer and ADE Assembler.

functions.description: Sets the selection status of the Point Sweeps check box in the Run Summary assistant pane.

functions.name: axlSetAllVarsDisabled
functions.description: Sets the selection status of the option to include the global variables in simulations. In the GUI, this is the selection status of the Global Variables check box in the Data View assistant pane of ADE Assembler.

functions.name: axlSetCopyRefResultsOption
functions.description: Specifies whether the simulation results need to be copied or moved from the reference history.

functions.name: axlSetCornerName
functions.description: Sets or updates the name of the given corner.

functions.name: axlSetCornerTestEnabled

functions.name: axlSetCurrentRunMode
functions.description: Sets the current simulation run mode for the given database.

functions.name: axlSetDefaultCornerEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables the default (nominal) corner for the specified test. The program creates a nominal corner when you create a test. This corner represents the absence of corner-specific information.

functions.name: axlSetDefaultVariables
functions.description: Creates a set of default variables in the Global Variables tree on the Data View pane and in the Parameters and Variables assistant of ADE Assembler.

functions.name: axlSetDesignVariablePerTest
functions.syntax: axlSetDesignVariablePerTest(  x_mainSDB t_varName t_testName [ ?enabled g_enableStatus ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables a design variable for a specific test. In the Setup assistant of ADE Explorer or the Data View assistant of ADE Assembler, it selects or clears the check box next to a design variable under a test.

functions.name: axlSetEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables a setup database element, such as a test or a variable.

functions.name: axlSetHistoryLock
functions.description: Locks the specified checkpoint history. After it is locked, you cannot delete the history or the simulation data saved for it.

functions.name: axlSetHistoryName
functions.description: Sets a new name for the specified history.

functions.name: axlSetHistoryPrefixInPreRunTrigger
functions.description: Sets a prefix to be used in the history name for a new run.

functions.name: axlSetJobPolicyProperty
functions.syntax: axlSetJobPolicyProperty(  t_jobPolicyName  t_jobPropertyName  t_jobPropertyValue  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a property name-value pair for the specified job policy. You can use this function to update the properties of an existing policy. To apply the updated properties to all the sessions, set the updated policy as the default policy for the tool by using the defaultJobPolicy environment variable.

functions.name: axlSetMainSetupDB
functions.description: Sets the working setup database for a session to the setup database specified by the given setupDBPath. This function is useful when you create a new session in a SKILL script and then you want to setup a database for that.

functions.name: axlSetMainSetupDBLCV
functions.syntax: axlSetMainSetupDBLCV(  t_session  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?mode t_mode ] )  => x_mainSDB / nil
functions.description: Sets the working setup database for a given session to the setup database specified by the given library, cell, or view.

functions.name: axlSetModelBlock
functions.description: Sets the name of the block for the specified model. By default, a model is associated with all the design blocks and is set as Global. In the MTS mode, a model is associated with a specific MTS block, so you need to use this function to specify the name of that block.

functions.name: axlSetModelFile
functions.description: Sets the model file for the specified model.

functions.name: axlSetModelGroupName
functions.description: Sets or associates the given model group with the specified corner.

functions.name: axlSetModelPermissibleSectionLists
functions.description: Sets a permissible section list for the given model extracted from a PCF file. If a model file includes many sections out of which only a limited number of sections are of relevance to your testbench, you can create a permissible section list for that model file. If the LimitModelSections environment variable is set to LimitedList, while displaying the list of section names in the Corners Setup UI, the tool checks the permissible section list for a model file and shows only the relevant names.

functions.name: axlSetModelSection
functions.description: Sets the section name for the specified model.

functions.name: axlSetModelTest
functions.description: Sets the name of the test to be associated with the specified model. By default, a model is associated with all the tests. In case of MTS mode, you need to associate the model with a specific test. Alternatively, you can use the axlPutModel function to specify the test name while adding a model.

functions.name: axlSetNominalCornerEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables the nominal corner in the specified setup database.

functions.name: axlSetNominalCornerTestEnabled
functions.description: Sets the status of the check box corresponding to the given test in the Nominal column on the Corners Setup form.

functions.name: axlSetOutputUserDefinedData
functions.syntax: axlSetOutputUserDefinedData( x_mainSDB t_testName t_outputName t_columnName t_columnValue ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value in the user-defined column for the specified test name and output.

functions.name: axlSetOverwriteHistory
functions.description: Enables or disables the Overwrite History check box in the Save Options form for the active setup.

functions.name: axlSetOverwriteHistoryName
functions.description: Sets the name of the history to be overwritten for the specified active setup.

functions.name: axlSetParameter
functions.syntax: axlSetParameter( x_mainSDB t_parameterPath t_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a value for the specified device parameter.

functions.name: axlSetParasiticRunMode
functions.description: Sets the parasitic run mode for the given setup.

functions.name: axlSetPreRunScript
functions.syntax: axlSetPreRunScript( t_sessionName t_testName t_scriptName ) => t_filePath / nil
functions.description: Sets or adds a pre-run script for a test.

functions.name: axlSetPreRunScriptEnabled
functions.syntax: axlSetPreRunScriptEnabled( t_sessionName t_testName g_enabled ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables execution of pre-run scripts before running simulations.

functions.name: axlSetReferenceHistoryItemName
functions.description: Sets the reference history name for the active setup or checkpoint. You can reuse the results or netlist from the reference history during an incremental simulation run. The reference history name set using this function also appears in the Reference field on the Reference History toolbar.

functions.name: axlSetReuseNetlistOption
functions.description: Enables or disables the option to use the reference netlist for the active setup or checkpoint. If this option is enabled, netlist of the design is reused for the incremental run. Otherwise, the design in renetlisted.

functions.name: axlSetRunDistributeOptions
functions.syntax: axlSetRunDistributeOptions(  x_hsdb  [ ?RunIn t_runIn ] [ ?DivideJobs t_divideJobs ] [ ?JobLimit n_jobLimit ] )  => t / nil

functions.name: axlSetRunOptionName
functions.description: Sets the run option name.

functions.name: axlSetRunOptionValue
functions.description: Sets a value for the given run option.

functions.name: axlSetScriptPath
functions.description: Sets the path of a script.

functions.name: axlSetTestToolArgs
functions.description: Sets the tool options for the test.

functions.name: axlSetUseIncremental
functions.description: Enables or disables the setup database option in active setup or checkpoint for using reference results as cache during incremental run. This function selects or clears the Use reference netlist check box on the Reference History form.

functions.name: axlSetWCCTime
functions.description: Sets the time information for the given specification handle of a worst-case corner.

functions.name: axlSetWYCSigmaTargetLimit

functions.description: Stops all runs currently evaluating in the session.

functions.name: axlStopAllJobs

functions.name: axlStopJob

functions.name: axlSuppressPersistedQuestionDialog

functions.syntax: axlToolSetSetupOptions(  t_session  t_test  l_toolOptions  )  => t / nil

functions.name: axlWriteDatasheetForm
functions.description: Causes a form to appear so that you can specify various options for generating a datasheet.

functions.name: axlWriteMonteCarloResultsCSV
functions.syntax: axlWriteMonteCarloResultsCSV t_session t_historyName [ ?testName t_testName ] [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?outputName t_outputPath ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Writes the results of the given Monte Carlo run history in CSV format. The tool saves the results for each corner in a separate CSV file.

functions.syntax: axlWriteOceanScriptLCV( t_fileName t_libraryName t_cellName t_viewName => t / nil
functions.description: Writes an OCEAN script for the given cellview in the specified file. If axlWriteOceanScriptLCV()is used in an existing session, it will write the current in-memory values and not the values saved on the disk.

functions.syntax: calcValForRel( t_outputName [ ?relxName t_relxName ] [ ?ageValue t_ageValue ] [ ?ageUnit t_ageUnit ] [ ?she g_she ] [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?historyName t_historyName ] [ ?run t_runName] ) => g_output / nil
functions.description: Retrieves the value of an output expression used in a reliability setup. You can use the value returned by this function in another output expression. When using the function calcValForRel in an output expression, you must specify different tests for stress and aged tests to avoid cyclic dependencies. You can create this expression in the Outputs Setup tab by using the Expression Builder too.

functions.name: captabSummary
functions.description: Prints a summary of the capacitance table from the specified results directory.

functions.name: cdfCopyCDF
functions.syntax: cdfCopyCDF( g_cellId | g_libId t_dataType g_sourceCdfDataId ) => g_cdfDataId / nil
functions.description: Copies the CDF data of the specified type from specified source to a library or cell by creating a new CDF data ID.

functions.name: cdfCopyParam
functions.description: Copies the specified parameter to the given CDF data object.

functions.name: cdfCreateBaseCellCDF
functions.syntax: cdfCreateBaseCellCDF( g_cellID  [ ?doneProc t_doneProc ] [ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ] [ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ] [ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ] [ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ] [ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ] ) => g_cdfDataID / nil
functions.description: Creates a base-level CDF description for a cell. The CDF description is created with no parameters or simulation models.

functions.name: cdfCreateBaseLibCDF
functions.syntax: cdfCreateBaseLibCDF(  g_libID  [ ?doneProc t_doneProc ] [ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ] [ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ] [ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ] [ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ] [ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ] ) => g_cdfDataID / nil
functions.description: Creates the Base Library CDF that is applied to all the devices in the library. The CDF description is created with no parameters or simModels.

functions.name: cdfCreateParam
functions.syntax: cdfCreateParam( g_cdfDataId [ ?name t_name ] [ ?type t_type ] [ ?defValue g_defValue ] [ ?units t_units ] [ ?parseAsNumber t_parseAsNumber ] [ ?choices l_choices ] [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?use t_use ] [ ?display t_display ] [ ?editable t_editable] [ ?dontSave t_dontSave] [ ?callback t_callback] [ ?storeDefault t_storeDefault ] [ ?parseAsCEL t_parseAsCEL ] [ ?description t_description ] ) => g_cdfDataId / nil
functions.description: Creates a parameter on the specified CDF database object with the specified attributes. The only attributes that are always required are the parameter's name and type. If this parameter description is not overriding an existing base-level parameter definition, you must also specify the default value.

functions.name: cdfCreateUserCellCDF
functions.syntax: cdfCreateUserCellCDF( g_cellId  [ ?doneProc t_doneProc ] [ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ] [ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ] [ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ] [ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ] [ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ] ) => g_cdfDataId / nil
functions.description: Creates a user-level CDF description for a cell. The CDF description is created with no parameters or simulation models.

functions.name: cdfCreateUserLibCDF
functions.syntax: cdfCreateUserLibCDF(  g_libId  [ ?doneProc t_doneProc ] [ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ] [ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ] [ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ] [ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ] [ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ] )  => g_cdfDataId / nil
functions.description: Creates the user-level library CDF that is applied to all the devices in the library. The user-level CDF can override entries in the base-level CDF. Therefore, a combination of the base-level CDF and the user-level CDF becomes the effective CDF.

functions.name: cdfDeleteCDF

functions.name: cdfDisableScaleFactorRetentionForZero
functions.description: Disables the unit scale factor retention for CDF parameters enabled using the cdfEnableScaleFactorRetentionForZero function.

functions.name: cdfDump
functions.syntax: cdfDump( t_libName t_fileName  [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?level s_level ]  [ ?edit g_edit ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Dumps the CDF description for the specified library and cell into the given file. If a cell is not specified, then only the library CDF description is dumped. The file is created in the current working directory or the directory specified with the file name. If g_edit is t, a text editor window is automatically opened on t_fileName. The default is no editor.

functions.name: cdfDumpAll
functions.syntax: cdfDumpAll( t_libName t_fileName  [ ?level s_level ]  [ ?edit g_edit ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Dumps the CDF description for the specified library and all its cells into the given file. You can also specify the level of the CDF description by using the ?level s_level argument. The specified file is created in the current working directory or the directory specified with the filename.

functions.name: cdfEditScaleFactors
functions.description: Displays the Units Scaling Factors form which can be used to set scaling factors for displaying CDF parameters.

functions.name: cdfEnableScaleFactorRetentionForZero
functions.description: Lets you retain the unit scale factor for a CDF parameter if its specified default value is 0 followed by the scale factor. This is possible only when the scale factor for a unit type is set to auto.

functions.name: cdfFindParamByName

functions.name: cdfFormatFloatString
functions.description: This function formats the input string into a value representation, if possible. It formats the input string using the input scale factor, re-converts the value to a string, and then returns the formatted string value. If the input string cannot be converted, the input string is returned with no change to it.
