functions.name: cdfGetBaseLibCDF
functions.description: Returns the base-level CDF description attached to a library. If one is not defined, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfGetCellCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description attached to a cell. If neither a base- nor user-level CDF description is defined for the cell or its library, it returns nil. The resulting CDF description represents the overlay of the user-level cell CDF on the base-level cell CDF on the user-level library CDF on the base-level library CDF.

functions.name: cdfGetCustomViaCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description associated with a custom via or returns nil. When the custom via's cell or library has a base or user-level CDF defined, it returns the g_cdfDataId, otherwise returns nil.

functions.name: cdfGetInstCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description associated with an instance.

functions.name: cdfGetLibCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description attached to a library. If neither a base- nor user-level CDF description is defined, it returns nil. The resulting CDF description represents the overlay of the user-level CDF on the base-level CDF.

functions.name: cdfGetUnitScaleFactor
functions.description: Displays the current scale factor for the specified unit.

functions.name: cdfGetUserCellCDF
functions.description: Returns the user-level CDF description attached to a cell. If one is not defined, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfGetUserLibCDF
functions.description: Returns the user-level CDF description attached to a library. If one is not defined, it returns nil.

functions.description: Updates the CDF structure in the memory for the specified library or cell Id with the contents stored on the hard disk. Returns nil if the CDF structures for the specified library and cell ID are not present in memory.

functions.name: cdfSaveCDF
functions.description: Saves a CDF description to disk. The CDF description is then read in every time you open the cell of the library to which the description is attached. You can save only base-level CDF descriptions.

If a doneProc post-processing procedure is specified, the function runs this procedure to validate any updates to the instance. When the ID given is not for an instance or the instance master does not have CDF definition, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfUpdateInstSingleParam

functions.description: Disables device checking. It is the same as turning off the Enable Device Checking check box in the Device Checking Setup form. No checks are written to Spectre input file. No device checking happens.

functions.description: This function plots acpr and spectrum masks if you select one of standards defined in Channel Definitions on envlp result Direct Plot form. These masks confirm that the acpr reaches the mask requirement defined in communication standards.

functions.name: drplEvmBpsk
functions.syntax: drplEvmBpsk( o_waveform1 o_waveform2 n_tDelay n_sampling b_autoLevelDetect n_voltage n_offset b_normalize [ ?percent b_percent ] ) => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatterplot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the two possible I and Q symbol combinations, and calculating the difference between the signal level and the ideal signal level. Compared to other types of phase shift keying, such as QPSK, QAM16 and QAM64, BPSK has lowest bit error rate for the same signal to noise ratio.

functions.description: Calculates cycle-to-cycle jitter from the result of pnoise analysis for a single event. where noisetype is set as pmjitter, or from the result of pnoise analysis of oscillators where noiseout is set as [pm].

functions.name: drplRFValueAt

functions.name: evmOFDM
functions.syntax: evmOFDM( o_waveform1 o_waveform2 e_sigStandard n_tstart e_modulationType n_fftSize n_PrefixLength n_SymbolPeriod [ ?packet n_packetLength ] [ ?modifier e_modifier ] [ ?skiplength n_skiplength ] [ ?idx n_idx ] [ ?getval g_getval ] ) => constellation o_waveform evm_value / nil
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the hb-envlp simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatterplot (constellation). EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a modern high throughput modulation scheme widely used in wireless signals, such as 802.11a,g,n, where EVM measurement is useful . The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to constellation points of each modulation type (can be BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, and 64QAM) and calculating the difference between the signal level and the ideal signal level.

functions.name: maeGetMTSMode
functions.description: Indicates whether the locally scoped models and options (MTS options) are enabled for the specified test.

functions.name: maeGetMappingForJobAndPoint
functions.description: Returns a list containing the mapping of job IDs to the point IDs allocated to them for all the simulations run in the current ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler session. After starting a simulation run, you can use this information to debug incomplete simulations.

functions.name: maeGetNBestDesignPoints
functions.description: Returns the best design points for the opened results.

functions.name: maeGetNumberOfExecutedRuns
functions.description: Returns the number of runs executed in the flow. It only counts a run that has been completed, partial runs are not included. This is exclusive for the fault dropping flow.

functions.name: maeGetNumberOfUndetectedFaultsFromHistory
functions.description: Returns the list of undetected faults for the history provided.

functions.name: maeGetOutputValue
functions.syntax: maeGetOutputValue( t_outputName t_testName [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?pointId x_pointId ] [ ?evalType t_evalType ] ) => x_value / nil
functions.description: Returns value of the given output.

functions.name: maeGetOverallSpecStatus
functions.description: Returns the overall specification status for the current history.

functions.name: maeGetOverallYield
functions.description: Returns the overall yield for the given history.

functions.name: maeGetParamConditions
functions.description: Returns the design parameter conditions for the given design point ID.

functions.name: maeGetParameter
functions.syntax: maeGetParameter( t_paramName [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue t_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t_value / nil
functions.description: Returns value of the given parameter for the given test or corner.

functions.name: maeGetReferenceHistories
functions.description: Returns a list of names of the reference histories used in the active setup or the given history.

functions.name: maeGetReliabilityAnalysisEnabled
functions.description: Returns the current status of the Reliability Analyses node in the active setup or in the specific run of a run plan.

functions.name: maeGetReliabilityModel
functions.syntax: maeGetReliabilityModel( t_relxSetupName [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => l_modelFile / nil
functions.description: Returns the model file settings used for the specified reliability setup in the active setup or in the specific run of a run plan.

functions.name: maeGetReliabilityOptionVal
functions.syntax: maeGetReliabilityOptionVal( t_relxSetupName s_varName [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t_varValue / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified reliability option in a reliability setup.

functions.name: maeGetReliabilityVarValue
functions.syntax: maeGetReliabilityVarValue( t_relxSetupName t_varName [ ?varType t_varType ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t_varValue / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified variable used in the fresh, stress, or aged test in a reliability setup.

functions.name: maeGetRelxSetupEnabled
functions.syntax: maeGetRelxSetupEnabled( t_relxSetupName [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Returns the current status of a reliability setup in the active setup or in the specific run of a run plan.

functions.name: maeGetRelxSetups
functions.syntax: maeGetRelxSetups( [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] ) => l_relxSetups / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of reliability setups saved in the active setup or in the specific run of a run plan.

functions.name: maeGetRelxStressFile
functions.syntax: maeGetRelxStressFile( t_relxSetupName [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t_stressFile / nil
functions.description: Returns the stress file used in the specified reliability setup in the active setup or in the specific run of a run plan.

functions.name: maeGetRelxTest
functions.syntax: maeGetRelxTest( t_relxSetupName [ ?testType t_testType ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t_testName / nil
functions.description: Returns the name of the test used in the fresh, stress, or aged stage of a reliability setup.

functions.name: maeGetRelxTestEnabled
functions.syntax: maeGetRelxTestEnabled( t_relxSetupName [ ?testType t_testType ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Returns the current status of a reliability stage in the specified reliability setup.

functions.name: maeGetResultOutputs
functions.description: Returns the list of outputs for the opened result.

functions.name: maeGetResultTests
functions.description: Returns a list of tests for the opened result.

functions.name: maeGetResultsViewSelectedCellsDetails
functions.description: Returns a list of data point ID, test name, and output name for each result value selected in the Detail, Detail-Transpose, or Fault results view of the currently visible run history. If the selected cell is in the column that does not show any results value, for example, Test or Output, no data is returned from that.

functions.name: maeGetRunPlan
functions.syntax: maeGetRunPlan( [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?historyName t_historyName ] [ ?enabled t_enabled ] ) => l_runPlanNames / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the runs available in the run plan for the given session or history.

functions.name: maeGetSessions
functions.description: Returns a list of valid ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler sessions that are currently open.

functions.name: maeGetSetup
functions.syntax: maeGetSetup( [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => l_setupDetails / nil
functions.description: Returns the required setup details of variables, parameters, corners, and tests from the given session.

functions.name: maeGetSetupLibrary
functions.description: Retrieves the setup library view from the current or specified session.

functions.name: maeGetSimOption
functions.syntax: maeGetSimOption( t_testName [ ?option t_optionName ] [ ?includeEmpty g_includeEmpty ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => l_options / nil
functions.description: Returns a list containing name-value pairs for the simulator options for the given test. By default, it returns all the simulator options whose value is not nil. If the includeEmpty argument is set to t, it returns all the simulator options. If a specific option is specified, the function returns the value of only that option.

functions.name: maeGetSimulationMessages
functions.description: Displays an error message of the given type during the simulation run.

functions.name: maeGetSpecStatus
functions.syntax: maeGetSpecStatus( t_outputName t_testName [ ?pointId n_pointId ] ) => pass / fail / undefined
functions.description: Returns the specification status for the given output, test and point id.

functions.name: maeGetStressFile
functions.syntax: maeGetStressFile( t_relxSetupName [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?historyName t_historyName ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?matchParams l_matchParams ] ) => t_output / nil
functions.description: Returns the path of the stress file to be reused from the specified reliability setup.

functions.name: maeGetTags
functions.description: Returns a list of tags assigned to the specified corners or variables in the given session.

functions.name: maeGetTestEnvVar
functions.syntax: maeGetTestEnvVar( t_testName t_varName [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified environment variable for the given test. This function can be used to get the value set for a particular test using the maeSetTestEnvVar function.

functions.name: maeGetTestOutputs
functions.description: Returns the list of outputs for the specified test in the current session or a specific maestro session.

functions.name: maeGetTestSession
functions.description: Returns session handle to the given test. You can use this handle to view or modify the test details.

functions.name: maeGetVar
functions.syntax: maeGetVar( t_varname [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue t_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t_value / nil
functions.description: Returns value of the given variable. Use this function to get the global, test-level, or corner value for the given variable.

functions.name: maeHasTestJobPolicy
functions.description: Checks if the given test has a test-specific job policy setup.

functions.name: maeImportHistory
functions.syntax: maeImportHistory( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?history t_historyName ] [ ?copyPSF g_copyPSF ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Imports the zip file for the given history from one cellview into the current cellview.

functions.name: maeImportSetupForExplorer
functions.description: Displays the Import Setup form in ADE Explorer, which you can use to import a saved maestro cellview in the current setup. This is a callback function.

functions.name: maeIsEvaluatorProcess
functions.description: Returns t if currently the expression evaluator service process is running for ADE Assembler or ADE Explorer. You can use this function in your .cdsinit file or in custom SKILL code.

functions.name: maeIsFinalRunCompleted
functions.description: Checks if the current run is the last run executed in the run plan. A run is said to be the last run if either no further runs exist in the run plan or no undetected faults are found in the current run.

functions.name: maeIsFirstRunInRunPlan
functions.description: Checks if the current run is the first run executed in the run plan. Implemented exclusively for the fault dropping flow.

functions.name: maeIsNetlistProcess
functions.description: Returns t if currently the netlister service process is running for ADE Assembler or ADE Explorer. You can use this function in your .cdsinit file or in custom SKILL code.

functions.name: maeIsPrerunScriptEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether pre-run scripts are enabled for a test in the given maestro session.

functions.name: maeIsSetupModified
functions.description: Checks whether the setup has been modified after the last time it was saved in the given maestro session.

functions.name: maeIsSingleTest
functions.syntax: maeIsSingleTest( t_libraryName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Returns t if the given cellview contains a single test or multiple tests.

functions.name: maeIsValidMaestroSession
functions.description: Confirms if the given session is valid for ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler.

functions.name: maeLoadCorners
functions.syntax: maeLoadCorners( t_fileName  [?operation t_operation] [?session t_session] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Loads corners from the given file into the corner setup of the current session or the specified session.

functions.name: maeLoadSetupState
functions.syntax: maeLoadSetupState( t_stateName [ ?tags l_tagNames ]  [ ?operation s_operationName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]) ) => t_sessionName / nil
functions.description: Loads the given setup state into the given session.

functions.name: maeLoadStateForTest
functions.syntax: maeLoadStateForTest( t_testName t_stateName [ ?session t_session ] [ ?loadFrom s_loadFrom ] [ ?statePath s_statePath ] [ ?libName t_libName ] [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?simulator t_simulatorName ] [ ?component l_componentList ] ) => t_sessionName / nil
functions.description: Loads the saved ADE state for the given test.

functions.name: maeMakeEditable
functions.description: Changes the mode of an already open cellview from read-only to editable.

functions.name: maeMakeReadonly
functions.description: Changes the mode of an already open cellview from editable to read-only.

functions.name: maeMergeFaultHistories
functions.syntax: maeMergeFaultHistories( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?historiesToMerge l_historiesToMerge ]  [ ?finalHistoryName t_finalHistoryName ]  [ ?logFile t_logFile ]  ) => t/ nil
functions.description: Merges fault histories into one.

functions.name: maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro
functions.syntax: maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro( t_stateLib t_stateCell t_stateName [ ?maestroLib t_maestroLib ] [ ?maestroCell  t_maestroCell ] [ ?maestroView t_maestroView ] [ ?migrateFrom s_migrateFrom ] [ ?statePath t_statePath ] [ ?simulator t_simulator ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] ) => l_cellviewDetails / nil
functions.description: Migrates the given ADE L state to a maestro cellview that can be opened in ADE Explorer.

functions.name: maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro
functions.syntax: maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro( t_stateLib t_stateCell t_stateName [ ?maestroLib t_maestroLib ] [ ?maestroCell  t_maestroCell ] [ ?maestroView t_maestroView ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] [ ?skipHistory g_skipHistory ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Migrates the given ADE XL view to a new maestro cellview that can be opened in ADE Assembler.

functions.name: maeOpenLogViewer
functions.description: Opens the Log Viewer window, where you can view the messages loaded from a database.

functions.name: maeOpenResults
functions.syntax: maeOpenResults( [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?history t_historyName ] [ ?run t_runName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Opens the result for the given history or run plan, and sets the result pointer to be used by other functions.

functions.name: maeOpenSetup
functions.syntax: maeOpenSetup( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?application t_applicationName ] [ ?histName t_historyName ] [ ?mode t_mode ] ) => t_sessionName / nil
functions.description: Loads the given cellview and restores the setup details from the specified history. If no history name is specified, the active setup is loaded. If the specified view is already opened in the current Virtuoso session, it is not opened again. However, if the view is already open in some other Virtuoso session, it is opened in read mode in the current session. If the given cellview does not exist, the function creates a new cellview with the same name.

functions.name: maeOpenViolationDb
functions.syntax: maeOpenViolationDb( t_sessionName t_testName t_historyName ) => x_dbId / nil
functions.description: Opens a connection to the checks and asserts database for the given maestro cellview and returns a unique ID for the connection. You can use this ID to read or modify the database and its attached waiver SQL database using other SKILL functions. You must close this connection using maeCloseViolationDb to release the connection and complete the transactions on the database.

functions.name: maePlotWithPlottingTemplate
functions.syntax: maePlotWithPlottingTemplate( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?history t_historyName ]  [ ?replaceMode t_replaceMode ]  [ ?name t_templateName ]   ) => l_windowsPlotted / nil
functions.description: Plots the results for the given history using the specified plotting template.

functions.name: maePrintFaultDroppingStatistics
functions.description: Prints the formatted results obtained after execution of the fault dropping flow. It also writes the same to the log file in the current work directory. This is exclusive for the fault dropping flow.

functions.name: maeReadResDB
functions.syntax: maeReadResDB( [ ?historyName t_historyName ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?run t_runName ] ) => h_resultsDBObj / nil
functions.description: Returns a handle to the results database for the given history.

functions.name: maeRefreshViolationDisplay
functions.description: Refreshes the Checks/Asserts results view. When it is already open and the database is modified, use this function to refresh the displayed results.

functions.name: maeRegTimer
functions.description: Registers or sets a timer to initialize the specified SKILL function after the given time has elapsed during simulation. This timer can be used in ADE interface job customization.

functions.name: maeRenameRelxSetup
functions.syntax: maeRenameRelxSetup( t_relxSourceName t_relxDestName [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Renames a reliability setup with the specified name.

functions.name: maeResetCornerEditingOptions
functions.description: Resets the Corners Setup form to its state before maeSetCornerEditingOptions was applied.

functions.name: maeRestoreHistory
functions.description: Restores the given history as the active setup.

functions.name: maeResumeSimulation
functions.description: Resumes the simulations that were earlier suspended automatically by ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler according to the settings specified on the Resources tab of the Job Policy Setup form.

functions.name: maeRunDspfChecker
functions.description: Runs the Spf Checker utility for the tests that have DSPF files in the setup.

functions.name: maeRunFaultSimulationWithFaultDroppingForActiveTests
functions.description: Runs the fault dropping flow in batch mode for the enabled tests in the given session.

functions.name: maeRunLogDiagnostics
functions.syntax: maeRunLogDiagnostics( [ ?session t_session ] [ ?lib t_libName ] [ ?cell t_cellName ] [ ?view t_viewName ] [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?historyName t_historyName ] [ ?points l_points ] [ ?testNames l_testNames ] [ ?checks l_checks ] [ ?jobs x_jobs ] [ ?tolerance x_tolerance ]  [ ?display g_display ]  [ ?log t_log ]  ) => x_ID / nil
functions.description: Runs a list of checks on the log files for the specified history and generates the ADE Diagnostics report. Troubleshooting simulation errors using log files can be a difficult task because ADE Assembler saves multiple log files that are generated by different components of the LSCS architecture. The ADE diagnostics reports provides a detailed analysis of such errors and helps in debugging.

functions.name: maeRunSimulation
functions.syntax: maeRunSimulation( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?runMode t_runMode ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?run t_runPlan ] [ ?waitUntilDone g_waitUntilDone ] [ ?returnRunId g_returnRunId ] ) => t_histname / x_runID / nil
functions.description: Sets the given run mode for the given session and runs simulation.

functions.name: maeSaveFaultsRunCount
functions.description: Saves the faults count globally for further use. If a fault count already exists, it adds the provided value to the existing value. This is exclusive for the fault dropping flow.

functions.name: maeSaveImagesUsingPlottingTemplate
functions.syntax: maeSaveImagesUsingPlottingTemplate( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?history t_historyName ]  [ ?replaceMode t_replaceMode ]  [ ?name t_templateName ]  [ ?dir t_dirPath ]  [ ?saveEachSubwindowSeparately t_saveEachSubwindowSeparately ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Plots and saves the results for the given history using the specified plotting template.

functions.name: maeSaveSetup
functions.syntax: maeSaveSetup( [ ?lib t_libName ]  [ ?cell t_cellName ] [ ?view t_viewName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the setup database file and test state files for the current session in the library, cell, view format. The behavior of this function is similar to File - Save. It is recommended to run this function after making changes in the setup.

functions.name: maeSaveSetupState
functions.syntax: maeSaveSetupState( t_stateName [ ?tags l_tagNames ]  [ ?inReadOnly s_readOnlyAction ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a setup state for the given session.

functions.name: maeSaveSetupStateForOptimization
functions.syntax: maeSaveSetupStateForOptimization( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?setupState t_setupState ] [ ?pointID x_pointID ] [ ?historyName t_historyName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the setup state for optimization from the best design point of a run or the given history. You can use this saved state as the starting point for an optimization run in a run plan.

functions.name: maeSensDeleteModel
functions.description: Deletes the specified model from the setup for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensDeleteModelGroup
functions.description: Deletes all the model groups specified in the Model Groups setting on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensDeleteParameter
functions.description: Deletes the specified parameter from the setup for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensDeleteVar
functions.description: Deletes the specified variable from the setup for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session. You can also use this function to delete the value for the Temperature field in the Sensitivity form.

functions.name: maeSensEnableDesignVariation
functions.description: Selects or deselects the Enable Design and PVT Variation check box on the Sensitivity form for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensEnableStatVariation
functions.description: Selects or deselects the Enable Variation of Statistical Parameters check box in the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensGetModel
functions.description: Returns a list of valid values and the nominal value for the specified model from the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensGetModelGroup
functions.description: Returns a list of values specified in the Model Groups setting on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensGetModels
functions.description: Returns a list containing the names of all enabled models on the Sensitivity form for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensGetParameter
functions.description: Returns a list of valid values and the nominal value for the specified parameter from the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensGetParameters
functions.description: Returns a list of all enabled parameters on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensGetVar
functions.description: Returns a list of valid values and the nominal value for the specified global variable from the Sensitivity form for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensGetVars
functions.description: Returns a list containing the names of all enabled global variables, including Temperature, on the Sensitivity form for the Sensitivity Analysis run mode in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensSetMethod
functions.description: Sets the value in the Method field on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensSetModel
functions.syntax: maeSensSetModel( t_modelName g_modelValue [ ?nominalValue g_nominalValue ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?modelTest t_modelTest ]  [ ?modelblock t_modelBlock ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a model on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity Analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensSetModelGroup
functions.syntax: maeSensSetModelGroup( g_modelGroupValue [ ?nominalValue g_nominalValue ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a model group on the Sensitivity form for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeSensSetParameter
functions.syntax: maeSensSetParameter( t_parameterName g_parameterValue [ ?nominalValue g_nominalValue ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a parameter on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session. If a parameter already exists with the given name, its value is updated.

functions.name: maeSensSetVar
functions.syntax: maeSensSetVar( t_varName g_varValue [ ?nominalValue g_nominalValue ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a global variable to the run options for the Sensitivity analysis run mode in the current or the specified maestro session. If a global variable already exists with the specified name, its value is updated. You can also use this function to change the value of Temperature.

functions.name: maeSetAnalysis
functions.syntax: maeSetAnalysis( t_testName t_analysis [ ?enable g_enabled ] [ ?options l_options ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds or removes an analysis for the given test. The function can also be used to set the value of different options for the analysis.

functions.name: maeSetCorner
functions.syntax: maeSetCorner( t_cornerName [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?enableTests l_enableTests ] [ ?disableTests l_disableTests ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new corner and enables/disables it for the given test.

functions.name: maeSetCornerEditingOptions
functions.syntax: maeSetCornerEditingOptions( [ ?cornerNameFilter g_FilterName ] [ ?session g_sessionName ] [ ?removeVarList g_VarList ] [ ?removeDuplicates {t|nil}] [ ?removeUndefined {t|nil}]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the options for editing the corners setup. These settings are reflected in the Corners Setup form, when the options Import Corners from CSV File and Import Corners from SDB File are used.

functions.name: maeSetCurrentRunMode
functions.description: Updates the current run mode in ADE Assembler.

functions.name: maeSetDUTForFaults
functions.syntax: maeSetDUTForFaults( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified design under test for the fault setup.

functions.name: maeSetDesign
functions.syntax: maeSetDesign( t_testName t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t_testName / nil
functions.description: Sets a design for the given test. Use this function to change the design associated to a test.

functions.name: maeSetEnableTestVar
functions.syntax: maeSetEnableTestVar( t_testName l_variableNames [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the specified variables or local sweeps for the given test.

functions.name: maeSetEnvOption
functions.syntax: maeSetEnvOption( t_testName [ ?options l_options ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets values for one or more environment options for the given test.

functions.name: maeSetFaultAnalysisType
functions.description: Sets the analysis type for the fault simulation run mode.

functions.name: maeSetFaultDFARunModeOptions
functions.syntax: maeSetFaultDFARunModeOptions( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?extraOptions t_extraOptions ]  [ ?runNominal g_runNominal ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the run mode options for the Direct Fault Analysis (DFA) to be run for fault simulation.

functions.name: maeSetFaultGroupToRun
functions.description: Sets the fault group to run for the active fault setup.

functions.name: maeSetFaultSamplingOptions
functions.syntax: maeSetFaultSamplingOptions( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?enableSampling g_enableSampling ]  [ ?samplingMethod t_samplingMethod ]  [ ?sampleByNumOrRatio t_sampleByNumOrRatio ]  [ ?sampleNum t_sampleNum ]  [ ?sampleRatio t_sampleRatio ]  [ ?seedValue t_seedValue ]  [ ?confidenceValue t_confidenceValue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the sampling options for the fault setup.

functions.name: maeSetFaultTFARunModeOptions
functions.syntax: maeSetFaultTFARunModeOptions ( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?extraOptions t_extraOptions ]  [ ?simulationMethod t_simulationMethod ]  [ ?maxIterations t_maxIterations ]  [ ?leadTime t_leadTime ]  [ ?faultPointsMethod t_faultPointsMethod ]  [ ?faultTimePoints g_faultTimePoints ]  [ ?start_step_stop l_start_step_stop ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the run mode options for Transient Fault Analysis to be run for fault simulation.

functions.name: maeSetGlobalFaultOptions
functions.syntax: maeSetGlobalFaultOptions ( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?defaultBridgeResistance t_defaultBridgeResistance ]  [ ?defaultOpenResistance t_defaultOpenResistance]  [ ?defaultStuckAtResistance t_defaultStuckAtResistance ]  [ ?stuckAtGround t_stuckAtGround ]  [ ?stuckAtSupply t_stuckAtSupply ]  [ ?defaultWeightExpr t_defaultWeightExpr ]  [ ?defaultWeightFactor t_defaultWeightFactor ]  [ ?defaultIndividualFaultWeight t_defaultIndividualFaultWeight ]  [ ?applyFaultCollapsing t_applyFaultCollapsing ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets global preferences for fault simulations.

functions.name: maeSetHistoryLock
functions.syntax: maeSetHistoryLock( t_historyName  g_lock [ ?session t_sessionName ]) => t / nil
functions.description: Locks or unlocks the given history for the given ADE Assembler session.

functions.name: maeSetJobControlMode
functions.description: Sets the job control mode in the given session.

functions.name: maeSetJobPolicy
functions.syntax: maeSetJobPolicy ( g_jobPolicyDPL [ ?testName t_testName ] [ ?jobType t_jobType ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the given job policy to the specified setup for the given test.

functions.name: maeSetMTSBlock
functions.syntax: maeSetMTSBlock( t_testName [ ?lib t_lib ] [ ?cell t_cell ] [ ?inst t_instName ] [ ?enable g_enable ] [ ?modelFiles l_modelFiles ] [ ?simOptions l_simOptions ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?mode t_mode ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables local scoping for the specified library cell (block) or instance and sets the specified MTS options. This includes the models files to be scoped locally and the process parameters, such as scale and temp to be included in the simulation locally.

functions.name: maeSetMTSMode
functions.syntax: maeSetMTSMode( t_testName [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ @rest g_mtsMode ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables the locally scoped models and options (MTS options) for the specified test.

functions.name: maeSetParameter
functions.syntax: maeSetParameter( t_parameterName g_parameterValue [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue l_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new parameter at the global level or corner level. If the parameter already exists, its value is updated.

functions.name: maeSetPreRunScript
functions.syntax: maeSetPreRunScript( t_scriptName [ ?tests l_testNames ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the given script as a pre-run script for the given test and sets its status.

functions.name: maeSetReliabilityAnalysisEnabled
functions.syntax: maeSetReliabilityAnalysisEnabled( g_enabled [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the status of Reliability Analyses node to the specified value.

functions.name: maeSetReliabilityModel
functions.syntax: maeSetReliabilityModel( t_relxSetupName l_value [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the model files to be used in the specified reliability setup.

functions.name: maeSetReliabilityOptionVal
functions.syntax: maeSetReliabilityOptionVal( t_relxSetupName s_varName t_varValue [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified reliability option in a reliability setup.

functions.name: maeSetReliabilityVarValue
functions.syntax: maeSetReliabilityVarValue( t_relxSetupName t_varName t_varValue [ ?varType t_varType ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified variable used in the fresh, stress, or aged test in a reliability setup.

functions.name: maeSetRelxSetupEnabled
functions.syntax: maeSetRelxSetupEnabled( t_relxSetupName g_enabled [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables a reliability setup in the active setup or in the specific run of a run plan.

functions.name: maeSetRelxStressFile
functions.syntax: maeSetRelxStressFile( t_relxSetupName t_stressFile [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the stress file to be used in the specified reliability setup in the active setup or in the specific run of a run plan.

functions.name: maeSetRelxTest
functions.syntax: maeSetRelxTest( t_relxSetupName t_testName [ ?testType t_testType ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the name of the fresh, stress, or aged test used in the specified reliability setup.

functions.name: maeSetRelxTestEnabled
functions.syntax: maeSetRelxTestEnabled( t_relxSetupName g_enabled [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?session t_session ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables a reliability stage in the specified reliability setup.

functions.name: maeSetRunOption
functions.syntax: maeSetRunOption( t_mode t_runOptionName t_runOptionValue [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value for a run option.

functions.name: maeSetSetup
functions.syntax: maeSetSetup( [ ?tests l_testNames ] [ ?variables l_variables ] [ ?parameters l_params ] [ ?corners l_corners ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the tests, global variables, parameters, and corners.

functions.name: maeSetSetupLibrary
functions.syntax: maeSetSetupLibrary( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Connects the provided setup library view to the maestro view.

functions.name: maeSetSimOption
functions.syntax: maeSetSimOption( t_testName  [ ?options l_options ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets values for the specified simulator options of the given test. Multiple options can be specified in a single command.

functions.name: maeSetSpec
functions.syntax: maeSetSpec ( t_outputName t_testName [ ?minimum g_minValue ] [ ?maximum g_maxValue ] [ ?gt g_greaterThanValue ] [ ?lt g_lessThanValue ] [ ?range g_rangeValues ] [ ?tolerance g_toleranceValue ] [ ?info g_info ] [ ?weight g_weightingFactor ] [ ?corner g_cornerName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a specification to an output defined for a test. You can also use this function to modify an existing specification for an output.

functions.name: maeSetStartingPointForOptimization
functions.syntax: maeSetStartingPointForOptimization( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?setupState t_setupState ] [ ?runMode t_runMode ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the given setup state as the starting point for the Local Optimization or Global Optimization run mode in the specified run.

functions.name: maeSetTags
functions.syntax: maeSetTags( [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?variables l_variables ] [ ?corners l_corners ] [ ?tags l_tags ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Assigns the given tags to the specified corners and variables. You can also append to or overwrite the existing tags.

functions.name: maeSetTestEnvVar
functions.syntax: maeSetTestEnvVar( t_testName t_varName g_varValue [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for the given environment variable at the test level. The value is used only by the specified test. Other tests in the session use the value set at the global level or specific values set for them, if any.

functions.name: maeSetVar
functions.syntax: maeSetVar( t_varname g_valValue [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue l_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a variable to the given test or corner in the given ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler session. If the variable already exists, its value is updated.

functions.name: maeStmConsolidateStimuli
functions.syntax: maeStmConsolidateStimuli( t_libName  t_cellName t_viewName ?reportFile t_reportFile ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes duplicate stimuli definitions from the given cellview. For this, ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler reviews each test in the cellview and, if required, reassigns pins and globals by removing duplicates.

functions.name: maeStmGenerateWaveforms
functions.syntax: maeStmGenerateWaveforms( t_libName  t_cellName t_viewName [ ?test t_testName ] [ ?reportFile t_reportFile ] [ ?force g_force ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates preview stimuli waveforms for the stimuli added for a maestro cellview that contains stimuli definitions added through the Stimuli Assignment form. These stimuli definitions are saved in the file lib-name/cell-name/view-name/namedStimuli/stimuli.xml.

functions.name: maeStopAllJobs
functions.syntax: maeStopAllJobs( [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?jobType t_jobType ] [ ?force g_force ] [ ?exitCode t_exitCode ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Stops all the simulation or netlisting jobs you started during the current session regardless of their state (started, getting configured, running).

functions.name: maeStopJob
functions.syntax: maeStopJob( [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?jobType t_jobType ] [ ?force g_force ] [ ?exitCode t_exitCode ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Stops the job for the specified job ID regardless of its state.

functions.name: maeStopSimulation
functions.description: Stops simulation runs for the given histories.

functions.name: maeSuspendSimulation
functions.description: Suspends the simulation run for the specified session. If not specified, the current simulation run is suspended.

functions.name: maeSwitchActiveFaultGroupForCurrentRun
functions.description: Sets the fault group to run for the current run in run plan. This is exclusive to the fault dropping flow.

functions.name: maeUnWaiveViolation
functions.syntax: maeUnWaiveViolation( x_dbId [?objectName t_objectName] [?objectType t_objectType] [?checkerName t_checkerName] [?analysisName t_analysisName] [?time t_time] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes from the waivers SQL database a waive rule matching the given criteria.

functions.name: maeUpdateImplicitSignals
functions.description: Updates the implicit signals for the tests in the specified maestro session.

functions.name: maeWaitUntilDone
functions.description: Specifies the names of historic checkpoints for which the tool must wait before proceeding.

functions.name: maeWaiveViolation
functions.syntax: maeWaiveViolation( x_dbId [?objectName t_objectName] [?objectType t_objectType] [?checkerName t_checkerName] [?analysisName t_analysisName] [?time t_time] [?comment t_comment] [?historyName t_historyName] [?designPoint x_designPoint] [?corner t_cornerName]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a rule to the waivers SQL database that waives a check and assert for the given object.

functions.name: maeWriteDatasheet
functions.syntax: maeWriteDatasheet( [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?resultsSummary g_resultsSummary ] [ ?testsSummary g_testsSummary ] [ ?detailedResults g_detailedResults ] [ ?plots g_points ] [ ?designVarsSummary g_designVarsSummary ] [ ?paramsSummary g_paramsSummary ] [ ?cornersSummary g_cornersSummary ] [ ?setupSummary g_setupSummary ] [ ?launchBrowser g_launchBrowser ] [ ?name t_name ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?historyName t_historyName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Writes the results for the given history in a datasheet.

functions.name: maeWriteScript
functions.syntax: maeWriteScript( t_fileName [ ?session t_session ] [ ?shouldRunActive g_shouldRunActive ]  [ ?runPlans l_runPlans ]  [ ?histories l_histories ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a script with the specified setup details. This script can be run from the command line.

functions.name: measureAcross
functions.syntax: measureAcross( t_expression [ ?parameters l_parameters ] ) => x_scalar / o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the given calculator expression across the parameters provided in the parameter list. Use this function only when you are creating expressions for outputs that can be evaluated across any dimension. These expressions have their eval type as any. If you specify this expression for other eval types, the parameter list is ignored.

functions.name: msgHelp
functions.description: This function is used to access extended help for an error or a warning message. Currently, Distributed Processing (DP) is the only product that supports this feature.

functions.name: mspDisplaySetPartSetupForm
functions.description: This function displays the Partitions Options form, which can be used to edit and set the values for the Analog Stop View Set and Digital Stop View Set.

functions.name: mspEditIEProps
functions.description: This is the main entry procedure for the Interface Element property editor. It takes an object type. The object type can be one of instTerm, instance, terminal, cellView, lib, or default.

functions.name: nlDisplayOption
functions.description: Prints the option names available on this object along with their values.

functions.name: nlError
functions.description: Issues a user error. The error is printed immediately and it is collected on the object. In this way, if netlisting is interrupted, the user is aware of any errors that occurred during netlisting. All errors are printed to the netlist log file.

functions.name: nlGetCdf
functions.description: Obtains the CDF information of the IE cell. CDF information contains the default IE parameter, default IE macro model file name and parameter mapping from CDF to simulator specific names.

functions.name: nlGetCellName
functions.description: Gets the cell name of the specified instance.

functions.name: nlGetCurrentSwitchMaster
functions.description: This function returns the database ID for the current switch master for the instance in hierarchical incremental netlisting. This function should only be used while printing the instance statement. Avoid using this function if possible.

functions.name: nlGetDesign
functions.description: Returns the design object.

functions.name: nlGetFormatter
functions.description: Returns the formatter.

functions.name: nlGetGlobalNets
functions.description: Returns a list of global nets. This method should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter.

functions.name: nlGetId
functions.description: Returns the database ID for the instance. If the instance represents a cdba instance, this is a database ID.

functions.name: nlGetLibName
functions.description: Gets the library name of the specified instance.

functions.name: nlGetModelName
functions.description: This method must be used to obtain the model name of an instance. Use of this method assures consistency in netlisting across interfaces. For instances that represent subcircuits, this method returns a name chosen by the netlister, using the modulePrefix netlist option.

functions.name: nlGetNetlistDir
functions.description: Returns the netlist directory.

functions.name: nlGetNetlistedStopCellViewList
functions.description: Returns a list of cellview objects treated as stop cells for the specified netlister object.

functions.name: nlGetNetlister
functions.description: Returns an object representing the netlister.

functions.name: nlGetNumberOfBits
functions.description: Returns the number of bits on the instance and terminal specified.

functions.name: nlGetOption
functions.description: Returns the value of the option.

functions.name: nlGetOptionNameList
functions.description: Returns a list of option names available on this object.

functions.name: nlGetPCellParamSource
functions.description: Identifies the source of value of the Pcell parameters of the given cellview.

functions.name: nlGetParamList
functions.description: Returns the list of parameters of the specified instance or cellview.

functions.name: nlGetParamStringValue
functions.description: Returns a string representing the parameter value for the instance and parameter name.

functions.name: nlGetScratchInstPcellParamValue
functions.description: Returns the parameter value of the scratch instance to be used for Pcell evaluations.

functions.name: nlGetScratchInstance
functions.syntax: nlGetScratchInstance( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_instanceName ) => d_databaseID / nil
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the scratch instance to be used for Pcell evaluations.

functions.name: nlGetSignalList
functions.description: Returns a list of mapped signal names for the instance according to the terminal order specified for the cellview.

functions.name: nlGetSimName
functions.description: If the input type is cellview object, then returns the simulator name of the subcircuit. If the input type is instance object, then returns the mapped name of the instance. The name returned depends on the useInstNamePrefix netlist option. When it is not set, the name prefix is not taken into account. However, for instances representing interface elements, the name prefix is always taken into account. No mapping is performed for interface elements.

functions.name: nlGetSimTerminalNets
functions.description: Returns the list of mapped names of signals connecting to the terminals of the cellview based on the terminal order specified for the cellview. Several signals may come from inherited connections.  Signal buses are handled in scalar form.

functions.name: nlGetSwitchMaster
functions.syntax: nlGetSwitchMaster( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_instanceName t_deviceParamName ) => d_databaseID / nil
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the switch master.

functions.name: nlGetSwitchViewList
functions.description: Returns the switch view list for the cellView.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalList
functions.description: Returns a list of terminal names in the order specified on the pin order property on the schematic, or on the termOrder property on the CDF, or on the cellview of the instance, in that order.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalNets
functions.description: Returns the schematic names of the signals connected to the terminals. Many of the signals may come from inherited connections.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalSignalName
functions.description: Returns the name of the signal connected to the terminal.

functions.name: nlGetToolName
functions.description: Returns a symbol representing the simulator. It returns the value of the tool name. This name is used for the selection of the simulator information on the library component.

functions.name: nlGetTopCellName
functions.description: Returns the cell name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetTopLibName
functions.description: Returns the library name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetTopViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the specified cellview object.

functions.name: nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile( o_formatter t_filename t_master ) => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the dspf_include statement for the DSPF type text cellview in the design.

functions.name: nlIncludeDbSPICEMODELTextFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for SPICEMODEL cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all SPICEMODEL modules. If your simulator does not support SPICEMODEL views, call the nlError function in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludePspiceFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludePspiceFile(  o_formatter  t_fileName  t_masterName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the include statement for pspice cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all pspice modules. If your simulator does not support pspice views, call nlError function in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeSrcFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for instances bound to source files using Hierarchy Editor. This is called while printing the footer for the netlist for all the source files to which any instance in the design is bound. If your simulator does not support source file bindings, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeVerilogFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludeVerilogFile(  o_formatter  t_filename  t_master )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the include statement for Verilog type text cell view in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all Verilog text cell views. If your simulator does not support Verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeVerilogaFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludeVerilogaFile(  o_formatter  t_filename  t_master )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the include statement for Verilog-a cell views in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all Verilog-a modules. If your simulator does not support Verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlInfo
functions.description: Sends an informational message to the calling application.

functions.name: nlInitialize
functions.description: For the nlFormatter class, this method initializes the netlister. This method can be redefined for the simulator-specific netlister and is called by nlCreateFormatter. This method initializes all simulator-specific aspects of netlisting such as name mapping. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, this method sets a number of netlist options. These options and their values are shown in the table below.

functions.name: nlIsModelNameInherited
functions.description: Returns t if the model name for the stopping instance is passed through the hierarchy through parameters.

functions.name: nlIsPcellInstance
functions.syntax: nlIsPcellInstance( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_instanceName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks if the specified instance name represents a schematic Pcell instance.

functions.name: nlIsPcellParam
functions.syntax: nlIsPcellParam( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_instanceName t_deviceParamName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks if the specified device parameter represents a Pcell parameter.

functions.name: nlIsSmartExtractedView
functions.description: Identifies if the currently netlisted cellview is of the type smart_view. You can use this function in custom netlist procedures to modify the syntax printed to the netlist as required. For example, you can modify the syntax to determine if the printing of parenthesis needs to be enabled or disabled when printing the port connections of the instance.

functions.name: nlMapGlobalNet
functions.description: Maps a global net (signal) to the simulator name. This should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter. Use at any other time is an error.

functions.name: nlObjError
functions.description: Similar to nlError, but prints a description of the object along with the error message. The description includes the library name, the cell name, the view name, and the instance name in case the object is an instance.

functions.name: nlPrintComment
functions.syntax: nlPrintComment(  o_netlister  [ t_arg1 t_arg2 ... ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints a comment.

functions.name: nlPrintComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the instance being netlisted.

functions.name: nlPrintFooter
functions.description: This method is called at the end of netlisting. It does not print anything at the end of the netlist for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

functions.name: nlPrintHeader
functions.description: This method writes the beginning comment, adds .GLOBAL, and prints header comments.

functions.name: nlPrintHeaderComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the netlist file, including the library, cell, and view names of the top-level cellview of the design netlisted. This method only has effect when the printFileComments netlist option is set.

functions.name: nlPrintIndentString
functions.description: Prints the indent string for the instance statement. When inside the top-level circuit, the empty string is printed. When inside subcircuit definitions, the value of the subcktIndentString netlist option is printed.

functions.name: nlPrintInst
functions.description: Prints the netlist statement for an instance. This is the default netlist procedure for a component.

functions.name: nlPrintInstComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for an instance.

functions.name: nlPrintInstEnd
functions.description: Prints the end of the instance statement, which is a return (\n). This method is called by the netlister after the netlist procedure or by nlPrintInst.

functions.name: nlPrintInstName
functions.description: Prints the simulator name of the instance, taking the instance name prefix specified on the component into account when the simulator so requires. This is determined with the useInstNamePrefix netlist option.

functions.name: nlPrintInstParameters
functions.description: Prints the instance parameters in name=value pairs.

functions.name: nlPrintInstSignals
functions.description: Prints the simulator names of the signals according to the terminal order specified on the component, using the nlGetSignalList method of the instance.

functions.name: nlPrintModelName
functions.description: Prints the model name. The nlGetModelName for the instance is used for the model name.

functions.name: nlPrintString
functions.description: Prints the string arguments to the file. This function does the required line folding, prefixing, and, postfixing.

functions.name: nlPrintStringNoFold
functions.description: Prints the string arguments to the file, like the function nlPrintString. This function does the required prefixing and postfixing, but does not fold the line until a newline character or maxLineLength is encountered. While in a 'no fold' print mode, calls cannot be made to nlPrintString.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktBegin
functions.description: Prints the .subckt keyword for the nlAnalogFormatter class. This method is called by nlSubcktHeader.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktEnd
functions.description: For the nlAnalogFormatter class, prints the .ends keyword, followed by a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit, to mark the end of the subcircuit definition. It is called by nlPrintSubcktFooter.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktFooter
functions.description: Writes the footer for the subcircuit. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, it prints .ends.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktFooterComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the subcircuit footer by printing the string 'End of subcircuit definition.' preceded by the comment begin string.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktHeader
functions.description: Writes the header for a subcircuit following these steps: prints comments by calling nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments; prints the subckt begin keyword by calling nlPrintSubcktBegin; prints the subckt name by calling nlPrintSubcktName; prints the subckt terminal list by calling nlPrintSubcktTerminalList.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the subcircuit header and the mapping information when the printSubcktComments option is set.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktName
functions.description: Prints a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit. This method is used by nlSubcktHeader.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktParameters
functions.description: Prints the passed parameters for the subcircuit definition.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktTerminalList
functions.description: Prints the simulator names of the signals connected to the terminals for a subcircuit definition and handles the signals resulting from inherited connections at a lower level .

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellFooter
functions.description: Writes the top cell view footer. This function prints an empty line and calls nlPrintTopCellFooterComments.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellFooterComments
functions.description: Returns t at the analogFormatter level.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellHeader
functions.description: Prints the header of the top-level circuit by calling nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments
functions.description: Calls nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

functions.name: nlSetOption
functions.syntax: nlSetOption(  o_netlister  s_option  g_value  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an option value.

functions.name: nlSetPcellName
functions.syntax: nlSetPcellName( S_cv t_paramNames g_paramValues ) => t / nil
functions.description: Define this function if the default generic OSS naming convention for Pcells needs to be customized.

functions.name: nlTranslateFlatIEPathName
functions.description: Parses a hierachical IE instance path and returns the path of the IE instance that is to be printed in the digital netlist.

functions.name: nlWarning
functions.description: Issue a warning to the user.

functions.name: printViolations
functions.syntax: printViolations( [ ?output t_output ] [ ?checks l_checks ] [ ?devices l_devices ] [ ?models l_models ] [ ?primitives l_primitives ] [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Prints a summary of all violations. Format of the output is similar to that of the output from the Print button on the Violations Display form. The resultsDir argument can be used to print violations from the different results directory.

functions.name: relxAddReliabilityInStateComponent
functions.description: Adds the Reliability Setup option in the save and load state forms of the specified session. To reuse the save and load state flow of ADE in your simulator, you can rewrite this function and ensure that the function returns t.

functions.name: relxAddReliabilityOption
functions.description: Adds a variable to the specified Reliability tool.

functions.name: relxAddSetupRelxOption
functions.syntax: relxAddSetupRelxOption ( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?type s_type ] [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?choices l_choices ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?display g_display ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?onFields l_onFields ] [ ?buttonLocation s_buttonLocation ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?defValue g_defValue ] [ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ] [ ?items l_items ] [ ?frame g_frame ] [ ?formApplyCB s_formApplyCB ] [ ?scrollable g_scrollable ] [ ?tooltip t_tooltip ] [ ?spacing x_spacing ] [ ?discLayout s_discLayout ] [ ?buttonIcon g_buttonIcon ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Adds new fields to the Reliability Options form.

functions.name: relxCreateCustomizedTab
functions.description: Adds a customized tab to the Reliability Options form.

functions.name: relxCreateRunObjectFile
functions.description: Creates the runObject file for the specified session.

functions.name: relxCustomizeDisplayOrEnableStatus
functions.description: Defines the display and enable status of the disclosures, fields, and tabs.

functions.name: relxDisplayDiscField
functions.syntax: relxDisplayDiscField( r_formObject t_disclosureName g_displaybleBoolean ) => t / nil
functions.description: Shows or hides the specified disclosure in the Reliability Options form.

functions.name: relxDisplayReliabilityForm
functions.description: Displays the Reliability form for the specified session.

functions.name: relxDisplayResult
functions.description: Displays the specified result log file.

functions.name: relxEnableDiscField
functions.syntax: relxEnableDiscField( r_formObject t_disclosureName g_enableBoolean ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the specified disclosure in the Reliability Options form.

functions.name: relxEnableFormTab
functions.syntax: relxEnableFormTab( r_formObject t_tabName g_enableBoolean ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the specified tab in the Reliability Options form.

functions.name: relxFormatRXControlFile
functions.description: When the session is created using Spectre, this function creates a file that includes all the possible options for Relxpert Reliability simulator mode. functions.description: When specified, displays all resistors on the Voltus-Fi GUI including those for which there are no layout shapes matching the specified resistor coordinates. These resistors are displayed using stick diagrams.

functions.name: vxfiLoadEMIRResults
functions.description: Specifies to load the EMIR results database file (.wdb) in the Voltus-XFi Result Browser. This function should be called after the vxfiOpenLayout function.

functions.name: vxfiLoadNets
functions.description: Specifies to load the nets in the Voltus-XFi Result Browser. This function should be called after the vxfiOpenLayout and vxfiLoadEMIRResults functions.

functions.name: vxfiOpenLayout
functions.syntax: vxfiOpenLayout( libname cellname viewname [ mode ] ) => w_windowId
functions.description: Opens the design in the Virtuoso layout and launches Voltus-XFi Results Browser.

functions.name: vxfiSaveNetSummaryInfoToCSV
functions.description: Specifies to write the net summary given in the Voltus-XFi Results Browser interface to a text file in the current working directory.

functions.name: vxfiSessionConnect
functions.syntax: vxfiSessionConnect( t_sessionName t_signalName s_callbackFunction ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a SKILL callback to be connected to a known signal or trigger emitted from a Voltus-XFi session. This function supports event-based trigger callbacks for pre-extraction, post-extraction, and pre-simulation. The function can be used to run LVS before running extraction, after running extraction, and before running simulation by registering the LVS run callback for these three events.

functions.name: vxfiSessionRegisterCreationCallback
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function as callback to be called whenever the event for which it is registered is occurred.

functions.name: vxfiSetLVSQueryOutputDirectory
functions.description: Specifies the path to the LVS output directory in which the input data is stored for extraction.

functions.name: vxfiSetLVSRunName
functions.description: Specifies the LVS run name to be used for extraction.

functions.name: DATA
functions.syntax: DATA( t_netName  t_analysis  [ t_dataDir ] ) => o_data / nil
functions.description: This is a basic data access function. It returns data for the specified node and analysis.

functions.name: IDC
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing the DC terminal current.

functions.name: IF
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing the ac sweep terminal current.

functions.name: IS
functions.description: Returns waveform representing the dc sweep terminal current.

functions.name: IT
functions.description: Returns waveform representing the transient sweep terminal current.

functions.name: LVS
functions.description: This is the primary function for LVS. It sets up all the actions needed to netlist the layout and schematics design as well as invoke LVS itself.

functions.name: MP
functions.syntax: MP(  t_instanceName t_parameterName [ t_dataDir ] ) => n_number / nil
functions.description: Returns the specified model parameter for the instance.

functions.name: NG
functions.description: Returns the noise gain waveform.

functions.name: OP
functions.syntax: OP( t_instanceName t_parameterName  [ t_dataDir ] ) => n_number / nil

functions.name: OPT

functions.name: SIMULATOR

functions.name: VAR

functions.name: VDC
functions.description: Returns  dc voltage for the specified net.

functions.name: VF
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing the ac sweep net voltage.

functions.name: VN
functions.description: Returns the noise waveform specified in V/sqrt (Hz).

functions.name: VN2

functions.name: VNP
functions.description: Returns  any single level noise parameter available in the PSF database.

functions.name: VNPP
functions.syntax: VNPP( t_name  t_param [ t_dataDir ] ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: VNPP accesses any double level noise parameter available in the PSF database.

functions.name: VPD
functions.syntax: VPD(  t_net1  t_net2 [ t_dataDir ] ) => wave / nil
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing phase difference between voltages at the two nets.

functions.name: VS
functions.description: Returns dc sweep waveform for the specified net.

functions.name: acdlPrintIncludedNetlist
functions.description: Writes data of the included netlist into the main netlist file.

functions.name: addCheck
functions.syntax: addCheck( t_name [ ?sub t_sub ] [ ?dev t_dev ] [ ?devlist l_devlist ] [ ?prim t_prim ] [ ?mod t_mod ] [ ?instparam t_instparam ] [ ?modelparam t_modelparam ] [ ?opparam t_opparam ] [ ?parameter t_parameter ] [ ?expression t_expression ] [ ?min t_min ] [ ?max t_max ] [ ?regions t_regions ] [ ?duration t_duration ] [ ?message t_message ] [ ?severity t_severity ] [ ?analyses l_analyses ] ) => t_name / nil
functions.description: Adds a new device check. Checks can be added to check a device parameter, a subcircuit parameter, a design variable or an expression. The scope of check is decided by the arguments ?sub, ?dev, ?mod, and ?prim. The ?min and ?max parameters can be used to set up the safe region if the parameter/expression being checked goes out of this region and a violation is reported.

functions.name: aedCopyCDF
functions.description: Opens the Copy Component CDF form.

functions.name: aedDeleteCDF
functions.description: Opens the Delete Component CDF form.

functions.name: aedEditCDF
functions.description: Opens the Edit CDF form to the library, cell, and CDF type specified by libraryName, cellName, and cdfType.

functions.name: ahdlUpdateViewInfo
functions.description: Updates cells and cellviews created with releases earlier than 4.4.2 so that the cells and cellviews can use cellview-specific parameters and parameter values. During the update, ahdlUpdateViewInfo, parses the Verilog-A or SpectreHDL modules that define the specified cellviews, issues any necessary error messages and updates the cellview CDF information.

functions.name: almDefineParam_accuracyMode
functions.description: This function is used to define the accuracy mode.

functions.name: almDefineParam_additionalParam
functions.description: This function is used to enable additional parameters.

functions.name: almDefineParam_fq
functions.description: This function is used to define a fq parameter.

functions.name: almDefineParam_noiseParaLabel
functions.description: Noise parameter label.

functions.name: almDefineParam_nportFileB
functions.description: nport file.

functions.name: almDefineParam_otherParaLabel
functions.description: This function is used to enable other paramters.

functions.name: almDefineParam_tranAdvanParaLabel
functions.description: Advanced tran parameter.

functions.name: almDefineParam_tranParaLabel
functions.description: tran parameter label.

functions.syntax: almGetModuleName( t_lib  t_cell  [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )  => s_moduleName / nil
functions.description: Returns the module name for the arguments specified. The netlist procedure is set with almSetModuleName.

functions.syntax: almGetNamePrefix( t_lib  t_cell  [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )  => t_namePrefix / nil
functions.description: Returns the name prefix for the arguments specified. The netlist procedure is set with almSetNamePrefix.
