functions.syntax: almGetNetlistProcedure( t_lib t_cell [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )  => s_procedure / nil
functions.description: Returns the netlist procedure for the arguments specified. The netlist procedure is used to netlist an instance. The netlist procedure is declared with almSetNetlistProcedure.

functions.name: almGetNetlistType
functions.syntax: almGetNetlistType( t_lib t_cell [ ?view t_view ] )  => t_netlistType / nil
functions.description: Returns the netlist type for the library, cell and view specified, if view-specific information is available. This procedure issued during netlisting.

functions.name: almGetOpPointParamMap
functions.syntax: almGetOpPointParamMap(  t_lib t_cell [ ?view g_view ]  [ ?tool g_tool ] )  => l_opMap / nil
functions.description: Returns the operating-point parameter map for the arguments specified. The netlist procedure is set with almSetOpPointParamMap.

functions.name: almGetOtherParameterList
functions.syntax: almGetOtherParameterList( t_lib t_cell [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool t_tool ] [ ?entry s_entry ] ) => l_parameterList / nil
functions.description: Returns the otherParameter list for the arguments specified. The otherParameter list is set with almSetOtherParameterList.

functions.name: almGetParameterList
functions.syntax: almGetParameterList( t_lib t_cell [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] [ ?entry g_entry ] )  => l_parameterList / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of parameters for the arguments specified. The parameter list is set with almSetParameterList.

functions.name: almGetPropMappingList
functions.syntax: almGetPropMappingList(  t_lib t_cell [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] [ ?entry g_entry ] ) => l_propMappingList / nil
functions.description: Returns the propMapping parameter list for the arguments specified. The propMapping list is set with almSetPropMappingList.

functions.name: almGetStringParameterList
functions.syntax: almGetStringParameterList( t_lib t_cell [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] [ ?entry g_entry ] )=> l_parameterList / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of string type parameters for the arguments specified. The parameter list is set with almSetStringParameterList.

functions.name: almGetTerminalList
functions.syntax: almGetTerminalList( t_lib t_cell [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )  => l_terminalList / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of terminal names for the arguments specified. The netlist procedure is set with almSetTerminalList.

functions.name: almGetTerminalMap
functions.syntax: almGetTerminalMap( t_lib t_cell S_terminal [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )  => s_map / nil
functions.description: Returns the simulator name of a terminal for the arguments specified. The netlist procedure is set with almSetTerminalMap.

functions.name: almGetViewInfoNameList
functions.description: Returns the list of view-name strings for which view-specific information is available, and for which the view exists.

functions.name: almHasViewInformation
functions.syntax: almHasViewInformation(  t_lib  t_cell  t_view  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Determines if the view-specific information is available for the library, cell, and view specified.

functions.name: almSetModuleName
functions.syntax: almSetModuleName ( t_lib t_cell t_name [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )
functions.description: Sets the module name for the view or tool.

functions.name: almSetNamePrefix
functions.syntax: almSetNamePrefix( t_lib t_cell t_name [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )
functions.description: Sets the name prefix for the view or the tool specified.

functions.name: almSetNetlistProcedure
functions.syntax: almSetNetlistProcedure( t_lib t_cell s_procedure [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )
functions.description: Sets the netlist procedure for the arguments specified.

functions.name: almSetOpPointParamMap
functions.syntax: almSetOpPointParamMap( t_lib  t_cell  l_map  [ ?view t_view ] [ ?tool t_tool ] )
functions.description: Sets the operating-point parameter map for the arguments specified. This map is used in results display.

functions.name: almSetOtherParameterList
functions.syntax: almSetOtherParameterList( t_lib t_cell l_parameter [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] [ ?entry g_entry ] )
functions.description: Sets list of other parameter names for the arguments specified.

functions.name: almSetParameterList
functions.syntax: almSetParameterList( t_lib t_cell l_parameter [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] [ ?entry g_entry ] )
functions.description: Sets list of parameter names for the arguments specified.

functions.name: almSetPropMappingList
functions.syntax: almSetPropMappingList(  t_lib t_cell l_parameter [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] [ ?entry g_entry ] )
functions.description: Sets the list of propMapping for the arguments specified.The parameters specified in the l_parameter list are mapped and printed to the netlist if the user has specified these values.

functions.name: almSetStringParameterList
functions.syntax: almSetStringParameterList( t_lib t_cell l_parameter [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] [ ?entry g_entry ] )
functions.description: Sets list of string parameter names for the arguments specified. These parameters are printed to the netlist if the user has given these values.

functions.name: almSetTerminalList
functions.syntax: almSetTerminalList( t_lib t_cell l_termList [ ?view t_view ] [ ?tool t_tool ] )
functions.description: Sets the list of terminal names for the lib arguments specified.

functions.name: almSetTerminalMap
functions.syntax: almSetTerminalMap( t_lib t_cell S_name g_map [ ?view g_view ] [ ?tool g_tool ] )
functions.description: Sets the mapped name (simulator name) for a terminal name (schematic name) for the arguments specified. The mapped name is used for results display and it is used by the simulator interface in the simulator input file.

functions.name: amseGeneralSetupForm
functions.description: Opens the General Setup form in Virtuoso AMS Designer. The General Setup form appears when you choose Detailed Setup and then General Setup from the AMS menu in Hierarchy Editor.

functions.name: amseQuickSetupForm
functions.description: Opens the Quick Setup form in Virtuoso AMS Designer. The Quick Setup form appears when you choose Quick Setup from the AMS menu in Hierarchy Editor.

functions.name: ancAdjustNameCase
functions.description: The function adjusts case for the name passed, based on the type specified.

functions.name: ancGetSimInstName
functions.description: This function provides the external instance name for the current instance being formatted in the netlister. The function must only be used by customized socket netlisters or custom socket netlist procedures. The routine takes into consideration the netlist mode (FNL, HNL or IHNL), case mapping (lower, upper or mixed) and the prefix for the instance.

functions.name: annRetrieveFromEffectiveCDF
functions.description: Retrieves the data from effective CDF. This function is used to match the CDF properties of the graphical window with the global effective CDF properties and needs to be called before annotating CDF properties to reflect the changes done in effective CDF properties.

functions.name: ansAnalogRegCDFsimInfo
functions.description: This is a utility function used to create the CDF for the <yourSimulator> simulator.The ansAnalogRegCDFsimInfo functions are called by the CDF editor. These functions are used to provide data type information for all the simInfo attributes.

functions.name: ansCdlCompPrim
functions.description: Enables printing of device information for primitives in the auCdl netlist. Specify this function as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the primitive devices for which you want the device information to be printed in the auCdl netlist. For more information about the ansCdlCompPrim netlist procedure, see the Virtuoso Analog Design Environment L User Guide.

functions.name: ansCdlGetMultiplicity
functions.description: Controls how multiplicity (converting an instance into multiple instances connected in parallel) is handled for an instance in the design when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the master of the instance.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSegmentConnections
functions.syntax: ansCdlGetSegmentConnections(  S_inst  l_connectionPairs  n_iterSeg  n_iterMult  n_numSegments  n_multiplicityFactor  t_segmentConnType  n_netCount  )
functions.description: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It controls how connectivity information is written in the netlist for instances for which a multiplicity factor is specified using the m or M property. For example, if an instance with a connection list like ((termA netA) (termB netB)) has to be converted into two segments connected in series, the modified connection list for the first segment will be  ((termA netA) (termB tempnet_0)) and ((termA tempnet_0) (termB netB)) for the second segment. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSegmentInfo
functions.description: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It returns the number of segments for an instance and the connection type (series, parallel, or user defined connection type name) between the segments. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSegmentInstParams
functions.syntax: ansCdlGetSegmentInstParams(  S_inst  l_propsList  n_iterSeg  n_iterMult  n_numSegments  n_multiplicityFactor  t_segmentConnType  ) => l_segment
functions.description: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It controls how values of parameters are printed on segments of an instance. auCdl calls this function with a list of property name and property value pairs for all those properties that are specified in device CDF simulation information instance parameters. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSimPropValue
functions.description: Returns the value of a specified property on the current instance being netlisted when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device.

functions.name: ansCdlHnlPrintInst
functions.description: Customizes how device information is written in the auCdl netlist. Specify this function as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the devices for which you want to customize the device information in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintConnections
functions.description: Customizes how the nets connected to a device are written in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintInheritedParams
functions.description: Customizes how inherited parameters are written in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintInstName
functions.syntax: ansCdlPrintInstName( &_fp  t_prefix  t_name  t_mappedName  g_isPrimitive  S_inst  S_master )
functions.description: Customizes how instance names are written in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintInstParams
functions.description: Customizes how instance parameters are written in the auCdl netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintInstProps
functions.description: Enables printing of user-defined instance properties and also customizes the format in which the properties are printed in the netlist. To print user-defined properties in the netlist, you must also use the `instProps argument in the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable defined in the .simrc file. For more information about the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable, see the Virtuoso Analog Design Environment L User Guide.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintModelName
functions.syntax: ansCdlPrintModelName( &_fp  g_isAPrimitive  g_definedPropVal  g_modelPropInstVal  g_componentPropInstVal  g_cdfModelName  g_cdfComponentName )
functions.description: Customizes the order in which auCdl looks for model names for primitives and the format in which the model information is written in the netlist.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintModuleName
functions.syntax: ansCdlPrintModuleName( &_fp  g_isAPrimitive  S_inst  S_master  S_parent  t_appedModuleName )
functions.description: Customizes how module names are written in the auCdl netlist for subcircuits.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintString
functions.description: Prints comment strings in the device information for instances in the auCdl netlist. To print comment strings in the device information, you must also use the `string argument in the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable defined in the .simrc file. For more information about the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable, see the Virtuoso Analog Design Environment L User Guide.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInst
functions.description: Writes the switch Pcell instance in the auCdl netlist based on the size and input values of the instance.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInstParam
functions.description: Writes into the auCdl netlist the list of CDF parameters and values defined for switch Pcell instances.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubCircuit
functions.description: Writes into the auCdl netlist the subckt definitions specified by hnlSpecialPCellLibCell in the .simrc file.

functions.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubcktConn
functions.description: Writes into the auCdl netlist the switch Pcell connections specified by hnlSpecialPCellLibCell in the .simrc file.

functions.name: apaExport
functions.description: This function can be used to export the sweep specifications, specified in the given Parametric Analysis window, to a file in the comma-separated values (csv) format. When called, the function opens the Export data in a csv format dialog where you need to provide name of the file to which the sweep data is to be exported.

functions.name: apaExportCB
functions.description: Callback for the menu File-Export to csv File in the Parametric Analysis window.

functions.name: apaStop
functions.description: This function can be used to stop a parametric analysis. Before calling this function from the CIW, make the parametric analysis window the current window. When called, this function will terminate the current simulator run and stop the parametric analysis. Any partial data created by parametric analysis will be removed. You can use the Pause or Pause Now menus to pause the parametric analysis before calling this function.

functions.name: apaStopCB
functions.description: Callback for the future menu Analysis-Stop in a parametric analysis window.

functions.name: artBlankString
functions.description: Returns true if the given object is equal to nil. If the given object is a string, checks if the string is empty or has blank space characters only and returns true. If the object is not nil and if the string has non-space characters, it returns nil.

functions.name: artClose
functions.description: Closes the file associated with the given handle.

functions.name: artCloseAllFiles
functions.description: Closes all files opened with artOutfile().

functions.name: artCurrentInstSimName
functions.description: This function provides the external instance name for the current instance being formatted in the netlister. The function should only be used for socket netlisters or custom netlist procedures for socket. The routine does not take into consideration case mapping registered for the tool or the prefix for the instance. It does take care of the netlisting mode (FNL, HNL or IHNL).

functions.name: artEnableAnnotationBalloon
functions.syntax: artEnableAnnotationBalloon( g_value  [ x_firstPoint ] [ x_lastPoint ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the display of parametric sweep results annotated on the schematic. When enabled, the first six result points are displayed in a pop-up window that appears when you hover the mouse pointer over an instance on the schematic. Use x_firstPoint and x_lastPoint to specify a range of result points to be displayed in the pop-up window.

functions.name: artFlush
functions.description: Flushes the file associated with the given handle.

functions.name: artFprintf
functions.syntax: artFprintf(  x_handle  t_text  g_args  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints out data like the standard C library fprintf, with the handle returned from artOutfile() as the first argument.

functions.name: artGenerateHierSymbolCDF
functions.description: Creates the cell CDF for the specified cellView, in the same way as happens when you create a symbol from a schematic in Composer. The cellView will be examined for any use of pPar() in expressions, and the corresponding parameters will be added to the CDF if they are not already present. Whilst both schematic and symbol cellViews may be passed to this function, it is usually best to pass a schematic cellView, in order to get the pPar()s used into the CDF.

functions.name: artGetCdfTargetCV
functions.description: This procedure returns the cell view dbobject that is the target of the update instance form or the create instance form. The function requires that either the arm property (armGet 'cdfInfo 'currentCellView) is set to a cellView, or that the variable cdfgForm is bound to a form with a property cellViewId attached (getq cdfgForm cellViewId). If neither of these is bound, nil is returned.

functions.name: artGetCellViewDesignVarList
functions.description: Returns the list of design variable name value pairs associated with the top level cellView.

functions.name: artInvalidateAmap
functions.description: Resets the in-memory Amap cache. Further mapping function calls will result in re-reading the amap files from disk.

functions.name: artListOpenFiles
functions.description: Lists names of all files opened with artOutfile()

functions.name: artListToWaveform
functions.description: This function takes a list of X,Y points and translates it into a waveform. Each of the X,Y points is also in a list format. If Y points are represented in a list format, they are treated as complex numbers while creating the waveform.

functions.name: artMakeString
functions.description: Converts data of the given data type to a string. The valid data types for the g_anyArg argument include symbol, integer, float, and string. The floating point numbers are converted into strings by using the `%.16g' format specification to produce the most precise output.

functions.name: artMakeStringPrec15
functions.description: Converts data of the given data type to a string. The valid data types for the g_anyArg argument include symbol, integer, float, and string. It similar to the function artMakeString, except that it uses the `%.15g' format specification to convert the floating point numbers into strings.

functions.name: artOutfile
functions.syntax: artOutfile(  t_name  t_mode  x_len  t_break  t_cont  t_begCom  t_endCom  t_tab  t_comments  )  => x_handle
functions.description: Opens the named file. The first argument is mandatory. The other arguments keep their default values if they are not set.

functions.name: asiAddFlowchartLink
functions.syntax: asiAddFlowchartLink(  o_flowchart  s_parentStep s_childStep ) => t / nil

functions.name: asiCheck
functions.syntax: asiCheck(  o_analysis | o_anaOption | o_envOption | o_simOption | o_keepOption  r_form  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Called by the environment to check values in the analysis and option fields.

functions.name: asiCheckAcEnabledWhenNoiseEnabled
functions.description: This method verifies that an AC analysis is enabled when a noise analysis is selected.  If this is not the case, it displays an error message in the analysis form's error dialog box and sets the error status of the form. It is called during the form apply callback.

functions.name: asiCheckAnalysis
functions.description: Checking function for the analysis class. e.g. for Spectre simulator object it checks each field value in the environment, highlights any errors, returns t or nil. Can be used for different analog simulator analysis objects.

functions.name: asiCheckBlank
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlank(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is non-blank.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankInstExists
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlankInstExists(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName  [ ?subAnaMsg t_subAnaMsg ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid instance name.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNetExists
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlankNetExists(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName [ ?subAnaMsg t_subAnaMsg ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid net name.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumeric
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlankNumeric(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName  [ ?subAnaMsg t_subAnaMsg ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericGeq
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlankNumericGeq(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName  g_value  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value greater than or equal to g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericGreater
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlankNumericGreater(  o_obj  r_form s_fieldName  g_value  [ ?subAnaMsg t_subAnaMsg ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value greater than g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericLeq
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlankNumericLeq(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName  g_value  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value less than or equal to g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericNequal
functions.syntax: asiCheckBlankNumericNequal(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName  g_value  [ ?subAnaMsg t_subAnaMsg ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value not equal to g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckDesignVariable
functions.syntax: asiCheckDesignVariable(  o_obj  r_form  s_fieldName  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid design variable.

functions.name: asiCheckDigitalSimulationSuccess
functions.description: Reports the success or failure of the simulation by looking at the digital simulator status file. Further, if no digital signals are saved by the user, this routine updates the logFileVerilog file to indicate that no digital waveforms are available for viewing.

functions.name: asiCheckExpression
functions.syntax: asiCheckExpression(  o_obj r_form  s_fieldName [ ?subAnaMsg t_subAnaMsg ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid expression.

functions.name: asiCheckExpressionGreater
functions.syntax: asiCheckExpressionGreater(  o_obj r_form s_fieldName g_value  [ ?subAnaMsg t_subAnaMsg ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is an expression that evaluates to a value greater than g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckMultipleGreater
functions.syntax: asiCheckMultipleGreater(  o_obj  r_form  s_largerField  s_smallerField  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that the value of the s_largerField entry is greater than that of the s_smallerField entry.

functions.name: asiCheckSimulationSuccess
functions.description: Determines if a simulation was successful.

functions.name: asiCloseOceanScript
functions.description: Closes the OCEAN script

functions.name: asiConstructDigitalNetlist
functions.description: Constructs the digital netlist file for viewing.

functions.name: asiCreateAnalysisField
functions.syntax: asiCreateAnalysisField( [ ?name s_fieldName ] [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?type s_type ] [ ?choices l_choices ] [ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?min g_min ] [ ?max g_max ] [ ?allowExpr s_allowExpr ] [ ?row x_row ] [ ?column x_column ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?coordinates l_coordinates ] [ ?displayOrder x_displayOrder ] [ ?labelText t_labelText ] [ ?private s_private ] [ ?display s_display ] [ ?editable s_editable ] [ ?appCB s_appCB ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?formApplyCB s_formApplyCB ] [ ?changeCB st_changeCB ] [ ?doubleClickCB st_doubleClickCB ] [ ?numRows x_numRows ] [ ?multipleSelect s_multipleSelect ] [ ?invalidateFunc s_invalidateFunc ] ) => o_envVar / nil
functions.description: Creates a new analysis field, such as from or to, for a new or changed analysis.

functions.name: asiCreateAnalysisOption
functions.syntax: asiCreateAnalysisOption( [ ?name s_optionName ] [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?type s_type ] [ ?choices l_choices ] [ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?min g_min ] [ ?max g_max ] [ ?allowExpr s_allowExpr ] [ ?row x_row ] [ ?column x_column ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?coordinates l_coordinates ] [ ?displayOrder x_displayOrder ] [ ?labelText t_labelText ] [ ?private s_private ] [ ?display s_display ] [ ?editable s_editable ] [ ?appCB s_appCB ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?formApplyCB s_formApplyCB ] [ ?changeCB st_changeCB ] [ ?doubleClickCB st_doubleClickCB ] [ ?numRows x_numRows ] [ ?multipleSelect s_multipleSelect ] [ ?invalidateFunc s_invalidateFunc ] [ ?sendMethod s_sendMethod ] ) => o_envVar / nil
functions.description: Creates a new analysis option for a new or changed analysis. You can call this function from within asiAddAnalysis or asiChangeAnalysis as an argument to ?optionList.

functions.name: asiCreateCdsenvFile
functions.description: Creates a .cdsenv file for the specified tool and dumps it to the current working directory.  This is meant as a development utility for integrators only.

functions.name: asiCreateFlowchart
functions.description: Creates a new flowchart.

functions.name: asiCreateFormatter
functions.description: First, a design object is created with the nlCreateDesign call, using the information on the OASIS session. Subsequently, the formatter is created with a call to nlCreateFormatter, using the information on the session. The formatter is added to the session and can be obtained with asiGetFormatter. This is a convenience routine that you cannot redefine, and the interface should not call it.

functions.name: asiCreateIncludeStatementFile
functions.syntax: asiCreateIncludeStatementFile(  o_simulatorSession  t_netlistFile t_includeNetlistFile  )  => t_includeNetlistFile / nil
functions.description: Creates a file that contains a statement to include netlist for simulation. Override this function to create a customized include statement according to the the simulator netlisting procedure and syntax.

functions.name: asiCreateLogFileVerilog
functions.description: Creates the file logFileVerilog in the .../psf directory to indicate the analysis result of Verilog-XL in a mixed-signal transient run.

functions.name: asiDcStore
functions.description: Copies the DC node voltages in processId.dc to the name you pass in fileName. This function assumes that your simulator writes the DC node voltages to netlistDir/raw/processId.dc.

functions.name: asiDefineDataAccessFunction
functions.description: Redefines a data access function.

functions.name: asiDefineDataMappingFunction
functions.description: Defines the data mapping functions.

functions.name: asiDeleteAnalysis
functions.description: Deletes an analysis.

functions.name: asiDeleteAnalysisField
functions.description: Deletes an analysis field from an existing analysis.

functions.name: asiDeleteAnalysisOption
functions.description: Deletes an analysis option.

functions.name: asiDeleteEnvOption
functions.description: Deletes a simulation environment option.

functions.name: asiDeleteFlowchartLink
functions.syntax: asiDeleteFlowchartLink(  o_flowchart  s_parentStep s_childStep ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the link between the specified parent and child steps.

functions.name: asiDeleteFlowchartStep
functions.syntax: asiDeleteFlowchartStep(  o_flowchart  s_name [ s_splice ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a step and any attached links from an existing flowchart. Typically, you do not need this function because you can unlink any flowchart step that you do not want to use with the asiDeleteFlowchartLink function.

functions.name: asiDeleteKeepOption
functions.description: Deletes a simulator keep option variable.

functions.name: asiDeleteSimOption
functions.description: Deletes a simulator option.

functions.name: asiDisableAnalysis
functions.description: Disables an analysis while keeping it in the analysis list. The analysis remains in the UI, but it is not sent to the simulator.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysis
functions.description: Displays the analyses for a tool. Use this function to determine which analyses you need to add or modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysisField
functions.description: Displays the analysis field names for an analysis. Use this function to determine which analysis field you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysisOption
functions.description: Displays the analysis option names for an analysis. Use this function to determine which analysis option you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayAnalysisOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the characteristics for one of the analysis options forms. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayEnvOption
functions.description: Displays the current set of simulation environment option names and values. Use this function only to determine which environment options you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayEnvOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the form characteristics for the Environment Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayFlowchart
functions.description: Displays the current steps and links for the flowchart. You can display all the step and link information, or you can display the steps and links that are below the rootstep step. Use this function only to determine which part of the flowchart you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayHighPerformanceOption
functions.description: Displays a list of variable and values of the High Performance Simulation Option form.

functions.name: asiDisplayKeepOption
functions.description: Displays the current simulator keep option names. Use this function to determine which options you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayKeepOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the form characteristics for the Keep Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplayNetlistOption
functions.description: Displays the current set of netlist options and values. Use this function only to determine which netlist options you can modify.

functions.name: asiDisplaySimOption
functions.description: Displays the current set of simulator option names and values. Use this function only to determine which simulator options you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiDisplaySimOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Displays the characteristics of the Simulator Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

functions.name: asiEditDigitalStimulus
functions.description: This method edits the digital stimulus file. It gets the full path to the stimulus file by calling asiGetDigitalStimulusFileName. If the stimulus file does not exist, the asiNetlist flowchart step is executed to run the netlister and create a digital stimulus file. Finally the stimulus file is opened in an editor.

functions.name: asiEnableAnalysis
functions.description: Enables an analysis, which means the analysis is selected and sent to the simulator.

functions.name: asiExecuteFlowchart
functions.syntax: asiExecuteFlowchart(  o_session  s_goalStep  [ s_printMessages ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Executes the flowchart for a given session up to and including the goal step.

functions.name: asiFinalNetlist
functions.description: Creates the final netlist.

functions.name: asiFormatAnalysis
functions.description: Formats and prints analysis statements to the control file. For the general asiAnalog class, it follows this routine: prints the analysis name by calling asiGetAnalysisName; prints the list of signals by calling asiGetAnalysisSigList and formats them in parentheses [for example: (net1 net2)]; prints the analysis field list in name=value pairs; prints the analysis options in name=value pairs; uses asiGetFormattedVal() to obtain the print string for an analysis field value or an analysis option value. Please see the description of asiGetFormattedVal routine for more details.

functions.name: asiFormatAnalysisList
functions.description: Formats all enabled analyses by calling asiFormatAnalysis.

functions.name: asiFormatControlStmts
functions.description: Creates and formats all control statements. It formats the following in the following order: node sets by calling asiFormatNoteSet; initial conditions by calling asiFormatInitCond; simulator options by calling asiFormatSimulatorOptions; analyses by calling asiFormatAnalysisList; nets/currents to save by calling asiFormatKeepList.

functions.name: asiFormatDefinitionFileList
functions.description: Formats the statement which includes the specified definition files.

functions.name: asiFormatDesignVarList
functions.description: Formats and prints the design variable statements to the design variable file. This routine first prints the string .PARAM followed by the design variables in name=value pairs. The design variables are obtained by calling asiGetDesignVarList.

functions.name: asiFormatGraphicalStimuli
functions.description: Formats the graphical stimuli statements to send to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiFormatGraphicalStimulusFileList
functions.description: Formats the statement that includes the graphical stimulus files.

functions.name: asiFormatInitCond
functions.description: Formats and prints the initial condition commands to the control statement file. This routine prints the string .IC followed by the initial conditions in V(net)=voltage pairs.

functions.name: asiFormatKeepList
functions.description: Formats and prints the signal save commands to the control statement file. At the asiAnalog class this routine returns t. You need to create your own asiFormatKeepList routine.

functions.name: asiFormatMTSModelAndSimOptions
functions.description: This method should be overridden to alter the format of the include file for an MTS block. The included file contains MTS options: Simulator Options and Model Files. The default implementation is in spectre format and is formatted as: simulatorOptions options tnom=27 scalem=1 scale=2 include Models/myModels.scs.

functions.name: asiFormatModelLibSelectionList
functions.description: Formats the statement which specifies the model library information.

functions.name: asiFormatNodeSet
functions.description: Formats and prints the nodeset commands to the control statement file. This routine prints .NODESET and then the nodesets in V(net)=voltage pairs.

functions.name: asiFormatSimulatorOptions
functions.description: Formats and prints the simulator option statements to the designated file. This routine prints .OPTIONS followed by name=value pairs.

functions.name: asiFormatTextStimulusFileList
functions.description: Formats the statement which includes the textual stimulus files.

functions.name: asiGetAdvAnalysis
functions.syntax: asiGetAdvAnalysis( { o_session | o_tool } s_analysisName )  => o_analysis / nil
functions.description: Returns the object of advanced analyses, such as Monte Carlo. This function is similar to the asiGetAnalysis function and is normally used by third party integrator to implement the simulator interface for their simulators.

functions.name: asiGetAnalogKeepList
functions.description: Returns the list of user-selected output signals that are analog. This method first checks if the current simulation session is mixed signal. If yes, then it returns all the user-selected output signals within the analog partition of the mixed signal design. Otherwise, it calls asiGetKeepList to get the list of signals and currents to be saved during simulation.

functions.name: asiGetAnalogRunDir
functions.description: Returns the analog simulator run directory.

functions.name: asiGetAnalogSimulator
functions.description: Gets the value of the analog simulator for a tool or session object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysis
functions.syntax: asiGetAnalysis( { o_session | o_tool } s_analysisName ) => o_analysis / nil
functions.description: Gets an analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisField
functions.description: Returns the specified analysis field object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for an analysis field that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldList
functions.description: Returns a list of analysis field objects defined for a particular analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldVal
functions.description: Gets the value of an analysis field from the environment.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldChoices
functions.syntax: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldChoices(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  ) => l_choices / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of choices for a field in the Choosing Analyses form. This procedure can be used within the asiCheck method to get the list of choices for an analysis field from the form for subsequent value checking. You can also use this procedure in an expression that controls whether a field is displayed in the form.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldVal
functions.syntax: asiGetAnalysisFormFieldVal(  r_form  s_analysisName  s_fieldName  ) => g_fieldValue / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of a field in the Choosing Analyses form. This procedure can be used within the asiCheck method to get the values of analysis fields from the form for subsequent value checking. You can also use this procedure in an expression that controls whether a field is displayed in the form.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisFormObj
functions.description: Returns the current analysis selected in the Choosing Analysis form for the simulation session.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisName
functions.description: Gets the name of the analysis.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisNameList
functions.description: Returns a list of analysis names defined for a tool.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionChoices
functions.description: Gets the list of choices for an analysis option that is set up as a list box.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionList
functions.description: Gets a list of analysis option objects defined for a particular analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionSendMethod
functions.description: Gets the sendMethod for an option in an analysis. The sendMethod indicates how the analysis option is sent to Cadence SPICE.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionVal
functions.description: Gets the value for the given option in an analysis.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisParamNameList
functions.description: Returns a concatenated list of fields and options defined for an analysis object.

functions.name: asiGetAnalysisSigList

functions.name: asiGetSelObjType

functions.name: asiGetSimCommandLineOrder
functions.description: Returns the order of options used in the simulator run command. By default, it returns the options in the following order:

functions.name: asiGetSimExecName

functions.name: asiGetSimName

functions.name: asiGetSimOptionVal

Otherwise, it returns the default value of digitalHost in the .cdsenv file for tool asimenv and partition startup.

functions.description: Returns the digital simulator host mode for mixed signal simulation. This method first verifies if host mode was set using asiSetVerilogHostMode. If yes, it returns that mode. Otherwise, it returns the default value of digitalHostMode in the .cdsenv file for tool asimenv and partition startup.

functions.name: asiInit<yourSimulator>

functions.description: Initializes the tool-specific analysis options for the tools derived from the asiAnalog class. This method can be used by third-party integrators to define their own analysis options in ADE XL.

functions.name: asiInitAnalysis
functions.description: Initializes the tool-specific analysis options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own analysis options.

functions.name: asiInitDataAccessFunction
functions.description: Initializes the data access function for the tool. This function can be used by a third-party integrator to define their own data access functions.

functions.name: asiInitEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the tool-specific environment options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own environment options.

functions.name: asiInitMixedKeepOption
functions.description: Initializes the mixed signal keep options variables.

functions.name: asiInitSimOption
functions.description: Initializes the simulation options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own simulation options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilog
functions.description: Initializes the verilog tool.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the base Verilog environment options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogFNLEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the Verilog FNL netlisting options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogHNLEnvOption
functions.description: Initializes the Verilog HNL netlisting options.

functions.name: asiInitVerilogSimOption
functions.description: Initializes the simulation options for verilog.

functions.description: Initializes the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This method is not called for tools that are derived from the asiSocket class.

functions.name: asiInitializeNetlisterMixed
functions.description: Initializes the mixed signal netlister. Partitions the design and then calls nlCreateDesign to get the design object. Does not re-partition if the design has not changed since last partition.

functions.name: asiInterruptSim
functions.description: This method provides an interrupt to the simulation run process for a session. It is associated with the Simulation->Stop action in the user interface. This method is called by the environment. Therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be re-defined for the interface. Use callNextMethod in this definition.

functions.name: asiInvalidateControlStmts
functions.description: The asiInvalidateControlStmts function is a wrapper to asiInvalidateFlowchartStep, which invalidates the asiSendControlStmts flowchart step.

functions.name: asiInvalidateFlowchartStep
functions.description: Invalidates a flowchart step for a particular session.

functions.name: asiIsAnalysisEnabled
functions.description: Tests to determine whether an analysis is enabled.

functions.name: asiIsCaseSensitive
functions.description: Determines whether the simulator is case sensitive or not. Returns t, if the simulator is case sensitive, else returns nil. The default value for this function is t.

functions.name: asiIsConfigDesign
functions.description: The function returns t if the design associated with the session is a Cadence 5.x configuration.

functions.name: asiLoadState
functions.syntax: asiLoadState(  o_session [ ?name t_name ] [ ?option s_option ] [ ?stateDir t_stateDir ] [ ?lib t_lib ] [ ?cell t_cell ] [ ?simulator t_simulator ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a saved state into the current simulation environment directly from the CIW without displaying the Loading State form.

functions.name: asiMTSIncludeFileExtension
functions.description: Returns file extension of MTS block specific include file so that the spectre (.scs ) and spice (.c ) syntax can be taken care of. The default extension is .scs.

functions.name: asiMTSIncludeFormat
functions.description: This method should be overridden to alter the format of the include statement that goes into the netlist. The default include statement is in the spectre syntax and is formatted as: include mts-opamplib-amplifier.scs.

functions.name: asiMapInstanceName
functions.description: Maps the hierarchical schematic instance name to the name in the netlist.

functions.name: asiMapNetName
functions.description: Maps the hierarchical schematic net name to the name in the netlist.

functions.name: asiMapOutputName
functions.syntax: asiMapOutputName(  t_dir s_type t_name [ ?formatflag s_formatflag ] )  => l_nameList
functions.description: Maps the given schematic name of the given type using the netlist directory. The result is a list of mapped strings.

functions.name: asiMapTerminalName
functions.description: Maps the hierarchical schematic terminal name to the name in the netlist.

functions.name: asiNeedSuffixEvaluation
functions.description: Specify whether the interface needs suffix evaluation or not. When this method returns t, the numeric suffixes specified in a numericString field will be evaluated. For example, suppose the start frequency field for the AC analysis has a value of 10M, asiGetFormattedVal(ac_start_fieldObj ) returns 1e7 provided it is created as a `numericString field.

functions.name: asiNetlist
functions.description: This method performs the creation of a design object. It then creates the formatter object with nlCreateFormatter, after which the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist. Netlist statistics are then printed. The netlister also provides a component count, as well as the addition of design variables found during netlisting.

functions.name: asiNetlistMixed
functions.description: This method performs mixed netlisting. It creates a formatter object with nlCreateFormatter, after which the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist.

functions.name: asiOpenOceanScript
functions.description: Opens the specified file for writing the OCEAN script. If the file exists, it asks for your permission to overwrite it.

functions.name: asiPartitionDesign
functions.description: This method partitions a mixed signal design into analog and digital parts.

functions.name: asiPrepareDigitalSimulation
functions.description: Performs digital run directory clean up. It removes the file that stores the exit code for any previous digital simulation and cleans up the digital simulator old log file.

functions.name: asiQuitSimulator
functions.description: This method terminates or kills the simulator run process based on the ipc signal being sent to the specified process. By default, the direct integration code sends a hard-kill signal to the simulator process. To change this option and send a soft-kill signal, the ?mode option should be set to true and overloaded for yourSimulator session. This method is called by the environment, therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be re-defined for the interface. Use, callNextMethod in its definition.

functions.name: asiRawNetlist
functions.description: Creates a raw netlist.

functions.name: asiRegCallBackOnSimComp
functions.description: Registers the specified user-defined callback function to run after completion of a simulation. The callback function should accept two arguments, a session object and the simulation status.

functions.name: asiRegCallBackOnSimCompForDist
functions.description: Registers the specified user-defined callback function to run after completion of distributed jobs.

functions.name: asiRegisterTool
functions.syntax: asiRegisterTool( '<simulatorName> [ ?class			s_className ] [ ?private			s_private ] [ ?initFunc			s_initFunc ] [ ?mixedSig			s_mixedSig ] ) => t
functions.description: Registers your simulator and your initialization function.

functions.name: asiRemoveAllModelLibSelection
functions.description: Removes all the model files by setting the modelFiles variable to nil. In addition, it also invalidates the asiSendControlStmts flowchart step by calling asiInvalidateControlStmts.

functions.name: asiRunSimulation
functions.description: This method performs the simulation for the session. This method is called by the environment, so you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be redefined for the interface. Use callNextMethod in this definition.

functions.name: drplEvmBpsk
functions.syntax: drplEvmBpsk( o_waveform1 o_waveform2 n_tDelay n_sampling b_autoLevelDetect n_voltage n_offset b_normalize [ ?percent b_percent ] ) => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatterplot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the two possible I and Q symbol combinations, and calculating the difference between the signal level and the ideal signal level. Compared to other types of phase shift keying, such as QPSK, QAM16 and QAM64, BPSK has lowest bit error rate for the same signal to noise ratio.

functions.name: evmOFDM
functions.syntax: evmOFDM( waveform1 o_waveform1 waveform2 o_waveform2 sigStandard e_sigStandard tstart n_tstart modulationType e_modulationType fftSize n_fftSize PrefixLength n_PrefixLength SymbolPeriod n_SymbolPeriod [ ?packet n_packetLength ] [ ?modifier e_modifier ] [ ?skiplength n_skiplength ] [ ?idx n_idx ] [ ?getval g_getval ] ) => constellation o_waveform evm_value / nil
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the hb-envlp simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatterplot (constellation). EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a modern high throughput modulation scheme widely used in wireless signals, such as 802.11a,g,n, where EVM measurement is useful . The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to constellation points of each modulation type (can be BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, and 64QAM) and calculating the difference between the signal level and the ideal signal level.
