functions.description: Prints the option names available on this object along with their values.

functions.name: nlError
functions.description: Issues a user error. The error is printed immediately and it is collected on the object. In this way, if netlisting is interrupted, the user is aware of any errors that occurred during netlisting. All errors are printed to the netlist log file.

functions.name: nlGetCdf
functions.description: Obtains the CDF information of the IE cell. CDF information contains the default IE parameter, default IE macro model file name and parameter mapping from CDF to simulator specific names.

functions.name: nlGetCellName
functions.description: Gets the cell name of the specified instance.

functions.name: nlGetCurrentSwitchMaster
functions.description: This function returns the database ID for the current switch master for the instance in hierarchical incremental netlisting . This function should only be used while printing the instance statement. Avoid using this function if possible.

functions.name: nlGetDesign
functions.description: Returns the design object.

functions.name: nlGetFormatter
functions.description: Returns the formatter.

functions.name: nlGetGlobalNets
functions.description: Returns the list of global nets. This method should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter.

functions.name: nlGetId
functions.description: Returns the database ID for the instance. If the instance represents a cdba instance, this id is a database ID. Avoid using this function if possible, and use type-checking precautions.

functions.name: nlGetLibName
functions.description: Gets the library name of the specified instance.

functions.name: nlGetModelName
functions.description: This method must be used to obtain the model name of an instance. Use of this method assures consistency in netlisting across interfaces. For instances that represent subcircuits, this method returns a name chosen by the netlister, using the modulePrefix netlist option.

functions.name: nlGetNetlistDir
functions.description: Returns the netlist directory.

functions.name: nlGetNetlistedStopCellViewList
functions.description: Returns a list of cellview objects treated as stop cells for the specified netlister object.

functions.name: nlGetNetlister
functions.description: Returns an object representing the netlister.

functions.name: nlGetNumberOfBits
functions.description: Returns the number of bits on the instance and terminal specified.

functions.name: nlGetOption
functions.description: Returns the value of the option.

functions.name: nlGetOptionNameList
functions.description: Returns the list of option names available on this object.

functions.name: nlGetPCellParamSource
functions.description: Identifies the source of value of the Pcell parameters of the given cellview.

functions.name: nlGetParamList
functions.description: Returns the list of parameters of the specified instance or cellview.

functions.name: nlGetParamStringValue
functions.description: Returns a string representing the parameter value for the instance and parameter name.

functions.name: nlGetSignalList
functions.description: Returns the list of mapped signal names for the instance according to the terminal order specified for the cellview. Use this method for printing instances to the netlist by the nlPrintInst method of the formatter. The terminal order for schematic subcircuits is determined by the pin order property on the schematic, or by the termOrder property on the CDF, or by the system, in that order.

functions.name: nlGetSimName
functions.description: If the input type is cellview object, then returns the simulator name of the subcircuit. If the input type is instance object, then returns the mapped name of the instance. The name returned depends on the useInstNamePrefix netlist option. When it is not set, the name prefix is not taken into account. However, for instances representing interface elements, the name prefix is always taken into account. No mapping is performed for interface elements.

functions.name: nlGetSimTerminalNets
functions.description: Returns the list of mapped names of signals connecting to the terminals of the cellview based on the terminal order specified for the cellview. Several signals may come from inherited connections.  Signal buses are handled in scalar form. For example, net10<0:3> is mapped as net10_0, net10_1, net10_2 and net10_3. Use this function while printing the subcircuit definition.

functions.name: nlGetSwitchViewList
functions.description: Returns the switch view list for the cellView.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalList
functions.description: Returns the list of terminal names in the order specified on the pin order property on the schematic, or on the termOrder property on the CDF, or on the cellview of the instance, in that order. This method should not be used by the formatter. In contrast to nlGetSignalList, buses are not handled individually: a terminal such as out<0:3> is represented in its original form.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalNets
functions.description: Returns the schematic names of the signals connected to the terminals. Many of the signals may come from inherited connections.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalSignalName
functions.description: Returns the name of the signal connected to the terminal.

functions.name: nlGetToolName
functions.description: Returns a symbol representing the simulator. It returns the value of the tool name. This name is used for the selection of the simulator information on the library component.

functions.name: nlGetTopCellName
functions.description: Returns the cell name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetTopLibName
functions.description: Returns the library name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetTopViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the specified cellview object.

functions.name: nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile( o_formatter t_filename t_master ) => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the dspf_include statement for DSPF type text cellview in the design.

functions.name: nlIncludeDbSPICEMODELTextFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for SPICEMODEL cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all SPICEMODEL modules. If your simulator does not support SPICEMODEL views, call the nlError function in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludePspiceFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludePspiceFile(  o_formatter  t_fileName  t_masterName )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the include statement for pspice cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all pspice modules. If your simulator does not support pspice views, call nlError function in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeSrcFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for instances bound to source files using Hierarchy Editor. This is called while printing the footer for the netlist for all the source files to which any instance in the design is bound. If your simulator does not support source file bindings, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeVerilogFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludeVerilogFile(  o_formatter  t_filename  t_master )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the include statement for verilog type text cell view in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all verilog text cell views. If your simulator does not support verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeVerilogaFile
functions.syntax: nlIncludeVerilogaFile(  o_formatter  t_filename  t_master )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the include statement for verilog-a cell views in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all verilog-a modules. If your simulator does not support verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlInfo
functions.description: Sends an informational message to the calling application.

functions.name: nlInitialize
functions.description: For the nlFormatter class, this method initializes the netlister. This method can be redefined for the simulator-specific netlister and is called by nlCreateFormatter. This method initializes all simulator-specific aspects of netlisting such as name mapping. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, this method sets a number of netlist options. These options and their values are shown in the table below. To inspect the value of an option, use nlGetOption.

functions.name: nlIsModelNameInherited
functions.description: Returns t if the model name for the stopping instance is passed through the hierarchy through parameters.

functions.name: nlIsSmartExtractedView
functions.description: Identifies if the currently netlisted cellview is of the type smart_view. You can use this function in custom netlist procedures to modify the syntax printed to the netlist as required. For example, you can modify the syntax to determine if the printing of parenthesis needs to be enabled or disabled when printing the port connections of the instance.

functions.name: nlMapGlobalNet
functions.description: Maps a global net (signal) to the simulator name. This should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter. Use at any other time is an error.

functions.name: nlObjError
functions.description: Similar to nlError, but prints a description of the object along with the error message. The description includes the library name, the cell name, the view name, and the instance name in case the object is an instance.

functions.name: nlPrintComment
functions.syntax: nlPrintComment(  o_netlister  [ t_arg1 t_arg2 ... ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints a comment. Use this method to print all comments. This method uses the comment character and line wrapping. A subsequent nlPrintf call inserts the end comment string.

functions.name: nlPrintComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the instance being netlisted.

functions.name: nlPrintFooter
functions.description: This method is called at the end of netlisting. It does not print anything at the end of the netlist for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

functions.name: nlPrintHeader
functions.description: This method writes the beginning comment, adds .GLOBAL, and prints header comments.

functions.name: nlPrintHeaderComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the netlist file, including the library, cell, and view names of the top-level cellview of the design netlisted. This method only has effect when the printFileComments netlist option is set.

functions.name: nlPrintIndentString
functions.description: Prints the indent string for the instance statement. When inside the top-level circuit, the empty string is printed. When inside subcircuit definitions, the value of the subcktIndentString netlist option is printed.

functions.name: nlPrintInst
functions.description: Prints the netlist statement for an instance. This is the default netlist procedure for a component.

functions.name: nlPrintInstComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for an instance.

functions.name: nlPrintInstEnd
functions.description: Prints the end of the instance statement, which is a return (\n). This method is called by the netlister after the netlist procedure or by nlPrintInst.

functions.name: nlPrintInstName
functions.description: Prints the simulator name of the instance, taking the instance name prefix specified on the component into account when the simulator so requires. This is determined with the useInstNamePrefix netlist option.

functions.name: nlPrintInstParameters
functions.description: Prints the instance parameters in name=value pairs.

functions.name: nlPrintInstSignals
functions.description: Prints the simulator names of the signals according to the terminal order specified on the component, using the nlGetSignalList method of the instance.

functions.name: nlPrintModelName
functions.description: Prints the model name. The nlGetModelName for the instance is used for the model name.

functions.name: nlPrintString
functions.description: Prints the string arguments to the file. This function does the required line folding, prefixing, and, postfixing.

functions.name: nlPrintStringNoFold
functions.description: Prints the string arguments to the file, like the function nlPrintString. This function does the required prefixing and postfixing, but does not fold the line until a newline character or maxLineLength is encountered. While in a 'no fold' print mode, calls cannot be made to nlPrintString.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktBegin
functions.description: Prints the .subckt keyword for the nlAnalogFormatter class. This method is called by nlSubcktHeader.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktEnd
functions.description: For the nlAnalogFormatter class, prints the .ends keyword, followed by a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit, to mark the end of the subcircuit definition. It is called by nlPrintSubcktFooter.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktFooter
functions.description: Writes the footer for the subcircuit. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, it prints .ends.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktFooterComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the subcircuit footer by printing the string 'End of subcircuit definition.' preceded by the comment begin string.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktHeader
functions.syntax: nlPrint SubcktHeader(  o_formatter  o_cellView  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Writes the header for a subcircuit following these steps: prints comments by calling nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments; prints the subckt begin keyword by calling nlPrintSubcktBegin; prints the subckt name by calling nlPrintSubcktName; prints the subckt terminal list by calling nlPrintSubcktTerminalList.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the subcircuit header and the mapping information when the printSubcktComments option is set.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktName
functions.description: Prints a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit. This method is used by nlSubcktHeader.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktParameters
functions.description: Prints the passed parameters for the subcircuit definition.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktTerminalList
functions.description: Prints the simulator names of the signals connected to the terminals for a subcircuit definition and handles the signals resulting from inherited connections at a lower level .

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellFooter
functions.description: Writes the top cell view footer. This function prints an empty line and calls nlPrintTopCellFooterComments.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellFooterComments
functions.description: Returns t at the analogFormatter level.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellHeader
functions.description: Prints the header of the top-level circuit by calling nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments
functions.description: Calls nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

functions.name: nlSetOption
functions.syntax: nlSetOption(  o_netlister  s_option  g_value  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an option value. For information about options, see Netlist Options on page 4-41.

functions.name: nlSetPcellName
functions.syntax: nlSetPcellName ( S_cv t_paramNames g_paramValues ) => t / nil
functions.description: Define this function if the default generic OSS naming convention for Pcells needs to be customized.

functions.name: nlTranslateFlatIEPathName
functions.description: Parses a hierachical IE instance path and returns the path of the IE instance that is to be printed in the digital netlist.

functions.name: nlWarning
functions.description: Issue a warning to the user.

functions.name: printViolations
functions.syntax: printViolations( [ ?output t_output ] [ ?checks l_checks ] [ ?devices l_devices ] [ ?models l_models ] [ ?primitives l_primitives ] [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Prints a summary of all violations. Format of the output is similar to that of the output from the Print button on the Violations Display form. The resultsDir argument can be used to print violations from the different results directory.

functions.name: relxAddReliabilityInStateComponent
functions.description: Adds the Reliability Setup option in the save and load state forms of the specified session. To reuse the save and load state flow of ADE in your simulator, you can rewrite this function and ensure that the function returns t.

functions.name: relxAddReliabilityOption
functions.description: Adds a variable to the specified Reliability tool.

functions.name: relxCreateRunObjectFile
functions.description: Creates the runObject file for the specified session.

functions.name: relxDisplayReliabilityForm
functions.description: Displays the Reliability form for the specified session.

functions.name: relxDisplayResult
functions.description: Displays the specified result log file.

functions.name: relxFormatRXControlFile
functions.description: When the session is created using Spectre, this function creates a file that includes all the possible options for Relxpert Reliability simulator mode. This function does not work for other sessions. If Lynx's netlist flow is based on the result of this function, you need to rewrite the relxGetRXControlFileName function.

functions.name: relxGetModifyNetlistVal
functions.description: Checks whether to modify the netlist before aging starts. You can rewrite this function as per your requirements.

functions.name: relxGetMosAgingTimeUnitVal
functions.description: Returns the unit of aging time, which can be represented in years, days, hours, minutes or seconds. Only one unit of time is supported for a given simulation run.

functions.name: relxGetMosAgingTimeVal
functions.description: Returns the aging time value of the simulation in the specified session. The aging time can be in years, days, hours, minutes or seconds. Only one unit of time is supported for a given simulation run.

functions.name: relxGetRXControlFileName
functions.description: Returns the name of the RXControl file.

functions.name: relxGetReliabilityOptionChoices
functions.description: Returns the possible values for the specified Reliability option in the given analog session. This function works for fields that are of type radio, cyclic, and toggle.

functions.name: relxGetReliabilityOptionVal
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified Reliability option variable in the given session.

functions.name: relxGetSimulationRunCommand
functions.description: Formats the content of the simulation run file present in the netlist directory. This file is required to run simulation flow.

functions.name: relxGetSpecifiedReliabilityStateFileName
functions.description: Returns the name of the state file used the Reliability form. By default, the name of the state file is relxOptions. However, you can rewrite this function to define another name for the state file for your simulator.

functions.name: relxGetUserCmdLine
functions.description: Returns the value of the userCmdLine option in the specified session.

functions.name: relxHighLightDevices
functions.description: Highlights the specified device and instance list on schematic, and also displays information for the selected devices and instances in the form of tags.

functions.name: relxInitAdapterReliabilityOption
functions.description: Rewrites the asiInitialize function when called in the initialization flow for the specified tool. This function internally calls the relxInitReliabilityOption function and also adds some private variables to this function.

functions.name: relxInitReliabilityOption
functions.description: Initializes the Reliability Option form in the specified tool. You can rewrite this function by using unit functions relxAddReliabilityOption and relxSetReliabilityOptionFormProperties.

functions.name: relxIsAgingOn
functions.description: Checks whether aging is ON or OFF in the specified session.

functions.name: relxIsReliabilityEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether the Reliability analysis is enabled or disabled in the specified session.

functions.name: relxIsStressOn
functions.description: Checks whether the stress is ON or OFF in the specified session.

functions.name: relxOption
functions.syntax: relxOption( [ s_option1 g_optionValue1 ]....[ s_optionN g_optionValueN ] ) => undefined / nil
functions.description: Enables you to specify the RelXpert options, along with values, to be used by the simulator.

functions.name: relxPostSimulation
functions.description: Description

functions.name: relxRunSimulation
functions.description: Runs the Relxpert simulation.

functions.name: relxSetAgingVal
functions.description: Enables or disables aging for simulation in the specified session. Also sets the specified simulation aging value, while enabling aging.

functions.name: relxSetReliabilityOptionFormProperties
functions.description: Sets the various properties of the Reliability form.

functions.name: relxSetReliabilityOptionVal
functions.description: Sets the value of the specified Reliability option variable in the given session.

functions.name: relxSetReliabilityVal
functions.description: Enables or disables the Reliability analysis in the specified session.

functions.name: setDevCheckOptions
functions.syntax: setDevCheckOptions( [ ?analysis s_analysis ] [ ?start t_start ] [ ?stop t_stop ] [ ?severity t_severity ] [ ?enableAll t_enableAll ] [ ?disableAll t_disableAll ] )
functions.description: This function can be used to set various parameters of checklimit statements. User can override the severity specified on individual asserts, provide the time interval during which the checking should be done (applies only to transient analysis), or enable/disable all device checks for the given analysis.

functions.name: sevAboutTool
functions.description: Generates and displays the standard About DFII window for the tool with the tool name in the message.

functions.name: sevActivateSelectedAnas
functions.description: Enables or disables the selected analyses.

functions.name: sevActiveSelectedAna
functions.description: Returns the list of selected analyses that are currently enabled.

functions.name: sevAddExpression
functions.syntax: sevAddExpression( o_session t_expressionname t_expression ) => t / nil
functions.description: Takes the name and expression as a string and adds a corresponding output in ADE session.

functions.name: sevAddMenuItemLists
functions.description: Adds menu items to an existing menu item list.

functions.name: sevAnnotateResults
functions.description: Annotates the selected results to the schematic window.

functions.name: sevBALMTool
functions.description: Opens the Transformer Modeler tool.

functions.name: sevBPMTool
functions.description: Opens the Bond Pad Modeler tool.

functions.name: sevChangeOutsOnSchematic
functions.syntax: sevChangeOutsOnSchematic( t_session t_setType [ ?selectionMode selectionMode ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets up for selection of selected output types from the schematic.

functions.name: sevChooseDesign
functions.description: Displays the Choosing Design form that lets you select the design to simulate.

functions.name: sevChooseEnvironmentOptions
functions.description: Displays the Environment Options form that lets you select the environment options for the simulation environment session.

functions.name: sevChooseSimulator
functions.description: Displays the Choosing Simulator/Directory/Host form that lets you choose the simulator you want to use, the run directory, and the host machine.

functions.name: sevChooseTemperature
functions.description: Displays the Setting Temperature form that lets you set the simulation temperature.

functions.name: sevCircuitCond
functions.description: Displays the Circuit Conditions form that lets you set or display any special circuit conditions.

functions.name: sevConvergence
functions.description: Displays the form for setting up the selected type of convergence aid.

functions.name: sevCopyCellViewVariables
functions.description: Copies the cell view variables and their values into the simulation environment.

functions.name: sevCopyVariablesToCellView
functions.description: Copies the simulation session variables and their values into the cellview.

functions.name: sevCornersTool
functions.description: Opens the Corners tool.

functions.name: sevCreateMainWindow
functions.description: Creates the main simulation environment window.

functions.name: sevDebug
functions.description: Runs the AHDL debugger using the current netlist.

functions.name: sevDeleteResults
functions.description: Displays the Delete Results form that lets you delete a set of previously saved results.

functions.name: sevDeleteSelectedAnas
functions.description: Deletes the analyses that are currently selected in the Analysis listbox.

functions.name: sevDeleteSelectedOpPoints
functions.description: Deletes the operating point instances selected in the Save Operating Points pane of the simulation window.

functions.name: sevDeleteSelectedOuts
functions.description: Deletes the selected items from the outputs list box.

functions.name: sevDeleteSelectedSubckts
functions.description: Deletes the subcircuit instances selected in the Save By Subckt Instances pane of the simulation window.

functions.name: sevDeleteSelectedVars
functions.description: Deletes any variables that are selected in the Variables listbox.

functions.name: sevDeleteSelections
functions.description: Deletes the selected items in any of the simulation environment list boxes.

functions.name: sevDevChecking
functions.description: Displays the Analog Design Environment Device Checking Setup form.

functions.name: sevDirectPlotMenu
functions.description: Creates the direct plot menu item list.

functions.name: sevDisplayViolations
functions.description: Displays the violations form.

functions.name: sevEditModels
functions.description: Displays the Model Library Setup form that lets you edit the Spectre direct model libraries.

functions.name: sevEditOptions
functions.description: Displays the Editing Session Options form that lets you edit the options for the given simulation environment session.

functions.name: sevEditPlottingOptions
functions.description: Displays the Setting Plotting Options form that lets you edit the plotting and printing options.

functions.name: sevEditSelectedAnas
functions.description: Displays the Choosing Analyses form that lets you select and edit the analyses.

functions.name: sevEditSelectedOuts
functions.description: Displays the Setting Outputs form that lets you edit the simulation outputs.

functions.name: sevEditSelectedVars
functions.description: Displays the Editing Design Variables form that lets you edit the simulation variables and their values.

functions.name: sevEditSimulationFile
functions.description: Displays the specified file in a window for editing.

functions.name: sevEditStimulus
functions.description: Displays the specified stimulus in a window for editing.

functions.name: sevEnvironment
functions.description: Displays the Oasis session object tied to the simulation environment session.

functions.name: sevEvaluateAndPlotExpressions
functions.description: Evaluates and plots all the output expressions.

functions.name: sevExportOutputsToCSV
functions.description: Exports the outputs specified in the ADE setup to the CSV file.

functions.name: sevExportOutputsToFile
functions.description: Exports the output from the ADE setup to the text or CSV file, which is specified by the .cdsenv variable outputsImportExportVersion. If the value of outputsImportExportVersion variable is greater than 1.0, then the function generates the output to the CSV file, else it generates the output to the text file.

functions.name: sevExportOutputsToTxt
functions.description: Exports the outputs specified in the Output listbox to a text file. This text file can be edited and imported back to ADE.

functions.name: sevFindSelectedVars
functions.description: Highlights the device on the schematic where the selected variable is used.

functions.name: sevGetExpressions
functions.description: Returns all the expressions in the specified ADE/ADEXL session.

functions.name: sevGetRegisteredPcellsForAnnotation
functions.description: Returns the list of library and cell name pairs of the registered Pcells to be used in the operating point annotation flow.

functions.name: sevGetSessionType
functions.description: Returns the name of the tool associated with the given session.

functions.name: sevIcon
functions.description: Displays the icon object corresponding to the specified name.

functions.name: sevImportOutputsFromCSV
functions.description: Imports the outputs from the CSV file to the ADE setup.

functions.name: sevImportOutputsFromFile
functions.description: Imports the output to the ADE setup from the text or CSV file, which is specified by the .cdsenv variable outputsImportExportVersion. If the value of outputsImportExportVersion variable is greater than 1.0, then the function imports the outputs from the CSV file, else it imports the outputs from the text file.

functions.name: sevImportOutputsFromTxt
functions.description: Imports the outputs saved in a text file to the output list box in the main ADE window.

functions.name: sevInvokeNCBrowse
functions.description: Displays the NCBrowse window.

functions.name: sevInvokeSimvision
functions.description: Displays the SimVision Waveform window.

functions.name: sevInvokeSimvisionDebugger
functions.description: Displays the SimVision Debugger interface with GUI options during an AMS session.

functions.name: sevIsContinuable
functions.description: Indicates whether the currently run simulation can be continued from its stopping point.

functions.name: sevKmodelTool
functions.description: Opens the RIFC Modeler for Cierto SPW tool.

functions.name: sevLMGTool
functions.description: Opens the Transmission Line Modeler tool.

functions.name: sevLoadState
functions.description: Displays the Loading State form that lets you load a saved state into the current simulation environment.

functions.name: sevMTSMode
functions.description: Returns the status of the MTS mode.

functions.name: sevMTSOptions
functions.description: Invokes the MTS option form if MTS mode is enabled. A dialog box appears if the MTS option is disabled.

functions.name: sevMenuItems
functions.description: Displays the menu item list that corresponds to the named menu item.

functions.name: sevMonteCarloTool
functions.description: Opens the Analog Statistical Analysis tool.

functions.name: sevMpuTool
functions.description: Displays the Setting Model Path form that lets you select the paths to the model files.

functions.name: sevNetlistAndDebug
functions.description: Forces the circuit to netlist and runs the AHDL debugger.

functions.name: sevNetlistAndRun
functions.description: Forces the circuit to netlist and then runs the simulation.

functions.name: sevNetlistFile
functions.description: Creates the selected type of netlist file.

functions.name: sevNoAnaSelections
functions.description: Indicates whether any analyses are selected in the Analysis listbox.

functions.name: sevNoDesign
functions.description: Indicates whether a design is tied to the simulation environment.

functions.name: sevNoEnvironment
functions.description: Indicates whether an Oasis environment is tied to the simulation environment.

functions.name: sevNoLog
functions.description: Checks if the specified log file exists for the AMS interface.

functions.name: sevNoOutSelections
functions.description: Indicates whether any output is selected in the Outputs listbox.

functions.name: sevNoOutputLog
functions.description: Indicates whether the simulation output log exists.

functions.name: sevNoPlottableExpressions
functions.description: Indicates whether there are any plottable expressions.

functions.name: sevNoPlottableOutputs
functions.description: Indicates whether there are any plottable outputs.

functions.name: sevNoPlottableSignals
functions.description: Indicates whether there are any plottable outputs.

functions.name: sevNoResults
functions.description: Indicates whether the specified results exist.

functions.name: sevNoVarSelections
functions.description: Indicates whether any variables are selected in the Variables listbox.

functions.name: sevNoViolationsFound
functions.description: Determines if any violation file has been found in the results.

functions.name: sevNonActiveSelectedAna
functions.description: Returns the list of selected analyses that are currently not enabled.

functions.name: sevNonMixedSignal
functions.description: Indicates whether the session is running a mixed signal simulation.

functions.name: sevOpenCalculator
functions.description: Opens the Calculator.

functions.name: sevOpenDRLBrowser
functions.description: Opens the Browse Project Hierarchy window.

functions.name: sevOpenEncap
functions.description: Opens the command type in window that lets you enter commands directly to the simulator.

functions.name: sevOpenJobMonitor
functions.description: Opens the Job monitor.

functions.name: sevOpenPlotWindow
functions.description: Opens a plot window.

functions.name: sevOpenPrintWindow
functions.description: Opens a print window.

functions.name: sevOpenSchematic
functions.description: Displays a schematic window for the design that is tied to the simulation environment.

functions.name: sevOpenXterm
functions.description: Opens an terminal window at the given path.

functions.name: sevOptimizationTool
functions.description: Opens the Optimization tool.

functions.name: sevPCMTool
functions.description: Opens the Spiral Inductor Modeler tool.

functions.name: sevPKGTool
functions.description: Opens the RFIC Package Modeler tool.

functions.name: sevParametricTool
functions.description: Opens the Parametric analysis tool.

functions.name: sevParasiticsDisplayed
functions.description: Determines whether the Show Parasitics menu will be disabled when the DC Operating Point results are available.

functions.name: sevParasiticsNotDisplayed
functions.description: Determines if the Hide Parasitics menu will be disabled when the DC Operating Point results are available.

functions.name: sevPlotAllOutputs
functions.description: Plots all enabled plottable outputs.

functions.name: sevPlotSignals
functions.syntax: sevPlotSignals( t_session t_type [ ?disableRedraw g_disableRedraw ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Plots the speacified type of signals that exist as outputs.

functions.name: sevPrintResults
functions.description: Displays the Print Results form that lets you print the selected type of simulation results.

functions.name: sevQuit
functions.description: Quits the simulation session.

functions.name: sevRegisterPcellsForAnnotation
functions.description: Registers a list of Pcells to be used in the operating point annotation flow.

functions.name: sevRemovePlotWindow
functions.description: Removes the specified plot window from the list of plot windows owned by the given simulation environment session.

functions.name: sevReset
functions.description: Resets the simulation environment session to its default values.

functions.name: sevRetrieveFromEffectiveCDF
functions.description: Retrieves data from the effective CDF. This function should be used before the sevAnnotateResults function.

functions.name: sevReturnVariablesWithEmptyValues
functions.description: Returns the set of variables in a session with empty values.

functions.name: sevRun
functions.description: Runs a simulation using the current netlist.

functions.name: sevRunEngine
functions.description: Runs a simulation from the simulation environment session.

functions.name: sevSaveOceanScript
functions.description: Displays the Save Ocean Script to File form that lets you save an Ocean script that will regenerate the current session to the specified file.

functions.name: sevSaveOptions
functions.description: Displays the Save Options form that lets you select what voltages and currents should be automatically saved in the simulation.

functions.name: sevSaveResults
functions.description: Displays the Save Results form that lets you save the current results.

functions.name: sevSaveState
functions.description: Displays the Saving State form that lets you save the current state of the simulation environment.

functions.name: sevSelectResults
functions.description: Displays the Select Results form that lets you select and load a previously saved set of results.

functions.name: sevSession
functions.description: Displays the session ID of the simulation environment such as the ADE L window, the schematic window associated with ADE L, or a form launched from ADE L.

functions.name: sevSetConnectModules
functions.description: Displays the Connect Rules form that allows you to select built-in or user-defined connect rules.

functions.name: sevSetEngineOptions
functions.description: Displays the Engine Options form for the selected type for editing.

functions.name: sevSetMTSMode
functions.description: Enables or disables the MTS mode.

functions.name: sevSetMainWindowPulldownMenus
functions.description: Sets the menus for the Virtuoso Analog Simulation Environment window.

functions.name: sevSetMenuItemLists
functions.description: Creates the menu item lists.

functions.name: sevSetPropertyForSelectedOuts
functions.syntax: sevSetPropertyForSelectedOuts( t_session  t_property  g_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the property to the specified value on the selected outputs.

functions.name: sevSetSchematicPulldownMenus
functions.description: Sets the simulation menus on the schematic window.

functions.name: sevSetSimDataDir
functions.description: Loads the results for the specified simulation environment session and results directory.

functions.name: sevSetSolver
functions.description: Displays the Choose Solver form, which lets you select a solver.

functions.name: sevSetTopSaveDir
functions.description: This function sets the ADE L Save State directory for the simulation environment session.

functions.name: sevSetTypeInWindowPulldownMenus
functions.description: Sets the menu on the simulator type in window.

functions.name: sevSetupSimulationFiles
functions.description: Displays the Simulation Files Setup form that lets you specify the simulation files and paths for Spectre direct simulation.

functions.name: sevSetupStimuli
functions.description: Displays the Setup Analog Stimuli form that lets you specify the circuit stimuli.

functions.name: sevSimulator
functions.description: Displays the name of the simulator used in the session as a string.

functions.name: sevStartSession
functions.syntax: sevStartSession( [ ?design g_design ] [ ?lib g_lib ] [ ?cell g_cell ] [ ?view g_view ] [ ?schematic g_schematic ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Starts the Virtuoso Analog Simulation Environment session tied to the specified design. It will try the design first, then lib/cell/view, and finally it will try the schematic. If none of these is specified, it will start a skeleton session that will not be able to do anything until a design has been tied to the session. The lib/cell/view arguments must be specified, otherwise they are ignored.

functions.name: sevStopEngine
functions.description: Stops the currently running simulation that is tied to the session.

functions.name: sevTopSaveDir
functions.description: Displays the current ADE L Save State directory path.

functions.name: sevViewCompilerLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulation compiler log file. The log file can be either ncvlog.log or ncvhdl.log depending on the contents of the AMS design.

functions.name: sevViewElabLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulation elaborator log file.

functions.name: sevViewNcVerilogLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulation NcVerilog log file.

functions.name: sevViewNetlisterLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS netlister log file.

functions.name: sevViewSimLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulator log file.

functions.name: sevViewSimulatorOutput
functions.description: Displays the simulation output log.

functions.name: sevWhatsNew
functions.description: Opens the Whats New window for the simulation environment.

functions.name: maeAddOutput
functions.syntax: maeAddOutput( t_outputName t_testName [ ?outputType t_outputType ] [ ?signalName t_signalName ] [ ?expr t_expr ] [ ?plot g_plot ] [ ?save g_save ] [ ?quote g_quote ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds or updates an output for the given test in the currently active setup.

functions.name: maeCloseResults
functions.description: Closes the results opened by the maeOpenResults function.

functions.name: maeCloseSession
functions.description: Closes the session that are opened using maeOpenSetup in the SKILL code. This function cannot be used to close the sessions opened from the Virtuoso user interface.

functions.name: maeConvertAndCombineMultiADELToAssembler
functions.syntax: maeConvertAndCombineMultiADELToAssembler( l_stateList t_maestroLib t_maestroCell [ ?maestroView t_maestroView ] [ ?migrateFrom t_migrateFrom ] [ ?rootPath t_rootPath ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] ) => l_cellviewDetails / nil
functions.description: Combines two or more ADE L states into one maestro cellview for ADE Assembler.

functions.name: maeCreateTest
functions.syntax: maeCreateTest( t_testName  [ ?sourceTest t_sourceTest ]  [ ?lib t_lib ]  [ ?cell t_cell ] [ ?view t_view ] [ ?simulator t_simulator ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a new test and adds it to the given maestro session. If a source test name is given, it creates a copy of that test. If that is not given, creates a new blank test and sets the design name using the library, cell, and view name.

functions.name: maeDeleteCorner
functions.description: Deletes the specified corner from the setup database.

functions.name: maeDeleteOutput
functions.syntax: maeDeleteOutput( t_outputName t_testName [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified output from the setup database.

functions.name: maeDeleteParameter
functions.description: Deletes the specified parameter from the setup database.

functions.name: maeDeleteSimulationData
functions.syntax: maeDeleteSimulationData( t_historyName ?session t_sessionName ?keepNetlist g_keepNetlist ?keepQuickPlot g_keepQuickPlot )=> t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the simulation results data for the given history.

functions.name: maeDeleteVar
functions.description: Deletes the specified variable from the setup database.

functions.name: maeExportOutputView
functions.syntax: maeExportOutputView( [ ?view t_viewName ] [ ?fileName t_fileName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?historyName t_historyName ] ) => t_filePath / nil
functions.description: Exports the output view to the specified .csv or .html file.

functions.name: maeExportSetupForExplorer
functions.description: Displays the Save A Copy form in ADE Explorer, which you can use to save the current setup. It is a callback function.

functions.name: maeGetAllPlottingTemplates
functions.description: Returns a list of all plotting templates saved in the given session.

functions.name: maeGetAnalysis
functions.syntax: maeGetAnalysis( t_testName t_analysis [ ?includeEmpty g_includeEmpty ] [ ?option t_option ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => l_options / nil
functions.description: Returns a list containing name-value pairs of the options set for the given analysis. By default, the function returns only those options for which the value is not empty. If the g_includeEmpty argument is set to t, it returns all the options. You can also specify the name of a specific option for which you want to know the value.

functions.name: maeGetCurrentRunMode
functions.syntax: maeGetCurrentRunMode( [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?run t_runName ] [ ?Abbreviations g_abbreviation ] ) => t_runModeName / nil
functions.description: Returns the name of the run mode set in the given session or the given run.

functions.name: maeGetEnabledAnalysis
functions.description: Returns a list containing names of all the analyses enabled for the given test.

functions.name: maeGetEnvOption
functions.syntax: maeGetEnvOption( t_testName [ ?includeEmpty g_includeEmpty ] [ ?option t_option ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => l_optionList / nil
functions.description: Returns a list containing name-value pairs for all the environment option for the given test. By default, it returns all the environment options whose value is not nil. If the includeEmpty argument is set to t, the function returns all the environment options. If a specific option is specified, it returns the value of only that option.

functions.name: maeGetExplorerTestName
functions.description: Returns the name of the test opened in ADE Explorer. If you descend into ADE Explorer from ADE Assembler, use this function to get the name of the current test.

functions.name: maeGetJobPolicy
functions.description: Returns the details of the job policy attached to the given test. If no test name is given, the function returns the policy attached to the current setup.

functions.name: maeGetJobPolicyByName
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list containing property-value pairs for the given job policy.

functions.name: maeGetNBestDesignPoints
functions.description: Returns the best n design points for the opened results.

functions.name: maeGetOutputValue
functions.syntax: maeGetOutputValue( t_outputName t_testName [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?pointId x_pointId ] [ ?evalType t_evalType ] ) => x_value / nil
functions.description: Returns value of the given output.

functions.name: maeGetOverallSpecStatus
functions.description: Returns the overall specification status for the current history.

functions.name: maeGetOverallYield
functions.description: Returns the overall yield for the given history.

functions.name: maeGetParamConditions
functions.description: Returns the design parameter conditions for the given design point ID.

functions.name: maeGetParameter
functions.syntax: maeGetParameter( t_paramName [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue t_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t_value / nil
functions.description: Returns value of the given parameter for the given test or corner.

functions.name: maeGetResultOutputs
functions.description: Returns the list of outputs for the opened result.

functions.name: maeGetResultTests
functions.description: Returns the list of tests for the opened result.

functions.name: maeGetRunPlan
functions.description: Returns a list of all the runs available in the run plan for the given session.

functions.name: maeGetSessions
functions.description: Returns a list of valid ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler sessions that are currently open.

functions.name: maeGetSetup
functions.syntax: maeGetSetup( [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => l_setupDetails / nil
functions.description: Returns the required setup details of variables, parameters, corners, and tests from the given session.

functions.name: maeGetSimOption
functions.syntax: maeGetSimOption( t_testName [ ?option t_optionName ] [ ?includeEmpty g_includeEmpty ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => l_options / nil
functions.description: Returns a list containing name-value pairs for the simulator options for the given test. By default, it returns all the simulator options whose value is not nil. If the includeEmpty argument is set to t, it returns all the simulator options. If a specific option is specified, the function returns the value of only that option.

functions.name: maeGetSimulationMessages
functions.description: Displays the error messages of the given type thrown during the simulating run.

functions.name: maeGetSpecStatus
functions.syntax: maeGetSpecStatus( t_outputName t_testName [ ?pointId n_pointId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Returns the specification status for the given output, test and point id.

functions.name: maeGetTestEnvVar
functions.syntax: maeGetTestEnvVar( t_testName t_varName [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified environment variable for the given test. This function can be used to get the value set for a particular test using the maeSetTestEnvVar function.

functions.name: maeGetTestSession
functions.description: Returns session handle to the given test. You can use this handle to view or modify the test details.

functions.name: maeGetVar
functions.syntax: maeGetVar ( t_varname [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue t_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Returns value of the given variable.

functions.name: maeImportSetupForExplorer
functions.description: Displays the Import Setup form in ADE Explorer, which you can use to import a saved maestro cellview in the current setup. It is a callback function.

functions.name: maeIsSetupModified
functions.description: Checks whether the setup has been modified after the last time it was saved in the given maestro session.

functions.name: maeIsSingleTest
functions.syntax: maeIsSingleTest( t_libraryName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Returns t if the given cellview contains a single test or multiple tests.

functions.name: maeIsValidMaestroSession
functions.description: Confirms if the given session is a valid session for ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler.

functions.name: maeLoadCorners
functions.syntax: maeLoadCorners( t_fileName  ?operation t_operation ?session t_session ) => t / nil
functions.description: Loads corners from the given file into the corner setup of the current session or the specified session.

functions.name: maeLoadSetupState
functions.syntax: maeLoadSetupState( t_stateName [ ?tags l_tagNames ]  [ ?operation s_operationName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]) ) => t_sessionName / nil
functions.description: Loads the given setup state into the given session.

functions.name: maeLoadStateForTest
functions.syntax: maeLoadStateForTest( t_testName t_stateName [ ?session t_session ] [ ?loadFrom s_loadFrom ] [ ?statePath s_statePath ] [ ?libName t_libName ] [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?simulator t_simulatorName ] [ ?component l_componentList ] ) => t_sessionName / nil
functions.description: Loads the saved ADE state for the given test.

functions.name: maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro
functions.syntax: maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro( t_stateLib t_stateCell t_stateName [ ?maestroLib t_maestroLib ] [ ?maestroCell  t_maestroCell ] [ ?maestroView t_maestroView ] [ ?migrateFrom s_migrateFrom ] [ ?statePath t_statePath ] [ ?simulator t_simulator ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] ) => l_cellviewDetails / nil
functions.description: Migrates the given ADE L state to a maestro cellview that can be opened in ADE Explorer.

functions.name: maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro
functions.syntax: maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro( t_stateLib t_stateCell t_stateName [ ?maestroLib t_maestroLib ] [ ?maestroCell  t_maestroCell ] [ ?maestroView t_maestroView ] [ ?overwrite g_overwrite ] [ ?skipHistory g_skipHistory ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Migrates the given adexl view to a new maestro cellview that can be opened in ADE Assembler.

functions.name: maeOpenResults
functions.syntax: maeOpenResults( [ ?session t_sessionName ] [ ?history t_historyName ] [ ?run t_runName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Opens the result for the given history or run plan, and sets the result pointer to be used by other functions.

functions.name: maeOpenSetup
functions.syntax: maeOpenSetup( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?histName t_historyName ] [ ?mode t_mode ] ) => t_sessionName / nil
functions.description: Loads the given cellview and restores the setup details from the specified history. If no history name is specified, the active setup is loaded. If the specified view is already opened in the current Virtuoso session, it is not opened again. However, if the view is already opened in some other Virtuoso session, it is opened in read mode in the current session. If the given cellview does not exist, the function creates a new cellview with the same name.

functions.name: maePlotWithPlottingTemplate
functions.syntax: maePlotWithPlottingTemplate( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?history t_historyName ]  [ ?replaceMode t_replaceMode ]  [ ?name t_templateName ]   ) => l_windowsPlotted / nil
functions.description: Plots the results for the given history using the specified plotting template.

functions.name: maeReadResDB
functions.syntax: maeReadResDB( [ ?historyName t_historyName ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?run t_runName ] ) => h_resultsDBObj / nil
functions.description: Returns a handle to the results database for the given history.

functions.name: maeRestoreHistory
functions.description: Restores the given history as active setup. The active setup is replaced with the setup from the history being restored.

functions.name: maeResumeSimulation
functions.description: Resumes the simulations that were earlier suspended automatically by ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler according to the settings specified on the Resources tab of the Job Policy Setup form.

functions.name: maeRunSimulation
functions.syntax: maeRunSimulation( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?runMode t_runMode ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?run t_runPlan ] [ ?waitUntilDone g_waitUntilDone ] [ ?returnRunId g_returnRunId ] ) => t_histname / x_runID / nil
functions.description: Sets the given run mode for the given session and runs simulation.

functions.name: maeSaveImagesUsingPlottingTemplate
functions.syntax: maeSaveImagesUsingPlottingTemplate( [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?history t_historyName ]  [ ?replaceMode t_replaceMode ]  [ ?name t_templateName ]  [ ?dir t_dirPath ]  [ ?saveEachSubwindowSeparately t_saveEachSubwindowSeparately ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Plots and saves the results for the given history using the specified plotting template.

functions.name: maeSaveSetup
functions.syntax: maeSaveSetup( [ ?lib t_libName ]  [ ?cell t_cellName ] [ ?view t_viewName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the setup database file and test state files for the current session in the library, cell, view format. The behavior of this function is similar to File - Save. By default, the setup of the current cellview is saved. If the cellview was opened in the read-only mode, a new library, cell, and view value must be provided for which you need to save the setup details.

functions.name: maeSaveSetupState
functions.syntax: maeSaveSetupState( t_stateName [ ?tags l_tagNames ]  [ ?inReadOnly s_readOnlyAction ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a setup state for the given session.

functions.name: maeSetAnalysis
functions.syntax: maeSetAnalysis( t_testName t_analysis [ ?enable g_enabled ] [ ?options l_options ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds an analysis or changes the enabled status of the specified analysis for the given test. The function can also be used to set the value of different options for the analysis.

functions.name: maeSetCorner
functions.syntax: maeSetCorner( t_cornerName [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?enableTests l_enableTests ] [ ?disableTests l_disableTests ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new corner and enables/disables it for the given test.

functions.name: maeSetEnableTestVar
functions.syntax: maeSetEnableTestVar( t_testName l_variableNames [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables the specified variables or local sweeps for the given test.

functions.name: maeSetEnvOption
functions.syntax: maeSetEnvOption( t_testName [ ?options l_options ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets values for one or more environment options for the given test.

functions.name: maeSetHistoryLock
functions.syntax: maeSetHistoryLock( t_historyName  g_lock [ ?session t_sessionName ]) => t / nil
functions.description: Locks or unlocks the given history in the given ADE Assembler session.

functions.name: maeSetJobPolicy
functions.syntax: maeSetJobPolicy ( t_jobPolicyName [ ?blockemail t_blockemail ] [ ?configuretimeout t_configuretimeout ] [ ?configuredtimeout t_configuredtimeout ] [ ?distributionmethod t_distributionmethod ] [ ?lingertimeout t_lingertimeout ] [ ?interfacename t_interfaceName ] [ ?jobhostname t_remoteHostName ] [ ?jobqueue t_queueName ] [ ?joboutfilename t_jobOutFileName ] [ ?joberrfilename t_jobErrFileName ] [ ?loginshell t_loginShellName ] [ ?jobresourcerequirements t_LSFresources ] [ ?jobprojectname t_LSFProjectNames ] [ ?jobsubmitcommand t_command ] [ ?jobusergroup t_LSFUserGroup ] [ ?maxjobs t_maxjobs ] [ ?parallelnumprocs t_lbsParallelNumProcs ] [ ?preemptivestart t_preemptivestart ] [ ?reconfigureimmediately t_reconfigureimmediately ] [ ?runtimeout t_runtimeout ] [ ?sgehardresource t_SGEHardResources ] [ ?sgesoftresource t_SGESoftResources ] [ ?sgepriority t_SGEPriority ] [ ?sgeparallelenv t_SGEParallelEnv ] [ ?showerrorwhenretrying t_showerrorwhenretrying ] [ ?showoutputlogerror t_showoutputlogerror ] [ ?startmaxjobsimmed t_startmaxjobsimmed ] [ ?starttimeout t_starttimeout ] [ ?usesameprocess t_usesameprocess ] [ ?tests l_testName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the given job policy to the specified setup for given tests. If the given job policy name exists, it overwrites the colliding properties and appends the new ones.

functions.name: maeSetParameter
functions.syntax: maeSetParameter( t_parameterName g_parameterValue [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue l_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a new parameter at the global level or corner level. If the parameter already exists, updates its value.

functions.name: maeSetPreRunScript
functions.syntax: maeSetPreRunScript( t_scriptName [ ?tests l_testNames ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the given script as a pre-run script for the given test and sets its status.

functions.name: maeSetRunOption
functions.syntax: maeSetRunOption( t_mode t_runOptionName t_runOptionValue [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value for a run option.

functions.name: maeSetSetup
functions.syntax: maeSetSetup( [ ?tests l_testNames ] [ ?variables l_variables ] [ ?parameters l_params ] [ ?corners l_corners ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables/disables the tests, global variables, parameters, and corners.

functions.name: maeSetSimOption
functions.syntax: maeSetSimOption( t_testName  [ ?options l_options ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets values for the specified simulator options of the given test. Multiple options can be specified in a single command.

functions.name: maeSetSpec
functions.syntax: maeSetSpec ( t_outputName t_testName [ ?minimum g_minValue ] [ ?maximum g_maxValue ] [ ?gt g_greaterThanValue ] [ ?lt g_lessThanValue ] [ ?range g_rangeValues ] [ ?tolerance g_toleranceValue ] [ ?info g_info ] [ ?weight g_weightingFactor ] [ ?corner g_cornerName ] [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a specification to an output defined for a test. You can also use this function to modify an existing specification for an output.

functions.name: maeSetTestEnvVar
functions.syntax: maeSetTestEnvVar( t_testName t_varName g_varValue [ ?session t_sessionName ] ) => t_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for the given environment variable at the test level. The value is used only by the specified test. Other tests in the session use the value set at the global level or specific values set for them, if any.

functions.name: maeSetVar
functions.syntax: maeSetVar( t_varname g_valValue [ ?typeName t_typeName ] [ ?typeValue l_typeValue ] [ ?session t_sessionName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a variable to the given test or corner in the given ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler session. If the variable already exists, its value is updated.

functions.name: maeStopSimulation
functions.description: Stops simulation runs for the given histories.

functions.name: maeWaitUntilDone
functions.description: Specifies the names of history checkpoints for which the tool must wait before proceeding further.

functions.name: maeWriteDatasheet
functions.syntax: maeWriteDatasheet( [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?resultsSummary t_resultsSummary ] [ ?testsSummary t_testsSummary ] [ ?detailedResults g_detailedResults ] [ ?plots g_points ] [ ?designVarsSummary g_designVarsSummary ] [ ?paramsSummary g_paramsSummary ] [ ?cornersSummary g_cornersSummary ] [ ?setupSummary g_setupSummary ] [ ?launchBrowser g_launchBrowser ] [ ?name t_name ]  [ ?session t_sessionName ]  [ ?historyName t_historyName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Writes the results for the given history in a datasheet.

functions.name: maeWriteScript
functions.syntax: maeWriteScript( t_fileName [ ?session t_session ] [ ?shouldRunActive g_shouldRunActive ]  [ ?runPlans l_runPlans ]  [ ?histories l_histories ]  ) => h_resultsDBObj / nil
functions.description: Creates a script with the specified setup details. This script can be run from the command line.

functions.name: sevCloseXmlFile
functions.description: Closes the specified XML state handle.

functions.name: sevConvertStateFormat
functions.syntax: sevConvertStateFormat( [ ?libs l_libs ] [ ?stateDir t_stateDir ] [ ?viewType t_viewType ] [ ?format t_format ] [ ?backup g_backup ] [ ?recover g_recover ] [ ?autoCheckin g_autoCheckin ] [ ?popUpWarnWin g_popUpWarnWin ] => t / nil
functions.description: Translates all ADE XL states from normal to XML format in the current directory. This function can also be used to do translate a specific parameter set. You can use this function in the OCEAN script and perform the translation in a batch.

functions.name: sevOpenXmlFile
functions.description: Opens the specified XML state file. If the specified file does not exist, this function creates a new file.

functions.name: sevReadTable
functions.syntax: sevReadTable( x_stateHandle S_componentName o_table ) => x_stateHandle / nil

functions.description: Enables the interface job debugging and sets the output to a file.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcExitMethod
functions.description: Job Interface member function used to exit a job. ADE XL usually attempts to call exit(0) on remote job cleanup the job's resources properly. However, if this fails or if ADE XL is forced to kill all jobs, the exit method will be called on every remote job. This method may be called after the job has already exited. This job can also be called multiple times.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcHealthMethod
functions.description: Job Interface member function used to return the current health of the job. ADE XL calls this function regularly (currently, every 5 seconds) on each job in order to recognize health changes. The available health types are: unknown, alive, or dead. If the job Interface detects that the process is still pending, return unknown. If the Job Interface detects that the job has launched, return alive. Otherwise, ADE XL will eventually receive a start message from the remote job and automatically change the current health of the job to alive. If the Job Interface detects that the job has exited, return dead. Otherwise, ADE XL will eventually recognize that remote communication has failed and automatically change the current health of the job to dead.Once marked dead, the health will not be queried, dead is a terminal state. If no change is detected, the current state should be returned.

functions.name: axlJobIntfcSetDebug

functions.name: axlJobIntfcStartMethod

functions.name: axlSDBGetChildVal
functions.description: Works as a wrapper around axlSDBGetChild and returns the value for a single child element.

functions.name: axlSDBGetChildren
functions.syntax: axlSDBGetChildren( x_SDBH [ t_name ] [ t_value ] S_returnAs ) => l_children / nil
functions.description: Returns child elements of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBGetExtension
functions.description: Returns the named setup database extension.

functions.name: axlSDBGetName
functions.description: Returns the name of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBGetValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBHp
functions.description: Returns whether the supplied argument is a valid setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBPutExtension
functions.description: Adds an extension to the ADE setup database under which customization can be created.

functions.name: axlSDBSetChild
functions.syntax: axlSDBSetChild( x_SDBH t_name t_value ) => x_SDBH / nil
functions.description: Creates a new child element under the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSDBSetMultipleEntry
functions.description: Sets a setup database name to be a multiple entry name.  By default, a setup database handle is a single entry name.  A single-entry element is differentiated only by its name, whereas a multi-entry element is differentiated by both name and value.

functions.name: axlSDBSetValue
functions.description: Sets the value of the provided setup database handle.

functions.name: axlSaveJobPolicy
functions.description: Saves the policy given by policyName.

functions.name: axlSaveSetup
functions.description: Saves the setup database file and test state files for the current window. The behavior of this function is similar to File - Save. If the cellview was opened in the read-only mode, a new library, cell, and view value must be provided for which you need to save the setup details.

functions.name: axlSaveSetupState
functions.syntax: axlSaveSetupState( t_session t_stateName l_tags [ ?inReadOnly readOnlyAction ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a setup state for the specified session.

functions.name: axlSaveSetupToLib
functions.syntax: axlSaveSetupToLib(  x_hsdb  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the setup database to the specified lib/cell/view.

functions.name: axlSessionConnect
functions.syntax: axlSessionConnect(  t_sessionName t_signalName s_callbackFunction )  => t / nil
functions.description: Register a SKILL callback to be connected to a known signal or trigger emitted from an ADE (G) XL session.

functions.name: axlSessionDisconnect
functions.description: Disconnects the specified SKILL callback connected to one or more known signals emitted by ADE (G) XL session.

functions.name: axlSessionRegisterCreationCallback
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function as callback to be called whenever the event for which it is registered is occurred.

functions.name: axlSessionSignalList
functions.description: Returns a list of all the signals or triggers that are emitted from a given ADE (G) XL session. You can create custom callback functions to be executed when these events are triggered. For more details, refer to Working with ADE (G)XL Signals or Triggers.

functions.name: axlSessionSignalSignature
functions.description: Returns the signature of a given signal that is emitted by an ADE (G)XL session. This function serves as a utility function to determine how to implement the slot or callback function in SKILL.

functions.name: axlSetAllCornersEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables all the corners for simulation. This changes the selection status of the Corners check box in the Run Summary assistant.

functions.name: axlSetAllParametersDisabled
functions.description: Sets the status of the Parameters check box in the Data View assistant pane.

functions.name: axlSetAllSweepsEnabled
functions.description: Sets the selection status of the Point Sweeps check box in the Run Summary assistant pane.

functions.name: axlSetAllVarsDisabled
functions.description: Sets the selection status of the option to include the global variables in simulations. In the ADE XL GUI, this is the selection status of the Global Variables check box in the Data View assistant pane.

functions.name: axlSetCopyRefResultsOption
functions.description: Sets whether the simulation results need to be copied or moved from the reference history.

functions.name: axlSetCornerName
functions.description: Sets or updates the name of the given corner.

functions.name: axlSetCornerTestEnabled
functions.syntax: axlSetCornerTestEnabled( x_cornerHandle  t_testName g_enableFlag )  => x_num / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables simulation of a test for the given corner. This function changes the status of the check box corresponding to a test in the column for the given corner.

functions.name: axlSetCurrentRunMode
functions.description: Sets the current simulation run mode for the given database.

functions.name: axlSetDefaultCornerEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables the default (nominal) corner for the specified test. The program creates a nominal corner when you create a test. This corner represents the absence of corner-specific information.

functions.name: axlSetDefaultVariables
functions.description: Creates a set of default variables in the Global Variables tree on the Data View pane and in the Parameters and Variables assistant for an ADE XL session.

functions.name: axlSetDesignVariablePerTest
functions.syntax: axlSetDesignVariablePerTest(  x_mainSDB t_varName t_testName [ ?enabled g_enableStatus ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables a design variable for a specific test. In the ADE XL UI, it selects or clears the check box next to a design variable under a test.

functions.name: axlSetEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables a setup database element, such as a test or a variable.

functions.name: axlSetHistoryLock
functions.description: Locks the specified checkpoint history. After it is locked, you cannot delete the history or the simulation data saved for it.

functions.name: axlSetHistoryName
functions.description: Sets a new name for the specified history.

functions.name: axlSetHistoryPrefixInPreRunTrigger
functions.description: Sets a prefix to be used in the history name for a new run.

functions.name: axlSetJobPolicyProperty
functions.syntax: axlSetJobPolicyProperty(  t_jobPolicyName  t_jobPropertyName  t_jobPropertyValue  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a property name-value pair for the specified job policy. You can use this function to update the properties of an existing policy. To apply the updated properties to all the ADE XL sessions, set the updated policy as the default policy for ADE XL by using the defaultJobPolicy environment variable.

functions.name: axlSetMainSetupDB
functions.description: Sets the working setup database for an ADE XL session to the setup database specified by the given setupDBPath. This function is useful when you create a new session in a SKILL script and then you want to setup a database for that.

functions.name: axlSetMainSetupDBLCV
functions.syntax: axlSetMainSetupDBLCV(  t_session  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?mode t_mode ] )  => x_mainSDB / nil
functions.description: Sets the working setup database for a given ADE XL session to the setup database specified by the given library, cell, or view.

functions.name: axlSetModelBlock
functions.description: Sets the name of the block for the specified model. By default, a model is associated with all the design blocks and is set as Global. In the MTS mode, a model is associated with a specific MTS block, so you need to use this function to specify the name of that block.

functions.name: axlSetModelFile
functions.description: Sets the model file for the specified model.

functions.name: axlSetModelGroupName
functions.description: Sets or associates the given model group with the specified corner.

functions.name: axlSetModelPermissibleSectionLists
functions.description: Sets a permissible section list for the given model extracted from a PCF file. If a model file includes many sections out of which only a limited number of sections are of relevance to your testbench, you can create a permissible section list for that model file. If the LimitModelSections environment variable is set to LimitedList, while displaying the list of section names in the Corners Setup UI, ADE XL checks the permissible section list for a model file and shows only the relevant names.

functions.name: axlSetModelSection
functions.description: Sets the section name for the specified model.

functions.name: axlSetModelTest
functions.description: Sets the name of the test to be associated with the specified model. By default, a model is associated with all the tests. In case of MTS mode, you need to associate the model with a specific test. Alternatively, you can use the axlPutModel function to specify the test name while adding a model.

functions.name: axlSetNominalCornerEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables the nominal corner in the specified setup database.

functions.name: axlSetNominalCornerTestEnabled
functions.description: Sets the status of the check box corresponding to the given test in the Nominal column on the Corners Setup form.

functions.name: axlSetOutputUserDefinedData
functions.syntax: axlSetOutputUserDefinedData(  x_mainSDB  t_testName  t_outputName  t_columnName  t_columnValue ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value in the given user-defined column for the given test name and output.

functions.name: axlSetOverwriteHistory
functions.description: Sets the Overwrite History option for the active setup.

functions.name: axlSetOverwriteHistoryName
functions.description: Sets the name of the history to be overwritten for the specified active setup.

functions.name: axlSetParameter
functions.syntax: axlSetParameter( x_mainSDB t_parameterPath t_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a value for the specified device parameter.

functions.name: axlSetParasiticRunMode
functions.description: Sets the parasitic run mode for the given ADE XL setup.

functions.name: axlSetPreRunScript
functions.syntax: axlSetPreRunScript( t_sessionName t_testName g_scriptName ) => t_filePath / nil
functions.description: Sets or adds a pre-run script for an ADE XL test.

functions.name: axlSetPreRunScriptEnabled
functions.syntax: axlSetPreRunScriptEnabled( t_sessionName t_testName g_enabled ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables execution of pre-run scripts before running simulations.

functions.name: axlSetReferenceHistoryItemName
functions.description: Sets the reference history name for the active setup or checkpoint. You can reuse the results or netlist from the reference history during an incremental simulation run. The reference history name set using this function also appears in the Reference field on the Reference History toolbar.

functions.name: axlSetReuseNetlistOption
functions.description: Enables or disables the option to use the reference netlist for the active setup or checkpoint. If this option is enabled, netlist of the design is reused for the incremental run. Otherwise, the design in renetlisted.

functions.name: axlSetRunDistributeOptions
functions.syntax: axlSetRunDistributeOptions(  x_hsdb  [ ?RunIn t_runIn ] [ ?DivideJobs t_divideJobs ] [ ?JobLimit n_jobLimit ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified run option settings for the given setup database. These settings are also visible in the Run Options form.

functions.name: axlSetRunOptionName
functions.description: Sets the run option name.

functions.name: axlSetRunOptionValue
functions.description: Sets a value for the given run option.

functions.name: axlSetScriptPath
functions.description: Sets the path of a script.

functions.name: axlSetTestToolArgs
functions.description: Sets the tool options for the test.

functions.name: axlSetUseIncremental
functions.description: Enables or disables the setup database option in active setup or checkpoint for using reference results as cache during incremental run. This function selects or clears the Use reference netlist check box on the Reference History form.

functions.name: axlSetWCCTime
functions.description: Sets the time information for the given specfication handle of a worst case corner.

functions.name: axlSetWYCSigmaTargetLimit
functions.description: Sets the sigma-to-target limit for Improve Yield flow using worst yield corners.

functions.name: axlSetupStates
functions.description: Retrieves a list of setup states from the given session.

functions.name: axlShowPersistedQuestionDialog
functions.description: Shows the suppressed question dialog for a specified msgId in a Virtuoso session.

functions.name: axlStop
functions.description: Stops a run based on id..

functions.name: axlStopAll
functions.description: Stops all runs currently evaluating in the ADE XL session.

functions.name: axlStopAllJobs
functions.description: Stops all the ICRPs jobs present in the system.

functions.name: axlStopJob
functions.syntax: axlStopJob(  t_sessionName x_jobId [ g_forceFlag ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Stops a job.

functions.name: axlSuppressPersistedQuestionDialog
functions.description: Suppresses the question dialog for a specified msgId in a Virtuoso session.

functions.name: axlToolSetOpPointInfo
functions.syntax: axlToolSetOpPointInfo(  g_sessionId  t_testName [ ?instanceName t_instanceName ] [ ?parameters t_parameters ] )  => o_sevOpPoint / nil
functions.description: Adds the signal specified for the oppoint type item to the Output Setup table in a test setup and returns the signal object.

functions.name: axlToolSetOriginalSetupOptions
functions.syntax: axlToolSetOriginalSetupOptions(  t_session  t_test  l_toolOptions  [ ?history x_history ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets options to their original values for the tool instance associated with the specified session and test.

functions.name: axlToolSetSetupOptions
functions.syntax: axlToolSetSetupOptions(  t_session  t_test  l_toolOptions  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the option values for the tool instance associated with the specified session and test.

functions.name: axlViewHistoryResults
functions.description: Display the results for the specified history item on the Results tab of the given ADE XL session.

functions.name: axlWriteDatasheet
functions.syntax: axlWriteDatasheet(  t_axlSession  x_historyEntry  [ ?directory t_directory ]  [ ?resultsSummary g_resultsSummary ]  [ ?testsSummary g_testsSummary ]  [ ?detailedResults g_detailedResults ]  [ ?plots g_plots ]  [ ?designVarsSummary g_designVarsSummary ]  [ ?paramsSummary g_paramsSummary ]  [ ?cornersSummary g_cornersSummary ]  [ ?setupSummary g_setupSummary ]  [ ?schematicDiagrams g_schematicDiagrams ] [ ?launchBrowser g_launchBrowser ] [ ?name t_name ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a datasheet for the specified history entry.

functions.name: axlWriteDatasheetForm
functions.description: Causes a form to appear so that you can specify various options for generating a datasheet.

functions.name: axlWriteMonteCarloResultsCSV
functions.syntax: axlWriteMonteCarloResultsCSV t_session t_historyName [ ?testName t_testName ] [ ?cornerName t_cornerName ] [ ?outputName t_outputPath ] ) => t / nil
