functions.name: ciTemplateListDIProps
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns a list of the property names, types, and values.

functions.name: ciTemplateListParamNames
functions.description: Returns a list of template parameter names if the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateListParams
functions.description: Returns a list of template parameter name, type, and value, provided the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateResetAllParams
functions.description: Resets all template parameters to their default values.

functions.name: ciTemplateResetParams
functions.description: Resets one or more template parameters to their default value.

functions.name: ciTemplateSetNote
functions.description: Sets the note parameter of a template.

functions.name: ciTemplateSetStatus
functions.syntax: ciTemplateSetStatus(  u_templateId s_statusSymbol t_statusComment ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the template status.

functions.name: ciTemplateSortParamDefs
functions.description: Sorts parameter definitions of a template type, by name and returns a list of parameter definitions sorted in alphabetical order.

functions.name: ciTemplateUpdateDIProps
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, updates the value of the named property.

functions.name: ciTemplateUpdateParams
functions.description: This function updates the parameter values of the listed parameters for templates that have one or more parameter definitions.

functions.name: ciTemplatep
functions.description: Checks if an object is a valid constraint template ID.

functions.name: ciToFloat
functions.description: Returns a floating point number for the passed value. If the value is a string, then it will be evaluated and the result returned.

functions.name: ciTransferConstraintsInProgress
functions.description: Returns a Boolean to indicate whether constraint transfer is in progress.

functions.name: ciTypeBindingParameter
functions.description: Returns the name of the registered binding parameter for a constraint type or an empty string if none is registered.

functions.name: ciTypeHasBindingParameter
functions.description: Checks if a binding parameter has been registered for the specified constraint type.

functions.name: ciTypeIsType
functions.description: Checks if the specified typeName is a constraint type name, which may be a built-in type, such as distance, or a user-defined custom constraint type that has been specified in a config.xml file.

functions.name: ciTypeIsUserDefined
functions.description: Checks if the specified typeName is a user-defined custom constraint type that is specified in a config.xml file.

functions.name: ciTypeListCon
functions.syntax: ciTypeListCon(  u_cache t_constraintType [ g_includeOutOfContext ] ) => l_designObject / nil
functions.description: Lists all the constraints of a given type for a given cache.

functions.name: ciUnRegisterTerm
functions.syntax: ciUnregisterTerm(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_termName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Unregisters the terminal of a l/c/v if that terminal has already been registered with a default net.

functions.name: ciUnexpandDeviceInfo
functions.description: Contracts any mfactored device names and optionally any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The mfactored device names used in the layout are of the format |<instName>.<mFactorIndx>, such as |MN1.3, and the iterated device names may be schematic device names like MN1<0> or layout device names like |MN1(0). In the layout, the device names may be mfactored and iterated, such as|MN1(3).4.  When a collection of mfactored device names are contracted (for example, |MN1.2, |MN1.3, |MN1.4) a single device will appear in the returned deviceInfo list using the base device name like |MN1, and the mfactor property will be set to the total number of devices that were contracted, in this case 3.

functions.name: ciUnexpandIteratedDeviceInfo
functions.description: Contracts any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The iterated device names may be schematic device names, such as MN1<0>, or layout device names, such as |MN1(0).

functions.name: ciUnexpandPhysicalDeviceInfo
functions.description: This is a utility function used in modgen generation for converting a physical devInfo disembodied property list into a logical devInfo disembodied property list. The devInfo disembodied property lists are created by calling ciCollectDeviceInfo for schematic (logical) and layout (physical) devices.

functions.name: ciUniqueMembers
functions.description: This utility function returns the unique members from the specified member list. It is typically used for member lists that can contain repeated member names due to mFactor expansion.

functions.name: ciUnregisterAssistant
functions.description: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector assistant (category) that was previously registered using ciRegisterAssistant.

functions.name: ciUnregisterConstraintEditor
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered constraint editor. If the constraint editor appears in the Constraint Manager's Constraint Editors menu, then running this function removes it from the menu list.

functions.name: ciUnregisterConstraintGenerator
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered constraint generator.

functions.name: ciUnregisterIterator
functions.description: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector iterator that was previously registered by using ciRegisterIterator. If successful, the iterator will no longer appear in the Edit Finder list or the Edit Iterator list.

functions.name: ciUnregisterNetSuperType
functions.description: Removes a net super-type, leaving its sub-types intact.

functions.name: ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes
functions.syntax: ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ g_hierarchical ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the existing notes on the templates and constraints for a single cellview or all along the hierarchy beginning from the given cellview.

functions.name: ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers
functions.syntax: ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers(  g_modgen  l_newModgenParams  l_newModgenMembers ) => t / nil
functions.description: A utility function, which updates the passed modgen constraint parameters and members.

functions.name: ciUprevEAConstrs
functions.description: Modifies and corrects those constraints in the 610EA (early adopter) release which became obsolete in the full 610 release. Specifically, this command will update any layout structure constraints to be modgen, cluster, or cluster boundary constraints.

functions.name: ciUtilsAddNTimes
functions.syntax: ciUtilsAddNTimes( g_val x_n t_valFmt g_addQuotes t_sep ) => x_str
functions.description: This utility function is used in modgen constraint generation for creating a string with repeated values.

functions.name: ciUtilsAddQuotes
functions.description: This function is used in constraint generation for converting a list of strings into a string where each string in the list will have double quotes when added to the string.

functions.name: ciUtilsBuildString
functions.description: This is a utility function for building a string from a list of values. The values are converted to strings by applying the passed string format and separated by the passed separator.

functions.name: ciUtilsGetArgVal
functions.syntax: ciUtilsGetArgVal(  l_args  t_argName  t_argAltName  [ ?defVal g_defVal ] ) => g_val
functions.description: This is a utility function for accessing constraint generator argument values from a disembodied property list where the argument names may take one of two forms.

functions.name: ciUtilsMakeNumberRange
functions.syntax: ciUtilsMakeNumberRange(  x_from  x_to  [ ?descending g_descending ]  [ ?fmt t_fmt ] ) => l_result
functions.description: This function returns a list containing a sequence of numbers ranging from the passed from value to the passed to value. Optionally, this function reverses the list into descending order and applies a sprintf format to the numbers.

functions.name: ciUtilsMakeUnique
functions.description: This function takes a list of items, which can contain duplicate items and returns a list without any duplicate items.

functions.name: ciUtilsRemoveNils
functions.description: Removes the nil elements from a list.

functions.name: ciUtilsRepeatNTimes
functions.description: This is a utility function for creating a list containing a single value repeated the specified number of times.

functions.name: ciUtilsReplaceNils
functions.description: This is a utility function for replacing any nil elements in a list with the specified value. See also, ciUtilsRemoveNils and ciUtilsMakeUnique.

functions.name: ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth
functions.syntax: ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth(  u_cache l_instsNetsPins [ ?minFingerWidth t_minWidth ] [ ?maxFingerWidth t_maxWidth ] ) => nil
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector as a generator to set a variantInfo property to each given instance registered as a fet, when the parameter value for the parameter registered as fingerWidth is greater than the given minWidth value, and smaller than the maxWidth value.

functions.name: ciWithinConstraint
functions.description: Returns the constraints that contain the specified objects as members of the given constraint type.

functions.name: ciXYInstSymmetricIterator
functions.syntax: ciXYInstSymmetricIterator(  d_cellview t_finderExpr [ ?trigger g_trigger ] [ ?likeSchemaSym g_likeSchemaSym ] ) => list / nil
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all symmetric design instance pairs, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYNetSymmetricIterator
functions.syntax: ciXYNetSymmetricIterator(  d_cellview t_finderExpr [ ?trigger g_trigger ] [ ?likeSchemaSym g_likeSchemaSym ] ) => list / nil
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric nets, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYPinSymmetricIterator
functions.syntax: ciXYPinSymmetricIterator(  d_cellview t_finderExpr [ ?trigger g_trigger ] [ ?likeSchemaSym t_likeSchemaSym ] ) => list / nil
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric pins, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYSortInsts
functions.description: Sorts a list of dbInstID, first by their X coordinates and then by their Y coordinates. This will order the instances, from top to bottom and left to right, in terms of where they are located on the canvas.

functions.name: ciXYSymmetricIterator
functions.description: Iterates all pairs of symmetric design instances/pins (objects) collecting them together into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil. The Circuit Prospector assistant finders use this function. The ciXYSymmetricIterator function evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects assigned to L and R local variables. The L and R variables can be referenced in the finderExpr.

functions.name: cstAddToConstraintGroup
functions.syntax: cstAddToConstraintGroup( g_cstConstraintGroupID g_memberConstraintGroupID [ g_append ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a constraint group to be a member constraint group of the containing constraint. You can position the constraint group at the beginning of the members or at the end of the members with g_append. The default value for g_append is nil, which means that add the constraint group to the beginning of the members. The member constraint group cannot be owned by other objects.   Note: A member constraint group cannot be added to itself.

functions.name: cstCreateConstraint
functions.syntax: cstCreateConstraint( g_cstConstraintGroupID t_constraintDefName g_layers g_value [ l_params ] [ g_isHard ] [ g_append ] [ t_name ] ) => g_cstConstraintID / nil
functions.description: Creates a constraint in the constraint group (g_cstConstraintGroupID) with the specified constraint definition name (t_constraintDefName), layers, constraint value, constraint parameters, hard attribute, the position of the constraint with the members of the constraint group and the name of the constraint.

functions.name: cstCreateConstraintGroupIn
functions.syntax: cstCreateConstraintGroupIn( { d_techID | d_cellViewID } t_constraintGroupName [ t_constraintGroupDefName ] [ g_operator ] ) => g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
functions.description: Creates a constraint group in the technology database (that is, techDb) or a cellview with arguments of the database ID, constraint group name, constraint group definition name and operator symbol.

functions.name: cstCreateConstraintGroupOn
functions.syntax: cstCreateConstraintGroupOn( g_object t_constraintGroupDefName [ g_operator ] ) => g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
functions.description: Creates a constraint group on an object (for example, net, term, and so on) with arguments of the object ID, constraint group definition name, and operator symbol. The constraint group definition name is required while constraint group operators are optional for this SKILL function.

functions.name: cstDeleteConstraint
functions.description: Deletes the constraint from any of the constraint groups it is a part of. Its value and constraint parameters are also deleted.

functions.name: cstDeleteConstraintGroup
functions.description: Deletes the constraint group (g_cstConstraintGroupID). The contained constraints in the constraint group are not automatically deleted when the constraintGroup is deleted.

functions.name: cstFindConstraintGroupIn
functions.syntax: cstFindConstraintGroupIn( { d_techID | d_cellViewID } t_constraintGroupName [ g_localOnly ] ) => g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
functions.description: Returns a constraint group ID (g_cstConstraintGroupID) from a database ID with constraint group name and a Boolean flag (g_localOnly).

functions.name: cstFindConstraintGroupOn
functions.description: Returns a constraint group ID (g_cstConstraintGroupID) from an object (g_object) with constraint group definition name.

functions.name: cstFindCutClassConstraintByName
functions.syntax: cstFindCutClassConstraintByName( d_constraintGroupId tx_layer t_name ) => d_cutClassConstraintId / nil
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the cut class constraint with a given cut class name, layer, and constraint group.

functions.name: cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize
functions.syntax: cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize( d_constraintGroupId tx_layer n_width n_length g_checkOrientation ) => d_cutClassConstraintId / nil
functions.description: Searches the specified layer in the specified constraint group and returns the first cut class constraint with the specified width and length. If g_checkOrientation is set to t, the orientation of the cut class will also be included as part of the search.

functions.name: cstFindFirstConstraint
functions.syntax: cstFindFirstConstraint( d_ConstraintGroupID t_constraintDefName [ ( tx_layer [ tx_purpose ] )... ] [ l_params ] [ g_onlyHard ] ) => d_ConstraintID / nil
functions.description: Searches a constraint group in the hierarchical order and returns the ID of the first constraint found with the given name, layers, purposes, and params. If the onlyHard argument is not specified, the first matching constraint is returned and it is possible that it is a hard constraint. If the onlyHard argument is specified, then the first matching hard constraint is returned.

functions.name: cstGet1DTableValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the table for the given index. The index varies depending on the constraint. It can be a width or a length.

functions.name: cstGet2DTableValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the table for the given indexes.

functions.name: cstGetConstraintGroups
functions.description: Returns all the containing constraint groups for the constraint (g_cstConstraintID).

functions.name: cstGetDefaultConstraintGroupName
functions.description: Gets the name of the constraint group that is used as the default constraint group on the objects of the cellview according to the specified application type.

functions.name: cstGetFoundryCGName
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the name of the alternate foundry constraint group. If there is no alternate foundry constraint group specified, it returns the name of the foundry constraint group.

functions.name: cstGetFoundryConstraintGroup
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the database ID of the alternate foundry constraint group specified for a given technology file. If there is no alternate foundry constraint group specified, it returns the ID of the foundry constraint group.

functions.name: cstGetTwoWidthTableValue
functions.syntax: cstGetTwoWidthTableValue(  d_ConstraintID  n_index1 n_index2 n_index3 ) => n_value
functions.description: Applies to the twoWidth table. It only returns the spacing value for a given width1, width2, and length.

functions.name: cstGetUnreferencedConstraints
functions.description: Returns all the unreferrenced constraints not belonging to any constraint group in a database (a technology database or a cellview).

functions.name: cstIsId
functions.description: Returns a Boolean that indicates whether the specified ID is a constraint ID.

functions.name: cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName
functions.syntax: cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName( d_cellview t_constraintGroupName t_type ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified constraint group name to be used as the default constraint group on the objects of the cellview according to the specified application type.

functions.name: lntAddTrace
functions.syntax: lntAddTrace( w_window { d_figId | t_netName } [ ?hierPath l_hierPath ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] [ ?userArea l_userArea ] [ ?hilightIncrementally g_hilightIncrementally ] [ ?retainColornStateInfo g_retainColornStateInfo ] [ ?hilightColor t_hilightColor ] [ ?maxCutShapes t_maxCutShapes ] [ ?constraintGroup t_constraintGroup ] ) => x_traceId / nil
functions.description: Creates a trace starting from the specified figure or net name in the specified window.

functions.name: lntClearNeighbors
functions.description: Deletes all computed neighbors in the specified window.

functions.name: lxRegMasterDiffName
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function that can return a name for the master difference reported by the Check Against Source command.

functions.name: abGetCurrentIncompleteNetFilter
functions.description: Returns the incomplete net filter currently applied on the specified window. An incomplete net filter is used to control the display of incomplete net markers in the Connectivity tab of the Annotation Browser assistant by showing or hiding a subset of net names.

functions.name: abHiFindMarker
functions.description: In the specified window, selects the row corresponding to a marker in the Annotation Browser when the corresponding marker object is clicked in the layout canvas. Even though the marker object is selected in the layout canvas, this does not modify the selection in the canvas. If the corresponding marker is not displayed in the Annotation Browser due to the applied filtering, nothing is selected in the Annotation Browser. If a window ID is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: abSetIncompleteNetFilter
functions.syntax: abSetIncompleteNetFilter( w_windowID t_filterState { Show | Hide } l_netNamess g_enable ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified incomplete net filter state for the specified list of nets in the given window. An incomplete net filter is used to control the display of incomplete net markers in the Connectivity tab of the Annotation Browser assistant by showing or hiding a subset of net names.

functions.name: abeBlockagesFromCellView
functions.syntax: abeBlockagesFromCellView( t_layerName o_outLayer g_queue ) => o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Copies blockages from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview, to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied blockages to the specified ABE layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeBoundariesFromCellView
functions.description: Copies the boundaries from the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied boundaries to a specified layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeClearLayer
functions.description: Removes all the shapes on the ABE layer and frees the memory. This is useful for re-using ABE layers.

functions.name: abeDone
functions.description: Closes the current ABE session and frees all the memory that was used by ABE.

functions.name: abeElapsedTime
functions.description: Returns the elapsed time for the current ABE session.

functions.name: abeInit
functions.syntax: abeInit( d_cellViewId  [ ?doInterrupts g_interrupts ]  [ ?depth g_depth ]  [ ?threads g_threadCount ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Initializes an ABE session for the specified cellview. The ABE elapsed time clock is set to zero.

functions.name: abeIslandIterator
functions.description: Returns the island iterator for the rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. Each entry is a list of points for a shape on the ABE layer.

functions.name: abeLayerAbut
functions.syntax: abeLayerAbut( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer for ABE layer1 shapes that abut with shapes on ABE layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAnd
functions.syntax: abeLayerAnd( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on ABE layer1 overlap shapes on ABE layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAndNot
functions.syntax: abeLayerAndNot( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on layer1 do not overlap shapes on layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAvoid
functions.syntax: abeLayerAvoid( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes on the output layer for shapes on layer1 that are completely outside of, and have no abutting edges with, shapes on layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerFromCellView
functions.syntax: abeLayerFromCellView( t_layerName  [ ?bbox l_bbox ]  [ ?bBox l_bBox ] [ ?purpose t_purposeName ]  [ ?excludePurpose l_purposeName ] [ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer [ ?queue g_queue ] ] [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  [ ?startLevel g_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel g_stopLevel ]  [ ?orientation g_orientation ] ) => o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Copies the shapes from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied shapes to a specific area, purpose, mask color, or hierarchical depth. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeLayerFromFigSet
functions.description: Adds the shapes from a FigSet to an existing ABE layer or a new ABE layer.

functions.name: abeLayerFromNet
functions.syntax: abeLayerFromNet( t_layerName  t_netName [ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer ]  ) => o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Adds the shapes from a net to an existing ABE layer or a new ABE layer. Logical connectivity is not preserved and therefore cannot be restored if the shapes are written back to the ABE session cellview.

functions.name: abeLayerFromShapes
functions.description: Creates an ABE layer with shapes from the given list.

functions.name: abeLayerGrow
functions.syntax: abeLayerGrow( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?north g_sizeNorth ]  [ ?south g_sizeSouth ]  [ ?east g_sizeEast ]  [ ?west g_sizeWest]  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer that are ABE input layer shapes that have been increased in size along one or more directions in the north, south, east, and/or west.

functions.name: abeLayerInside
functions.syntax: abeLayerInside( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds ABE layer1 shapes that are completely inside an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeLayerMergeTiles
functions.syntax: abeLayerMergeTiles( i_abeLayer t_orientation [ ?queue { t | nil } ]  => o_outputLayer / nil
functions.description: Uses an existing ABE layer to recreate maximum tiles based on the specified orientation.

functions.name: abeLayerOr
functions.syntax: abeLayerOr( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes from the input ABE layer to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerOrPtArray
functions.description: Adds a polygon that is represented by a list of points to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerOutside
functions.syntax: abeLayerOutside( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds to the ABE output layer the ABE layer1 shapes that are completely outside the ABE layer2 shapes. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeLayerShrink
functions.syntax: abeLayerShrink( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?north g_sizeNorth ]  [ ?south g_sizeSouth ]  [ ?east g_sizeEast ]  [ ?west g_sizeWest]  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Decreases the size of shapes from the input ABE layer and outputs them to the ABE output layer. Shapes can be reduced by different distances in the north, south, east, and west directions.

functions.name: abeLayerSize
functions.syntax: abeLayerSize( o_abeInputLayer  o_abeOutputLayer  g_size  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes that have been increased or decreased in size from the ABE input layer to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerStraddle
functions.syntax: abeLayerStraddle( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that partially overlap an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerToBlockages
functions.syntax: abeLayerToBlockages( o_abeInputLayer  t_layerName  [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  [ ?blockageType g_blockageType ]  [ ?tiles g_tiles  | ?noHoles g_noHoles ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes as blockage objects from the ABE layer to the specified layer. Optional arguments specify a mask color and blockage type for the blockage objects, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether shapes are copied as tiles instead of islands.

functions.name: abeLayerToCellView
functions.syntax: abeLayerToCellView( o_abeLayer  t_layerName  [ ?tiles g_tiles  | ?noHoles g_noHoles ]  [ ?purpose t_purposeName ]  [ ?maskColor g_maskColor ]  [ ?cell t_cellName ] [ ?view t_viewName ]  [ ?cvId d_cellviewID ]  [ ?shapeIds { t | nil} } (2031625) ) => l_shapeIDs / t / nil
functions.description: Copies shapes from the ABE layer to the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview. Optional arguments specify the layer purpose, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as islands instead of primitive tiles.

functions.name: abeLayerToHilightSet
functions.syntax: abeLayerToHilightSet( o_abeInputLayer  h_hilightSetId  [ ?tiles g_tiles  | ?noHoles g_noHoles ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the rectangles and polygons on the specified ABE layer to the specified highlight set. Optional arguments specify whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as primitive tiles instead of islands.

functions.name: abeLayerTouch
functions.syntax: abeLayerTouch( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  [ ?includeCorners g_includeCorners ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that touch (completely overlap, partially overlap, or abut) an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerXor
functions.syntax: abeLayerXor( o_abeLayer1  o_abeLayer2  o_abeOutputLayer  [ ?queue g_queue ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds rectangles and polygons to the ABE output layer where ABE layer1 shapes and ABE layer2 shapes do not overlap.

functions.name: abeMTdebug
functions.description: Enables the output of additional messages to monitor progress when multithreading is used.

functions.name: abeNewLayer
functions.description: Creates a new ABE layer.

functions.name: abeRemoveLayer
functions.description: Removes the specified ABE layer.

functions.name: abeRunQueue
functions.description: Runs all the ABE operations that are queued for processing.

functions.name: abeShapesInside
functions.syntax: abeShapesInside( d_cellViewId  l_insideShapeObj  l_outsideShapeObj  ) => l_shapeObj / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes from the inside list that are completely inside a shape from the outside list. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeShapesOutside
functions.syntax: abeShapesOutside( d_cellViewId  l_outsideShapeObj  l_insideShapeObj  ) => l_shapeObj / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes from the outside list that are completely outside of shapes from the inside list. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeTileIterator
functions.description: Returns the tile iterator for the primitive rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. The iterator can be restricted to a region of the layer.

functions.name: absAbstract
functions.description: Runs the Abstract step for selected cells and creates an abstract view for those cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absAttachTechLib
functions.description: Attaches the named technology library to the current library.

functions.name: absCopyBinOptions
functions.syntax: absCopyBinOptions( from_bin { Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore | user_bin_name } to_bin { Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore | user_bin_name } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies bin option settings from one bin to another.

functions.name: absDeleteBin
functions.description: Deletes the named user bin. You cannot delete a system bin.

functions.name: absDeleteBinMoveCellsTo
functions.syntax: absDeleteBinMoveCellsTo( name { Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore | user_bin_name } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a named user bin and moves any cells in that bin to another specified bin.

functions.name: absDeselectAllBins
functions.description: Deselects all currently selected bins.

functions.name: absDeselectBin
functions.description: Deselects a named bin.

functions.name: absDeselectBinFrom
functions.description: Deselects a range of bins. The deselection is done from top to bottom starting from the from bin. The from bin should be above the to bin the Bin pane, otherwise all bins listed after from are deselected.

functions.name: absDeselectCell
functions.description: Deselects a named cell.

functions.name: absDeselectCellFrom
functions.description: Deselects a range of cells. The deselection is done from top to bottom starting from the from cell. The from cell should be above the to cell the Cell pane, otherwise all cells listed after from are deselected.

functions.name: absDeselectCells
functions.description: Deselects all cells in the current bins.

functions.name: absDeselectCellsInList
functions.description: Deselects a list of cells that are not adjacent to each other in the Cell pane.

functions.name: absDisableUpdate
functions.description: Both the absDisableUpdate and absEnableUpdate functions are used to control whether or not the graphical user interface updates in response to changes in, for example, bin selection. This ensures that the GUI does not update unnecessarily when several events in a row are processed. This is inserted by the abstract generator into the record file.

functions.name: absDistributeCells
functions.description: Distributes cells between bins according to the options set.

functions.name: absEnableUpdate
functions.description: Both the absEnableUpdate and absDisableUpdate functions are used to control whether or not the graphical user interface updates in response to changes in, for example, bin selection. This ensures that the GUI does not update unnecessarily when several events in a row are processed. This is inserted by the abstract generator into the record file.

functions.name: absExit
functions.description: Closes the abstract generator.

functions.name: absExportLEF
functions.description: Generates LEF files for cells in one or more bins. All exported LEF data is contained in the LEF filename.

functions.name: absExportOptions
functions.description: Save the options settings for the current session to a specified location.

functions.name: absExportReport
functions.description: Outputs a summary of the cells in your library to a report file.

functions.name: absExtract
functions.description: Runs the Extract step for the selected cells and creates an extracted view for those cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absGetBinOption
functions.description: Returns the value of a specified option in a given bin.

functions.name: absGetBinType
functions.description: Returns the type of the bin passed as an argument. Both system and user bins can be specified as arguments.

functions.name: absGetBins
functions.description: Displays the list of available bins. The list returned includes the five system bins as well as the user bins, if any.

functions.name: absGetCellProp
functions.description: Returns the specified property value for a cell.

functions.name: absGetLibrary
functions.description: Returns the name of the current library.

functions.name: absGetOption
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified global option.

functions.name: absGetSelectedBins
functions.description: Returns the list of bins selected in the Bin pane. The order of the bins in the list matches the order in which they appear in the Bin pane.

functions.name: absGetSelectedCells
functions.description: Returns the list of cells selected in the Cell pane. The cells might belong to different bins.

functions.name: absGetTerminalProp
functions.syntax: absGetTerminalProp( cell terminal property { direction | termType | shape | netExpr | suppSensitivity | groundSensitivity } ) => string
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified property for the specified terminal. Specify only cells that have already been processed by absPins. The Pins step generates the cell terminals.

functions.name: absImportCTLF
functions.description: Creates cellviews from CTLF logical data.

functions.name: absImportDEF
functions.description: Creates cellviews from DEF data.

functions.name: absImportGDS
functions.description: Creates cellviews from GDSII layout data.

functions.name: absImportLEF
functions.description: Creates cellviews from LEF data.

functions.name: absImportLogical
functions.description: Creates cellviews from existing logical information, typically represented in TLF or Verilog formats.

functions.name: absImportOasis
functions.description: Creates cellviews from OASIS data.

functions.name: absImportOptions
functions.description: Loads a previous session's saved options file from the specified location.

functions.name: absImportVerilog
functions.description: Creates cellviews from Verilog logical data.

functions.name: absMoveSelectedCellsToBin
functions.description: Moves any currently selected cells to a named bin. This can be one of the five system bins or a user-defined bin.

functions.name: absNewBin
functions.syntax: absNewBin( name { Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a new user bin to store library cells.

functions.name: absPins
functions.description: Runs the Pins step for the selected cells and creates a pins view for those cells based on options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absRenameBin
functions.description: Renames a previously created user bin.

functions.name: absRevalidateSelectedCells
functions.description: Revalidates all invalid views for cells selected in the Cell pane. If the view has an error or warning, this remains. The view status is no longer grayed out.

functions.name: absSelect
functions.description: Selects cells according to the specified options.

functions.name: absSelectAllBins
functions.description: Selects all the bins in the current library.

functions.name: absSelectBin
functions.description: Selects the named bin. This makes the specified bin current for use with other functions.

functions.name: absSelectBinFrom
functions.description: Selects a range of bins. The selection is made from top to bottom starting from the from bin. The from bin should be above the to bin the Bins pane, otherwise all bins listed after from are selected.

functions.name: absSelectCell
functions.description: Selects a single named cell.

functions.name: absSelectCellFrom
functions.description: Selects a range of cells. The selection is made from top to bottom starting from the from cell. The from cell should be above the to cell the Cell pane, otherwise all cells listed after from are selected.

functions.name: absSelectCells
functions.description: Selects all cells in the selected bins.

functions.name: absSelectCellsInList
functions.description: Selects a list of cells that are not adjacent to each other in the Cell pane.

functions.name: absSetBinOption
functions.syntax: absSetBinOption( bin option value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a value for a specified option in a specified bin.

functions.name: absSetCellProp
functions.description: Specifies a property value for a cell. The variables you can use for the value parameter depend on the property.

functions.name: absSetLibrary
functions.description: Specifies the library that you want to process through the abstract generator. This involves either creating a new library and setting into it or setting into an existing library.

functions.name: absSetOption
functions.description: Sets values for all abstract generator global options. The SKILL function to apply the absSetOption settings is run after the absSetOption function has been set.

functions.name: absSetTerminalProp
functions.syntax: absSetTerminalProp( cell terminal property { direction | termType | shape | netExpr | suppSensitivity | groundSensitivity } value ) => 0 / 1
functions.description: Specifies a terminal value for a cell. The variables you can use for the value parameter depend on the property setting.

functions.name: absSort
functions.description: Sets sort criteria for those cells in the current bin.

functions.name: absVerify
functions.description: Runs the Verify step for selected cells and creates a verify view for those cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absVersion
functions.description: Returns version, build, and operating system information.

functions.name: adpInitFloorPlan

functions.name: cphSetInstPhysicalBinding
functions.syntax: cphSetInstPhysicalBinding( g_physConfigID t_lib t_cell t_view t_inst t_physLib t_physCell t_physView ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the physical binding for a specified instance in the physical configuration associated with the given ID The library and cell are empty, the system issues a warning message.

functions.syntax: cphSetOccurViewList( g_physConfigID t_path t_switchList ) => t / nil

functions.syntax: cphSetSchCellPhysicalBinding( d_topSchCVID t_libName t_cellName t_value [ ?layCVId d_layCVId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the physical binding of a cell specifying top-level schematic and layout cellviews IDs instead of the cphManager ID. After the cell binding is set, the SKILL function also saves the update to the physConfig view.

functions.name: cphSetSchInstForceDescend
functions.syntax: cphSetSchInstForceDescend( d_topSchCVID d_schInstID g_value g_all [ ?layCVId d_layCVId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value for force descend on the specified instance, specifying top-level schematic and layout cellview IDs instead of the cphManager ID.

functions.name: cphSetSchInstPhysicalBinding
functions.syntax: cphSetSchInstPhysicalBinding( d_topSchCVID d_schInstID t_value g_all [ ?layCVId d_layCVId ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the physical binding of an instance specifying the top-level schematic and layout cellview IDs instead of the cphManager ID.

functions.name: cphSetStopList
functions.description: Sets the physical stop view list for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. The list specifies the view names that are used to determine the corresponding physical view for a given logical view. When traversing a hierarchy, Configure Physical Hierarchy uses the first view it encounters with one of the specified names.

functions.name: cphSetViewList
functions.description: Sets the logical switch view list for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. The list specifies the view names used to descend into a hierarchical design to find schematic views.

functions.name: cphUprevDesign
functions.syntax: cphUprevDesign( t_physLib t_physCell t_physView t_cfgLib t_cfgCell t_cfgView ) => t / nil
functions.description: Converts the specified design to use a physical configuration view. You must specify the name of the design to be converted and the name of the physical configuration to use.

functions.name: cphUprevIncremental
functions.syntax: cphUprevIncremental(  t_libName t_cellName t_physConfigView )  => t / nil
functions.description: Modify existing physical configuration views for the library, cell and/or physical configuration names provided by cleaning up the data related to LAM physical stop list.

functions.name: cphUprevLibrary
functions.description: Converts the specified library to use physical configuration views. You must specify the name of the library to be converted. You can optionally specify a name for the configuration view that is generated (the default is physConfig).

functions.name: cphVisitNextNode
functions.description: Moves the visitor to the next occurrence as defined by the start mode specified in cphVisitStart. The start mode defines which nodes are visited, but not order in which they are visited.

functions.name: cphVisitStart
functions.syntax: cphVisitStart( g_physConfigID t_startMode { PHYSICAL_LEAF | LOGICAL_LEAF | HIERARCHY_PHYSICAL_LEAF 	| HIERARCHY_LOGICAL_LEAF } [ t_path ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Starts a visit at the specified occurrence in the specified mode. The start mode defines which nodes are visited, but does not specify the order in which they are visited.

functions.name: cphVisitStop
functions.description: Stops the visitor currently running in the specified physical configuration.

functions.name: cphVisitedInstance
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the instance of the occurrence currently being visited.

functions.name: cphVisitedPath
functions.description: Returns the path to the occurrence currently being visited.

functions.name: cphVisitedSwitchMaster
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the switch master cellview for the occurrence currently visited.

functions.name: cphVisitedTarget
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the logical cellview for the occurrence currently being visited.

functions.name: ctAddCellToCompTypeGroup
functions.syntax: ctAddCellToCompTypeGroup( g_physConfigID t_physLib t_physCell t_ctgName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Assigns a specified physical cell to a component type group in the physical configuration associated with the given ID.

functions.name: ctCreateCompTypeGroup
functions.syntax: ctCreateCompTypeGroup( g_physConfigID t_ctgName t_deviceType t_widthParamName t_orientationParamName t_drainTermName t_gateTermName t_sourceTermName t_bulkTermName t_activeLayers f_foldingThresh t_views ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a component type group with the specified attributes and stores it in the physical configuration associated with the given ID. If the component type group exists already, it is updated with the specified attribute values.

functions.name: ctDeleteCellFromCompTypeGroup
functions.syntax: ctDeleteCellFromCompTypeGroup( g_physConfigID t_physLib t_physCell ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes a specified physical cell from its current component type group in the physical configuration associated with the given ID.

functions.name: ctDeleteCompTypeGroup
functions.description: Deletes a specified component type group from the physical configuration associated with the given ID.

functions.name: ctGetCellCompTypeGroup
functions.syntax: ctGetCellCompTypeGroup( g_physConfigID t_physLib t_physCell ) => t_ctgName / nil
functions.description: Returns the component type group to which a specified physical cell is assigned.

functions.name: ctGetCellCompTypeGroups
functions.syntax: ctGetCellCompTypeGroups( g_physConfigID t_physLib t_physCell ) => l_compTypes / nil
functions.description: Returns all the component type groups to which a specified physical cell was assigned.

functions.name: ctGetCompTypeCells
functions.description: Returns a list of all the physical cells assigned to the specified component type.

functions.name: ctGetCompTypeGroupAttr
functions.syntax: ctGetCompTypeGroupAttr( g_physConfigID t_ctgName t_attrName { deviceType | activeLayer | width | foldingThreshold  	| views | drain | gate | source | bulk } ) => g_value / nil
functions.description: Returns the value of a specified attribute in the component type group.

functions.name: ctGetCompTypeNames
functions.description: Returns a list of component type group names for the physical configuration associated with the given ID.

functions.name: ctSetCompTypeGroupAttr
functions.syntax: ctSetCompTypeGroupAttr( g_physConfigID t_ctgName t_attrName { deviceType | activeLayer | width | foldingThreshold  	| views | drain | gate | source | bulk } g_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an attribute by name in the component type.

functions.name: dbIsVPLGen
functions.description: Returns true if the design is a VPLGen.

functions.name: dbRegVPLGenCreateCellName
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function to create unique cell names for VPLGen core layouts.

functions.name: dbUnregVPLGenCreateCellName
functions.description: Unregisters the SKILL function used to generate unique cell names for VPLGen core layouts. Once unregistered, Layout XL uses the default naming convention when creating new VPLGen Pcell instances in the layout view.

functions.name: drdAddTarget
functions.description: Sets the shape located at the specified point in the specified window as a DRD target. The function does not remove from the selection the shapes already set as DRD targets. If two or more shapes overlap at the specified point, the shape on the active layer is set as a DRD target.

functions.name: drdBatchCheck
functions.description: Runs DRD checker on the specified area of the specified cellview. The hierarchy depth and batch checking rules specified in the DRD Options form are honored. Use this function to run a DRD check on read-only cellviews to view any DRC violations as warning messages in CIW.

functions.name: drdBatchCheckLicenseAvailable
functions.description: Checks whether a Layout XL license is available. If the license is available, the function returns t. If the license is unavailable, it attempts to check out the license. If the attempt is successful, it checks the license back in and returns t.

functions.name: drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem(  t_CategoryName x_toggleValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a constraint category in the Constraint Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdCheckedLayerGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdCheckedLayerGroupItem(  t_layerCategoryName x_toggleValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a layer category in the Layer Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdCompactObjects
functions.syntax: drdCompactObjects(  { s_direction | 'target | 'anchor l_targets } l_figs [ 'useSameMaskSpacingOnly ] [ 'useUserSpacingOnly ] [ 'compact | 'compactAndSpread | 'spread ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Compacts the specified objects in accordance with the relevant spacing rules.

functions.name: drdCompactSelSet
functions.syntax: drdCompactSelSet(  { s_direction | 'target | 'anchor l_targets } [ w_winID ] [ d_cellViewID ] [ 'useSameMaskSpacingOnly ] [ 'useUserSpacingOnly ] [ 'compact | 'compactAndSpread | 'spread ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Compacts objects in the selected set in accordance with the relevant spacing rules.

functions.name: drdCompactorOptions
functions.description: Displays the DRD Compactor Options form, in which you can set the options for compacting and spreading objects.

functions.name: drdConstraintGroupHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the categories listed in the Constraint Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdConstraintHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the constraints listed in the Constraint column or sorts the constraints alphabetically, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdConstraintItemClicked
functions.syntax: drdConstraintItemClicked( t_constraintName x_columnIndex x_stateValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a constraint for different checking modes, that is, Enforce, Notify, Post-Edit, and Batch, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdEnablePixelThreshold
functions.description: Enables a pixel threshold. When you move an object toward another object and you cross this pixel threshold, the object being moved is automatically snapped to the closest edge of the DRC halo or the target object, if DRD Smart Snap mode is enabled. You can disable this pixel threshold to temporarily disable smart snapping during interactive editing.

functions.name: drdGetAllowedWidth
functions.syntax: drdGetAllowedWidth( d_objID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?upperLimit f_maxValue ] ) => l_integers / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of allowed widths for the specified layer.

functions.name: drdGetMinSpacing
functions.syntax: drdGetMinSpacing( d_techID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?width1 f_width1Val ] [ ?width2 f_width2Val ] [ ?prl f_prlVal ] [ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?sameMask { 0 | 1 } ] ) => f_minSpaceVal / nil
functions.description: Returns the minimum spacing value defined by the minSpacing (One layer) constraint for the specified layer, based on the specified width, parallel run length (prl), direction, and mask values.

functions.name: drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing
functions.syntax: drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing( d_techID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?span f_spanVal ] [ ?prl f_prlVal ] [ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?sameMask { 0 | 1 } ] ) => f_minSpanSpaceVal / nil
functions.description: Returns the minimum span length spacing value defined by the minSpanLengthSpacing constraint for the specified layer, based on the specified span, parallel run length (prl), direction, and mask values.

functions.name: drdGetMinVoltageSpacing
functions.syntax: drdGetMinVoltageSpacing( d_techID t_layerName [ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ] [ ?voltage1 f_voltage1Val ] [ ?voltage2 f_voltage2Val ] ) => f_minVolSpaceVal / nil
functions.description: Returns the minimum voltage-dependent spacing value defined by the minVoltageSpacing (One layer) constraint for the specified layer based on the specified voltages. The voltage difference is calculated as the absolute difference of the two input voltages, which correspond to the voltages set on the two objects for which you want to retrieve the minimum spacing.

functions.name: drdIsPixelThresholdEnabled
functions.description: Indicates whether the pixel threshold is enabled or disabled.

functions.name: drdLayerGroupHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the layer categories listed in the Layer Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdLayerHeaderClicked
functions.description: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the layers listed in the Layer column or sorts the layers alphabetically, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdLayerItemClicked
functions.syntax: drdLayerItemClicked( t_layerName x_columnIndex x_stateValue w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Toggles the state of a layer on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdListConstraintCategoryRules
functions.syntax: drdListConstraintCategoryRules( [ ?cv d_cellViewID ] [ ?outputFile s_fileName ] [ ?active { t | nil } ] [ ?splitTF { t | nil } ] [ ?csv { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Lists constraints supported by DRD in the version of the software that is currently running. The constraints' information can be saved in an ASCII file or listed in CIW, in a tabular format or as a comma-separated list.

functions.name: drdOptionUpdateConstraint
functions.syntax: drdOptionUpdateConstraint(  l_modeCategories l_constraints g_state )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default states for specified constraints and modes in the configuration file for the Filter tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdOptionUpdateLayer
functions.description: Sets the default state for specified layers in the configuration file for the Filter tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdOptionsSet
functions.description: Sets default states for fields in the configuration file for the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdRemoveTarget
functions.description: Unsets a DRD target that exists at the specified point in the specified window. If multiple DRD targets overlap at the specified point, the DRD target on the active layer is unset.

functions.name: drdSelectConstraintGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdSelectConstraintGroupItem( t_constraintCategoryName x_selectIndex w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Selects the constraint category in the Constraint Category column and displays the corresponding constraints in the Constraint column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdSelectLayerGroupItem
functions.syntax: drdSelectLayerGroupItem( t_layerCategoryName x_selectIndex w_windowId )  => t / nil
functions.description: Selects the layer category in the Layer Category column and displays the corresponding layers in the Layer column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

functions.name: drdToggleSmartSnapMode
functions.description: Freezes DRC halos, which helps snap objects to the closest edge of the halo or the object.

functions.name: drdToggleSmartSnapModeForDiscreteSpacing
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Freezes discrete spacing markers, which helps snap objects to the closest marker.

functions.name: drdVerifySelSet
functions.description: Checks the objects selected in the specified design for rule violations and generates a marker for each rule violation found. If a design is not specified, it checks the objects selected in the design open in the current window.

functions.name: eadAddNetsToNetGroup
functions.syntax: eadAddNetsToNetGroup( x_cellViewID t_groupName ?netNames l_netNames ?regExp t_regExp ?file t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified nets to an existing net group for the given cellview.

functions.name: eadCreateDataSetLayCSVTemplate
functions.description: Creates a CSV template file for a given layout cellview in a format that can later be used to fill in current values and to create a user-defined EAD dataset from it.

functions.name: eadCreateNetGroup
functions.syntax: eadCreateNetGroup( x_cellViewID t_groupName ?netNames l_netNames ?regExp t_regExp ?file t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a new net group by the given name in the given cellview. If given, it can also contain the nets.

functions.name: eadDeleteNetGroup
functions.description: Deletes a net group from the given cellview.

functions.name: eadGetNetsInNetGroup
functions.description: Lists all the nets contained in the specified net group of the given cellview.

functions.name: eadGetTriggerDesc
functions.description: Provides a description about the given event and the arguments required by the SKILL triggers registered for that event.

functions.name: eadJobClose
functions.description: Collects results from the batch jobs submitted to computer farms or dedicated servers for distributed computation. When all the distributed jobs are completed successfully, you can use this command to collect extraction results from each job. The parasitic results from individual batch run are combined into one OA database and automatically displayed in the EAD browser summary table.

functions.name: eadJobStatus
functions.description: Returns the status of batch jobs submitted to computer farms or dedicated servers for distributed computation.

functions.name: eadJobSubmit
functions.description: Submits batch jobs to computer farms or dedicated servers for distributed computation.

functions.name: eadRegTrigger
functions.syntax: eadRegTrigger( t_eventName t_callbackProcName n_priority ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a user-defined callback SKILL function for the specified event or trigger with the given priority. You can create custom callback functions to perform necessary updates when these events are triggered.

functions.name: eadRegisterCustomEMVariable
functions.description: Registers a variable as a custom variable for the purpose of EM calculation. By using the eadSetEMVariable function, you can vary the value of the registered variable before running EM checks. If a variable is not registered, modifying its values does affect EM calculations.

functions.name: eadRemoveNetsFromNetGroup
functions.syntax: eadRemoveNetsFromNetGroup( x_cellViewID t_groupName ?netNames l_netNames ?regExp t_regExp ?file t_fileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes the given nets from the specified net group of the given cellview.

functions.name: eadRemoveParasitics
functions.syntax: eadRemoveParasitics( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the parasitic information associated with the specified layout design and saves the design (provided there were no other unsaved changes prior to calling the function).

functions.name: eadSetEMVariable
functions.syntax: eadSetEMVariable( g_varName [ g_varValue ] [ g_layerName ] [ g_analysisPointName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a custom variable registered by eadRegisterCustomEMVariable. The value is used by the EM limit calculation expressions in the ICT-EM file.

functions.name: eadUnregTrigger
functions.description: Removes the entry for the specified SKILL trigger from the registered list of triggers for the given event. When the specified event occurs, the remaining registered triggers, if any, for that event get executed in their order of priority.

functions.name: elecCreateDataSetCSVTemplate
functions.syntax: elecCreateDataSetCSVTemplate(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_fileName [ ?resultTypes l_resultTypes ] [ ?maxHierLevel n_maxHierLevel ] [ ?scaleFactors l_scaleFactors ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a CSV template file for a given schematic cellview in a format that can be later used to fill in the current or voltage values, and to create an EAD dataset from it.

functions.name: elecGetCurrentData
functions.syntax: elecGetCurrentData(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_dataSetName  t_terminalName [ t_measurementName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Gets the electrical data for the specified terminal in the given cellview. The data is retrieved from the specified dataset.

functions.name: elecGetDataSetNames
functions.syntax: elecGetDataSetNames(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ t_dataSetType ] ) => l_dataSetNames / nil
functions.description: Gets the list of available result datasets for a given design. Also see EM Dataset.

functions.name: elecGetDataSetParamsPropValue
functions.syntax: elecGetDataSetParamsPropValue(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_dataSetName t_paramName ) => t_paramValue / nil
functions.description: Gets the value for the given parameter from the property list of the given dataset saved for the given cellview.

functions.name: elecTransferDataSets
functions.syntax: elecTransferDataSets( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?dataSetList l_dataSetList ] [ ?dataSetType t_dataSetType ] [ ?schLCV g_schLCV ] [ ?needToSave g_needToSave ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Transfers datasets from schematic to layout. By default, the function transfers all the datasets from schematic to layout. You can use the key arguments to transfer specific datasets.

functions.name: elecUpdateDataSetParamsPropValue
functions.syntax: elecUpdateDataSetParamsPropValue(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_dataSetName t_paramName t_paramValue ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the value for a parameter/property of the given dataset saved for the given cellview. You can use this function to modify the value of a dataset property for a schematic or layout view.

functions.name: electDeleteDatasets
functions.syntax: elecDeleteDataSets(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ ?dataSetList l_dataSetList ] [ ?dataSetType l_dataSetType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes electrical data from the specified design. This function can be used for both layout and schematic view of a design.

functions.name: gpeAbutGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpeAbutGridEntries( u_sandbox l_gridEntries [ ?abutType { x_abutType | t_abutTypeName } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Abuts the specified list of instances or indexes using the given abutment type in the given sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeAddDummy
functions.syntax: gpeAddDummy( u_sandbox t_direction [ ?n x_rowsCols ] [ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the specified number of dummy rows or columns in the given direction to the specified Modgen sandbox object. The dummy configuration entry, if specified, is used to configure the default entries. The master for the generated dummy entries is set to either the dummy configuration entry, which provides the master lib:cell:view specification, or the grid entries. Even if the dummy configuration entry specifies the source, the value is ignored and source is calculated based on the grid entries.

functions.name: gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells
functions.description: Fills the empty cells in the specified sandbox object with dummies.

functions.name: gpeAddDummySurround
functions.description: Adds a ring of dummies around the specified sandbox grid.

functions.name: gpeAddInstance
functions.description: Adds the given list of instances to the specified Modgen.

functions.name: gpeAddMatchGroups
functions.description: Adds the specified matched groups to the given Modgen sandbox object. A matched group is a set of topological trunks with similar properties.

functions.name: gpeAddStrapEntries
functions.description: Adds the given straps to the topology (topo) section of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeAddTrunkChains
functions.description: Adds the specified trunk chain values to the topo portion of the Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeClearChannelWidthEntry
functions.syntax: gpeClearChannelWidthEntry( u_sandbox x_index t_direction ) => t / nil
functions.description: Clears the channelWidth value of the specified channel in the specified sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpeClearGridEntries( u_sandbox [ ?row x_row ] [ ?col x_col ] ) => l_gridEntries / nil
functions.description: Unplaces the grid entries that match the given identifiers in the given sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeClearMatchGroups
functions.description: Removes all the matched groups from the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeClearPresetGenerators
functions.description: Deletes all the registered preset generator functions from the system.

functions.name: gpeClearStrapEntries
functions.description: Removes all straps from the given Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearTopo
functions.description: Removes all topologies from the given Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearTrunkChains
functions.description: Removes all trunk chains from the Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeCopyColAbutment
functions.syntax: gpeCopyColAbutment( u_sandbox x_sourceCol x_targetCol ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies abutment information from one column to another.

functions.name: gpeCopyRowAbutment
functions.syntax: gpeCopyRowAbutment( u_sandbox x_sourceRow x_targetRow ) => t / nil
functions.description: Copies abutment information from one row to another.

functions.name: gpeCreateAbutEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateAbutEntries( [ ?rows l_rows ] [ ?cols l_columns ] [ ?abutType l_abutType ] [ ?template l_template ] ) => l_abutEntry / nil
functions.description: Creates a list of abut entries that are in line with the information in the arguments.

functions.name: gpeCreateAbutType
functions.syntax: gpeCreateAbutType( [ ?syncChains { t | nil } ] [ ?preserveRows { t | nil } ] [ ?permute { t | nil } ] [ ?mirrorEquivOrients { t | nil } ] [ ?mirror { t | nil } ] [ ?interdigitateChains { t | nil } ] [ ?dummyFlexBothEndNets { t | nil } ] [ ?chainLeftNet { Source | Drain | Either } ] [ ?chainAlignPMOS { Top | Center | Bottom } ] [ ?chainAlignNMOS { Top | Center | Bottom } ] [ ?allowSingleBulk { t | nil } ] [ ?abutStrategy { sdFirst | dummyFirst } ] )  => l_abutType / nil
functions.description: Creates an abutType DPL, which can be passed to the gpeCreateAbutEntry API. The abutment then uses the chaining parameters specified in the abutType parameter. The defaults for the arguments are obtained from the Modgen environment if set. Otherwise, the defaults of lxChain are honored.

functions.name: gpeCreateAlignment
functions.syntax: gpeCreateAlignment( [ ?direction t_direction ] [ ?type t_type ] [ ?reflayer g_reflayer ] [ ?spacing f_spacing ] ) => l_alignment / nil
functions.description: Creates an alignment DPL, which can be passed as an alignment argument for gpeCreateGridEntry to set the member alignment and spacing of a grid entry. Specifying a direction, although not necessary for types other than center, is highly recommended.

functions.name: gpeCreateChannelWidthEntry
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox channel width entry that can be passed in gpeSetChannelWidthEntry to set the channel widths.

functions.name: gpeCreateDummyConfig
functions.syntax: gpeCreateDummyConfig( [ ?master t_master] [ ?source l_source ] [ ?connectivity l_connectivity ] [ ?parameters l_parameters ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?defaultNet t_defaultNet ] ) => l_dummyConfig / nil
functions.description: Creates a dummyConfig DPL, which can be used as an argument for gpeCreateGridEntry to create a dummy grid entry. If the master is not set, the source is used to determine the master. If the source is not set, the dummy uses the neighboring instances as its source.

functions.name: gpeCreateDummyConfigNet
functions.description: Creates a dummyConfigNet DPL that can be added to a list with other dummyConfigNet DPLs and passed as the connectivity argument to gpeCreateDummyConfig to create a dummyConfig DPL.

functions.name: gpeCreateDummyConfigParam
functions.syntax: gpeCreateDummyConfigParam( t_name [ ?type t_type ] [ ?value t_value ] )  => l_dummyConfigParam / nil
functions.description: Creates a dummyConfigParam DPL that can be added to a list with other dummyConfigParam DPLs and passed as the parameters argument to gpeCreateDummyConfig to create a dummyConfig DPL.

functions.name: gpeCreateGridEntry
functions.syntax: gpeCreateGridEntry( [ ?row x_row ] [ ?col x_col ] [ ?name t_name ] [ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ] [ ?orientation t_orientation ] [ ?hAlign l_hAlign ] [ ?vAlign l_vAlign ] [ ?template l_template ] ) => l_gridEntry / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox grid entry DPL for an instance or a dummy. A grid entry can represent either an instance or a dummy.

functions.name: gpeCreateInstTermEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateInstTermEntries( [ ?deviceNames l_deviceNames ] [ ?instTermNames l_instTermNames ] [ ?gridEntries  l_gridEntries ] ) => l_instTermEntries / nil
functions.description: Creates instTerms for all combinations of the two identifiers and returns a list of instTerms names that were created. The return value is used as an argument to twig and strap entries to define the connectivity of the topology objects.

functions.name: gpeCreateMapEntry
functions.syntax: gpeCreateMapEntry( [ ?schematicName t_schematicName ] [ ?symbolName t_symbolName ] [ ?template l_template ] ) => l_mapEntry / nil
functions.description: Creates a map entry DPL that stores the schematic name of an instance, along with its symbol mapping.

functions.name: gpeCreateMatchGroupEntry
functions.syntax: gpeCreateMatchGroupEntry( d_matchGroupID [ ?twigMatchType t_twigMatchType ] [ ?trunkMatchType t_trunkMatchType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a DPL that represents a matched group. The DPL can then be added to a Modgen sandbox object using the gpeAddMatchGroups function.

functions.name: gpeCreateSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeCreateSandbox( [ ?cv d_cellview ]  [ ?ids l_figs ] [ ?sync { t | nil } ] ) => u_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox object that includes the specified instances. This function can be used to create Modgen sandbox objects in both schematic and layout cellviews. If none of the arguments are provided, the current edit cellview and selected instances are considered.

functions.name: gpeCreateStrapEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateStrapEntries( [ ?netNames l_netNames ] [ ?instTermEntries l_instTermEntries ] [ ?direction t_direction ] [ ?constraints l_constraints ] [ ?template l_template ] ) => l_straps / nil
functions.description: Creates straps for the specified nets that connect the given instance terminals.

functions.name: gpeCreateTrunkChain
functions.syntax: gpeCreateTrunkChain( ?trunks l_trunks ?anchorIndex n_anchorIndex [ ?trunkDirection { horizontal | vertical } ] [ ?offsetDirection { positive | negative } ] [ ?anchorPoint t_anchorPoint ] [ ?anchorReference t_anchorReference ] [ ?centerInChannel { t | nil } ] [ ?template l_template ] ) => g_trunkChainObject / nil
functions.description: Creates trunk chain entries based on the specified identifiers from the sandbox. It is recommended to use only one of the optional arguments. If none of the optional arguments is provided, all trunk chains available in the Modgen are listed. If multiple optional arguments are provided, the return value is the intersection of all the sets.

functions.name: gpeCreateTrunkEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateTrunkEntries( [ ?netNames lt_netNames ] [ ?offset f_offset ] [ ?longOffsetSource1 t_longOffsetSource1 ] [ ?longOffset1 f_longOffset1 ] [ ?longOffsetSource2 t_longOffsetSource2 ] [ ?longOffset2 f_longOffset2 ] [ ?twigs lg_twigs ] [ ?twigConstraints lg_twigConstraints ] [ ?constraints lg_constraints ] [ ?template l_template ] [ ?matchGroup l_matchGroupID ] ) => l_trunkObjects / nil
functions.description: Creates a list of trunk entries, one for each netName. The properties defined by the arguments are applied to all trunks. To define different properties for each trunk, call the function in a for loop and set the arguments, as required, for each unique trunk.

functions.name: gpeCreateTwigEntries
functions.syntax: gpeCreateTwigEntries( [ ?instTermEntries l_instTermEntries ] [ ?constraints l_constraints ] [ ?template l_template ] ) => g_twigObject / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox twig object, which specifies the instance terminals to make connections to and the constraints that define how the connections must be made. The twig objects can be added to trunk with the ?twigEntries parameter on gpeCreateTrunkEntries.

functions.name: gpeDeleteDummyEntries
functions.syntax: gpeDeleteDummyEntries( u_sandbox g_includeInternal g_unplaceOnly g_fullRCOnly ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes dummy entries from the given Modgen sandbox object and compresses the grid based on the specified options.

functions.name: gpeDeleteSandbox
functions.description: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object but does not delete its associated figGroup.

functions.name: gpeEditSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeEditSandbox( [ d_modgenID | d_figGroupID ] [ g_sync ] ) => u_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Returns a Modgen sandbox object that represents the current Modgen or figGroup. The sandbox object can be edited using SKILL APIs.

functions.name: gpeExtractReuseTemplate
functions.syntax: gpeExtractReuseTemplate( u_constraint | d_fig g_structureName t_fileName ) => t | nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Extracts the given Modgen a into a reusable text file.

functions.name: gpeExtractTemplateFromMG
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Generates a reusable template for each Modgen constraint present in the specified constraint cache.

functions.name: gpeFinishSandbox
functions.syntax: gpeFinishSandbox( u_sandbox [ ?transfer { t | nil } ] [ ?removeScratch { t | nil } ] [ ?backAnnotate { t | nil } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object. If run from the schematic view, the Modgen's associated scratch cellview is also deleted. If run from the layout view, the command optionally transfers the Modgen constraint to the schematic view and backannotates any dummies. gpeFinishSandbox must be used in tandem with the functions that create sandboxes, such as gpeCreateSandbox and gpeEditSandbox. It is recommend that all Modgen sandbox objects are finished by calling this function.

functions.name: gpeGetAbut
functions.description: Returns the Modgen abutment DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetAbutTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of abutment types for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetAbutTypeName
functions.description: Returns the name corresponding to the given abutment type number from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetChannelWidthEntry
functions.syntax: gpeGetChannelWidthEntry( u_sandbox x_channelNumber t_direction ) => g_ChannelWidthEntry / nil
functions.description: Returns the channelWidth sandbox object that matches the given index and direction values.

functions.name: gpeGetConstraints
functions.description: Returns a list of constraint IDs that are associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetDefaultAbutType
functions.description: Returns the default abutment type name for the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetFigGroup
functions.description: Returns the ID of the Modgen figGroup that is associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGrid
functions.description: Returns the Modgen sandbox grid DPL that describes the grid placement of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridColCount
functions.description: Returns the number of columns available in the grid of the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridEntries
functions.syntax: gpeGetGridEntries( u_sandbox [ ?row x_row ] [ ?col x_col ] [ ?name t_name ] ) => l_gridEntries / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of grid entries from the Modgen sandbox that match the specified identifiers. If you specify multiple identifiers, then the function returns a list of instances that satisfy all requirements.

functions.name: gpeGetGridRowCount
functions.description: Returns the number of rows available in the grid of the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridSelection
functions.description: Returns a list of indexes that represent the grid selection in the GPE (Grid Pattern Editor) assistant. The DPL is a list of list of indexes, for example ((0 1) (1 3) ... ), that are associated with the given userType (UT).

functions.name: gpeGetGridValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the cells in the Grid Pattern Editor table view.

functions.name: gpeGetMap
functions.description: Returns the Modgen sandbox map DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetMapEntry
functions.description: Returns the map entry DPL from the specified Modgen sandbox object that matches the specified schematic or symbol name. The function first looks for a matching schematic name; if not found, then looks for a matching symbol name and returns the first match.

functions.name: gpeGetSelection
functions.syntax: gpeGetSelection( g_tableView ) => list(row column) / list(bottom:left top:right)
functions.description: Returns a list of currently selected cells or a range of cells in a grid-pattern-editor table format.

functions.name: gpeGetStrapEntries
functions.syntax: gpeGetStrapEntries( u_sandboxObject [ ?netNames l_netNames ] [ ?deviceNames l_deviceNames ] [ ?instTermNames l_instTermNames ] ) => l_straps / nil
functions.description: Filters straps in the Modgen sandbox based on the given identifiers. It is recommended to use only one of the optional arguments. If no arguments are provided, all straps in the Modgen are displayed. If multiple arguments are provided, the intersection of the sets is displayed.

functions.name: gpeGetTrunkChains
functions.syntax: gpeGetTrunkChains( u_sandbox [ ?anchorIndex n_anchorIndex ] [ ?trunkDirection t_trunkDirection ] [ ?offsetDirection t_offsetDirection ] [ ?anchorPoint t_anchorPoint ] ) => l_trunksChains / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of trunk chains based on the specified identifiers. If none of the optional arguments are provided, all trunkChains available in the Modgen are listed. If multiple optional arguments are provided, the return value is the intersection of all the sets.

functions.name: gpeGetTwigEntries
functions.description: Returns all twigs on the specified trunks from the given sandbox.

functions.name: gpeIsPresetGenDisplayable
functions.description: Checks whether the given preset generator should be displayed in the Preset drop-down list of the Grid Pattern Editor.
