functions.syntax: rteCreateBlockRingScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?contour g_contour ] [ ?channel g_channel ] [ ?blockClearance f_blockClearance ] [ ?horiLayer t_horiLayer ] [ ?vertLayer t_vertLayer ] [ ?latticeStyle g_latticeStyle ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a block ring routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreateCellRowsScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateCellRowsScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?allRouteLayers g_allRouteLayers ] [ ?routeLayers l_routeLayers ] [ ?endOfRow g_endOfRow ] [ ?extendToNearest g_extendToNearest ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a cell rows routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreateCoreRingScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateCoreRingScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?ringAtCenter g_ringAtCenter ] [ ?relativeTo s_relativeTo ] [ ?coreClearance f_coreClearance ] [ ?padClearance f_padClearance ] [ ?inAreaClearance f_inAreaClearance ] [ ?outAreaClearance f_outAreaClearance ] [ ?areaXLo f_areaXLo ] [ ?areaYLo f_areaYLo ] [ ?areaXHi f_areaXHi ] [ ?areaYHi f_areaYHi ] [ ?horiLayer t_horiLayer ] [ ?vertLayer t_vertLayer ] [ ?latticeStyle g_latticeStyle ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a core ring routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreatePadRingScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreatePadRingScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?allPinLayers g_allPinLayers ] [ ?pinLayers l_pinLayers ] [ ?railPins g_railPins ] [ ?edgePins g_edgePins ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a pad ring routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreatePinToTrunkScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreatePinToTrunkScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?allPinLayers g_allPinLayers ] [ ?pinLayers l_pinLayers ] [ ?useTrunkLayer g_useTrunkLayer ] [ ?trunkLayer t_trunkLayer ] [ ?minTrunkWidth f_minTrunkWidth ] [ ?minWireWidth f_minWireWidth ] [ ?maxWireWidth f_maxWireWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a pin to trunk routing scheme. A trunk is usually a power net created by power routing commands such as pad ring, core ring, block ring, stripes, or cell rows.

functions.name: rteCreateStripesScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateStripesScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?horiStripes g_horiStripes ] [ ?yStep f_yStep ] [ ?horiLayers l_horiLayers ] [ ?vertStripes g_vertStripes ] [ ?xStep f_sStep ] [ ?vertLayers l_vertLayers ] [ ?pinClearance f_pinClearance ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] [ ?minStripeWidth f_minStripeWidth ] [ ?offsetFrom s_offsetFrom ] [ ?leftOffset f_leftOffset ] [ ?bottomOffset f_bottomOffset ] [ ?useCenterLine g_useCenterLine ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a stripes routing scheme.

functions.name: rteCreateViasScheme
functions.syntax: rteCreateViasScheme( [ ?name s_name ] [ ?layerRange g_layerRange ] [ ?minLayer t_minLayer ] [ ?maxLayer t_maxLayer ] [ ?cutArrayRule s_cutArrayRule ] [ ?cutArrayRows n_cutArrayRows ] [ ?cutArrayColumns n_cutArrayColumns ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a via insertion scheme.

functions.name: rteDecomposeTrunks
functions.description: Converts pathSegs and vias in power trunks to normal, routed pathSegs and vias. The function uses the current cellview and the selected set.

functions.name: rteDeleteRoutedNets
functions.description: Deletes the routed paths of all nets in the design. Optionally, you can preserve routed power nets.

functions.name: rteFixAntenna
functions.syntax: rteFixAntenna( [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?all g_all ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?set g_set ] [ ?excludeNets l_excludeNets ] [ ?layerList l_layerList ] [ ?fullRulesChecking g_fullRulesChecking ] [ ?maxWiresToPush x_maxWiresToPush ] [ ?model l_models ] [ ?useDiodes g_useDiodes ] [ ?useJumpers g_useJumpers ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Fixes process antenna violations for the entire design, a specific net, or nets in a set by inserting jumpers and/or diodes. You can choose to ignore specific nets.

functions.name: rteFixViolations
functions.syntax: rteFixViolations( [ ?cv d_cvID ] [ ?closeOpens g_closeOpens ] [ ?excludeNet t_excludeNet ] [ ?excludePowerGround g_excludePowerGround ] [ ?fixCrossing g_fixCrossing ] [ ?fixMfgGrid g_fixMfgGrid ] [ ?fixMinArea g_fixMinArea ] [ ?fixMinAreaAtPins g_fixMinAreaAtPins ] [ ?fixMinEdge g_fixMinEdge ] [ ?fixMinEncArea g_fixMinEncArea ] [ ?fixMinWidth g_fixMinWidth ] [ ?fixNumCuts g_fixNumCuts ] [ ?fixPortShort g_fixPortShort ] [ ?fixRouteGrid g_fixRouteGrid ] [ ?reducePinWireNotches g_ReducePinWireNotches ] [ ?maximizeCuts g_maximizeCuts ] [ ?offsetVia g_offsetVia ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?searchAndRepair g_searchAndRepair ] [ ?set g_set ] s_value ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: This function allows you to fix violations for a selected area or for an entire cellview.

functions.name: rteGeomAnd
functions.syntax: rteGeomAnd( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Generates new shapes that are common on two or more layer purposes.

functions.name: rteGeomAndNot
functions.syntax: rteGeomAndNot( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?size1 f_size1 ] [ ?size2 f_size2 ] [ ?trimCorners g_trimCorners ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Generates new shapes that exist on one layer purpose and do not overlap shapes on another layer purpose. You can optionally use sized shapes from one or both of the layer purposes. And you can choose to operate on a specific region or the entire design.

functions.name: rteGeomNot
functions.syntax: rteGeomNot( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Inverts the shapes on a layer purpose to generate new shapes.

functions.name: rteGeomOr
functions.syntax: rteGeomOr( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Merges all shapes on the input layer purposes and generates new shapes on the output layer purpose.

functions.name: rteGeomSize
functions.syntax: rteGeomSize( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?size f_size ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?trimCorners g_trimCorners ] [ ?fixEdgesToRegion g_fixEdgesToRegion ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Performs an oversize or undersize shapes on a specific layer purpose.

functions.name: rteGeomXor
functions.syntax: rteGeomXor( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?lpp1 g_lpp1 ] [ ?lpp2 g_lpp2 ] [ ?outputLpp l_outputLpp ] [ ?blockedLayer l_blockedLayer ] [ ?polygons g_polygons ] [ ?region l_region ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Generates new shapes from shapes on either input layer purpose that do not overlap the other layer purpose.

functions.name: rteOptimizeRoute
functions.syntax: rteOptimizeRoute( [ ?cv d_cvID ] [ ?checkAntenna g_checkAntenna ] [ ?detailCritic g_detailCritic ] [ ?excludeNet t_excludeNet ] [ ?excludePowerGround g_excludePowerGround ] [ ?reduceVias g_reduceVias ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?set g_set ] [ ?useDoubleCutVias g_useDoubleCutVias ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: This function is used to optimize routing by performing refinement routing steps, such as reducing the vias, master vias, straighten wire.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteBlockRing
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteBlockRing( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?instances t_instances ] [ ?channels g_channel ] [ ?contour g_contour ] [ ?blockClearance f_blockClearance ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?lattice g_lattice ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes block ring routing for a layout cellview.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteCellRow
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteCellRow( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?routingArea l_routingArea ] [ ?rowEnd g_rowEnd ] [ ?extend g_extend ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes cell row routing for a layout cellview.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteCoreRing
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteCoreRing( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?coreClearance f_coreClearance ] [ ?padClearance f_padClearance ] [ ?inAreaClearance f_inAreaClearance ] [ ?outAreaClearance f_outAreaClearance ] [ ?routingArea l_routingArea ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?lattice g_lattice ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes core ring power routing for a layout cellview.

functions.name: rtePowerRoutePadRing
functions.syntax: rtePowerRoutePadRing( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?pads l_pads ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?railPins g_railPins ] [ ?edgePins g_edgePins ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes pad ring power routing for a layout cellview.

functions.name: rtePowerRoutePinToTrunk
functions.syntax: rtePowerRoutePinToTrunk( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?instances l_instances ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?trunkLayer t_trunkLayer ] [ ?minTrunkWidth f_minTrunkWidth ] [ ?minWireWidth f_minWireWidth ] [ ?maxWireWidth f_maxWireWidth ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes pin to trunk routing for a layout cellview. A trunk is usually a power net created by power routing commands such as pad ring, core ring, block ring, stripes, or cell rows.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteStripes
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteStripes( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?routingArea l_routingArea ] [ ?xStep f_sStep ] [ ?yStep f_yStep ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?pinClearance f_pinClearance ] [ ?netClearance f_netClearance ] [ ?netWidth f_netWidth ] [ ?minLength f_minLength ] [ ?leftOffset f_leftOffset ] [ ?bottomOffset f_bottomOffset ] [ ?xOffset f_xOffset ] [ ?yOffset f_yOffset ] [ ?centerLine g_centerLine ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes stripes power routing for a layout cellview.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteTieShield
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteTieShield( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?shieldTieFreq n_shieldTieFreq ] [ ?coaxTieFreq n_coaxTieFreq ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Ties shield wires to the shield nets in the entire design. Executed after creating shield nets either automatically or interactively.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteTrimStripes
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteTrimStripes( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?includeStraps g_includeStraps ] [ ?undoable g_undoable ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Trim existing stripes created by the rtePowerRouteStripes function.

functions.name: rtePowerRouteViaInsertion
functions.syntax: rtePowerRouteViaInsertion( [ ?cv d_cvId ] [ ?nets l_nets ] [ ?instances l_instances ] [ ?layers l_layers ] [ ?minLayer t_minLayer ] [ ?maxLayer t_maxLayer ] [ ?rows n_rows ] [ ?columns n_columns ] [ ?squareCutArray g_squareCutArray ] [ ?useValidRoutingVias g_useValidRoutingVias ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Executes via insertion between previously routed power rings, stripes, and cell rows.

functions.name: rteSearchAndRepair
functions.syntax: rteSearchAndRepair( [ ?cv d_cvid ] [ ?closeOpens g_closeOpens ] [ ?excludeNet t_excludeNet ] [ ?excludeType t_excludeType ] [ ?set g_set ] [ ?region l_region ] [ ?fullRulesChecking g_fullRulesChecking ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Searches for and fixes same net and different net spacing violations.

functions.name: soiEnableDrcDfm
functions.description: Enables the DRC/DFM tab in the Annotation Browser and the DRC/DFM commands in the Optimize menu in Layout XL.

functions.name: spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly
functions.syntax: spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly( d_lhsInst d_rhsInst n_minOd n_minPoly ) => n_odSpacing
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Calculates the required oxide diffusion spacing between two adjacent instances based on minimum oxide diffusion spacing and polysilicon spacing constraints.

functions.name: spdGetAbutName
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the user abutment name associated with the specified abutment strategy registered using the spdGetUserAbutProc function.

functions.name: spdGetAbutStrategy
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the abutment strategy associated with the specified user abutment name registered using the spdRegUserAbutProc function.

functions.name: spdGetSymDeviceInfo
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns an object containing information, such as length, width, fingers, and binding related to the specified symbolic device. This information can be used to write user callback functions.

functions.name: spdGetUserAbutProc
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns an object containing the registered user abutment options with associated user callbacks and the description that were registered using the spdRegUserAbutProc function.

functions.name: spdGetUserFlowProc
functions.description: Returns an object containing the user flow callbacks that were registered using the spdRegUserFlowProc function.

functions.name: spdPerformAbutment
functions.syntax: spdPerformAbutment( d_lhsInst d_rhsInst x_keepContacts t_abutStrategy { sdFirst | dummyFirst } ) => ld_chain / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Performs abutment on two adjacent instances according to the specified arguments and the SPD P/N chain alignment setting.

functions.name: spdRegUserAbutProc
functions.syntax: spdRegUserAbutProc( l_abutNames t_abutProc t_checkProc t_restoreProc [ ?libName t_libName ] [ ?description t_description ] [ ?checkOdAbut t | nil ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers callback to check the design for OD abutment.  (ICADVM18.1 Only) Registers a list of user-defined abutments and related callbacks to perform these abutments in the SPD Editing or SPD Preview window or when a layout generated using SPD is brought back to the SPD Editing window. You can register them globally or by name of the library. However, if the design contains instances from different libraries, SPD will load the user-defined abutments and related callbacks from only one of registered libraries.

functions.name: spdRegUserFlowProc
functions.syntax: spdRegUserFlowProc( [ ?postGen t_postGenProc ] [ ?preGen t_preGenProc ] [ ?postGenLayout t_postGenLayProc ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers user-defined callbacks to further customize the design in specific steps of the SPD flow.

functions.name: spdUnregUserAbutProc
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Unregisters the current user abutment callback for the specified library. You cannot unregister a callback during an SPD session because it is still in use.

functions.name: spdUnregUserFlowProc
functions.description: Unregisters the current user flow callback. You cannot unregister a callback during an SPD session because it is still in use.

functions.name: techGetLxExtractLayers
functions.description: Returns the list of extract layers from the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. These layers are listed as validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group.

functions.name: techGetLxNoOverlapLayers
functions.description: Lists the pairs of layers that cannot overlap.

functions.name: techIsLxExtractLayer
functions.description: Indicates whether the specified layer is listed as an extract layer in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The extract layers are listed under validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group.

functions.name: techIsLxNoOverlapLayer
functions.syntax: techIsLxNoOverlapLayer( d_techFileID tx_layer1 tx_layer2 ) => t / nil
functions.description: Indicates whether the specified pair of layers is a derived no overlap layer in the specified technology file. The order in which the layers is specified does not matter.

functions.name: techSetLxExtractLayer
functions.description: Adds the specified layer to the list of extract layers in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The extract layers are listed under validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group. If any of the necessary technology file sections do not already exist, this function creates them.

functions.name: techSetLxExtractLayers
functions.description: Adds the specified layers to the list of extract layers in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The extract layers are listed under validLayers in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group. If any of the necessary technology file sections do not already exist, this function creates them.

functions.name: techSetLxNoOverlapLayer
functions.syntax: techSetLxNoOverlapLayer( d_techFileID tx_layer1 tx_layer2 ) => t / nil
functions.description: Derives a no overlap layer by performing an AND operation on the two specified layers, and flags it as an error layer in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. The derived layer is defined in the techDerivedLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section of the technology file and is listed as an errorLayer in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group. No overlap layers are named and numbered consecutively; each is named noOverlapLayern, where n is the next available consecutive integer. If any of the necessary technology file sections does not already exist, the function creates them.

functions.name: techSetLxNoOverlapLayers
functions.description: Creates a list of layers that cannot overlap. The function creates a derived layer by performing an AND operation on each pair of layers and flags the resultant layer as an error layer in the virtuosoDefaultExtractorSetup constraint group in the specified technology file. Each derived layer is defined in the techDerivedLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section of the technology file and is listed as an errorLayer in the interconnect subsection of the constraint group.

functions.name: tpaSelectWSSPDef
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Selects the specified WSSPDef on the Track Pattern Assistant. This is similar to selecting the WSSPDef in the Track Pattern Assistant.

functions.name: tpaSetActivePattern
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the active pattern for the given width spacing snap pattern definition (WSSPDef).

functions.name: tpaSetAllDefsVisible
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the visibility of the active WSSPDefs to All Visible (AV) or None Visible (NV) for a cellview.

functions.name: tpaSetDefVisible
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the visibility of the active pattern for the given WSSPDef or snap pattern definition (SPDef) in the Track Pattern table. If the WSSPDef or SPDef is enabled in the Track Pattern table, this also controls the visibility of the active pattern in the canvas.

functions.name: tpaSetFilterByNumber
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the Track Pattern Assistant Filter field using the list order number for the desired setting.

functions.name: tpaSetWireType
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the active wire types for the active width spacing pattern (WSP) of the given WSSPDef.

functions.name: tpaToggleDef
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Enables or disables the specified WSSPDef or SPDef.

functions.name: tpaToggleLayer
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the visibility for the active pattern of the enabled WSSPDef or SPDef on the given snapping layer.

functions.name: updateReturnPopupMenuItem
functions.description: Adds the Return menu item to the pop up menu specified.

functions.name: vcpfeCreateEstimatedRows
functions.description: Runs placement planning to estimate the number of rows required and creates the rows.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceBoundaryCells
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Places boundary cells after generating rows in the specified cellview. Before placing the boundary cells, ensure that you have set all the required environment variables.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceConstraintGroup
functions.description: Returns the name of the constraint group that will be used when the placer is run on the specified cellview.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceFillers
functions.syntax: vcpfePlaceFillers( d_cv g_mode ?partitionName { prBoundary | g_clusterBoundaryName } ?fillerCompTypes t_fillerCompTypes ?fillerCellNames t_fillerCellNames ?ignoreBlockages { t | nil } ?createphysOnly { t | nil } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts or deletes filler cells from the specified cellview.

functions.name: vcpfePlaceTapCells
functions.syntax: vcpfePlaceTapCells( d_cv t_mode {insert | delete} [ ?partitionName t_name ] [ ?tapCompTypes t_types ] [ ?tapCellNames t_cellNames ] [ ?tapToTapSpacing f_value ] [ ?tapBackOff f_value ] [ ?minTapSpacing f_value ] [ ?tapPattern {Regular | Checker Board} ]  [ ?skipRow x_number ] [ ?tapRowOffset f_value ] [ ?tapRowEndOffset f_value ] [ ?periodicTap {t | nil} ] [ ?lockTap {t | nil} ] [ ?avoidAbutment {t | nil} ]  [ ?ignoreBlockages {t | nil} ] ) => l_tapCellIDs / nil
functions.description: Inserts tap cells in the empty spaces between standard cells in the specified cellview as per the specified arguments. When t_mode is set to delete, all tap cells in the given cellview are deleted.

functions.name: vcpfeRunCustomDigitalPlacer
functions.syntax: vcpfeRunCustomDigitalPlacer( d_schCvID d_layCvID [ ?groupCMOSPairs { t | nil } ] [ ?preserveChains { t | nil } ] [ ?groupMFactors { t | nil } ] [ ?allowRotation { t | nil } ] [ ?selectedCompList l_selectedCompList ] [ ?placementMode { Auto Placement | ECO Placement } ] [ ?optimization { none | basic | moderate | optimized } ] [ ?ecoModeImpact { none | localized | maximized } ] [ ?insertSubstrateContacts { t | nil } ] [ ?saveAs { t | nil } ] [ ?saveAsLibName t_libName ] [ ?saveAsCellName t_cellName ] [ ?saveAsViewName t_viewName ] [ ?overwrite { t | nil } ] [ ?intraRowSpacer { t | nil } ] [ ?interRowSpacer t | nil } ] [ ?adjustBdy { t | nil } ] [ ?reserveTracksForRouting { -1 | 0 | 1 ... 10 } ] [ ?vcpRulesConstraintGroup t_constraintGroupName ] [ ?minBoundaryOffset f_offset ] [ ?maxPinsPerNet x_numPins ] [ ?mixedMode { t | nil } ] [ ?placeCluster t_clusterName ] [ ?componentEdge { Boundary | Bounding Box } ] ) => t
functions.description: Runs the custom digital placer, specifying the type of placement that is done, the technology rules to be used, any automatic spacing adjustments to be done, and how the modified cellview is saved.

functions.name: vdrCheckVoltageLabels
functions.syntax: vdrCheckVoltageLabels( d_cellviewID [ t_reportFilename ] [ g_enablePopup ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Verifies that all top-level nets in the specified layout cellview are correctly labeled in the canvas.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageLabel
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageLabel( d_cellviewID lt_datasetName t_lowVPurposeName t_highVPurposeName [ f_labelHeight ] [ g_externalNets ] [ g_internalNets ] [ g_update ] [ g_generateLabels ] [ g_overrideMode ] [ x_hierStopLevel ] [ u_posLabelCreationCB ] [ t_voltageInfoFile ] [ t_layerPurposeFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates labels for the minimum and maximum voltages from simulation data on the nets in a layout design. This function works only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageLabelOnNets
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageLabelOnNets( d_cellviewID ld_netIDs t_lowVPurposeName t_highVPurposeName [ f_labelHeight ] [ t_layerPurposeFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates labels from the voltage values entered manually in the Property Editor assistant for the specified top-level nets in the given cellview. The labels are created on the geometry of the net in question. Where there is no geometry, the labels are created on all the Pcell and instance terminals connected to the net. This command works only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageMarkers
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageMarkers( d_cellviewID t_voltagePurposeFile [ ?dataset t_datasetName ] [ ?update { t | nil } ] [ ?override_mode { t | nil } ] [ ?externalNet { t | nil } ] [ ?internalNet { t | nil } ] [ ?hierStopLevel x_hierStopLevel ] [ ?postMarkerCreationCB u_postMarkerCreationCB ] [ ?csvFile t_voltageInfoFile ] [ ?voltageRounding { roundOff | floor | ceiling } ] [ ?mode { maxVoltage | minVoltage | bothVoltage } ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates markers for minimum and/or maximum voltages on the nets in the specified design. Voltage information can be taken from simulation datasets, from user-defined voltages on nets, or from a voltage information file. The voltage purpose file specifies on which layer-purpose pair a marker is created depending on the voltage value in question.

functions.name: vdrCreateVoltageMarkersOnNets
functions.syntax: vdrCreateVoltageMarkersOnNets( d_cellviewID ld_netIDs t_voltagePurposeFile [ ?postMarkerCreationCB t_postMarkerCreationCB ] [ ?voltageRounding { roundOff | floor | ceiling } ] [ ?voltageMode { maxVoltage | minVoltage | bothVoltage } ] [ ?ignoreZeroVoltNets lt_netNames ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates markers from the voltage values entered manually in the Property Editor assistant for the specified top-level nets in the given cellview.

functions.name: vdrDeleteLabels
functions.description: Deletes from the specified cellview all the labels and markers created using the VDR flows.

functions.name: vdrGenerateLabelsGUI
functions.description: Opens the Voltage Dependent Rules form, which you can use to create voltage labels or markers on nets. This command works only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.name: vdrGenerateVSyncShapes
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 EXL Only) Creates voltage sync (vsync) shapes between nets that are constrained by a common voltage sync constraint.

functions.name: vdrGetValidLayers
functions.description: Returns the list of valid layers on which labels or markers can be generated. The list was specified previously using the vdrSetValidLayers function.

functions.name: vdrRunSanityChecker
functions.syntax: vdrRunSanityChecker( d_cellviewID [ g_checkMarkers ] [ g_checkAgainstLayout ] [ f_tolerance ] [ g_isToleranceAbsolute ] [ t_logFile ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks constrained voltage labels in the layout against the voltage values stored in the schematic or layout net properties and reports any discrepancies between the values. You can optionally apply a threshold up to which mismatches are tolerated and not reported. You can also specify the location and name of a log file in which the report is captured.

functions.name: vdrRunVSyncSanityChecker
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 EXL Only) Checks whether there are valid voltage sync (vsync) shapes on nets that are constrained by a common vsync constraint. The checker reports any vsync shapes that are wrongly created and any nets that have a vsync constraint defined but no vsync shape between them.

functions.name: vdrSanityCheckerGUI
functions.description: Opens the VDR Sanity Checker form, which you can use to check constrained VDR voltage labels in the layout view and report any labels that are missing or which have values different from the values specified for the net in the schematic or layout design.

functions.name: vdrSetValidLayers
functions.syntax: vdrSetValidLayers( d_cellviewID { l_layers | nil } ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies a list of valid layers on which labels or markers can be generated. The software creates labels or markers only for nets on one of the listed layers. Each subsequent call to this function overrides all the previously set layers.

functions.name: vfoAbut
functions.syntax: vfoAbut( g_obj l_instsList [ @rest l_args ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Abuts the instances provided in the l_instList. You can pass optional arguments to this SKILL API. Note: The Abut command does not call the vfoAbut function for fluid devices.

functions.name: vfoAdvGRUpdateCDF
functions.syntax: vfoAdvGRUpdateCDF( g_obj t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => l_cdfParams
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Helps to modify the existing CDFs on a FGR device and add more CDFs on it. The function can be defined for subclasses of vfoAdvGuardRing. It works based on callback mechanism, that is, the user defines it and the infrastructure calls it.

functions.name: vfoAllocateProtocolObj
functions.description: Allocates and returns the newly allocated and initialized instance of the vfo protocol class of the Pcell. You can use the vfoGetProtocolClassName SKILL function to determine the name of the protocol class.

functions.name: vfoAllocateShapeData
functions.description: Returns a newly allocated and initialized instance of the subclass of the vfoShapeData  class for the specified database shape ID.

functions.name: vfoChopInstance
functions.syntax: vfoChopInstance( g_obj d_instId chopShapeData [ @rest l_args ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Chops the fluid shape of a given instance. The information of the chop rectangle or polygon is provided by chopShapeData which is a class object of vfoShapeData. The shape data points are in the design coordinates. This function transforms the chopShapeData before chopping the fluid shape.  Note: The Chop command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters. If the chop operation results in multiple shapes, it may need to create multiple Pcell instances.

functions.name: vfoConvertToPolygon
functions.syntax: vfoConvertToPolygon(  g_obj d_instId [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Converts the fluid shape of the given instance to a polygon. This is used for instances containing path type fluid shape. The Convert to Polygon command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfoCreateAutoFGR
functions.description: Wraps obstacles in wrap mode on clicking an obstacle if AUTO mode is selected in the Device field of the Create Guard Ring form. This function is used to specify the bindkey for creation of FGR in auto mode.

functions.name: vfoCreateObstruction
functions.syntax: vfoCreateObstructions( g_obj d_instId layerPurposePair obstructionShapeData [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. A tunnel helps you to cut a specific layer-purpose of a guard ring device for connectivity purpose. There are four types of tunneling mechanisms-Path, Rectangle, Polygon, and Overlapping Shape. For procedural details about creating tunnels using GUI, refer to the Creating a Tunnel Through a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.  Note: To remove any existing obstructions, use the vfoDeleteObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoCreateObstructions
functions.syntax: vfoCreateObstructions( g_obj d_instId l_lppPoint [ @rest l_args ] )  => nil
functions.description: (IC6.1.8 Only) Creates obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. A tunnel helps you to cut a specific layer-purpose of a guard ring device for connectivity purpose. There are four types of tunneling mechanisms-Path, Rectangle, Polygon, and Overlapping Shape. For procedural details about creating tunnels using GUI, refer to the Creating a Tunnel Through a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.  Note: To remove any existing obstructions, use the vfoDeleteObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoCreateShapeData
functions.description: Allocates, initializes, and returns an instance of the subclass of the vfoShapeData of the given shape type.

functions.name: vfoDeleteObstruction
functions.syntax: vfoDeleteObstruction( g_obj d_instId layerPurposePair obstructionShapeData [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. This SKILL function is equivalent to healing.  For procedural details about healing an obstruction using GUI, refer to the Healing a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.  Note: To create an obstruction, use the vfoCreateObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoDoSnapToSnapPattern
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Snaps the fluid object to the snap pattern.

functions.name: vfoDrawFluidShape
functions.syntax: vfoDrawFluidShape( g_shapeObj cellView layerPurposePair ) => d_obj / nil
functions.description: Creates a dbObject corresponding to shapeData object in the given cellview on the given layer purpose pair.

functions.name: vfoGRCleanVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGRCleanVersionCache( t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the index.pcl and cache.pcl files by removing any unused entries of sub-masters from these files. This is an alternative to cleaning the cache if you have disabled the automatic FGR cache cleaning mechanism described in the Automatic Cache Cleaning section, or even if the Automatic Cache Cleaning mechanism is enabled by you and would like to clean the FGR caches on-demand.

functions.name: vfoGRCompareParams
functions.syntax: vfoGRCompareParams( g_obj d_inst1 d_inst2 )  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Checks the equality of FGR instances. You override this function and can define its new  equality for FGR instances. By default, it checks the value of the following parameters: verticalPitch, horizontalPitch, verticalSegWidth, and horizontalSegWidth. This function is called by the Merge command. For the Merge command to succeed, this function should return t for the two FGR instances being compared.

functions.name: vfoGRCreateDeviceClass
functions.description: Creates the device class definition for fluid guard ring (cdsGuardRing) in the given technology file. If the device class already exists in the technology file, it is updated when override is set to true.

functions.name: vfoGRDisableVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGRDisableVersionCache( l_FGRcellDDID t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Disables version cache for all instances that belong to the specified super-master list and found in the specified library, cell, or view. All instances are updated and the value of their createVersionCache parameter is set to 0.

functions.name: vfoGREnableVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGREnableVersionCache( l_FGRcellDDID t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Enables version cache on all instances currently not cache-enabled that belong to the specified list of FGR super-masters and found in the in the specified library, cell, or view. The createVersionCache parameter of such instances will get updated from 0 to the VFO version of the current Virtuoso session.

functions.name: vfoGRGeometry
functions.description: Calls three generic functions in the following order: vfoSfInitialize(pcell), vfoSfDraw(pcell), and then vfoSfFinalize(pcell) for drawing the fluid Pcell geometry.  NOTE: This is the top-level entry point to the vfo space-filling Pcell.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCommonQPtr
functions.description: Returns the common queue pointer of the Create Guard Ring form customized by you.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormFieldProp
functions.description: Gets the value of a property assigned to an existing field or GUI component displayed on the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormIdentifier
functions.description: Returns the unique identifier string used for creating the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormPointer
functions.description: Returns the form pointer corresponding to the unique identifier that creates the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetExtraArgument
functions.description: Retrieves the value of user-defined fields, that is, list of `key value' pair set using the vfoGRSetExtraArgument SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoGRGetExtraArgumentName
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the extra parameter names in a list. The end user should override this function for its class that has been extended from vfoAdvGuardRing.

functions.name: vfoGRGetQueuePointer
functions.description: Returns the pointer corresponding to the name of the queue of the customized Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRMaximizeShapes
functions.description: Tries all possible combinations of fillStyle and decompositionMode to find the combination that maximizes the number of shapes, and thereby the number of contact cuts.

functions.name: vfoGRNewCreateForm
functions.syntax: vfoGRNewCreateForm( t_uniqueFormIdentifier t_formType [ l_callbackList ] )  => r_formPointer / nil
functions.description: Creates the new Create Guard Ring form, that is, a new form pointer along with the unique fields and form symbol.

functions.name: vfoGRRegCreateFormUpdateCallback
functions.description: Registers the user-defined form customization procedure. This procedure gets called for the particular form pointer after the vfoGRUpdateCreateForm trigger is called.

functions.name: vfoGRSetCreateFormAllFieldsInvisible
functions.description: Sets the visible property for the predefined system fields, except the Technology and Device fields, on the Create Guard Ring form. This function cannot be used to set the properties of fields that you add while customizing the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRSetCreateFormFieldProp
functions.description: Sets the properties of the fields or components displayed on the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRSetExtraArgument
functions.description: Makes the values of the user-defined GUI components available for processing to the FGR infrastructure that resides in Virtuoso, and sets the corresponding CDF parameters. This SKILL function helps in binding the front-end data for back-end processing.

functions.name: vfoGRSmoothen
functions.description: Removes the small notches in the given direction from the fluid shape of the given fluid Pcell instance. The temporary shapes are created on tmpLpp.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateCreateFormSize
functions.description: Resizes the Create Guard Ring forms, including the form used for modgens. This function updates the size of all tabs and subtabs proportionately. However, there is no change in the size of the fields on the form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateTunnelLPPs
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the layer-purpose pairs on which tunnelling is allowed. The VFO infrastructure selects common layer-purpose present in the FGR and LPPs returned by the function vfoGRUpdateTunnelLPPs. If the function vfoGRUpdateTunnelLLPs returns nil, all FGR layer-purposes are displayed on the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateTunnelOptions
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the list of supported options for FGR tunnel shape types. VFO infrastructure uses options returned by this function and checks with the existing options. The first value returned by this function is selected by default when the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form opens. If the vfoGRUpdateTunnelOptions function is not defined, returns nil, or any invalid option is returned, all tunnel options are displayed on the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateVersionCache
functions.syntax: vfoGRUpdateVersionCache( l_FGRcellDDID t_libName [ ?cellName t_cellName ] [ ?viewName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the vfoCreateVersion parameter of an instance to the current Virtuoso version. If the vfoCreateVersion parameter is set to 0, the vfoGRUpdateVersionCache function does not update the vfoCreateVersion parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. You have to call the vfoGREnableVersionCache function to update this parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. If the vfoCreateVersion parameter is set to an older Virtuoso version and the image of the sub-master is not found in the cache files, cache.pcl and index.pcl, the vfoGRUpdateVersionCache function does not update the vfoCreateVersion parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. You have to call the vfoGRDisableVersionCache function and then the vfoGREnableVersionCache function to update this parameter to the latest Virtuoso version.

functions.name: vfoGetDeviceClassParam
functions.syntax: vfoGetDeviceClassParam(  t_libName t_deviceName t_classParam )  => value / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the class parameter of the specified cdsGuardRing device. This SKILL function also supports the incremental technology database (ITDB). Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetDeviceFormalParam
functions.syntax: vfoGetDeviceFormalParam(  t_libName t_deviceName t_formalParam )  => value / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the implementation formal parameter of the specified cdsGuardRing device. This SKILL function also supports ITDB. Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetFileListWithLoadSequence
functions.description: Returns a list of vfo*.ils filenames with their loading sequence.

functions.name: vfoGetImplementationClassName
functions.description: Returns the value of the vfoGRImpl class parameter, that is the implementation class name, of an FGR device from the specified library. This SKILL function also supports the incremental technology database (ITDB). Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetInstWithMissingCache
functions.description: Returns two lists of dbIDs. The first is the list of dbIDs of all instances whose submaster is found in index.pcl file but not found in cache.pcl file because the file is corrupt or missing. The second is the list of dbIDs of instances whose submaster is not found because the supermaster has been updated after instance creation.

functions.name: vfoGetParam
functions.description: Returns the value of a CDF parameter for the given object.

functions.name: vfoGetProtocolClassName
functions.description: Returns the symbol naming the protocol class to use with the fluid Pcell functions.

functions.name: vfoGetVersion
functions.description: Returns the version of the VFO SKILL code used in Virtuoso. This SKILL function is available from IC6.1.6 ISR2 and ICADV12.1 ISR4 onwards.

functions.name: vfoGrCreateCDF
functions.description: Creates fluid guard ring CDF parameters on the given library, cell view of the fluid guard ring device. It deletes any existing CDF parameters on the device.

functions.name: vfoInstallFluidDeviceFiles
functions.syntax: vfoInstallFluidDeviceFiles(  [ ?installPath t_installPath ] [ ?overwrite { t | nil } ] [ ?showMsg { t | nil } ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a set of Cadence-supplied SKILL files in a specific sequence in the Virtuoso environment. These files are required to work with fluid guard rings. These files are automatically loaded when you start Virtuoso.

functions.name: vfoIsCommandInDragMode
functions.description: Returns t if the vfo-related command is in drag mode, else returns nil.

functions.name: vfoIsGuardRing
functions.description: Returns t if the object to be queried is a valid guard ring instance, else returns nil.

functions.name: vfoMergeInstances
functions.syntax: vfoMergeInstances( g_obj d_inst1 d_inst2 [ @rest l_args ] )  => dbId / nil
functions.description: Merges the fluid Pcell instances inst1 and inst2. The Merge command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfoReInstallAllFluidGuardRingDevices
functions.description: Reinstalls all the FGR devices in the specified technology file.

functions.name: vfoReInstallGuardRingDevice
functions.description: Reinstalls the specified FGR devices in the specified technology file.

functions.name: vfoRotateInstance
functions.syntax: vfoRotateInstance( g_obj d_inst1 x_angle_in_degrees [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Applies the rotation angle on the FGR instance. This function applies to Pcells.

functions.name: vfoSetParam
functions.syntax: vfoSetParam( obj s_param value )  => value / nil
functions.description: Sets the value of a CDF parameter to the given value and triggers the callback, if any. The callback is triggered recursively so that if the callback changes another parameter, that callback is also triggered, recursively.

functions.name: vfoSetParams
functions.description: Sets the value of multiple parameters in a single call. The l_paramlist argument contains a list of parameter name and value pairs.

functions.name: vfoSetProtocolClassName
functions.description: Sets the protocol class for fluid Pcell for the given Pcell supermaster. This function gets called in the Pcell code for creating the supermaster of a fluid guard ring device in a text file.

functions.name: vfoSfDraw
functions.description: Draws the Pcell geometries using the information populated by the vfoSfInitialize function.

functions.name: vfoSfFinalize
functions.description: Performs any required cleanup.

functions.name: vfoSfInitialize
functions.description: This is the initialization function that is called during space-filling Pcell evaluation. This function initializes the slots and populates other required information for Pcell drawing (vfoSfDraw).

functions.name: vfoSfOuterEdgeCornerContRemoval
functions.description: Removes the ear-vertex and end-corner contacts from the corners of an FGR to ensure it is created with a smaller footprint. This is achieved by allowing specification of enclosure values lesser than the maximum value, but greater than the minimum value of the minOppExtension rule.

functions.name: vfoSmoothen
functions.syntax: vfoSmoothen( d_shape s_direction [ ?tmpLpp t_tmpLpp ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Smoothens the given polygon shape. If the shape is not a polygon, then the shape is returned unchanged.

functions.name: vfoSupportsAbut?
functions.description: Checks if the Abut operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsChop?
functions.description: Checks if the Chop operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsConvertToPolygon?
functions.description: Checks if the Convert to Polygon operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsCreateObstruction?
functions.description: Checks if the Create Obstruction (Tunnel) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsCreateObstructions?
functions.description: (IC6.1.8 Only) Checks if the Create Obstruction (Tunnel) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsDeleteObstruction?
functions.description: Checks if the Delete Obstruction (Heal) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsMerge?
functions.description: Checks if the Merge operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsRotation
functions.description: Checks of the Pcell instance supports rotation.

functions.name: vfoSupportsUpdateModelShape?
functions.description: Checks if the fluid shape of the given instance can be modified. This function is called by commands that directly update the fluid shape, such as Stretch, Reshape, Split, and Align.

functions.name: vfoSupportsVersionCache
functions.description: (IC6.1.8 Only) Checks whether the Version Cache Management feature is supported on the specified instance.

functions.name: vfoTransformFluidShape
functions.description: Applies the transform to the given shapeData. This function modifies the given shapeData object and returns it.

functions.name: vfoUpdateModelShape
functions.syntax: vfoUpdateModelShape(  g_obj d_instId shapeId newShapeType newPointList [ @rest l_args ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the given fluid shape of the Pcell instance. The new shape type and points are specified in the newShapeType and newPointList arguments, respectively. The newPointList points are in the design coordinates. This function transforms the newPointList before updating the fluid shape. The Edit command for fluid shapes does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfpAlignPins
functions.syntax: vfpAlignPins( t_referencePinFigNameList t_targetPinfigNameList g_topCellViewId ) => t / nil
functions.description: Aligns a list of target pins with respect to the position of a list of reference pins.

functions.name: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHier
functions.syntax: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHier( t_topLogicalLibName t_topLogicalCellName t_topLogicalViewName t_topPhysicalLibName t_topPhysicalCellName t_topPhysicalViewName t_FloorplanPropertyFileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a hierarchical floorplan. It takes the Floorplan property file and the names of the logical and physical top cell view names as inputs. The top logical lib cell view name should match the names provided in the Floorplan property file.

functions.name: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHierNoPropFile
functions.syntax: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHierNoPropFile( t_topLogicalLibName t_topLogicalCellName t_topLogicalViewName t_topPhysicalLibName t_topPhysicalCellName t_topPhysicalViewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Generates a physical configuration without a Floorplanning property file.

functions.name: vfpCPHLoadFloorplanFile
functions.syntax: vfpCPHLoadFloorplanFile( t_topLogicalLibName t_topLogicalCellName t_topLogicalViewName t_FloorplanPropertyFileName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Populates the CPH form in Soft Block mode by using the Floorplan property file.

functions.name: vfpCreateBoundaryPinsForSelectedShapes
functions.description: Creates boundary pins on selected shapes.

functions.name: vfpHiPushPreRoutesDown
functions.description: Invokes the GUI for pushing pre-routes down.

functions.name: vfpLoadPhysicalView
functions.syntax: vfpLoadPhysicalView( t_sourceLibName t_sourceCellName t_sourceViewName t_targetLibName t_targetCellName t_targetViewName ?updateInstances g_updateInstances ?loadPins s_updatePins ?addGeometries g_addGeometries  ?updateBoundaries g_updateBoundaries  ?replaceRows g_replaceRows  ?replaceBlockages g_replaceBlockages  ?replaceHalos g_replaceHalos  ?transferConstraints g_replaceHalos  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Updates the instance, pins, geometries, and P&R information from a source cell view to a target cell view. The source cell view acts as a template to perform the following in the target cell view:

functions.name: vfpPinConnectivitySetting
functions.description: This function takes no arguments. It invokes a GUI to enable the pin connectivity information setting.

functions.name: vfpPtAddPinResizeEstimator
functions.description: Register a custom SKILL function for resizing pins. This registered function is passed as a parameter to vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator to resize pins.

functions.name: vfpPtGetPinResizeEstimators
functions.description: Retrieves a list of registered pin resize estimator SKILL functions. You can specify whether the list must include only the function nicknames or both the function names and their nicknames.

functions.name: vfpPtLoadPinResizeFile
functions.description: Loads the specified SKILL file containing pin-resize functions.

functions.name: vfpPtRemovePinResizeEstimator
functions.description: Deregisters the given pin resize estimator SKILL function.

functions.name: vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator
functions.syntax: vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator( d_topCellViewID t_nickname ?mode { all | selected | specify } ?pinList l_pinList ) => t / nil
functions.description: Runs the given registered pin resize estimator SKILL function on pins as specified in the mode argument.

functions.name: vfpPushPreRoutesDown
functions.syntax: vfpPushPreRoutesDown( t_topCVLibName  t_topCVCellName  t_topCVViewName t_softBlockInstName  t_targetLibName  t_targetCellName  t_targetViewName g_pushCloseWireBlkg g_rebindInst [ g_pushOverlappingBlockages ] [ g_pushPowerNetGeometry ] [ g_pushRegularNetGeometry ] [ g_pushRow ] [ g_pushWSP ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Pushes the top level power-structures of a cell view topCVLibName:topCVCellName: topCVViewName over soft block instance softBlockInstName into target cell view targetLibName:targetCellName:targetViewName.

functions.name: vfpReportIOPadLocation
functions.description: Prints the IO pad information in formatted manner for all the pads which are placed in the IO rows within the design.

functions.name: vfpSbDefineObstruction
functions.syntax: vfpSbDefineObstruction( l_PhysLCV t_obstructionType [ ?topOffset  n_topOffset ] [ ?bottomOffset n_BottomOffset ] [ ?leftOffset n_LeftOffset ] [ ?rightOffset n_RightOffset ] [ ?layerName t_layerName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates placement, routing, or other obstructions based on the obstructionType argument. All conditions that are enforced for these obstructions through GUI-based flow are applicable here. For example, only one placement blockage would be applied per soft block. If a second placement blockage is applied through this API, a warning is issued. The latest applied placement blockage will not replace the existing placement blockage.

functions.name: vfpSbDeleteObstruction
functions.syntax: vfpSbDeleteObstruction( l_PhysLCV t_obstructionType [ ?topOffset  n_topOffset ] [ ?bottomOffset n_BottomOffset ] [ ?leftOffset n_LeftOffset ] [ ?rightOffset  n_RightOffset ] [ ?layerName t_layerName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified obstruction.

functions.name: vfpSbEditIOPin
functions.syntax: vfpSbEditIOPin( l_PhysLCV t_termName [ ?lpp txl_lpp ] [ ?width n_width ] [ ?height n_height ] [ ?number x_number ] [ ?criticality x_criticality ] [ ?sigType t_sigType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Edits attributes of the pin that is associated with the specified termName.

functions.name: vfpSbEditSoftBlockType
functions.description: Edits the blockType of the specified soft block.

functions.name: vfpSbSetPolygonalBoundary
functions.syntax: vfpSbSetPolygonalBoundary( l_PhysLCV l_ listOfPolygonPoints ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the boundary attributes of soft blocks that are polygonal in shape.

functions.name: vfpSbSetRectangularBoundary
functions.syntax: vfpSbSetRectangularBoundary( l_PhysLCV n_width n_height ) => t  / nil
functions.description: Specifies the boundary vertices of the rectangular soft block.

functions.name: viaFindTransitions
functions.syntax: viaFindTransitions( t_constraintGroupSetup t_topLayerName t_bottomLayerName )  => l_viaTransitionsObject / nil
functions.description: Returns the list of transitions of the given constraint group setup object found between the specified top and bottom layers.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasAtPoint
functions.syntax: viaGenerateViasAtPoint( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_point t_viaOptionsObject [ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias with the specified options at a given location in the specified window or cellview.The figures present at the given location are queried, and if they form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasFromShapes
functions.syntax: viaGenerateViasFromShapes( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_shapes t_viaOptionsObject [ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias from the specified shapes with the given via options in the specified window or cellview. If the specified shapes form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the shapes.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasInArea
functions.syntax: viaGenerateViasInArea( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_ptArray t_viaOptionsObject [ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ] [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias with the specified options within a given area in the specified window or cellview. The figures present at the given location are queried, and if they form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaGetViaOptions
functions.description: Returns a via options object from the specified constraint group. This via options object can be used by any SKILL procedre enabling generation or recomputation of vias.

functions.name: viaLoadViaVariants
functions.description: Loads the via variants from the specified cellview for the Create Via command.

functions.name: viaRecomputeVias
functions.syntax: viaRecomputeVias( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_via t_viaOptionsObject [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Recomputes the via list with the given via options in the specified window or cellview. The figures connected by the vias are searched and the vias are recomputed with the via options specified to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaRecomputeViasAtPoint
functions.syntax: viaRecomputeViasAtPoint( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_point t_viaOptionsObject [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Recomputes vias with the specified options at a given location in the specified window or cellview. The vias present at the given location are queried along with the figures connected by the vias. The vias are then recomputed with the via options specified to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaRecomputeViasInArea
functions.syntax: viaRecomputeViasInArea( w_windowId | d_cellViewId l_ptArray t_viaOptionsObject [ ?startLevel x_startLevel ] [ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ] )  => l_via / nil
functions.description: Recomputes vias with the specified options within a given area in the specified window or cellview. The vias present at the given location are queried along with the figures connected by the vias. The vias are then recomputed with the via options specified to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaRegisterCreateViaInitCallback
functions.description: Registers the function to be called each time the Create Via form is opened. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure and the init procedure that is registered should be defined without arguments.

functions.name: viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called after the viaEngine processing. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure. The postViaEngine procedure that is registered should be declared with one argument, the viaEngineContext. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback function that is registered should be declared with the viaEngineContext argument. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The function returns t or nil. If nil is returned by the viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback function registered, vias are not created.

functions.name: viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called before the viaEngine processing. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure. The preViaEngine procedure that is registered should be declared with one argument, viaEngineContext. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback function that is registered should be declared with the viaEngineContext argument. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The function returns t or nil. If nil is returned by the viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback function registered, vias are not created.

functions.name: viaSaveViaVariants
functions.description: Saves the via variants from the Create Via command into the specified cellview.

functions.name: viaSetDefaultCutClasses
functions.syntax: viaSetDefaultCutClasses( t_techLibName [ t_constraintGroupName ] ((bottomLayer topLayer cutClass) ...) [ g_reset ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default cut classes to be used for each layer.

functions.name: viaSetDefaultValidViaDefs
functions.syntax: viaSetDefaultValidViaDefs( t_techLibName t_constraintGroupName l_viaDef [ g_reset ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default vias to be used by Wire Edit and Create Via commands from the list of valid vias of the specified constraint group.

functions.name: viaUnregisterCreateViaInitCallback
functions.description: Unregisters the createVia initialization procedure if it has been registered. If it has not been registered, this function does nothing.

functions.name: viaUnregisterPostViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Unregisters the postViaEngine procedure if it has been registered. If it has not been registered, this function does nothing.

functions.name: viaUnregisterPreViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Unregisters the preViaEngine procedure if it has been registered. If it has not been registered, this function does nothing.

functions.name: vpaOptimizePins
functions.syntax: vpaOptimizePins( ?cv d_cellViewId ?layoutLCV l_LCVName [ ?cphId g_cphId ] [ ?selectedOnly g_selectedOnly ] [ ?spacingType t_spacingType ] [ ?spacingValue n_spacingValue ] [ ?targetPinSide l_targetPinSides ] [ ?enableCongestion g_enableCongestion ] [ ?congestionValue n_congestionValue ] ) => t / nil / List of (sbId lib:cell:view status)
functions.description: Runs pin optimization on the specified cellview or design based on the options you specify. You can specify only those parameters that you want to control. The parameters that you do not specify get their values from the corresponding LayoutXL environment variable.

functions.name: vsrDeletePreset
functions.syntax: vsrDeletePreset( t_fileName [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?path t_path ] [ ?confirmation g_confirmation ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a preset file.

functions.name: vsrLoadPreset
functions.syntax: vsrLoadPreset( t_fileName [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?execMode s_execMode ] [ ?path t_path ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a preset file to the Wire Assistant form and the Virtuoso Space-based Router Options form.

functions.name: vsrSavePreset
functions.syntax: vsrSavePreset( t_PresetLabel t_fileName [ ?directory t_directory ] [ ?path t_path ] [ ?tooltip t_tooltip ] [ ?description t_description ] [ ?iconFileName t_iconFileName ] [ ?iconText t_iconText ] [ ?location s_location ] [ ?mode s_mode ] [ ?envGroups l_envGroups ] ) ; => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the current settings to a preset file for later re-use.

functions.name: weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem
functions.syntax: weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem t_name t_customTransition [ t_bindkey ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a menu item to the context-sensitive menu of the Create Bus command. You can use the added menu item to call the customer SKILL API. A bindkey is also assigned to the menu item.

functions.name: weCWHoldWidth
functions.description: This function is used for the create wire command when smart snapping is active. The width that is highlighted by smart snapping is used by the next wire that is being created even if the wire is created at another position than the current one.

functions.name: weCycleCutColorVia
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Cycles color of each cut when a via is inserted.

functions.name: weGatherBusWires
functions.description: This function is used when the leHiCreateBus command is running. If the gap between the bus wires does not match the minSpacing rule, then the wires are gathered at the minimum spacing. If the wires are already at minSpacing, they will be spread to use the initial gap, which is the gap before executing the weGatherBusWires function.

functions.name: weGetCustomTransitionMenuItems
functions.description: Returns a list of custom transitions that were added to the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

functions.name: weGetPathSegWidth
functions.description: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal path segments when their width is being queried. Unlike dbGetPathSegWidth which returns the value stored in the OpenAccess database for the width of diagonal pathSegs, this API does the sqrt(2) conversion appropriately and return the width value as it appears in the property editor form or object inspector assistant.

functions.name: weHiEditBus
functions.description: Starts the Edit - Wiring - Bus command in Layout XL and higher tiers. The command lets you edit the width and spacing of bus bits. If no window ID is specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: weHiWireTo45
functions.description: Starts the interactive command that lets you select wire corners to create chamfering.

functions.name: weRemoveCustomTransitionMenuItem
functions.description: Removes a custom transition menu item from the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

functions.name: weScaleMagnifierOrDecreaseWidth
functions.description: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom out in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, decrease the width of the current wire.

functions.name: weScaleMagnifierOrIncreaseWidth
functions.description: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, increase the width of the current wire.

functions.name: weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment
functions.description: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment SKILL API scroll down the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

functions.name: weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment
functions.description: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment SKILL API scrolls up the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

functions.name: weSetPathSegWidth
functions.syntax: weSetPathSegWidth(  [ g_pathSegId ]  float value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal pathseg when the width is being changed. In addition, it also supports diagonal pathseg with custom extension and appropriately updates the values when the width is being changed.

functions.name: wspCheckActive
functions.syntax: wspCheckActive( d_cellviewId  t_layerName | ?shapes g_selSetId  [ ?region l_bBox ]  [ ?purpose t_purposeName ]  [ ?hilightSet g_hlSetId ]  [ ?markers g_markers [ ?vioLimit g_limit ] ]  [ ?checkColor g_checkColor ]  [ ?checkWidth g_checkWidth ]  [ ?checkWireType g_checkWireType ]  [ ?depth x_depth ]  [ ?mergeShapes g_mergeShapes [ ?ignoreColorOnMerge g_ignoreColor ] ]  [ ?mergePurposes l_mergePurposes ] [ ?returnVioShapes g_returnVioShapes ] ) => t / l_dbID / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Checks shapes for width, color, and wireType conformance to the active width spacing pattern (WSP) on the specified layer or in the specified set. The active WSP can be for the global grid or a pattern region.

functions.name: wspCreateWSP
functions.syntax: wspCreateWSP ( d_cellViewId  t_name  [ ?offset n_offset ]  [ ?repeatOffset g_repeatOffset ]  [ ?shiftColor g_shiftColor ]  [ ?allowedRepeatMode t_allowedRepeatMode ] [ ?defaultRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatMode ] [ ?wsspDef t_wsspDefName ] n_width n_space [ repeat n_repeats ] [ wireType t_wireType ] [ color n_mask ] [ displayPacket t_displayPacket ] ) => d_wspId
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates a WSP in the specified cellview. If the WSP already exists, it is replaced. This function creates simple WSPs and not nested lists. It checks the shapes for width, color, and wire type conformance to the active width spacing pattern (WSP) on the specified layer or set. The active WSP can be for the global grid or a pattern region.

functions.name: wspCreateWSPByAttr
functions.syntax: wspCreateWSPByAttr ( d_cellViewId  list (nil 	'name t_name 	'offset n_offset 	'shiftColor g_shiftColor 	'repeatOffset g_repeatOffset 	'allowedRepeatMode t_allowedRepeatMode 	'defaultRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatMode 	tracks  ( list(nil 			'width n_width 			'space n_space 			[ 'wireType t_wireType ] 			[ 'color t_color ] 			[ 'displayPacket t_displayPacket ] 			 ) ) ) => d_wspId
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates a WSP. The pattern attributes are specified as a DPL. This function is specified with the wspGetFlatAttr function, which returns an existing pattern as a DPL. It lets you convert the existing patterns to a DPL, modify them, and recreate them.

functions.name: wspCreateWSPGroup
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates a WSP group in the specified cellview. The argument after t_name are interpreted as group members.

functions.name: wspCreateWSSPDef
functions.syntax: wspCreateWSSPDef ( d_cellViewId  t_name tx_layer t_direction n_period [ ?defaultActive t_defaultActive ] [ ?allowedPatterns l_patterns ] [ ?allowedPatternGroups l_groups ] [ ?defPurpose tx_purpose ] [ ?offset n_offset ] [ ?orthogonalGrid t_orthogonalGrid] )  => d_wsspDefId
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates a WSSPDef in the specified cellview. If t_defaultActive is specified, the WSSPDef is created immediately. If it is not specified, the creation of WSSPDef is deferred until the first call to the function wspCreateWSP that references this WSSPDef. This enables all WSSPDefs to be specified first, followed by calls to wspCreateWSP that reference the WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspCreateWSSPDefByAttr
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates a WSSPDef using an attribute DPL.

functions.name: wspDeleteCellViewAllWSPData
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Deletes all the WSP data from the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspDeleteMetalFill
functions.syntax: wspDeleteMetalFill ( t_LayerName ?removeTrim g_removeTrim ?removePatch g_removePatch ?removePassive g_removePassive )  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Deletes the shapes created by the wspMetalFillTrim() function.

functions.name: wspDumpToFile
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates a SKILL file that can be used to recreate the WSP information in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspMetalFillTrim
functions.syntax: wspMetalFillTrim ( d_cellViewId  t_LayerName ?region l_region ?passivePurpose t_passiveFillPurpose ?patchFillPurpose t_patchFillPurpose ?gapFillPurpose t_gapFillPurpose ?lockColor g_lockColor ?boundaryCut g_boundaryCut ?forceBoundaryCut g_forceBoundaryCut ?insertFillOnly g_insertFillOnly ?insertTrimOnly g_insertTrimOnly ?allowTrimWithError g_allowTrimWithError ?horizontal t_horizontal ?snapToOrthGrid t_snapToOrthGrid ?ctrlFile t_ctrlFileName )  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Fills metal shapes based on WSP tracks and inserts trim shapes as needed.

functions.name: wspRegionFindByLayer
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of the WSP region IDs for the specified routing layer name in a cellview.

functions.name: wspRegionFindByWSSPDef
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of region IDs in the specified cellview for a WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspRegionGetActivePattern
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the name of the active pattern for a WSP region.

functions.name: wspRegionGetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of names of allowed pattern groups for the specified WSP region.

functions.name: wspRegionGetAllowedPatterns
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list with the names of the allowed patterns for a WSP region. By default, this function returns the effective set of patterns by combining the allowed patterns and allowed pattern groups. You can use the g_excludeGroups argument to ignore the allowed pattern groups.

functions.name: wspRegionGetWSSPDef
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the ID of the WSSPDef to which the specified region is bound.

functions.name: wspSPDefFind
functions.syntax: wspSPDefFind ( d_cellViewId  t_layerName  [ ?enabledOnly g_enabledOnly ] )  => l_spdef / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Finds all the snapPatternDefs (SPDefs) that apply to the specified routing layer name. In a cellview, one SPDef or WSSPDef per layer is enabled as a global grid. With the optional argument g_enabledOnly set to t, WSSPDefs that are enabled as global for the specified routing layer are returned.

functions.name: wspSetWSSPDefRegionPurpose
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Overrides the region purpose attribute for the specified WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSPFindByName
functions.syntax: wspWSPFindByName ( d_cellViewId  t_wspname  [ cellViewOnly g_cellViewOnly ] )  => d_wspId
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Finds a WSP by name in a cellview or in the technology database.

functions.name: wspWSPGetFlatAttr
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Return the attributes of a WSP as a DPL.

functions.name: wspWSPGroupFindByName
functions.syntax: wspWSPGroupFindByName ( d_cellViewId  t_wspname  [ cellViewOnly g_cellViewOnly ] )  => d_wspGroupId
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Finds a WSP group by its name in a cellview or in the technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatternGroups
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatternGroups(	 d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName  t_patternGroupName ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Adds a WSP group to the list of allowed pattern groups for a WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatterns
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatterns( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName  t_patternName ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Adds a WSP to the allowed patterns for a WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToEnabled
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Adds a list of WSSPDefs to the list of WSSPDefs enabled as global grids in the specified cellview. This will filter out any duplicate, undefined wsspDefs, and wsspDefs with direction mis-match.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefClearEnabledOverrides
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Removes any global grid overrides from the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefFind
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of WSSPDefs that apply to a given routing layer name. The WSSPDefs may exist in the cellview or in the technology database. In a cellview, one WSSPDef per layer is enabled as a global grid. With the optional argument g_enabledOnly set to t, WSSPDefs that are enabled as global for the given routing layer are returned.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefFindByName
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Finds a WSSPDef by its name in a cellview or technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetActivePattern
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the active pattern name for a WSSPDef in the specified cellview. The active pattern may be set by a constraint in the cellview or from the WSSPDef in the cellview or technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list with the names of the allowed pattern groups for the specified WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAllowedPatterns
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of names of allowed WSPs for a given WSSPDef in the specified cellview. A WSSPDef has a list of allowed patterns and allowed pattern groups. The effective set of allowed patterns is a combination of the allowed WSPs and a WSP that is a member of an allowed pattern group. By default, this function returns the effective set of allowed patterns. You can use the g_excludeGroups argument to get only the directly allowed WSPs.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAttr
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) The attributes of the specified WSSPDef are converted to a DPL format. All the of attribute representations are the same as the source representation, except the snappingLayers attribute, which is stored as an association table for LPP look up.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetEnabledOverrides
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns the names of all the WSSPDefs in the specified direction that are enabled as global grids. The WSSPDef direction is orthogonal to the routing direction. This filters out any duplicates, undefined wsspDefs, and wsspDefs with a direction mis-match.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatternGroups
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatternGroups( d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_patternGroupName ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Removes a pattern group from the allowed pattern groups of a WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatterns
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatterns(	 d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_patternName  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Removes a WSP from the allowed patterns of the specified cellview. This function only removes the directly-allowed WSP. If a pattern is allowed because it is a member of an allowed pattern group, then no update is made.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromEnabled
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Removes the specified WSSPDefs from the list of WSSPDefs that are enabled as global grids in the cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRename
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Renames a WSSPDef by deleting and recreating it. So, the DB ID may change. This function updates the global grid and any regions that reference the WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetActivePattern
functions.syntax: wspWSSPDefSetActivePattern( d_cellViewId  t_wsspDefName t_defaultActiveName ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the default active WSP for a WSSPDef in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatternGroups

functions.name: bottomEdge
