functions.name: ccBendConnector
functions.syntax: ccBendConnector( l_port n_radius n_bangle  n_rmin n_gamma )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a bend connector making a circular turn from the specified starting port with the radius, bend angle, and gamma fraction given in ccWaypointConnector. The connector consists of a central circular arc and two apex clothoids matching its curvature at one end and with zero curvature at the other end. Gamma is the ratio of the circular bend angle to the total bend angle.

functions.name: ccConvertIntoCurvy
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a new ccShape to which the specified database figure is attached.

functions.name: ccCreateCurve
functions.syntax: ccCreateCurve( t_x t_y l_interval )  => o_curve / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a ccCurve object using the specified parametric functions and interval.

functions.name: ccCreateFacet
functions.syntax: ccCreateFacet( l_origin [ ?angle n_angle ] [ ?radius n_radius ] [ ?offsets l_offsets ] [ ?name t_name ] ) => o_facet / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a ccFacet object. A facet is a special type of straight segment that is specified by the origin point, offsets, curvature, and rotation angle. It can be used to implement a smooth stitching between two ccShape objects.

functions.name: ccCreateLine
functions.syntax: ccCreateLine( d_cellViewId l_lpp g_origin ) => o_line / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a ccLine object at the specified layer-purpose pair of the given cellview from either a ccPolyCurve or a list of polyCurve segments forming a polyCurve of class G2. If the resulting polyCurve is not of class G2, the function terminates with an error.

functions.name: ccCreatePath
functions.syntax: ccCreatePath( d_cellviewId l_lpp l_segments [?defaultWidth g_defWidth]  [?smoothness   S_smoothness] )  => o_path / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a ccPath object on the specified layer-purpose pair from one or a list of path segments.

functions.name: ccCreatePie
functions.syntax: ccCreatePie( d_cellviewId l_lpp  [ ?angle n_angle ]  [ ?startRadius n_startRadius ] [ ?length n_length ] [ ?endWidth n_endWidth ] [ ?endLength n_endLength ] [ ?offset l_offset ] [ ?rotation n_rotation ] [ ?genFigs { t | nil } ] )  => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a pie slice figure bounded by outer circle and optionally by an inner circle, two radiuses at given angles, and optionally by an outer capping of given length. The function generates different figures based on the input as follows:        When the startRadius is nil, the pie shape that is generated is a true pie shape, with the      length being the radius.        When the startRadius is larger than 0.0, a donut shape is generated, with the inner part      radius determined by the value, while the length is used to represent the thickness of the      donut.        When endWidth is specified, a termination is generated, caping the coupler by a shape      that is conceptually the union of a rectangle and the last pie shape, with the inner-curved      radius as specified. In this case, endWidth must be smaller than the arc defined by sum      of radius and length and larger than the arc from radius.   If rotation or offset is specified, the resulting the object undergoes corresponding transformation.

functions.name: ccCreatePolyCurve
functions.syntax: ccCreatePolyCurve( l_segments [ ?close { t | nil } ] [ ?smoothness S_smoothness ] )  => o_polyCurve / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a ccPolyCurve object from a list of specified polyCurve segments.

functions.name: ccCreateRect
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a rectangle with the specified coordinates as a closed polyCurve.

functions.name: ccCreateSurface
functions.syntax: ccCreateSurface( d_cellViewId l_lpp o_boundary [ l_holes ]  )  => o_surface / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a ccSurface object on the specified layer-purpose pair from the specified boundary, which is ccPolyCurve with positive area and a list of holes, which are ccPolyCurve objects with negative areas.

functions.name: ccCurveConnector
functions.syntax: ccCurveConnector( l_port1 l_port2 n_rmin [ ?method x_method ] [ ?parameters l_parameters ] )  => l_connector | nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a curve connector with two specified ports and a minimum curvature radius. Depending on the input, the connector consists of different combinations of line, circle, and clothoid curve segments.

functions.name: ccFindSurfaceFacet
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Searches for a facet with the specified name on the given surface.

functions.syntax: ccGenFigs( o_shape [ ?attach { t | nil } ] [ ?snapToMFG { t | nil } ]  [ ?accuracy { n_accuracy | nil } ] ) => l_figs / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Generates geometry for the specified ccShape and optionally attaches it to the originating ccShape.

functions.name: ccGetAll

functions.name: ccGetFromFig
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns the ccShape attached to the given database figure.

functions.name: ccGetPathBoundary
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns the ccBoundary of the specified ccPath.

functions.name: ccGetPathCenterLine
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns the center line of the path as an open ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccGetPathEdge
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a new ccPolyCurve that is either the left or the right edge of the boundary of the specified path.

functions.name: ccIsEnabled
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Checks if the CurvyCore engine is enabled.

functions.name: ccIsLinearCurve
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Checks if the given ccCurve is linear.

functions.name: ccLayerAnd
functions.syntax: ccLayerAnd( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived from the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 that overlap areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes1.

functions.name: ccLayerAndNot
functions.syntax: ccLayerAndNot( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived from the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 that do not overlap any areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes2.

functions.name: ccLayerOr
functions.syntax: ccLayerOr( g_shapes1 g_shapes2 [ ?cellView d_cellViewId ] [ ?lpp l_lpp ] )  => l_surface / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a list of new surface shapes derived by combining the areas of shapes of the first input argument g_shapes1 and the areas of shapes of the second input argument g_shapes2.

functions.name: ccMirrorFacet
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a mirrored or reversed copy of the given ccFacet. If the facet is viewed as a segment, it reverses the direction, which mean that it goes from the end of the original facet to its beginning. However, this function also updates the radius attribute in such a way that two G2-connected paths have mirrored facets at the connection point.

functions.name: ccRemoveFigs
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Removes the database figures attached to the given ccShape.

functions.name: ccReversePolyCurve
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a reversed copy of the given polyCurve, which is the polyCurve with the same geometry but in the opposite direction, which is from the end of the original polyCurve to its beginning.   This function can be used to turn positive-closed polyCurves into negative polyCurves, and negative-closed polyCurves into positive polyCurves.

functions.name: ccSmoothenFig
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns the result of smoothening of the specified ccShape as a new transient ccSurface.

functions.name: ccSmoothenPolyCurve
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a smoothened copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccSpiralConnector
functions.syntax: ccSpiralConnector( n_lengthInnerSpiral0 n_lengthOuterSpiral1 x_numberOfTurns n_minRadius n_gamma  ) => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a spiral connector that consists of an inner S-shaped figure of two joined circular bend connectors. Each endpoint of S is prolonged by a straight extension and then by N-turnings of a spiral circling around S.

functions.name: ccTransformFacet
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccFacet.

functions.name: ccTransformPolyCurve
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccTromboneConnector
functions.syntax: ccTromboneConnector( l_legs  n_rmin n_gamma  )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a trombone-shaped connector that consists of five legs of given lengths, smoothly connected by waypoint connectors with the given gamma ratio and the minimum curvature radius.

functions.name: ccWaypointConnector
functions.syntax: ccWaypointConnector( l_port1    l_port2    l_points   n_rmin n_gamma    )  => l_connector / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Creates a waypoint connector between the specified points with the given minimum curvature radius and the given portion (gamma) of the circular bending angle in the overall bending angle.  If both ports are nil, then at least three waypoints must be specified as input. The connector starts at the first waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the first two waypoints and ends at the last waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the last two waypoints.  If both ports are not nil, specify the initial and the final points, tangents, and radiuses of the connector.   If no waypoints are specified, the start point and the end point are connected by a curve connector.   If a single waypoint is specified, it is connected to the start and the end point by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoint.   If two waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other with a straight line and to the start and the end point with a pair of curve connectors with zero curvatures at the waypoints.   If three or more waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other by a waypoint connector like in the case where both ports are nil and to the start and the end point by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoints.  It is an error to only specify one port as nil and the other port as not nil.  The waypoint connector consists of a sequence of lines, circles, and clothoids. If the calculation of the waypoint connector can only be partially completed, then the result will only contain segments between the starting point and the point where the calculation failed.

functions.description: Renames a specified gdmSpec object representing a cellview. The source object is deleted after a copy is created. When you copy a directory containing the cellview, all files in the directory are copied, regardless of whether they are co-managed or not.

Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, the ccpSetAutoRename function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

functions.name: ccpRegMonitor
functions.description: Registers the copy monitor that you create. A copy monitor is a program that displays the progress of the copy command while it is being executed. For an example of a copy monitor, see the copy monitor used in the Library Manager's Copy Wizard.

functions.name: ccpRegTrigger
functions.syntax: ccpRegTrigger( t_copyPhaseStr s_triggerFunction [ g_canEditList ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers the copy trigger that you create. The copy trigger is called in the copy phase that you specify.

functions.name: ccpRemoveTrigger
functions.description: Removes the registered copy trigger function from the copy phase you specify.

functions.syntax: ccpRenameReferenceLib( G_fromLib G_toLib q_updateList [ s_whatCanChange ] [ g_existenceCheck ] [ g_reReferenceCustomVias ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Renames, in a library or a subset of a library, references to an external library. The external library is not changed.

functions.name: ccpSetAutoRename
functions.description: Sets the status of the auto rename feature to on or off. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, this function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

functions.name: centerBox
functions.description: Returns the center point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and is assumed to be correct.

functions.name: changeEnterFun
functions.syntax: changeEnterFun( s_enterFun  [ ?prompts l_promptList ]  [ ?points l_pointList ]  [ ?wantPoints x_pointLimit ] [ ?form s_form ]  [ ?addPointProc t_addProcName ]  [ ?delPointProc t_delProcName ]  [ ?initProc t_initProcName ]  [ ?doneProc t_doneProcName ] [ ?formProc t_formProcName ] [ ?pathStyle t_pathStyle ] [ ?cursor x_cursor ] [ ?pathWidth f_pathWidth ] [ ?beginExtent f_beginExtent ] [ ?endExtent f_endExtent ]  [ ?dontDraw g_dontDraw ] [ ?alwaysMap g_alwaysMap ] [ ?acceptString g_acceptString ] [ ?acceptNumber g_acceptNumber ] [ ?noInfix g_noInfix ] [ ?cmdName t_cmdName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Since this function uses the current window to determine which enterfunction to change, make sure to properly set the current window before using this function. See hiSetCurrentWindow for information about setting the current window.

functions.name: changeNextEnterFun
functions.description: If an enterfunction is currently active, sets a flag that causes the next enterfunction invocation for the current window or a specified window to use the changeEnterFun logic rather than being nested.

functions.name: ciwAddTranslatorItem

functions.description: Adds an entry for the Import or Export commands.

functions.name: ciwCreateMenu
functions.description: Creates a menu from the given menu definition. The menu created can be used as a pop-up menu. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwCreatePulldown
functions.description: Creates a pulldown menu from the given menu definition. The ls_menuDef argument can either be a list defining the contents of a pulldown menu or the SKILL symbol that represents the list. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwHiExit
functions.description: Exits the session.

functions.name: ciwMenuInit
functions.description: Initializes and installs the CIW pulldown menus based on the menu files found in the hierarchy. This function will be called instead of hiInstallCIWMenus. It can also be called from the CIW to debug the menu file contents.  If g_reset is specified as t, the CIW menus are reset. Calling ciwMenuInit without any arguments will initialize the CIW menus only if it has not already been done.

functions.name: ciwMenuInstall
functions.description: Creates and installs into r_window a menu banner based on ls_bannerDef. Useful for applications that create and manage their own windows. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwMenuLoadFile
functions.description: Reads menu files found in the DFII hierarchy using t_appName.

functions.name: ciwRemoveTranslatorItem
functions.syntax: ciwRemoveTranslatorItem( s_tag t_itemText t_callback ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes an entry from the Import or Export commands.

functions.name: clearAllEnterFunctions
functions.description: Cancels all nested enterfunctions associated with the current window.

functions.name: colorIndex
functions.description: Returns the pixel value for the colormap index of the specified RGB value. This function is an alias for hiMatchColor.

functions.name: dagAddActionToObject
functions.description: Adds the action to the specified dag node or class. However, if the action is already in the list, it is not replaced. For an existing action, use dagDeleteActionFromObject to delete the action and then call dagAddActionToObject.

functions.name: dagCreateClass
functions.description: Creates a dagClass and returns it. If a class by this name already exists, it is overwritten.

functions.name: dagCreateNode
functions.description: Creates a dagNode and returns it.

functions.name: dagDeleteActionFromObject
functions.description: Deletes the action named t_actionName from the specified class or node. If a node's action was inherited from its class, the action must be deleted from the class, not the node.

functions.name: dagDestroyNode
functions.description: Destroys a dagNode. All descendant nodes and arcs of this node are also destroyed, as well as the arcs linking this node to its parents.

functions.name: dagDisplayTool
functions.description: Redisplays a dagTool. You can use this function if you want to re-display all of the objects in the graph rather than calling dagRefreshObject for each one.

functions.name: dagGetCurrentObject
functions.description: Often, when writing action procedures or SKILL objects, you need to know the node for which the action was selected. dagGetCurrentObject does this. It takes no arguments and returns the current node, or nil.

functions.name: dagGetCurrentTool
functions.description: Returns the current dagTool, and nil if there is not a current dagTool. The current dagTool is different from the current window. The current tool might not be the current window.

functions.name: dagLinkParentToChild
functions.description: Creates a dagArc that links the parent node to the child node. It returns the arc it creates. If an error occurs, it returns nil.

functions.name: dagNumToTool
functions.description: Returns the dagtool that matches the window number specified by x_toolNumber.

functions.name: dagOpenTool
functions.syntax: dagOpenTool( x_backGroundColor l_bBox w_startingObject t_name t_help )  => w_dagTool / nil
functions.description: Creates a dagTool object and opens a window in which to display the graph starting from the specified starting node.

functions.name: dagPopTool
functions.description: Pops the tool stack (specified by the w_dagTool argument).

functions.name: dagPushTool
functions.description: Pushes a new starting object (specified by the w_newStartingNode argument) onto the stack of the tool (specified by w_dagTool).

functions.name: dagRefreshObject
functions.description: Redraws the node (specified by w_dagNode) in all the tools it is currentlydisplayed in.

functions.name: dagSetActionStatus
functions.syntax: dagSetActionStatus( t_actionName w_dagObject g_status  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the status of the specified action in the action list of the class or node. An action that has been turned off is grayed-out in the pop-up menu and not available through its action accelerator, if any.

functions.name: dagSetCurrentTool
functions.description: Sets the current dagTool to the one specified by the w_dagTool argument.

functions.name: dagSetExpandedActionStatus
functions.syntax: dagSetExpandedActionStatus( t_actionName w_dagObject g_status ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the status of the specified action in the expanded-action list of a node. Setting the status to nil makes the action name appear gray in the pop-up menu and makes the action accelerator unavailable. Once a dagNode has been placed into a tool, the actions from the dagClass are concatenated to make a full list of actions for this node. This is known as the expanded-action list.

functions.name: dagSetFont
functions.description: Modifies the font used in text mode in any dag tool.

functions.name: dagUnlinkParentFromChild
functions.description: Unlinks a parent node from a child node. It takes, as its only argument, the dagArc that connects the parent to the child. The arc is destroyed; however, neither the parent node nor the child node is destroyed. This can be useful if you want to change the parent of a node.

functions.name: dataTrigger
functions.description: The data trigger is called after the DE has collected and verified all of the trigger arguments, checked for the proper application registration, and opened or validated a window for the design.

functions.name: dbAbutIsInteractive
functions.description: This function is used by user-defined abutment functions. It indicates if the call to the abutment function was triggered by an interactive action.

functions.name: dbAbutIsReAbutGroup
functions.description: When called during abutment event 3 (un-abutment), the SKILL function indicates if re-abutment of Pcell instances will be triggered immediately after un-abutment. If the SKILL function returns true, the PDK SKILL function can store relevant information, if needed, from the current abutment group.

functions.name: dbAddAreaToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Adds an area boundary to the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddFigToFigGroup
functions.description: Adds a figure to the specified figGroup.

functions.name: dbAddFigToNet
functions.description: Assigns the given figure object to a specified net object. If the figure is already associated with a different net, the figure will be detached from that net before being assigned to the given net object.

functions.name: dbAddFigToPin
functions.description: Adds the specified figure to the given pin.

functions.name: dbAddFigToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function adds a via or a non-text shape to the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddFigsToPin
functions.description: Adds a list of figures to the given pin.

functions.name: dbAddObjectToGroup
functions.description: Adds a database object to a group.

functions.name: dbAddObjectsToMarker
functions.description: Adds a list of objects to a specified marker.

functions.name: dbAddPinToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function adds a pin to the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaBackgroundDef
functions.description: Adds a reference to the specified placeArea object in the given backgroundDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified placeArea to the specified compTypeSetDefs. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaRailDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified placeArea to the specified railDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects specified are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowBackgroundDef
functions.description: Adds a reference to the specified row object in the given backgroundDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified compTypeSetDef to the specified row object. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowRailDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified railDef to the specified row object. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddStrapObject
functions.description: Adds a database object to a specified strap pattern. The object must be of the type InstTerm, Via, or Shape. The object must be in the same database as the strap.

functions.name: dbAllCellViews
functions.syntax: dbAllCellViews(  g_lib  t_cellName  [ d_contextCellView ]  )  => l_viewName / nil
functions.description: Lists all the view names of a cell.

functions.name: dbAreaBoundaryHasLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating that the layerPriorityOrder constraints set on the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbAreaBoundaryHasValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating that the validRoutingLayers constraint is set on the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbAttachRowRegionToPRBoundary
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Associates the given rowRegion with the PRBoundary in the same block. If the PRBoundary is assigned to another rowRegion, it is first detached from that region before being assigned to the specified rowRegion.

functions.name: dbBoundaryQuery
functions.syntax: dbBoundaryQuery( d_cellviewId l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_boundary / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the boundaries in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbCVHasInheritedSig
functions.description: Checks if there is any inherited signal in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCVHasInheritedTerm
functions.description: Checks whether there is any inherited terminal in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCVHasNetSetProp
functions.description: Determines if the netSet property is set on a cellview.

functions.name: dbCanonicalizeAnyAngleTransform
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Canonicalizes composition of the given transformations into a pair of orientation angles and a non-negative acute angle. Transformations are either numbers representing counter-clockwise rotation in degrees or strings representing orientation. The effect of transformation by the composition of the transformations in the return value is the same as effect of transformation by the composition of all input transformations.

functions.name: dbCellViewAreLayerShiftsValid
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a Boolean depending on whether the layer shift information on the instances in the specified cellview is synchronized with the layers and color information in the bound tech. This function is currently intended only for the advanced nodes release.

functions.name: dbCellViewClearLayerShifts
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Clears the layer shift information from all instances in the specified cellview. Any cached layer shift specification for the tech bound to the cellview is left intact.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Checks whether the equivalent connectivity time is set on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasLayerShifts
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a Boolean indicating whether there is layer shift information on any instance in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasOpticalData
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview has optical data.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasPhotonicPinFig
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Checks whether the specified cellview has a photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges
functions.syntax: dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges(  d_cellViewId  [ g_shapes g_vias g_HCLs ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Checks whether any edits were done to the specified type of objects in the older versions of Virtuoso after color lock type information was set for some of them.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasVirtHier
functions.description: Determines whether the specified cellview contains virtual hierarchy data.

functions.name: dbCellViewInitForLayerShifting
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Initializes the layer shift data for the given cell.

functions.name: dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes
functions.syntax: dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes(  d_cellViewId t_value  [g_shapes g_vias g_HCLs] )  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Changes color lock type for all color-locked objects of the specified object types to the given value.

functions.name: dbCellViewUpdateLayerShifts
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates or rebuilds the layer shift specification cache with the layers that are in the tech bound to the specified cellview. As a result, the per-layer shift information on the instances in the cellview is removed.

functions.name: dbChangeGroupType
functions.description: Changes the type of a group.

functions.name: dbCheckParamCell
functions.description: Checks if the specified cellview is a valid parameterized cell. If there was an error during the reading, binding, or evaluation of the specified cellview, a description of the error is returned.

functions.name: dbCheckRecursion
functions.description: Checks for occurrence of the given top cellview in the hierarchy of the instHeader masters or any other recursion inside the instHeader master's hierarchy.

functions.name: dbClearAllActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Clears all the active wire type specifications on the design and for the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef. Additionally, clears all the region-specific active wire types.

functions.name: dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData
functions.syntax: dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData( d_cellView [ ?dryRun { t | nil } ] [ ?ignoreUnboundRefs { t | nil } ] ) => x_numClearedObjects / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Opens hierarchy below the given cellview and removes all occShape coloring data that does not have any effect on the display of coloring data in the opened hierarchy. By default, if some instances or vias in the hierarchy cannot be bound, the function prints a warning message and returns nil, but cleanup can be forced with the ignoreUnboundRefs argument.

functions.name: dbClose
functions.description: Closes a cellview.

functions.name: dbCloseBag
functions.description: Closes the property bag in the given mode.

functions.name: dbColorShapeQuery
functions.syntax: dbColorShapeQuery(  d_cellViewId l_layerPurposePair l_bBox [ x_startLevel ] [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ] [ l_transform ] ) => l_shapeColorPairs / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of all shapes and their effective color, where the bounding boxes of the shapes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbColorShapeQuery2
functions.syntax: dbColorShapeQuery2(  d_cellViewId l_layerPurposePair l_bBox [ x_startLevel ] [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ] [ l_transform ] ) => l_occShapesWithColorAndState / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of shapes and occurrence shapes within a given region, and the coloring information for each shape. The coloring information includes the color, whether the color is locked, and whether the coloring is due to the color attribute or hierarchical color locking on the shape.

functions.name: dbCompressPointArray
functions.description: Compresses collinear points in a list of points.

functions.name: dbComputeBBox
functions.description: Recomputes the given cellview's bounding box.

functions.name: dbComputeBBoxNoNLP
functions.description: Computes the given cellview's bounding box, but excludes all the bounding boxes of the nlp labels in the given cellview itself and its reference cellviews.

functions.name: dbConcatTransform
functions.description: Merges two individual transformations into a single new transformation.   For example, the call(dbMoveFig F cv (dbConcatTransform T1 T2)) results in figure F being moved to the same position and orientation as two successive calls to dbMoveFig in the following order:        (dbMoveFig F cv T1)       (dbMoveFig F cv T2)

functions.name: dbConvertAnyAngleTransformFromDbToMY
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Converts orientation-based representation of an orthogonal transformation into an MY-based representation. Orientation-based representation is a pair of DB orientation and any-angle rotation with the rotation applied first. The MY-based representation is a pair of any-angle rotation and an optional reflection over a Y-axis with the reflection applied first.

functions.name: dbConvertArcToLine
functions.description: Converts an arc to a line. A line is defined as a number of connecting segments.

functions.name: dbConvertDonutToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a donut to a polygon.

functions.name: dbConvertEllipseToPolygon
functions.description: Converts an ellipse to a polygon.

functions.name: dbConvertLineToPath
functions.syntax: dbConvertLineToPath(  d_line  x_width  [ t_pathStyle ]  )  => d_path / nil
functions.description: Converts a line to a path.

functions.name: dbConvertPathSegToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a pathseg to a polygon based on the boundary list.

functions.name: dbConvertPathToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a path to a polygon with the same number of points as the path.

functions.name: dbConvertRectToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a rectangle into a polygon.

functions.name: dbCopyCellView
functions.syntax: dbCopyCellView(  d_srcCVId  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  [ t_version  [ g_contextId  [ g_overwrite ] ] ]  )  => d_cellViewId / nil
functions.description: Copies a cellview to a destination cellview.

functions.name: dbCopyFig
functions.syntax: dbCopyFig(  d_fig  d_cellView  [ l_transform ]  )  => d_fig / nil
functions.description: Copies and transforms a figure, and places it in a cellview.

functions.name: dbCopyProp
functions.description: Copies all the properties of one database object to another database object.

functions.name: dbCopyPropList
functions.description: Copies all the properties from the database object given in the first argument to the database object given in the second argument in a single, atomic, copy operation. Properties with the same name in the destination object are overwritten. If the given database objects are pcell instances, then pcell evaluation happens once after all the properties are copied.

functions.name: dbCopyShape
functions.syntax: dbCopyShape( d_shapeId d_cellviewId [ l_transform ]  ) => d_newShapeId / nil
functions.description: Copies a shape to the specified cellview with the given transformation.

functions.name: dbCopySingleProp
functions.description: Copies a single property to a destination object.

functions.name: dbCreateArc
functions.syntax: dbCreateArc(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose l_ellipse_bBox  l_arc_bBox  )  => d_arc / nil
functions.description: Creates an arc.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaBlockage
functions.syntax: dbCreateAreaBlockage( d_cellviewId l_points [ d_owner ] ) => d_areaBlockageId / nil
functions.description: Creates an area blockage object of the type placement in the given cellview. Area blockages are used to prevent instances from being placed within a specific area.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaBoundary
functions.syntax: dbCreateAreaBoundary( d_cellviewId l_points [ t_name = nil]  [ lt_edgeNames = nil] ) => d_areaBoundaryId / nil
functions.description: Creates an area boundary object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaHalo
functions.syntax: dbCreateAreaHalo( d_ownerId n_topOffset n_bottomOffset n_leftOffset n_rightOffset ) => d_areaHaloId / nil
functions.description: Creates an areaHalo blockage object of type placement. An area halo is associated with an instance or a prBoundary to represent an extended area around the master's prBoundary.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Creates an area pin group guide with the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateBackgroundDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateBackgroundDef( d_cvId t_name l_lpp t_netName g_leftEnc g_rightEnc g_topEnc g_bottomEnc )  => d_backgroundDefId / nil
functions.description: Creates a backgroundDef based on the specified attributes. The layer-purpose pair must exist to create a backgroundDef.

functions.name: dbCreateBackgroundDefByAttr
functions.syntax: dbCreateBackgroundDefByAttr( d_cvId t_name g_dpl ) => d_bgDefId / nil
functions.description: Creates a backgroundDef based on the SKILL DPL specification of the object. Contents of the SKILL DPL specification are checked before the backgroundDef is created.

functions.name: dbCreateBusNetDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateBusNetDef( d_cellviewId t_baseName t_bitOrder ) => d_busNetDefId / nil
functions.description: Creates a bus net definition with specified bit order and base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateBusTermDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateBusTermDef( d_cellviewId t_baseName t_bitOrder ) => d_busTermDefId / nil
functions.description: Creates a bus terminal definition with specified bit order and base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateCluster
functions.syntax: dbCreateCluster( d_cellViewId t_clusterName t_clusterType ) => d_clusterId / nil
functions.description: Creates a cluster in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateClusterBoundary
functions.syntax: dbCreateClusterBoundary( d_clusterId t_name l_points [ lt_edgeNames ] ) => d_boundaryId / nil
functions.description: Creates a cluster boundary object in the cellview of the given cluster. The cluster boundary is associated with a cluster (grouping of objects) and defines the area of the cluster objects.

functions.name: dbCreateCompTypeSetDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateCompTypeSetDef(  d_cellViewId  t_compTypeSetName  t_rowReference t_componentReference l_allowedOrientations l_componentTypes [ g_componentOffset ] [ g_pitch ] ) => d_compTypeSetDef / nil
functions.description: This function creates a container of component types that use the same placement attributes.

functions.name: dbCreateCompTypeSetDefByAttr
functions.description: Creates a compTypeSetDef in the given cellview based on the specified attributes list.

functions.name: dbCreateConn
functions.syntax: dbCreateConn(  d_net  d_inst  d_term  )  => d_instTerm / nil
functions.description: Identical to dbCreateInstTerm, except the net d_net defines a valid net to be connected to the instance terminal of a master terminal d_term.

functions.name: dbCreateConnByName
functions.syntax: dbCreateConnByName(  d_net  d_inst  t_name  )  => d_instTerm / nil
functions.description: Similar to dbCreateConn, except the master terminal is defined by t_name instead of being specified by the master terminal's dbObject.

functions.name: dbCreateConnByNewName
functions.syntax: dbCreateConnByNewName(  d_net  d_inst  t_name  )  => d_instTerm / nil
functions.description: Similar to dbCreateConnByName, except t_name can refer to a master terminal to be created in the master cellview of instance d_inst.

functions.name: dbCreateCoverObstruction
functions.syntax: dbCreateCoverObstruction( d_prBoundaryId x_topLayerMaskNumber [ g_allowPGNet ] ) => d_coverObstructionId / nil
functions.description: Creates a cover obstruction object associated with the specified prBoundary object.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedAreaBoundary
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Creates a curved area boundary in the specified cellview, using the specified points.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedPath
functions.syntax: dbCreateCurvedPath( d_cellViewId  txl_layerPurpose  l_curvedPoints  x_width ) => d_curvedPathId
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Creates a curved path that has a straight centerline and round edges at all segments.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedPolygon
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Creates a curved polygon.

functions.name: dbCreateCustomViaVariant
functions.syntax: dbCreateCustomViaVariant( d_cellViewId t_viaVariantName t_viaDefName l_viaParams ) => d_viaVariantId / nil
functions.description: Creates a custom viaVariant in cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateDiffMaskGroup
functions.syntax: dbCreateDiffMaskGroup( d_cellView t_groupName d_sameMaskGroup1 d_sameMaskGroup2 ) => d_group / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Creates a diff-mask, color shape group (d_group) in the specified cellview with a pair of same-mask color shape groups and with the given name. The name must be unique amongst all diff-mask groups in the cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateDonut
functions.syntax: dbCreateDonut(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose  l_point  x_outR  x_holeR  )  => d_donut / nil
functions.description: Creates a donut (two concentric circles).

functions.name: dbCreateDot
functions.syntax: dbCreateDot(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose  l_point  )  => d_dot / nil
functions.description: Creates a dot.

functions.name: dbCreateEdgePinGroupGuide
functions.description: Creates an edge pin group guide with the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateEllipse
functions.syntax: dbCreateEllipse(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose l_bBox  )  => d_ellipse / nil
functions.description: Creates an ellipse.

functions.name: dbCreateEnumProp
functions.syntax: dbCreateEnumProp(  g_object  t_name  t_value  l_string  )  => d_prop / nil
functions.description: Creates an enumerated property for an object.

functions.name: dbCreateExtParamInst
functions.syntax: dbCreateExtParamInst( d_cellView d_master t_name l_point t_orient [ x_numInst [ l_params [ g_physOnly ] ] ] ) => d_inst / nil
functions.description: Creates a parameterized cell instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient. The parameters in the l_params list may be CDF parameters whose values match the CDF parameter defaults.

functions.name: dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName
functions.syntax: dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName( d_cellView t_libName t_cellName t_viewName t_name l_origin t_orient [ x_numInst [ l_params [ g_physOnly ] ] ] ) => d_inst / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance of the specified Pcell master in the specified cellview. The parameters in the parameter list may be CDF parameters. In this case, for each parameter the function creates an explicit local user property on the instance, even if its value is the same as the default on the master.

functions.name: dbCreateFigGroup
functions.syntax: dbCreateFigGroup(  d_cellView t_name g_ordered l_origin t_orient ) => d_figGroup / nil
functions.description: Creates a figGroup object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateGCellPattern
functions.syntax: dbCreateGCellPattern( d_cellviewId g_isHorizontal n_startCoord x_count n_spacing [ tx_layer ] ) => d_GCellPatternId / nil
functions.description: Creates a GCell pattern in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateGenViaVariant
functions.syntax: dbCreateGenViaVariant( d_cellviewId  t_name  t_viaDefName l_paramList )  => viaVariantId / nil
functions.description: Creates a genViaVariant object in the specified cellview according to the specified viaDef and parameter list.

functions.name: dbCreateGroup
functions.syntax: dbCreateGroup(  d_cellViewID  t_groupName  l_groupType  [ t_groupDefName ] )  => d_group / nil
functions.description: Creates a group of the specified group definition in the specified cellview. If a group definition is not specified, a traditional, unrestricted group is created, which allows all types of objects and all types of groups as members and can exist in any database.

functions.name: dbCreateGuide
functions.syntax: dbCreateGuide( d_cellviewId l_startPoint l_endPoint [ t_startLayerName ] [t_endLayerName ]  ) => d_guideId / nil
functions.description: Creates a guide based on the specified parameters.

functions.name: dbCreateHierProp
functions.description: Creates a hierarchical property for an object.

functions.name: dbCreateInPlaceCoverObstruction
functions.description: Creates an InPlaceCoverObstruction object on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbCreateInst
functions.syntax: dbCreateInst(  d_cellView  d_master  t_name  l_point  t_orient  [ x_stopIndex ]  [ g_physOnly] )  => d_inst / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateInstByMasterName
functions.syntax: dbCreateInstByMasterName(  d_cellView  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_instName  l_origin  t_orient  [ x_numInst ]  [ g_physOnly ]  )  => d_inst / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance (of cellview-t_libName/t_cellName/t_viewName) in d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateInstTerm
functions.syntax: dbCreateInstTerm(  d_net  d_inst  d_term  )  => d_instTerm / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance terminal on the instance d_inst for the master terminal d_term.

functions.name: dbCreateInstTermByPosition
functions.syntax: dbCreateInstTermByPosition( d_netId d_instId x_position ) => d_instTermId / nil
functions.description: Creates an instTerm connecting to a terminal at the given position and to the specified master instance.

functions.name: dbCreateLabel
functions.syntax: dbCreateLabel(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose l_point  t_label  t_just  t_orient  t_font  x_height  )  => d_label / nil
functions.description: Creates a graphic text-string label.

functions.name: dbCreateLayerBlockage
functions.syntax: dbCreateLayerBlockage( d_cellviewId tx_layer t_type l_points [ d_owner ] ) => d_layerBlockageId / nil
functions.description: Creates a layer blockage object of the specified type in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateLayerHalo
functions.syntax: dbCreateLayerHalo(  d_ownerId  tx_layer t_type n_top n_bottom n_left n_right ) => d_layerHalo / nil
functions.description: Creates a layer halo blockage object of the specified type.

functions.name: dbCreateLib
functions.description: Creates a library named t_libName.

functions.name: dbCreateLine
functions.syntax: dbCreateLine(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose l_points  )  => d_line / nil
functions.description: Creates a line.

functions.name: dbCreateMarker
functions.syntax: dbCreateMarker( d_cellviewId t_msg t_tool l_points [ ld_objects ] [ g_isVisible ] [ g_isClosed ] [ t_severity ] [ t_shortMsg ] [ t_deleteWhen ] ) => d_markerId / nil
functions.description: Creates a marker object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateNet
functions.syntax: dbCreateNet(  d_cellView  t_name  [ d_parentNet ]  )  => d_net / nil
functions.description: Creates a new net in a cellview. If the net already exists, returns nil.

functions.name: dbCreatePRBoundary
functions.syntax: dbCreatePRBoundary( d_cellViewId l_points [ lt_edgeNames ] ) => d_boundaryId / nil
functions.description: Creates a prBoundary object in the specified cellview for place-and-route purpose. A cellview can only have one prBoundary.

functions.name: dbCreateParamInst
functions.syntax: dbCreateParamInst(  d_cellView  d_master  t_name  l_point  t_orient  [ x_numInst  [ l_params  [ g_physOnly ] ] ] )  => d_inst / nil
functions.description: Creates a parameterized cell instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateParamInstByMasterName
functions.syntax: dbCreateParamInstByMasterName(  d_cellView  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_name  l_origin  l_orient  [ x_numInst  [ l_params  [ g_physOnly ] ] ] )  => d_inst / nil
functions.description: Creates an instance of the specified Pcell master in the specified cellview. The parameters in the parameter list may be CDF parameters. In this case, when you create a Pcell instance and pass a parameter, with the same value as the default value, dbCreateParamInstByMasterName() does not create an explicit local user property on the instance because the value is the same as the default. If the value is different from the default, the function stores the value as a local property on the instance.

functions.name: dbCreateParamSimpleMosaic
functions.syntax: dbCreateParamSimpleMosaic(  d_cellView  d_masterCellView  t_name  l_origin  l_orient  x_rows  x_cols  n_rowSpacing  n_colSpacing  l_params   )  => d_mosaic / nil
functions.description: Creates a parameterized simple mosaic (from the master d_masterCellView) in d_cellView, with an origin and orientation specified by l_origin and l_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateParamSimpleMosaicByMasterName
functions.syntax: dbCreateParamSimpleMosaicByMasterName(  d_cellView  t_libName t_cellName  t_viewName  t_name  l_origin  l_orient  x_rows  x_cols  n_rowSpacing  n_colSpacing  l_params   )  => d_mosaic / nil
functions.description: Creates a parameterized simple mosaic (from the master t_libName/t_cellName/t_viewName) in d_cellView, with an origin and orientation specified by l_origin and l_orient.

functions.name: dbCreatePath
functions.syntax: dbCreatePath(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose l_points  n_width  [ t_pathStyle ]  )  => d_path / nil
functions.description: Creates a path.

functions.name: dbCreatePathSeg
functions.syntax: dbCreatePathSeg( d_cellviewId txl_layerPurpose l_beginPt l_endPt n_width t_beginStyle t_endStyle [list( 	n_beginExt 	n_endExt 	[ l_extValue ] 	)] ) => d_pathSegId / nil
functions.description: Creates a path segment based on the specified parameters. The argument l_extValue is an optional list that contains six entries.

functions.name: dbCreatePin
functions.syntax: dbCreatePin(  d_netId  d_figId | nil [ t_pinName | nil ]  [ d_termId | nil]   )  => d_pin / nil
functions.description: Creates a pin.

functions.name: dbCreatePlaceArea
functions.syntax: dbCreatePlaceArea(  d_cellViewId  t_name  g_width g_height l_origin t_orientation [ f_utilization ]  ) => d_IdOfCustomPlacementArea / nil
functions.description: Creates a custom placeArea in the specified cellview. A custom placeArea is a row structure used for placing device-level instances.

functions.name: dbCreatePolygon
functions.syntax: dbCreatePolygon(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose l_points  )  => d_polygon / nil
functions.description: Creates a polygon.

functions.name: dbCreateProp
functions.syntax: dbCreateProp(  g_object  t_name  t_propType  g_value  )  => d_prop / nil
functions.description: Creates a scalar property for an object. If a property named t_name already exists on the specified object, it returns nil.

functions.name: dbCreateRailDef
functions.syntax: dbCreateRailDef(  d_cellViewId  t_raildDefName t_netName l_lpp t_rowReference t_railReference g_width [ g_offset ] [ g_beginOffset ] [ g_endOffset ] ) => d_railDef / nil
functions.description: This function creates a container of attributes to define a row rail. The definition can be referenced in more than one row or placeArea. If a physical attribute is modifed in the object, it is instantly reflected in all row/placeArea that reference the railDef.

functions.name: dbCreateRailDefByAttr
functions.syntax: dbCreateRailDefByAttr( d_cvId t_name l_attr_dpl )  => d_railDefId / nil
functions.description: Creates railDef based on the SKILL DPL of the railDef object specification. Contents of the SKILL DPL specification are checked before railDef is created.

functions.name: dbCreateRangeProp
functions.syntax: dbCreateRangeProp(  g_object  t_name  t_propType  g_value  g_lBound  g_uBound  )  => d_prop / nil
functions.description: Creates a range property for an object.

functions.name: dbCreateRect
functions.syntax: dbCreateRect(  d_cellView  txl_layerPurpose l_bBox  )  => d_rect / nil
functions.description: Creates a rectangle.

functions.name: dbCreateRegionBoundary
functions.syntax: dbCreateRegionBoundary(  d_cellViewId  l_curvedPoints  t_regionName  [ t_layerType ] ) => d_regionBoundaryId / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Creates a region boundary.

functions.name: dbCreateRelatedSnapPatterns

functions.name: dbCreateXformPCell
functions.description: Creates a new Pcell supermaster with the additional parameters: mag and angle. The new Pcell is used in emulating magnification and any-angle rotation of instances. If the source cellview is maskLayout, the Pcell cell name is same as that of the source cellview, with _xform appended to it, otherwise, the viewName is similarly renamed. This Pcell creates an instance of the source cellview, flattens it, and then transforms all the resultant shapes by adding the parameters mag and angle. If the Pcell supermaster already exists, it is opened as read-only, and the cellview ID is returned.

functions.name: dbDefineProc

The specified file name should be the name of a file containing un-encrypted SKILL code defining procedure pcGenCell. The cellview should have a hierarchical property named parameters, which should be a hierarchical property list containing the default values for the parameters.

functions.name: dbDeleteAllNet

functions.description: Deletes one of the following objects: shapes, nets, terminals, instance terminals, pins, instance pins, mosaics, instances, mosaic instances, properties, groups, and group members. Any other object type produces an error.

functions.description: The dbDumpPcell function is used in the implementation of the keepPcell option, during streamIn and streamOut. Pcells are preserved by writing the pcells to SKILL files (during StreamOut) which are loaded back into CDB/Virtuoso (during StreamIn).

functions.description: Returns a list of all the objects (such as, shapes, instances, and mosaics) in a cellview that overlaps the area specified by l_bBox.  If the object comes from a lower level in the hierarchy, instead of from the specified cellview, the object is represented by a list (potentially a nested list, if it comes from more than one level down). Each level of the list has the ID of the instance in the corresponding level in the hierarchy.  For example, if there is a rectangle in a master cellview two levels down, for this rectangle, in the top cellview, dbGetOverlaps will return a nested list. The output of this function is same as dbGetTrueOverlaps.
