functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Determines whether the specified shape contains pattern region information.

functions.name: dbHasPatternRegionNoActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns true if no active wire types is set on the specified pattern region.

functions.name: dbHasShape
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview contains any shapes.

functions.name: dbHasShortedTerminals
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview contains nets that are connected to multiple terminals.

functions.name: dbInPlaceCoverObstructionExists
functions.description: Checks whether an InPlaceCoverObstruction object is present on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbInstClearLayerShifts
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Removes all per-layer color shifting information from the specified instance.

functions.name: dbInstGetLayerShifts2
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a list of shifts that are applied to the layers in the master of the specified instance.

functions.name: dbInstHasLayerShifts
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a Boolean value indicating whether per-layer color shifts are specified on the instance.

functions.name: dbInstQuery
functions.syntax: dbInstQuery( d_cellviewId l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_inst / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the instances in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbInstSetLayerShifts2
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the given l_layerShifts on the specified instance.

functions.name: dbIsAnyInstBaseNameUsed
functions.description: Check if the name is used as instance basename in the cellview.

functions.name: dbIsBagId
functions.description: Returns t if the specified ID is a valid bagId, otherwise, it returns nil.

functions.name: dbIsBagReadable
functions.description: Checks if the property bag exists on disk for the given ddId object and if the user has read access for that property bag file.

functions.name: dbIsBagWritable
functions.description: Returns the UNIX file permission of the file that contains the property information. For example, basic is a system owned library, dbIsBagWritable will always return nil on its property. If you own a library, and its prop.xx has write permission, even if the bag is opened in r mode, dbIsBagWritable will still return t. A new property bag that exists only in VM is not considered writable.

functions.name: dbIsBlockageColored
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Indicates whether the specified blockage is colored in a color other than grayColor.

functions.name: dbIsBlockageColoringAllowed
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Indicates whether the specified blockage is of a blockage type that can be colored. Only layer blockages can be colored.

functions.name: dbIsCellViewGenViaMaster
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview ID is of a genViaMaster object.

functions.name: dbIsCellViewModified
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview has been modified since the last open or last save.

functions.name: dbIsCellViewNetVoltageRangeSet
functions.description: Ensures that the voltage range is set on a cellview.

functions.name: dbIsCellViewPhysicalOnly
functions.description: Checks whether the connectivity detail of a cellveiw is visible only to the block domain or to both the block domain and the OpenAccess module domain.

functions.name: dbIsCellViewStdViaMaster
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating whether the specified cellview is a standard via master.

functions.name: dbIsConnCurrent
functions.description: Tests whether the value of the connectivity current property is equal to the cellview's timestamp counter value.

functions.name: dbIsCurved
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Checks whether the specified shape is a curved shape.

functions.name: dbIsFigSetGroup
functions.description: Determines whether the specified object is a FigSetGroup.

functions.name: dbIsFluidPcell
functions.description: Checks if submaster belongs to a Fluid Pcell supermaster.

functions.name: dbIsFluidShape
functions.description: Checks if the specified shape is marked as a Fluid shape.

functions.name: dbIsGenVia
functions.description: Checks whether the specified database object is a genVia object.

functions.name: dbIsGenViaHeader
functions.description: Checks whether the specified database object is a genViaHeader object.

functions.name: dbIsGenViaVariant
functions.description: Checks whether the specified database object is a genViaVariant object.

functions.name: dbIsId
functions.description: Returns t if the argument is a valid database object ID, otherwise, it returns nil.

functions.name: dbIsImplicit
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Verifies whether the object represented by the specified database ID is implicit. Supported objects: dbRailDef, dbBackgroundDef and dbCompTypeSetDef.

functions.name: dbIsInRowRegion
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Checks if a figure with the given figure database ID belongs to a rowRegion.

functions.name: dbIsInstTransparent
functions.description: Checks if the specified instance ID is set to be transparent to the Layout XL binder.

functions.name: dbIsMultiTechEnabled
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Confirms whether the Virtuoso Multi Tech Framework functionality is enabled in the current session.

functions.name: dbIsNetNameDescend
functions.description: Checks if the net name descend mode is set or not.

functions.name: dbIsNetOptical
functions.description: Checks whether the specified net or signal has optical data.

functions.name: dbIsNetVoltageRangeSet
functions.description: Ensures that the voltage range is set on a net.

functions.name: dbIsNonSKILLPcell
functions.description: Checks whether a pcell is not a SKILL pcell.

functions.name: dbIsObjectBound
functions.description: Determines whether or not an object is bound. If the master cellview of the object is opened, the object is bound. Otherwise it is not bound.

functions.name: dbIsPhotonicsEnabled
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Confirms whether the photonics-related functionality is enabled.

functions.name: dbIsRegionBoundary
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Confirms if the specified area boundary is a region boundary.

functions.name: dbIsRowRegion
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Checks if the specified database object is a rowRegion.

functions.name: dbIsRowRegionAttachedToPRBoundary
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Checks whether the specified rowRegion is associated with the PRBoundary of the block that contains the rowRegion.

functions.name: dbIsSameMaster
functions.description: Determines if two instances or mosaics are instantiated from the same cellview master.

functions.name: dbIsShapeColorLocked
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Indicates whether the coloring for the specified shape is locked.

functions.name: dbIsShapeColored
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Indicates whether the specified shape is colored in a color other than grayColor.

functions.name: dbIsShapeColoringAllowed
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Indicates whether the specified shape is of a type that can be colored or not. Only the following shapes can be colored: arcs, lines, donuts, ellipses, pathSegs, paths, rects, and polygons.

functions.name: dbIsSigInherited
functions.description: Given a signal id in sigId, this function checks if there is an inherited net expression attached to it.

functions.name: dbIsSigNameGlobal
functions.description: Tests if the signal t_name is a global signal.

functions.name: dbIsTapSteiner
functions.description: Checks whether the specified ID is a tap steiner ID.

functions.name: dbIsTermInherited
functions.description: Checks whether there is an inherited net expression attached to the given terminal.

functions.name: dbIsTermSoftConnect
functions.description: Checks the softConnect attribute value of the specified terminal. Since the softConnect attribute can only be set on explicit, single-bit terminals, using this query on an implicit or multi-bit terminal always returns nil.

functions.name: dbIsTopologyPatternId
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified object ID is a dbTopologyPattern.

functions.name: dbIsTrackPatternColorAlternating
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the coloring for the specified track pattern is alternating.

functions.name: dbIsTrackPatternColored
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the first track of the specified track pattern is colored in a color other than gray.

functions.name: dbIsTrackPatternColoringAllowed
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified track pattern can be colored. Only track patterns with specified track layer can be colored.

functions.name: dbIsVRFEnabled
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Confirms whether the VRF-related functionality is enabled in the current session.

functions.name: dbIsVRFInfraEnabled
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Confirms whether the VRF infrastructure sub-system is enabled in the current session. This includes the basic database SKILL functions required to work with the curved shapes, SKILL functions vrfSipGet and vrfSipSet, Allegro translators, and other related features.

functions.name: dbIsValidSigNetExpr
functions.description: Given an inherited net expression in the t_netExpression associated with a signal, this function checks whether its syntax is valid. This function does as much local checking as possible, but it does not detect whether the given default net name is global, nor whether the evaluation of the property results in a valid net name.

functions.name: dbIsValidTermNetExpr
functions.description: Given an inherited net expression in t_netExpression associated with a terminal, this function checks whether its syntax is valid. This function does as much local checking as possible, but it does not detect whether the given default net name is global nor whether the evaluation of the property results in a valid net name.

functions.name: dbIsViaColorStateLayerLocked
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Indicates whether the coloring for the specified individual layer in a via is locked.

functions.name: dbIsViaColorStateLocked
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Returns a Boolean indicating whether the coloring on the via is locked. The default value is nil.

functions.name: dbLayerAnd
functions.syntax: dbLayerAnd(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 l_dbIdList2  [ x_numVertices ] [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of objects derived from the overlap of objects on the input lists. This function generates the areas common to both input lists. The resulting objects are created in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbLayerAndNot
functions.syntax: dbLayerAndNot(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 l_dbIdList2  [ x_numVertices ] [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects derived from areas of the first input list that do not overlap any area of the second input list and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbLayerBlockageQuery
functions.syntax: dbLayerBlockageQuery( d_cellviewId tx_layer l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_layerBlockage / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the layer blockages in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbLayerEnclose
functions.syntax: dbLayerEnclose(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 l_dbIdList2 [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes on the first list that enclose shapes on the second list. A shape is enclosing the other if the entire area of a second shape is covered by first shape.

functions.name: dbLayerHoles
functions.syntax: dbLayerHoles(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects from those areas consisting of all the holes in shapes of the input list. A hole is an area created when the perimeter of a polygon touches itself, enclosing an area that is not the polygon.

functions.name: dbLayerInside
functions.syntax: dbLayerInside(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 l_dbIdList2 [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Creates a new merged object for each overlapping object on dbIdList1 that is completely enclosed by an object on dbIdList2 and returns a list of the new object/objects created. A shape on dbIdList1 is considered inside if its entire area is enclosed by the area of a shape on dbIdList2. Coincident shapes are considered inside in this check. If both shapes are coincident on all sides, then each shape can be defined as being inside the other.

functions.name: dbLayerNoHoles
functions.syntax: dbLayerNoHoles(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects from those areas consisting of all the original shapes of the input list without holes. A hole is an area created when the perimeter of a polygon touches itself, enclosing an area that is not the polygon.

functions.name: dbLayerOr
functions.syntax: dbLayerOr(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 [ l_dbIdList2 ] [ x_numVertices ] [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects that encompass all areas on input lists and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbLayerOutside
functions.syntax: dbLayerOutside(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 l_dbIdList2 [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Creates a new object for each object on dbIdList1 that is not enclosed by any object on dbIdList2 and returns a list of the new object created. A shape on dbIdList1 is considered outside if none of its area is enclosed by the area of a shape on dbIdList2. Coincident shapes are considered inside in this check. Butting edges are considered outside.

functions.name: dbLayerSize
functions.syntax: dbLayerSize(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 n_value [ x_numVertices ] [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Performs an over size or under size operation on the object specified in the input list.

functions.name: dbLayerStraddle
functions.syntax: dbLayerStraddle(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 l_dbIdList2 [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects from those shapes on the first layer that straddle shapes on the second layer. A shape is straddling, if part of its area is covered by part of the shape on the second layer and part is not. The return list also includes copies of shapes that are touching these straddling shapes. Butting and coincident edges do not affect this function.

functions.name: dbLayerTile
functions.syntax: dbLayerTile(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Fractures edges of the specified object on the input list into vertical trapezoids.

functions.name: dbLayerXor
functions.syntax: dbLayerXor(  d_cellViewId t_layerName l_dbIdList1 l_dbIdList2 [ x_numVertices ] [ g_mfgGrid ] )  => l_dbIdList
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects derived from those portions of either input list that do not overlap the other list and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbListTypes
functions.description: Lists the enumerated values for a specified database enumerated type.

functions.name: dbMakeBagCurrent
functions.description: Refreshes the given property bag if it is out of date relative to the one on disk.

functions.name: dbMakeFigSetGroup
functions.description: Creates a FigSetGroup in the specified cellview and populates it with the contents of the specified FigSet.

functions.name: dbMakeNet
functions.syntax: dbMakeNet(  d_cellView  t_name  [ d_parentNet ]  )  => d_net / nil
functions.description: Creates a new net in a cellview. If the net already exists, it returns the dbObject of the net.

functions.name: dbMarkerQuery
functions.syntax: dbMarkerQuery( d_cellviewId l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_marker / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the markers in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbMergeNet
functions.description: Merges one netId2 into netId1. The pins, terminals, connections, figures, properties, and signals of the merging net (netId2) are merged into the surviving net (netId1), and member nets of netId2's signals become members of netId1's signals. Only one of the nets may already be attached to a terminal, not both; both nets must have the same number of bits. If the two nets are in the same net hierarchy, netId1 must not be a descendent of netId2. If the merge is successful, netId1 is returned; otherwise, nil is returned.

functions.name: dbMergeSignal
functions.description: Merges two signals into one signal.

functions.name: dbMergeSingleProp
functions.description: Merges a property with a destination object without overwriting the property if it already exists.

functions.name: dbMergeStrongGroups
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. Strong connections are modeled by multiple pinFigs on the same pin.

functions.name: dbMoveChildNet
functions.description: Moves a net to be the child of given parent net, both should be on same terminal.

functions.name: dbMoveFig
functions.syntax: dbMoveFig(  d_fig  d_cellView  [ l_transform ]  )  => d_fig / nil
functions.description: Moves and transforms a figure, and places it in a cellview.

functions.name: dbMoveGroupMember
functions.description: Moves group member d_groupMem1 immediately after group member d_groupMem2.

functions.name: dbMovePinToNet
functions.description: Moves a pin to the specified net.

functions.name: dbMoveShape
functions.description: Moves a shape to given cellview with given transformation.

functions.name: dbMustConnectPins
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. External Pin connections are modeled by collections of MustJoin Terms. See dbSetTermMustJoin.

functions.name: dbNetHasTopology
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified net has a topology.

functions.name: dbNetIsSig
functions.description: Tests whether the specified net ID is also a signal.

functions.name: dbOpenAutoSavedCellView
functions.syntax: dbOpenAutoSavedCellView(  t_libName  t_cellName  lt_viewName  [ t_version ]  )  => d_cellView / nil
functions.description: Reads the auto-saved file.

functions.name: dbOpenBag
functions.description: Opens the library, cell, or view property bag in the given mode.

functions.name: dbOpenCellViewByType
functions.syntax: dbOpenCellViewByType(  { gt_lib | nil } t_cellName  lt_viewName  [ t_viewTypeName  [ t_mode  [ d_contextCellView ] ] ]  )  => d_cellView / nil
functions.description: Opens a cellview.

functions.name: dbOpenHier
functions.description: Opens and binds masters of instances that constitute a design hierarchy.

functions.name: dbOpenPanicCellView
functions.syntax: dbOpenPanicCellView(  gt_lib  t_cellName  t_viewName  [ t_version  [ t_mode  [ d_contextCellView ] ] ] )  => d_cellView / nil
functions.description: Opens a saved panic cellview from a physical panic file with extension .oa-. The cellview .oa- opens in read mode only. You can then use the dbSave() function to save it to a new cellview, or call the dbReopen() function to reopen it in the append mode and then call the dbSave() function to save the cellview back to disk.

functions.name: dbOpenParamCellView
functions.syntax: dbOpenParamCellView( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  [ l_params ] ) => d_cellView / nil
functions.description: Opens submaster cellview of the Pcell supermaster specified by the library, cell, and view names and the parameter values.

functions.name: dbParseSigNetExpr
functions.syntax: dbParseSigNetExpr(  t_netExpression  ) => t_searchScope    t_propName     t_formatString     t_defaultNetName / nil
functions.description: Parses the expression and returns the individual components of the expression that include the search scope, the property name to be used in searching, the format string, and the default net name.

functions.name: dbParseTermNetExpr
functions.syntax: dbParseTermNetExpr(  t_netExpression  )  => t_searchScope 	t_propName  	t_formatString  	t_defaultNetName / nil
functions.description: Parses the expression and returns the individual components of the expression that include the search scope, the property name to be used in searching, the format string, and the default net name.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasKeepoutSpacing
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating that the keepoutSpacing constraint is set on the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating that the layerPriorityOrder constraint is set on the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasMinPinSpacing
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating whether the minSpacing constraint is set on the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasMinPinWidth
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating whether the minWidth constraint is set on the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating whether the validRoutingLayers constraint is set on the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinHasMinPinSpacing
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating whether the minSpacing constraint is set on the specified pin.

functions.name: dbPinHasMinPinWidth
functions.description: This function returns a boolean value indicating whether the minWidth constraint has been applied to the specified pin.

functions.name: dbPlacementBlockageQuery
functions.syntax: dbPlacementBlockageQuery( d_cellviewId l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_via / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the placement blockages in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbPointArrayAnd
functions.syntax: dbPointArrayAnd(  d_cellViewId l_pointList1 l_pointList2  [ x_maxPoints ] )  => l_pointList / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from the overlap of shapes in the two input point lists. This function generates the areas common to both the input lists. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbPointArrayAndNot
functions.syntax: dbPointArrayAndNot(  d_cellViewId l_pointList1 l_pointList2 [ x_maxPoints ] )  => l_pointList / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from the area of the first input point list that does not overlap any area of the second input point list. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbPointArrayOr
functions.syntax: dbPointArrayOr(  d_cellViewId l_pointList1 [ l_pointList2 ] [ x_maxPoints ] )  => l_pointList / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from the union of shapes in the two input point lists. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview. If the second input point list is not specified, the first input point list is returned.

functions.name: dbPointArraySize
functions.syntax: dbPointArraySize(  d_cellViewId l_pointList n_value [ x_maxPoints ] )  => l_pointList / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived after performing an over size or under size operation on the shapes specified in the input list. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbPointArrayXor
functions.syntax: dbPointArrayXor(  d_cellViewId l_pointList1 l_pointList2 [ x_maxPoints ] )  => l_pointList / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from portions of both the inputs lists that do not overlap the points in the other input list.

functions.name: dbProduceMemName
functions.description: Returns a list of the member names for the given name.

functions.name: dbProduceOverlap
functions.syntax: dbProduceOverlap(  d_cellView  l_bBox  [ lx_level  [ l_layerPurposePair ] ]  )  => ld_shape / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the shapes in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the area specified by l_bBox. This function interface is simpler than dbGetOverlaps if you are only interested in finding the overlapping shapes.

functions.name: dbProduceOverlapInst
functions.syntax: dbProduceOverlapInst(  d_cellView  l_bBox  [ lx_level ]  )  => ld_inst / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the instances in a cellview that overlap the area specified by l_bBox. This function interface is simpler than dbGetOverlaps if you are only interested in finding instances.

functions.name: dbPurge
functions.description: Forces a cellview to close and removes from virtual memory.

functions.name: dbPurgeBag
functions.description: Forces a property bag to close and removes it from virtual memory.

functions.name: dbReOpenBag
functions.description: Reopens the given g_bagId for the given mode.

functions.name: dbRebuildRowRegion
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Removes contents of the specified rowRegion and then regenerates it based on the rowRegionSpec associated with it.

functions.name: dbRedoToHandle
functions.description: Invokes redo up to the given handle. If no handle name is given, it rolls forward to the next labeled checkpoint.

functions.name: dbRefreshBag
functions.description: Refreshes the virtual memory image of the property bag by the one from the disk. If the disk file does not exist and the bag is in edit mode, then the virtual memory is truncated.

functions.name: dbRefreshCellView
functions.description: Refreshes the cellview in virtual memory with the most current copy from disk. If there were any changes to the cellview, this function purges the cellview from virtual memory and reopens the cellview.

functions.name: dbRefreshLibDataCompressionLevel
functions.description: Refreshes the data compression level for the specified library ID from the disk.

functions.name: dbRegPostSaveAsTrigger
functions.description: Allows users to register a trigger function that is called after a postSaveAs or Save Copy operation.

functions.name: dbRegPostSaveTrigger
functions.description: Allows users to register a trigger function that is to be called after dbSave. If dbSave fails, this trigger will not be launched. This trigger will be called only after saving the db cellviews. The post save trigger will be called with the db cellview ID.

functions.name: dbRegPurgeTrigger
functions.description: Registers a user-defined trigger function.

functions.name: dbRegSaveTrigger
functions.description: Registers a SKILL preSave trigger. The trigger function does not need to exist at the time of register, a warning will be issued though. If the function is bound, it is called before the cellview is saved.

functions.name: dbRemoveFigFromFigGroup
functions.description: Removes a figure from a figGroup object.

functions.name: dbRemoveLayerColorData
functions.syntax: dbRemoveLayerColorData( d_cellViewId t_layerName g_locked [ g_via g_hcl g_instColorShift g_blockage g_trackPattern ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Removes the color data from the specified layer in the given cellview. By default, all color data is removed. You can optionally preserve the via color data, hierarchical color locks, layer shift information, blockage color data, and track pattern color data.

functions.name: dbRemoveObjectsFromMarker
functions.description: Removes a list of objects from a specified marker.

functions.name: dbRemovePinGroupGuideEdge
functions.description: This function removes the prBoundary and edge name specification from the specified edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbRemovePlaceAreaBackgroundDef
functions.description: Removes the association between the specified placeArea and backgroundDef. The background shape on the placeArea is also removed.

functions.name: dbRemovePlaceAreaCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified compTypeSetDef in the specified placeArea. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemovePlaceAreaRailDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified railDef in the specified placeArea. The rail geometry is also deleted. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemoveRowBackgroundDef
functions.description: Removes the given backgroundDef from the specified custom row. Removing a backgroundDef also removes the background shape associated with the backgroundDef from the custom row.

functions.name: dbRemoveRowCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified compTypeSetDef in the specified row. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemoveRowRailDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified railDef in the specified row. The rail geometry is also deleted. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemoveStrapObject
functions.description: Removes the database object from the specified strap pattern.

functions.name: dbRenameNet
functions.description: This function changes the name of the net pointed by netId to the newNetName.

functions.name: dbReopen
functions.description: Changes the mode of the specified cellview to the given mode.

functions.name: dbReplaceEnumProp
functions.syntax: dbReplaceEnumProp(  g_object  t_name  t_value  l_string  )  => d_prop / nil
functions.description: Replaces an enumerated property for an object.

functions.name: dbReplaceHierProp
functions.description: Replaces a hierarchical property for an object.

functions.name: dbReplaceInstParamList
functions.description: Atomically replaces all the Pcell instance parameters with the given parameter list. The resulting Pcell subMaster is evaluated only once.

functions.name: dbReplaceInstWithVias
functions.syntax: dbReplaceInstWithVias( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Detects and replaces the via-like instances with standard vias in the existing design across the hierarchy of the given library, cell, and view. The function overwrites the existing design and saves it. New via definitions can be created if the technology file is writable.

functions.name: dbReplaceParam
functions.syntax: dbReplaceParam(  d_cellViewId t_name t_type g_value )  => d_prop / nil
functions.description: Add or modifies a cellview parameter if the cellview is a pcell super master. If the cellview is not a super master, dbReplaceParam gives a warning stating that it cannot define a parameter for a non super master, and quits. This function is only used on pcell super master cellviews.

functions.name: dbReplaceProp
functions.syntax: dbReplaceProp(  g_object  t_name  t_propType  g_value  )  => d_prop / nil
functions.description: Replaces a scalar property for an object. Calls to dbReplaceProp for abutment groups must be made before calls to dbReplaceProp for pcell properties.

functions.name: dbReplacePropList
functions.description: Replaces the specified list of properties (l_params) in the given object. dbReplacePropList will trigger Pcell evaluation once as an atomic operation.

functions.name: dbReplaceRangeProp
functions.syntax: dbReplaceRangeProp(  g_object  t_name  t_propType  g_value  g_lBound  g_uBound  )  => d_prop / nil
functions.description: Replaces a range property for an object.

functions.name: dbReplaceSigNetExpr
functions.description: Replaces any existing inherited net expression already associated with the signal. If none exists, t_netExpression is attached to the given signal and adds the signal to the set of signals having inherited net expressions.

functions.name: dbReplaceTermNetExpr
functions.description: Replaces any existing inherited net expression already associated with the terminal. If none exists, t_netExpression is attached to the given terminal and adds the terminal to the set of terminals having inherited net expressions.

functions.name: dbResetPropList
functions.description: Resets a list of properties on a given object with the specified list of properties.

functions.name: dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile
functions.syntax: dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => d_cellviewID / nil
functions.description: Restores and opens the auto-saved file for the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile
functions.syntax: dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => d_cellviewID / nil
functions.description: Restores and opens the panic file for the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbRowQuery
functions.syntax: dbRowQuery( d_cellviewId l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => ld_row / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the rows in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbRowRegionMatchesSpec
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Checks whether the rowRegion matches its rowRegionSpec.

functions.name: dbSave
functions.syntax: dbSave( d_cellview [ d_destCellView | t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the changes made to a specified cellview opened in write or append mode. By default the cellview is saved to the same database ID; however, you can optionally specify a different destination cellview ID or create a new cellview in a different library. A cellview opened in read mode can only be saved as a new cellview with the different name.

functions.name: dbSaveBag
functions.description: Writes the virtual memory image of the property bag to disk.

functions.name: dbSearchCDF
functions.description: Sets and un-sets a flag that will cause CDF to be searched for parameter values.

functions.name: dbSearchPropByName
functions.description: Searches for the specified property.

functions.name: dbSetAreaBoundaryLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: This function sets the value of the layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbSetAreaBoundaryValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: This function sets the value of the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbSetAutoSave
functions.description: Enables or disables the automatic save feature.

functions.name: dbSetAutoSaveCallback
functions.description: Enables a user-defined callback function to control the frequency at which large designs are auto-saved. When set, the user-defined callback function is called just before the design is about to be auto-saved.

functions.name: dbSetBeginPatch
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Adds or removes the beginStyle patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value.

functions.name: dbSetBlockageColor
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Assigns color to the specified blockage.

functions.name: dbSetBoundaryEdge
functions.syntax: dbSetBoundaryEdge( d_boundaryId l_points [ lt_edgeNames ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the points (edges) and edge names for the specified boundary.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewActiveWireTypesForWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified cellview for a given widthSpacingSnapPatternDef.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewEEQMaster
functions.description: Sets the value of the EEQmaster attribute of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Sets the equivalent connectivity time on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange
functions.syntax: dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange( d_cvId  n_minVoltage n_maxVoltage ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the default minimum and maximum net voltages on a cellview ID.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewSymmetry
functions.description: Sets the symmetry (or orientation) on a cellview (for which the ID is specified). The symmetry of the cellview can be set to a string value, such as X, Y, XY, any, or none, where X mirrors the cellview about the x axis and Y mirrors the cellview about the y axis.

functions.name: dbSetColorModel
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the value of the color model constraint for the specified cellview. It specifies how you want the contents of the block to be color-shifted. Possible values are any, layerBased, or locked.

functions.name: dbSetCompTypeSetDefCompFilters
functions.description: Sets the component filters in the specified compTypeSetDef.

functions.name: dbSetConnCurrent
functions.description: Sets the value of the connectivity current property to the cellview's timestamp counter value.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedAreaBoundaryPoints
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Sets curved points for the specified curved area boundary object.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedPolygonPoints
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Sets list of curved points for a curved polygon.

functions.name: dbSetEndPatch
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Adds or removes the endStyle patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value.

functions.name: dbSetFigAbutName
functions.description: Assigns a unique abutment name to the figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment names specified for the figure ID.

functions.name: dbSetFigAbutRefName
functions.description: Assigns an abutment reference name to the specified figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment reference names specified for the figure ID.

functions.name: dbSetFluidShape
functions.description: Sets the given name for the specified shape to mark it as a fluid shape. This function can be used only in a sub-master layout view, for example, during Pcell generation.

functions.name: dbSetFullPatch
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Adds or removes the full style patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value. Path segment needs to have at least one property among beginStyle or endStyle or both to set the full style patch type.

functions.name: dbSetGenViaParamDefault
functions.description: Sets the specified parameter to its default value based on the given genVia ID and parameter name.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridDefaultRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetGlobalGridDefaultRepeatMode( d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_repeatMode ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode as the default on a cellview for the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grid.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridOffsetReferenceType
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the global grid offset reference type on a cellview for the snapPatternDef and widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grids. The global grid offset reference type can be boundary or origin.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetGlobalGridRepeatMode( d_cellViewId t_wsspDefName t_patternName t_repeatMode ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode for the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grid in the specified cellview for the given width spacing pattern.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractFileName
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractFileName attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractFilePath
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractFilePath attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractViewName
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractViewName attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBloat
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBloat( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName n_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction Bloat attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBlockageAttributeValue
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction BlockageAttributeValue attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBlockageModel
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction BlockageModel attribute on the specified instance header on the specified layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionDoughnutHalo
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionDoughnutHalo( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName n_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction DoughnutHalo attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionMergeDistance
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction MergeDistance attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionNeedsRemodeling
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction NeedsRemodeling attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinCutOut
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinCutOut( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName g_value )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction PinCutOut attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinRemodeling
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction PinRemodeling attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionSpacingModel
functions.syntax: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionSpacingModel( d_InstHeaderId t_layerName t_spacingModelName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction SpacingModel attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInstHeaderMasterName
functions.syntax: dbSetInstHeaderMasterName(  d_instHeader  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the master of individual instance on the instHeader to the new master. All the instances are removed from the old instHeader and move to the new instHeader, which may exist or not. When an instHeader is empty, meaning it does not have any instance on this instHeader, the instHeader is removed and the ID is no longer valid.

functions.name: dbSetInstHeadersCounter
functions.description: Sets the value of the instance header change count property on each instance header to the instance master cellview's timestamp counter value.

functions.name: dbSetInstTransparent
functions.description: Sets an instance as transparent to the Layout XL binder.

functions.name: dbSetIntegrationColorModel
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the value of the integration color model constraint for the specified cellview. Possible values are any or locked.

functions.name: dbSetLibDataCompressionLevel
functions.description: Sets the data compression level for designs that are saved to the specified library ID.

functions.name: dbSetMarkerName
functions.description: Assigns the specified name to the marker associated with the given marker ID. The name can be an empty string.

functions.name: dbSetNIMsgMode
functions.description: Turns on/off the not implemented message.

functions.name: dbSetNetNameDescend
functions.description: Sets a mode, descending or ascending, which determines the direction of the net name vector expression.

functions.name: dbSetNetPowerDomain
functions.description: Sets the power domain for the specified net.

functions.name: dbSetNetVoltageRange
functions.syntax: dbSetNetVoltageRange( d_netId  n_minVoltage n_maxVoltage ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the minimum and maximum voltages on the specified net.

functions.name: dbSetNetVoltageRangeSource
functions.description: Sets the voltage range source on the specified net ID.

functions.name: dbSetOccShapeColor
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Assigns the specified color to the given occurrence shape. You can set the color for occurrence shapes with types Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

functions.name: dbSetOccShapeColorLockType
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Changes the color lock type of the specified occurrence shape. You can set the color state only for occurrence shapes with the following types: Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

functions.name: dbSetOccShapeColorLocked
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Changes the color state of the specified occurrence shape. You can set the color state for occurrence shapes with types Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

functions.name: dbSetPatchType
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the patch type for the specified path segment.

functions.name: dbSetPathSegPoints
functions.syntax: dbSetPathSegPoints( d_pathSegId l_beginPt l_endPt  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Specifies the beginning and ending points for the given path segment.

functions.name: dbSetPathSegStyle
functions.syntax: dbSetPathSegStyle( d_pathSeg n_width t_beginStyle t_endStyle 	[ n_beginExt n_endExt      [ n_beginLeftDiagExt n_beginRightDiagExt n_beginRightHalfWidth     n_endLeftDiagExt n_endRightDiagExt n_endRightHalfWidth ]	] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the path segment style of a given path seg database object.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionActivePattern
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the given active pattern for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified pattern region.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the given allowed pattern groups for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the given allowed patterns for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionDefaultRepeatMode
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets default repeat mode on the specified pattern region.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionName
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the specified pattern region for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionNoActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets no active wire types on the specified pattern region.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetPatternRegionRepeatMode( d_patternRegion t_patternName t_repeatMode )  => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode on the pattern region for the specified width spacing pattern.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionShiftColor
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Determines whether shift color is enabled for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetPatternRegionWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefName
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef name on the specified pattern region. The widthSpacingSnapPatternDef must already exist.

functions.name: dbSetPhotonicPinFigAngle
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Sets the given attribute value as the angle of the specified photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbSetPhotonicPinFigRadius
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Sets the given attribute value as the radius of the specified photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbSetPhotonicPinFigWidth
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Sets the given attribute value as the width of the specified photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbSetPinFigAccessDirection
functions.description: Specifies the access direction for the given pin figure.

functions.name: dbSetPinFigName
functions.description: Specifies the name for the given pin figure.

functions.name: dbSetPinFigPlacementStatus
functions.description: Specifies the placement status for the given pin figure.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdge
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdge( d_edgePinGroupGuide d_prBoundary t_name ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function specifies new or updates existing prBoundary edge information for the edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdgeStartOffset
functions.description: This function sets the start offset of the edge on the edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideEdgeStopOffset
functions.description: This function sets the stop offset of the edge on the edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideKeepoutSpacing
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideKeepoutSpacing( d_pinGroupGuide tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function sets the value of the keepoutSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: This function sets the value of the layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing( d_pinGroupGuide tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function sets the value of the minSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinWidth
functions.syntax: dbSetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing( d_pinGroupGuide tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function sets the value of the minWidth constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinGroupGuideValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: This function sets the value of the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSetPinMinPinSpacing
functions.syntax: dbSetPinMinPinSpacing( d_pinID tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function sets the value of the minSpacing constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbSetPinMinPinWidth
functions.syntax: dbSetPinMinPinWidth( d_pinID tx_layer n_value ) => t / nil
functions.description: This function sets the value of the minWidth constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbSetPlaceAreaOrient
functions.description: Sets the orientation of the specified custom placeArea.

functions.name: dbSetPlaceAreaUtilization
functions.description: Sets the assigned placement utilization for the specified custom placeArea.

functions.name: dbSetPlacementGrid
functions.syntax: dbSetPlacementGrid( d_cellviewId l_origin  f_pitchX f_pitchY ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the placement grid information. The origin of the placement grid, and the X pitch and Y values are set for the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetRailDefFigType
functions.description: Sets the railFigType for the specified railDef.

functions.name: dbSetRouteAuthor
functions.description: Sets the author type for the specified route.

functions.name: dbSetRowRegionPoints
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Changes the rectilinear specification of the given rowRegion.

functions.name: dbSetRowRegionRowRegionSpec
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the given rowRegionSpec as the template for the specified rowRegion.

functions.name: dbSetRowRegionUsesPartialRowSpec
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) A Boolean indicating whether the population of rowRegion is set to fill the space with partial specialization of rowRegionSpec.

functions.name: dbSetShapeColor
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Assigns the specified color to the given shape if the color state is unlocked.

functions.name: dbSetShapeColorLockType
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the color lock type for the specified shape.

functions.name: dbSetShapeColorLocked
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Changes the color state of the shape.

functions.name: dbSetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer
functions.description: Sets the connectToLayer attribute of the specified softConnect terminal.

functions.name: dbSetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer
functions.description: Sets the pinlessTerminalLayer attribute of the specified softConnect terminal. You can specify both the layer name or layer number of the terminal.

functions.name: dbSetStrapName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified strap pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetStrapTwig
functions.description: Changes the twig associated with the specified strap pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTermGroundSensitivity
functions.description: Specifies the terminal ground sensitivity attributes for the given terminal ID.

functions.name: dbSetTermMustJoin
functions.description: Sets the connection status of the terminals specified by the terminal IDs to mustJoin.

functions.name: dbSetTermSoftConnect
functions.description: Sets the softConnect attribute of the specified terminal to the given value.

functions.name: dbSetTermSupplySensitivity
functions.description: Specifies the terminal supply sensitivity attributes for the given terminal ID.

functions.name: dbSetTerminalAntennaRuleOnLayer
functions.syntax: dbSetTerminalAntennaRuleOnLayer(  d_termId  t_modelName t_dataName g_value tx_layer ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an antenna rule to a specified terminal according to model name, data name, and value layer pair.

functions.name: dbSetTerminalAntennaRules
functions.syntax: dbSetTerminalAntennaRules(  d_termId  t_modelName t_dataName l_antennaValueLayerPairs  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an antenna value layer pair list to a terminal according to model name and data name.

functions.name: dbSetTextDisplayNameValueVisible
functions.syntax: dbSetTextDisplayNameValueVisible(  d_tdId g_isNameVisible g_isValueVisible ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the isNameVisible and the isValueVisible flags. The isNameVisible flag sets the text display name visibility. When this flag is set to true, the name of the text display will be visible. The isValueVisible flag sets the text display value visibility. When this flag is set to true, the value of the text display will be visible.

functions.name: dbSetTopologyName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified topology ID.

functions.name: dbSetTopologyNet
functions.description: Changes the net associated with the specified topology. The net must be a single-bit net.

functions.name: dbSetTrackPatternColorAlternating
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the coloring type of the track pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Assigns a color to the first track of the specified track pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkAnchor
functions.description: Sets the anchor for the specified trunk pattern. The anchor may be an instance or another trunk.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkConnectName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified trunk connect pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkConnectTrunks
functions.syntax: dbSetTrunkConnectTrunks( d_trunkConnectId  d_startTrunkId  d_endTrunkId  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the start and end trunks for the specified trunk connect ID.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkDirection
functions.description: Specifies whether the given trunk is running in the horizontal or vertical direction.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffset1
functions.description: Sets the longitudinal offset1 value for the specified trunk pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffset2
functions.description: Sets the longitudinal offset2 value for the specified trunk pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffsetSource
functions.description: Sets the longitudinal offset source value of the specified trunk pattern ID. Valid source values are twigExtents, figGroupExtents, twigExtentsTermOnly, guardRing.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffsetSource1
functions.description: Sets the first longitudinal offset source value of the specified trunk pattern ID. Valid source values are twigExtents, figGroupExtents, instanceExtents, guardRing, and connExtents.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkLongOffsetSource2
functions.description: Sets the second longitudinal offset source value of the specified trunk pattern ID. Valid source values are twigExtents, figGroupExtents, instanceExtents, guardRing, and connExtents.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkName
functions.description: Sets the name of the trunk specified by the trunk pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkOrthoOffset
functions.description: Sets the orthogonal offset value for the specified trunk pattern ID. The specified value must be in userUnits. An orthogonal offset is only meaningful when there is an anchor set for the trunk pattern.

functions.name: dbSetTrunkSide
functions.description: Sets the side value for the specified trunk pattern ID. The valid side values are bottom, top, left, and right.

functions.name: dbSetTwigName
functions.description: Sets the name of the specified twig pattern ID.

functions.name: dbSetTwigObject
functions.description: Sets the database object for the specified twig ID. A twig can have only one object and that is one of the following: InstTerm, Via, MPPShape, or a Strap.

functions.name: dbSetTwigPinName
functions.description: Sets the pin name set for the specified twig.

functions.name: dbSetUndoHandle
functions.description: Sets an undo handle with the specified name on the current undo checkpoint. If there already exists a handle with the same name, you can optionally specify that the existing handle is moved from its current position in the undo stack and associated with the current undo checkpoint.

functions.name: dbSetViaColorInfo
functions.syntax: dbSetViaColorInfo( d_dbViaId l_layer1ControlInfo  l_layer2ControlInfo  l_cutLayerControlInfo  ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Updates the color control and color state for the three via layers (via layer1, via layer2, and cut layer) of the given via.

functions.name: dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked
functions.syntax: dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked( d_dbViaId t_dbViaLayerType g_setLocked ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Locks and unlocks the color state for individual layers in a via.

functions.name: dbSetViaColorStateLocked
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the color state for the specified via.

functions.name: dbSetViaCutLayerControl
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the color control for the cut layer shapes of the via master.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayer1Control
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the color control for layer1 shapes of the via master.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayer2Control
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the color control for layer2 shapes of the via master.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayerColorLockType
functions.syntax: dbSetViaLayerColorLockType( d_viaId t_viaLayer g_lockType ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the color lock type for the specified via layer.

functions.name: dbSetViaLayerControl
functions.syntax: dbSetViaLayerControl( d_dbViaId t_dbViaLayerType t_colorControl ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets the color control for the specified layer in the given via.

functions.name: dbSetViaParamDefault
functions.description: Sets the value of a parameter of a specified via to use its default value by a parameter name.

functions.name: dbSetViaShapePurpose
functions.description: Sets the purposes of all shapes in the cdsVia to the specified purpose. The updated parameters include primaryShapePurpose, cutShapePurpose, and otherShapePurpose. To set all purposes to their original values (defined in the cdsViaDevice definition), use an empty string as the new purpose value.

functions.name: dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode
functions.syntax: dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode( d_wspId t_allowedRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatMode ) => t / nil
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Only) Sets a valid combination of allowed and default repeat modes for the specified width spacing pattern.

functions.name: dbSetq, dbSet
functions.syntax: dbSetq( d_object g_value St_AttrOrPropName )  	=> g_value / nil   dbSet( d_object g_value St_AttrOrPropName )  	=> g_value / nil
functions.description: Modifies the value of an attribute or a property associated with a database object.

functions.name: dbShapeQuery
functions.syntax: dbShapeQuery( d_cellviewId l_layerPurposePair l_bBox [ x_startLevel ]  [ x_stopLevel ] [ n_filterSize ]  [ l_transform ]  ) => l_occShapes / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the shapes in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbSoftConnectTermHasConnectToLayer
functions.description: Checks if the given terminal has the softConnect connectToLayer attribute set.

functions.name: dbSoftConnectTermHasPinlessLayer

functions.description: This function removes an area boundary from the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSubFigFromNet
functions.description: Removes the given figure object from the net object with which it is already associated.

functions.name: dbSubFigFromPin
functions.description: Removes the specified figure from the given pin.

functions.name: dbSubFigFromPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function removes a via or a non-text shape from the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbSubFigsFromPin

functions.name: dbSubPinFromPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function removes a pin from the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbTransformAccessDirection
functions.description: Transforms the given direction by the specified orientation and returns the corresponding access direction.

functions.name: dbTransformBBox
functions.description: Transforms a bounding box.

functions.name: dbTransformCellView
functions.syntax: dbTransformCellView(  d_cellViewId  f_mag  f_angle )  => t / nil
functions.description: Scales (magnifies) and/or rotates all shapes in a cellview.

functions.name: dbTransformPoint
functions.description: Transforms a coordinate pair.

functions.name: dbTransformPointList
functions.description: Transforms all points in an array in the same way as dbTransformPoint does with a single point. This function does not modify the original array, and returns the transformed array.

functions.name: dbUnabutGroup
functions.description: Unabuts members of an abutment group.

functions.name: dbUndefineProc
functions.description: Changes the parameterized cell specified by the d_cellView to be a regular cellview.

functions.name: dbUndoToHandle
functions.description: Invokes undo back to the given handle. If no handle name is given, rolls back to the last labeled checkpoint.

functions.name: dbUnregPostSaveAsTrigger
functions.description: Allows users to unregister the trigger function called after a postSaveAs operation

functions.name: dbUnregPostSaveTrigger
functions.description: Un-registers the post save trigger function from dbSave.

functions.name: dbUnregPurgeTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters a user-defined trigger function.

functions.name: dbUnregSaveTrigger
functions.description: This function unregisters the SKILL preSave trigger function specified by the given name.

functions.name: dbUnsetAreaBoundaryLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: This function deletes the layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbUnsetAreaBoundaryValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: This function deletes the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbUnsetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Removes equivalent connectivity time information from the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbUnsetCellViewNetVoltageRange
functions.description: Resets the voltage range on a cellview to its default value.

functions.name: dbUnsetCellViewPhysicalOnly
functions.description: Unsets the physical-only attribute of the specified cellview, allowing connectivity to be visible in the OpenAccess module domain.

functions.name: dbUnsetCompTypeSetDefCompFilters
functions.description: Removes the component filters from the specified compTypeSetDef.

functions.name: dbUnsetLibDataCompressionLevel
functions.description: Removes the data compression level of the specified library.

functions.name: dbUnsetNetVoltageRange
functions.description: Resets the minimum and maximum voltages on a net to their default values.

functions.name: dbUnsetNetVoltageRangeSource
functions.description: Resets the voltage range source of the specified net ID to its default value.

functions.name: dbUnsetPhotonicPinFigAngle
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Resets the attribute value of the angle for the specified photonics pinFig.

functions.name: dbUnsetPhotonicPinFigRadius
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Resets the attribute value of the radius for the specified photonics pinFig.

functions.name: dbUnsetPhotonicPinFigWidth
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1 Photonics Only) Resets the attribute value of the width for the specified photonics pinFig.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideKeepoutSpacing
functions.description: This function deletes the keepoutSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: This function deletes layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideMinPinSpacing
functions.description: This function deletes the minSpacing constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideMinPinWidth
functions.description: This function deletes the minWidth constraint on the given pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinGroupGuideValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: This function deletes the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinMinPinSpacing
functions.description: This function deletes the minSpacing constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbUnsetPinMinPinWidth
functions.description: This function deletes the minWidth constraint on the given pin.

functions.name: dbUnsetTermMustJoin
functions.description: Removes the mustJoin pin connection status from the given terminal.

functions.name: dbValidP
functions.description: Determines if the argument is a valid database object ID.

functions.description: Returns a list of all the vias in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbWeaklyConnectPins
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. Weak pin connections are modeled by pinFigs on different pins on the same terminal.
