functions.name: geDeleteInstProbe
functions.description: Deletes an instance probe from a window.

functions.name: geDeleteInstViewLevel
functions.description: Removes all instance-specific view levels associated with an instance ID.

functions.name: geDeleteNetProbe
functions.description: Deletes a net probe from a window.

functions.name: geDeleteTermProbe

functions.description: Removes vertices from the selected set if they pass the selection filter.

functions.name: geEditSingleObject

functions.description: Deletes an instance probe from a window.

functions.syntax: geEnterDeleteNetProbe(  [ w_windowId ]  [ lt_probeSpec ]  [ g_repeatCmd ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a net probe from a window.

functions.name: geEnterDeleteTermProbe
functions.description: Deletes a terminal probe from a window.

functions.name: geEquivWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of a window that has the same edit cellview as the specified window.

functions.name: geEquivWindowSet
functions.description: Returns a list of all windows that have the same edit cellview as the specified window.

functions.name: geExplainProbe
functions.description: Explains the probes in a window.

functions.name: geFindPathToCellViewInst
functions.description: Returns a hierarchical path of one of the references to a particular master in a cellview. This function returns the closest reference with the fewest levels of hierarchy.

functions.name: geGetAdjustedPath
functions.syntax: geGetAdjustedPath(  w_winId  t_pathList  [ d_cellview ]  [ t_viewnameList ]  ) => t_adjustedPathList
functions.description: Reduces the given hierarchical net path to the shortest hierarchical name that is equivalent to this net.

functions.name: geGetAllAreaViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves all area view levels set for a window. The view levels are returned as a list with the start level and stop level for the areas.

functions.name: geGetAllInstViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves the start level and stop level assigned within a window. The start level and stop level are returned as a list of integers. If no start level and stop level are defined, then nil is returned.

functions.name: geGetAllProbe
functions.description: Gets a list of all the probes in a window.

functions.name: geGetAreaViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves an area view level overlapping a bounding box. The view level is returned as a list with the start level and stop level for that area. If more than one area overlaps the given box, the first area found is used.

functions.name: geGetBackgroundCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview used for the background cellview.

functions.name: geGetCellViewWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of a window in which the specified cellview is displayed.

functions.name: geGetCrossProbeValue
functions.description: Queries the view type to see if it is set.

functions.name: geGetCurrentHilightSet
functions.description: Retrieves the current highlight set.

functions.name: geGetCurrentWindowHilightSet
functions.description: Returns the window highlight set which is at the top of the window highlight stack.

functions.name: geGetDisabledMenus
functions.description: Given a windowId, returns all the disabled submenus for all banner menus on that window. If menuList is specified, only the disabled submenus on those banner menus are returned.

functions.name: geGetEditCellView
functions.description: Returns the ID for the cellview being edited.

functions.name: geGetEditCellViewWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the edit cellview.

functions.name: geGetEditRep
functions.description: An alias for geGetEditCellView. Returns the ID for the cellview being edited.

functions.name: geGetEnablePredicate
functions.description: Returns the enable predicate of the menu for the application named appName or nil if undefined.

functions.name: geGetFigHilightObjectId
functions.description: Returns the highlight object ID of the object d_figId in the highlight set g_hlSetId.

functions.name: geGetHierMemInst
functions.description: Returns a list describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place to arrive at the cellview in the window.

functions.name: geGetHilightObjectFigId
functions.description: Returns the figure ID of the highlighted object.

functions.name: geGetInstHier
functions.description: Returns a string describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place in the current window to arrive at the cellview in the window.

functions.name: geGetInstHierPath
functions.description: Similar to geGetInstHier but returns additional information for mosaic instances.   This function returns a list of list describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place in the current window to arrive at the cellview in the window. The list contains the following information for each instance:  (dbinst memInst row column)

functions.name: geGetInstTransform
functions.syntax: geGetInstTransform(  d_InstId  )  => list( list( xOffset yOffset ) rotation magnification )
functions.description: Evaluates a path to an instance returned by dbGetTrueOverlaps and concatenates the overall offset, transform, and magnification of the instance placed within the design hierarchy. The value returned by geGetInstTransform is a three member list containing the values of the three variables mentioned above. This transform list can be passed to the functions dbCopyFig or dbMoveFig as their third argument to copy or move the shape to the cellView passed to dbGetTrueOverlaps as its first argument.

functions.name: geGetInstViewLevel
functions.description: Retrieves the start level and stop level of an instance. The start level and stop level are returned as a list of integers. If start level and stop level are not defined for the chosen instance, nil is returned.

functions.name: geGetLockInfo
functions.syntax: geGetLockInfo(  t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t_userHostInfo / no data on lock available
functions.description: Returns the user and host from a .cdslck file.

functions.name: geGetMarkerDisplayText
functions.description: Displays the text associated with a marker.

functions.name: geGetMarkerOwner
functions.description: Displays the owner of a marker.

functions.name: geGetMarkerReason
functions.description: Displays the reason for a marker.

functions.name: geGetMarkerType
functions.description: Displays the type of a marker.

functions.name: geGetNetNameDisplayFilter
functions.description: Returns the net name filtering settings currently in use for the given cellview.

functions.name: geGetObjectSelectedSet
functions.syntax: geGetObjectSelectedSet(  [ d_cellview ]  )  => list( 	list(d_selectedObject 		list( 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				... 		) 	list(d_selectedObject 		list( 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column)) 				... 		) 	... ) => l_selectedSet
functions.description: Returns a list of lists describing objects selected in the hierarchy of the given cellview. If the cellview is omitted, the current edit cellview of the current window is used. For each object in the selected set, the path to it consisting of the instance ID, the member instance, the row, and the column is given.

functions.name: geGetPotentialSelection
functions.syntax: geGetPotentialSelection(  [ w_windowId ] [ g_ignoreSelect]  [ l_point] ) => ((d_figId l_path) g_isAllSelected [l_selArray]) / nil
functions.description: Returns the figure ID of the object which can be selected, hierarchical path of the figure, and indicates if the figure is fully or partially selected.

functions.name: geGetProbeNetFilter
functions.description: Returns the net filtering settings of the Highlight Options form currently in use for the given cellview.

functions.name: geGetProbeNetStopLevel
functions.description: Gets the display stop level of net probes.

functions.name: geGetProbeUserLPP
functions.description: Gets the layer-purpose pair to be used by the geAdd*Probe functions if no layer-purpose pair is passed into these functions.

functions.name: geGetScrollPercent
functions.description: Obtains the percentage used by geScroll when shifting the drawing.

functions.name: geGetSelProtectedObjects
functions.description: Returns a list of all the objects that are marked protected in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelSet
functions.description: Returns a list of the currently selected objects in a window or cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelSetCount
functions.description: Counts selected objects in a cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelSetFigPoint
functions.description: Returns a list indicating whether points are selected for an object.

functions.name: geGetSelectedInstancesCount
functions.description: Counts selected instances in a cellview.

functions.name: geGetSelectedSet
functions.description: Returns a list of selected objects in a cellview.

functions.name: geGetSortedSelectByLine
functions.description: Returns the sorted list of the crossed objects by the line.

functions.name: geGetStoredSelectionSets
functions.description: Returns the list of names for the stored selection sets in the given cellview.

functions.name: geGetTopCellViewWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the top cellview.

functions.name: geGetTopLevelCellView
functions.description: Returns the ID of the top-level cellview displayed in a window.

functions.name: geGetWindowBox
functions.description: Returns the lower left and upper right coordinates of the current window display.

functions.name: geGetWindowCellView
functions.description: Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window.

functions.name: geGetWindowRep
functions.description: An alias for geGetWindowCellView. Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window.   This function returns nil if the current window is empty or if no current window is defined. The cellview being displayed in the window can be different from the cellview being edited, as returned by geGetEditCellView, if you are currently editing a cell in place.

functions.name: geGetWindowSelProtectionHighlight
functions.description: Returns whether or not the protected objects in the specified window are highlighted.

functions.name: geGetWindowSelProtectionSelectability
functions.description: Returns whether or not the protected objects in the specified window can be selected.

functions.name: geGetWindowStatus
functions.description: Returns the status for the application named appName on the window windowId.

functions.name: geHasMarker
functions.syntax: geHasMarker(  d_cellview  [ l_owner ]  [ l_type ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Queries whether the cellview contains any markers with owner l_owner and type l_type.

functions.name: geHiCommonFindMarker
functions.description: Opens the Find Marker form and highlights the current marker in the current window.

functions.name: geHiDeleteAllMarker
functions.description: Displays a form that prompts you to select the markers to be deleted from the current cellview.

functions.name: geHiDeleteMarker
functions.description: Deletes the current marker in the current window.

functions.name: geHiDisplaySelectionForm
functions.description: Opens a form that allows you to manage selection options.

functions.syntax: geHiDragFig( w_windowID  r_form t_srcPrompt t_dstPrompt t_cmdName t_SelSet g_useMultiWindow [ l_firstPoint ] )
functions.description: Used in conjunction with other SKILL functions to implement the dragging of selected database figures.

functions.name: geHiExplainMarker
functions.description: Explains the current marker in the current cellview.

functions.name: geHiFindMarker
functions.description: Highlights the current marker in the current window.

functions.name: geHiSetSelProtectionEF
functions.description: Starts an enter function to set selection protection.

functions.name: geHiStoreSelectionForm
functions.description: Opens the Save/Restore Selection Set form.

functions.name: geHiUnsetSelProtectionEF
functions.description: Starts an enter function to remove selection protection.

functions.name: geHighlightProtected
functions.description: Displays a halo around objects that are protected from being selected in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geInsertHilightObjectsInGroup
functions.description: Groups all given highlight objects together.

functions.name: geInstIdToFileSpec
functions.description: Creates a fileSpec (disassociated property list) from the data in an instance and the given mode.

functions.name: geIsAutoStoreSelectionOn
functions.description: Returns true if the auto store selection set feature is enable.

functions.name: geIsFigAllSelected
functions.description: Checks whether an object is completely selected.

functions.name: geIsFigPartiallySelected
functions.description: Checks whether an object is partially, but not completely, selected.

functions.name: geIsFigSelected
functions.description: Checks whether an object is at least partially selected.

functions.name: geIsGraphicalWindow
functions.description: This function tests if the specified window (or by default, the current window) is a graphical window.

functions.name: geIsMarkerShape
functions.description: Checks whether a shape was created as a marker.

functions.name: geIsNetNameDisplayActiveOnWindow
functions.description: Checks whether the Net Name Display functionality is supported for the given window ID.

functions.name: geIsNetNameDisplayEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether the Net Name Display functionality is enabled for the given window ID.

functions.name: geIsObjectAllSelected
functions.description: Tests if the specified figure is fully selected.

functions.name: geIsObjectPartiallySelected
functions.description: Tests if the specified figure is partially selected.

functions.name: geIsObjectSelected
functions.description: Tests if the specified figure is partially or fully selected.

functions.name: geIsPathReentrant
functions.syntax: geIsPathReentrant(  d_cellview  l_points  n_width  [ t_style ]  [ n_beginExt ]  [ n_endExt ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether a path is self-intersecting.

functions.name: geIsPolygonReentrant
functions.description: Determines whether a polygon is self-intersecting.

functions.name: geIsSelProtection
functions.description: Returns whether the specified object in the specified window is protected from being selected.

functions.name: geIsValidHilightGroup
functions.description: Determines whether the highlighted group is valid.

functions.name: geIsValidHilightId
functions.description: This function determines whether a highlight ID is valid.

functions.name: geIsValidHilightObject
functions.description: Determines whether the highlighted object is valid.

functions.name: geIsValidHilightSet
functions.description: Determines whether a highlight set is valid.

functions.description: Creates an icon from a SKILL file.

functions.syntax: geLoadNextProbe(  [ w_window ]  [ p_port ]  [ s_prop ]  [ s_cond ] [ g_value ]  [ s_loadCount ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Loads a probe into a window. Identical to geLoadProbe except that s_loadCount is a symbol containing the index of the probe to be loaded.

functions.name: geLoadProbe
functions.syntax: geLoadProbe(  [ w_windowId ]  [ p_port ]  [ s_prop ]  [ s_cond ]  [ g_value ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Loads probes into a window.

functions.syntax: geMakeProbeWithColor(  [ ?window w_windowId ] [ ?name t_name ] [ ?object g_object ] [ ?otherObject g_otherObject ] [ ?color g_color ] [ ?probeType t_probeType ] [ ?displayStyle t_displayStyle ]  [ ?viewTypeList l_viewTypesToCrossProbe ]  [ ?message t_messageString ]  ) => o_probeObject
functions.description: Creates a probe of the specified type and gives it the specified color.

functions.name: geMakeProbeWithLabel
functions.syntax: geMakeProbeWithLabel(  [ ?window w_windowId ] [ ?name t_name ]  [ ?object g_object ]  [ ?otherObject g_otherObject ] [ ?label g_label ] [ ?probeType t_probeType ] [ ?displayStyle t_displayStyle ] [ ?viewTypeList l_viewTypesToCrossProbe ] [ ?message t_messageString ] [ ?labelName t_labelName ] [ ?labelColor l_labelColor ] [ ?labelOffset l_labelOffset ] [ ?labelFont t_labelFont ] [ ?labelFontSize f_labelFontSize ] [ ?labelJust t_labelJust ] [ ?labelOrient t_labelOrient ] )  => o_probeObjectId
functions.description: Creates a probe and gives it the specified label.

functions.syntax: geMakeProbeWithOnColor(  [ ?window w_windowId ] [ ?name t_name ] [ ?object g_object ] [ ?otherObject g_otherObject ] [ ?onColor g_onColor ] [ ?probeType t_probeType ] [ ?displayStyle t_displayStyle ] [ ?viewTypeList g_viewTypesToCrossProbe ] [ ?message t_messageString ] ) => o_probeObjectId
functions.description: Creates an instance probe and gives it the specified color.

functions.syntax: geMakeProbeWithoutColor(  [ ?window w_windowId ] [ ?name t_name ] [ ?object g_object ] [ ?otherObject g_otherObject ] [ ?probeType t_probeType ] [ ?viewTypeList l_viewTypesToCrossProbe ] [ ?message t_messageString ] ) => o_probeObject
functions.description: Creates a probe of the specified type without specifying any colors. The object is highlighted when it is found by specifying the color defined in the geProbeOptionForm. This form can accessed from Option - Probe.

functions.name: geMenuForObjectsUnderPoint
functions.description: Creates the (De)Select Under Cursor menu for the specified window and point.

functions.name: geNetNameDisplayOptionForm
functions.description: Opens the Net Name Display Options form. This SKILL function is supported only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

functions.name: geNewWindow
functions.description: Makes a copy of a window.

functions.name: geOpen
functions.syntax: geOpen(  [ ?window w_windowId ] [ ?lib t_lib ] [ ?cell t_cell ] [ ?view t_view ] [ ?viewType t_viewType ] [ ?mode t_mode ] ) => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Opens a design in a new window.

functions.name: gePointQuery
functions.syntax: gePointQuery(  w_windowId  l_point  t_filterProc  ) => d_figId / nil
functions.description: Returns the ID of the object found at the point l_point.

functions.name: gePointToFig
functions.syntax: gePointToFig(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_ignoreSelect ]  [ l_list ]  ) => d_figure / nil
functions.description: Returns the ID of the object located at the coordinates given in l_list.

functions.name: gePopHilightStack
functions.description: Pops the current highlight set out of the highlight stack.

functions.name: gePopWindowHilightStack
functions.description: Pops the current window highlight set out of the window highlight stack.

functions.name: gePrintAllProbe
functions.description: Prints a list of the probes in a window.

functions.name: geProbeP
functions.description: Checks if the value passed in is a probe.

functions.name: gePush
functions.syntax: gePush(  w_windowId  t_accessMode  d_instId  x_iteration x_row  x_col  [ g_cancel ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Pushes into an instance.

functions.name: gePushHilightStack
functions.description: Pushes a highlight set into the highlight stack of the cellview to which the highlight belongs.

functions.name: geQuerySelSet
functions.description: Displays the properties of each object in the selected set.

functions.name: geRefresh
functions.description: Redraws all areas of all windows that have not been updated since the last redraw and need redrawing.

functions.name: geRefreshCellView
functions.description: Redraws a cellview when necessary. If a bounding box is specified, only the specified area is redrawn.

functions.name: geRefreshCellViews
functions.description: Displays a form that shows all cellviews from the specified cellview that have been modified by another process but not reread from disk. You can then select which ones should be refreshed. The top-level cellview is also checked for modification.

functions.name: geRefreshWindow
functions.description: Refreshes a window. If a bounding box is specified, only that area is refreshed.

functions.name: geRefreshWorldView
functions.description: Refreshes the worldView window.

functions.name: geRegCrossProbeTrigger
functions.syntax: geRegCrossProbeTrigger( g_ilFunc x_priority t_name ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a trigger function for cross probing.

functions.name: geRegSaveAllTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger name for the Save All form.

functions.name: geResetBackgroundCellView
functions.description: Resets the background cellview on the given window.

functions.name: geResetCellView
functions.description: Re-displays the last saved version of a cellview.

functions.name: geResetHilightSetAlphaBlendingParameters
functions.description: Resets the alpha blending values to maximum values (1000) for the given highlight set.

functions.name: geResetHilightSetHaloParameters
functions.description: Resets the halo parameters set on a highlight set.

functions.name: geRestoreWinView
functions.description: Restores the view saved with geSaveWinView.

functions.name: geReturn
functions.description: Returns to the previous (parent) level displayed in a window before a descend, edit in place, or switch was done.

functions.name: geReturnToLevel
functions.description: Displays a list box containing the levels to which you can return.

functions.name: geSave
functions.description: Saves a design.

functions.name: geSaveAs
functions.syntax: geSaveAs(  [ w_windowId ]  [ t_libName ]  [ t_cellName ] [ t_viewName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a design under another name.

functions.name: geSaveHier
functions.description: Saves a design hierarchically starting from the edit cellview of the specified window to the specified depth.

functions.name: geSaveIcon
functions.syntax: geSaveIcon(  [ w_windowId ]  [ t_iconName ]  [ t_fileName ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a cellview as a SKILL icon file.

functions.name: geSaveNetNameDisplayFilter
functions.description: Saves the net name filtering settings that are currently applied on the given cellview after the geSetNetNameDisplayFilter function is called. After you call the geSaveNetNameDisplayFilter, the settings will be reloaded automatically when you open the cellview in a new Virtuoso session.

functions.name: geSaveProbe
functions.description: Saves probes to a port.

functions.name: geSaveProbeNetFilter
functions.description: Saves the probe net filtering settings that are currently applied on the given cellview after the geSetProbeNetFilter function is called. After you call the geSaveProbeNetFilter, the settings are reloaded automatically when you open the cellview in a new Virtuoso session.

functions.name: geSaveWinView
functions.description: Saves the current view of w_windowId to t_name.

functions.name: geScroll
functions.syntax: geScroll(  [ w_windowId ]  [ t_dir ]  [ g_zoom ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Scrolls a view.

functions.name: geSelObjectsPartiallySelected
functions.description: Fully selects the objects that are partially selected in the specified window. If all objects are already fully selected, geSelObjectsPartiallySelected extends the selection according to the current selection granularity.

functions.name: geSelectAll
functions.description: Selects all objects in the specified window.

functions.name: geSelectAllFig
functions.description: Selects all objects in a cellview that pass the selection filter.

functions.name: geSelectArea
functions.syntax: geSelectArea(  [ w_windowId ]  [ l_points ]  [ t_areaShapeType ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the objects within the area defined by t_areaShapeType to the selection.

functions.name: geSelectBy2PointsLine
functions.description: Selects objects by drawing a line. Press Shift and draw a line to overlap the additional objects to be selected. Press Ctrl and draw a line to overlap the objects to be removed from the selected set. The selection is done when the second point is entered.

functions.name: geSelectByline
functions.description: Enables you to select objects by drawing a line. Press Shift and draw a line to overlap the additional objects to be selected. Press Ctrl and draw a line to overlap the objects to be removed from the selected set. Double-click to end the line.

functions.name: geSelectFig
functions.description: Adds an object to the selected set if it passes the selection filter.

functions.name: geSelectFigNoFilter
functions.description: Selects the specified figure regardless of the selection filter.

functions.name: geSelectFigPoint
functions.description: Adds vertices of an object to the selected set if they pass the selection filter.

functions.name: geSelectFigs
functions.description: Selects figures from a specified list of figures.

functions.name: geSelectNextAutoStoreSet
functions.description: Sets the next stored auto selection set as the current selection set. This function ends on the last stored selection set.

functions.name: geSelectNextInSelSet
functions.description: Selects an object from the selected set of objects in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geSelectObject
functions.description: Selects the specified figure at the specified hierarchical path, if it passes the selection criteria.

functions.name: geSelectObjectNoFilter
functions.description: Selects the specified figure at the specified hierarchical path.

functions.name: geSelectPoint
functions.description: Uses the given point to select the object. If there is no object at that location, no object is selected and nil is returned.

functions.name: geSelectPreviousAutoStoreSet
functions.description: Restores the previous stored auto selection set. This function ends on the first stored selection set.

functions.name: geSelectPreviousInSelSet
functions.description: Selects the last selected object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geSelectProtected
functions.description: Selects the objects that are protected from being selected in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geSelectStoredSelectionSet
functions.description: Adds the elements of the specified selection set into the current selection set of the given cellview.

functions.name: geSelectToggleObject
functions.description: Toggles the state of the selected objects in the specified window. This means that the function deselects the selected objects and selects the remaining objects.

functions.name: geSelectViaPile
functions.description: Extends the selection set by adding via pile for each via selected. If the selection set does not contain vias, nil is returned.

functions.name: geSetAreaViewLevel
functions.syntax: geSetAreaViewLevel(  [ w_windowId ]  l_bBox  [ n_start ]  [ n_stop ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets display start and stop threshold levels for an area independently of the window levels.

functions.name: geSetAutoStoreSelection
functions.description: Enables the auto store selection set feature on a cellview. Stored selection sets are remembered as long as the cellview is open. Once the cellview is closed, the recorded information is lost.

functions.name: geSetBackgroundCellView
functions.syntax: geSetBackgroundCellView(  w_windowId  d_cellViewId | l_libName, cellName, viewName [ l_transform ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a background cellview on specified window. A cellview ID or a list of libName, cellName, and viewName can be given.

functions.name: geSetCrossProbeValue
functions.description: Sets the view types to cross-probe.

functions.name: geSetEnablePredicate
functions.description: Sets the enable predicate of the r_menu for t_appName to n_enablePredicate.

functions.name: geSetEnterFunctionSelectionMode
functions.description: Sets the selection mode for the enter function associated with the specified window.

functions.name: geSetHilightSetAlphaBlendingParameters
functions.syntax: geSetHilightSetAlphaBlendingParameters(  g_hSetId g_halo g_fill g_outLine )  => t / nil
functions.description: This function sets the alpha blending values for the specified highlight set.

functions.name: geSetHilightSetHaloParameters
functions.syntax: geSetHilightSetHaloParameters( h_hlSetId g_haloPosition g_haloType g_haloThickNess g_haloTransparency [ g_drawStroke ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the halos parameters on the given highlight set in order to draw the set with halos.

functions.name: geSetInstViewLevel
functions.syntax: geSetInstViewLevel(  w_windowId  d_instId  n_start  n_stop  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets display start and stop threshold levels for an instance independently of the window levels.

functions.name: geSetLimitedProbe
functions.description: Sets the specified probe as a directed probe.

functions.name: geSetMaxCreatedProbe
functions.description: Sets the maximum number of created probes.

functions.name: geSetNetNameDisplayFilter
functions.syntax: geSetNetNameDisplayFilter(  d_cellview  t_mode l_netNames ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a net name filtering on the given cellview. You can control which nets are displayed or not by the net name display feature.

functions.name: geSetProbeDirection
functions.description: Sets the specified probe as a directed probe.

functions.name: geSetProbeNetFilter
functions.syntax: geSetProbeNetFilter(  d_cellview  t_mode l_netNames ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets a net filtering for probe on the given cellview.

functions.name: geSetProbeNetStopLevel
functions.description: Sets the display stop level of net probes.

functions.name: geSetProbeUserLPP
functions.description: Sets the layer-purpose pair to be used by the geAdd*Probe functions if no layer-purpose pair is passed in to these functions.

functions.name: geSetScrollPercent
functions.description: Controls the percentage of the drawing currently visible that is shifted when geScroll is activated.

functions.name: geSetSelProtection
functions.syntax: geSetSelProtection(  [ d_cellview ] | [ d_figId ] | [ l_figId ] ) => l_results / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified object as protected, which prevents it from being selected. If no figId is specified, the selected objects in the specified or in the current cellview are set as protected.

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionAllObjects
functions.description: Sets all the objects in the specified cellview as protected, which prevents them from being selected.

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptionForm
functions.description: Opens the Selection Protection Highlight Options form where you can configure the settings for highlighting protected objects.

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptions
functions.syntax: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptions(  w_window d_cellview [ l_options ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the highlight options for objects that are marked protected.

functions.name: geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle
functions.syntax: geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle(  d_probeId g_trueColorProbeVal g_probeHighlightVal )  => t / nil
functions.description: This function sets the trueColorProbeVal and probeHighlightVal options of the specified probeId.

functions.name: geSetWindowStatus
functions.description: Sets the status for w_windowId and t_appName to n_status.

functions.name: geShareWindowHilightSet
functions.description: Shares the given window highlight set with other windows.

functions.name: geShift
functions.description: Shifts w_windowId in the direction t_dir.

functions.name: geSingleSelectBox
functions.syntax: geSingleSelectBox(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_point ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the single mode of area selection.

functions.name: geSingleSelectPoint
functions.syntax: geSingleSelectPoint(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_point ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the single mode of point selection.

functions.name: geStoreSelectionSet
functions.description: Records the current selection set into the cellview manual store selection set list.

functions.name: geSubSelectBox
functions.syntax: geSubSelectBox(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_bBox ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the sub mode of area selection.

functions.name: geSubSelectPoint
functions.syntax: geSubSelectPoint(  [ w_windowId ]  [ g_partial ]  [ l_point ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Implements the sub mode of point selection.

functions.name: geSwitch
functions.syntax: geSwitch(  w_windowId  t_accessMode  d_instId  x_iteration  x_row  x_col  [ g_cancel ] ) => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Switches into an instance.

functions.name: geSwitchInContext
functions.syntax: geSwitchInContext(  w_windowId  t_accessMode  d_instId  x_iteration  x_row  x_col  [ verbose ] ) => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Switches into an instance by using the view name specified in the hierarchy manager configuration context. If the correct configuration context is not found, this function uses the geSwitch command to perform the switch.

functions.name: geToggleAreaSelectOption
functions.description: Toggles area selection mode.

functions.name: geToggleDisplayResolution
functions.description: Rotates the value of the graphic environment variable displayResolution between the values Very High, High, Medium, and Low. This function is bound to the F9 bindkey in the default layout editor bindkeys.

functions.name: geToggleFilterSize
functions.description: Rotates the value of the graphic environment variable filterSize between the values 0.0, 3.0, 10.0, 25.0, and 50.0. This function is bound to the F9 bindkey in the default layout editor bindkeys.

functions.name: geTogglePartialSelect
functions.description: Toggles partial selection off and on.

functions.name: geToggleWindowSelProtectionHighlight
functions.description: Toggles the highlight state of protected objects in the specified window.

functions.name: geToggleWindowSelProtectionSelectability
functions.description: Toggles the selectability state of protected objects in the specified window.

functions.name: geTransformUserBBox
functions.description: Transforms the specified bounding box by a list describing the offset, orientation, and magnification.

functions.name: geTransformUserPoint
functions.description: Transforms a coordinate pair by the displacement and rotation passed in.

functions.name: geTransparencyOptions
functions.description: (ICADVM18.1) This form opens the Transparency Options form.

functions.name: geUnRegCrossProbeTrigger
functions.description: Removes the cross probe trigger, if one is registered.

functions.name: geUnhighlightProtected
functions.description: Removes the halo from the objects marked as protected in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geUnsetAllSelProtection
functions.description: Removes the selection protection from all the protected objects in the specified cellview.

functions.name: geUnsetSelProtection
functions.syntax: geUnsetSelProtection(  [ d_cellview ] | [ d_figId ] | [ l_figId ] ) => l_results / nil
functions.description: Removes the selection protection from the specified protected objects. If no figId is specified, protection of the selected objects in the specified or in the current cellview is removed.

functions.name: geUpdateWindowMenus
functions.description: Updates the enabled status of all the menu items in the window's banner menu hierarchy and all of the window's fixed menu items.

functions.name: geValidateWindow
functions.description: Verifies the database ID of a window.

functions.name: geWindowToEditPoint
functions.description: Translates coordinate values when you are using edit in place. geWindowToEditPoint applies the top-level cellview's coordinates to the cellview being edited; geEditToWindowPoint does the reverse.

functions.name: geWriteCellView
functions.syntax: geWriteCellView(  d_cellview  t_libName  t_cellName t_viewName  [ t_version ]  [ d_contextId ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a copy of a cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToBackgroundAndEditCV
functions.description: When a background cellview is set on the window, zooms to fit the background cellview and the current edit cellview. If a background cellview is not set on the window, zooms to fit the current edit cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToBackgroundCV
functions.description: When a background cellview is set on the window, zooms to fit the background cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToGrid
functions.description: Zooms in on a subject up to the last point at which the major grid is still visible.

functions.name: geiLoadProbe
functions.description: Displays the Load Probes form.

functions.name: geiSaveProbe
functions.description: Displays the Save Probes form.

functions.name: getCurrentWindow
functions.description: The getCurrentWindow function is an alias for the hiGetCurrentWindow function.

functions.name: getMaxScreenCoords
functions.description: The getMaxScreenCoords function is an alias for the hiGetMaxScreenCoords function.

functions.name: hdbAddConfigToBag
functions.description: Adds a configuration handle to a configuration bag.

functions.name: hdbBind
functions.syntax: hdbBind( h_pathVector t_masterLibName t_masterCellName t_masterViewName t_instName g_fixedLib g_fixedCell g_fixedView [ g_wantSignature ] [ g_wantWhy ] )  => ( t_boundLibId t_boundCellId t_boundView h_bindSignature h_bindWhy )
functions.description: Binds an instance to a master.

functions.name: hdbBindBit
functions.syntax: hdbBindBit( h_pathVector t_masterLibName t_masterCellName t_masterViewName t_baseInstName x_bit x_leftRangeIndex x_rightRangeIndex g_fixedLib g_fixedCell g_fixedView [ g_wantSignature ] [ g_wantWhy ] ) => ( t_boundLib t_boundCell t_boundView h_bindSignatureId h_bindWhyId )
functions.description: Binds a single bit of an iterated instance.

functions.name: hdbBitHasRules
functions.syntax: hdbBitHasRules( h_hdbPathVector t_baseInstName x_bit ) => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether a bit-specific configuration rule applies to the specified iterated instance bit.

functions.name: hdbClose
functions.description: Closes a configuration. In all cases where you are using the hdb interface to traverse (bind, elaborate) a design use hdbCloseConfigsInBag to close open configurations instead of this function.

functions.name: hdbCloseConfigsInBag
functions.description: Closes all of the configurations held in a configuration bag.

functions.name: hdbCreateConfigBag
functions.description: Creates a configuration bag to hold configurations.

functions.name: hdbCreatePathVector
functions.description: Creates a path vector to use while traversing (elaborating) a design hierarchy.

functions.name: hdbCreatePathVectorStack
functions.description: Creates a stack to hold path vectors when traversing into sub-configurations.

functions.name: hdbDestroyPathVector
functions.description: Destroys a path vector.

functions.name: hdbExplainBinding
functions.syntax: hdbExplainBinding( t_indentation t_masterLibName t_masterCellName t_masterViewName t_instName g_fixedLib g_fixedCell g_fixedView t_boundLib t_boundCell t_boundView h_bindSignatureId h_bindWhyId )  => t_string
functions.description: Explains why a hdbBind binding was made the way it was.

functions.name: hdbExplainSignature
functions.description: Explains the contents of a binding signature.

functions.name: hdbExplainStop
functions.description: Explains why a stop was declared.

functions.name: hdbGetCellName
functions.description: Gets the cell name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetLibName
functions.description: Gets the library name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetPathStackStr
functions.description: Creates a string listing all the path vectors. Creates something similar to a fully rooted path for a design binding that contains sub-configurations.

functions.name: hdbGetPathStr
functions.description: Creates a string representation of a path vector.

functions.name: hdbGetPathVectorStackTop
functions.description: Gets the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbGetTopCellName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top cell of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetTopLibName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top library of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetTopViewName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top view pointed to by h_hdbConfig.

functions.name: hdbGetViewName
functions.description: Gets the view name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbHasIterInstBitRules
functions.description: Determines whether a configuration contains rules that apply to iterated instance bits.

functions.name: hdbIsAtStopPoint
functions.description: Checks if the point just pushed into with hdbPushCell is a stop point.

functions.name: hdbIsConfig
functions.syntax: hdbIsConfig( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Checks if a given library/cell/view is a configuration.

functions.name: hdbIsIterInst
functions.syntax: hdbIsIterInst( t_instName  [ t_nameSpace ] ) => (t_baseInstName t_leftIndex t_rightIndex) / nil
functions.description: Determines whether an instance name is of an iterated instance. If it is of an iterated instance, the base instance name and range indexes are returned.

functions.name: hdbIsOpenConfig
functions.description: Checks if the configuration ID you specify is valid. The configuration ID is valid if the configuration is still open.

functions.name: hdbIterInstHasBitRules
functions.syntax: hdbIterInstHasBitRules( h_pathVectorId t_baseInstName x_leftRangeIndex x_rightRangeIndex ) => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether an iterated instance has bit-specific configuration rules. If it does, you might want to check whether the binding for individual bits of the iterated instance are different from the iterated instance binding.

functions.name: hdbOpen
functions.syntax: hdbOpen( t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName  t_mode  [ t_nameSpace ] )  => h_configId / nil
functions.description: Opens a configuration for read or edit.

functions.name: hdbPopCell
functions.description: Pops an entry off a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPopPathVect
functions.description: Pops a path vector off the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbPushBitCell
functions.syntax: hdbPushBitCell( h_pathVectorId t_baseInstName x_bit  x_leftRangeIndex x_rightRangeIndex t_libName t_cellName t_viewName [ h_bindWhy ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Pushes the cell of an iterated instance bit on to a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPushCell
functions.syntax: hdbPushCell( h_pathVectorId  t_instanceName  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Push a cell onto a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPushPathVect
functions.description: Adds a path vector on to the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbReOpenNewConfig
functions.description: Increments the reference count of an in-memory only configuration (that is, a new configuration that has not yet been written to disk) and returns t. If the configuration does not exist in memory or if it already exists on disk, this function returns nil and the reference count is not incremented.

functions.name: hdbSave
functions.description: Saves a configuration opened with hdbOpen.

functions.name: hdbSaveACopy
functions.syntax: hdbSaveACopy( h_configId  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Makes a copy of a configuration and saves it to a library/cell/view. Unlike hdbSaveAs, this function does not modify the location of the configuration associated with the specified configId.

functions.name: hdbSaveAs
functions.syntax: hdbSaveAs( h_configId  t_libName  t_cellName  t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a configuration to a library/cell/view.

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultLibListString
functions.description: Sets the global library list in the configuration specified by the h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultStopListString
functions.description: Sets the global stop view list in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultViewListString
functions.description: Sets the global view list in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetObjBindRule
functions.syntax: hdbSetObjBindRule( h_configId g_specifier g_rule ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets or deletes a binding rule on a cell, instance, or occurrence (path). You can set the following binding rules: library list, view list, binding, or stop point.

functions.name: hdbSetTopCellViewName
functions.syntax: hdbSetTopCellViewName( h_configID t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the top of the design hierarchy to library.cell:view in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hiAbout
functions.description: Displays an application's product information window, which includes the release version and copyright information. If w_windowId is a session window, the product information is about the window that is displayed in the top tab.

functions.name: hiAbsolutePan
functions.syntax: hiAbsolutePan( [ w_window ]  [ n_%x ]  [ n_%y ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Scrolls a window in any direction by specifying the amount to pan as a percentage of the window size.

functions.name: hiAddCyclicChoice
functions.syntax: hiAddCyclicChoice(  r_form  s_cyclicField  g_newChoice  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the new entry to the end of the list of choices in the cyclic field in the form.

functions.name: hiAddField
functions.syntax: hiAddField(  g_formRegionOrLayout g_field  [ x_attachment | s_layout [ l_field_controls ] ]  ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a field to a form. The form must already exist, and the field must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

functions.name: hiAddFields
functions.syntax: hiAddFields(  g_formRegionOrLayout l_items [ g_attachmentsOrLayout ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds fields to a form. The form must already exist, and the fields must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

functions.name: hiAddFixedMenu
functions.syntax: hiAddFixedMenu(  [ ?window w_window ]  ?fixedMenu g_fixedMenu  [ ?menuSide s_menuSide ]  [ ?append g_append ] [ ?newLine g_newLine ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: NOTE: Fixed menus are no longer supported in windows. Use the new toolbar functions to create toolbars instead for windows. Existing fixed menus that have been added to windows will no longer be displayed, although they will not generate any warnings. Replace these menus with toolbars.

functions.name: hiAddItemToLayout
functions.syntax: hiAddItemToLayout(  g_formRegionOrLayout  g_item  [ ?layoutControls l_layoutControls ]  [ ?toLayout s_layoutName ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the required controls to the layout.

functions.name: hiAddMenuItem
functions.description: Adds the menu item or action to the end of all instances of the specified hiMenu.

functions.name: hiAddNonRepeatPrefix
functions.description: Adds a string to the list of repeat filter strings. All strings will be compared on every command run.

functions.name: hiAddTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Adds characters to the word delimiter list for the window.

functions.name: hiAddToolbarItem
functions.description: Adds one toolbar item to a toolbar. The item is added to the end of the toolbar.

functions.name: hiAddToolbarItems
functions.description: Adds a list of toolbar items to a toolbar. The items are added at the end of the toolbar.

functions.name: hiAdvanceProgressBarOneStep
functions.description: Increments the  progress bar by one step for the window specified.

functions.name: hiAppendInputCmd
functions.description: Appends a command to the input area of an encapsulation window.

functions.name: hiApplyWinConfig
functions.description: Applies a workspace to a session window. If the session window has toolbars and dock assistants that were not present when the workspace was created, they will be hidden.

functions.name: hiBindKeyModifiers
functions.description: Returns the list of modifiers that can be used with bindkeys in the current session. You can specify the type of keys for which you want the list of legal modifiers: printable, mouse, or function.

functions.name: hiBoxCenter
functions.description: Returns the center point of a bounding box.

functions.name: hiCancelProgressBox
functions.description: Programmatically cancels a progress dialog box. The callback procedure for the dialog box, if any, will be called.

functions.name: hiChangeBannerLabel
functions.syntax: hiChangeBannerLabel( w_windowId  t_bannerLabel  x_labelPosition  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Overwrites an existing label or adds a new label in the banner bar of a window.

functions.name: hiChangeFormCallback
functions.description: Changes the doneAction and/or the cancelAction of the specified form to the SKILL callback procedure defined by newCallback. newCallback can be a symbol, a string, a function object,or a list of two symbols/strings/function objects. The first callback will be taken as the doneAction. The second callback will be taken as the cancelAction. After this routine is called, if the OK or Apply button of the form is pressed, the doneAction is executed, and if the Cancel button is pressed, the cancelAction is executed.

functions.name: hiChangeFormTitle
functions.description: Changes the window manager title of the specified form to t_newTitle.

functions.name: hiCheckAbort
functions.description: Returns the value of the global abort flag.

functions.name: hiClearClipboard
functions.description: Clears the text stored in the system clipboard.

functions.name: hiClearCurrentTextSelection
functions.description: Clears current selection, if any, in the specified text window. This is equivalent to clicking anywhere in the text window when text is selected.

functions.name: hiCloseWindow
functions.description: Closes and destroys a window, dock window, or session window.

functions.name: hiCollapseTreeItem
functions.description: Collapses the tree item you specify. This function also executes the collapse callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiConfigureBindKeys
functions.syntax: hiConfigureBindKeys( ?showOnlyApps l_apps ?showAllChildren g_showAllChildren ?selectApp t_appname ?selectKeyBinding t_keyBinding ?showEmptyApps g_showEmptyApps ?showInheritedBindings g_showInheritedBindings )  => t / nil
functions.description: Resets and displays the Bindkey Configuration form according to the supplied arguments. If the form is currently open, and contains unsaved changes, it will prompt before resetting the data.

functions.name: hiCreate2DMenu
functions.description: Creates a two-dimensional popup menu. Once this menu is created, you can display it with hiDisplayMenu or associate it with a window using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiCreateAction
functions.syntax: hiCreateAction( ?name s_name [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?icon g_icon ] [ ?iconText t_iconText ] [ ?toolTip t_tooltip ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?checkable g_checkable ] [ ?checked g_checked ] [ ?defAction g_defaultAction ] [ ?actionList l_actionList ] [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?useNameForIconText g_useNameForIconText ] ) => o_action
functions.description: Creates an action for a toolbar or menu. An action is a toolbar or menu item that, when clicked, triggers a callback. Actions are typically used for common commands that are added to multiple places in the user interface, such as toolbars and menus. An action present in both a toolbar and a menu remains synchronized; for example, if it is selected from the toolbar, the corresponding menu item is also checked.

functions.name: hiCreateAppForm
functions.syntax: hiCreateAppForm(  ?name s_name  ?fields l_fieldEntries  [ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ] [ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ] [ ?formTitle t_formTitle ]  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?unmapAfterCB g_unmapAfterCB ]  [ ?mapCB g_mapCallback ] [ ?formType s_formType ]  [ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ] [ ?buttonLayout g_buttonLayout ]  [ ?buttonDisabled s_buttonDisabled ] [ ?help g_help ]  [ ?initialSize g_initialSize ] [ ?minSize g_minSize ] [ ?maxSize g_maxSize ] [ ?dontBlock g_dontBlock ] [ ?fieldFocus s_fieldFocus ] [ ?plist g_plist ] [ ?baseName s_baseName ] )  => r_form
functions.description: Returns the SKILL representation of a form with the specified field entries, setting it to the specified name. All standard forms, from simple forms to property lists, are generated using hiCreateAppForm, with varying field entries. Use this function instead of hiCreateForm.

functions.name: hiCreateBBoxField
functions.syntax: hiCreateBBoxField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value l_currentValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?defValue l_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?editable g_editable ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a bounding box field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateBooleanButton
functions.syntax: hiCreateBooleanButton( ?name s_fieldName  ?buttonText t_buttonText [ ?buttonLocation s_buttonLocation ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?value g_booleanValue ] [ ?defValue g_defaultValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a single Boolean button for a form. The button text appears as a prompt next to the button; the button is on the left of the button text if the ?buttonLocation argument is 'left and on the right of the button text if the ?buttonLocation argument is 'right. A Boolean field consists of a single toggle button which may have an associated callback procedure executed when the Boolean state changes.

functions.name: hiCreateButton
functions.syntax: hiCreateButton( ?name s_fieldName  ?callback g_callback  [ ?buttonText t_buttonText ]  [ ?buttonIcon g_buttonIcon ]  [ ?showTextWithIcon g_showTextWithIcon ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a standalone push button for a form or two-dimensional menu. The button must have an associated callback procedure to be executed when the button is selected. A button-only field differs from a button box field in that there is no prompt associated with this button.

functions.name: hiCreateButtonBoxField
functions.syntax: hiCreateButtonBoxField( ?name s_fieldName  ?choices l_buttonText  ?callback l_callbackList  ?prompt t_fieldPrompt [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a button box field for a form. A button box field contains individual buttons to be displayed in one row. Each button in the button box will have an associated callback procedure that is executed when that button is selected. A prompt is displayed on this row as well.

functions.name: hiCreateColorArray
functions.description: Example: colorArray[0] is represented by a or A; colorArray[12] is represented by m or M; colorArray[26] is represented by a period (.).

functions.name: hiCreateComboField
functions.syntax: hiCreateComboField( ?name s_fieldName  ?items g_choices [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?format t_fieldFormat ]  [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a drop-down combination field, which is a type-in field with an attached drop-down list. Users can either select an item from the list or type in a value.

functions.name: hiCreateCyclicField
functions.syntax: hiCreateCyclicField(  ?name s_fieldName  ?choices l_enumerations  ?prompt t_fieldPrompt  [ ?value g_currentValue ]  [ ?defValue g_defaultValue ]  [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?font t_font ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?keepHistory g_keepHistory ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a cyclic field for a form. A cyclic field contains a list of string or icon enumerations, which are displayed in a drop-down list. Only one item can be selected at a time.

functions.name: hiCreateDisclosureButton
functions.syntax: hiCreateDisclosureButton(   ?name s_name [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?defValue g_defValue ] [ ?help S_help ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?onFields l_onFields ] [ ?offFields l_offFields ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: A disclosure button is a button without a label used for displaying the additional information or functionality associated with another widget.

functions.name: hiCreateDisclosureTriangle
functions.syntax: hiCreateDisclosureTriangle(   ?name s_name [ ?labelText t_labelText ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?defValue g_defValue ] [ ?help S_help ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?onFields l_onFields ] [ ?offFields l_offFields ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: A disclosure triangle is a low profile widget for displaying the additional information or functionality embedded in a form.

functions.name: hiCreateDockWindow
functions.syntax: hiCreateDockWindow( ?appType t_appType ?widgetType t_widgetType [ ?handle s_handle ] [ ?dockSizeHint l_dockSizeHint ] [ ?minimumSizeHint l_minimumSizeHint ] [ ?floatSizeHint l_floatSizeHint ] [ ?form g_form ] [ ?help t_help ] [ ?scrollBar g_scrollBar ] [ ?title t_title ] [ ?visibilityProc s_visibilityProc ] ) => w_dwindowID / nil
functions.description: Creates a dockable window, which can be docked in a session window with the hiDockWindow function. Dockable windows can be of the following types: form, hypertext, html, or text. Dockable windows cannot be of type graphics.

functions.name: hiCreateFileSelectorField
functions.syntax: hiCreateFileSelectorField( ?name s_fieldName  ?mode s_mode [ ?prompt t_prompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a type-in field similar to a string field, except that it also has a Browse button at the right of the type-in box. The Browse button, when pressed, brings up a file dialog box that lets users select a file or directory. You can use the ?mode argument to specify what the user is allowed to select. The file dialog is modal, that is, it blocks access to the application while it is open. When the user makes a selection and closes the file dialog, the selection is entered into the type-in box.

functions.name: hiCreateFloatField
functions.syntax: hiCreateFloatField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ ?value f_currentValue ] [ ?acceptNil g_acceptNil ] [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?defValue f_defaultValue ]  [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?range l_fieldRange ]  [ ?format t_fieldFormat ]  [ ?editable g_editable ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a float field for a form. A float field is a field which accepts floating-point input only. A format string can be specified which will automatically be imposed on any user input. An optional range can be specified and enforced for this field as well.

functions.name: hiCreateFloatSpinBox
functions.syntax: hiCreateFloatSpinBox( ?name s_fieldName [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?defValue g_defaultValue ] [ ?font t_fontName ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?range l_rangeOfItems ] [ ?shadowed g_shadowed ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?precision x_precision ] [ ?step f_step ] [ ?obeyWidth g_obeyWidth ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?wrapAround g_wraparound ] [ ?arrowOrientation g_arrowOrientation ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a float spin box field, which contains a range of items that users can cycle through. The spin box field can only contain floating point numbers. For integers, use hiCreateSpinBox.

functions.name: hiCreateForm
functions.syntax: hiCreateForm(  s_formHandle  t_formName  g_formAction  l_fieldEntries  g_formHelp [ g_unmapAfterCB ]  )  => r_form
functions.description: Use hiCreateAppForm instead of this function.

functions.name: hiCreateFormButton
functions.syntax: hiCreateFormButton( ?name s_fieldName  ?buttonText t_buttonText  ?callback g_callback  [ ?buttonIcon g_buttonIcon ]  [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?showTextWithIcon g_showTextWithIcon ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a standalone push button for a form or two-dimensional menu. This function is the same as hiCreateButton.

functions.name: hiCreateFormLabel
functions.syntax: hiCreateFormLabel( ?name s_name [ ?labelText t_labelText ] [ ?labelIcon g_labelIcon ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?justification s_justification ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] )
functions.description: This function is an alias for hiCreateLabel. Use hiCreateLabel instead of this function.

functions.name: hiCreateFormLayout
functions.syntax: hiCreateFormLayout(  s_name  [ ?items l_items ]  [ ?frame g_frame ]  [ ?margins l_margins ]  [ ?spacing g_spacing ]  [ ?label_align g_labelAlign ] [ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ]  [ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?scrollable g_scrollable] )  => r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a form layout by specifying the labels, margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateFrameField
functions.syntax: hiCreateFrameField( ?name s_fieldName  [ ?labelText t_labelText ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a frame field for a two-dimensional form. A frame field is a border that surrounds a group of related fields so they are easier to see.

functions.name: hiCreateGridLayout
functions.syntax: hiCreateGridLayout(  s_name  [ ?items l_items ]  [ ?frame g_frame ]  [ ?margins l_margins ]  [ ?spacing g_spacing ]  [ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ]  [ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?scrollable g_scrollable] )  => r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a grid layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout
functions.syntax: hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout(  s_name  [ ?items l_items ]  [ ?frame g_frame ]  [ ?margins l_margins ]  [ ?spacing g_spacing ]  [ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ]  [ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?scrollable g_scrollable ] )  => r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a horizontal box layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateHorizontalFixedMenu
functions.syntax: hiCreateHorizontalFixedMenu( s_menuHandle  l_menuItems  x_rows  x_cols  [ S_doneCallback ] [ s_showTextWithIcon ] )  => r_hiMenu
functions.description: Creates a horizontal fixed menu that is a free-floating menu unattached to any application window. The fixed menu is created as a grid of row x column dimensions, and contains menu item objects created by hiCreateMenuItem. An additional Done item is added as the last item. Selecting Done removes the fixed menu from the screen.

functions.name: hiCreateHypertextField
functions.syntax: hiCreateHypertextField( ?name s_name [ ?title t_title ] [ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ] [ ?value t_value ] [ ?pos t_position ] [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?shadowed g_shadowed ] [ ?hasVerticalScrollbar g_hasVerticalScrollbar ] [ ?hasHorizontalScrollbar g_hasHorizontalScrollbar ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a hypertext field, which displays rich text with hypertext navigation. See also hiCreateSimpleHypertextField().

functions.name: hiCreateIntField
functions.syntax: hiCreateIntField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value x_currentValue ] [ ?acceptNil g_acceptNil ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?defValue x_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?format t_fieldFormat ]  [ ?range l_fieldRange ]  [ ?editable g_editable ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates an integer field entry for a form. An int field is a field that accepts integer input only. A format string can be specified which will automatically be imposed on any user input. An optional range can be specified and enforced for this field as well.

functions.name: hiCreateLabel
functions.syntax: hiCreateLabel( ?name s_fieldName  [?labelText t_labelText]  [?labelIcon g_labelIcon] [?justification s_justification]  [?font t_font]  [?enabled g_enabled] [?invisible g_invisible] [?help g_fieldHelp] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a standalone label entry for a form or two-dimensional menu. This label-only field contains a descriptive label and can provide additional features to a form or two-dimensional menu.

functions.name: hiCreateLayerCyclicField
functions.syntax: hiCreateLayerCyclicField( d_techFileId  t_fieldPrompt  t_callback  l_layers  [ l_LPpair ] [ s_fieldName ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a cyclic field entry containing icon representations of specified layers for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateLayoutForm
functions.syntax: hiCreateLayoutForm(  s_name  t_title  r_layout  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?mapCB g_mapCallback ] [ ?help g_help ] [ ?unmapAfterCB g_unmapAfterCB ]  [ ?buttonLayout g_buttonLayout ] [ ?buttonDisabled l_buttonDisabled ] [ ?formType s_formType ] [ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ] [ ?baseName s_baseName ] [ ?plist g_plist ] [ ?initialSize l_initialSize ] [ ?minSize l_minimumSize ]  [ ?maxSize l_maximumSize ] [ ?sizePolicy s_sizePolicy ]  )  => r_form / nil
functions.description: Returns the SKILL representation of a layout form with the specified field entries and sets it to the specified name.

functions.name: hiCreateListBoxField
functions.syntax: hiCreateListBoxField( ?name s_fieldName ?choices l_listItems [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?value l_selectedItem ]  [ ?defValue l_defSelectedItem ]  [ ?valueByPosition g_valueByPosition ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?changeCB g_changeCB ] [ ?numRows x_numRows ] [ ?multipleSelect g_multipleSelect ] [ ?doubleClickCB g_doubleClickCB ] [ ?CBOnReselect g_CBOnReselect ] [ ?keepHistory g_keepHistory ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a list box field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateListField
functions.syntax: hiCreateListField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ ?value l_currentValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?defValue l_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a list field entry for a form. A list field accepts a valid SKILL expression as input. SKILL's linereadstring determines if the expression is valid. The list expression ID is not evaluated; it is only checked to see if it is valid.

functions.name: hiCreateMLTextField
functions.syntax: hiCreateMLTextField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ ?prompt t_prompt ]  [ ?value t_value ]  [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?hasVerticalScrollbar g_hasVerticalScrollbar ] [ ?hasHorizontalScrollbar g_hasHorizontalScrollbar ] [ ?enableWordWrap g_enableWordWrap ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?changeCB g_changeCB ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ]  )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a multiline text field entry for a form. Any input typed into this field will be converted to a single string accessible through SKILL.

functions.name: hiCreateMenu
functions.description: Returns the SKILL representation of a popup menu. Once this menu is created, you can display it with hiDisplayMenu or associate it with a window using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiCreateMenuItem
functions.syntax: hiCreateMenuItem( ?name s_itemHandle  ?itemText t_menuItemText  [ ?itemIcon g_menuIcon ]  [ ?callback t_itemCallback ] [ ?disable g_disabled ]  [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?font t_font ] )  => r_hiMenuItem
functions.description: Creates a menu item that can be used in any type of menu, except two-dimensional menus and simple menus.

functions.name: hiCreateOptionsForm
functions.syntax: hiCreateOptionsForm( s_formHandle  t_formName  l_fieldEntries  g_help  ) => r_form
functions.description: Generates a form with the specified field entries, setting it to formHandle.

functions.name: hiCreateOutputStringField
functions.syntax: hiCreateOutputStringField( ?name s_fieldName [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a field that displays text. You cannot type into this field.

functions.name: hiCreatePointField
functions.syntax: hiCreatePointField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ ?value l_currentValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?defValue l_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a point field entry for a form.

functions.name: hiCreatePointListField
functions.syntax: hiCreatePointListField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ ?value l_currentValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?defValue l_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a point list field entry for a form.

functions.name: hiCreatePulldownMenu
functions.description: Creates a pulldown menu that contains text, icon, or slider menu items. s_menuHandle is the SKILL symbol set to the created menu.

functions.name: hiCreateRadioField
functions.syntax: hiCreateRadioField(  ?name s_fieldName  ?choices l_radioList  [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value t_currentSelection ]  [ ?defValue t_defaultSelection ]  [ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ]  [ ?font t_font ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?callback l_radioListCallbacks ]  )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a radio field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateReportField
functions.syntax: hiCreateReportField( ?name s_fieldName [ ?title t_title ] [ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ] [ ?headers g_headers ] [ ?choices l_choices ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?defValue g_defaultValue ] [ ?returnPackedValue g_returnPackedValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?enableDeselectCB S_enableDeselectCB ] [ ?doubleClickCB g_doubleClickCB ] [ ?sortCallback g_sortCallback ] [ ?sort l_sort ] [ ?selectMode s_selectMode ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] [ ?altRowHilight g_rowHighlight ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a report field, which you can use to display information in a complex format. For example, you can display a table with sortable columns. The items in a report field can be selected but they cannot be edited.

functions.name: hiCreateScaleField
functions.syntax: hiCreateScaleField( ?name s_fieldName  [ ?prompt t_prompt ]  [ ?value x_currentValue ] [ ?callback g_callback ]  [ ?isContinuous g_isContinuous ] [ ?range l_range ] [ ?defValue x_defaultValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?precision x_precision ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a scale field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateScrollRegion
functions.syntax: hiCreateScrollRegion( ?name s_name [ ?fields l_fieldEntries ] [ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ] [ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ] [ ?labelText t_labelText ]  [ ?borderWidth x_borderWidth ]  [ ?scrollBars g_scrollBars ] [ ?rightMargin x_rightMargin ] [ ?bottomMargin x_bottomMargin ] [ ?help g_help ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a scroll region field, which can be scrolled and can contain any type of field. A scroll region field is like a sub-form within a form.

functions.name: hiCreateSeparatorField
functions.description: Creates a separator field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateSeparatorMenuItem
functions.description: Creates a menu separator-a horizontal line that separates menu items. This menu item is used in the l_menuItems argument of the hiCreateMenu and hiCreatePulldownMenu functions. You can use the separator menu item in more than one menu or in multiple locations in the same menu.

functions.name: hiCreateSimpleHypertextField
functions.syntax: hiCreateSimpleHypertextField( s_name t_text t_link [ g_newWindow ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a simple one-line hypertext field, which displays a hyperlink to a Web page. See hiCreateHypertextField() for information on how to create a more complex hypertext field.

functions.name: hiCreateSimpleMenu
functions.syntax: hiCreateSimpleMenu( s_menuHandle  t_menuTitle  l_menuItems  l_menuItemCallbacks  )  => r_hiMenu
functions.description: Returns the SKILL description of a simple menu, which is a single level menu containing only text menu items, none of which invoke a submenu. Once this menu is created, you can display it with hiDisplayMenu or associate it with a window using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiCreateSliderMenuItem
functions.syntax: hiCreateSliderMenuItem( ?name s_itemHandle  ?itemText t_menuItemText  ?subMenu r_pulldownMenu  [ ?itemIcon l_menuIcon ] [ ?disable g_disabled ] [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?font t_font ] )  => r_hiSliderItem
functions.description: Creates a slider menu item that is used in functions that create a menu (all menus except simple or 2D menus). Slider menu items bring up submenus when selected. They can contain text (t_menuItemText) or icon (l_menuIcon) information.

functions.name: hiCreateSpinBox
functions.syntax: hiCreateSpinBox( ?name s_fieldName [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?defValue g_defaultValue ] [ ?font t_fontName ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?range l_rangeOfItems ] [ ?arrowOrientation g_arrowOrientation ] [ ?shadowed g_shadowed ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?obeyWidth g_obeyWidth ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?wrapAround g_wraparound ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a spin box field, which contains a range of items that users can cycle through. The spin box field can only contain integers. For floating point numbers, use hiCreateFloatSpinBox.

functions.name: hiCreateStackedLayout
functions.syntax: hiCreateStackedLayout(  s_name  [ ?items l_items ]  [ ?frame g_frame ]  [ ?margins l_margins ]  [ ?currentIndex g_currentIndex ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?scrollable g_scrollable ] )  => r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a stacked layout defstruct of the first field in the stack.

functions.name: hiCreateStringField
functions.syntax: hiCreateStringField(  ?name s_fieldName  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value t_currentValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ] [ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ] [ ?format t_fieldFormat ]  [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a string field entry for a form. Any input typed into this field is surrounded by double quotation marks before being passed to SKILL to interpret.

functions.name: hiCreateTabField
functions.syntax: hiCreateTabField( ?name s_name ?fields l_fieldEntries [ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ] [ ?tabs g_tabs ] [ ?pageBase g_pageBase ] [ ?value g_currentValue ] [ ?defValue g_defaultValue ] [ ?tabPlacement g_tabPlacement ] [ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?pageScroller g_pageScroller ] [ ?notebookStyle g_notebookStyle ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a tab field, which can have multiple pages. You can change the pages interactively by selecting the tab attached to each page, or programmatically by using the form->field->value property.

functions.name: hiCreateToggleField
functions.syntax: hiCreateToggleField(  ?name s_fieldName  ?choices l_toggleList  [ ?help g_fieldHelp ]  [ ?numSelect x_numSelectable ]  [ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]  [ ?value l_currentValues ]  [ ?defValue l_defaultValues ] [ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ]  [ ?font t_font ]  [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?callback l_toggleListCallbacks ]  )  => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a toggle field entry for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateToolbar
functions.syntax: hiCreateToolbar( ?name s_name [ ?title t_title ] [ ?toolButtonStyle s_buttonStyle ] [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ] [ ?items l_toolbarItems ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?contextMenuItems l_contextMenuItems ] ) => o_hiToolbar
functions.description: Creates a toolbar that you can add to windows and session windows. A toolbar is a container object that can contain combo boxes, type-in items, actions, and separators.

functions.name: hiCreateToolbarComboBox
functions.syntax: hiCreateToolbarComboBox( ?name s_name ?items l_items [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?value t_value ] [ ?toolTip t_tooltip ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?CBOnEnter g_cbOnEnter ] ) => o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a drop-down list box item (popularly called a combo box) to be added to the toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar. The drop-down list box has a type-in field as well as a drop-down list. You can either type in a value or select an item from the list.

functions.name: hiCreateToolbarSeparator
functions.description: Creates a separator that is used to separate the items in a toolbar created uisng hiCreateToolbar.
