functions.name: hiCreateToolbarTypein
functions.syntax: hiCreateToolbarTypein( ?name s_name [ ?prompt t_prompt ] [ ?value t_value ] [ ?tooltip t_tooltip ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?editable g_editable ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?width x_width ] [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ] [ ?CBOnEnter g_cbOnEnter ] ) => o_typein
functions.description: Creates a type-in field to be added to the toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar.

functions.name: hiCreateTree
functions.description: Creates a new tree or sub-tree, to which you then add items you create with the hiCreateTreeItem function. You add the tree to a tree table field created with the hiCreateTreeTable function.

functions.name: hiCreateTreeItem
functions.syntax: hiCreateTreeItem( s_itemName [ g_description ] [ g_itemIcon ] [ g_selectionIcon ] [ g_expandedIcon ] [ g_expandedSelectionIcon ] ) => r_treeItem / nil
functions.description: Creates a new item for a tree. Use hiTreeAppendItem or hiTreePrependItem to attach the item to a tree.

functions.name: hiCreateTreeTable
functions.syntax: hiCreateTreeTable( ?name s_name [ ?title t_title ] [ ?choice g_choice ] [ ?value g_value ] [ ?defValue g_defaultValue ] [ ?help g_fieldHelp ] [ ?headers g_headers ] [ ?sort l_sort ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?enableDeselectCB g_enableDeselectCB ] [ ?expandCallback g_expandCallback ] [ ?collapseCallback g_collapseCallback ] [ ?sortCallback g_sortCallback ] [ ?nextField g_nextField ] [ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ] [ ?selectMode s_selectMode ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?altRowHilight g_rowHighlight ] ) => r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a tree table field. If you have already created a tree, you can specify it when you create the field; otherwise you can add a tree later to the field. To create a tree, use hiCreateTree and other tree table field functions.

functions.name: hiCreateTypeinMenuItem
functions.syntax: hiCreateTypeinMenuItem( ?name s_name  [ ?itemIcon g_icon ]  [ ?itemText t_text ]  [ ?callback S_funcname ]  [ ?disable g_disable ]  [ ?statusTip t_statusTip ]  [ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]  [ ?completerType s_type ]  [ ?completerList l_list ] )  => r_menuItem / nil
functions.description: Creates a type-in menu item that can receive user inputs. When a user types text in the type-in menu item created using this function and presses Enter, the specified callback function (S_funcname) is executed.

functions.name: hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout
functions.syntax: hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout(  s_name  [ ?items l_items ]  [ ?frame g_frame ]  [ ?margins l_margins ]  [ ?spacing g_spacing ]  [ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ]  [ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ] [ ?enabled g_enabled ] [ ?invisible g_invisible ] [ ?scrollable g_scrollable ] )  => r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a vertical box layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateVerticalFixedMenu
functions.syntax: hiCreateVerticalFixedMenu( s_menuHandle  l_menuItems  x_rows  x_cols  [ S_doneCallback ] [ s_showTextWithIcon ] )  => r_hiMenu
functions.description: Creates a vertical fixed menu that can be displayed in the root window. Fixed menus can no longer be displayed in application windows; use the new toolbar functions to create toolbars for windows instead.

functions.name: hiCreateWindow
functions.syntax: hiCreateWindow( g_boxSpec  t_widgetType  t_appType  [ t_help ] [ g_scrollbars ] [ g_form ]  [ l_iconPosition ] )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates, but does not display, a window of one of the following types: session, graphics, text, hypertext, html, encap, or form. This window becomes the current window.

functions.name: hiCreateWorldView
functions.description: Creates a World View assistant for your graphics window, which you can then display with hiDockWindow. World View assistant is a small window that shows you a picture of your entire design and marks the part of the design that is currently displayed in the graphics window. You can also use it to navigate the design or zoom in or out of it.

functions.name: hiDBoxCancel
functions.description: Function logged when either the Cancel or the No button is pressed on a dialog box. This function can also be called directly from SKILL to simulate pressing No or Cancel.

functions.name: hiDBoxOK
functions.description: Function logged when the OK, Yes or Done button is pressed in a dialog box. This function can also be called directly from SKILL to simulate pressing OK, Yes or Done.

functions.name: hiDeiconifyWindow
functions.description: Converts an icon to a window. If the window is contained in a session window, the session window is deiconified.

functions.name: hiDeleteBannerLabel
functions.description: Deletes a label from the banner bar of a window.

functions.name: hiDeleteBannerMenu
functions.description: Deletes a menu from the menu bar of a window.

functions.name: hiDeleteBannerMenus
functions.description: Deletes all menus from the menu bar of a window.

functions.name: hiDeleteField
functions.description: Deletes a field from a form.

functions.name: hiDeleteFields
functions.description: Deletes multiple fields from a form.

functions.name: hiDeleteForm
functions.description: Deletes the form specified and any fields the form contains.

functions.name: hiDeleteItemFromLayout
functions.syntax: hiDeleteItemFromLayout(  x_index g_formRegionOrLayout  [ s_layoutName ] )  => x_index / nil
functions.description: Deletes an item from hiLayout using the specified index.

functions.name: hiDeleteMenu
functions.description: Destroys the menu given by hiMenu, which must be a valid data structure. Individual menu items contained in this menu are also destroyed.

functions.name: hiDeleteMenuItem
functions.description: Deletes a menu item or action from all instances of the specified r_hiMenu.

functions.name: hiDeleteToolbar
functions.description: Deletes a toolbar from a window.

functions.name: hiDeleteToolbarBreak
functions.description: Deletes the toolbar break before the specified toolbar from the toolbar area of a window.

functions.name: hiDeleteToolbarItem
functions.description: Deletes a toolbar item from a toolbar.

functions.name: hiDeleteToolbarItems
functions.description: Removes toolbar items from a toolbar.

functions.name: hiDeltaPan
functions.syntax: hiDeltaPan( [ w_window ]  [ n_deltax ]  [ n_deltay ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Pans the view of a design in any direction by specifying the displacements in user units.

functions.name: hiDisableAsstBindKeyPrefix
functions.description: Adds the specified bindkey prefix (also known as an appType), which is associated with a dock window (assistant), to the list of disabled bindkey prefixes. As a result, the bindkeys defined using that prefix are disabled.

functions.name: hiDisableMenuItem
functions.syntax: hiDisableMenuItem( r_hiMenu  s_itemHandle [ w_windowId ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Grays out a menu item on pull-down, pop-up, or fixed menus, making it unselectable.

functions.name: hiDisableTailViewfile
functions.description: Turns off the ability to repeatedly read from the end of a file.

functions.name: hiDisplayAppDBox
functions.syntax: hiDisplayAppDBox( ?name s_dboxHandle  [ ?dboxBanner t_dboxBanner ] [ ?dboxText t_dboxText ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?dialogType x_dialogType ] [ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ]  [ ?buttonLayout s_buttonLayout ] [ ?buttons g_buttons ] [ ?dontPopdowns g_dontPopdowns ] [ ?defaultButton x_defaultButton ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?help g_help ] )  => t / nil / cancel
functions.description: Creates and displays a dialog box. You can add a pre-defined set of buttons to the dialog box or you can specfiy your own buttons. The dialog box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

functions.name: hiDisplayBlockingDBox
functions.description: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function.

functions.name: hiDisplayColorDialog
functions.description: Displays the Select color dialog, which lets you select a color. This function returns the RGB (Red, Green, and Blue) value of the color you select as well as the alpha channel value, if the ?alpha argument was t. The Select color dialog is a modal dialog.

functions.name: hiDisplayFileDialog
functions.syntax: hiDisplayFileDialog( ?dialogName s_dialogName ] [ ?workingDir t_workingDir ] [ ?filter t_filter ] [ ?mode s_mode ] [ ?modal g_modal ] [ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?userData s_userData ] [ ?caption t_caption ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?acceptMode s_acceptMode ] [ ?labelText t_labelText ] [ ?confirmOverwrite g_confirmOverwrite ] ) => l_userSelection / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a file selection dialog box, which lets users select a file or directory. The dialog box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

functions.name: hiDisplayFixedMenu
functions.syntax: hiDisplayFixedMenu( r_hiMenu  g_menuLocation [ x_width ] [ x_height ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Displays the specified fixed menu in the default root window (screen). The menu appears on a side of the screen, to be shared among Cadence application windows contained within the screen. The x_width and y_height arguments are ignored and currently exist only for compatability reasons. x_width and y_height of the menu are automatically determined by the size of the menu items and the number of columns and rows.

functions.name: hiDisplayForm
functions.description: Displays a form. Do not use hiDisplayForm for displaying options forms. You can also use this function to bring a form to the top of the screen if the form is covered by other windows.

functions.name: hiDisplayListBox
functions.syntax: hiDisplayListBox( s_listBoxHandle  t_listBoxTitle  l_listItems  t_help )  => t / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a list box. The list box will display a list of strings. The user can select one of these strings by clicking over the item with the left mouse button. The list box remains on the screen until the user selects OK or Cancel. The list box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen

functions.name: hiDisplayMenu
functions.description: Displays a menu created by hiCreateMenu, hiCreateSimpleMenu, or hiCreate2DMenu. For non-2D menus, the menu is always displayed at the current cursor's position at the time hiDisplayMenu is called.

functions.name: hiDisplayModalDBox
functions.syntax: hiDisplayModalDBox( s_dBoxHandle  t_dBoxBannerText  t_dBoxMsg  g_dBoxHelp  t_confirmAction [ l_location ] [ x_dboxType ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function.

functions.name: hiDisplayModelessDBox
functions.syntax: hiDisplayModelessDBox( s_dBoxHandle  t_dBoxBannerText  t_dBoxMsg  g_dBoxHelp  t_confirmAction [ l_location ] [ x_dboxType ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function. Additionally, set ?dialogStyle to 'modeless.

functions.name: hiDisplayNonBlockingDBox
functions.description: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function.

functions.name: hiDisplayProgressBox
functions.syntax: hiDisplayProgressBox( ?name s_name [ ?banner t_banner ] [ ?text t_text ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?callback g_callback ] [ ?totalSteps x_totalSteps ] [ ?delay x_delay ] [ ?autoClose g_autoClose ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Creates a progress dialog box that displays the progress of a command. The progress dialog box is always modeless (non-blocking).

functions.name: hiDisplaySaveForRestoreDialog
functions.description: Displays the Save Session Form, which lets you specify the file in which to save your session information. This function is the programmatic equivalent of selecting Options - Save Session in the CIW.

functions.name: hiDisplayUserDBox
functions.syntax: hiDisplayUserDBox( ?name s_dboxHandle [ ?dboxBanner t_dboxBanner ] [ ?dboxText t_dboxText ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?dialogType x_dialogType ] [ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ] [ ?defaultButton x_defaultButton ] ?buttons g_buttons [ ?callbacks g_callbacks ] [ ?dontPopdowns g_dontPopdowns ] [ ?help g_help ] ) => buttonIndex / callbackReturnVal / t / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a dialog box. This function lets you customize buttons in the dialog box. You can also choose whether the dialog box is removed from the screen or not when a button is pressed. Using this function is equivalent to using hiDisplayAppDBox with s_buttonLayout set to 'UserDefined.

functions.name: hiDisplayWindow
functions.syntax: hiDisplayWindow( w_windowId | w_sessionWindowID [ w_sessionWindowId ] [ g_tabTitle ] [ g_tabIcon ] [ g_tabTip ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Displays any window created by hiCreateWindow, including session windows; does not display dockable windows or empty session windows. This function always displays graphics windows in a session window-if you do not specify a session window, this function creates a new one and displays the graphics window in it.

functions.name: hiDisplayWindowMenu
functions.description: Displays the popup menu associated with the given w_windowId, which must be a valid data structure returned by a call to hiOpenWindow or hiCreateWindow.

functions.name: hiDockWindow
functions.syntax: hiDockWindow( ?window w_dwindowID [ ?session g_sessionWindowID ] [ ?side s_side ] [ ?index x_index ] [ ?unmapped g_unmapped ] [ ?tabOnto w_dwindowID ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Docks a dockable window in a session window. You must specify the g_sessionWindowID argument the first time that you display a dock window with this function.

functions.name: hiDynamicPanAbsolute
functions.description: Pans a design to display the specified point at the center of the window. This function is similar to hiPan, except that it pans dynamically, that is, it displays the panning movement.

functions.name: hiDynamicPanGrabbing
functions.description: Pans (grabs and moves) a design in the specified (or current) window from one point to another. You can even pan the design when editing it. The panning operation ends when you release holding the mouse button or DrawThru bindkey.

functions.name: hiDynamicPanInteractive
functions.description: Pans a design continuously when you place the cursor near the edge of a graphics window. You can control the speed at which the design is panned by varying the distance between the cursor and the edge of the window-the closer the cursor is to the edge of the window, the faster the speed.

functions.name: hiDynamicPanRelative
functions.syntax: hiDynamicPanRelative( [ w_window ] [ n_percentX ] [ n_percentY ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Pans a design in the direction and distance specified in n_percentX and n_percentY. The distance is a percentage of the window size.

functions.name: hiEditPropList
functions.syntax: hiEditPropList( g_object  [ t_title ] [ g_modifiable ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Invokes the property list editor for the given g_object.

functions.name: hiEditfile
functions.description: Brings up a form in which you can specify the file you want to edit and then calls the edit function on the file.

functions.name: hiEnableAsstBindKeyPrefix
functions.description: Removes the specified bindkey prefix (also known as an appType), which is associated with a dock window (assistant), from the list of disabled bindkey prefixes. For information about how to add a bindkey prefix to the list of disabled bindkey prefixes, see hiDisableAsstBindKeyPrefix.

functions.name: hiEnableBlink
functions.description: Enables or disables blinking, depending on the value of the g_blink argument. When blinking is disabled, objects that would normally blink in graphics windows will not blink. In some cases, disabling blinking can improve graphics performance. You can also disable blinking by starting the application with the -noblink option.

functions.name: hiEnableMenuItem
functions.syntax: hiEnableMenuItem( r_hiMenu  s_itemHandle [ w_windowId ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Makes unselectable menu items in pull-down, pop-up, or fixed menus selectable.

functions.name: hiEnableTailViewfile
functions.description: Turns on the ability to repeatedly read from the end of a file and update the viewfile window. This will continually update the viewfile window with text that is appended to the end of the file being viewed. This only works when appending to a file. If the file is modified in another way (such as edited using an editor), the results are unpredictable. This function is equivalent to the UNIX command tail_f and works the same way.

functions.name: hiEncap
functions.syntax: hiEncap( [ g_boxSpec ] [ t_cmd ] [ t_title ] )  => w_window / nil
functions.description: Invokes an encapsulation session by creating and displaying an encapsulation window.

functions.name: hiEndLog
functions.description: Stops writing the transaction log to the file previously specified by hiStartLog.

functions.name: hiEnqueueCmd
functions.description: Adds t_command, which is to be executed after returning from the current function and re-entering the event loop, to the command queue.

functions.name: hiEscapeHTMLTags
functions.description: Returns a string in which HTML tags such as greater-than and less-than are replaced with (or converted to) character directives such as ampersand-g-t-semicolon and ampersand-l-t-semicolon.This is done to preserve the display of the HTML tags in places such as field prompts.

functions.name: hiEscapeStringChars
functions.description: Escapes certain characters (backslash and double quote characters) in a string by preceding them with a backslash so that they do not cause errors when the string is evaluated in SKILL. You can use this function to prepare strings that will be evaluated in callbacks.

functions.name: hiExpandTreeItem
functions.description: Expands the tree item you specify. This function also executes the expand callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiExportImage
functions.syntax: hiExportImage( ?fileName t_filename [?window w_window] [?exportRegion s_exportRegion] [?bBox l_bBox] [?width n_width] [?height n_height] [?scaleFactor n_scaleFactor] [?haloType s_haloType] [?scaleHalos g_scaleHalos] [?fileType g_fileType] [?keepAspect g_keepAspect] [?transparentBG g_transparentBG] [?colorType s_colorType] [?fgColor t_fgColor]		 [?verbose g_verbose] [?windowProps g_windowProps] [?decorations g_decorations] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Takes a screen capture of a design in a graphics window and exports it to a standard image format such as PNG. This function can only be used with graphics windows.

functions.name: hiExportImageDialog
functions.description: Displays the Export Image dialog box, which lets you take a screen capture of the design contained in the specified window and save it to a standard image format. This function can only be called for graphics windows.

functions.name: hiFileDialogDone
functions.description: This function is logged when a file dialog box is dismissed. Applications do not need to call this function; it is provided for replay purposes.

functions.name: hiFileDialogSelection
functions.description: Returns the selection made by the user in the file dialog box. This function is typically called from a user callback.

functions.name: hiFileDialogSetSelection
functions.description: This function is logged when a selection is made from a file dialog.

functions.name: hiFixedMenuDown
functions.description: Removes the specified fixed menu from the screen.

functions.name: hiFlush
functions.description: Causes event queues to be synchronized and processes all exposure events.  This ensures that newly exposed or updated windows and forms are drawn.  This function is used primarily for quicktests.

functions.name: hiFlushCIW
functions.description: Immediately flushes any buffered output to the CIW (Command Interpreter Window).

functions.name: hiFlushLogFile
functions.description: Flushes the contents of the main and any open secondary log files.

functions.name: hiFocusToCIW
functions.description: Temporarily refocuses the input window to the CIW until a return is entered.

functions.name: hiFocusToCursor
functions.description: Sets the window focus mechanism.

functions.name: hiFocusToEncap
functions.description: Temporarily focuses the keyboard input to an encapsulation window.

functions.name: hiFocusToToolbarItem
functions.syntax: hiFocusToToolbarItem( ?toolbar S_toolbar  ?item S_toolbarItem  [?warpPointer g_warp]  [?window w_window] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the keyboard focus on a visible, enabled, and editable toolbar type-in or combo item.

functions.name: hiFormApply
functions.description: Equivalent to clicking the Apply button on a form.

functions.name: hiFormCancel
functions.description: Equivalent to clicking the Cancel button on a form.

functions.name: hiFormClose
functions.description: Equivalent to clicking the Close button on a form. This function is an alias for hiFormDone. The Close button is identical to the OK button, except that it triggers hiFormClose instead of hiFormDone.

functions.name: hiFormDefaults
functions.description: Equivalent to clicking the Defaults button on a form. The value of each field on the form is compared to its default value and, if it is different, it is set to the default value and the value-change callback is invoked.

functions.name: hiFormDone
functions.description: Equivalent to clicking the OK button on a form. This function is identical to the hiFormFinish function.

functions.name: hiFormFinish
functions.description: Equivalent to clicking the OK button on a form. This function is identical to the  hiFormDone function.

functions.name: hiFormList
functions.description: Returns a list of all form symbols currently defined in SKILL space.

functions.name: hiFormUnmap
functions.description: Unmaps the form from the screen before a callback is completed.

functions.name: hiGenTextIndex
functions.syntax: hiGenTextIndex( w_windowId  t_text  x_fromIndex  )  => x_index / nil
functions.description: Returns the character position that is the next occurrence of the text string relative to a specified position in the file.

functions.name: hiGenerateThumbnails
functions.syntax: hiGenerateThumbnails( ?lib g_lib [ ?cell g_cell ] [ ?view g_view ] [ ?sizes g_sizes ] [ ?output g_output ] [ ?verbose g_verbose ] [ ?exportArgs g_exportArgs ] [ ?filePath t_filePath ] ) => thumbnails / nil
functions.description: Generates thumbnails for given library cellviews. Function behavior depends on arguments provided. All arguments can be lists in order to batch-generate thumbnails for a series of libraries, cells, views and sizes. At present, only the default 128x128 thumbnail is used by Cadence tools.

functions.name: hiGetAbsWindowScreenBBox
functions.description: Returns the absolute screen coordinates of a window, assuming 0:0 is the lower-left corner of the screen.

functions.name: hiGetActiveTabWindow
functions.description: Returns the window ID of the window that is the active tab in the session window.

functions.name: hiGetAnyFile
functions.syntax: hiGetAnyFile( [ ?workingDir t_workingDir ] [ ?filter t_filter ] [ ?dialogName s_dialogName ] [ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?userData s_userData ] [ ?caption t_caption ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?modal g_modal ] [ ?acceptMode s_acceptMode ] [ ?confirmOverwrite g_confirmOverwrite ] ) => l_userSelection / nil
functions.description: Calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'anyFile. Use this function to prompt the user to specify the name of a file to open or save.

functions.name: hiGetAppType
functions.description: Returns the application type of a window. The application type is set when the window is created.

functions.name: hiGetAttention
functions.description: Rings the bell in the keyboard or terminal.

functions.name: hiGetBBoxResource
functions.description: Returns the bounding box specification defined in the .Xdefaults file for the specified resource.

functions.name: hiGetBannerLabels
functions.description: Returns the list of labels that are in the banner bar of a window. (These labels were added with the  ?labels argument to the hiOpenWindow function when the window was created or with the hiChangeBannerLabel function.)

functions.name: hiGetBannerMenus
functions.description: Returns a list of the menus that are in the menu bar of a window.

functions.name: hiGetBannerPoint
functions.description: Retrieves the X:Y location value stored in the banner of the specified window. If the window ID is not specified, Virtuoso returns the location of the current window.

functions.name: hiGetBeepVolume
functions.description: Retrieves the loudness of the beep.

functions.name: hiGetBindKey
functions.description: Returns the SKILL command string bound to a key or mouse button for an application.

functions.name: hiGetBindKeyInheritAlias
functions.description: Returns a list of application names that inherit the bindkeys from t_applicationType.

functions.name: hiGetBindKeyInheritRoot
functions.description: Returns the application name from which t_applicationType inherits its bindkeys.

functions.name: hiGetBindKeyPrefixList
functions.description: Returns a list of registered applications. This list is used to build the menu for the Cyclic button on the Bind Keys form.

functions.name: hiGetBindKeys
functions.description: Returns the list of bindkeys that are set for an application.

functions.name: hiGetButtonAreaHeight
functions.description: Returns the button area height of an instantiated form.

functions.name: hiGetCIWindow
functions.description: Retrieves the window identity of the CIW.

functions.name: hiGetChoiceStrings
functions.description: Returns strings of all choices in a list box, radio button, or cyclic field.

functions.name: hiGetClipboard
functions.description: Returns the text stored in the system clipboard.

functions.name: hiGetCommandPoint
functions.description: Gets the location where the cursor was the last time a mouse button or keyboard key was pressed, but only until the cursor leaves that window.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentCmd
functions.description: Returns the 	command name associated with the enterfunction currently running in a window, or nil if no enterfunction is running.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentEnterFunPoints
functions.description: Returns the list of points entered in the active enterfunction of the current window.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentField
functions.description: Returns the symbol name of the field that currently has input focus.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentForm
functions.description: Returns the last active form, that is, the form that the cursor was last in.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentIndex
functions.description: Returns the current cursor index position relative to all the text in the window.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentTextSelection
functions.description: Returns the text selected in the specified viewfile window. This is the text which has been selected by using a mouse button action, such as by double-clicking or drag-selecting. If no text appears selected, the function returns nil.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentTextSelectionLoc
functions.description: Returns the text coordinates of the text selected in the specified viewfile window.  This is the text which has been selected using a mouse action, such as by double-clicking or drag-selecting. If no text is selected in the specified window, the function returns nil.

functions.name: hiGetCurrentWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of the current window. If the current window is in a session window, the ID of the window, not the session window, is returned. Session windows and dockable windows can never be the current window.

functions.name: hiGetCursor
functions.description: Identifies the type of cursor that is currently set for the specified window.

functions.name: hiGetCursorByName
functions.description: Returns the ID associated with the specified cursor name.

functions.name: hiGetCursorName
functions.description: Returns the name of the cursor associated with the specified cursor ID.

functions.name: hiGetCyclicValueString
functions.description: Returns the current value of a cyclic field as a string. This function returns nil if the specified value is an icon list without the fourth member (optional).

functions.name: hiGetDBoxDefaultLocation
functions.description: Gets the default location of all dialog boxes, which has been set with the hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation function.

functions.name: hiGetDbuPoint
functions.description: Returns the current location of the pointer, or nil if the pointer is not within the drawable area of the window or the window is hidden behind other tabs in a session window.

functions.name: hiGetDefaultThumbnail
functions.description: Displays a default cellview type thumbnail when a thumbnail is not available for that application. This prevents the thumbnail area of a dialog or window from being left blank.

functions.name: hiGetDefaultThumbnailResolution
functions.description: Returns a list that comprises of a pair of integers that indicate the default thumbnail resolution that applications are currently using.

functions.name: hiGetDefaultWidgetSpacing
functions.description: Returns the recommended number of pixels between UI elements. The spacing between related elements, such as a group of Boolean buttons, is smaller than elements, which are not related.

functions.name: hiGetDisabledAsstBindKeyPrefixes
functions.description: Returns the list of bindkey prefixes disabled using hiDisableAsstBindKeyPrefix.

functions.name: hiGetDisplayName
functions.description: Returns the current display name.

functions.name: hiGetDrawThruDelta
functions.syntax: hiGetDrawThruDelta(  [ g_detail ] )  => x_defaultDelta / ( x_defaultDelta ( x_highButton1Delta x_highButton2Delta x_highButton3Delta ) )
functions.description: When no argument is presented, or if the g_detail argument is nil, will return the default draw-thru delta.

functions.name: hiGetEFDrawThruDelta
functions.description: Returns the list of EnterFunction draw-thru deltas for the three mouse buttons.

functions.name: hiGetEFunCursor
functions.description: Gets the cursor for an active enterfunction.

functions.name: hiGetEncapSkillCmd
functions.description: Returns the SKILL function associated with a window.

functions.name: hiGetExistingDirectory
functions.syntax: hiGetExistingDirectory( [ ?workingDir t_workingDir ] [ ?dirOnly g_dirOnly ] [ ?dialogName s_dialogName ] [ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?userData s_userData ] [ ?caption t_caption ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?modal g_modal ] ) => l_userSelection / nil
functions.description: Calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'dirOnly. If the ?dirOnly argument is nil, calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'directory. Use this function to ask the user to select a directory.

functions.name: hiGetExistingFile
functions.syntax: hiGetExistingFile( [ ?workingDir t_workingDir ] [ ?filter t_filter ] [ ?dialogName s_dialogName ] [ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?userData s_userData ] [ ?caption t_caption ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?modal g_modal ] ) => l_userSelection / nil
functions.description: Calls hiDisplayFileDialog with the mode set to 'existingFile. Use this function to ask the user to select a file to open.

functions.name: hiGetExistingFiles
functions.syntax: hiGetExistingFiles( [ ?workingDir t_workingDir ] [ ?filter t_filter ] [ ?dialogName s_dialogName ] [ ?callback t_callback ] [ ?userData s_userData ] [ ?caption t_caption ] [ ?location l_location ] [ ?modal g_modal ] ) => l_userSelection / nil
functions.description: Calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'existingFiles. Use this function to ask the user to select the files to open.

functions.name: hiGetFieldAttachments
functions.description: Returns the integer representing the combination of attachment bit values when the field is in an attachment form.

functions.name: hiGetFieldInfo
functions.description: Returns the dimensions of any form field or 2D menu item that is in an instantiated form. Do not use the return value of hiGetFieldInfo to restore a field to its original location. Instead, use the values you specified originally.

functions.name: hiGetFieldMinSize
functions.description: Returns the minimum size for the field widget and prompt.

functions.name: hiGetFieldOverlaps
functions.description: Generates warnings if the form specified contains any fields whose bounding boxes overlap with other fields, or any fields in which the bounding box for the prompt portion of the field overlaps with the main portion of the field. The function generates an initial warning that overlaps were found, then additional warnings for each overlap. Returns nil if the form is uninstantiated; t otherwise.

functions.name: hiGetFieldScope
functions.description: Returns the scope containing the given field. The return value can be a scroll region, a tab page, a tab field, form, or nil.

functions.name: hiGetFont
functions.description: Returns the font type (if valid), or a list of valid font types if t_fontType is all. This function is being provided for compatibility with previous releases and should no longer be used.

functions.name: hiGetFontInfo
functions.description: Returns the Disembodied Property List (DPL), which contains the name, size, weight, and italic style along with the description of the font.

functions.name: hiGetFormLocation
functions.description: Returns the x and y coordinates of the upper-left corner of the form you specify. If the form is not currently displayed, but has been displayed at least once, this function returns the last location at which it was displayed. If the form has never been displayed, this function returns nil.

functions.name: hiGetFormSize
functions.description: Returns the width and height of the given form.

functions.name: hiGetGeometryResource
functions.description: Gets geometry resources from the X resource database.

functions.name: hiGetGridLayoutItemLocation
functions.description: Searches for a list containing the symbol name of the layout that contains s_layoutOrField, and the row, column, row span, and column span of that item within the layout.

functions.name: hiGetHelp
functions.description: Retrieves the help string that is defined for the window.

functions.name: hiGetIconName
functions.description: Gets the name that is displayed on a window's icon when the window is minimized. This name is set with the hiSetIconName function.

functions.name: hiGetInsertionPosition
functions.description: Gets the current position of the insertion cursor in a type-in field. You can use the hiSetInsertionPosition function to change the position of the cursor.

functions.name: hiGetItemOfLayout
functions.syntax: hiGetItemOfLayout(  x_index g_formRegionOrLayout  [ s_layoutName ] )  => x_index / nil
functions.description: Returns the description of all the items in the specified hiLayout as per the index order.

functions.name: hiGetKeyboardFocusField
functions.description: Returns the field that currently has keyboard focus or is nil.

functions.name: hiGetLayerCyclicValue
functions.description: Returns the layer object associated with the current value of the layer cyclic field.

functions.name: hiGetLayoutChildLayouts
functions.description: Returns the list of symbolic names of child-hiLayout items in the hiLayout.

functions.name: hiGetLayoutFields
functions.description: Returns the list of symbolic names of field items in hiLayout.

functions.name: hiGetLayoutFrame
functions.syntax: hiGetLayoutFrame( g_formRegionOrLayout  [ s_layoutName ] ) => t_title / t / nil
functions.description: Returns the frame title of a hiLayout form, a scroll region, or a tab page in the hiLayout form.

functions.name: hiGetLayoutItemIndex
functions.description: Returns a list containing the symbol name of the layout, which contains s_layoutOrField, and the index of that item within the layout.

functions.name: hiGetLayoutItems
functions.description: Returns the description of all the items in the specified hiLayout in the index sequence.

functions.name: hiGetLayoutMargins
functions.description: Returns the top, bottom, left, and right margins of the layout.

functions.name: hiGetLayoutType
functions.description: Returns the type of hiLayout. The layout types that can be returned are 'hbox, 'vbox, 'grid, 'form, or 'stacked.

functions.name: hiGetListBoxFieldFit
functions.description: Returns the width and height necessary for displaying a list box with the specified number of rows and columns and the specified font.

functions.name: hiGetListBoxValue
functions.description: Provides the value of a list box field as a list of strings. This function is useful when the valueByPosition property of a list box field is set to non-nil, which means its value is managed and reported as a list of integers (indicating position) instead of a list of strings.

functions.name: hiGetLogFileName
functions.description: Returns the rooted file name of the Virtuoso session log file.

functions.name: hiGetMagnifierSize
functions.description: Returns a two element list for the currently opened magnifier for the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiGetMaxScreenCoords
functions.description: Retrieves the screen coordinates of the upper-right corner of the display screen. The lower-left corner of the screen is assumed to be 0:0. This is the maximum size that you can specify for a window.

functions.name: hiGetMenuItems
functions.description: Returns a list of the menu items in the specified menu.

functions.name: hiGetMouseMoveSampleRate
functions.description: Gets the current setting of the mouse sample rate.

functions.name: hiGetMouseStopDetectTime
functions.description: Gets the current setting (in milliseconds) used to detect if a mouse has stopped moving.

functions.name: hiGetMultiClickTime
functions.description: Returns the number of milliseconds that must elapse before a mouse click is recognized as a separate single click rather than the second click of a double click.

functions.name: hiGetNonRepeatPrefixes
functions.description: Returns list of hiRepeat filter strings.

functions.name: hiGetNumMenus
functions.description: Returns the number of menus in the menu bar of a window.

functions.name: hiGetNumVisibleItems
functions.description: Returns the number of visible items for a list box field.

functions.name: hiGetPoint
functions.description: Retrieves the xy position for the current location of the cursor within the boundaries of the window. It returns the xy position even if the cursor is in another window or form that is covering the specified window, as long as the cursor is within the boundaries of the specified window.

functions.name: hiGetProgress
functions.description: Gets the current progress (that is, the current step) from a progress dialog box.

functions.name: hiGetProgressBarCurrentStep
functions.description: Returns the current step of the progress bar from the window specified.

functions.name: hiGetProgressBarTotalSteps
functions.description: Returns the maximum number of total steps for the  progress bar from the window specified.

functions.name: hiGetProgressTotalSteps
functions.description: Gets the total number of steps of the progress bar in a progress dialog box.

functions.name: hiGetRadioValueString
functions.description: Returns the current value of a radio field as a string.

functions.name: hiGetRepeatCommand
functions.description: Returns the command that would be executed by hiRepeat, that is, the command that was last executed in the CIW; or nil, in cases where hiRepeat will not execute a command.

functions.name: hiGetScreenPoint
functions.description: Returns the current location of the pointer relative to the upper-left corner of the drawable area of a window. This function does not apply to session windows or dockable windows.

functions.name: hiGetScreenSize
functions.description: Returns the size of the current display screen as a list of two lists, the first being the width and height in pixels, the second being the width and height in millimeters.

functions.name: hiGetScrollBarInfo
functions.description: Provides information about the horizontal and vertical scroll bars on a form or scroll region field. You can use this information to set the position of scroll bars with the hiSetScrollBarValue function.

functions.name: hiGetSessionWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of the session window that contains the specified window or dock window.

functions.name: hiGetSharedIcon
functions.description: Gets the icon associated with an action. The icon is in the format in which it was originally specified: an image file name or an hiIcon list.

functions.name: hiGetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex
functions.description: Returns the index of the current top item.

functions.name: hiGetStringResource
functions.description: Gets resources from the resource database of the X Window System.

functions.name: hiGetStrokeBBox
functions.description: Returns the bounding box of the stroke when within a callback initiated by a stroke.

functions.name: hiGetStrokeFirstPt
functions.description: Returns the point location of the first pixel of a stroke when within a callback initiated by a stroke.

functions.name: hiGetStrokeLastPt
functions.description: Returns the point location of the last pixel of a stroke when within a callback initiated by a stroke.

functions.name: hiGetTextCharAtLoc
functions.description: Returns the character of the specified character index location for a window.

functions.name: hiGetTextClass
functions.description: Returns the value of the current active text class. If hiSetTextClass() has not been set, the current active text class will be 0. Also, a few other functions may reset the active text class back to 0 or possibly another value. Otherwise the currently active text class will be the one set by the last call to hiSetTextClass().

functions.name: hiGetTextDispLoc
functions.description: Returns the top and bottom character locations of the current visible region of a window.

functions.name: hiGetTextFieldFit
functions.syntax: hiGetTextFieldFit(  x_rows x_columns g_ignored g_hasVerticalScrollbar g_hasHorizontalScrollbar )  => l_dimensions
functions.description: Returns the size necessary for a multiline text field to display x_rows and x_columns of characters.

functions.name: hiGetTextIndexLoc
functions.syntax: hiGetTextIndexLoc( w_windowId x_line x_column  )  => x_location / nil
functions.description: Returns the character index location of a line and column number in a window.

functions.name: hiGetTextLineColumn
functions.description: Returns the line and column number for an index location in a window.

functions.name: hiGetTextSelByLoc
functions.description: Returns a list of starting and ending location pairs of all selected text strings in the specified class.

functions.name: hiGetTextSelection
functions.description: Retrieves the currently selected text strings from within a specified class.

functions.name: hiGetTextSourceLength
functions.description: Returns the length of the source in a window.

functions.name: hiGetTextWidth
functions.description: Returns the width, in pixels, of a string of characters that has a specified font.

functions.name: hiGetTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Returns the current settings of the word delimiter list for the window.

functions.name: hiGetThumbnailFilename
functions.description: Returns the name of a thumbnail file for a given resolution. If no specific size is requested, the filename for the default thumbnail resolution will be used (as set by hiGetThumbnailDefaultResolution).

functions.name: hiGetToolbarObjName
functions.description: Gets the name that is used to store the toolbar's window configuration information. This name is set with the hiSetToolbarObjName function.

functions.name: hiGetTopListItem
functions.description: Returns the top item position of a listbox field.

functions.name: hiGetTree
functions.description: Gets the tree that is inserted under the item you specify.

functions.name: hiGetTreeItemDescription
functions.description: Returns the description of an item. The description is set initially with the g_description argument of hiCreateTreeItem. You can reset the description with hiSetTreeItemDescription.

functions.name: hiGetTreeItemIcons
functions.description: Gets the following icons associated with a tree item: default icon, expanded icon (displayed when the item is expanded), selection icon (displayed when the item is selected), and expanded selection icon (displayed when the item is both expanded and selected).

functions.name: hiGetTreeItemParent
functions.description: Gets the parent tree of an item, that is, the tree to which the item belongs. If the item is used in multiple places, this function returns all the parent trees.

functions.name: hiGetTreeItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items in a tree.

functions.name: hiGetTreeParent
functions.description: Gets the parent of a tree, that is, the item under which the tree is inserted. If the tree is inserted in multiple places, this function returns all the items under which it is inserted.

functions.name: hiGetUndoLimit
functions.description: Returns the maximum number of hiUndo commands that can be performed in sequence. This number is set with the hiSetUndoLimit function or with the Undo Limit field in the CIW User Preferences form.

functions.name: hiGetUserAbort
functions.description: Returns t if the user has pressed Ctrl-C to abort a procedure, and nil otherwise.

functions.name: hiGetViewBBox
functions.description: Returns the bounding box displayed in a window.

functions.name: hiGetWMOffsets
functions.description: Returns a list of offsets (dimensions) of the window manager border placed around each window.

functions.name: hiGetWidgetType
functions.description: Returns the widget type of a window. Valid widget types are session, graphics, text, hypertext, html, encap, form, and none.

functions.name: hiGetWinConfig
functions.description: Creates a new workspace based on the session window layout and returns its ID.

functions.name: hiGetWinConfigInfo
functions.description: Returns information about a workspace (window configuration): the list of dock assistants and toolbars that are are part of the workspace and whether they are visible, hidden, or floating.

functions.name: hiGetWinObjName
functions.description: Gets the window name that is used to store the dock assistant's workspace information. This name is set with the hiSetWinObjName function.

functions.name: hiGetWindowDisplayState
functions.description: Returns detailed information about the display state of a window.

functions.name: hiGetWindowFixedMenu
functions.description: Identifies the fixed menu on a window.

functions.name: hiGetWindowIconifyState
functions.description: Returns the icon position of an iconified window. If the window is contained in a session window, this function returns the icon position of the session window.

functions.name: hiGetWindowList
functions.description: Returns a list of window IDs of all windows that have been created but not closed, including those that are not currently displayed. You can specify the type of window with the s_windowType argument. By default, all windows except session windows and dock windows are returned.

functions.name: hiGetWindowMenu
functions.description: Returns the symbol of the menu associated with the specified window. This menu was associated with a window by using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiGetWindowName
functions.description: Returns the window name, which is displayed in the window manager frame of a window. This name is set with the hiSetWindowName function.

functions.name: hiGetWindowState
functions.description: Returns the display state of a window: mapped, unmapped, or iconified.

functions.name: hiGetWindowToolbars
functions.description: Gets the list of toolbars that a window contains. The toolbars are listed in the order in which they were placed in the window with hiPlaceToolbar.

functions.name: hiGetXFontName
functions.description: Returns the default font name for the specified font type that was used prior to TrueType fonts.

functions.name: hiGoToIndex
functions.syntax: hiGoToIndex( w_windowId x_indexNo ?highlight g_highlight ?align g_align ?forceAlign g_forceAlign ) => t / nil
functions.description: Positions the specified character index within the viewport for a given text window

functions.name: hiGoToLine
functions.syntax: hiGoToLine( w_windowId x_lineNo ?highlight g_highlight ?align g_align ?forceAlign g_forceAlign ) => t / nil
functions.description: Positions the specified line number onscreen for a given text window

functions.name: hiGraphicMode
functions.description: Returns t if the Virtuoso environment is currently running in graphical mode, nil if it is running in -nograph mode.

functions.name: hiHasToolbarBreak
functions.description: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether there was a toolbar break before the specified toolbar.

functions.name: hiHelp
functions.syntax: hiHelp(  s_objType S_objName  [ g_objDetail ] [ g_moreDetail ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Constructs a help symbol from its arguments and invokes the Cadence Help API to display the help document associated with the help symbol. If the hiHelpAction property is set, hiHelp executes the callback associated with the property, instead of calling the Cadence Help API. hiHelp is the main service routine for the online help system.

functions.name: hiHideProgressBar
functions.description: Removes the progress bar (and its label) from the window you specify.

functions.name: hiHideToolbar
functions.description: Hides a toolbar. If g_detach is set to t, this function removes the toolbar from the window.

functions.name: hiHighlightField
functions.syntax: hiHighlightField(  g_form  s_field  g_highlightType  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Highlights a type-in field depending on the value of g_highlightType.

functions.name: hiHypertextReadin
functions.description: Reads in a text file, which can include hyperlinks, into a hypertext field. This function resets the value of the hypertext field.

functions.name: hiHypertextReplace
functions.description: Replaces the text in a hypertext field with the new text that you provide. The text can contain hyperlinks. This function replaces the value of the hypertext field with the new text.

functions.name: hiHypertextScroll
functions.description: Scrolls a hypertext field to display the text containing the link you specify. This function updates the ?pos argument of hiCreateHypertextField().

functions.name: hiIconifyWindow
functions.description: Converts a window to its icon. If the window is contained in a session window, the session window is iconified.

functions.name: hiIgnoreProp
functions.description: Does not display the specified property of a given object type in the Property List Editor form.

functions.name: hiInEnterFun
functions.description: Returns the symbol of the enterfunction pending in the window.

functions.name: hiInFormApply
functions.description: Checks whether the Apply button on a mapped form is selected.

functions.name: hiInheritBindKey
functions.description: Causes a registered application to inherit bindkeys from another application.

functions.name: hiInsertBannerMenu
functions.syntax: hiInsertBannerMenu( w_windowId  g_menu  x_menuPosition  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a menu into the menu bar of a window. If the menu symbol that you specify already exists on the window, a warning message is issued and the menu is not placed on the window.

functions.name: hiInsertBlankCIWOutputPage
functions.description: Inserts a blank page to the CIW output area.

functions.name: hiInsertItemToLayout
functions.syntax: hiInsertItemToLayout(  g_formRegionOrLayout  g_item  [ ?layoutControls l_layoutControls ]  [ ?index x_index ]  [ ?toLayout s_layoutName ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts the required controls to the layout.

functions.name: hiInsertMenuItem
functions.syntax: hiInsertMenuItem( r_hiMenu  r_menuItem g_position  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a menu item or action into a specified position of all instances of r_hiMenu.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbar
functions.syntax: hiInsertToolbar( w_windowID o_hiToolbar s_toolbar ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a toolbar into the toolbar area of a window before s_toolbar.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbarBreak
functions.description: Inserts a toolbar break into the toolbar area of a window before the specified toolbar.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbarItem
functions.syntax: hiInsertToolbarItem( o_hiToolbar o_hiToolbarItem s_toolbarItemBefore ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts a toolbar item before a specific item in a toolbar.

functions.name: hiInsertToolbarItems
functions.syntax: hiInsertToolbarItems( o_hiToolbar l_hiToolbarItems s_toolbarItemBefore ) => t / nil
functions.description: Inserts toolbar items before a specific item in a toolbar.

functions.name: hiInstantiateForm
functions.description: Instantiates the C structure of a form from SKILL.

functions.name: hiIs2DMenu
functions.description: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid 2D menu.

functions.name: hiIsBlinkEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether blinking is enabled or not. You can use hiEnableBlink to enable or disable blinking in your current session.

functions.name: hiIsForm
functions.description: Checks whether a form or menu is a valid one.

functions.name: hiIsFormDisplayed
functions.description: Checks whether a form is displayed.

functions.name: hiIsIcon
functions.description: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid icon.

functions.name: hiIsInFieldCancel
functions.description: Query this function during a field callback to determine if the form is currently being canceled (the callback may be initiated by the cancel operation). If the form is being canceled, the form handle is returned; otherwise nil is returned.

functions.name: hiIsInReplay
functions.description: Indicates whether your Virtuoso session is in replay mode, that is, if commands are being executed from a replay file, which is typically a log file. Your session is in replay mode if you are running a Virtuoso workbench with the -replay logfile or -test option or if you are replaying a file with the hiReplayFile SKILL function.

functions.name: hiIsInstantiated
functions.description: Returns t if a form has been displayed at least once or a menu has been placed in a window. Returns nil if the form has been deleted or if g_formRegionOrMenu is not valid.

functions.name: hiIsMagnifierAnchored
functions.description: Checks if the magnifier has been anchored inside the specified graphics window. If the magnifier has been anchored it will not move with the mouse cursor.

functions.name: hiIsMagnifierOpened
functions.description: Indicates whether a magnifier is currently opened in the specified window.

functions.name: hiIsMenu
functions.description: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid menu.

functions.name: hiIsMenuItemEnabled
functions.syntax: hiIsMenuItemEnabled( r_hiMenu s_itemHandle [ w_windowId ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether a menu item is enabled.

functions.name: hiIsMenuSlotFilled
functions.description: Checks whether a menu already exists in the specified position in the menu bar of a window.

functions.name: hiIsProgressBoxCancelled
functions.description: Checks whether a progress box is canceled. A progress box is considered canceled if it is canceled with the Cancel button, canceled with the hiCancelProgressBox function, closed from the window manager, or automatically closed when the progress bar reaches 100% (if it was created with the ?autoClose argument set to t).

functions.name: hiIsScrollRegion
functions.description: Returns t if the item is a scroll region field, nil if it is not a scroll region field.

functions.name: hiIsWidgetType
functions.description: Determines if a widget type is valid or not.

functions.name: hiIsWindowSpecifier
functions.description: Validates a window specifier, which is passed as the boxSpec argument to the hiCreateWindow and hiOpenWindow functions.

functions.name: hiItemInsertTree
functions.description: Creates a sub-tree under an item. You need to specify the item and the sub-tree as the arguments for this function.

functions.name: hiItemRemoveTree
functions.description: Removes the sub-tree from an item in the tree. The item remains in the tree as a leaf; only the sub-tree under it is removed. The expansion icon next to the item is removed.

functions.name: hiLaunchBrowser
functions.description: Starts a Web browser, if needed, and opens the URL you specify.

functions.name: hiLayerMatchCyclicStr
functions.description: Returns the layer cyclic value associated with the specified t_layer.

functions.name: hiLayerStringToLPP
functions.description: Returns the layer object in the specified d_techFileID associated with the specified t_layer.

functions.name: hiLayoutUTp
functions.description: Verifies that an argument is an instantiated hiLayout object.

functions.name: hiListBoxCancel
functions.description: Performs the same action as the Cancel button on the listbox.

functions.name: hiListBoxDone
functions.description: Performs the same action as the OK button on the listbox.

functions.name: hiListFocusableToolbarItems
functions.description: Lists all type-in and combo toolbar items that are currently defined in the specified window and can be used as arguments for the function hiFocusToToolbarItem.

functions.name: hiListView
functions.description: Lists the saved viewing parameters for a given view, or for all views if viewName is not specified. This function applies to graphics windows only

functions.name: hiLoadIconData
functions.description: Loads a pixmap and returns it in a format that can be used with any hi function that accepts icons, such as hiCreateMenuItem or hiCreateButton. This function can load files that are in any of the image formats supported by Qt; currently these are:  BMP, JPG, PNG, PPM, XBM, and XPM. PNG is the recommended format.

functions.name: hiLoadIconFile
functions.syntax: hiLoadIconFile( t_fileName x_width x_height ) => l_hiIcon / nil
functions.description: Loads an icon file of any format, such as PNG, and returns the icon in a format that can be used with hi functions that accept icons. If t_fileName is a relative path, the Cadence Search File mechanism (CSF) is used to search for the file.

functions.name: hiLoadImageFile
functions.syntax: hiLoadImageFile( t_fileName x_width x_height ) => l_hiImage / nil
functions.description: Loads an image file of any format, such as PNG, and returns the image in a format that can be used with hi functions that accept icons. If t_fileName is a relative path, the Cadence Search File mechanism (CSF) is used to search for the file.

functions.name: hiLogDragEvents
functions.description: Starts logging drag events (mouse movements in a graphics window while an enter function is active) in the log file so that they can be replayed later.

functions.name: hiLookupHRFtag
functions.description: Returns the command that has been defined as the help response for a help tag in a .HRF file. You can get more information about the usage of this function from the your_install_dir/tools/dfII/samples/local/hrfHelp.il file.

functions.name: hiLowerTab
functions.description: Lowers a tabbed window contained in a session window to the bottom of the list of tabbed windows.  If there is only a single tab, the function does nothing.  If there are multiple tabs, and the function is passed the window ID of the current tab, and it cycles to the next tab in the sequence.   If passed the window ID of one of the tabs that is not the current tab, the function does nothing.

functions.name: hiLowerWindow
functions.description: Lowers a window to the bottom of the list of visible windows.

functions.name: hiMapWindow
functions.description: Displays a window, dockable window, or session window on screen.

functions.name: hiMarkNestable
functions.description: Makes enterfunctions nestable. When an enterfunction is running and a new one is called, the new enterfunction replaces the old enterfunction in the stack. When the new enterfunction is finished or canceled, the old enterfunction is resumed. This function reverses the effect of hiMarkNonNestable.

functions.name: hiMarkNonNestable
functions.description: Makes enterfunctions non-nestable. When an enterfunction is running and a new one is called, the new enterfunction replaces it in the stack. When the new enterfunction is finished or canceled, the enterfunction it replaced will not be returned to, but will have been canceled by the new enterfunction.

functions.name: hiMatchColor
functions.description: Returns a layer color index corresponding to the specified RGB color. It creates a new color index if the color specified does not have any corresponding index.

functions.name: hiMatchColorByName
functions.description: Returns a layer color index corresponding to the specified color name.

functions.name: hiModalDBoxHelp
functions.description: Displays a message in a modal dialog box. A modal dialog box is a blocking dialog box-it waits for an acknowledgement before allowing the application to continue.

functions.name: hiModelessDBoxHelp
functions.description: Displays a message in a modeless dialog box. A modeless dialog box is a non-blocking dialog box-it does not wait for an acknowledgement before allowing the application to continue.

functions.name: hiMoveField
functions.syntax: hiMoveField(  r_2DFormOr2DMenu  s_field  l_location  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Moves the specified field to a new location. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiMoveFixedMenu
functions.syntax: hiMoveFixedMenu(  [ ?window w_window ]  [ ?menuSide s_menuSide ]  [ ?fixedMenu g_fixedMenu ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Moves the fixed menu to the opposite side of the window. NOTE: Fixed menus are no longer supported in windows. Use the new toolbar functions to create toolbars instead for windows. Existing fixed menus that have been added to windows will no longer be displayed, although they will not generate any warnings. Replace these menus with toolbars.

functions.name: hiMoveInsBarToEnd
functions.description: Places the cursor (insertion point) at the end of a text field, scrolling the field so the cursor is visible.

functions.name: hiMoveToFormField
functions.syntax: hiMoveToFormField(  g_formOrRegion s_field )  => moved / focused / nil
functions.description: If the specified field is a text field and can accept input focus, it is set as the current field and the input focus is set to it.

functions.name: hiMoveWindow
functions.description: Moves the lower left corner of a window to a new screen location. If w_windowId is a window contained in a session window, the session window is moved.

functions.name: hiNextWinView
functions.description: Undoes hiPrevWinView on a graphics window.

functions.name: hiOffsetField
functions.syntax: hiOffsetField(  r_2DFormOr2DMenu  s_field  l_offsets  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Offsets one field from its current position. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiOffsetFields
functions.syntax: hiOffsetFields(  r_2DFormOr2DMenu  l_fields l_offsets  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Offsets several fields from their current positions. All fields are offset by the same distance (l_offsets); they move as a block. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiOpenWindow
functions.syntax: hiOpenWindow( [ ?bBox l_boxSpec ]  [ ?type t_widgetType ]  [ ?appType t_applicationType ]  [ ?menus l_menus ]  [ ?labels l_labels ]  [ ?help t_helpString ]  [ ?scroll g_scrollbars ] [ ?form g_form ] [ ?closeProc s_closeProc ] [ ?iconPosition l_iconPosition ] [ ?session g_sessionWindow ] [ ?tabTitle g_tabTitle ] [ ?tabIcon g_tabIcon ] [ ?tabTip g_tabTip ] )  => w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a window. This function displays the new window in a session window if the session window argument is specified or if the new window is a graphics window.

functions.name: hiPan
functions.description: Scrolls a window so that the display is centered on a point.

functions.name: hiPickWindow
functions.description: Lets you select a window without changing the current window. When this function is called, the pointer is grabbed and not released until either the mouse button or the Escape key is pressed. Any other keyboard event is ignored and the mouse click is not passed on to anything else.

functions.name: hiPlaceToolbar
functions.syntax: hiPlaceToolbar( w_windowID o_hiToolbar [ s_toolbarArea ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds a toolbar to the specified toolbar area of a window. If the toolbar already exists on the window, this function moves it to the specified area. The toolbar is placed at the end of the current toolbars in that area.

functions.name: hiPlaceToolbarBreak
functions.description: Adds a toolbar break to the specified toolbar area of a window.

functions.name: hiPrevWinView
functions.description: Restores a graphics window to the view displayed before the last zoom or pan command.

functions.name: hiPrintToLogFile
functions.description: Prints the specified string to the CDS.log file, and to any secondary log files that might have been opened with hiStartLog, without displaying it in the CIW output area.

functions.name: hiQueryFont
functions.description: Returns the values of the attributes of S_fontType.

functions.name: hiQuit
functions.description: Quits the Virtuoso session.

functions.name: hiRaiseTab
functions.description: Raises a tab contained in a multi-tabbed session window to the top of the list and makes it the active tab. If there is only a single tab, the function does nothing.

functions.name: hiRaiseWindow
functions.description: Raises a window to the top of the list of visible windows.

functions.name: hiReadWinConfig
functions.description: Reads a workspace file previously saved by hiSaveWinConfig and returns the workspace ID.

functions.name: hiReattachField
functions.description: Reattaches a field in a two-dimensional form or scroll region that has field attachments. This function places the field according to the new position and attachment information. This function can be used only with forms or scroll regions that already have field attachments. For forms or scroll regions that do not have field attachments, use the hiMoveField, hiResizeField, hiOffsetField, and hiOffsetFields functions.

functions.name: hiReattachToolbar
functions.description: Reattaches a given toolbar to its parent main window without showing it.

functions.name: hiRedo
functions.description: Undoes the last hiUndo, assuming no other database modifications have occurred.

functions.name: hiRedraw
functions.description: Redraws the contents of a window.

functions.name: hiRefreshTextWindow
functions.description: Redraws all the selections and refreshes the viewfile window.

functions.name: hiRegCloseProc
functions.description: Registers the procedure to be called when a window is closed. You can register closing procedures for windows, session windows, and dockable windows. A session window's closing procedure is called before the closing procedure of any of the windows it contains.

functions.name: hiRegCurWindowTrigger
functions.description: Registers the SKILL function to be called whenever the current window changes. The SKILL function will be called with one argument: an integer representing the window number of the new current window. If no window is current (for example, if all windows except the CIW are closed or if any open windows have the property neverCurrentWindow set to t), then the argument is 0.

functions.name: hiRegSetBindKeyProc
functions.syntax: hiRegSetBindKeyProc( t_application S_function [ g_notInherited ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function that will be called after a bindkey is set for the specified application with the hiSetBindKey function or the CIW's Key or Mouse Binding form, or after a set of bindkeys is defined with the hiSetBindKeys function.

functions.name: hiRegTimer
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function string that is executed after the specified time.

functions.name: hiRegZoomPanProc
functions.description: Registers a SKILL procedure for a graphics window that will be called whenever a user uses a zoom, pan, fit, or redraw command in that window. If you do not specify a window while registering the procedure, the procedure will be called whenever the user uses these commands in any graphics window. The SKILL procedure is passed the window ID and the bounding box of the display in user units.

functions.name: hiRegisterBindKeyPrefix
functions.description: Registers an application bindkey prefix. Use this function to register prefixes that you do not want to register with the Design Editor application. Cadence applications are already registered.

functions.name: hiRemoveFixedMenu
functions.description: Removes a fixed menu from a window. If you do not specify a menu, all fixed menus are removed. To delete a fixed menu, first use hiRemoveFixedMenu to remove the fixed menu from the window and then use hiDeleteMenu to destroy the fixed menu.

functions.name: hiRemoveNonRepeatPrefix
functions.description: Removes a repeat filter prefix that has been previously added using hiAddNonRepeatPrefix.

functions.name: hiRemovePromptLine
functions.description: Removes the prompt line from the graphics window you specify or, if you do not specify a window, from the current window.

functions.name: hiRemoveTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Removes characters from the word delimiter list for the window.

functions.name: hiRepeat
functions.description: Re-executes the last command executed in the CIW.

functions.name: hiReplaceAllBannerMenus
functions.description: Replaces all menus in a window with new menus.

functions.name: hiReplaceTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Replaces the original word delimiters for the window with a new set of characters.

functions.name: hiReplayFile
functions.description: Replays a log file. Use this function only for testing or debugging. In general, use the functions load or loadi instead of hiReplayFile. hiReplayFile is intended to be run only from a Command Interpreter Window.

functions.name: hiReportDeselectAllItems
functions.description: Deselects all selected items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportDeselectItem
functions.syntax: hiReportDeselectItem( g_reportField g_itemIndex [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects an item in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportDeselectItems
functions.syntax: hiReportDeselectItems( g_reportField l_itemIndexList [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deselects items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportGetSelectedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently selected in a report field.

functions.name: hiReportSelectAllItems
functions.description: Selects all items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportSelectItem
functions.syntax: hiReportSelectItem( g_reportField g_itemIndex [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects an item in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiReportSelectItems
functions.syntax: hiReportSelectItems( g_reportField l_itemIndexList [ g_notify ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Selects items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiResetAbort
functions.description: Sets the global abort flag to nil.

functions.name: hiResetProgressBox
functions.syntax: hiResetProgressBox( g_pboxID x_totalSteps t_text g_autoClose ) => t / nil
functions.description: Resets a progess dialog box to the new values you specify. The progress bar is also reset to 0%.

functions.name: hiResizeField
functions.syntax: hiResizeField(  r_2DForm  s_field  l_resizeDescription  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Changes the width, height, or promptBox width of a specified field. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

functions.name: hiResizeMagnifier
functions.description: Changes the magnifier size dynamically.

functions.name: hiResizeWindow
functions.description: Resizes a window to the size of a bounding box. If w_windowID is a window within a session window, the session window is resized.

functions.name: hiRestoreView
functions.description: Restores a graphics window to the view specified by viewName.

functions.name: hiSaveAsViewfile
functions.description: Saves the contents of the current window to the specified name.

functions.name: hiSaveForRestore
functions.description: Saves your session information in the file you specify. This function is the programmatic equivalent of selecting the Options - Save Sessions command in the CIW and saving a file in the Save Sessions form that appears.

functions.name: hiSaveIconData
functions.syntax: hiSaveIconData( l_hiIcon t_fileName [ t_formatName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a loaded pixmap to a file in the format that you specify. This function accepts an hi pixmap description and converts it to any of the image formats supported by Qt; currently, these are: BMP, JPG, PNG, PPM, XBM, and XPM. However, PNG is the recommended format.

functions.name: hiSaveView
functions.description: Saves the current viewing parameters of a graphics window.

functions.name: hiSaveViewfile
functions.syntax: hiSaveViewfile( [ w_windowId ]  [ t_fileName ]  [ g_donotOverwrite ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Saves the contents of the viewfile window to a file on disk. If you do not specify any arguments, a Save As form appears that lets you select the file.

functions.name: hiSaveWinConfig
functions.syntax: hiSaveWinConfig( n_configID t_pathToFile [ g_overwrite ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Saves a workspace to a file. The g_overwrite argument lets you specify whether or not to overwrite an existing file.

functions.name: hiScaleBox
functions.description: Returns a bounding box that has the same center point as the bounding box passed in, but whose sides are scaled by 1/n_scale.

functions.name: hiScaleMagnifier
functions.description: Changes the zooming factor of the magnifier dynamically.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowBottom
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the bottom position of the viewable window.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowDown
functions.description: Scrolls the window down one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowLeft
functions.description: Scrolls the window left one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowRight
functions.description: Scrolls the window right one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowToCurrentIndex
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the current cursor index position in the viewable window.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowToIndex
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the index position in the specified window and forces the text at the given position to be displayed.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowToName
functions.description: Scrolls a hypertext window to a link and displays the text associated with the link. A hypertext window is a text window that can display text with hyperlinks in it.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowTop
functions.description: Scrolls the window to the top position of the viewable window.

functions.name: hiScrollWindowUp
functions.description: Scrolls the window up one screenful of text at a time.

functions.name: hiSelectTextByLoc
functions.syntax: hiSelectTextByLoc( w_windowId  l_locationPair [ x_class ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Highlights a list of strings specified as a list of starting and ending location pairs.

functions.name: hiSetAbort
functions.description: Sets the global abort flag to t.

functions.name: hiSetActionChecked
functions.syntax: hiSetActionChecked( o_action g_checkState [ g_triggerCB ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets an action's checked state (checked or unchecked) and triggers the action's callback, unless you specify otherwise by setting g_triggerCB to nil.

functions.name: hiSetBeepVolume
functions.description: Sets the loudness of the beep.

functions.name: hiSetBindKey
functions.syntax: hiSetBindKey( [ t_applicationType ]  [ t_key ]  [ t_skill_cmd ]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Binds a SKILL command string to a keyboard key or a mouse sequence for an application.

functions.name: hiSetBindKeys
functions.description: Sets multiple bindkeys for an application at one time. For memory and performance efficiency, use this function instead of hiSetBindKey if you are setting multiple bindkeys. For information about restrictions, see hiSetBindKey.

functions.name: hiSetButtonIcon
functions.description: Changes a button's icon after the button is created. This function updates all instances of the button.

functions.name: hiSetButtonLabel
functions.description: Changes a button's label text or icon after the button is created. This function updates all instances of the button.

functions.name: hiSetCallbackStatus
functions.description: Overrides the removal (unmapping) of a form when the form's OK button is pressed.

functions.name: hiSetClipboard
functions.description: Sets the text to be pushed to the system clipboard.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentField
functions.syntax: hiSetCurrentField( g_form  s_fieldName [ g_limitSearch ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Makes the specified type-in field the current field (sets input focus to the field). If the field is not visible, hiSetCurrentField scrolls the form or scroll region field so the field becomes visible.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentForm
functions.syntax: hiSetCurrentForm( g_form [ g_setIfNotDisplayed [ g_setIfNotInstantiated ] ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Makes the form you specify the current form. If the form is displayed, moves the focus to the form.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentIndex
functions.description: Sets the current cursor index position relative to all the text in a window and scrolls the window if needed.

functions.name: hiSetCurrentTextSelectionLoc
functions.syntax: hiSetCurrentTextSelectionLoc( w_windowId  x_startIndex  x_endIndex  ) => t | nil
