functions.name: xstInGetVMLibs
functions.description: Returns the list of virtual memory libraries created by XStream In. Only the primary libraries created by XStream In are returned. The additional libraries that are created if the number of cellviews is more than the value specified in the Maximum Cells in Target Library field are not returned by this function.

functions.name: xstInOnCancel
functions.description: This is a user-defined function, which is called when user presses the Cancel button.

functions.name: xstInOnCompletion
functions.description: This is a user-defined function, which is called when the translation is completed.

functions.name: xstInOnTranslate
functions.description: This is a user-defined function, which is called when user presses the Apply or Translate button.

functions.name: xstInSaveVMLib
functions.description: Saves the specified virtual memory library, t_vmLibName, to either the specified directory, t_path, or the current working directory, if t_path is not specified. Multiple libraries are created in a single translation using XStream In if the number of cellviews is more than the value specified in the Maximum Cells in Target Library field. All the libraries created during a single XStream In translation are also saved.

functions.name: xstInSetField
functions.description: Enables you to populate GUI field values in the XStream In form. You can populate all the GUI field values using the appropriate option name and value.

functions.name: xstOutDoTranslate
functions.description: Issues the StreamOut command based on the GUI field values. By default, this function is a non-blocking function. However, if the Stream Out From Virtual Memory option is selected, then this function becomes a blocking function.

functions.name: xstOutOnCancel
functions.description: This is a user-defined function, which is called when user presses the Cancel button.

functions.name: xstOutOnCompletion
functions.description: This is a user-defined function, which is called when the translation is completed.

functions.name: xstOutOnTranslate
functions.description: This is a user-defined function, which is called when user presses the Apply or Translate button.

functions.name: xstSetField
functions.description: Enables you to populate GUI field values in the XStream Out form. You can populate all the GUI field values using the appropriate option name and value.

functions.name: vpmExportDotLib
functions.description: Exports the extracted power intent in the .lib file format.

functions.name: vpmExportPowerIntent
functions.description: Exports the 1801 Design Model for a design. Ensure that the design has been extracted by using vpmExtractPowerIntent or the GUI options in Virtuoso Schematic Editor. This function requires a session ID, which is generated upon successful power intent extraction for the design.

functions.name: vpmExportPowerIntentSetup
functions.syntax: vpmExportPowerIntentSetup( t_setup_file_name [ ?overwriteExisting g_overwriteExisting ] [ ?filter g_filter ] [ ?lpDBLibName g_lpDBLibName ] [ ?lpDBCellName g_lpDBCellName ] [ ?lpDBViewName g_lpDBViewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Exports the loaded setup to a specified file. This file can be verified for the setup options that the Power Manager has used during import/export of power intent.

functions.name: vpmExportPowerModel
functions.description: Exports the 1801 power model for a design. Ensure that the design has been extracted by using vpmExtractPowerIntent, or using the GUI options in Virtuoso Schematic Editor. This function requires a session ID, which is generated upon successful power intent extraction for the design.

functions.name: vpmExtractPowerIntent
functions.syntax: vpmExtractPowerIntent( t_lib t_cellName t_viewName ) => session_id / nil
functions.description: Extracts the power intent from the given design. It also identifies sub-hierarchical blocks in the top-level design, which need macro model extraction or are associated with a 1801 file.

functions.name: vpmImportPowerIntent
functions.syntax: vpmImportPowerIntent( t_libname t_cellname  t_viewname t_viewlist t_file1801Path [ ? resolveTopNets g_resolveTopNets ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Imports the power intent for any cellview. Apart from this, in the design hierarchy, the SKILL function creates the netSet properties and resolves tie connections. It also creates supply pins corresponding to the power domain nets and global nets.

functions.name: vpmImportPowerIntentSetup
functions.syntax: vpmImportPowerIntentSetup( t_libname t_cellname  t_viewname t_setup_file_name [ ? lpDBLibName g_lpDBLibName ] [ ? lpDBCellName g_lpDBCellName ] [ ? lpDBViewName g_lpDBViewName ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Imports a SKILL file that contains the user-defined setup. This has the attributes required to extract the desired information from the design cellview for importing or exporting the power intent.

functions.name: vpmRemoveImportedPowerIntent
functions.syntax: vpmRemoveImportedPowerIntent( t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ) => writeMixedFormatPST/ nil
functions.description: Removes the entire power intent information that was imported for a cellview. This function also removes the netSet properties, tie connections, supply pins, and so on.

functions.name: 1/x
functions.description: Returns the inverse value. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: 10**x
functions.description: Returns the 10x value of the input signal. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: OS
functions.description: Returns the specified device parameter of the given instance from the DC analysis data.

functions.name: OT
functions.description: Returns the specified device parameter of the given instance from the transient analysis data.

functions.name: PN
functions.description: Returns a waveform for the transient phase noise of the input waveforms in decibels (dBc/Hz). Phase noise is defined as the power spectral density of the absolute jitter of an input waveform. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: Rn
functions.description: Returns the equivalent noise resistance as a function of frequency. This function is available only on a 2-port network from that uses a S-parameter analysis.

functions.name: a2d
functions.description: Returns the digital form of an analog input waveform, which may be a scalar, list or family of waveforms or a string representation of expressions. The corresponding SKILL command name for this function is awvAnalog2Digital.

functions.name: aaSP
functions.description: Returns the S-parameter waveform for a two-port network for the specified portorder values. The S-parameters describe the response of an N-port network to voltage signals at each port.

functions.name: abs_jitter
functions.description: Returns a waveform that contains the absolute jitter values in the input waveform for the given threshold. The output waveform can be expressed in degrees, radians, or unit intervals (UI). The absolute jitter can be plotted as a function of cycle number, crossing time, or reference clock time.

functions.name: acos
functions.description: Returns the inverse cosine of a ignal.

functions.name: acosh
functions.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine or hyperbolic arc-cosine of a signal.

functions.name: adtFFT
functions.description: Calculates the fast Fourier transform (FFT) of the input list.

functions.name: adtIFFT
functions.description: Calculates the inverse discrete Fourier transform of the input list.

functions.name: analog2Digital
functions.description: Returns the digital form of the analog input signal.

functions.name: appendWaves
functions.syntax: appendWaves(  o_wave1  o_wave2  [ o_waveN ]  )  => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Appends a series of input waveforms in the X vector direction into a single output waveform.It is the users responsibility to insure that the input waveforms X vectors are in the proper sequence.

functions.name: armSetCalc
functions.description: Sets the calculator resource of the specified property to the specified value.

functions.name: asin
functions.description: Returns the inverse sine of a signal.

functions.name: asinh
functions.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine or hyperbolic arc-sine of a signal.

functions.name: atan
functions.description: Returns the nverse tangent of a signal.

functions.name: atanh
functions.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent or hyperbolic arc tangent of a signal.

functions.name: average
functions.description: Computes the average of a waveform over its entire range. Average is defined as the integral of the expression f(x) over the range of x, divided by the range of x.

functions.name: awvAddSubwindow
functions.description: Adds a subwindow to the Waveform window.

functions.name: awvAnalog2Digital
functions.syntax: awvAnalog2Digital(  o_wave n_vhi  n_vlo  n_vc  n_timex  t_thresholdType  )  => o_digWave / n_digval / nil
functions.description: Returns the digital form of the analog input, which can be a waveform, list or family of waveforms, or a string representation of expression(s).

functions.name: awvAppendExpression
functions.syntax: awvAppendExpression( w_windowId t_expr l_context [ ?index			l_waveIndexList ] [ ?color			l_colorList ] [ ?lineType			l_styleList ] [ ?dataSymbol			l_symbolList ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?showSymbols			l_showList ] [ ?lineStyle			l_styleList ] [ ?lineThickness l_thicknessList ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Evaluates the t_expr expression and adds the resulting waveforms to a subwindow.

functions.name: awvAppendList
functions.syntax: awvAppendList( w_windowId l_YListList l_XList [ ?index			l_waveIndexList ] [ ?color			l_colorList ] [ ?lineType			l_styleList ] [ ?dataSymbol			l_symbolList ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => t | nil
functions.description: Plots the Y values in l_YListList against the X values in l_XList and adds the resulting waveforms to a subwindow.

functions.name: awvAppendWaveform
functions.syntax: awvAppendWaveform( w_windowId l_waveform [ ?expr			l_exprList ] [ ?index			l_waveIndexList ] [ ?color			l_colorList ] [ ?lineType			l_styleList ] [ ?dataSymbol			l_symbolList ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?stripNumber			l_stripNumberList ] [ ?showSymbols			l_showList ] [ ?lineStyle			l_styleList ] [ ?lineThickness 		l_thicknessList ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Adds the waveforms in the l_waveform list to a subwindow.

functions.name: awvClearPlotWindow
functions.description: Clears the graphics shown in the waveform window. The History for the window and subwindows are maintained.

functions.name: awvClearSubwindowHistory
functions.description: Erases the contents of a particular subwindow. This function deletes the waveforms, title, date stamp, and labels stored in internal memory. The other subwindows are not affected.

functions.name: awvClearWindowHistory
functions.description: Erases the contents of a Waveform window and deletes the waveforms, title, date stamp, and labels stored in internal memory. This function operates on subwindows whose update statuses are on. To force this function to operate on all subwindows, set g_force to t.

functions.name: awvCloseCalculator
functions.description: Closes calculator window of the current session or the session specified (optional).

functions.name: awvCloseWindow
functions.description: Closes the specified Waveform window.

functions.name: awvCloseWindowMenuCB
functions.description: Closes the current window.

functions.name: awvCreateBus
functions.description: Creates a bus with the given digital signals and radix type.

functions.name: awvCreateBusFromWaveList
functions.description: Creates a digital bus from a list of digital waves provided as input.

functions.name: awvCreatePlotWindow
functions.description: Creates a Waveform window and returns the window ID.

functions.name: awvDeleteAllWaveforms
functions.description: Deletes all the waveforms in the specified subwindow.

functions.name: awvDeleteMarker
functions.syntax: awvDeleteMarker( w_windowId t_bookmarkId | l_bookmarkIds [ ?subwindow x_subwindow ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified bookmark(s) from the given window.

functions.name: awvDeleteSubwindow
functions.description: Deletes a subwindow from a Waveform window.

functions.name: awvDeleteWaveform
functions.syntax: awvDeleteWaveform( w_windowId x_index [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a waveform curve from a subwindow.

functions.name: awvDigital2Analog
functions.syntax: awvDigital2Analog(  o_waveform  n_vhi  n_vlo  s_VX  [ ?mode s_mode ] [ ?outWaveType s_outWaveType ] [ ?vprevSTART s_vprevSTART ] )  => o_waveform | nil
functions.description: Computes the analog output of the provided digital waveform o_waveform.

functions.name: awvDisableRedraw
functions.description: Disables or enables redraw of the Waveform window based on the value of the g_disable flag. You might use this function to freeze the Waveform window display, send several plots to the window, then unfreeze the window to display all the plots at once.

functions.name: awvDisplayDate
functions.description: Displays the current date and time in the Waveform windowwindow.

functions.name: awvDisplayGrid
functions.syntax: awvDisplayGrid( w_windowId  g_on  [ ?subwindow x_subwindow ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the display status for a grid on the indicated waveform subwindow.

functions.name: awvDisplaySubwindowTitle
functions.syntax: awvDisplaySubwindowTitle( w_windowId t_title [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Displays a title in a subwindow.

functions.name: awvDisplayTitle
functions.description: Displays a title on a Waveform window.

functions.name: awvEraseWindowMenuCB
functions.description: Deletes all the objects (e.g. waveforms, markers) from the waveform subwindow.

functions.name: awvEval
functions.description: Returns the expression

functions.name: awvExitWindowFunctionAdd
functions.description: Adds a function to the list of functions that are called when you close a Waveform window or exit the Cadence software while a Waveform Window is open.

functions.name: awvExitWindowFunctionDel
functions.description: Deletes a function from the list of functions that are called when you close a Waveform window or exit the Cadence software while a Waveform window is open.

functions.name: awvExitWindowFunctionGet
functions.description: Gets the list of functions that are called when you close a Waveform window or exit the Cadence software while a Waveform window is open.

functions.name: awvEyeCross
functions.description: Returns an output waveform showing X-axis values where the given eye diagram crosses the specified threshold on Y-axis.

functions.name: awvGetAssertName
functions.description: Returns the name of assert defined in violation data.

functions.name: awvGetCurrentSubwindow
functions.description: Returns the current subwindow.

functions.name: awvGetCurrentWindow
functions.description: Returns the window ID for the current Waveform window.

functions.name: awvGetDisplayMode
functions.description: Returns the display mode of a subwindow.

functions.name: awvGetDrawStatus
functions.description: Returns the draw status of the waveform display window.

functions.name: awvGetHiWindow
functions.description: Returns the ID of the waveform HI window corresponding to the specified waveform window ID. This function is primarily used to support menu customization using HI calls.

functions.name: awvGetInitializationTimeout
functions.description: Retrieves the time-out period (in seconds) set for ADE to establish connection with Virtuoso Visualization and Analysis XL.

functions.name: awvGetOnSubwindowList
functions.description: Returns the list of subwindows that are being used in the specified Waveform window. This list includes only subwindows whose display and update statuses are turned on. To get a list of all subwindows whose displays are on, regardless of update status, set g_all to t.

functions.name: awvGetPlotStyle
functions.description: Gets the plotting style for the waveforms in a subwindow.

functions.name: awvGetScalarFromWave
functions.description: Returns the Y-axis value of the point when the input waveform is single point. If the waveform has multiple points, this function returns back the input waveform.

functions.name: awvGetSelectedTraceWaveforms
functions.description: Returns a list of waveforms corresponding to the traces that are selected in the specified or current subwindow of the given window.

functions.name: awvGetSmithModeType
functions.description: Returns the Smith display type of a subwindow.

functions.name: awvGetStripNumberOfSelectedTrace
functions.description: Returns the strip number of the selected trace plotted in the specified window.

functions.name: awvGetStripNumbersList
functions.description: Returns the list of strip numbers in the specified subwindow of the given window.

functions.name: awvGetSubwindowList
functions.description: Returns a list of all the subwindows whose update statuses are turned on, regardless of whether their displays are on or off. To get a list of all subwindows, including subwindows whose update statuses are off, set g_all to t.

functions.name: awvGetSubwindowStripCount
functions.description: Returns the total number of strips displayed in the specified subwindow of the given window.

functions.name: awvGetSubwindowTitle
functions.description: Returns the title of the subwindow.

functions.name: awvGetUnusedEntityList
functions.syntax: awvGetUnusedEntityList( w_windowId [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?total		x_total ] ) => l_waveformEntityIndices | nil
functions.description: Returns a list of integers that have not already been used to identify curves in a subwindow. You can specify the total number of integers to include in the return value with x_total.

functions.name: awvGetWaveNameList
functions.description: Returns a list that contains two elements. The first element is a list of numbers for the curves and the second is a list of the corresponding names.

functions.name: awvGetWindowList
functions.description: Returns a list of all the Waveform Windows associated with the current process.

functions.name: awvGetWindowTitle
functions.description: Returns the title of the waveform window.

functions.name: awvGetXAxisLabel
functions.syntax: awvGetXAxisLabel( w_windowId [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?computed			g_computed ] ) => t_label | nil
functions.description: Returns the user-specified X axis label if you set computed to nil. Returns the system-computed X axis label otherwise.

functions.name: awvGetXAxisMajorDivisions
functions.description: Returns the number of major divisions that are set on the X-axis of a given graph.

functions.name: awvGetXAxisMinorDivisions
functions.description: Returns the number of minor divisions on the X-axis of a given graph.

functions.name: awvGetXAxisStepValue
functions.description: Returns the step size value for the X-axis for a given graph.

functions.name: awvGetXAxisUseStepValue
functions.description: Determines whether the X-axis scale uses the step value.

functions.name: awvGetXMarkerNames
functions.description: Returns the names of all the X markers in a subwindow.

functions.name: awvGetYAxisLabel
functions.syntax: awvGetYAxisLabel( w_windowId x_yNumber [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?computed			g_computed ] [ ?stripNumber			x_stripNumber ] ) => t_label | nil
functions.description: Returns the user-specified Y axis label if you set computed to nil. Returns the system-computed Y axis label otherwise.

functions.name: awvGetYAxisMajorDivisions
functions.syntax: awvGetYAxisMajorDivisions( w_windowId x_yNumber [ ?subwindow w_subwindow ] )  => x_majdivs / nil
functions.description: Returns the number of major divisions that are set on the Y-axis of a given graph.

functions.name: awvGetYAxisMinorDivisions
functions.syntax: awvGetYAxisMinorDivisions( w_windowId  x_yNumber [ ?stripNumber x_stripNumber ] [ ?subwindow w_subwindow ] )  => x_mindivs / nil
functions.description: Returns the number of minor divisions on the specified Y-axis of a given graph.

functions.name: awvGetYAxisStepValue
functions.syntax: awvGetYAxisStepValue( w_windowId  x_yNumber [ ?stripNumber x_stripNumber ] [ ?subwindow w_subwindow ] )  => x_stepSize / nil
functions.description: Returns the step size value for the specified Y-axis for a given graph.

functions.name: awvGetYAxisUseStepValue
functions.syntax: awvGetYAxisUseStepValue( w_windowId  x_yNumber [ ?stripNumber x_stripNumber ] [ ?subwindow w_subwindow ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Determines whether the Y-axis scale use the step value for the specified strip in a given graph.

functions.name: awvGetYMarkerNames
functions.description: Returns the names of all the Y markers in a subwindow.

functions.name: awvInitWindowFunctionAdd
functions.description: Adds a function to the list of functions that are called when a new Waveform window is opened. The list of functions is empty by default. For example, you can use this function to add menus to every new Waveform window that is opened.

functions.name: awvInitWindowFunctionDel
functions.description: Deletes a function from the list of functions that are called when a new Waveform window is opened.

functions.name: awvInitWindowFunctionGet
functions.description: Returns the current list of functions that are called when a new Waveform window is opened. This list is empty by default.

functions.name: awvIsPlotWindow
functions.description: Returns t if the specified window is a Waveform window.

functions.name: awvLoadCustomCalcFunction
functions.description: Loads the specified custom function template to the Function Panel of Calculator. This function template contains the UI definitions corresponding to the given SKILL function. These UI definitions can be obtained from the specified SKILL file or from a separate .ocn file.

functions.name: awvLoadEyeMask
functions.description: Loads the eye mask saved in a VCSV file and adds it to the eye mask list in the Eye Diagram assistant. The loaded eye mask is displayed in the Mask drop-down list of the Eye Mask tab.

functions.name: awvLoadMenuCB
functions.description: Displays the Load Menu (Windows -> Load ...).

functions.name: awvLoadSharedCustomFunctionsFile
functions.description: This function is used to share custom functions template among multiple users from a central file location.

functions.name: awvLoadWindow
functions.syntax: awvLoadWindow(  w_windowId  t_fileName  [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] )  => t / nil
functions.description: Initializes the state of a Waveform window from information saved in a file.

functions.name: awvLogXAxis
functions.syntax: awvLogXAxis( w_windowId g_state [ ?subwindow x_subwindowID ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the X axis for a strip in a subwindow to display logarithmically if the g_state flag is set to t. If g_state is not set to t, the display is set to linear.

functions.name: awvLogYAxis
functions.syntax: awvLogYAxis( w_windowId x_yNumber g_state [ ?stripNumber			x_stripNumber ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the Y axis for a strip in a subwindow to display logarithmically if the g_state flag is set to t. If g_state is not set to t, the display is set to linear. If you do not specify a strip, the limits are applied when the Waveform window is in the composite mode.

functions.name: awvPlaceAMarker
functions.description: Places marker of type A on the specified trace.

functions.name: awvPlaceBMarker
functions.description: Places marker of type B on the specified trace.

functions.name: awvPlaceBookmark
functions.description: Adds a bookmark in the specified window. You can create bookmarks on the graph for the regions that you are interested in. The bookmarks can be organized into groups, where a bookmark group can contain other groups.

functions.name: awvPlaceWaveformLabel
functions.syntax: awvPlaceWaveformLabel( w_windowId x_waveIndex l_location t_label t_expr [ ?textOffset			g_textOffset ] [ ?color			t_color ] [ ?justify			t_justify ] [ ?fontStyle			t_fontStyle ] [ ?height			t_height ] [ ?orient			t_orient ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => s_labelId | nil
functions.description: Attaches a label to the specified waveform curve in a subwindow.

functions.name: awvPlaceWindowLabel
functions.syntax: awvPlaceWindowLabel( w_windowId l_location t_label t_expr [ ?color			t_color ] [ ?justify			t_justify ] [ ?fontStyle			t_fontStyle ] [ ?height			t_height ] [ ?orient			t_orient ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => s_labelId | nil
functions.description: Displays a label in a subwindow.

functions.name: awvPlaceXMarker
functions.syntax: awvPlaceXMarker( w_windowId n_xLoc [ ?label t_label ] [ ?subwindow	 		x_subwindowId ] )  => t_xLoc / t / nil
functions.description: Places a vertical marker at a specific x-coordinate in the optionally specified subwindow of the specified window.

functions.name: awvPlaceYMarker
functions.syntax: awvPlaceYMarker( w_windowId n_yLoc [ ?label t_label ] [ ?subwindow x_subwindowId ] )  => t_yLoc / t / nil
functions.description: Places a horizontal marker at a specific y-coordinate in the optionally specified subwindow of the specified window.

functions.name: awvPlotExpression
functions.syntax: awvPlotExpression( w_windowId t_expr l_context [ ?expr		l_dispExprList ] [ ?index		l_waveIndexList ] [ ?color		l_colorList ] [ ?lineType			l_styleList ] [ ?dataSymbol			l_symbolList ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?yNumber			l_yNumberList ] [ ?stripNumber			l_stripNumberList ] [ ?showSymbols			l_showList ] [ ?lineStyle			l_styleList ] [ ?lineThickness 		l_thicknessList ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Evaluates the t_expr expression and assigns the numbers specified in l_waveIndexList to the waveforms resulting from the evaluation.

functions.name: awvPlotList
functions.syntax: awvPlotList( w_windowId l_YListList l_XList [ ?expr			l_exprList ] [ ?index			l_waveIndexList ] [ ?color			l_colorList ] [ ?lineType			l_styleList ] [ ?dataSymbol			l_symbolList ] [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?yNumber			l_yNumberList ] [ ?stripNumber			l_stripNumberList ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Plots the Y values in l_YListList against the X values in l_XList and displays the resulting waveforms in a subwindow. If you do not specify numbers for the waveforms in l_waveIndexList, the lowest unused numbers for the subwindow are assigned.

functions.name: awvPlotSignals
functions.syntax: awvPlotSignals( l_sigList [ ?plotStyle t_style ] [ ?graphType t_type ] [ ?graphModifier l_modifier ]  [ ?wavetype g_waveType ] )
functions.description: Displays a signal in the graph window.

functions.name: awvPlotSimpleExpression
functions.syntax: awvPlotSimpleExpression( t_expression  [ ?plotStyle t_plotStyle ] [ ?graphType t_graphType ] [ ?graphModifier t_graphModifier ] ) => o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Evaluates an expression and plots the resulting waveform.

functions.name: awvPlotWaveform
functions.syntax: awvPlotWaveform( w_windowId l_waveform [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] [ ?yNumber			l_yNumberList ] [ ?stripNumber			l_stripNumberList ] [ ?expr			l_exprList ] [ ?index			l_waveIndexList ] [ ?component			t_component ] [ ?color			l_colorList ] [ ?lineType			l_styleList ] [ ?lineStyle			l_styleList ]  [ ?lineThickness l_thicknessList ] [ ?dataSymbol			l_symbolList ] [ ?showSymbols			l_showList ] [ ?barBase			t_barBase ] [ ?barWidth			t_barWidth ] [ ?barShift			t_barShift ] [ ?yAxisUnit			t_yAxisUnit ] [ ?yAxisLabel			t_yAxisLabel ] [ ?label			t_label ] [ ?modifierType				t_modifierType ] [ ?graphType			t_graphType ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Plots the waveforms in the l_waveform list in a subwindow. If you do not specify numbers for the waveforms in l_waveIndexList, the lowest unused numbers for the subwindow are assigned.

functions.name: awvPlotWaveformOption
functions.syntax: awvPlotWaveformOption( w_windowId x_waveIndex t_component [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Sets the plot option for a particular waveform in a subwindow.

functions.name: awvPrintWaveform
functions.syntax: awvPrintWaveform(  [ ?output		t_filename | p_port ]  [ ?numSigDigits			 x_sigDigits ]  [ ?format		 	s_format ]  [ ?numSpaces			x_numSpaces ]  [ ?width			x_width ]  [ ?from			x_from ]  [ ?to			x_to ]  [ ?step			x_step ]  o_waveform1			[o_waveform2 ...]  )  => t / nil
functions.description: Prints the text data of the waveforms specified in the list of waveforms in a result display window.

functions.name: awvRedisplaySubwindow
functions.syntax: awvRedisplaySubwindow( w_windowId [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] g_readData ) => t / nil
functions.description: Refreshes the display for a subwindow.

functions.name: awvRedisplayWindow
functions.description: Refreshes the display for a Waveform window.

functions.name: awvRedrawWindowMenuCB
functions.description: Redraws all the objects (e.g. waveforms, markers) in the waveform window.

functions.name: awvRemoveDate
functions.description: Removes the date and time from the Waveform window.

functions.name: awvRemoveLabel
functions.syntax: awvRemoveLabel( w_windowId s_id | l_id  [ ?subwindow			x_subwindow ] ) => t / nil
functions.description: Removes the label, or all the labels identified in a list, from a subwindow.

functions.name: awvRemoveSubwindowTitle
functions.description: Removes the title from a subwindow.

functions.name: awvRemoveTitle
functions.description: Removes the title from a Waveform window.

functions.name: awvResetAllWindows

Most of the time, however, we work on real-valued signals only.

functions.name: evmQAM
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) for multi-mode modulations. The function plots the I versus Q scatterplot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the four possible I and Q symbol combinations and calculating the difference between the original signal level and the ideal signal level.

functions.name: evmQpsk
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatter plot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the four possible I and Q symbol combinations and calculating the difference between the original signal level and the ideal signal level.

An open eye means that the detector can distinguish between 1's and 0's in its input, while a closed eye means that a detector placed on Vout is likely to give errors for certain input bit sequences.

functions.name: psd
functions.description: Describes how the power (or variance) of a time series (signal) is distributed with frequency. Mathematically, it is defined as the Fourier Transform of the auto correlation sequence of the time series (signal). The waveform is first interpolated to generate evenly spaced data points in time. The spacing of the data points is the inverse of the dft sampling frequency. The psd is computed by first breaking up the time interval into overlapping segments. Each segment is multiplied, time point by time point, by the specified windowing function. The dft is performed on each windowed segment of the baseband waveform. At each frequency, the dfts from all segments are averaged together and the squared modulus of these averages gives the psd.

functions.name: vsaSetEMOnlyICTFile

functions.name: vsaSetEMTechFileName

functions.syntax: vsaSetEMTypes(  list (imax iavg irms iacpeak iavgabs) )

functions.name: vsaSetIRPlot

functions.name: vsaSetLRPShortedLayers

functions.name: vsaSetQRCData

functions.description: When specified, displays all resistors on the Voltus-Fi GUI including those for which there are no layout shapes matching the specified resistor coordinates. These resistors are displayed using stick diagrams.
